name: Caelin
description:
Stop guessing how a knit, shirt, suit, trench, vest or skirt will sit on you. Caelin turns your portrait into a quiet collegiate outfit, so you see outer, middle and next-to-the-skin layers on your own face before you commit.
Caelin is a wardrobe for layered looks, not a storefront of finished clothes. You choose Campus, Weekend, Commute, Library, Lecture or Afternoon tea, then hang Knitwear, Shirt, Suit, Trench, a vest, cardigan or skirt as the focus. The picture that comes back keeps you recognizable and keeps the palette muted, so the question is always the same: do these layers belong together on you.
• See the stack on your portrait. A generated look is drawn from the photo you take or pick, with garment focus and occasion you set, so knit, collar, jacket, coat and skirt layers separate instead of melting into one blob.
• Keep the day inside one collegiate mood. Campus, the library, a lecture hall and afternoon tea share navy, camel and pewter. Accessory sets and cloth character stay in that range, which makes the next choice smaller and calmer.
• Compare before you decide. Place two looks side by side for layers and accessories. Try the coat on or off, or ask for knit, shirt, suit and trench from the same portrait, and spend attention on the difference that matters.
• Keep a wardrobe you can reopen. Save a reference, store a layer recipe with an optional local effect picture, and record a short fitting note on a look. The note stays with that plate so you can play it when you return.
• Trust the limit of a reference. Every picture says it does not show true dye, size or a finished service, so you judge the layers rather than treat it as a finished garment.
Open Caelin, hang your portrait, and let a quiet layered outfit show you the next campus, library or afternoon tea — on you, not on a mannequin.

name: Skybreak Patrol
description:
Skybreak Patrol — аркадный космический шутер от YETI³. Выбирайте секторы на карте кампании, уклоняйтесь от залпов и сражайтесь с боссом в каждом пятом секторе. Новые секторы открываются по мере прохождения, а к пройденным боям можно возвращаться.

Между вылетами выбирайте корабли и пилотов, улучшайте вооружение и защиту, собирайте кристаллы в кузнице и выполняйте задания. В бою используйте пушки, ракеты, лазер, электромагнитный импульс и ядерный удар.

Игра работает офлайн, сохраняет прогресс и рекорды на устройстве. Она бесплатна, без рекламы и встроенных покупок. Интерфейс автоматически выбирает язык устройства из шести доступных.

name: Letter Isle: Word Puzzle
description:
Swipe across the letters, find the words, grow your island.

Letter Isle is a calm, colourful word puzzle. Make words from the letter wheel and fill in the crossword. Every two levels add a new building to your island: a hut, a pier, a lighthouse and more. When an island is finished, set sail for the next one in the archipelago.

10 ISLANDS, 200 LEVELS
• Seaside Village, Forest Isle, Star Peak, Oasis Isle, Glacier Isle, Volcano Isle, Coral Reef, Cloud Isle, Blossom Valley and Crystal Isle
• Every island has its own colours, music and resident: Pinch the crab, Spike the hedgehog, Hoot the owl and friends
• Every island has its own twist: locked letters, star time, gold tiles and hidden letters
• After 200 levels, Explore mode gives you endless levels

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
• Solve the daily puzzle, keep your streak going and share your result

STARS AND COLLECTIONS
• 3 stars per level: finish it, use no hints, try no wrong words
• Every word you find goes into your word album, and every finished island gives you a card
• Valid words that are not in the grid fill your bonus chest
• Decorate finished islands with rainbows, lights, fireworks and more

HINTS
• The bulb reveals a letter, the flashlight reveals a chosen letter everywhere, the rocket reveals five tiles at once

FOR EVERYONE
• Large text and colour-blind mode
• English and Turkish
• Vibration, sound and music settings

GOOD TO KNOW
• Free to play, supported by ads. No ad ever interrupts a level, and there are no ads in your first 10 levels
• Watch an optional ad to double a reward or get a free hint
• No account and no in-app purchases
• Your progress is saved on your phone. Plays offline

name: Short Games - 5s Microgames
description:
5-second microgames, one after another.

Each game gives you a single command — "DODGE!", "WHACK!", "PUMP!" — so you get the rules at a glance.
Clear one and the next game peeks in from the bottom. Swipe up. Again. And again.

• Each game lasts about 5 seconds
• Three misses and it's game over
• It speeds up as you go
• 30 microgames that look and play a little differently every time
• New games join the mix the more you play
• Pick any game from the collection to practice it
• One finger: tap, swipe, drag
• Lovingly shaded sunset-colored pixel art
• Collection book and score sharing

This app shows ads. "Remove Ads" (one-time purchase) removes interstitial ads.

name: S.O.S 2.0 Lost Place
description:
Eine Trennung oder das Ende einer Ehe wirft viele Fragen auf. Soll ich mich noch einmal melden? Warum kreisen meine Gedanken? Wie komme ich mit der Sehnsucht zurecht?

S.O.S 2.0 Lost Place hilft dir, deine Gefühle einzuordnen und einen nächsten Schritt zu finden. Gib eine Frage oder ein Stichwort ein oder stöbere in den Themen Liebe, Beziehung, Trauer, Liebeskummer und Emotionen.

Die Antworten erklären, was gerade in dir vorgehen kann, was dir im Alltag helfen kann und was du besser lässt. Dazu kommen Anleitungen und eine bebilderte Hilfe. Die Inhalte und die Suche sind offline verfügbar. Die App bietet Orientierung und ersetzt keine professionelle Beratung.

name: Advent Calendar Story Book
description:
An advent calendar with a story behind every door, for your iPhone and Apple Watch.

From December 1 to 24, one painted door opens each day on a snowy mountain town. Behind it waits the next chapter of an original Christmas tale, The Lamplighter and the Lost Star: ten-year-old Wren is lighting the town's twenty-four lanterns alone for the first time when a small, frightened star tumbles out of the sky. To send Pim home by midnight on Christmas Eve, Wren will need a flame that has never gone out, a bell that has been silent for twenty years, and a song sung by the whole town together. Along the way there is a goat who eats everything, a grumpy clockmaker with a secret, a fish with very particular taste in pillows, and a storm called the Howl.

Each chapter is a few minutes of warm, funny, cliff-hanger reading for ages 6 to 99, perfect to read aloud at bedtime, with its own painted storybook illustration. Today's door glows until you open it; opening it plays a little bell jingle and a sparkle of vibration. Doors that are not ready yet stay locked and tell you how many days are left, so nobody can peek ahead. On Christmas Day the star opens with the epilogue, and the whole story stays readable until the end of January.

ON IPHONE
• The calendar is a full-screen painted town at night, with living northern lights, falling snow and lit windows.
• 24 painted wooden doors swing open in 3D with a shower of sparks.
• Each chapter opens as a storybook page with a large painting, a drop cap and adjustable text size.
• Read to me: your iPhone can read the chapter aloud with its own voice, paragraph by paragraph.
• A storybook gallery of every painting, a cast of characters with a map of the town, and a Christmas Day star screen.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show today's door, or the days until the first one.

ON APPLE WATCH
• The illustrated calendar with its 24 doors on your wrist: tap a door, or turn the Digital Crown to choose one.
• Read each chapter in large book type and scroll with the Digital Crown.
• Complications show today's door or the countdown on your watch face.
• A calm always-on screen with today's door number.
• The watch app works on its own. With both installed, doors opened on the watch are opened on the iPhone too, and the other way round.

FEATURES
• 24 doors; one new door opens each day from December 1 to 24, by your device's date
• An original Christmas story in 24 chapters plus a Christmas Day epilogue, written for this app
• 25 painted storybook illustrations, one per chapter
• A different little bell jingle for every door, and a sparkle vibration (both can be switched off)
• Countdown before December; read it all again from Christmas Day until the end of January
• Family-friendly: gentle, funny and safe for young children
• The story is in English

PRIVACY
No ads, no accounts, no in-app purchases, no tracking, no internet. The app collects nothing. Only your opened doors are shared between your own iPhone and Apple Watch.

One purchase covers the iPhone app and the Apple Watch app.

name: ALIKS CRM
description:
ALIKS CRM — мобільний застосунок для команд, які вже працюють у кабінеті ALIKS AI CRM. Усе важливе з кабінету тепер у телефоні.

ВХІДНІ
• Розмови з WhatsApp, Telegram, Viber, Instagram, Messenger та сайту в одному списку.
• Відповідайте текстом, фото, файлом або голосовим повідомленням.
• Видно, хто відповів останнім — бот чи менеджер, і хто веде розмову.
• Передайте розмову колезі або поставте бота на паузу одним дотиком.

СПОВІЩЕННЯ
• Push, коли бот передав розмову менеджеру, прийшла заявка, оплата або новий лід.
• Відповідь клієнту прямо зі сповіщення.
• Тихі години та вибір, які сповіщення отримувати на цей телефон.

УГОДИ
• Воронки й етапи, сума та відповідальний.
• Переведення угоди на наступний етап, нотатки, дзвінок клієнту.
• Нова угода й новий контакт за хвилину.

ЗАВДАННЯ
• Протерміновані, на сьогодні й на завтра.
• Постановка завдань собі та колегам.

ДАШБОРД
• Керівник бачить увесь кабінет: хто чекає відповіді, скільки виграно за місяць, навантаження команди.
• Менеджер бачить свої розмови, завдання й угоди.

ДОСТАВКА
• Для кабінетів з підключеною Новою поштою: одержувач, місто, відділення, вартість і статуси відправлень.

Світла й темна тема — за налаштуванням телефона.

Щоб користуватись застосунком, потрібен обліковий запис ALIKS AI CRM. Його створює компанія на сайті aicrm.aliks.com.ua, після чого керівник додає працівників.

name: Aprender la Hora con Tic
description:
Aprender la hora nunca fue tan divertido. Con Tic, un despertador muy simpático, los niños aprenden a leer el reloj paso a paso, a su ritmo y jugando.

DE «EN PUNTO» AL RELOJ DE 24 HORAS
19 niveles en 7 unidades que siguen el orden del colegio:
• El reloj: en punto e y media
• Los cuartos: y cuarto y menos cuarto
• De cinco en cinco: y cinco, y diez, menos veinte…
• Minuto a minuto: todas las rayitas del reloj
• Mañana, tarde y noche: de la mañana, del mediodía, de la tarde…
• Reloj digital y reloj de 24 horas: las 13:00, las 17:30…
• El tiempo que pasa: ¿qué hora será?, ¿cuánto tiempo ha pasado?

APRENDER JUGANDO
• Lecciones guiadas con Tic, que explica cada paso con voz
• 12 tipos de ejercicios: elegir la hora, mover las agujas, escuchar y tocar el reloj, completar la frase, pasar a 24 horas…
• Colores que ayudan: la aguja corta (la hora) es roja y la larga (los minutos), verde
• Estrellas, puntos, rachas diarias y celebraciones para que quieran volver cada día

PENSADA PARA FAMILIAS
• Voz en español de España y de Latinoamérica («menos cuarto» o «un cuarto para»)
• Objetivo diario y aviso opcional para no perder la racha
• Zona de padres con el progreso: lecciones, niveles, racha y estrellas
• Compras y ajustes protegidos con control parental
• Sin anuncios, sin cuentas y sin recoger datos del niño
• Funciona sin conexión

PRUEBA GRATIS
La primera unidad es gratis. Con un único pago desbloqueas para siempre los 19 niveles, sin suscripción.

Términos: https://aprender-la-hora.vercel.app/terminos
Privacidad: https://aprender-la-hora.vercel.app/privacidad

name: Aquarius Pro Kiosk
description:
Aquarius Pro Kiosk puts the Aquarius warehouse screens on an iPhone or iPad, for seafood and food businesses that run Aquarius Pro.

Set the device up once with a setup code from your Aquarius administrator, and your team can:
• Pick orders by route or by stock line
• Work through fresh, frozen and dry orders
• Check stock levels, intake and grading
• Reprint and cancel labels
• Scan barcodes with the device camera

The app opens your company's own Aquarius system, so the screens, permissions and data are the ones your administrator has set up. You need an Aquarius Pro account to use it.

Questions or help: enquiries@acss.co.uk

name: Arrow Escape Lab
description:
Find the right order. Clear every arrow.

Tap an arrow to send it out of the grid in its fixed direction. Other arrows and obstacles block the way, so each move can open a new possibility.

Explore 1,000 regular levels across ten worlds, with 100 levels in each world. Energy, switches, gates, locked arrows, rotatable arrows, portals and direction fields add new decisions as you progress. A separate laboratory offers 30 more puzzles for exploring mechanics.

Undo, restart and local hints let you try another idea. Collect up to three stars: complete the level, solve without hints, and keep blocked attempts to two or fewer. Undo has no star penalty.

All levels and 60 game languages are included locally. The app follows a supported system language, or you can choose a language in settings. Progress is saved on your device. Sound, music and haptics have separate settings.

One purchase. No ads, in-app purchases or subscriptions. Fully playable offline after installation. No player account is required.

name: ASI-OS
description: ASI-OS ist das interne Firmenbetriebssystem der ASI-Wache GmbH. Mitarbeitende nutzen die App für Einsatzplanung, Arbeitszeiterfassung, projektbezogene Informationen, Dokumente und betriebliche Abläufe. Der Zugriff ist nur mit einem freigeschalteten ASI-OS-Konto möglich.

name: AthlorX: Corrida e Treino
description:
Treinas sozinho e queres um plano a sério? A AthlorX foi criada por um treinador para atletas que querem evoluir — na corrida, no CrossFit, no Hyrox ou no ginásio.

UM PLANO FEITO PARA TI
• Escolhe a tua modalidade: corrida, força, CrossFit, Hyrox, funcional, HIIT, perda de gordura ou mobilidade.
• Combina corrida com outra modalidade, com dias próprios para cada uma.
• Planos por nível, para casa ou ginásio, com o equipamento que tens.
• Reordena a semana, junta sessões no mesmo dia e adiciona treinos extra.

CORRIDA A SÉRIO
• Fácil, longa, tempo, intervalos, séries e colinas, com progressão semana a semana.
• Ritmos calculados a partir das tuas marcas (5 km, 10 km, meia, maratona).
• Ritmo por km com GPS e coaching no fim de cada corrida.

CROSSFIT E HYROX
• Biblioteca de WODs: Girls, Hero, Games e Open, com versões RX, intermédia e iniciante.
• Cria os teus WODs: AMRAP, For Time, EMOM, Tabata, Death By, buy-in/cash-out, escadas e esquemas de reps.
• Cronómetros com sinais sonoros, pontuação e recordes.
• Hyrox: estações, compromised runs e simulações de prova por nível.

EVOLUÇÃO QUE SE VÊ
• Recordes pessoais detetados automaticamente.
• Histórico, resumo semanal, sequências e conquistas.
• Integração com Apple Saúde.

PREMIUM
• Plano adaptativo: check-in semanal que ajusta volume e intensidade ao que sentes e rendes.
• Progressões: gráficos de evolução por benchmark e teste.
• Hyrox completo.
• Estatísticas completas: forma e fadiga, eficiência de corrida e recordes.
Tudo o resto é grátis.

OS TEUS DADOS SÃO TEUS
Sem criação de conta. Os teus treinos ficam guardados no teu telemóvel, com cópia de segurança quando quiseres.

Disponível em português, inglês, espanhol, francês, alemão e italiano.

SUBSCRIÇÃO
O Premium está disponível em subscrição mensal ou anual, com 7 dias grátis. O pagamento é cobrado na tua conta Apple ID no fim do período grátis. A subscrição renova automaticamente, salvo se for cancelada pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período em curso. Gere ou cancela nas definições da tua conta App Store.

Termos: https://sites.google.com/view/athlorx/termos
Privacidade: https://sites.google.com/view/athlorx/privacidade

name: Avia To Raning Simulator
description:
Unlock the fascinating world of aerodynamic wonders through this immersive digital workshop designed for curious minds and creative families. Experience the joy of crafting intricate folded crafts that glide gracefully across your living room. The app offers a comprehensive suite of digital tools to refine your folding techniques and master the delicate art of flight. Within the flight laboratory, you gain access to precision trajectory simulation tools and advanced trim adjustment features. If your creation experiences a wobbly path, utilize the built-in diagnostic repair system to calibrate balance and stability. Keep track of every launch using an integrated test console featuring a high-precision stopwatch and real-time activity tracking, ensuring that every session is documented with professional accuracy. You will discover how different structural modifications influence performance, turning every experimental session into a valuable learning opportunity about basic physics and fluid dynamics. We ensure that every interaction provides a deep dive into the mechanics of flight, helping you grasp the fundamental principles of air movement and lift in a fun, tactile way that bridges the gap between imagination and reality.

Deepen your expertise with an extensive library of animated folding tutorials that guide you through complex geometric sequences. Every instruction is clear and approachable, making it simple to construct high-performance gliders regardless of your current experience level. The platform includes educational modules that explain the science behind lift, drag, and gravity, reinforced by interactive quizzes that test your newfound knowledge. Host friendly competitions for up to eight individuals using the local scoring interface, creating a perfect environment for quality bonding time at home. Your progress is cataloged within a personal hangar that retains detailed history logs, flight records, and statistical insights regarding your best aerial achievements. Unlock new visual styles and customization options as you climb through the ranks, earning digital badges that celebrate your dedication to mastering the sky. The interface remains fluid and intuitive, allowing for seamless transitions between structural design, performance testing, and educational content without unnecessary complexity. Engaging with these resources helps sharpen your problem-solving skills while you explore the limitless potential of a simple sheet of paper transformed into an airborne vessel.

Connect with an intelligent guidance companion specifically trained to provide helpful advice regarding structural geometry and flight mechanics. This conversational feature is protected by strict safety measures to ensure that all interactions remain strictly focused on the hobby of crafting and launching folded paper objects. Parents retain complete control over these features, with optional content management and clear permission prompts integrated throughout the experience. Everything you save, including your custom model configurations, historical flight metrics, and personal advancement records, remains securely stored on your device to maintain total privacy. The digital assistant operates with complete focus on clarity and education, ensuring that users of all ages can gain meaningful insights while exploring the nuances of aeronautical design. By combining hands-on creativity with high-tech simulation, the app fosters a unique bridge between traditional manual crafts and modern scientific analysis, encouraging exploration, experimentation, and hours of wholesome engagement for every participant. Discover how simple manual adjustments translate into massive improvements in distance and stability, letting you witness the immediate impact of your engineering decisions. With a focus on accessibility and entertainment, this experience invites everyone to become a master of the air, one fold at a time, within a safe and supportive digital

name: book4me: Reading Journal
description:
Your books. Your pace. Your ideas.

book4me brings together your personal library, reading progress and the thoughts you want to keep. Make room for books you want to read, follow your current reading and remember what stays with you.

A LIBRARY WITH YOUR HISTORY
• Add and edit books, authors and editions.
• Look up an edition by ISBN through Open Library and review its details before saving.
• Organize books by status and start a reread while keeping earlier reading cycles and notes.

FOLLOW EVERY READING SESSION
• Track progress in pages, percentage or time.
• Start, pause, resume and save a session with the reading timer.
• View completed sessions on the calendar and set a weekly goal in minutes.
• Preview your weekly recap and choose whether to include book titles when sharing it.

KEEP YOUR IDEAS CLOSE
• Write and edit notes attached to each book.
• Recognize text from an image on your device, review the result and append it to your note.

YOUR READING RECORDS, WITH YOU
• Use the library and manual reading records offline, without an account.
• Export a complete JSON backup or your current book list as CSV.
• Review data and possible duplicates before importing.
• Adjust language, theme and text size using system features.

book4me is designed for iPhone, iPad and Mac. The interface includes English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German and Italian, with regional options.

ISBN lookup and catalog cover loading require an internet connection; available details vary by edition. Text recognition depends on the image and device capabilities.

This version focuses on your on-device library. Public synchronization and subscriptions are not active. book4me organizes your reading; it does not provide ebook or audiobook content.

name: Buoy: Swim Coach
description:
Buoy is a swim coach for your iPhone and Apple Watch. Nervous in water, learning your first lengths or training for a race: Buoy finds where you are and gives you one clear next step for every swim.

ONE THING AT A TIME
• A quick check finds your level in about a minute.
• Your path is built from 145 swimming skills, in the order that works.
• Today shows one thing to work on, with a cue short enough to remember in the water.

SEE IT DONE RIGHT
• An animated swimmer shows how each drill is done: floats, kicks, breathing, all four strokes, turns and dives.
• Example videos for nearly every skill.

MADE FOR THE POOL
• Pool mode: big type, a big Next button for wet hands, hold and rest timers, and a screen that stays on.
• Plan my swim: 20, 30 or 45 minutes built around today's skill, with a warm-up, the check and a cool-down.
• Your step on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

ON APPLE WATCH
• Today's swim on your wrist, one step at a time, with the swimmer showing how.
• Records a pool swim with its lengths and distance in Apple Health.
• A tap on your wrist when a hold or rest is over. Water Lock while you swim.

FIX WHAT'S GOING WRONG
Sinking legs? Swallowing water? A few quick checks find the fix, and Buoy checks again later that it stuck.

CALM WHEN YOU NEED IT
Nervous in water? The calm track starts gently and goes at your pace.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• How deep you've gone, your swim log and your swim days.
• Game Center leaderboards for skills earned and problems solved.

WORKS WITH BUDY
Every Budy plan includes Buoy. Budy members unlock it without a purchase, and their swims count toward Swimming in Budy.

SUBSCRIPTION
The quick check, your plan, finding a fix and the safety guide are free. Practising with Buoy needs a monthly Buoy subscription or any Budy plan. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it's turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Buoy is a coaching aid, not a lifeguard. Swim where it's safe, and have a lifeguard or buddy watching when you practise breath holds or in deep water.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://budy.fit/privacy

name: C.C’s DeepArtEffect
description:
C.C’s DeepArtEffect adds motion and depth to a photo you have already taken. Made by an SSI underwater photography instructor.

Your phone finds the subject in the photo. The effect is applied behind it; the subject stays sharp and its edge blends softly into the background.

• Blur: background blur, flow, spin
• Zoom: zoom-in, zoom-out, zoom pan
• Creative: tunnel, vortex, tube, spiral, fisheye
• Strobe trail: the motion trail also comes from the subject, which stays sharp (slow shutter and strobe look)
• Overlay: combine two photos with 14 blend modes; use the Overlay camera to line up the second shot with the first
• Tap to choose the subject; the point you tap stays sharpest
• Choose the effect centre and the flow direction by hand
• Refine the subject with a brush; works with a mouse, trackpad or housing remote too
• Always saved at your photo's own resolution: HEIC 10-bit, JPEG or lossless 16-bit TIFF
• Date, camera and location data are kept; your original photo never changes

Vortex, tube and spiral work best on macro photos.

Free version: background blur and zoom-in, full resolution, no watermark.
DeepArtEffect Plus unlocks all effects, strobe trail and Overlay.

Everything runs on your phone. No account, no data collection.

Subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage it in your Apple account settings.
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://ccdeepart.github.io/deepart-privacy/effect/privacy.html

name: CardLedger - Card SMS Ledger
description:
Keep track of card approval messages and spending. Designed for Korean card messages.

• Paste an approval message or add an expense manually
• Review recent transactions and weekly spending
• Explore spending by date and category
• Review, edit and classify entries
• Optional on-device AI analysis on supported devices

Entries are stored on your device. Shortcut automation requires setup in Apple Shortcuts. AI availability depends on your device and Apple Intelligence settings.

name: Cay: Island Widgets & Timer
description:
Timers you can see at a glance.

Start a timer and it stays in sight: on the Lock Screen, in the Dynamic Island and in StandBy. Pause it, add time or stop it right there. Nothing opens.

WHAT YOU CAN RUN
• Focus: blocks with breaks and rounds, and a ring when it is time to rest
• Timer: tea, eggs, pasta, laundry or any minutes
• Countdown: days to a trip or a birthday, typed in or picked from your Calendar
• Stopwatch: count up and pause from the Lock Screen
• Parking: your paid time, a warning 10 minutes before it runs out and a note where the car is
• Rest timer: rest between sets with a set counter
• Charging: how long the iPhone has been charging

WIDGETS
• Countdown for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen
• Quick start: one tap starts a timer
• Battery, and your timekeeper with today's focus minutes
• Control Center buttons, Siri and Shortcuts actions

A TIMEKEEPER OF YOUR OWN

Pick one of eight pixel-art cats to sit next to your timers. Every focus minute earns a treat, and treats unlock new cats.

CAY PRO

Focus, timers and two countdowns are free. Pro unlocks parking, rest, stopwatch and charging timers, unlimited countdowns and every cat at once. Choose monthly, yearly with a 7-day free trial, or a one-time purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in Settings.

No ads. No account. No tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone.

The Dynamic Island needs iPhone 14 Pro or later. On other iPhones the same timers live on the Lock Screen.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://somefork2.github.io/cay-support/privacy.html

name: Color Puzzle - Slide & Rotate
description:
Slide tiles to make each block a single color.

Swipe to move a whole row or column. Tiles that slide off one edge wrap around to the other. In some stages, you can also rotate blocks. Think about the order of your moves, then fill every block with tiles of the same color. Each color can finish in any block.

• 50 stages, from small boards to puzzles with nine blocks
• Free play with randomly shuffled 4 × 4 or 6 × 6 boards
• Undo your last move or get a hint when you're stuck
• Tile symbols, adjustable sound, and a reduce motion option
• Pick up where you left off with progress saved on your device
• Play in English or Japanese

Watch an optional video ad to see one way to solve the puzzle.

name: ConfirmaCitas
description:
ConfirmaCitas is the app for patients of clinics that use ConfirmaCitas, starting with physiotherapy. Sign in with your e-mail and a one-time code, no passwords.

YOUR APPOINTMENTS
• Upcoming and past, with the clinic, service, date and time.
• Each appointment shows the clinic's policy and until when you can cancel for free, calculated for that appointment.
• Confirm your attendance with one tap.

CANCEL OR CHANGE THE TIME
• Before cancelling you see the clinic's policy and the option to change the time instead.
• You can leave a reason if you want.
• If the clinic charges for late cancellations, the app tells you before you confirm.
• Change the time by picking a day and a free slot, without calling.

BOOK
• Book at the clinics linked to your account or search for one by name.
• Open your clinic's booking links, invite code or QR code.

PRE-VISIT QUESTIONNAIRE
• When your clinic sends it, mark on a body map (front and back) where it hurts, the side, the intensity from 0 to 10, the type of pain, since when and what makes it worse.
• You can answer with an accessible list instead of the map.
• If you filled it in before, you can start from your previous answers.
• Only your clinic sees your answers.

NOTIFICATIONS
• The app asks for permission when you book or confirm, not when you open it.
• Confirm from the notification without opening the app. If you choose Cancel, the app opens to show you the policy first.

ALSO
• Add the appointment to your calendar without giving access to your calendars.
• Directions to the clinic with Maps.
• Profile: your name, add a phone or e-mail with a code, your clinics, notifications, log out and delete your account from the app.

PRIVACY
No ads, no analytics and no tracking. Your data is used only to make the app work and for your clinic to manage your appointments.

Light and dark mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver.

The app is in Spanish and English. You need an appointment or an invitation from a clinic that uses ConfirmaCitas.

name: ContrastLoom
description:
Test a foreground and background in a live text sample. Enter hex values, use the system color picker, or sample a color from a photo you select. See the contrast ratio and separate WCAG 2.2 AA text targets for ordinary and large text.

Save promising pairs in named palettes with optional notes. Compare them by contrast, reopen a saved pair in Check, or share the palette as a plain-text report. Your palettes and notes are stored in the app's local library.

Check and Palettes work offline.

name: Copenpark - Kbh Parkeringskort
description:
Copenpark tells you where you can park with a Copenhagen beboerlicens (resident parking licence).

Open the map and the app shows:
- which zone you are in
- whether your licence is valid there
- the hours, rules and rates that apply

Features
- Zone map with satellite view
- Address search
- Works offline with cached zones and map
- Danish and English

Independent app
Copenpark is an independent app and is not affiliated with Københavns Kommune. Zone data and rules may be incomplete or out of date. Signs and markings on the street always prevail. Always check kk.dk for the official rules.

Support: https://copenpark.hejtech.io/support

name: Crabivora
description:
Crabivora is the all-in-one trade manager built for river crab and Chinese mitten crab (hairy crab) businesses — farms, co-ops, wholesalers, market stalls and restaurant suppliers.

Register what you buy, know exactly what's alive in your tanks, invoice customers in seconds and see your true profit on every sale.

PROCUREMENT REGISTRATION
• Record purchases from farms and co-ops by grade, sex, pieces, weight and price per kg
• Origin waters: Yangcheng Lake, Taihu, Hongze, Gucheng, Chaohu, pond farms and more
• Freight and handling folded automatically into your landed cost per kg
• Pay in full, part-pay or buy on credit — track what you owe each supplier
• Smart grade suggestion from average crab weight

LIVE INVENTORY
• Every purchase line becomes a traceable stock lot
• Grade × sex matrix: King, Premium, Select, Standard and Juvenile, male and female
• Freshness alerts: Prime, Sell soon and Urgent by days in tank
• Log mortality and losses (weak, missing limb, weight shrinkage) with their cost
• Stocktake adjustments and moves between holding tanks, cold room and ponds
• Full movement history and survival rate

SALES INVOICING
• Tap your tanks to build an invoice — oldest lots are used first (FIFO) automatically
• Live margin per line, discounts, tax and payment terms
• Beautiful PDF invoices to share by WeChat, WhatsApp, email, AirDrop or print
• Partial payments, overdue alerts and one-tap "receive payment"
• Void an invoice and the crabs return to their original lots
• Lot traceability: see which lake and tank every sold crab came from

TRANSACTIONS & LEDGER
• Cash position, money to collect and money owed to suppliers
• Expenses by category: feed, ice, packaging, transport, labour and more
• Money in vs money out by day, week and month

DASHBOARD
• Today's revenue, gross profit and margin
• Sales vs purchases chart and stock-by-grade breakdown
• Top buyers and recent activity
• Alerts for aging stock, low stock, overdue invoices and supplier payables

WORK AS A TEAM
• Owners invite staff with a simple join code
• Everyone sees the same live stock, invoices and ledger on their own iPhone
• Roles: Owner, Manager and Staff control who can void, delete and change settings
• Every record shows who created it
• Shared invoice numbering — two phones never issue the same number

OFFLINE-FIRST
Works at the pond, on the boat or in the market with no signal. Everything is saved on your iPhone and syncs automatically when you're back online.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads and no tracking. Use it fully on one iPhone without an account, or sign in to work with your team. Export a full backup anytime, and delete your account from inside the app.

Made for the crab trade — from the lake to the table.

name: CraftPrint: Actual Size Print
description:
Turn your photos, labels and craft patterns into prints at the size you choose. Enter dimensions in centimeters, millimeters or inches, check the live paper preview, then export a PDF or print with AirPrint.

A SMALL WORKSHOP FOR BIG IDEAS
• Import a photo or a page from a PDF.
• Set width and height, with an option to keep proportions.
• Arrange repeated copies for labels, stickers or gift tags.
• Choose A4, US Letter, A3 or US Legal paper.
• Adjust margins, spacing and paper orientation.
• Add cut guides or mirror artwork for compatible transfers.
• Save layouts and keep finished PDFs ready to print again.

GO BEYOND ONE SHEET WITH PRO
Split a large design across multiple sheets with adjustable overlap, joining guides and row/column labels. Useful for craft templates, sewing patterns, stencils and posters made from your own artwork.

CHECK BEFORE YOU PRINT
A free 100 mm check sheet and printer correction help you check your printer's scale. Print at 100% / Actual Size with the matching paper. AirPrint needs a compatible printer; you can also share the PDF with a print shop. Paper margins and printer settings can affect the result.

START FREE, UPGRADE ONCE
Your first basic export and one saved layout are free. Finish an optional rewarded ad to earn another basic export. The free version includes ads. CraftPrint Pro is a one-time purchase for unlimited exports, large tiled designs, unlimited saved layouts and no ads. No subscription. Previously saved PDFs can be shared or printed again without using another export.

YOUR DESIGNS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
No account is required. Design processing and the workshop library stay on your device. Advertising and purchase services use the internet. Files and Photos may download originals from iCloud.

Bring your artwork. Choose its size. Make something.

name: CreaLings
description:
Every photo hatches a creature.

Point your camera at flowers, graffiti, fruit, a sunset or an old stone wall – CreaLings reads the colors of your picture and awakens a unique CreaLing from them. The subject decides the element and the stats – and every hatch looks a little different.

COLLECT
• 12 elements from fire to ghost, 10 body types, 120 atlas fields to discover
• Rare mixed CreaLings with two elements
• Epic CreaLings with the Aurora aura and their own special ability – only from perfect photos
• Levels, nicknames and favorites for your darlings
• Evolution: at levels 10 and 20 your CreaLings grow bigger and gain a crystal fan, energy wings and element orbs

BATTLE
• Teams of three CreaLings, line up front/middle/back
• Tap at the right moment: the timing ring decides perfect hits and blocks
• Strengths and weaknesses: water puts out fire, lightning barely affects earth, stones hardly hit ghosts – but no element is fully immune
• Ranked battles against real players' teams via Game Center
• A daily battle, monthly seasons and a giant weekly boss every week

NEW EVERY DAY
• Daily goals, daily streak with gifts, element week, 25 achievements
• Friendly battles via code or QR code

YOUR PHOTOS STAY WITH YOU
The photo is analyzed only on your device (48 × 48 pixels) and discarded right away. No uploads, no face recognition, no location. No account, no ads.

FAIR SHOP
Auras for your CreaLings (silver, gold, galaxy), arenas, frames, titles and card designs – visible to other players, but with no battle advantage.

Camera photos only – go out and explore!

name: Croc Hop
description:
The water is rising and the only way out is up!

In Croc Hop your monkey climbs by hopping on the backs of crocodiles. Stomp a croc with its mouth closed for a SUPER JUMP. But watch out for red eyes: that croc is about to snap!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap the left, middle or right of the screen to jump that way
• Steer in mid-air too
• Land on a closed-mouth croc for a super jump
• Don't land in an open mouth, and don't fall in the water

6 ZONES
• Swamp, River, Open Sea, Storm, Night and the slippery Glacier
• The higher you go, pelicans try to knock you off and piranhas leap from the water

POWERS AND CHARACTERS
• Balloon, Freeze, Magnet and Shield
• Collect bananas and upgrade your powers
• The Frog jumps higher, the Sloth glides, the Parrot double-jumps
• Hats you unlock with your record or buy in the shop

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
• Daily missions with bonus bananas
• 7-day login rewards

GOOD TO KNOW
• Free and supported by ads. No ad ever interrupts a run
• If you like, watch an ad to continue where you fell, double your bananas or get free bananas
• No account, no in-app purchases
• Your progress is saved on your phone. Plays offline
• English, Turkish, German, Spanish and Japanese

name: Declaram: contabilitate PFA
description:
Declaram este contabilitate online pentru PFA și PFI: contabilul firmei îți ține evidența și îți întocmește și depune declarațiile, iar tu folosești aplicația ca să trimiți documentele și să vezi oricând cum stai.

FACTURI
• Emiți facturi din telefon, către firme sau persoane fizice, din România sau din UE.
• Facturile se trimit în e-Factura (SPV), iar statusul îl vezi în aplicație.
• Vezi ce e încasat și ce e restant, și trimiți factura pe email clientului.
• Facturi recurente pentru clienții cu care lucrezi lunar.

CHELTUIELI
• Fotografiezi bonul sau factura, iar aplicația decupează documentul și citește datele.
• Contabilul verifică fiecare cheltuială și îți spune dacă e deductibilă.
• Când lipsește un document, primești o notificare cu ce trebuie încărcat.

DECLARAȚII ȘI TAXE
• Declarația unică și celelalte declarații le întocmește și le depune contabilul.
• Vezi declarațiile depuse, recipisa și suma de plată.
• Urmărești plafoanele de TVA, CAS și CASS și termenele care urmează.

LEGĂTURA CU CONTABILUL
• Scrii direct contabilului din aplicație și primești răspunsul tot aici.
• Încarci extrasele bancare și documentele firmei cerute de contabil.

SIGURANȚĂ
• Conexiune criptată și autentificare în doi pași.
• Contul se poate șterge oricând din aplicație.

Declaram este operat de CONTAB LCE S.R.L., firmă de contabilitate autorizată CECCAR. Aplicația este pentru clienții Declaram.

name: Din Kültürü Soru Bankası
description:
Din Kültürü ve Ahlak Bilgisi Dersi 8. Sınıflar İçin LGS Hazırlık Süreci İçin Hazırlanmış Dev Soru Bankası
Ücretsiz ve Reklamsız.
İster 1 ünite seçin, ister 5 ünite, seçilen üniteleri karıştırıp 10 soruluk deneme testleri oluşturur.
Cevaplar seçildiğinde anında geri bildirim verir, doğru ve yanlış cevapları görüntüler.

name: Doñihue Conectado - Vecinos
description:
Doñihue Conectado es la app oficial de la Ilustre Municipalidad de Doñihue para vecinos y vecinas de Doñihue y Lo Miranda. Reúne en un solo lugar la información y los servicios municipales que usas día a día.

INFORMACIÓN IMPORTANTE
Revisa los avisos destacados de la Municipalidad apenas abres la app.

AVISOS Y NOTIFICACIONES
Recibe alertas de emergencias, cortes de servicios y actividades comunales directamente en tu teléfono.

PAGOS MUNICIPALES
Accede a los pagos de derecho de aseo, patentes municipales y permiso de circulación.

TRÁMITES Y FORMULARIOS
Encuentra formularios para becas, talleres e inscripciones, y entra a la Ventanilla Única para realizar trámites en línea.

MAPA COMUNAL
Ubica oficinas municipales, servicios y lugares de interés de la comuna, busca por nombre o categoría y mira cómo llegar desde donde estás.

BENEFICIOS PARA VECINOS
Conoce los descuentos que ofrecen los comercios asociados al presentar tu Tarjeta Vecino.

EMERGENCIAS
Llama con un toque a Bomberos, Carabineros y otros números de emergencia nacionales y de la comuna.

CONTACTO
Escribe a la Municipalidad, visita su sitio web, revisa sus redes sociales y consulta los horarios de atención.

Doñihue Conectado: tu comuna, más cerca.

name: Driver Princess: Ehliyet Oyunu
description:
Direksiyona geçmeden önce direksiyonu burada tanı.

Driver Princess, ehliyet yolculuğunu ezber sorulardan çıkarıp gerçek bir sürüş deneyimine dönüştürür. Arabana biner, şehre çıkar, kırmızı ışıkta durur, yayaya yol verir, ambulansa şerit açar, paralel parkını yaparsın. Hata yaparsan oyun durur ve ne olduğunu tek cümleyle anlatır. Sınav günü ilk kez karşılaşacağın an kalmaz.

NEDEN DRIVER PRINCESS?

Ehliyet uygulamalarının çoğu sadece soru sorar. Oysa sınavı geçmek, yolda ne yapacağını bilmekle başlar. Driver Princess ikisini birleştirir: önce sürersin, sonra "E-sınavda böyle sorulur" sorusuyla öğrendiğini pekiştirirsin.

GERÇEK TRAFİK, GERÇEK KURALLAR
- 3D şehirde, şehirlerarası yolda ve otoyolda sür
- Işıklı ve kontrolsüz kavşaklar, dönel kavşak, okul bölgesi, yaya geçidi
- DUR levhası, hız sınırı ve yasaklama levhaları
- Her uyarının altında dayandığı trafik mevzuatı yazar

BEKLENMEDİK ANLARA HAZIR OL
- Yola fırlayan top ve ardından koşan çocuk
- Arkadan yaklaşan ambulans
- Park hâlindeki araçtan aniden açılan kapı
- Kör noktada saklanan motosiklet
- Gece, yağmur ve sis: hangi far, ne kadar fren mesafesi?

PARKI STRESSİZ ÖĞREN
- Direksiyon sınavındaki paralel park manevrasının aynısı
- Otoparkta geri park ve yokuşta el freniyle kalkış
- Direksiyonu kendin çevirirsin, istediğin kadar tekrar edersin

SÜRÜCÜ KARNEN HER SÜRÜŞTEN SONRA HAZIR
- 100 puandan başlarsın, her hata puan düşürür, 70 ve üzeri geçer
- Nerede, neden puan kaybettiğini net görürsün
- Üç taç topla, bütün sahneleri tamamla

E-SINAVA TAM HAZIRLIK
- Gerçek sınav düzeninde 50 soruluk deneme: 45 dakika, dört ders
- Kavşak canlandırmalı animasyonlu sorular
- Trafik ve çevre bilgisi, ilk yardım, araç tekniği, trafik adabı
- İlk yardımda güncel bilgiler

DİREKSİYON SINAVI PROVASI
- Gerçek sınavdaki gibi renkli hata sistemi
- Güzergâh her oyunda değişir, ezber yapamazsın

SENİN ARABAN, SENİN TARZIN
- Üç araç: şehirli hatchback, retro mini, köşeli arazi aracı
- Sekiz renk
- Otomatik ya da manuel vites: oyun seçimine göre ayarlanır

HER YERDE ÇALIŞIR
- İnternet olmadan da oynanır
- Türkçe sesli eğitmen her adımda yanında
- Eski telefonlar için hızlı grafik seçeneği

Arabaya biniş, kalkış ve duruş, şehir içi, trafik işaretleri, beklenmedik olaylar, park, şehirlerarası yol, kaza anı ve sınav modları: 9 modül, 28 sahne ve bir e-sınav denemesi.

Driver Princess ücretsizdir, reklam içermez ve kişisel bilgi istemez.

Not: E-sınav soruları özgündür, resmî sınavın çıkmış soruları değildir. Driver Princess bir sürücü kursunun yerini tutmaz; kursa ve sınava hazırlanmana yardım eder.

name: DriverGuide
description:
Learn the road rules of the country you drive in, as a road trip of short stories.

Drive a car across the map, stop by stop. Each stretch of road is a short lesson with a narrator you choose, then quick questions that check what you learned. Every lesson comes from an official source, and the app shows which one.

• Road rules for Ghana and the United Kingdom, with more countries on the way
• Story lessons, narrated aloud, that work offline
• Questions that explain why an answer is right
• Checkpoints, passport stamps and a streak to keep you going
• Rule updates when the law changes
• Friends and a weekly league, if you want them
• Optional DriverGuide Plus subscription (monthly or yearly, auto-renewing): no daily lesson limit, switching between countries, extra rides and paints. Lessons are free for everyone, and your first country is free.

Plus is billed to your Apple ID and renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.
Terms of Use: https://driverguide.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://driverguide.app/privacy/

DriverGuide is a learning aid, not legal advice, and it is not affiliated with any government body. Always follow the official rules and the road signs.

name: Duct Route Check
description:
See how every branch fits into the network.

Duct Route Check compares pressure loss from one main supply to each terminal at the airflows you specify. Keep the connections, assumptions and calculation trail together.

BUILD YOUR NETWORK
• Connect rigid round or rectangular duct runs in a supply tree.
• Enter the required airflow at each terminal. Shared trunk flow is calculated from downstream demands.
• Add straight length, your fitting equivalent lengths and known extra pressure losses.

FOLLOW EVERY ROUTE
• Compare complete supply-to-terminal pressure losses.
• See the highest-loss route and compare it with your entered duct pressure budget.
• Inspect the straight-duct, fitting and extra-loss breakdown for each run, with Reynolds number and Darcy friction factor.

COMPARE BEFORE AND AFTER
• Save an independent baseline before changing the network.
• Review current and baseline results route by route.
• Keep baseline geometry and calculation assumptions with the project.

TAKE THE RECORD WITH YOU
• Preview and export a multipage PDF with inputs, route results, assumptions and sources.
• Export editable project files and import them as separate copies.
• Switch between metric and US customary display units.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Calculations and projects stay on your device. No account, analytics, advertising or developer-operated backend. Source links open externally only when you choose them.

SCOPE
This is a specified-flow pressure-loss estimate for rigid ducts in turbulent flow, not a prediction of delivered airflow, a balancing solver or a certified building design package. It does not size equipment, calculate heat loads or check code compliance. Fitting, junction, terminal and equipment losses must be supplied explicitly. Independently verify source data, the model and site conditions before work.

English interface. Designed for iPhone and iPad.

name: E & G Finanzrechner
description:
Der E & G Finanzrechner hilft dir, Sparen und Entnehmen nachvollziehbar zu berechnen – im Beratungsgespräch oder für eigene Modellrechnungen.

Berechne Startkapital, Rate je Zahlung, Endkapital, Laufzeit oder Effektivzins aus deinen Annahmen.

Bestimme die Zahlungen pro Jahr, berücksichtige eine jährliche Beitragsdynamik und wähle zwischen vor- und nachschüssigen Zahlungen. Übernimm Ergebnisse direkt in die nächste Rechnung oder rufe gespeicherte Werte wieder ab.

Die Berechnungen laufen auf deinem Gerät. Eine Registrierung oder Internetverbindung ist für den Rechner nicht erforderlich. Es gibt keine Werbung und keine In-App-Käufe.

Teile deine Ergebnisse als PDF. Auf Wunsch ergänzt du „Erstellt für“ und „Erstellt von“ und nimmst bisherige Finanzberechnungen der Sitzung auf.

Die Oberfläche passt sich der verfügbaren Fensterbreite an. Auf größeren Ansichten stehen Rechner und gespeicherte Werte nebeneinander.

Die Ergebnisse sind Modellrechnungen auf Grundlage deiner Eingaben. Sie ersetzen keine individuelle Anlage-, Finanzierungs- oder Steuerberatung und sind keine Garantie für eine künftige Wertentwicklung.

name: EEV Control
description:
EEV Control pilote vos contrôleurs EEV à distance : commandez un équipement d'un geste, planifiez ses horaires, automatisez ses réactions, et sachez à tout moment ce qui s'est passé.

PILOTER
• Commandez chaque relais d'un appui, depuis n'importe où
• Voyez en temps réel l'état de vos sorties et de vos contrôleurs
• Donnez à chaque contrôleur et à chaque sortie un nom qui vous parle

PLANIFIER
• Créneaux horaires : un équipement s'allume et s'éteint seul, aux jours et heures choisis
• Temporisations : une sortie se coupe d'elle-même après la durée fixée

AUTOMATISER
• Règles automatiques : une sortie réagit à l'état d'une entrée ou d'un capteur
• Combinez plusieurs conditions pour décider quand agir

SUIVRE
• Historique d'activité : qui a commandé quoi, et quand
• Modules d'extension : ajoutez des entrées et des sorties à votre contrôleur

INSTALLER SIMPLEMENT
• Ajout d'un contrôleur en scannant son QR code
• Mise en service guidée des modules WiFi et 4G
• Partage de l'accès à un contrôleur avec un proche ou un collègue

EN TOUTE SÉCURITÉ
• Échanges chiffrés entre l'application, nos serveurs et vos contrôleurs
• Déverrouillage par Face ID
• Votre compte ne s'ouvre que sur un téléphone à la fois
• Aucune publicité, aucun pistage, aucune donnée revendue
• Suppression de votre compte et de vos données depuis l'application

Interface en français et en anglais, thème clair ou sombre.

EEV Control fonctionne avec les contrôleurs EEV (4G et WiFi) et leurs modules d'extension. Un contrôleur est nécessaire pour utiliser l'application.

Une question ? contact@eev.tn

name: El Expresivo
description:
El Expresivo es el periódico digital dominicano que te cuenta las noticias en video corto, como te gusta verlas.

Qué trae la app:
• Videos verticales: desliza hacia arriba y mira las noticias del día en pocos segundos.
• Última hora: recibe un aviso cuando pasa algo importante. Máximo cuatro avisos al día, para no molestarte.
• Noticias por sección: nacional, internacional, política, deportes, sucesos, economía y más.
• Lectura cómoda: cada nota completa, con fotos y modo oscuro.
• Comparte por WhatsApp con un toque.
• Buzón ciudadano: envíanos fotos, videos o denuncias desde tu celular. Tú decides si apareces con tu nombre o de forma anónima. Nada se publica sin revisión de la redacción.

Puedes apagar los avisos cuando quieras desde Ajustes.

Política de privacidad: https://elexpresivo.com/politica-de-privacidad/

name: Ethern
description:
O mundo real é o feed.

A Ethern é uma rede social que liga os lugares por onde você passa às pessoas que passaram por eles. Você deixa uma mensagem, foto ou vídeo preso a um lugar de verdade: um banco de praça, a mesa de um café, uma trilha, a poltrona do cinema. Quem chegar ali encontra o seu Rastro e pode se conectar com você.

COMO FUNCIONA
• Crie: escreva uma mensagem, tire uma foto ou grave um vídeo.
• Deixe: grave num cartão do Kit Ethern e deixe no lugar, ou prenda ao mapa como Rastro virtual.
• Encontre: leia o QR Code ou chegue a até 50 metros para abrir o Rastro.
• Conecte: peça conexão com quem deixou. A conversa só abre quando os dois aceitam.

RASTROS DE TODO TIPO
• Cápsula do tempo: só abre na data que você escolher.
• Rastro viajante: um cartão que passa de mão em mão pelo mundo, com o caminho no mapa.
• Só presencial: conteúdo que só abre no local.
• Convites reais: chame pessoas para correr, tomar um café ou ir ao cinema, com check-in no lugar.

SUA ÓRBITA
Lugares, Rastros deixados e lidos, conexões, encontros e selos. Uma reputação construída vivendo, não com curtidas.

PRÊMIOS DE PARCEIROS
Empresas espalham QR Codes premiados pela cidade. Ingressos e cupons ficam na sua carteira, com QR de uso único, e você pode dar de presente.

SEGURANÇA EM PRIMEIRO LUGAR
• O mapa mostra Rastros, nunca pessoas. Ninguém vê onde você está.
• Contatos e conversa só com aceite dos dois lados.
• Celular confirmado, só maiores de 18 anos e bloqueio de GPS falso.
• Fotos e vídeos passam por análise antes de aparecer.
• Denúncia e bloqueio em um toque.

BEM-ESTAR
Limite diário, modo anti-scroll e horário silencioso. A Ethern quer que você passe mais tempo fora da tela.

Disponível em 12 idiomas. A Ethern é uma marca da Ousia Group.

name: EZ Study Bible for Kids
description:
EZ Study Bible for Kids is a Bible course for children ages 5 to 10 that you watch and play on Apple TV with the remote.

Twelve lessons go from Genesis to Revelation. Follow a little golden star through the whole Bible story, from beginning to end. Every lesson has:
· a short animated story, narrated by Aunt Ever
· one person and one sentence to remember
· five big events to count on five fingers
· a little game: pick the word that fills the blank, then put the five big events in order to light the lesson's star
· a question to talk about with Mom and Dad

Made for watching together as a family. "For parents" has notes on every lesson and ideas for talking with your child.

No sign-up, no ads, and nothing about your child is collected. The lit stars are saved only on this Apple TV. Scripture quotations are from the ESV. Also in Chinese (中文): switch on the "For parents" page. On the web: kids.ezstudybible.com

Edited by Uncle Wilson · Narrated by Aunt Ever

name: Farfield Warmup
description:
Farfield Warmup is a training book that stays on your phone. Pick the sports you actually play. Each day the whistle gives you one session: a sport, a block of work and rest, and a note about the weather.

You can:

Follow today's whistle, or open the sport and train on your own.
Log sessions, personal marks, and short plays.
Use the gym floor for lifts, with cues you can use today.
Read the last 7 days: minutes, mix of sports, effort, and how they compare with the previous 7 days.
Earn badges for streaks, variety, and showing up.
Keep one optional cloud backup. The phone stays the original. Restore or erase the copy whenever you want.

name: FC Coffee
description:
FC Coffee is the official app of FC Coffee cafés in Malaysia, run by Flavor Compass Sdn. Bhd. Order your favourite drinks, collect rewards and keep track of your orders in one place.

ORDER YOUR WAY
• Scan the QR code on your café table to order, or order takeaway
• Browse the full menu: Vietnamese-style coffee, cold drip, fruit teas and fruit coffees
• Choose your options and see the total before you order
• Pay at the counter by card or DuitNow QR
• Get a notification when your order is ready

MEMBER REWARDS
• Show your member QR at the counter to earn points
• Swap points for coupons and use them on your next visit
• Receive a birthday gift every year
• See your points, coupons and order history at any time

MADE FOR YOU
• Find the FC Coffee café nearest to you, with its address and opening hours
• Use the app in English, 中文 or Bahasa Melayu
• Manage your account, and delete it at any time from Account

Membership is free. Sign up with your email or mobile number.

name: Ferry VN - Fast Ferry Tickets
description:
Ferry VN is the official fast-ferry booking app of ferryvn.com, operated by Ferry VN Joint Stock Company. Search trips, pick seats, pay and get your e-ticket on your phone.

FIND A TRIP FAST
• Choose departure, destination, date (and return date for round trips) and number of passengers.
• The month calendar highlights only days with sailings; a 7-day strip changes the date in one tap.
• Filter by operator, price range and departure time; sort earliest or latest.
• Compare price, seats left and ticket issuance speed for every trip.

PICK SEATS ON THE REAL SEAT MAP
• Deck-by-deck seat map coloured by seat class; touch and hold to see the price.
• Book up to 30 seats for groups and families.

FILL IN PASSENGERS QUICKLY
• Scan a Vietnamese ID card or passport to fill in name, document number, date of birth and nationality.
• Save frequent passengers for next time.
• Request a VAT invoice and look up tax codes.

FLEXIBLE PAYMENT
• VietQR bank transfer, bank cards via OnePay, or wallet balance.
• Payment status is checked automatically when you return to the app.

MANAGE YOUR TICKETS
• My trips: upcoming, past and cancelled, with a payment deadline countdown.
• E-tickets with QR code, PDF download, port fee receipts and e-invoices.
• View tickets offline.
• Request cancellation under each operator's conditions, shown clearly before you pay.
• Look up an order without signing in.

POPULAR ROUTES
Ho Chi Minh City, Phu Quoc, Ha Tien, Rach Gia, Hon Son, Hai Tac, Nam Du, Tho Chu, Con Dao, Vung Tau, Soc Trang, Can Tho, Phan Thiet, Phu Quy, Ly Son (Sa Ky), Hon Tre, Chau Doc, Phnom Penh and Saigon River tours.

OPERATORS
Phu Quoc Express, Superdong, Greenlines, Lightning 68, Hoa Binh, Minh Nga, Thanh Thoi, Chan Kha, Saigon Watergo, Victoria Speedboat and more.

SUPPORT
Travel guides, news and policies inside the app. Hotline +84 924 299 898, Zalo OA or hi@ferryvn.com.

Available in Vietnamese and English.

name: Finanzking
description:
Finanzking ordnet deine Finanzen – privat und geschäftlich – und bringt deine Belege ohne Zettelchaos zur Steuerkanzlei.

BELEGE SCANNEN UND FINDEN
• Rechnungen und Quittungen mit der Kamera scannen, als Foto oder PDF hinzufügen
• Händler, Datum und Betrag werden automatisch erkannt
• Texterkennung direkt auf dem Gerät – jeder Beleg ist im Volltext durchsuchbar, auch über die iPhone-Suche
• Automatisch abgelegt nach privat/geschäftlich, Monat und Ordner

EINNAHMEN, AUSGABEN, LIQUIDITÄT
• Buchungen erfassen oder per CSV aus dem Online-Banking importieren
• Daueraufträge mit Erinnerung am Vortag
• Liquiditätsvorschau: Was bleibt bis Monatsende frei verfügbar?
• Getrennte Übersicht für privat und geschäftlich

AN DEN STEUERBERATER SENDEN
• Monat, Quartal, Jahr oder einzelne Belege auswählen
• Als AES-256-verschlüsseltes ZIP – das Passwort geht getrennt per SMS oder E-Mail
• Direkt an die hinterlegte Kanzlei-Adresse, ohne sie jedes Mal einzutippen
• Mit Übersicht aller Buchungen als PDF und CSV

TEILEN, DRUCKEN, SICHERN
• Belege als Original, durchsuchbares PDF oder Text teilen
• In iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive oder OneDrive sichern
• Drucken per AirPrint

DEINE DATEN GEHÖREN DIR
• Kein Konto, kein Server: Alles bleibt verschlüsselt auf deinem iPhone
• App-Sperre mit Face ID
• Optional im iCloud-Backup deines Geräts

GRATIS UND PRO
Die Gratis-Version enthält alle Grundfunktionen, 10 Scans pro Tag und Werbung. Mit einem kurzen Video gibt es 3 Scans extra.
Finanzking Pro ist werbefrei, scannt unbegrenzt und exportiert an deine Steuerkanzlei.

Finanzking Pro gibt es als Monats- oder Jahresabo. Die Zahlung erfolgt über deine Apple-ID. Das Abo verlängert sich automatisch um denselben Zeitraum, wenn es nicht spätestens 24 Stunden vor Ablauf gekündigt wird. Verwalten und kündigen kannst du es in den Einstellungen deiner Apple-ID.

Nutzungsbedingungen: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Datenschutz: https://pdydy07.github.io/datenschutz.html

Finanzking ersetzt keine Steuerberatung.

name: FinchCog
description:
FinchCog is a clockwork puzzle game set in a miniature palace theater. Arrange short and long cams on an eight-beat score to control a wooden bird’s wings, beak, and tail.

Only one part can start moving on each beat, but a part already in motion can hold its pose. Run a rehearsal to see your arrangement come to life. If two parts try to start together, step through the score and see exactly where the mechanism jams.
- Solve 12 handcrafted performance scores across three acts.
- Revisit selected scores with tighter cam limits to find a different solution.
- Use Free Choreography to create, rehearse, and save your own performances.
- Replay your creations in the Works Cabinet, compare two versions beat by beat, or use either version as the starting point for a new piece.

name: Finova: Finanzen lernen
description:
Finova macht Finanzwissen zum Spiel. In fünf Minuten am Tag lernst du alles über Geld: vom ersten Gehalt über ETFs bis zu Bewertung und Investment Banking.

LERNEN:
• 30 Level und 3 Karrierepfade mit über 500 Fragen
• Maskottchen Bernd, Serien, XP und Ränge
• Alta!: die Altersvorsorge ab 2027 einfach erklärt

SPIELEN
• 15 Finanzspiele, 9 davon live mit Freunden per Raumcode
• Fakt oder Fake: Finanzmythen aus Social Media entlarven
• Karten Trading mit Unternehmensbewertung, nur mit Spielgeld

KARRIERE
• Karrierepfade Investment Banking, Private Equity und Real Estate
• Excel Training mit Feedback und Interview Training
• Lebenslauf Check, der auf deinem Gerät ausgewertet wird

Finova ist ein Projekt von Studierenden der EBS Universität. Ohne Tracking. Alle Inhalte dienen der Bildung und sind keine Anlageberatung.

name: Fita: Toca-Fitas Retrô
description:
Um toca-fitas de verdade no seu iPhone. Seus álbuns viram fitas cassete numa estante: coloque uma no deck, aperte as teclas mecânicas e veja a fita passando de um carretel para o outro.

• Teclas com clique, vibração e o som do motor ao enrolar a fita
• Contador mecânico e visor de LCD
• Cada fita lembra onde parou, como uma fita de verdade
• 4 fitas demo com músicas originais, para ouvir mesmo sem biblioteca
• No iPhone Duo: feche o aparelho com a fita no deck e ela começa a tocar

Grátis com anúncios. O Fita Pro (mensal, anual ou vitalício) libera capas cristal, cromo, neon e madeira, decks prata, esporte e nogueira, e remove os anúncios.

Toca músicas da sua biblioteca do app Música (baixadas ou adicionadas à biblioteca).

As assinaturas renovam automaticamente até serem canceladas nos Ajustes da sua conta Apple.

Termos de Uso (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Política de Privacidade: https://leandersantosm.github.io/apps-suporte/fita/privacidade.html

name: FyntraBR
description:
O app Fyntra é a área do cliente para lojistas e empresas que recebem pagamentos pela Fyntra. Acompanhe o desempenho do seu negócio de onde estiver.

• Painel de vendas: veja o total vendido, a quantidade de vendas e a taxa de conversão por período, com gráfico e calendário.
• Vendas: consulte cada venda, com status, forma de pagamento, valores e histórico de eventos.
• Carteira: acompanhe o saldo disponível, os valores a receber, a reserva financeira e o extrato completo.
• Antecipações, infrações e taxas: consulte o andamento e as condições da sua conta.
• Múltiplas contas: alterne entre os perfis da sua empresa com um toque.
• Segurança: login protegido por verificação antirrobô e ativação de novos dispositivos.

O app é exclusivo para clientes Fyntra. Para abrir sua conta, fale com a equipe Fyntra.

name: Game Galaxy Learning
description:
Game Galaxy is a space adventure where kids learn real math with Kit, a friendly space fox.

MATH GALAXY: KINDERGARTEN TO GRADE 5
Six constellations, one for each grade, with 41 planets and nearly 900 missions. Every mission follows the same rhythm: a warm-up, Kit shows how, your turn, practice, and a boss problem that opens the vault.

• Kit reads every line aloud, so even early readers can play on their own
• Hands-on models: ten frames, number lines, place value disks, fraction strips, area models and more
• Story problems taught step by step: read, draw, solve
• Practice that gets easier or harder based on how your child is doing
• Follows the Common Core State Standards

SEVEN SPACE GAMES
Jetpack Kit, Star Blocks, Rocket Words, Asteroid Sweep, Star vs. Moon, Comet Checkers and Galaxy Chess.

MADE FOR KIDS AND GROWN-UPS
• No ads, ever
• No accounts, no chat, no tracking
• Progress stays on your device
• A grown-ups area behind a gate, with a weekly progress report
• Several players on one device, each with their own explorer

name: GoSalon
description:
GoSalon, mevcut GoSalon hesabı bulunan salon sahipleri ve personeller için işletme yönetimi uygulamasıdır.

Randevu çizelgenizi takip edin, müşteri kayıtlarına erişin, satış ve tahsilat işlemlerinizi yönetin, ürün ve hizmetlerinizi görüntüleyin. Hesabınıza tanımlanan yetkilere göre işletme raporlarını ve kişisel performansınızı inceleyin.

Uygulama mevcut hesaplarla giriş içindir. Uygulama içinde üyelik oluşturma veya abonelik satın alma işlemi sunulmaz. Erişebileceğiniz ekranlar ve işlemler işletme yöneticinizin belirlediği yetkilere bağlıdır.

name: Happy Ride Arcade
description:
Happy Ride is a pixel-art arcade game about the oldest city adventure there is: getting somewhere by bike.

Steer left, steer right, and ring your bell. That is all there is to it. The street does the rest.

WHAT IS OUT THERE
- People crossing while looking at their phones
- Dogs, food carts and parked cars
- Potholes and open manholes
- Drivers who honk, and that one guy in a hurry who wants your lane
Ring the bell and most of them move. Most of them.

MAKE IT YOURS
- Seven bikes, from a twitchy fixie to an old junk bike nobody would steal. Each one rides differently.
- Four looks for your rider.
- Four bells, including a horn.

SEVEN PLACES
City at sunset, by day and by night, a quiet neighborhood, a dangerous one, and the highway by day and by night. Every place has its own 16-bit style tune.

THE LONGER YOU RIDE
The ride speeds up little by little, up to a top speed. How far can you get?

ALSO
- Game Center leaderboards for every place, and achievements
- Plays with the Siri Remote or a game controller
- English and Spanish
- No ads. Nothing to buy.

name: HEALTH ACADEMY DEUTSCHLAND
description:
BITTE BEACHTEN SIE: 
FÜR DEN ZUGANG ZUR APP BENÖTIGEN SIE EINEN HEALTH ACADEMY DEUTSCHLAND ACCOUNT.
WENN SIE KURSTEILNEHMER/-IN SIND, ERHALTEN SIE DIESEN KOSTENFREI VON IHREM BILDUNGSBERATER.

Beginnen Sie Ihre Reise in eine neue Zukunft und lassen Sie sich von HEALTH ACADEMY DEUTSCHLAND auf diesem Weg begleiten.
HEALTH ACADEMY DEUTSCHLAND ist Ihre umfassende Fitness-Plattform mit:

• Checken sie Kurse und Öffnungszeiten
• Verfolgen sie ihre täglichen Fitness Aktivitäten
• Verfolgen sie ihr Gewicht und andere Körperwerte
• Über 2000+ Übungen und Aktivitäten
• Klare 3D Übungsdarstellungen
• Vorgegebene Workouts und die Option eigene Workouts zu erstellen
• Über 150 Abzeichen zu verdienen

Wählen sie Workouts online und synchronisieren sie diese mit ihrer App für zuhause oder im Studio um ihre Fortschritte zu verfolgen. Von Kraft bis Gewichtheben, diese App fungiert als Ihr persönlicher Trainer, der sie begleitet und motiviert!

Sie können diese App mit der Apple Health App synchronisieren. Wenn Sie diese Übertragung aktivieren, wird jedes Training aus der Health App automatisch zu Ihrem Aktivitätskalender hinzugefügt.

name: HKBP SUPERAPP
description:
HKBP Superapp TV menghadirkan layanan Huria Kristen Batak Protestan (HKBP) di layar televisi Anda, nyaman dinavigasi dengan remote.

• Alkitab: baca seluruh kitab dalam Terjemahan Baru.
• Buku Ende dan Kidung Jemaat: telusuri dan baca lirik lagu.
• Ibadah: lihat tata ibadah dan partangiangan pekan ini, lengkap dengan lagu dan bacaan Alkitab.
• Almanak: jadwal liturgi harian dan bacaan pagi serta malam.
• Renungan: renungan harian untuk keluarga.
• Berita: kabar terkini dari HKBP.

Masuk ke akun HKBP bersifat opsional. Semua fitur utama dapat dipakai tanpa masuk.

Catatan: untuk sementara video belum tersedia di Apple TV.

name: HomeDeck TV
description:
HomeDeck brings your Home Assistant dashboards to Apple TV. It reads the dashboards you already have and renders them natively, so they look like they do in the browser and respond instantly to the Siri Remote.

NATIVE LOVELACE RENDERING
• Built-in Home Assistant cards: tile, entities, button, glance, thermostat, light, gauge, sensor, history and statistics graphs, weather forecast, media control, alarm panel, calendar, to-do list, logbook, map, picture elements, energy and more
• Popular community cards, rendered natively with nothing to install: Mushroom, button-card (with templates and JavaScript), ApexCharts, mini-graph-card, Bubble Card and card-mod styling
• Masonry, sections, panel and grid views, conditional cards and visibility rules
• Your Home Assistant themes, icons and language

BUILT FOR THE LIVING ROOM
• Navigate every card with the Siri Remote focus engine
• Tap to toggle, open detailed controls for lights, covers, fans, climate, locks, vacuums and media players
• Live updates over the Home Assistant WebSocket API – states change on screen the moment they change at home
• Top Shelf: see key readings on the Apple TV Home Screen and jump straight into a view

QUICK, PRIVATE SETUP
• Finds Home Assistant on your local network automatically
• Sign in with your Home Assistant username and password (two-factor authentication supported) or a long-lived access token
• Talks only to your own server. No accounts, no cloud relay, no analytics, no tracking
• No server yet? Try the built-in demo home first

REQUIREMENTS
A recent Home Assistant server reachable from your Apple TV, on your local network or via your own remote URL.

HomeDeck is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Home Assistant or the Open Home Foundation.

name: How Much Is It Worth: Scanner
description:
How much is it worth? Snap a photo and find out in seconds. How Much Is It Worth is the item value scanner app that shows you what your stuff is actually worth, with prices from real, live listings and the proof behind every number.

Coins in a jar, cards in a shoebox, a watch from your grandad, an antique from the garage sale, last year's phone. Whatever it is, take a picture and ask "how much is this worth?" or "what is this worth?" You get a Worth about price, the full price range, and the actual listings it came from, so you can check the numbers yourself.

WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT
• Up to three photos, not just one. A shot of the back, a label, a hallmark or a serial number helps us identify the exact item.
• You confirm the item before we price it. If the name, model or year is wrong, fix it first, so a wrong match never turns into a wrong price.
• A real range, not a guess. See the low, the high and a Worth about figure in the middle.
• Proof you can open. Every value comes with the live listings behind it.
• Condition in a tap. Switch between Good, Near Mint, Graded and more, and the value updates straight away.
• Ready to sell. Copy a listing with three prices: Quick sale, Fair price or Top dollar.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Take or upload up to three photos of your item.
2. Check what we think it is, and edit anything that's off.
3. See what it's worth: the Worth about price, the listed range, how confident we are, and the listings it came from.
4. Adjust the condition to see how the value changes.
5. Save it to your collection, or copy a ready-made listing to sell it.

WHAT IS IT WORTH? SCAN ANYTHING
Coins and money: pennies, nickels, dimes, quarters, half dollars, silver dollars, error coins, old banknotes and two dollar bills.
Cards: trading cards, sports cards, baseball, basketball and football cards, and graded cards.
Antiques and vintage: furniture, china, porcelain, crystal, glassware, pottery, clocks, art, prints and vintage finds.
Jewelry, gold and silver: rings, necklaces, bracelets, gold and silver jewelry, sterling silver, jade and gemstones.
Watches: vintage, luxury and everyday watches.
Collectibles: stamps, comics, books, vinyl records, toys, action figures, dolls, plush toys and memorabilia.
Fashion: handbags, designer bags, clothing, shoes and sneakers.
Electronics and games: phones, tablets, consoles, video games and cameras.
Around the house: furniture, tools, instruments like guitars, home decor and everyday items you want to sell.
If people buy and sell it, the app can usually tell you how much it's worth.

A PRICE CHECKER FOR SELLERS AND RESELLERS
Clearing out the house, flipping thrift finds or pricing a garage sale? Ask "what's it worth?" and check the resale value before you list. No more guessing what to charge, and no more selling something for a fraction of its value.

AN APPRAISAL APP FOR COLLECTORS
Track your collection and watch the total value grow. Find out what your coins, cards, stamps and antiques are worth today, and decide what to keep, sell or get professionally appraised.

KEEP TRACK OF YOUR COLLECTION
Save every scan in one place, with its photo, value range and listings, and see the total value of everything you own.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Your first 3 scans are free, then you get 1 free scan a week. Premium gives you unlimited scans: $29.99 a year with a 3-day free trial, or $4.99 a week. Cancel anytime in your store settings.

So, how much is it worth? Download How Much Is It Worth and scan your first item free.

Prices are estimates based on current public listings, not certified appraisals. For rare or very valuable items, get a professional appraisal too.

Support: https://howmuchisitworth.today/support
Privacy: https://howmuchisitworth.today/privacy
Terms: https://howmuchisitworth.today/terms

name: HSA Record Vault
description:
Organize HSA expenses, scan receipts, track reimbursements and contributions, create reports, and keep records private on your iPhone or iPad.

Description — 2,722/4,000 characters

Keep your HSA records organized, private, and ready when you need them.

HSA Vault helps you maintain a clear record of medical expenses, supporting documents, reimbursements, and account contributions. Capture receipts as expenses happen, review important details, and prepare organized records for reimbursement or tax time—all without creating an account.

ORGANIZE MEDICAL EXPENSES
Record the provider, patient, service date, category, amount, payment method, and notes for each expense. Quickly search your vault and filter records that are unreimbursed or still need review.

KEEP SUPPORTING DOCUMENTS TOGETHER
Attach receipts, statements, explanations of benefits, proof of payment, images, and PDFs directly to the related expense. Preview documents inside the app so the complete record stays easy to find.

SCAN RECEIPTS WITH LESS TYPING
Use the device camera to scan paper documents or import an image or PDF. On-device text recognition suggests useful details such as the provider, service date, and amount. You remain in control and review detected values before saving.

TRACK REIMBURSEMENTS
See how much of each eligible expense remains unreimbursed. Record partial or full reimbursements and maintain a useful history of payments from your HSA.

CREATE REIMBURSEMENT PACKETS
Select expenses and generate a consolidated PDF packet with expense details and supporting documents. Save it to Files or share it using the apps and services you choose.

MONITOR HSA CONTRIBUTIONS
Record personal and employer contributions, view annual totals, and compare contributions with the limits you enter for your planning needs.

REVIEW REPORTS
Explore spending summaries by month, year, category, provider, and patient. Create year-end PDF reports for your own records.

BACK UP AND RESTORE
Export a portable backup of your vault and restore or merge it later. Optional password protection helps secure sensitive backup files saved to Files, iCloud Drive, or another destination.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your vault is stored locally in protected app storage. Receipt recognition runs on your device. HSA Vault has no developer account system, advertising, analytics, or tracking, and does not upload your records to a developer-operated server. Your information leaves the app only when you choose to export or share it.

OPTIONAL APP LOCK
Use your device’s available authentication to help prevent casual access and conceal vault content in the app switcher.

HSA Vault is an organizational recordkeeping tool. It does not determine whether an expense is eligible and does not provide tax, legal, financial, or medical advice. Always review current IRS guidance and consult a qualified professional about your circumstances.

name: Huddle: Learn with Friends
description:
Huddle turns any topic into a small block-model world you explore with friends.

Type a topic and the kind of world you want, like "fractions, as a bridge that can collapse". Huddle builds a tabletop island of 4 to 10 places, and each place is a skill. Your squad walks the map together, answers questions that come from the scene, and explains ideas to each other. Everyone levels up on their own.

ONE QUESTION AT A TIME
Each turn shows one question, and the screen always says whose turn it is. Nobody can answer for someone else.

QUESTIONS INSTEAD OF ANSWERS
If you get it wrong, Huddle doesn't hand you the answer. It asks a smaller question that points you the right way. A short explanation only comes after a few tries, followed by a new question from another angle. Sometimes when you're right, Huddle or a teammate pushes back, and you have to explain why.

EXPLAIN IT TO A FRIEND
Some turns ask one player to explain an idea in a sentence. The teammate decides whether it convinced them.

FAIR LEVELS
Each place goes from level 0 to 5. Leveling up takes two separate passes, one of them a later revisit. Places you've already passed quietly get harder, so old skills stay fresh. Each player has their own dots on the map, so the squad can see who is strong where.

FINISH TOGETHER
When everyone reaches the target level, a co-op final challenge unlocks. Each player has to handle their own part. Afterwards you see the final map and the spots each person should work on next.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Two phones: invite friends with a link or a 6-character friend code
- One phone: take turns, with a handoff screen between players
- Chinese and English
- A complete sample world that always works, even without AI

BUILT FOR KIDS 9 TO 14
- Invite-only squads. There is no public lobby, no matchmaking with strangers, and no global chat
- The host can remove players and anyone can report
- Turn on preset phrases only ("I have an idea", "Give me a sec", "Your turn")
- Just a nickname and a block avatar, with no account
- No ads, no public leaderboard, no in-app purchases

Huddle builds on Jane Street's open-source socratic-tutor (MIT License) and turns it into a world you play with friends.

The topic you type is sent to an AI to build the world and its questions. Nicknames are not sent. Worlds made by AI can contain mistakes. You can report anything that looks wrong.

name: Imaan: Prayer Times & Quran
description:
