Imaan is a free Islamic companion for every day. No ads, no account, no in-app purchases.

PRAYER TIMES AND ADHAN
• Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha calculated from your location with the official method of your country (you can change the method and the Asr in the settings)
• Adhan notification at the time of every prayer: the adhan from Doha for Fajr, the adhan from Madinah (Quba Mosque) for the other four prayers
• Countdown to the next prayer
• Hijri calendar and Islamic holidays

QIBLA AND MOSQUES
• Compass pointing to the Kaaba, with the distance to Makkah
• Mosques near you, with directions

THE HOLY QURAN
• The complete Mushaf of Madinah, page by page, with the index of the 30 juz
• Recitation by renowned qaris, surah by surah and verse by verse
• Translations in many languages

DUA, HADITH AND DHIKR
• Dua of the day, hadith of the day and question of the day
• Morning and evening adhkar, Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim with search
• The 99 Names of Allah
• Tasbih counter
• Duas read aloud: first the Arabic, then the translation in your language (realistic voices need an internet connection)
• Save the duas and hadiths you love

LEARN
• Library of Islamic books (PDF) from IslamHouse
• Wudu, how to pray, Zakat calculator and Hajj

ISLAMIC TV AND RADIO
• Live channels from Makkah and Madinah and Islamic channels in many languages
• Islamic radio stations from around the world

QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS
• Ask about Islam by voice or text. The answers are generated by artificial intelligence (Google Gemini), with references to the Quran and the Sunnah. AI answers can contain mistakes: always check with a qualified imam or scholar.

FOR EVERYONE, EVERYWHERE
• Interface in 16 languages: the app follows the language of your phone
• Suitable for all ages
• No ads, no account, no tracking. What you save stays on your phone. Your location is used only to calculate prayer times and the Qibla and to find mosques nearby.

Privacy Policy: https://imaan-app.pages.dev/privacy

May Allah accept from us and from you.

name: Kapicu: Latin Dominoes
description:
Kapicu is Latin dominoes the way we play at home: loud, fast and with the whole family at the table.

PLAY YOUR RULES
• Puerto Rico: partners, double-six, first to 500, with capicú and chuchazo bonuses.
• Dominicana: first to 200, every pip counts, capicú bonus.
• Cubana: double-nine, 10 tiles each, first to 100.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Against the computer, offline, with easy, medium or hard opponents.
• Online with friends: share a table code, talk with voice chat, and play from anywhere.
• Play Now matches you with players at your level, from rookies to masters.
• Watch live tables, send quick phrases and reactions.

A TABLE THAT FEELS REAL
• Tiles follow the line and turn the corners like on a real table.
• The announcer calls ¡Capicú!, ¡Paso! and ¡Chiva!
• Original Latin music, sound effects and celebrations.
• La libreta: keep score for your real game at the table.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Premium tables, domino sets, avatars and celebrations.
• Represent your flag: your wins count for your country.
• Daily gift, daily challenges, levels, divisions and achievements.
• Kapicu Club: every premium item except Mythic ones (25% off those), double coins and Club-only extras.

YOUR RECORD, WITH YOUR APPLE ID
Your stats and progress are saved with iCloud, and Game Center leaderboards show the best players in the world, in your country and this week.

Safe tables: mute, block and report players any time.

Kapicu Club is an optional auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; it renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://kapicu-server.onrender.com/privacy

name: Kelime Düellosu: Online Oyun
description:
Kelime Düellosu, iki oyuncunun aynı 7 harfle 90 saniye boyunca yarıştığı canlı bir Türkçe kelime oyunudur.

NASIL OYNANIR
• İkiniz de aynı 7 harfi görürsünüz.
• 90 saniyede bu harflerle olabildiğince çok Türkçe kelime türetin.
• Uzun kelime daha çok puan getirir; Ç, Ğ, İ, Ö, Ş, Ü gibi Türkçe harfler ekstra puan kazandırır; 7 harfin hepsini kullanmak büyük bonus verir.
• Aynı kelimeyi önce bulan puanı alır. Hızlı olmak kadar doğru kelimeyi seçmek de önemli.

ÜÇ OYUN MODU
• Klasik: 90 saniye, aynı 7 harf, aynı kelimeyi önce bulan puanı alır.
• Raunt düellosu: 5 raunt, her rauntta yeni harfler ve 20 saniye; yalnızca en iyi kelimen sayılır.
• Maraton: tek başına oyna. Her rafta hedef puana ulaş, sıradaki rafa geç; kaç raf dayanabilirsin? Haftalık Maraton sıralamasında yerini gör.

JETON VE JOKERLER
• Oynadıkça jeton kazan: görevler, galibiyetler, günlük meydan okuma ve Maraton jeton verir.
• Jetonunla ipucu al ya da Maraton'da süreni uzat. Jeton satın alınmaz, yalnızca oynayarak kazanılır.

ARKADAŞINLA OYNA
• Oda kur, 6 haneli kodu ya da davet bağlantısını gönder, arkadaşın katılsın.
• Arkadaş ekle, çevrimiçi olduklarını gör, tek dokunuşla meydan oku.
• Arkadaşın çevrimdışı mı? Sıralı düello başlat: sen şimdi oyna, o aynı harfleri 3 gün içinde oynasın.
• Maç bitince rövanş iste.

HER GÜN YENİ BİR MEYDAN OKUMA
• Günde bir kez, herkes için aynı harflerle günlük meydan okuma. Sonucunu herkesle karşılaştır.

GÜNLÜK GÖREVLER VE ROZETLER
• Her gün üç yeni görev: tamamla, lig puanını ve jetonunu al; hepsini bitirene bonus.
• Galibiyetlerin, serilerin ve liginle rozet kazan, koleksiyonunu Profil'de gör.

LİG VE SIRALAMA
• Kazandıkça lig puanı topla: Bronz, Gümüş, Altın, Elmas, Efsane.
• Haftalık, genel, günlük ve Maraton sıralamasında yerini gör.

DİĞER ÖZELLİKLER
• Rakip bulunamazsa kısa sürede antrenman botuyla eşleşirsin; bot her zaman "BOT" etiketiyle gösterilir.
• Bağlantın kopsa bile maç sürer, geri dönünce kaldığın yerden devam edersin.
• Maç sonunda sonuç kartını paylaş, arkadaşlarına aynı harflerle meydan oku.
• Hızlı tepkilerle rakibine gülümse; istemediğin oyuncuyu raporla ya da engelle.
• Misafir olarak hemen başla; Google, Apple veya e-posta ile hesabını bağla.
• Premium'un yoksa bir reklam izleyip renkli harf taşı temalarını 24 saat deneyebilirsin.
• Oyun reklamla desteklenir; Premium ile reklamsız oynar, harf taşı temalarını (Turkuaz, Mercan, Altın, Gece) açar, avatarına çerçeve takar (rakibin de görür), ayrıntılı istatistiklerini görür ve sonuç ekranında animasyonlu emote'lar gönderirsin.

Not: Oyun internet bağlantısı gerektirir.

name: KittyKatdoku
description:
A little logic. A little company. A quilt full of cats.

KittyKatdoku is a cozy logic puzzle game set in a warm quilt atelier. Find the hidden cats using the colored regions and clues already sewn into each board. One cat belongs in each region, cats cannot share a row or column, and neighboring cats need a little space—even diagonally.

A curious kitten keeps you company as you solve each quilt, one square at a time.

• Play 21 handcrafted campaign puzzles.
• Generate fresh puzzles with adjustable board sizes, colors, and clues.
• Make your own quilts in the pattern workshop, with custom regions, cats, and hints.
• Tap or drag to mark an X; double-tap to place a cat.
• Continue your unfinished puzzle with automatic local saving.
• Adjust music, sound effects, kitten sounds, and reduced motion in the menu.

Play offline. No account, advertising, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Progress and custom puzzles stay on your device.

name: Konreservas
description:
Konreservas es la app para el equipo de los negocios que reciben reservas con Konreservas: peluquerías, centros de estética, consultas, gimnasios, academias, talleres, restaurantes y muchos más. Es el mismo panel que usas en el ordenador, ahora en tu iPhone y tu iPad.

Necesitas una cuenta de Konreservas para entrar. Entras con tu correo y tu contraseña, y con tu segundo factor si lo tienes activado.

TU DÍA, DE UN VISTAZO
• Agenda del día, la semana o el mes, filtrada por persona y por estado.
• Cada reserva con su cliente, su servicio, con quién es, su estado y lo cobrado y lo pendiente.
• Apunta las reservas que te llegan por teléfono, cambia la hora o cancela una reserva desde el móvil.

AVISOS EN EL MÓVIL
• Recibe un aviso cuando entra una reserva nueva, cuando se cancela una o cuando queda libre un hueco de la lista de espera. Al tocarlo, se abre esa reserva.

TUS CLIENTES
• La ficha de cada cliente, con sus datos de contacto, su historial de reservas y una nota interna que solo ve tu equipo.

LISTA DE ESPERA
• Quien no encuentra hueco se apunta desde tu página de reservas. Cuando se libera uno, tú eliges a quién ofrecérselo, o dejas que se le ofrezca solo al primero de la lista.

COBROS, BONOS Y TARJETAS REGALO
• Lo cobrado y lo pendiente de cada reserva: en tu local, por transferencia o con tarjeta.
• Bonos de sesiones y tarjetas regalo con su saldo. Véndelos en el mostrador y mira lo que le queda a cada cliente.

INFORMES
• Ingresos, reservas, ocupación y clientes del periodo que elijas, comparados con el periodo anterior.

TU OFERTA Y TU EQUIPO
• Servicios con su duración y su precio, horarios, equipo, salas y recursos.
• Cada persona entra con su propio usuario y ve lo que le toca según su papel.

EN ESPAÑOL Y EN INGLÉS
• La app se usa en español o en inglés, según el idioma de tu cuenta.

Tus clientes no necesitan esta app: reservan desde tu enlace de reservas o desde tu web.

¿Dudas? Escríbenos a hola@konreservas.com.

name: L&L Concept
description:
L&L Concept loue du matériel de fête et d'outillage autour d'Arzal, dans le Morbihan.

• Le catalogue complet, avec les prix et les photos, sans créer de compte.
• Un panier comme sur le site : articles, packs et consommables.
• Le devis en direct : dates, livraison selon votre adresse, montage, options (garantie casse, nettoyage, garantie météo…), code promo et bon cadeau.
• Votre compte seulement au moment de réserver.
• Le suivi de chaque réservation : billet avec QR code, paiement en ligne sécurisé, documents (devis, contrat, factures).
• Modifier les dates ou les quantités, prolonger la location, ajouter des consommables.
• Payer à plusieurs avec une cagnotte à partager.
• L'état des lieux de retour avec les photos.
• Des notifications à chaque étape : devis, paiement reçu, rappels avant la location.

Retrait à notre dépôt ou livraison. Une question ? Appelez-nous au 02 57 62 12 19.

name: Labellius
description:
Small labels, your own words.

Arrange text, emoji, photos and dates to create labels your way.

• Type directly on your label and drag to arrange
• Seven free fonts with bold and color controls
• Recent emoji and categorized symbols
• Add images, dates, barcodes and QR codes
• Save favorite labels and import or export project files
• GLORYTEC 8145 and custom multi-cell A4 sheets
• Fill one cell, one column or the whole sheet
• Print preview, PDF export and position calibration

No account is required. Label projects stay on your device. The iPhone and iPad app includes Google AdMob banner advertising. There are no in-app purchases or paid ad-removal options.

Printing requires a compatible printer on your local network. iPhone and iPad use AirPrint; Mac uses installed printer drivers. A direct connection is available for Canon LBP6030/6018 models. Available methods depend on the model and network. Check alignment on plain paper before printing on label sheets.

name: LEM Plan
description:
LEM Plan helps you stay organised throughout your working week: view published shifts, record working hours and breaks, share your availability, and request time off. Everything you need for your schedule comes together clearly in one app.

Schedule and shift details
Browse your published shifts in a clear weekly calendar and move easily between weeks. Select any day or shift to check start and end times, net duration, work area, planned breaks, and daily notes.

Track working time and breaks
Start work, take a break, and finish your shift directly from the Today screen. The live timer displays your active working time and recorded break duration separately. Your time entries sync across your devices with LEM Plan, even if you clock in without a scheduled shift.

Hours account and weekly overview
Keep track of your overall hours balance alongside your progress for the current week. Compare recorded hours against your weekly target and view your weekly difference at a glance. Your inbox also keeps you informed if an open time entry is closed automatically.

Absences and time-off requests
Check your remaining leave entitlement, active vacation bans, and the status of your submitted requests. When requesting time off, choose your date range, mark the first or last day as a half day if needed, and add an optional message for scheduling. Pending requests can be withdrawn directly in the app.

Share your availability
Let scheduling know when you are available or unavailable—either as a one-off entry or repeating on selected weekdays, for the whole day or a specific time window.

German and English
You can switch the app language between German and English at any time in your account settings.

For internal company use
LEM Plan is designed for internal use within participating businesses. Sign in with your existing employee account provided by your organisation.

name: Libreta
description:
O Libreta é a caderneta do professor de padel, beach tennis e tênis. Agenda da semana, alunos, presença, tipo de cada aula, cobrança com Pix e repasse ao clube num lugar só. Você monta a agenda do seu jeito, e o aluno que preferir reserva sozinho pelo seu link.

PRA QUEM DÁ AULA
• Início com o seu dia e o seu mês: aulas de hoje, alunos ativos, recebido no mês, atrasados, repasse ao clube e aniversariantes da semana.
• Agenda da semana em grade de horários ou em lista. Toque num horário livre, marque os alunos e a aula entra na agenda toda semana, com eles fixos. Folgas e feriados em um toque.
• Cada horário do seu jeito: montado por você ou aberto pra reserva dos alunos, com as regras de categoria e de vagas.
• Turmas por categoria e gênero, com as categorias do seu esporte. O aluno vê as turmas da categoria dele e das mais fracas.
• Presença em um toque, com o tipo da aula sugerido pelo número de alunos: individual, dupla, trio ou quarteto. Aula avulsa, experimental ou com valor livre, aluno por aluno.
• Cobrança do seu jeito: pacote, só contar as aulas, pós-pago ou mensalista, com valor por tipo de aula nos planos por aula e ajuste aluno por aluno.
• Fechamento da semana, da quinzena ou do mês com o detalhe por tipo de aula em cada cobrança.
• Pix com QR e código copia e cola em cada cobrança, direto na sua chave, sem taxa do Libreta.
• Repasse ao clube por aula dada, por aluno presente ou em percentual, calculado na hora pra você acompanhar.
• Um link só seu: o aluno pede cadastro por ele e você aprova. Lista de espera que sobe sozinha quando alguém cancela.
• Lembrete da aula, cobrança e parabéns pelo WhatsApp do aluno em um toque.

PRA QUEM TREINA
• Todas as suas aulas numa agenda só, mesmo com mais de um professor, com o professor, o esporte e o clube de cada aula.
• Reserva a vaga ou entra na lista de espera pelo celular, com o prazo de cancelamento sempre à vista.
• Acompanha o pacote e as cobranças de cada professor e paga pelo Pix copia e cola.
• Recebe o lembrete da aula no celular e fala com o professor pelo WhatsApp em um toque.

SEUS DADOS
O Libreta guarda só o que organiza a aula. Só o seu professor vê os seus dados, e ele só vê os alunos dele. O Pix vai direto pro professor: o Libreta não recebe nem intermedeia pagamento. Você apaga a sua conta quando quiser, no próprio app, em Mais, Apagar minha conta.

name: Life in the UK Test by NTCART
description:
Get ready for the Life in the UK test with realistic practice, clear lessons and helpful tracking. Free during launch: everything included.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 20 mock tests with 480 original questions: 24 questions, 45 minutes and the 18/24 pass mark, just like the real test
• 25 short lessons covering every chapter of the official handbook
• Practice by topic: values, what is the UK, history, modern society, government and law
• Years and numbers drill for the dates and facts people find hardest
• Focus list: questions you got wrong come back until you know them
• Saved questions: star any question to review later
• Readiness score and test-date countdown
• Clear results with explanations and what to do next
• Optional: hear questions read aloud and answer by voice, even hands-free
• Light and dark mode, daily reminders, no account needed

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your progress stays on your phone. No sign-up, no ads, no tracking.

IMPORTANT
This is an independent practice app made by NTCART LIMITED. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Home Office. The questions are written by us to help you learn and are not the official test questions. Book your real test at GOV.UK.

name: Lockstead: Private Vault
description:
Lockstead keeps your private photos and important documents in a vault that's locked with its own passcode, separate from your iPhone's. People who know your phone passcode still can't open it.

NOBODY ELSE CAN OPEN IT
• Everything is encrypted on your iPhone with AES-256 before it's saved.
• The vault has its own 6-digit passcode, plus Face ID if you want it.
• It locks the moment you leave the app, and hides itself in the app switcher.
• We can't see your vault. There's no account, no server, and no backdoor.

PHOTOS, VIDEOS, AND ALBUMS
• Add photos and videos from your library, then delete the originals so they're only in Lockstead.
• Take photos and videos straight into the vault with the built-in camera.
• Save straight from WhatsApp, Messages, Mail, and other apps: tap Share, then Lockstead.
• Organize everything into albums, and share or save any item when you choose.

EXTRA PROTECTION
• A decoy passcode opens a separate, harmless vault if you're ever made to unlock.
• Optional break-in photos: a wrong passcode takes a photo you can see once you unlock.
• Alternate app icons for a quieter home screen.

IT NEVER LOSES YOUR STUFF
• Encrypted backup to your own iCloud, automatically. Your iCloud password alone can't open it.
• New iPhone? Install Lockstead, enter your passcode, and everything comes back.
• A recovery key you save at setup opens your vault if you forget your passcode.
• Deleted something by mistake? It waits in Recently Deleted for 30 days.
• Export an encrypted backup file to a USB drive, your Mac, or any cloud you use.

YOUR IMPORTANT DOCUMENTS TOO
• Scan passports, IDs, and cards with the camera, or import PDFs.
• Add an expiry date and Lockstead reminds you 30 days and 7 days before. Reminders never show the document's name on your lock screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking. Only anonymous crash reports, which you can turn off.
• Free for up to 25 photos and documents. Unlock unlimited with one payment, no subscription.
• Your vault is never held hostage: viewing, backup, and export are always free.

name: Loopmark: Crochet Row Counter
description:
Tap the big number to count a row. Never lose your place in a crochet pattern again.

Loopmark is a simple crochet row counter with one big number. Put the hook down, pick it up later, and your count is still there.

• Tap anywhere on the big count to add a row, even without looking
• Rows or rounds, for blankets, scarves, amigurumi and granny squares
• Pattern repeats: see "Repeat 3 · row 2 of 4" under the count
• Row reminders: "row 24: buttonhole" or "every 6 rows: change colour"
• Target rows with a progress bar
• −1 to fix a mis-tap, Undo after a delete
• Two projects at a time, free
• Large, readable numbers; dark mode follows your phone

Private by design
No account. No ads. No tracking. No AI. Your projects stay on your phone.

name: Low Sky: Drone Ops
description:
Slip under the radar, hit the target, get home. Low Sky: Drone Ops is a side-view stealth game about flying low: enemy radars sweep the sky in bright cones, and hills, valleys and the dark are your cover.

100 MISSIONS, 5 REGIONS
• Desert canyons, coast and islands, snowy peaks, an industrial harbour and a night fortress
• A boss battle every tenth mission: a canyon fortress, a flagship, an iron convoy, a citadel
• Strike, recon photos, cargo on a rope, artillery marking, convoy hunts and infiltration

SIX DRONES, SIX WAYS TO PLAY
• Bumble drops bombs, Lark takes photos and marks targets, Porter carries cargo
• Plummet dives, Longwing fires rockets on the move, Nightmoth is almost invisible
• Upgrade battery, motor, armour, stealth, countermeasures and payload
• Paint schemes to unlock with stars

OUTSMART THE DEFENCES
• Radars, AA guns, missile launchers, searchlights, jammers and drone hives
• Hear the lock tone? Pop a flare
• Three stars per mission for a quiet, fast, clean run

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Simple one-thumb controls, one-hand mode and a left-handed layout
• Colour-blind mode, adjustable stick size, 47 languages
• Plays offline. Game Center achievements and leaderboards

FAIR
• No energy, no random boxes: every mission can be finished without buying anything
• Free with ads; a one-time purchase removes them

A toy-like world with fictional sides: no blood, only machines.

name: Mahalle Marketim
description:
Mahalle Marketim'e hoş geldin! Küçük bir bakkalı devral, müşterilerine güler yüzle hizmet et ve dükkânını adım adım mahallenin en sevilen marketine dönüştür.

KASADA SEN VARSIN
• Müşterilerin getirdiği ürünleri barkod okuyucudan geçir
• Poşetle, tutarı hesapla ve para üstünü doğru ver
• Sabırsız müşterileri bekletme, memnuniyetini yüksek tut

DÜKKÂNINI SEN YÖNET
• Bilgisayardan sipariş ver, rafları ve dolapları doldur
• Fiyatları kendin belirle: çok pahalıysa müşteri almaz, çok ucuzsa kâr etmezsin
• Elektrik faturasını ve haftalık kirayı ödemeyi unutma

BÜYÜ VE GELİŞ
• İçecek dolabı, ekmek dolabı, meyve-sebze tezgâhı gibi yeni bölümler aç
• Reklam kampanyalarıyla daha çok müşteri çek
• Günlük görevleri tamamla, ödülleri topla
• Bakkal → Market → Süpermarket: seviye atla, dükkânını büyüt

Marketine istediğin adı ver, mahallenin esnafı ol!

name: Maritime Traffic: Cruise Radar
description:
What ship is that on the horizon? Find nearby vessels, follow their journeys and stay updated on the ships that matter to you.

Ship Tracker: Marine Radar brings AIS vessel tracking, port information, watchlists and journey history together in one app. Explore marine traffic on a map, search for a specific ship or point your iPhone toward the sea to discover vessels in that direction.

VIEW SHIPS ON AN AIS MAP
Explore ship positions on an interactive map powered by AIS data from Digitraffic, BarentsWatch and AISStream. Filter by vessel type to focus on the marine traffic you want to see, from cargo ships and tankers to ferries and cruise ships, where data is available.

SEARCH FOR SHIPS AND EXPLORE PORTS
Find a vessel with name or MMSI, IMO, port and open its details to learn more about the ship and its reported activity. Explore ports and view vessel positions in the surrounding area, whether you are watching your local harbor or following a ship farther away.

SAVE VESSELS AND GET ALERTS
Add ships to your watchlist so you can find them again easily. Receive notifications when a followed vessel enters or leaves a monitored port area, reports an anchored status or starts sending AIS updates again.

Follow a favorite ferry, keep an eye on a cargo ship or stay informed about the vessel carrying someone you care about.

VIEW JOURNEY HISTORY
See where a ship has traveled with vessel track history. Follow its recorded path on the map and review distance traveled and average speed for the available journey data.

Use ship history to look back at recent movements and understand how a vessel reached its current position.

DISCOVER SHIPS WITH HORIZON
Point your iPhone toward the sea to see vessels in that direction, along with their distance and reported status.

Horizon uses your location and compass, without using the camera. It is a simple way to explore nearby ships while watching from the coast, a harbor or a waterfront.

MADE FOR EVERYDAY SHIP WATCHING
• Discover vessels near the coast.
• Follow cruise ships, cargo vessels and ferries.
• Keep favorite ships in one watchlist.
• Get updates about port-area movements.
• Explore recorded vessel routes.

DISLAMER
Vessel visibility, position freshness, history and alerts depend on available AIS coverage and received reports. Some vessels may be missing or have an older last reported position. Small boats and vessels without available AIS transmissions may not appear.

Horizon direction and distance depend on your device’s location, compass accuracy and available vessel positions.

This app is for information and ship spotting. It is not intended for navigation, collision avoidance or emergency use.

name: Masfo
description:
Masfo, aracının ve evinin bakım kayıtlarını, aldığın teklifleri ve yaklaşan işlerini tek yerde tutar.

Bakımı kaydet
Lastik, yağ, fren, muayene: her işlemi tarih, km, fiyat ve notuyla kaydet. Aradığını isim ya da nota göre saniyede bul.

Km'si gelince unutma
Hatırlatmaları tarihe ya da hedef kilometreye göre kur. Masfo son kaydına bakıp kaç km kaldığını gösterir, tarihi gelince bildirim gönderir.

Teklifleri yan yana gör
Not Modu ana ekranda bakım kayıtlarının hemen yanında. Aldığın teklifleri tutarı ve tarihiyle yaz, karar verirken geri dön. İstemezsen tek dokunuşla gizle.

Takvim ve rapor
Tüm kayıtlarını takvimde adlarıyla gör. Aylık harcamanı, kategori dağılımını ve km başına bakım maliyetini takip et.

Verilerin sende
Hesap yok, reklam yok, takip yok. Her şey telefonunda durur. Yedeğini dosya olarak al, listeni Excel'e aktar. Yanlışlıkla sildiğin kayıtlar 30 gün Silinenler'de bekler.

name: Medora Tower
description:
Medora Tower — навчальна гра, що перетворює перевірку знань на захопливий процес будівництва вежі. Відповідайте на запитання, заробляйте бали, зводьте найвищу споруду та встановлюйте нові рекорди.

Застосунок працює повністю без інтернету та не вимагає реєстрації.

Можливості:
• імпорт тестів із PDF, TXT і QST прямо з «Файлів»
• вибір кількості питань або діапазону номерів
• перемішування питань і відповідей
• улюблені питання зі зірочкою
• продовження незавершеної спроби
• перегляд усього файлу, помилок і пошук за словом
• світла й темна теми, українська й англійська мови
• усі дані зберігаються лише на твоєму пристрої

Вбудована демонстраційна гра допоможе швидко ознайомитися з усіма можливостями.

name: MeterSpan
description:
Keep an offline notebook for your electricity, water and gas meters. Enter dated cumulative readings to see how much you used between checks.

- Record dated readings in kWh or cubic metres and revisit the original values.
- Review usage, calendar days and average daily usage for any adjacent reading period.
- Compare two periods on the same meter, even when the periods have different lengths.
- Enter an optional unit rate to estimate the usage portion of the cost. Estimates use your current rate and exclude taxes, fixed charges and tiered pricing.
- Filter your history and share readings and calculated periods as a CSV.

Meter and reading records stay in the app’s local storage.

name: MIKUBO Parceiro
description:
MIKUBO Parceiro é a aplicação dos estafetas, transportadores e motoristas da MIKUBO, a plataforma 100% cabo-verdiana de refeições, encomendas e transporte.

RECEBA PEDIDOS PERTO DE SI
• Fique online quando quiser: os pedidos próximos chegam ao seu telemóvel.
• Veja o ganho, a recolha e o destino antes de aceitar.
• Navegue até ao restaurante e ao cliente com o mapa.

ENTREGAS, ENCOMENDAS E TRANSPORTE
• Entregue refeições dos restaurantes parceiros.
• Responda a pedidos de transporte de encomendas e mercadorias com a sua proposta de preço.

OS SEUS GANHOS, SEMPRE CLAROS
• Saldo e histórico de cada entrega na aplicação.
• Pagamentos semanais por transferência bancária.
• Comissão transparente, sem surpresas.

INSCRIÇÃO SIMPLES
• Crie a sua conta, envie os seus documentos pelo telemóvel e acompanhe a validação.
• Apoio local em português e kriolu.

A localização é partilhada apenas enquanto está online, para lhe propor entregas próximas.

Para encomendar uma refeição ou enviar uma encomenda, instale a aplicação MIKUBO.

name: Mirador: What's on in Granada
description:
Everything happening in Granada, a short walk away.

Every day, Mirador gathers the programs of theaters, museums, venues, town halls and cultural organizations in Granada and its metropolitan area, and sorts them by time and distance: concerts, theater, cinema, flamenco, dance, exhibitions, fairs and markets, talks, workshops, routes and guided tours. Open Mirador and see what’s starting near you.

TODAY
A timeline of what’s about to start, with the walking minutes to every venue. Right alongside, the exhibitions, fairs and markets you can visit today, grouped by type and sorted by which close first.

MONTH
The whole month as a calendar, with every day’s sessions and what opens. Filter what runs over several days by type and see on a bar how long each exhibition has left.

NEARBY
Choose how far you feel like walking, from 5 to 45 minutes, and the map shows what’s starting around you and what’s open now. Kilometers work too, if you’re cycling or taking the bus.

MIRADOR MODE
Turn your iPhone towards the city, like from a viewpoint in the Albaicín. Mirador tells you what’s on today in that direction, how many minutes away on foot it is and which landmark you’re facing.

AGENDA AND REMINDERS
Save the events you like and choose when to be reminded: when you have to leave, based on your walking time; 30 minutes or an hour before; the day before or that morning. Your agenda works offline.

AND ALSO
• Widgets: what’s on near you today and what you’ve saved, on your Home Screen, plus the walk to your next event and when to leave, on your Lock Screen.
• On iPad, the list and the details side by side.
• Dark mode, following your system.
• In English, Spanish, Italian, German, Portuguese, French, Japanese and Chinese. Event details appear in Spanish, as each organizer publishes them.

YOUR PRIVACY
No accounts, no ads and no analytics. Your location is only used on your device to work out distances, and it never leaves it. If you don’t share it, or you’re far from Granada, Mirador measures from Plaza Nueva, in the city center.

Mirador is free and independent: it isn’t run by any town hall or organizer. Every event links to its source; check times and tickets there before you go.

Missing an event or a venue? Suggest it at miradorgranada.es.

name: Montis.
description:
Keep the mountain days that stay with you.
Montis is a mountain journal for hikers, hillwalkers and summit collectors who want to remember the experience behind every ascent. From a quiet morning on a familiar fell to the final peak in a personal challenge, give each mountain day a place in your story.
REMEMBER THE WHOLE DAY
Keep several peaks in one trip and give each its own outcome: Summited or Turned Back. Add the date, weather, companions and optional summit times. Write about changing views, good company and the decisions that mattered along the way. A thoughtful turnaround belongs in your mountain history too.
KEEP THE FEELING, NOT JUST THE DATE
Add photographs, choose a cover and arrange your memories in the order you want to revisit them. Record a voice memory while the day is still fresh. Save your observations about wind, snow, ground conditions and visibility alongside your words and pictures.
BUILD A HISTORY AROUND EVERY PEAK
See the different mountains you have successfully summited and the successful ascents you have accumulated. Open a peak to revisit earlier outings, seasonal memories and the photographs connected with each trip. Search your journal by trip or peak name, browse by year and keep favourite mountains close.
GIVE YOUR NEXT OUTING A PURPOSE
Create a personal challenge from a collection of peaks you want to complete. Choose its name, emblem and colour, then decide whether past ascents should count. Qualifying summit records update your progress, so you can see what is complete and choose the next mountain from the peaks that remain.
CELEBRATE, THEN RETURN
Complete a round to create a personal challenge certificate with your chosen signature. Save it, share it or start another round while keeping earlier achievements. Each new round counts ascents dated after the previous round's completion, giving familiar mountains a fresh chapter.
MAKE THE JOURNAL YOURS
Keep a draft when you need more time to finish an entry. Create a trip summary and choose whether to include companion names or private notes. Export a journal backup to preserve a copy of your mountain memories.
For weekend walkers, returning hikers and people building a lifetime collection of summits, Montis turns individual outings into a mountain story worth keeping.
Record your next trip. Keep what made it matter.

name: Moventra: Home Workouts
description:
Moventra builds a bodyweight workout that fits the time you have. No weights, no bands, no gym: every move uses only your living room floor and sometimes a wall.

TELL IT HOW MANY MINUTES YOU HAVE
Pick 5, 10, 15, 20, 30 or 45 minutes (or anything from 3 to 60). Short days get a quick warm-up and a tight circuit. Longer days add moves, rounds and reps, plus a cardio finisher and a longer stretch. Five minutes is a real workout.

GUIDED, ANIMATED WORKOUTS
Every one of the 100+ moves has an animated illustration, simple how-to cues, a timer or rep counter, rest timers and a "next up" preview. Tap Easier any time to switch to a gentler version.

GETS HARDER AS YOU GET STRONGER
Rate each move Too easy, Just right or Too hard. Your targets grow, and you level up from wall push-ups to knee push-ups to full push-ups and beyond. Too hard steps you back.

YOUR GOALS AND YOUR SPORT
Pick any mix of goals: get stronger, look better, lose weight, more energy, better flexibility. Training for a sport? Choose golf, hockey, running, tennis, pickleball, basketball, soccer, baseball, football, skiing, cycling, swimming or boxing and get a weekly sport day with moves built for it, like rotation and hip mobility for golf or skating stance and lateral power for hockey.

A PLAN FOR YOUR WEEK
Choose your workout days. Moventra rotates upper body, legs and full-body days, keeps track of what's next, and builds in recovery stretches, including an automatic light day after three hard days in a row. Sore knees, wrists, lower back or shoulders, or need to keep it quiet? Moves are swapped for safer ones.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Workouts done, total minutes, streaks, weight trend, your level on every move, personal records, badges and a weekly report.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no server. Everything stays on your iPhone. Sign in with Apple is optional.

Moventra is general fitness guidance, not medical advice. Check with a doctor before starting a new exercise program.

Built by capableprocess.ai

name: NagaCX
description:
O NagaCX leva o Inbox da sua empresa para o celular. Veja as conversas que chegam pelo WhatsApp e pelos outros canais conectados à plataforma NagaCX e responda de onde estiver.

• Conversas separadas em Novos, Meus, Outros e Flow

• Assuma, transfira e finalize atendimentos
• Agende mensagens e organize clientes com etiquetas
• Receba notificação de novas mensagens
• Entre com segurança, com verificação em 2 etapas

O app é para equipes de empresas que já usam a NagaCX. O acesso é criado pelo administrador da empresa em nagacx.com.

name: Ortadoğu Postası
description:
Ortadoğu Postası, Ortadoğu ve çevresindeki gelişmeleri Türkçe aktaran haber sitesi ortadogupostasi.com'un uygulamasıdır. Bölgenin gündemini sade, gazete düzeninde bir arayüzle okuyun.

GÜNDEM

name: Plant Identifier · PlantKey
description:
PlantKey tells you what a plant is from a photo — right on your iPhone, with no account and even without internet.

IDENTIFY PLANTS IN A SECOND
• Houseplants, garden flowers, trees, herbs, weeds and wildflowers — more than 7,900 of the world's most common species
• Point the camera at a leaf, a flower or the whole plant, or pick a photo from your library
• Honest answers: up to three likely matches, how sure PlantKey is, and reference photos to compare
• Not sure? Add a close-up of a leaf or a flower and PlantKey combines the photos
• No plant in the frame? PlantKey says so instead of guessing
• Works offline; your photos never leave your phone

KNOW YOUR PLANT
• Common name, Latin name and family
• Safety for cats, dogs and children
• Light, watering, humidity, temperature, soil, feeding and repotting — detailed care for almost 2,000 popular house and garden plants
• A short article from Wikipedia (needs internet)

CARE THAT FITS YOUR HOME
• Add plants to your garden and get reminders to water, feed, mist and repot
• Tell PlantKey the soil is still moist and the schedule adjusts
• Season, window light, pot size and material are taken into account

PLANTKEY PRO
• Unlimited garden (5 plants are included without Pro)
• Plant Doctor: answer a few questions about yellow, brown or spotty leaves and get the likely causes with step-by-step care
• Light meter: check with the camera whether a spot is bright enough
• Growth journal without limits (3 photos per plant are included without Pro)
Identifying plants never needs Pro.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No trackers. No account.

Safety notes are general guidance, not veterinary or medical advice. If a pet or a child has eaten a plant, contact a vet or poison control right away. An identification can be wrong: never eat a plant because an app named it.

PlantKey Pro is optional: a yearly or weekly subscription, or a single lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://appbaron-apps.netlify.app/plantkey/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://appbaron-apps.netlify.app/plantkey/privacy/

name: Prompt by Mr. Asad
description:
Prompt puts every Claude Code window running in iTerm2 on your Mac into one list on your iPhone. Read along, reply, answer questions and approve plans from wherever you are.

What you can do:
- See every live window in one list, with a colour for working, waiting on you and finished
- Reply to any window and watch the answer come back
- Answer its questions and approve or change its plans with one tap
- Get a notification when a window needs you, and answer it from the notification
- Follow live status on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
- Add widgets to your Home Screen and Lock Screen
- Send photos and screenshots straight into a window
- Start a new window in one of your recent folders
- Read long answers in a clean reader view
- Lock the app with Face ID

How it works: a small helper runs on your Mac. Your iPhone connects to it directly on your Wi-Fi, with an encrypted connection tied to your Mac by the pairing code. Add Tailscale and it works from anywhere. Prompt never types into a shell: it only talks to Claude Code windows.

Your privacy: what you type and the photos you send go from your iPhone to your own Mac. Claude Code on your Mac then sends them to Anthropic under your own account, as it does when you type at your desk. We never see them. Notification text is encrypted on your Mac and passes through our relay to Apple without being stored.

You need an iPhone on iOS 26 or later, and a Mac with iTerm2 and Claude Code. Setup takes a few minutes: the website gives you one message to paste into Claude Code on your Mac, and it does the rest. Try the demo first, no Mac needed.

Prompt is made by Huddle Duck Ltd. It is not made by or affiliated with Anthropic.

Membership unlocks live use with your own Mac. It is £8.99 a month in the UK, and Apple sets the price in other countries. It renews every month until you cancel. Cancel at least 24 hours before it renews in Settings, then your name, then Subscriptions. Setup and the demo are free.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://prompt.asadshah.co.uk/privacy

name: Puff: Sopre a Semente
description:
Sopre no microfone e a semente de dente-de-leão sobe. Pare de soprar e ela cai. Passe entre os espinheiros e colete o pólen brilhante.

• Controle por sopro, com calibração para o seu fôlego e para o barulho do lugar
• Modo toque: segure a tela para subir — para jogar em silêncio ou sem soprar
• Céu de entardecer, sons suaves e partidas rápidas
• Recorde pessoal

O microfone só é usado para medir a força do sopro, no próprio aparelho. Nada é gravado nem enviado.

Grátis com anúncios. Uma vez por partida, você pode assistir a um anúncio para continuar de onde a semente caiu.

name: Putt Paradise
description:
You have a few minutes and you want a game that is easy to pick up and hard to put down.

Putt Paradise is mini golf for your iPhone. Drag back anywhere on the screen, let go, and watch the ball roll.

18 HOLES, SIX WORLDS

- Meadow: gentle hills and bank shots to get you started
- Beach: lagoons, sand traps and a spinning turnstile
- Desert: ramps, sliding gates and a maze
- Frost: ice that keeps the ball sliding and snowdrift speed bumps
- Volcano: lava pools and a cup on top of a crater
- Neon: pinball bumpers, speed strips and wormholes

HOW IT PLAYS

- The ball rolls the way you expect. It climbs hills, slows in sand and banks off the rails.
- Pinch to zoom in. Double-tap to see the whole course.
- Play all 18 for a scorecard, or practice any hole.
- Your best scores are saved on your iPhone.

FREE

Putt Paradise is free. There are no ads, no in-app purchases and no accounts. The game collects no data and works offline.

Privacy Policy: https://putt-paradise.jay-2fd.workers.dev/privacy/

name: Readysphere
description: Readysphere pomáha ľuďom, ktorí sa pripravujú na presťahovanie na ostrov Man alebo tam už žijú, usporiadať si dôležité povinnosti. Kroky k vybaveniu dokladov, dátumy platnosti, daňový kalendár a šesť núdzových scenárov tvoria prehľadný osobný plán. Označujte splnené úlohy, pridávajte poznámky a núdzové kontakty a na úvodnej obrazovke sledujte svoju pripravenosť. Hlavné funkcie je možné používať bez registrácie. Daňový odhad je orientačný. Aktuálne podmienky a termíny si overte u príslušných úradov.

name: Rechenkreuz
description:
Drei Zeilen und drei Spalten – und jede ist eine Rechnung. Fülle die leeren Felder so, dass alle sechs Gleichungen stimmen. Manche Zahlen brauchen zwei Ziffern. Jedes Rätsel hat genau eine Lösung.

FÜR DEINEN FEIERABEND
Jeden Abend um 20:00 Uhr Wiener Zeit erscheint eine neue Ausgabe. Alles entsteht direkt auf deinem iPhone; ein Download ist nicht nötig. Das Archiv hält frühere Ausgaben zum Nachholen bereit.

VOM ERSTEN PLUS ZUM GROSSEN KREUZ
Übungshefte führen von einfachen Rechnungen bis zu Kreuzen mit allen vier Grundrechenarten. Im Lernmodus zeigt eine Waage, welche Seite einer Gleichung schwerer ist. Mit Prüfen und Tipp kommst du weiter, wenn du feststeckst.

ZWEI AUSGABEN, EIN RÄTSEL
Setzkasten setzt die Zahlen auf Holzlettern. Die Nachtausgabe stellt sie hell auf dunkles Papier. Du wählst den Look selbst oder lässt die App nach Gerätezeit zwischen 20:00 und 6:00 Uhr automatisch wechseln.

DEIN FORTSCHRITT BLEIBT BEI DIR
Spielstände, gelöste Ausgaben und deine Serie liegen auf diesem iPhone. Eine lokale Sicherung hilft bei Speicherproblemen. Ein Ergebnis lässt sich ohne verratene Lösung über das iOS-Teilen-Menü weitergeben.

Kostenlos. Kein Konto, keine Werbung, keine In-App-Käufe und kein Abo. Deutschsprachige Oberfläche, mit VoiceOver-Beschriftungen und Unterstützung für größere Systemschrift. Rätsel, Hefte und Archiv funktionieren offline.

name: Redesk
description:
Redesk samler arbeidsflaten for redaksjonen på iPhone. Åpne dagens oppgaver, følg arbeidet på oppgavetavlen og fortsett på en sak mens du er ute på oppdrag.

• Hold oversikt over oppgaver, frister og hvem som har ansvar.
• Skriv og rediger utkast i Skrivestudio.
• Åpne redaksjonens medier, og del nedlastede filer med iPhone-delingsarket.
• Motta varsler fra Oppgavetavla når du aktiverer varsler på iPhone.

Logg inn med idgo. Avisadministratoren gir tilgang til redaksjonens arbeidsflate.

name: Reeltopus: AI Video Editor
description:
The whole studio. One thumb.

Reeltopus is the AI video studio for creators: an AI video editor, clip maker and caption app in one. Turn a podcast, stream or vlog into scored short clips, edit by asking, add auto captions in 100+ languages, then post, schedule and see what worked, all from your phone. Meet Topus, the octopus with an arm for every job.

CLIP IT
Drop in a long video and Topus finds the moments worth sharing. Every clip is scored on its hook, flow, payoff and shareability, with the reason it was picked. Swipe to keep the best.

EDIT BY ASKING
Just say the edit: "make it 30 seconds", "cut the intro", "yellow captions". Topus makes the change, and every change can be undone.
• Cut words straight from the transcript; remove pauses and filler words in one tap
• AI reframe that follows the speaker, split screen, screen share and face cam
• Auto captions and subtitles in 100+ languages, with animated styles
• B-roll, music, sound effects, colour looks, text and stickers
• Your brand kit and templates on every clip

PACKAGE TO WIN
• Packaging Lab: hook, title and cover versions for every platform, and a report on what wins with your audience
• Title and thumbnail tests on your YouTube videos
• AI thumbnail maker, carousels, show notes, newsletters and posts written from your video

POST IT
• Post or schedule shorts and reels to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn and more: 9 platforms from one place
• Autopilot drafts next week's posts from your best clips, for you to approve

PROVE IT
• Video analytics: views and watch time by platform, and what works for you by length, hook and posting time
• Research: what people in your niche search for, with title and hook ideas
• Smart links that count clicks, leads and sales, and your sponsor deals in one place

Repurpose every video: podcast clips, stream highlights, talking-head shorts, webinar moments.

Reeltopus posts only when you say so, and only to accounts you connect. Your videos stay yours.

Terms: https://reeltopus.com/terms
Privacy: https://reeltopus.com/privacy
Reeltopus is made by Turncraft Private Limited.

name: Rivt
description: From hashes and blocks to consensus, smart-contract security and zero-knowledge proofs, 12 step-by-step courses help you understand the science behind blockchain. In interactive labs you compute hashes, create digital signatures, build Merkle trees and repair broken block links yourself, with every calculation running live on your device. A knowledge graph, a glossary and encyclopedia, quizzes in several formats and spaced review make the ideas stick, while your notes, progress analytics and personal reports are always at hand. It supports Chinese, English and Finnish, most content works offline, and you can start right away in guest mode.

name: Roadstart: Permit Test Prep
description:
UNOFFICIAL STUDY APP. Roadstart is an independent educational app made by Faiz Ahmad Dae. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the Maryland Department of Transportation Motor Vehicle Administration (MVA), the Virginia Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV), or any other government agency, and it does not provide licenses, permits, test appointments, or any government service. All lessons and practice questions are our own original material, written from state law and the official driver's manuals. They are not the actual test questions.

Official sources (check them before your test):
• Maryland MVA – Maryland Driver's Manuals: https://mva.maryland.gov/licenses-ids/driver-education-safety/maryland-drivers-manuals
• Virginia DMV – Virginia Driver's Manual: https://www.dmv.virginia.gov/licenses-ids/exams/manual
• Maryland law (Transportation Article): https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/mgawebsite/Laws/Statutes
• Virginia law (Code of Virginia, Title 46.2): https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title46.2/

Roadstart teaches the driver's knowledge (permit) test for Maryland and Virginia in your own language: English, Persian (Farsi), Dari, Pashto, Arabic or Spanish.
English · فارسی · دری · پښتو · العربية · Español

LEARN
• More than 100 short lessons for each state, with pictures. Each lesson takes a few minutes.
• Every lesson and question can show the English text under your language, so you also learn the words used on the real test.
• More than 190 road signs with their meaning, flashcards and a sign quiz.
• A glossary of driving words.

PRACTICE
• More than 1,000 practice questions for each state. Every answer is explained.
• Practice tests in the format of the real test: 25 questions for Maryland; 10 road signs and then 30 questions for Virginia.
• You can also take the practice test in English only.
• Review the questions you answered wrong.

PLAN
• Enter the day of your test and see how many lessons to study each day.
• After each practice test, see which chapters to study next.

PRIVATE, AND WORKS OFFLINE
• Works without internet.
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on your phone.

PRICE
• Lessons, road signs and reviewing your mistakes are free.
• One practice test and one quick practice a day are free.
• Unlimited practice tests and chapter practice are an optional one-time purchase for each state (State Pass). It is not a subscription.

Found a mistake? Write to support@topjow.org.

name: Ship Tracker: Boat & Cruise
description:
See the ships around the world on a clear live map. Tap any vessel to find out its name, speed and destination, follow the voyages that matter to you and check who is arriving in port.

Whether you watch ships from the shore, follow a cruise your family is on or keep an eye on a friend's yacht, Ship Tracker keeps it simple. No account needed.

LIVE MAP
• Ships from public AIS data, drawn with real names and a color for each type
• Filter by cargo ships, tankers, cruise ships, fishing boats and yachts
• Near me shows the ships around you
• Satellite view

SHIP CARD AND DETAILS
• Tap any ship for its card with speed, course, heading and status
• Voyage with departure, destination and ETA
• With Pro: full live data such as draught and position, and vessel data such as IMO, call sign, flag, gross tonnage and year built, where available

MY FLEET (PRO)
• Save the ships you care about and give them your own names
• See at a glance where each one is and where it is going

PORTS
• Find ports and see which ships are arriving and leaving

WHAT IS INCLUDED
Free: the live map, filters, Near me, ship cards, voyages, search, ports and the first 3 rows of each port board.
Ship Tracker Pro adds full live and vessel data, My Fleet, 7-day tracks, past port calls and complete port boards.

SUBSCRIPTION
Ship Tracker Pro is an auto-renewable subscription: weekly, monthly or yearly, with a 3-day trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when the trial ends or at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple ID Account Settings.

AIS data comes from third parties and can be missing, delayed or wrong. Do not use Ship Tracker for navigation or safety decisions.

Terms of Use: https://shiptracker.link/terms
Privacy Policy: https://shiptracker.link/privacy

name: Shisheng - Watch Recorder
description:
Raise your wrist. It is already recording.

Shisheng listens while you wear your watch, then turns the day into text you can read, a timeline you can scroll, and a recap you can ask questions to.

· Always-on recording on Apple Watch: screen off, app switched, wrist down — still recording.
· Your whole day as one timeline. Silent stretches are skipped automatically, so a full day is usually a few hundred KB.
· A daily highlight: the promise you made, the thing someone handed you, the idea you blurted out.
· Daily recap written from a bystander's view — not a transcript.
· Ask in plain words: what did I promise today, which day was the hardest.
· Search a phrase and jump back to that second.

One-time purchase. No subscription, no in-app purchase, no locked features.

Your recordings stay on your iPhone. No server, no account, no login. Transcription happens on device and audio is never uploaded. Recap and Ask need your own AI provider key; only then is that day's text sent, directly from your phone to the provider you chose. Audio is deleted automatically after 30 days by default; text and marks are kept.

name: Singer LapForce
description:
Singer LapForce is the official mobile app for Singer LapForce sales partners. Manage product lookups, sales verification, warranty checks, and performance tracking from your iPhone,  wherever you sell.

Scan & verify sales
Quickly scan product barcodes or enter serial numbers manually to look up item details and confirm sales on the spot.

Warranty checks made simple
Scan or enter a serial number to instantly check warranty status and coverage details for customers.

Stay on top of your performance

Browse products & commissions
Explore the LapForce product catalogue by category, view product details, and see commission information to support your sales conversations.

Scan history at a glance

Knowledge Hub
Access articles and product knowledge to stay informed and sell with confidence.

Built for the field
Designed for dealers and sales teams on the go, fast, focused, and ready when you are.

Download Singer LapForce and simplify the way you sell, verify, and support every customer.

name: Slalo: Ski Lessons
description:
Learn to ski with 11 lessons on an animated 3D skier. Beginners start with the snowplow, stopping and their first parallel turns. Stronger skiers can move on to carving, short turns, moguls, ice, steep blacks, jump turns, powder and trees.

Each lesson splits one technique into a few steps. Tap a step and the skier shows it: the parts of the body that matter light up, and labels on the body point at what to watch. Switch to the common mistake and the same skier gets it wrong, so you can compare the two.

THE LESSONS
Beginner
• Snowplow glide, on a green. Make a wedge (the "pizza"), keep your speed down and press one ski to turn.
• Stopping, on a green. Push your heels out and press the inside edges until you come to a stop.
• First parallel turns, on a blue. Start each turn with a small wedge, then bring the skis together.

Intermediate
• Carving, on a blue. Tip the skis onto their edges so they grip and follow a clean arc.
• Short turns, on a red. Quick, rhythmic turns where the legs turn and the body keeps facing down the hill.

Advanced
• Moguls, on a black. Your legs fold over each bump and stretch into each dip, so your head travels smoothly.
• Ice and hardpack, on a red. Get the edges biting early and keep your upper body quiet so the outside ski holds.
• Ready for blacks, on a 30° slope. Commit forward and down the hill when your instinct says lean back.
• Jump turns, on a 38° slope. Plant the pole, hop, and swing both skis across the hill in the air.

Off-piste
• Powder. Stay centered with your weight even on both skis, and bounce from one turn into the next.
• Trees, in a glade. Look at the gaps and keep your turns short and in control.

Every lesson also has a "Why it works" page, most with a simple formula, and a list of common mistakes with a fix for each one.

QUIZ AND SKI PINS
A step counts as watched after a few seconds. Watch them all and a short quiz unlocks: in each of three rounds the skier makes one turn, and you say whether it was good or the mistake. Get two of the three right and the lesson is complete. You can retry the quiz any time.

Each finished lesson puts an enamel-style ski pin on your pin board. Finish every lesson in a section and you get that section's pin too, and all 11 earn the Whole mountain pin. A bar on the home screen counts the lessons you've finished.

Slalo keeps your progress on your iPhone and never sends it anywhere. You can reset it in About.

VIEW OPTIONS
Each step starts at half speed so you can see the move, then speeds up to show the flow, and you can set the speed yourself. The Balance lens draws the center of mass, gravity and the push of the snow on the skis. The Angles lens shows leg, body and knee angles, updated live as the skier turns.

Pick from five camera angles (three-quarter, front, side, behind and above) or drag to orbit. You can freeze the turn at Transition, Edging, Apex or Release, and add a second camera view in the corner to watch from two sides at once.

CARVING CALCULATOR
In the Carving lesson, set your speed and your ski's sidecut radius, and Slalo works out the edge angle and turn radius for a clean carve. The physics is simplified, so treat the numbers as a guide.

HOW THE SKIER MOVES
Code animates the skier from the physics of each turn, simplified so the technique is easy to see. The angles and speed on screen come from that model.

SAFETY
Slalo teaches technique and doesn't replace an instructor. Learn new terrain with one, and start on a gentle beginner slope with flat ground at the bottom. Powder and trees are off-piste: never go alone, check the avalanche forecast, carry a transceiver, shovel and probe you know how to use, and stay clear of tree wells, the deep hollows that can form around trunks.

name: SmiProg
description:
Select a thread mill for an internal thread, calculate cutting data and generate a CNC program on your iPhone or iPad. Compare two cutters for the same job to see how tool life and machining time affect the cost of each thread.

FIND A THREAD MILL
Choose the workpiece material, thread profile and thread length. SmiProg lists matching SmiCut thread mills and shows each cutter’s diameter, cutting length and number of flutes. You can also enter the dimensions of your own tool. Work with metric, UN and pipe threads, including BSPT, NPT and NPTF.

CALCULATE FEEDS AND SPEEDS
See recommended cutting speed, feed per tooth and radial passes alongside calculated spindle speed, feed at the thread diameter and feed at the center of the mill. Enter your own cutting values to see how the machining time changes.

GENERATE A CNC PROGRAM
Create Fanuc / ISO IJK programs for a machining center or a lathe with live tooling, or Heidenhain Klartext programs for a vertical machining center. Set the thread hand, safety distance and laser-marked cutter diameter. Copy or share the program, then verify it in simulation or single block before machining.

COMPARE COST PER THREAD
Compare is available to everyone. Enter your own tool prices in EUR, set the tool life and hourly machine rate, and compare machining time, tooling cost and total cost per thread. SmiCut dealers can contact SmiCut for the password to view EUR catalogue prices. Enter it once per device.

Cutting calculations, cost comparisons and CNC programming work offline. The optional online Material Selector can help you find a material category by name or designation. SmiProg is available in 16 languages.

name: Soi: Food Additive Scanner
description:
One little label. A little less guesswork.

Soi helps you understand unfamiliar names in food ingredient lists. Take a photo, choose an image or paste text to identify additives and find explanations you can explore further.

MORE THAN A NUMBER
• A 0–100 additive score and an attention level for each substance identified.
• Tap an additive for its functions, assessment explanation, year and reference sources.
• Explore dietary information, uncertainties and links to FDA, EU, EFSA or Open Food Facts sources where available.

READ LABELS YOUR WAY
• Photograph the ingredient list on packaging.
• Choose an existing image with the iPhone photo picker.
• Paste text you’ve copied.
• Try a sample label in the welcome flow without using a free scan.

A TIDY SCAN HISTORY
Home shows your three most recent results. Tap View all to revisit scans, swipe to delete one or Select all to tidy up several at once.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Photos are recognised with Apple Vision on your iPhone. Images and text are not uploaded to a server. No account, ads or tracking tools. History and your watch list stay on your device. Purchases, restores and external sources need a connection.

FREE AND SOI PRO
Five free scans each month, with full results and additive details. Unclear photos do not count. Soi Pro is one lifetime purchase for unlimited scans and your personal additive watch list, including dietary preferences. Restore with the same Apple Account. No monthly renewal fees.

UNDERSTANDING THE SCORE
The score summarises additive classifications from the source table. It does not assess sugar, salt, fat or overall nutritional value. Soi does not measure concentrations or how much you eat. A high score does not mean a food is suitable for everyone. Grey indicates a missing assessment in the table, not a safety conclusion.

Recognition may miss or misread text, and source assessments may be outdated. Always check the original label, source and assessment year. Soi is for information only. It does not diagnose, recommend treatment or confirm that a food is suitable for someone with an allergy.

Additive data from Open Food Facts under ODbL. Modified database and method: https://soi.escbase.xyz/en/data/
Privacy: https://soi.escbase.xyz/en/privacy/
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Requires iPhone with iOS 26 or later. Apple Intelligence is not required. Available in English and Vietnamese.

name: SplitMori
description:
Split a dinner bill, keep track of shared trip expenses, or settle up after a group event. SplitMori shows what each person owes, who paid, and how to settle the balance.

Free features

• Split a bill in seconds. Enter the total and the people involved, then split equally, let someone treat the group, or record individual spending.

• Keep a ledger for meals, trips and group activities. Record who paid each expense, review member balances and see suggested transfers. Free supports one active activity at a time.

• Record merchant refunds and actual repayments, correct expenses and view earlier versions. Settlement suggestions update as the ledger changes. Members arrange any actual payments themselves.

• Share a split result or activity settlement as a PNG. Back up your local ledger manually, or preview a backup before confirming a restore.

Lifetime Pro

A one-time purchase unlocks multiple active activities, custom splits by amount, percentage or shares, multiple hosts, itemized expenses, advanced service charge and discount allocations, and multiple merchant payers on one expense. Pro also exports activity settlements as PDF or CSV.

Choose from 15 currencies: HKD, CNY, MOP, TWD, USD, JPY, CAD, AUD, NZD, MYR, THB, PHP, KRW, SGD and VND. Each activity uses its selected currency. Amounts are not automatically converted.

Use SplitMori in English or Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong). Your ledger stays on your device, and no account is required.

name: Squirrel Den: Focus Timer
description:
Put your phone down and let a tiny squirrel keep you company.

Squirrel Den is a cozy focus timer. Start a session, and your squirrel works beside you. Finish, and you earn hazelnuts to spend on cozy themes for your den. Step away, and nothing is lost: no scolding, no broken streaks, no guilt.

THOUGHT BURROW
A distracting thought pops up mid-session? Tap "Park a thought", write one line, and the squirrel buries it. After your session, dig it up and turn it into a task, or let it go. Stay in flow without losing the idea.

FOCUS YOUR WAY
• Timer or stopwatch: a set length, or free focus you finish yourself
• Subjects: Study, Work, Reading, Create, Other, or add your own
• Tasks: attach a to-do to a session and see how long you've focused on it
• Gentle by design: 30 seconds of grace if you leave the app, and a rest day each week won't break your streak

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Daily goal, streak and total focus time
• Week, month and year charts
• A calendar that lights up the days you focused
• Focus time by subject
• Achievements for sessions, hours and streaks

MAKE YOUR DEN COZY
• Spend hazelnuts on themes: Meadow, Autumn Forest, Cherry Blossom, Winter Cabin, Starry Night
• Optional Spring & Summer Pack: three more dens (one-time purchase, no subscription)
• Falling leaves, snow, petals and stars
• Soft sounds, optional ambient rain, fireplace or night forest while you focus
• Haptic feedback you can turn off

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Squirrel Den is a focus-support experience, not a medical device.

name: Sufler: Teleprompter Camera
description:
Sufler shows your script as one line over the camera: you look into the lens and read, instead of glancing down at your notes.

The current word is highlighted and the line moves at your pace. Drag the line and the control pad anywhere on the screen, wherever it is easiest to look.

• One line with the current word highlighted. Your eyes follow a single line, with no jumping around a paragraph.
• Pace in words per minute. Faster, slower, pause: one tap.
• For landscape video: with the camera on the left, the current word sits next to it, so your eyes stay near the lens. The line can go right up to the edge of the screen.
• Sentence-level rewind. A tap goes to the start of the current or the next sentence; holding scrolls quickly, word by word.
• Text size to match how far you are from the screen.
• Built-in camera: video with sound, front and back cameras, 1080p, pinch to zoom. The finished video is saved to Photos. The line and the pad are not part of the recording.
• The pad folds into one button with a double tap on Play, so it does not cover the picture, and unfolds the same way.
• Scripts on your phone: paste or type text, import a .txt file (UTF-8, UTF-16, Windows-1251). Keep as many scripts as you like and sort them into folders.
• All settings on one tab, with a live sample of the line: you see each change as you make it.

SUFLER PRO
Without Pro you can try the app: the line moves for 30 seconds per reading and for 10 minutes in total. Sufler Pro lifts that limit and opens:
• Two lines. You see what comes next: the line you have read moves up.
• Two kinds of motion: even speed, or word accent, where long words and punctuation get more time.
• The colour of the current word and the typeface: eight colours and four typefaces, so the line reads well on your background.
• 4K video and 60 frames per second.
• "Over other apps": the line moves into a Picture in Picture window and stays on screen while you use other apps. The window's buttons pause the text, change its speed as it runs and move by sentences. Some camera apps do not show such a window; in that case, record right inside Sufler.

Pro comes as a yearly subscription (the first week is a trial, for new subscribers), a monthly subscription, or a one-time purchase that stays for good. A subscription renews by itself until you cancel it, which you do in your App Store account settings at least a day before the paid period ends.

For video blogs, lectures, presentations, speeches and video messages.

No account and no ads. Your scripts and videos stay on your phone: the app sends them nowhere.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://vlegacy.github.io/sufler/privacy/

name: The LIT Pro
description:
LIT Pro is the photo-sharing app for event photographers and the guests they shoot.

FOR GUESTS
• Open the album link or scan the QR code your photographer shares.
• Take one selfie and LIT Pro finds every photo you appear in, out of thousands.
• Browse, star and save your photos in full quality.
• Your selfie is used only to find your photos in that album.

FOR PHOTOGRAPHERS AND STUDIOS
• Sign in with your LIT account to see all your albums in one place.
• Upload photos and videos straight from your phone.
• Share a client link or an all-access link with a QR code, on WhatsApp or anywhere.
• Control downloads, link expiry, hidden photos and album covers.
• Add your studio logo, watermark and social links so every guest knows who shot their photos.
• See client favourites and guest activity.

LIT Pro works with your existing LIT (thelit.app) account and albums.

name: Tiny Hops: Block Puzzle
description:
Tiny Hops is a cute puzzle full of logic: a bouncy little cube has to break every numbered block in the level.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap the arrows to hop from block to block.
• Every hop on a block lowers its number. At 1, it breaks!
• Break all the blocks to clear the level, without falling into a gap.
• Grab the hidden gem in each level.

700 LEVELS ON 14 ISLANDS
Each island has its own colors and surprises, from small levels to learn the ropes to big maps that go down and climb back up.

THINGS TO DISCOVER
• Springs, boxes and heavy boxes
• Slippery ice and clouds that vanish
• Portals, twin blocks and bombs
• Buttons that open and close doors
• Conveyors that carry you along

DRESS UP YOUR HERO
Spend gems on 25 skins (ninja, robot, watermelon, astronaut...) and 16 accessories.

NO RUSH
• No timers and no lives.
• Undo hops and restart anytime.
• Use hints when you get stuck.

The game is free, with ads and optional purchases to remove ads and get gems and hints.

name: tochofit: Diario de Gimnasio
description:
tochofit es un diario de gimnasio para apuntar lo que haces de verdad: ejercicios, series, repeticiones y kilos. Con eso te enseña cómo progresas y te dice cuándo toca subir peso.

RUTINAS A TU MEDIDA
Al empezar te pregunta tu nivel, cuántos días entrenas, si es en casa o en el gimnasio y qué material tienes. Con eso te prepara las rutinas, solo con ejercicios que puedes hacer. Más de 700 ejercicios con animación, con figura de hombre o de mujer. Cambias lo que quieras: añadir, quitar, reordenar o cambiar un ejercicio por otro.

MODO GUIADO
Un ejercicio en grande, la serie que toca, los kilos de la última vez y el descanso con su cuenta atrás. Apuntas cada serie con un toque. Funciona sin cobertura: lo que apuntas en el gimnasio se guarda en el iPhone y se sube cuando vuelve la señal.

PROGRESO Y ESTADÍSTICAS
Gráfica de cada ejercicio, tu mejor marca estimada (1RM) y récords que saltan solos. Tus semanas y meses con sesiones, tiempo, kilos y series, tu racha y el músculo que más y menos trabajas. Abre un entreno y verás cuánto tardaste en cada ejercicio y cómo vas frente a la última vez. En los ejercicios principales, cómo vas frente a la media para tu sexo y tu peso. El mapa del cuerpo te enseña qué músculos has trabajado esta semana.

COMPARTIR
Pasa un entreno en PDF a tu entrenador, con todas las series, o sácalo como imagen para tus redes, con tu foto de fondo si quieres.

TU CUERPO
Peso y medidas, con bíceps, antebrazo, muslo y gemelo por separado, izquierdo y derecho, y un dibujo que te enseña dónde medir. Fotos de progreso (frente, perfil y espalda) para comparar el antes y el ahora. Las fotos solo las ves tú.

TU SUEÑO
Por la mañana, una carita y las horas, y te da el consejo del día: sesión suave o día para buscar récords. Media, racha de noches buenas, gráfica de las últimas noches y cuánto rindes en el gimnasio según duermes. Tu sueño no lo ve nadie más, tampoco tu entrenador.

ALIMENTACIÓN Y FOTO DEL PLATO
Cuenta tus calorías y tus proteínas: escanea el código de barras, busca el producto o haz una foto del plato y la app te dice qué ingredientes ve y cuántos gramos, para que lo revises y lo apuntes. La foto no se guarda: se analiza y se descarta. Lo que quemas en otras actividades se suma al objetivo del día.

APPLE SALUD
Si lo activas, tochofit lee de Salud tu peso, tus pasos, tus pulsaciones, tus calorías activas, los entrenamientos de tu reloj que no son de pesas y tu sueño, y guarda allí el peso que apuntas. Así se juntan la báscula, el reloj y el gimnasio en un solo sitio. Puedes desconectarlo cuando quieras.

AMIGOS Y PIQUE
Sigue a tus amigos (con permiso: nadie te sigue si no aceptas). Cuelga un entreno, un trofeo o una foto que elijas tú, y reacciona o comenta lo de los demás. Pique semanal entre amigos; si no quieres salir, se quita. Pasa una rutina a tu gymbro por su alias o por enlace. Puedes denunciar una publicación o un comentario y bloquear a una persona.

MODO ENTRENADOR
Tu entrenador puede seguirte desde su cuenta: ve tus entrenos y tu progreso, te manda rutinas, notas y objetivos, y recibe un aviso cuando bates un récord. Tú decides si ve también tu peso, tus medidas y tus fotos (vienen apagados) y le quitas el acceso cuando quieras.

GRATIS Y TUS DATOS EN SU SITIO
Crear la cuenta es gratis, solo con tu correo. Tus datos no se venden y se guardan en la Unión Europea. Puedes borrar tu cuenta desde la propia app.

tochofit es de El Origami Talavera SL (Talavera de la Reina). Ayuda: https://tochofit.com/ayuda

name: Transwordle: Word Guess Game
description:
Guess the five-letter word. But every time you miss, the secret word changes! Your old rows and the whole keyboard repaint for the new word, so the board always tells the truth about the word hidden right now

Colors work as usual: green for the right spot, yellow for a letter in another spot, gray for a letter the word does not have. After a change, sparkles show what got warmer (solid) or colder (hollow). Guess the word hidden right now and you win, and the word stops running away

SOLO
Unlimited games, no daily limit, 10 tries each. When a game ends, the result card shows the path of the word, every word it went through, and a button for the next game

RANKED
1v1 duels with an Elo rating. Matchmaking finds an opponent close to your rating within seconds

You share one board and take turns, 45 seconds a move, with no limit on tries. Any miss changes the word for both of you, and the first to guess the current word wins. If the clock runs out, your turn is skipped, but too many skips lose the duel

PLAY A FRIEND
A private room for two. Send the link or the 4-letter code and take turns on one board. Rematches keep the series score, and the first move alternates between rounds. Games with a friend never change your rating

PROFILE AND SETTINGS
Your profile keeps your rating, your highest rating, solo games played, win rate, current and longest streak, how many tries your wins took, and recent duels

In Settings you can switch sound, vibration, high contrast colors, and sparkles on or off

FREE, NO ACCOUNT
No sign-up, no ads, no in-app purchases

LANGUAGES
The words you guess are always English five-letter words. Buttons, menus and help come in 100 languages and follow your device

Transwordle is an independent game, not affiliated with The New York Times or any of its games

name: Troggu
description:
Troggu is the traditional tarot game of the Valais, in the Swiss Alps. It is played with 62 cards by five to seven players: one player takes on all the others – with the talon or solo. If everyone passes, a misère is played.

AGAINST BOTS
• Start right away, even without an internet connection
• Three levels: Beginner, Advanced, Expert
• The bots have character – and call out across the table in Valais German

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
• “How Troggu works”: a first round, explained step by step
• A tip for every move, with the reasoning behind it
• A recommendation when bidding: pass, normal or solo?
• A review after each round: the most expensive tricks, and where the bots would have played differently
• The complete rules are built in

WITH FRIENDS
• Open a table and share a link or a code
• Bots take the empty seats
• Regulars’ table: players and purse are kept for 30 days

LIKE AT THE TABLE
• The historic cards of the Swiss “1JJ” tarot – or a clear, easy-to-read deck
• Scoring in rappen (Swiss centimes) on the slate, with a purse for the whole evening
• Little and Grand misère to round off the evening
• Statistics on your own rounds

In English, German and French. Free, no ads, no account.

name: trovie: Social Media Organizer
description:
trovie gathers the posts you find across social media into folders you make, so you can find them again anytime.

Share a post to trovie, or copy its link and open Add Post. Pick a folder and tap Add. It opens there next time, even without a connection.

ADD IN A FEW TAPS
• Share a post straight from the app you're in
• Or copy its link and open Add Post. trovie fills in the link for you
• Bring in your own photos and videos from the Photos app

ORGANIZE YOUR WAY
• Folders with the cover you choose, cropped the way you like
• Tags, sorting, and a grid or list for every folder
• Select several posts to move them, edit them together, or merge them into one carousel
• Unsorted keeps anything that isn't in a folder yet
• Hide folders you'd rather keep to yourself

LOOK AT IT YOUR WAY
• Scroll a folder like a feed
• Photos and videos full screen
• Play a whole folder as a slideshow

FIND IT AGAIN
• Search titles, captions, tags and authors in one place
• Tap a tag or an author to see every post that shares it

YOURS, ON YOUR IPHONE
• Nothing to sign up for. No ads.
• trovie keeps your posts on your iPhone and collects no data
• Back up your library and send a copy to iCloud Drive, AirDrop and more
• Deleted posts wait in Trash for 30 days

MAKE IT YOURS
• Six themes, from Light to Lavender
• Meet Mallie. She drops by now and then, and you can turn her off anytime

Works with links from Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads, Reddit and X. Links from other websites come in as the page's photos and videos, or as a readable article.

name: Uncrease: PDF reader
description:
PDFs are made for paper. On a phone that means pinching, zooming and scrolling sideways to follow one sentence across two narrow columns. Uncrease turns them back into clean text that flows to fit your screen.

READ IT YOUR WAY
• Text size, font, line spacing and column width
• Light, sepia, dark and true black themes
• Scroll, or turn pages like a book
• Pick up exactly where you left off

NOTHING LOST IN CONVERSION
• Headings, lists, quotes and footnotes come through as they should
• Figures, tables and equations stay where they belong; tap one to zoom
• Two-column papers, books and reports all reflow
• Scanned pages are read on your device and turned into text

PDFS, EBOOKS AND ARTICLES
• Open PDFs and EPUBs from Files or other apps
• Share a link from Safari to save an article or a PDF
• Search inside a book, or across your whole library

HIGHLIGHT, NOTE, LISTEN
• Highlight in four colours and add notes
• Read aloud with the screen off, at your own pace, with a sleep timer
• Footnotes open in place without losing your page

FIND SOMETHING NEW
• Search Project Gutenberg's public-domain classics, arXiv's research papers and OAPEN's open-access books
• Get a book in one tap; it's ready to read in seconds
• Recommendations from what you read, worked out on your device
• Add your own OPDS catalogue, such as a Calibre library

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no ads. Your library, highlights and reading stay on your device. Uncrease sends anonymous usage statistics and crash reports to help us improve it (never what you read or search for), and you can turn them off in one tap.

name: Unifons
description:
Unifons puts your work schedule on your phone.

Unifons is your employer's workforce platform; your HR department invites you personally. You get a link or a QR code: open it in the app and you see your own schedule right away.

What you see:
