A private VIP minivan from Antalya (AYT) and Gazipaşa (GZP) airports to your hotel in Alanya and back, even for one passenger. The price is per car, not per person, and the same by day and by night. The driver meets you at arrivals with a name sign.

ESIM AND SERVICES
Mobile internet without roaming for Turkey and Europe, installed with a QR code. Currency exchange, car rental, repairs, home rental, a doctor and a translator: tell us what you need, and we find a trusted specialist and send you the price.

CHAT
Instant answers to common questions, and a real person when you need one. Write in your own language: the answer comes in it too.

PAYMENT AND CANCELLATION
You pay on the day of the tour: in cash in any currency at the day's rate, or by card. Cancellation is free up to 24 hours before the start.

SIX LANGUAGES
English, Russian, German, Polish, Serbian and Finnish. Prices can be shown in euros, dollars, pounds, Turkish lira, złoty, roubles or dinars as a guide; bookings and tickets are in euros.

Website: https://alanyabook.com
Questions: info@alanyabook.com

name: Albert — Your AI Team
description:
Albert is an AI team that works on your computer: it joins your client meetings, plans the work, designs the screens, builds and tests the software, and films the demo video.

This app keeps you in charge from your phone.

• SAY YES OR NO — Albert only stops for decisions. Approve a plan, a merge or an email in one tap.
• TALK TO ALBERT — ask what he is doing, or give him a new job, by voice or text.
• SEE EVERYTHING HE MADE — plans, designs, builds, meetings and demo videos.
• FOLLOW THE BOARD — every task and who is on it.
• THE WALL — see what other builders made with Albert, ask for help, and share your own.

Albert does the work on your Mac or Windows computer (or Albert's cloud computer). Pair this phone with a short code from the desktop app.

New to Albert? Tap "Try the demo" to look around with sample data, no account needed.

You lead. Albert builds.

name: Alien Font+
description:
Invent an alien script, then type in it.

Alien Font designs a whole font family from a single seed — every letter, digit and punctuation mark — and previews it live as you type. When you find one you love, export it as a real font and use it anywhere.

Endless Alphabets
• Get a brand-new script in an instant with New Seed
• Strokes walked over a grid, letters drawn inside rings, or cells of dots
• Fine-tune symmetry, sharpness, contrast, stroke direction and more, or let the seed choose

A Real Font Family
• Exports a variable TrueType collection (.ttc) with Regular and Italic
• Every weight from Thin to Black in one file
• Share it with AirDrop, Files or Mail, or save it with Export on Mac and iPad

Every Detail
• Preview your own text at any weight, size and slant
• Open any glyph up close, with its Unicode name and code point

Perfect for games, worldbuilding, tabletop campaigns, sci-fi props, secret notes and logos.

Available on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro.

name: ALIS Events
description:
Welcome to the official app for the Americas Lodging Investment Summit (ALIS) events. Maximize your conference experience with powerful networking tools designed for hotel investors, owners, and industry leaders from all over the world. Stay up to date with the live agenda, connect with top executives, and arrange 1-on-1 meetings right from your mobile device. 
Login instructions, including a link to download the app, are sent to attendees via the email address they used to register for the event.

name: Alpine Mountain Guide
description: Plan your next ski day with Alpine Mountain Guide. Explore ski areas worldwide, see mapped runs and lifts, and download a resort map before you lose service. Check Apple Weather, watch official mountain webcams in Alpine, and find links for tickets, rentals, and lift and trail reports. Time a run with the stopwatch on iPhone or Apple Watch. Create a private trip, invite friends, and choose when to share your location.

name: Amber Mile
description:
The road past the depot has no lights of its own. Your bus rolls only onto asphalt it can see, and its headlamps reach one stretch ahead, so every bend waits in the dark until you light it.

Set a sodium post on an iron lamp base by the verge and the curve glows amber. Aim a floodlamp down one branch of a junction and the driver takes that way; light both branches and the bus halts. Porch lanterns glow gently enough to leave sleeping cottages undisturbed, and a signal flare blazes once before burning out, which matters where roads loop back. Riders board only at a lit shelter. Each mile ends with a ticket punched for a full coach, a still village and sparing lamps, and its fares buy new rides at the all-night garage.

Leave a deer in the glow, though, and it bolts straight into the lane.

name: AmgiDeck: Flashcards & Vocab
description:
How much of what you studied yesterday will you still remember tomorrow morning?
Cognitive science shows that over 70% of newly learned material fades within 24 hours without timely active recall.

AmgiDeck is your precision memory lab—combining tactile red-sheet active recall, an enhanced Ebbinghaus spaced repetition scheduler, on-device textbook OCR, and hands-free commuter audio so you study less and remember 95% longer.

■ Start Studying in Seconds: 8 Curated Decks (1,034 Cards Included)
No empty-app frustration. Open AmgiDeck and dive straight into 8 built-in decks across business communication, office idioms, kanji, professional literacy, computer science & AI, legal principles, and medical/anatomy fill-in-the-blank terminology.

■ 6 Reasons Learners Switch to AmgiDeck

1. Tactile Red-Sheet Masking & Active Recall
Cover definitions or terms across your entire deck list just like a classic red study sheet—tap any hidden bar to reveal the answer instantly and strengthen neural retrieval.

2. 3-Minute Golden-Time Briefing & Smart Spaced Repetition
Rate each card with one tap or swipe (Again 1m · Hard 6m · Good 1d · Easy 4d+). AmgiDeck predicts the exact moment a memory is about to fade and serves a focused 3-minute daily briefing.

3. Camera Textbook Scan to 3-Second Cloze Cards (100% On-Device)
Stop typing long definitions by hand. Snap a photo of any printed textbook or handout—on-device text recognition extracts sentences privately (zero server upload). Simply tap key terms to turn them into [ ___ ] fill-in-the-blank flashcards in 3 seconds.

4. Open Deck Plaza & PC Web 6-Digit Code Sync
• Open Deck Plaza: Preview and save top-rated community decks in 1 second.
• PC Web Studio (amgideck.campdalstudio.com): Paste bulk CSV/TSV spreadsheet rows on your computer and beam them straight to your phone using a 6-digit code—no login required.

5. Hands-Free Commuter Audio Loop
Studying on a crowded train or walk? Plug in your headphones. AmgiDeck reads the prompt, gives you a thinking pause, and speaks the answer automatically.

6. Backlog Avalanche Rescue, Zero-Damage Cram & Speed Quiz
Took a few days off and came back to 150 overdue cards? One tap on Backlog Rescue redistributes overdue reviews smoothly across 3 days so you never burn out. Before exam day, use Cram Mode or Multiple-Choice/Typing Quizzes on weak and bookmarked cards without altering your long-term schedule.

■ Eye-Soothing Paper & Night Slate Ergonomics
Switch effortlessly between glare-free Warm Off-White Paper and late-night Slate Dark Mode. Use every core feature immediately in local Guest Mode, with optional cloud backup whenever you switch devices.

name: AN Umrah & Hajj
description:
AN Umrah & Hajj is an app for groups performing Umrah or Hajj.

It helps the guide and the pilgrims stay organized on the journey, follow the rites clearly, and know the prayer times where they are.

Prayer and Qibla
The app calculates prayer times from your location. In Makkah and Madinah it uses the Umm al-Qura method and Saudi local time. You can receive a spoken reminder fifteen minutes before the adhan, and an alert when the time begins. It also shows the Qibla direction from your position and the Hijri date on the home screen.

Rites and adhkar
There is a ritual guide with read-aloud in Arabic, Hebrew, English, and Russian, counters for Tawaf and Sa’i, morning and evening adhkar as a continuous recitation, passages from the Qur’an, and du'a requests you can share.

Your group
The administrator creates a group and invites members. Inside the group: a walkie-talkie for live talk, text or voice updates, an optional map of members’ locations, a help request, the group schedule, and bus boarding check-in. You can report content or block a user.

Account
Sign-up uses a username and password. A phone number is optional. You can delete your account from the home screen, in the bottom bar. By creating an account you agree to the terms: objectionable content is not allowed.

Basic use: open the app, sign in or continue as a guest for the general sections, allow location to see prayer times for your city, and allow notifications to receive prayer alerts.

Contact: nlgbatsharon@gmail.com

name: Ancient Slumber
description:
Bring candlelight into a room with a view. Ancient Slumber combines an interactive candle clock, animated night scenes, ambient sounds and a visual countdown.

START WITH FOREST AMBIENCE
Watch a night forest through a window. Adjust rain, snow, wind, the night hour, candlelight and available sound levels from the quick menu. Forest Ambience and the starter candle are free.

CANDLE, PIN AND HOURGLASS
Light a candle, place a pin and watch the wax burn down. Set a time or a date and time, choose an occasion or add your own explanation, and show or hide the countdown details. Choose a candle or an hourglass for the countdown. Candle-time mode pauses when you extinguish the candle; real-time mode follows the selected deadline and keeps the candle lit.

SIX PREMIUM WINDOW AMBIENCES
Night Harbour: A distant city, moving sea and passing ships.
Space Ambience: Rotating planets, a drifting space station and shooting stars.
Concert Ambience: A high window overlooking a crowd and changing stage lights.
Night Metro: An elevated train moving through a night city.
Wedding Garden: A night garden and a couple embracing on a pink-lit platform.
Cyber City: Futuristic buildings, a bridge, flying vehicles and adjustable RGB lighting.

Choose the controls available for your scene, including weather, movement, sound or lighting. Premium also includes candle and holder collections, including the retracting Cyber candle set.

COUNT ANIMALS
With Premium, choose sheep, cats, dogs, cows, rabbits, foxes, deer or pandas. Watch them cross the fence, change the counting ambience and rhythm, and pause or reset the counter.

FREE AND PREMIUM
The free version contains ads. Optional rewarded ads unlock one selected candle light for each completed ad. Premium removes ads and unlocks Premium content while the subscription is active. Monthly and yearly plans are available. Prices and billing periods are shown before purchase. Internet is needed for ads and store communication. Scene images and sound files are included with the app.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Subscriptions are purchased through Apple's App Store. Payment is charged to your Apple account when you confirm a purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. Apple may charge for renewal during the 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple account settings. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.

PLEASE NOTE
Keep the app open on screen for ambient audio and alarm sounds; audio does not play in the background. Ancient Slumber is not a replacement for a reliable wake-up alarm or a medical device. It does not guarantee improved sleep or concentration. Available in English and Turkish.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/ancient-slumber-privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Antrenman Defteri: Set Takibi
seller_name: Z SISTEM KURUMSAL HIZMETLER SANAYI TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
Antrenman Defteri, salonda not defteri ya da telefon notları yerine kullanabileceğin sade bir antrenman günlüğüdür.

Bir hareketi seçtiğin anda geçen antrenmanda ne yaptığını görürsün. Uygulama, bugün için bir hedef de önerir: tüm setlerde üst tekrar sınırına ulaştıysan kiloyu artırmanı, ulaşmadıysan aynı kiloda bir tekrar fazlasını önerir.

NELER YAPABİLİRSİN
• Her set satırında geçen antrenmanın aynı sıradaki setini ("Önceki" sütunu) gör
• Kilo ve tekrarı +/- butonlarıyla, klavye açmadan gir
• Dinlenme sayacını kendi sürene göre ayarla
• Yeni rekorları otomatik yakala (tahmini 1RM)
• Yanlışlıkla sildiğin seti geri al
• Yarım kalan antrenmana kaldığın yerden devam et
• Antrenman sonunda süre, set sayısı, toplam hacim ve rekorları özet olarak gör
• Geçmiş antrenmanlarını ve her hareketin gelişim grafiğini incele
• Haftalık takvimde hangi günler çalıştığını gör
• Kardiyo ve süreli hareketleri (plank gibi) de aynı yerde kaydet
• Hazır hareket kütüphanesinden seç ya da kendi hareketini ekle

GİZLİLİK
Hesap açman gerekmez. Verilerin yalnızca cihazında saklanır, hiçbir sunucuya gönderilmez. Dilediğin zaman verilerini yedek dosyası olarak dışa aktarabilir, sonra geri yükleyebilirsin.

Not defterini bırak, geçen seferi hatırlamaya çalışmadan antrenmanına odaklan.

name: AOA Creator
description:
AOA Creator keeps your whole week in one place.

Open the app and see exactly where you stand: how many takes and pictures your plan asks for this week, how many you have done, and how many are left. No counting, no spreadsheets, no guessing.

WHAT YOU GET
• This week at a glance — takes done, takes to go, pictures remaining and the one deadline that matters
• Your calendar — your recording days, which you can move yourself; the rest of the week follows
• Requests — your weekly content plan, each style in it and every task, with instructions, an example script and a reference to watch
• Style guides — the instructions for each style in your plan, formatted to read on a phone
• Marketing — your accounts with their follower and view figures, and how each style is performing
• Invoices — each weekly invoice with its amount, status and week
• Notifications — a heads-up when your plan changes, a recording day is coming or something needs you
• Ask — a built-in assistant that answers questions about your plan, your calendar and your week, and can move a recording day for you once you confirm it

Every change to your calendar asks for your confirmation first. The app never posts for you and never touches your social accounts.

WHO IT IS FOR
AOA Creator is for creators working with AOA Mgmt. Your sign-in is issued by the agency; there is no public sign-up inside the app. If you work with us and need access, email artofattractionofm@gmail.com.

name: aoold Trailquill: AI Hike Log
description:
Trailquill is a field journal for hikers. Record the trails you've walked, plan the next trip, and see every trailhead you've reached on one map. Your journal stays on your device.

LOG EVERY HIKE
• Distance, elevation gain and loss, high point, moving time and difficulty
• Pick the trailhead by tapping a map, no location permission needed
• Add waypoints with altitude and time to draw a live elevation profile
• Weather, route type, hiking partners, notes and photos

SCOUT, YOUR AI TRIP PLANNER
• One-tap commands: plan a weekend hike, find something harder than your last one, or build a pack list for your next trip
• Ask in your own words, like "a 2-day hike near Seattle", and attach photos for context
• Scout turns your hikes into dashboards: season totals, elevation progress and hikes by region
• Every plan can be undone with one tap

YOUR JOURNAL AT A GLANCE
• Total distance, total gain, hike count and highest point on one screen
• Completed, Planned and Wishlist trips, each with an elevation sparkline and countdown
• Detailed hike pages with route maps, elevation charts, photo grids and waypoint timelines

MAP OF YOUR FOOTPRINTS
• Every trailhead on one map, colored by Completed, Planned or Wishlist
• Standard and satellite views

PACK SMARTER
• Pack lists with total weight, a weight breakdown by category and a checklist
• Templates for day hikes, multi-day trips and alpine climbs
• Attach a pack list to a planned hike

YEAR IN REVIEW
• Monthly distance and elevation charts, difficulty mix and your highlights

SAFETY CARD
• Keep an emergency contact and medical notes on your phone, stored only on your device

Imperial or metric units. Sign in with Apple or email.

Privacy: https://trailquill.cc/privacy-notice
Terms: https://trailquill.cc/terms-of-service

name: Aqua Ledger: Water & Care
description:
Keep water test results and water changes together for each aquarium. Record pH, ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, temperature or salinity, then view the selected measurement over time with water changes marked on the chart. Enter the actual tank volume to see how much of it a change replaces. The next date follows the latest recorded change and your chosen interval. Export a CSV of your water records.

The app works offline. Use Settings to back up and restore your records. No account or subscription.

name: AquaKeeper: Fishing Condition
description:
Do you like fishing, but always end up guessing which bait will work today and why the fish aren't biting? It’s time to turn guesswork into a precise system!
AquaKeeper is your reliable offline companion, fully functional even when you completely lose cell service by the water. The app tells you exactly which tackle to choose, what depth layer to target, and which baits deliver peak performance for the current weather and atmospheric pressure.
Get personalized recommendations for every fish species, match the ideal rig to any water condition, and build your own database of winning combinations. No more experimenting in the dark just proven solutions for a guaranteed strike on every trip.

name: ARBOT PRO
description:
ARBOT PRO is the control app for the SCIPIA ARBOT PRO robot arm car. It drives the wheels and the 4-joint robot arm over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and shows the video from the robot's Wi-Fi camera on the same screen.

WHAT YOU NEED
• An ARBOT PRO kit: the robot arm car running ARBOT PRO firmware 1.1.0 or newer
• The robot's BLE serial module (named SCIPIA000 to SCIPIA999)
• Optional: the ARBOT PRO camera, an ESP32-S3 Wi-Fi camera (network name SCIPIA_ plus the robot number). You can drive without it.
• No robot yet? Try the virtual robot (demo) built into the app.

MAIN FEATURES
• Joystick driving: the car moves only while you hold the joystick and stops when you let go. A slider sets the speed.
• Joint control: move the base, shoulder, elbow and grip with −/+ buttons while you hold them. The angle is shown in degrees.
• Home pose: press and hold to move the arm back to its start pose.
• STOP button: stops driving, the arm and playback at once.
• Teach and play: move the arm and save poses one by one (up to 50, stored on the robot), then play them once or in a loop.
• Live pose: a drawing of the joint angles reported by the robot and the current drive command.
• Camera video: joins the camera Wi-Fi with the same robot number and shows its video. You can also find a camera on your router, enter its IP address, and turn the camera LED on or off.
• Firmware check: checks the robot's firmware version and tells you what to do if it does not match.
• Connection warning: a banner appears when the robot connection is lost, with vibration if the robot was moving on its own.
• Settings: video display (show all or fill screen), vibration, left-handed layout, live pose calibration.
• English and Korean, with VoiceOver support.

TRY IT WITHOUT A ROBOT (DEMO)
At the bottom of the robot list, choose "Virtual robot (demo)". A virtual robot inside the app answers like a real one, so you can try driving, the arm controls, STOP, and teach and play without any hardware. The demo has no camera video.

GETTING STARTED
1. Switch on the robot.
2. Tap "Connect robot" and allow Bluetooth.
3. In "Choose robot", pick your robot (SCIPIA plus its number).
4. If you have the camera, switch it on and tap "Connect" on the camera card. Allow joining the Wi-Fi network and local network access when asked.
5. Drive with the joystick and move the arm with the joint buttons.

GOOD TO KNOW
• If Bluetooth is off, turn it on in Control Center.
• The robot list shows only Bluetooth modules whose name starts with SCIPIA.
• The camera uses 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only. The camera Wi-Fi has no internet, so while you watch the camera your iPhone uses mobile data for the internet.
• The control screen is designed for landscape; iPhone also supports portrait. In iPad Split View, Slide Over or small windows, the app shows a guide instead of the controls.
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no account. The app sends no data to any server: it talks to the robot over Bluetooth and to the camera over the camera's local Wi-Fi only.

SUPPORT
SCIPIA · https://scipia.co.kr/
Email: osc95@hanmail.net

name: Arkholm
description:
Arkholm är en pappersverkstad med två bänkar. På mäskbänken ställer du fiber, malning, kar och gusk, och läser jämnhet och fiberlängd. På torkbänken ställer du press, värme, borste och alun, och läser yta och bläckfång.

Ett steg i taget. Inga liv, ingen klocka, ingen reklam och inget konto. Det du skriver stannar på den här enheten.

• 64 mäsksteg — mal fibrerna och läs jämnheten
• 78 torksteg — pressa arket och läs ytan
• Lagt tar bara de steg du själv behåller
• Vägen går i ordning; håll fönstret, så öppnas nästa
• Säg till från förstasidan, så sparas orden på enheten

Arkholm samlar inte in och skickar inte data. Ingen analys och ingen reklam. Tar du bort appen töms verkstaden.

name: Artpanda
description:
Artpanda is the companion app for compatible Artpanda projectors. Connect your device, choose an image, and prepare your picture for drawing, tracing, and creative projects.

• Add your projector over Bluetooth and set up its Wi-Fi connection.
• Browse the inspiration gallery or import images from Photos.
• Organize your works and recent projections in one place.
• Adjust corner alignment, scale, rotation, and mirroring.
• Use line-art and grayscale effects, or reset all picture adjustments.
• Check your device version and available firmware updates.

Sign in with Apple, Google, or an email account to get started.

A compatible Artpanda projector is required for projection and device-control features. Firmware updates require a working Wi-Fi connection. An internet connection is needed for sign-in and downloading new gallery content.

name: Astralica
description:
Your sign, alive on your wrist.

Astralica turns your Apple Watch into a living zodiac face. Pick your sign once, and every glance shows where the Sun, Moon and planets really are right now, and what that means for your day.

Most horoscope apps give you the same text as everyone else. Astralica starts from the real sky. It calculates the positions of every planet on your device, all through the day, and builds your day from them.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
• Health, Love and Business scores from 1 to 5, refreshed every day
• A short reading of the day, written from today's actual transits
• "Why these scores": see exactly which planets lift your day and which ask for care
• The daily horoscope for your sign

A WATCH FACE THAT MOVES WITH THE SKY
• All twelve signs around the edge, your sign at the top
• Live planet markers that travel through the zodiac as the days pass
• Your sign's constellation, drawn star by star
• The Moon phase, the Moon's sign and today's retrogrades
• A calm, dimmed version for Always On

COMPLICATIONS FOR ANY FACE
Add Zodiac Day or Moon to your favourite Apple Watch face, from Modular to Smart Stack. They update through the day on their own, even when the app is closed.

THE REAL SKY, IN YOUR HAND
• A full chart wheel with signs, houses and aspects
• Sky Now: every planet's degree, sign, house and retrograde status
• Your Ascendant and houses for where you are (optional)
• When the Moon changes sign, plus the next Full Moon and New Moon

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-up, no ads and no tracking. The sky is calculated on your device and works offline. Your location is optional, approximate and never leaves your iPhone or Apple Watch.

MADE FOR APPLE
Designed to feel at home on Apple Watch and iPhone: clean type, true black, and colour that comes from the sky itself.

Choose your sign and look up. Your day is already written in the stars.

For entertainment.

name: Athletes vs Aliens
description:
Aliens have landed, and only America's athletes can stop them.

Roll the dice, race around a diamond-shaped board and win back one neighborhood at a time. Rebuild famous landmarks, rescue captured pro athletes and take on a boss at the end of every board. Win, and you fly on to the next city: Staten Island, Manhattan, the Jersey Shore, Philadelphia, Boston, Miami and beyond.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Game Mode: roll, collect, build and travel across 12 mission boards.
• Story Mode: defend the states one by one on the invasion map.
• Fight Mode: pure action. Pick a state and battle wave after wave of aliens.

A ROSTER OF HEROES
Start with a boxer, a slugger and a golfer, then free more pros as you go: a fastball pitcher, a tennis ace, a volleyball star, a badminton pro, a polo rider on horseback, a quarterback, a hoops star, a hockey enforcer and a soccer striker. Every hero fights differently, from close-range power to long-range shots.

COLLECT EVERYTHING
• 81 cards across 9 sets, with rewards for every finished set
• Card packs, a star vault, trophies and achievements
• Dice skins, ships to ride and daily events with prize tracks

FAIR PLAY
Everyone plays by the same rules. Daily limits keep replays fair, and the odds for every card pack and the Lucky Wheel are shown in the game.

Athletes vs Aliens is free to play. Optional coin packs are available as in-app purchases.

name: Átomo Wars
description:
Átomo es un chihuahua extraordinario: inteligente, valiente, rockero y siempre listo para enfrentar a los gato monsters. Ponte sus lentes de sol y entra en una aventura de acción y plataformas en 2D.

ELIGE TU SIGUIENTE MISIÓN
Explora diez mundos en el orden que prefieras, desde Barrio rebelde y Selva salvaje hasta el Núcleo Monster. Derrota a sus jefes y aprende una habilidad especial en cada mundo. En Selva Salvaje, cruza ruinas móviles, esquiva emboscadas desde el dosel y enfrenta las dos fases de Jaguarra.

MUEVE, APUNTA Y DISPARA
Controla a Átomo con un joystick direccional. Apunta arriba, abajo o en diagonal; salta mientras disparas y elige tu combinación de arma y habilidad. También puedes fijar tu posición para apuntar desde el sitio.

PANDORA LLEGA AL RESCATE
Su avión aparece durante la partida y deja cápsulas en forma de hueso con armas poderosas de uso limitado. Recoge corazones para recuperar vida y huesos de poder para alimentar armas y habilidades.

ROCK, LUCES Y EXPLOSIONES
Cada mundo tiene su propia música original. Ajusta volumen, vibración, intensidad visual y joystick para jugar a tu manera.

JUEGA A TU RITMO
Conserva localmente los mundos completados, habilidades, récords y un punto de control de la partida activa. Puedes jugar sin conexión y sin crear una cuenta.

UNA SEGUNDA OPORTUNIDAD, TÚ DECIDES
Al perder, puedes elegir un anuncio recompensado para reanimar a Átomo una vez por intento, cuando haya anuncios disponibles. Puedes reiniciar normalmente sin verlo. No hay banners ni anuncios que interrumpan la partida automáticamente.

Los anuncios opcionales de Google AdMob requieren conexión y disponibilidad. Esta versión no incluye compras dentro de la app. Los enlaces de privacidad y soporte se abren en el navegador y requieren conexión.

name: AussiePrep: Citizenship Test
description:
Prepare for the Australian citizenship test with practice questions written from the official booklet, Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond.

THE REAL FORMAT, THE REAL RULE
• Mock tests like the real one: 20 questions, 45 minutes, 5 from each part of the booklet
• The values rule enforced: you need 15 of 20 AND all 5 Australian values questions right. If a values answer is wrong, the result says so — even at 19/20
• A quick values check before every mock test

STUDY SMART
• 370 practice questions across the booklet's 4 testable parts
• Every question shows the booklet page it comes from, with a clear explanation
• Australian values module: every values question, double-checked against the booklet
• Smart Mistakes: questions you miss come back until you get them right twice in a row
• Spaced review, readiness score and pass chance that respect the values rule
• Progress by topic: mastered, answered and total for each part

AI TUTOR (PRO)
• Ask about any question or topic and get a short explanation based on the booklet
• Answers in your help language

YOUR LANGUAGE
• Explanations and menus in English, العربية, 简体中文, Tiếng Việt and हिन्दी
• Questions stay in English, like the real test

FREE TO TRY
• Every feature on a free sample of each topic, plus one full mock test
• Pro is a one-time purchase — no subscription — and unlocks every question, unlimited mock tests, all explanations and the AI tutor

AussiePrep is an independent app by ANAVASIS LLC and is not affiliated with the Department of Home Affairs or the Australian Government. Questions are based on Our Common Bond, © Commonwealth of Australia, CC BY 4.0. The official booklet and practice test are free from the Department of Home Affairs.

name: Awai: Breathing Sound & Light
description:
Between waking and dreaming.

Awai is a Japanese word for the soft space in between — where one thing quietly becomes another. In Awai, sound slowly swells and fades like breathing, and a faint orb of light glows in time with it. There is no voice and no instructions. Just sound, light, and you.

■ Sound that breathes
• Tones swell and settle in a slow, steady rhythm
• Some follow a breath-like cycle; others drift and sway, or simply hang in the air
• 13 sounds to start with — Sinking into the Deep, Held by the Sky, Still Lake, Zen Garden, Shrine at Dawn and more

■ Shape it with one finger
• Touch the orb and move it until it feels right
• Change the swirl, the reverb, the tide, the pitch — you choose what the orb controls
• Let go, and only the shimmering light remains

■ Tune it to your liking
• Adjust the tide, swell, brightness and more
• Choose the pitch in Hz, with the nearest note shown (528 Hz · near C)
• Solfeggio frequencies, 432 Hz and 440 Hz, or any value you like
• Optional snap to Solfeggio values, with a gentle tap you can feel
• Save your changes as My Sounds

■ Build your own
• Pick a base tone, percussion, motion and light — four simple steps
• 9 tones, from pure tones and crystal bowls to soft noise
• 10 percussion sounds, from a soft heartbeat to the rin bell
• Two voices can cross from left to right, fade away, or slowly approach
• Binaural offset for headphones

■ Japanese sounds
• Shō, shakuhachi and koto, the knock of a bamboo fountain, suzu bells and taiko
• Synthesized to sit between the real and the dreamlike, rather than to copy the instruments

■ For long listening
• Plays in the background and from the Lock Screen
• Timer that fades out slowly and ends with a single bell
• Optional interval bells, tuned to blend into the sound
• Dim Screen, so only the music stays
• Mix with other apps
• Save listening time to Apple Health as Mindful Minutes (optional)
• A quiet record of the days you listened and your total time — no streaks to keep up

■ Simple and private
• Every sound is generated live on your iPhone. No recordings, no downloads
• No ads
• No data collection. Everything stays on your iPhone
• Try three sounds for free. One purchase unlocks everything, including sounds added in future updates — no subscription
• English and Japanese

Touch the light, and stay a while in between.

---
uteralab makes small, quiet apps that help you value the little moments in your day.

name: AXLE by VIXIP
description:
AXLE by VIXIP is a fleet management app for organisations that run their vehicles on AXLE.

For drivers:
• Daily walkaround checks with photos of defects
• Report an incident from the roadside
• See your own check history

For fleet managers: vehicles, alerts, checks, incidents, maintenance and drivers in one place, with compliance dates kept in view. Administrators manage people and access.

AXLE is account-based. Your organisation's administrator creates your account and decides what you can see and do. Your organisation's data is kept in its own AXLE workspace, separate from other organisations.

Support: https://vixip.co.uk/contact/

name: AxzemrUopm
description: This is a tool for identifying everyday knowledge, presenting easily confused words, concepts, and operations in a pixelated game style. You can first record the reasons for confusion, then create a distinction axis, marking the conditions that determine the answer within the specific text. The smallest comparisons progressively display situations, conditions, and explanations, with counterexamples helping to identify the boundaries of rule applicability. Practice supports single, multiple, and insufficient information judgments, retaining each answer and the reason for misjudgment. When rules are modified or answers are questionable, the relevant situations move to a confirmation area; check before resuming practice. A personal quick lookup expands rules and examples by keywords, allowing for manual sorting and prioritizing frequently missed conditions.

name: Baby Photo Album: Swaddlebook
description:
Swaddlebook is a private family photo album and baby journal for parents, grandparents and everyone who loves your little one.

Most baby album apps keep your photos on their servers, and your memories depend on them. Swaddlebook works the other way around.

■ Your photos stay yours
• Photos and videos are encrypted on your iPhone and saved in your own cloud drive, not on our servers.
• Delete the app, or even if our company disappears, your photos are still in your drive.
• Export everything as one zip: every photo and video, your baby log as a spreadsheet, and an album page that opens offline.
• Got a new iPhone? Restore your album from your own drive.

■ Private, encrypted family sharing
• Family copies are encrypted on your iPhone before they are uploaded.
• The album key travels only inside your invite link or QR code. Our server never sees it, so we cannot see your photos.
• Family members on other phones can join the same album.

■ Grandparents join with one link
• Send a link or show a QR code. Grandma and grandpa open it and that's all.
• No account, no password, no sign-up for viewers.
• Big photos, likes and comments in one tap.
• New photo alerts: the app checks when iOS allows background refresh and whenever it is opened, so alerts can arrive late.

■ Sorted the way you remember
• Photos are sorted by the date they were taken.
• Your baby's age is shown on every photo: "4 months 12 days", "Day 135".
• Videos up to 3 minutes.
• More than one child? Each child gets their own album.
• Both parents can add photos.

■ Baby log in 3 seconds
• Feeding (bottle, breast left/right, solids), sleep timer, diapers, height and weight, and first milestones.
• The whole family sees the log together, also encrypted.

■ Growth chart and monthly growth card
• Compare height and weight with the WHO Child Growth Standards for 0-36 months. For reference only, not medical advice.
• A monthly growth card is made on your iPhone. Share it or save it.

■ Promise
• We will never hold your photos hostage. You can always export everything.

■ Good to know
• To add photos, a parent connects their own Google Drive. This only links storage: there is no app account or sign-in. The app can only see the files it creates.
• Viewers do not need any account.
• Available in 31 languages.

Seller: Juna Design (CHUN A IM). Developed and operated by TanzSoft under contract with the seller.
Questions: windyz90@kakao.com

name: BAFsuper Term
description:
BAFsuper Term helps families plan education cash around the school year—not a bank balance, and not a generic calendar.

Enter term dates, known costs (books, camps, exams, childcare), monthly 529 or Junior ISA targets, taxable brokerage DCA, and optional paycheck weeks. Set four priorities: education must-pays, tax-advantaged contributions, parent investing, and summer cash peaks.

Then use: • Cashflow — month-by-month education spend + account contributions + self-invest, to the cent
• Timeline — due dates, contribution days, open camp deposits
• Book — three ledgers kept separate; child-account paper gains stay out of parent totals

Save a year plan when it looks right. Change a camp fee or contribution later and the plan is marked out of date on purpose.

Planning figures stay on your iPhone. Personal planning aid only—not tax, brokerage, or investment guidance.

name: Baker County Service
description:
Baker County Service is the work app for the technicians of Baker County Heating & Cooling and Grant County Heating & Cooling.

• See your day's visits in order, with the customer, address and what the job needs.
• Tap On my way, Arrive, Pause, Hold or Finish as the visit moves along.
• Look up the customer's equipment and past work before you walk in.
• Attach photos of the equipment and the work.
• Build the invoice from the company price book.
• Keep working with no signal: your changes send when you're back in range.

Only people the company gives a login can sign in.

name: Bamen: Listen & Speak Japanese
description:
Understand spoken Japanese and answer back, in the places you will actually be.

Bamen is a listening and speaking course built like a train map. Every theme is a line, every situation is a station: the airport gate, the taxi, the izakaya, the pharmacy, the bank counter, a job interview, signing a lease. Each word comes inside a real sentence you can hear, take apart and say yourself.

HEAR IT, THEN SAY IT
• Every word and sentence spoken by natural Japanese voices. Tap any word to hear it alone, or slow the sentence down.
• Learn the whole sentence: tap any word in it to open its own card, then come straight back.
• Text fades as your ear improves: Read → No romaji → Ear first → Ear only.
• Flip it around: see the English, say it in Japanese, and check yourself with the microphone. Missed it? Try again as often as you like.
• Pitch-accent marks show where the voice rises and falls.
• A word is finished only when you can understand it AND say it.

LEARN WHY IT'S SAID THAT WAY
Tap Extra help for the story behind a word: what its kanji mean, why the reading changes, and the real-life traps (in a shop, "daijōbu desu" means "no thanks"). Number and counter cards show how every number sounds, 1 to 10.

HANDS-FREE LISTENING
Turn your words into a playlist for the commute: Japanese → English → Japanese, shadowing, or Japanese only. Keeps playing with the screen off.

THREE LEVELS, 109 STATIONS, 2,500+ WORDS
• Level 1 Survival: travel, food, shopping, health, polite set phrases.
• Level 2 Daily Life: casual speech, plans, reasons, opinions, sorting out problems.
• Level 3 Fluent Situations: keigo for work, banks, city hall, hospitals, contracts and ceremonies.

GRAMMAR ONE TAP AWAY
Particles and patterns are color-coded in every sentence. Tap one and the grammar note opens right there, with more examples you can play.

MEMORY HOOKS
Every word has a sound-alike story and a picture, so new words stick the first time.

TALK IT THROUGH (Pass + Talk)
Role-play any scene with an AI partner who plays the clerk, the station staff or the doctor, using the words you just learned. Type, use romaji or speak your answer; ask anything in English. Gentle corrections show the natural way to say it.

THREE BUTTONS, NO GUESSING
"Got it", "Almost" or "Show me again". The app schedules the rest, from minutes to months. Quick games between cards (match pairs, Last Train, fill the gap) keep it lively.

RIDE EVERY DAY
A short daily plan, streaks, station stamps, train-class levels from Local to Maglev, daily quests and a weekly tip.

Accurate romaji (Hepburn) and readings on everything. Works offline (Talk needs a connection). No ads.

FREE: the Basics and Numbers stations.
BAMEN PASS: every station, level and feature. $4.99/month or $34.99/year.
BAMEN PASS + TALK: everything, plus the AI conversation partner. $9.99/month or $69.99/year.
Both start with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://bamenlearning.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://bamenlearning.com/privacy

Voices: VOICEVOX:春日部つむぎ, VOICEVOX:雀松朱司.

name: BandParcel
description: Select the color of each band to find a resistor’s nominal value and tolerance limits. BandParcel shows the band sequence with text labels and a drawing. Save parts by name and compare values in a sorted index. Supports four- and five-band resistors with the available tolerance colors. The results describe the markings. For a physical reading, measure the part separately. The app works offline.

name: BARAKAT ALZAYTOON
description:
بركات الزيتون – تطبيق يجمع الناس والخدمات في مكان واحد.

يتيح التطبيق لجميع المستخدمين استكشاف المشاريع التجارية والخدمات المتوفرة والتواصل المباشر مع أصحابها بسهولة.

كما يوفر لأصحاب المشاريع إمكانية عرض أعمالهم وخدماتهم والوصول إلى العملاء.

ويتميز التطبيق بحساب خاص للسكان، يوفر خدمات إضافية لتسهيل الحياة اليومية والتواصل بين الجيران، مثل متابعة الأخبار والإعلانات، واستقبال الإشعارات، وطلب الخدمات، وإنشاء رموز QR مؤقتة للضيوف، وتنظيم معلومات المركبات.

تطبيق بركات الزيتون، لتواصل أسهل وخدمات أقرب إليك.

name: Barline: Sheet Music Library
description:
Barline turns your voice into sheet music, and gives you a free library of nearly 2,000 scores to read, mark up and play along with.

HUM IT OR PLAY IT
Tap record and sing, whistle, hum or play one line on an instrument. Barline listens, finds the notes and draws them as sheet music while you watch. Fix any note with a tap, play it back, change the tempo and key, and practise your own tune bar by bar. Works best with one voice or instrument at a time: humming, singing, flute, violin, recorder, or one hand on a piano. Your recording is processed on your device and is never saved or uploaded.

FIND ANY SCORE
Search nearly 2,000 full scores by composer, title, instrument, period or form. Try "romantic piano", "baroque guitar" or "waltz". Browse hand-picked collections such as Bach essentials, sonata classics, Christmas and lullabies.

READ, PRINT, DOWNLOAD
Open any score full screen, turn pages with a tap, print it or save the PDF. Reading, printing and downloading are always free. Scores you open stay on your device for offline use.

PLAY ALONG, YOUR WAY
Fifty easy arrangements adapt to you bar by bar. Play on a MIDI keyboard or the on-screen piano and each bar moves up or down a level as you improve. Ten songs are free.

BARLINE PLUS
- All 50 play-along songs
- Transpose any song to a key that suits you
- Marking tools: fingering, pedal, breath, bowing, dynamics, text notes and two layers
- Setlists you can play straight through, page after page
- Save your hummed tunes, practise them, and open voice memos (free: 30-second recordings; Plus: up to 3 minutes)
- Practise your own MusicXML files
- Keep every score you open for offline use

METRONOME ON EVERY SCREEN
A metronome button is always one tap away: pick a tempo by name or number, tap it in, choose the beats per bar and watch the pendulum swing in time. Free for everyone.

MARKING THAT RESPECTS THE SCORE
Your marks sit on a separate layer. The score itself never changes, and your marks stay on your device. Open the sample score to see every tool in action.

YOUR FILES STAY YOURS
Add your own PDFs, photos of sheet music or MusicXML files. They are stored on your device and never uploaded.

OPEN SOURCES, CREDITED
Full scores are typeset by volunteers of the Mutopia Project and are public domain, CC BY or CC BY-SA. Every score shows its typesetter and license, and the Credits page lists them all.

Barline Plus: 3-day free trial for new subscribers on the monthly and yearly plans, then $2.99 per month or $19.99 per year, renewing automatically until cancelled. Lifetime: $39.99 one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and you can manage or cancel in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms: https://barline-cex.pages.dev/terms
Privacy: https://barline-cex.pages.dev/privacy

name: Baro Voice
description:
Speak here. It's written there.

Baro turns your iPhone into a microphone for your computer. Click a text box on your Mac or Windows PC, hold the button on your phone, and talk. The words appear as you speak and are typed right where your cursor is.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pair once: open Baro on your computer and scan its QR code with your phone.
• Click where you want to write: email, chat, documents, notes, an AI coding tool.
• Hold the button and talk. Watch the words appear. Slide off to cancel.
• Let go, and it's typed in. Fix it like anything you typed. Ctrl+Z undoes.

No text box? A card opens by your mouse, so you can copy the words and paste them anywhere.

GREAT FOR
• Replies and emails you'd rather say than type
• Long drafts, notes and stories
• Prompts for AI chat and coding tools

LANGUAGES
Dictate in English, Korean or Chinese, or let Baro pick the language.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your voice is turned into text and not kept.
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• Delete your account anytime, right in the app.

WHAT YOU NEED
• The free Baro desktop app for macOS or Windows: barovoice.com/download
• An internet connection on your phone and your computer

Baro is in early access. Sign in with Apple, Google or email. Approved accounts get a free trial, currently one month and 1,000 minutes of dictation.

name: basho.
description:
FEEL AT HOME IN JAPAN
Finding the right local service in Japan shouldn't be complicated.
basho. helps international residents discover local businesses, understand their English-language support, and get an extra hand when needed, ad free.

SEE ENGLISH SUPPORT AT A GLANCE
Every listing shows how well the business supports English: fluent, partial or low, with a short checklist of what is available, such as an English-speaking doctor, English-speaking reception or an English website. Each listing also shows when its details were last checked.

FIND WHAT YOU NEED
- Browse by category: healthcare, beauty, education, family, fitness, wellness, pets, home, real estate, repairs, retail, professional services and more
- Search by name, service or area
- Filter by place, from a whole prefecture down to a ward or neighbourhood
- Filter by English level
- Use your location to jump to the area you are in
- See each place on a map, then open directions with one tap

REAL REVIEWS FROM PEOPLE LIKE YOU
Read what other English speakers say about each place. Write your own review to help the next person, and report anything that does not look right.

SAVE AND SHARE
- Save listings to come back to later
- Call or visit a business website straight from its page
- Share a listing with friends or family by link

CONCIERGE
Not confident calling a clinic or a shop yourself? Our concierge team can contact a business for you to book an appointment, ask a question or arrange something more involved.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
- Browse without an account
- Sign in with Apple, Google or email when you want to save listings or write reviews
- Delete your account and your data from inside the app at any time
- No ads and no tracking

basho. covers services across Japan and is built for English speakers living in, working in or visiting the country.

Questions or feedback? We would love to hear from you at the support link below.

name: Başkent: Rule Your Nation
description:
You are the first leader of a small coastal nation that has just declared independence. The capital is empty, the treasury is thin and the people are hopeful. Give your country a name and shape its future with every decision over the next 20 years.

A LIVING CITY
You zone the neighborhoods, factories, farmland and power plants. The city reacts to your choices: when happiness falls, the squares fill with protesters; during a strike the factories stand still; in good times fireworks light up the night. Earthquakes, epidemics and crises change the streets too.

A NEW AGENDA EVERY MONTH
High-speed rail or schools? Ban the strike or sit down at the table? Every decision has a price. Balance economy, happiness, security, technology, environment and freedom.

LAWS AND PARLIAMENT
You propose the laws, but passing them takes Political Power and a majority. Rival parties form alliances, the opposition files censure motions and the next election is always around the corner. Build a coalition, or drift toward an authoritarian order and risk a coup.

DEVELOPMENT TREES
In the Military, Economy, Technology and Ideology trees every node has an advantage and a cost. Choose your doctrine and use your powers at the right moment.

NEIGHBORS AND THE WIDER WORLD
Four neighboring states wage war, impose embargoes and pressure one another. Mediate, send aid, form alliances or expand your borders. War is paid for on the home front too: waves of emigration, angry unions, a tired public.

FOUR NEWSPAPERS, FOUR VIEWS
Every decision makes the next day's papers. The papers of the workers, the business world, the military and the intellectuals tell the same story in very different ways.

Economic collapse, revolution or a coup... or 20 years that history books will call a Golden Age. Your legacy is in your hands.

FEATURES
• The founding story of a newborn nation; give your country its own name
• A living 3D city that reacts to your decisions, by day and by night
• Decision cards, emergencies and natural disasters
• Laws, elections, coalitions and rival parties
• Military, Economy, Technology, Ideology and Politics trees
• War, embargoes, peace talks and regional unification
• Country Status screen with charts
• Playable without an internet connection
• Built for phones, tablets and foldables
• 7 languages: English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Español, Português, Русский, Français

Başkent is free to play and contains ads. Ads never appear during a decision or a crisis. The optional one-time "Remove Ads + Supporter" pack removes interstitial ads and unlocks the Gold Edition newspaper theme.

All countries, parties and people are fictional.

name: Bawean Esport Alliance
description:
Bawean Esport Alliance (BEA) adalah wadah resmi liga dan turnamen esport Pulau Bawean, dimulai dari Mobile Legends: Bang Bang.

Aplikasi BEA dibuat untuk manajer tim dan pengurus BEA agar urusan kompetisi bisa dikerjakan langsung dari HP.

Untuk manajer tim:
- Kelola profil dan logo tim
- Tambah dan perbarui data pemain: nickname, role, ID game, dan foto
- Atur roster tim untuk setiap kompetisi
- Lihat jadwal pertandingan tim
- Laporkan hasil pertandingan beserta bukti
- Bagikan kabar dan postingan tim

Untuk admin BEA:
- Verifikasi tim dan pemain baru
- Kelola daftar tim dan pemain
- Pantau data kompetisi

Semua data tersambung dengan portal baweanesportalliance.com, sehingga profil tim, roster, jadwal, hasil, dan klasemen tampil otomatis untuk publik. Data pribadi seperti NIK, dokumen, dan nomor WhatsApp tidak pernah ditampilkan ke publik.

Akun manajer dibuat melalui baweanesportalliance.com/daftar, lalu diverifikasi oleh admin BEA.

BEA tidak berafiliasi dengan Moonton atau Mobile Legends: Bang Bang.

name: Beacon Echo
description:
Beacon Echo is your online connection monitor, diagnostics and history keeper.

When opened it periodically queries set of specified hosts using standard ICMP pings to see if they're reachable and keeps the online history for up to set amount of days.

It can autoconfigure reachable LAN based on your actual connection and optionally store hosts into a per connection profile, 
it can also perform DNS queries and HTTPS certificates expiration checks.

In case of a discovered network issue it can help to diagnose failing layer, and - based on user configurable set of criteria - send local notifications or post to a webhook for each state.
It keeps all history which is exportable and shareable as markdown/json/cvs document with all the details.

On iOS/iPadOS it runs periodically when opened, while in background - based on how often OS performs background refresh - and if network is available it performs one quick ping only to known hosts to check if they're reachable.

name: BeamRig
description:
BeamRig is a precision lighting blueprint and photometric ratio calculator designed for cinematographers, studio photographers, gaffers, and visual artists.

Built on fundamental optical physics, BeamRig brings clarity to set pre-visualization with an intuitive 2D overhead canvas, instant key-to-fill contrast gauges, modifier stop-loss compensation, and fully standalone production ticket generation.

KEY FEATURES:

• 2D OVERHEAD CANVAS BLUEPRINT
Position key lights, soft fills, rim fixtures, flags, and bounce reflectors around your subject and camera with interactive drag controls. Real-time directional beam angles, coverage cones, and throw distance rings (1m to 3m) visualize your setup at a glance.

• PHOTOMETRIC CONTRAST & FALLOFF GAUGES
Compute precise illuminance using the inverse square law (E = I / d²). Monitor key-to-fill contrast ratios (1:1 to 1:16) and EV exposure deltas in real-time, accompanied by photometric contribution breakdown bars.

• LIGHT MODIFIERS & COLOR TEMPERATURE GELS
Select from standard professional shapers (including 90cm octaboxes, beauty dishes, parabolic softboxes, and honeycomb grids) with calibrated stop-loss ratings. Factor in full, half, and quarter CTO/CTB color conversion gels.

• PRODUCTION RIG VAULT
Save, duplicate, and organize complete lighting setups for commercial portraiture, high-key fashion, or dramatic noir cinematography. Ships with production-ready presets including Rembrandt, Paramount, and Classic Loop.

• ON-DEVICE SPECIFICATION EXPORT
Generate clean, printable vector PDF production tickets and plain-text summaries directly on your device. AirDrop to crew, print for set binders, or copy to project notes without remote server dependencies.

FOCUSED & STANDALONE:
• Direct on-device computation without account setup.
• Clean single-device workflow.
• Engineered for fluid, responsive mobile operation.

name: BeePass
description:
BeePass is the field app for beekeepers and queen breeders, linked to your BeePass account: scan a queen, score her visit with gloves on, dictate instead of writing, count varroa, weigh the supers, and save everything even without network.

EVALUATE A QUEEN
• Scan the queen's QR code on the hive: her visit form opens.
• Scores from 1 to 4, half points included, on big buttons: gentleness, calmness on the comb, swarming, diseases, stores.
• Honey per harvest, varroa, brood, VSH and visit notes.
• Several F1 queens can be scored together, up to 50.
• Dictation: you speak and the form fills in live. Each value understood is shown and can be undone.

PIN TEST AND TREATMENTS
• The 3-hour timer keeps running even with the app closed, and reminds you.
• Varroa treatments are picked from the official list of the apiary's country, with a reminder the day before they end.

HARVEST AND HONEY HOUSE
• Scan the queen then her supers, and weigh them on a Bluetooth scale.

WINTERING, LOSSES, MIGRATORY BEEKEEPING
• Scan colonies one by one, with nothing to type.
• A colony evaluated in another apiary is moved there, with a button to undo.

OFFLINE
Evaluations, Pin Tests, scans, weighings and moves wait on the phone and are sent in order as soon as the network is back, with no duplicates. Your apiaries and queens stay available for 7 days.

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Sign in with email, Apple, Google or Facebook, with two-factor authentication if you have turned it on.
• Face ID or Touch ID lock when the app opens; no password is kept on the phone.
• Delete your account from the app.

A FIELD TOOL
The app keeps what matters, at the hive and in the honey house. Full queen records, pedigree, genetic indexes, season documents and account settings are on the website beepass.io.

A BeePass account is required. Available in French, English, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese and Russian.

name: Behind the Bar: Bartender Game
description:
You can read a hundred cocktail recipes and still freeze when someone orders a Negroni.

Behind the Bar puts you to work. Guests sit down, order and wait. You pick the glass, add ice, measure, shake or stir, strain, garnish and serve before their patience runs out.

LEARN BY DOING
- Classic recipes with exact measures.
- Each shift teaches one skill, from building a highball to double straining.
- The recipe card fades as you improve, until you work from memory.

GUESTS WHO NOTICE
- Shake a drink that should be stirred and somebody will mention the bubbles.
- Every drink gets a review, so you know what to fix.
- Tables order through a waiter, and some guests only describe what they want.

A COURSE WITH A CERTIFICATE
- Pass a shift and earn a certificate with your name on it.
- Finish the course for the full certificate. Anyone can verify it online.

Plays offline on iPhone and iPad. From the makers of Stirred Art.

name: Belcome: Book Salons & Spas
description:
Belcome shows the salons, barbershops, spas and med spas near you and lets you book a time in a few taps, without calling.

WHAT IS NEAR YOU
Open the map and see the places around you, closest first, with their category, distance and rating. Search by name, service or city, or type a city or ZIP when location is off. Tap the heart to keep a place in Favorites.

EVERYTHING BEFORE YOU BOOK
Each place has its own page: services with price and duration, the next open time, the team with their photos, reviews from real visits, opening hours, directions and a button to call.

BOOK IN A FEW TAPS
Pick the service and its option, add extras, choose a professional or anyone available, and pick a time. Times are shown in the business's own time zone, so 9:00 means 9:00 at the door. When a business asks for a deposit, you pay it on a secure payment page with Apple Pay or a card.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
Continue with Apple or Google, or get a 6-digit code by e-mail. No password to remember.

ALL YOUR APPOINTMENTS IN ONE PLACE
See upcoming and past visits from every Belcome business with the same e-mail, open directions, manage a visit, and book again. Packages and credits you still have at each business show up too, with a way to use them.

Belcome is free to download. Businesses on Belcome set their own prices and policies.

name: Belg
description:
Belg ist die App für den Familienalltag. Kinder machen mit, Eltern behalten die Kontrolle.

AUS ARBEIT WIRD EINE MISSION
• Eltern stellen Missionen ein: Zimmer aufräumen, Auto waschen, Hausaufgaben
• Ein Foto zeigt, dass es erledigt ist
• Für jede Mission gibt es Bohnen

IM SHOP WERDEN BOHNEN ZU FREIHEITEN
• Eltern legen fest, was es gibt: Spielzeit, ein Ausflug, länger aufbleiben
• Gekauftes liegt im Tresor, bis es eingelöst wird
• Bohnen sind kein Geld und kein Druckmittel. Es gibt keine Strafen

LERNEN, DAS SPASS MACHT
• Kopfrechnen: rechnen, bis das Monster satt ist
• Vokabeln Runde für Runde, mit Ton und Eselsbrücken
• Lesen üben: Belg hört zu
• Schule: der nächste Schultag aus WebUntis

DER FAMILIENALLTAG AN EINEM ORT
• Einkaufszettel für alle, Zu-tun-Liste, Termine und Wetter
• Hilferuf: ein Knopf, und die Eltern wissen, wo ihr Kind ist
• Spiele, die die Eltern freigeben

BELGAI
• Beantwortet Fragen in kindgerechter Sprache
• Ist für jedes Kind aus, bis die Eltern es einschalten
• Eltern können jedes Gespräch mitlesen

Keine Werbung. Kinder brauchen keine eigene E-Mail-Adresse: die Eltern legen sie an und laden sie per QR-Code ein.

BELG PLUS
Der Kern von Belg ist kostenlos: Missionen, Shop und Bohnen für die ganze Familie. Belg Plus bringt BelgAI, Fotos mit KI-Prüfung, eigene Lieder, mehr Vokabeln und Lernrunden, die Schule und mehr Platz für Missionen und Belohnungen.

Belg Plus gibt es als Abo für 5,99 € im Monat oder 49,99 € im Jahr (Preise in Deutschland, andere Länder in Landeswährung). Neue Abonnenten bekommen den ersten Monat gratis. Die Zahlung wird bei Bestätigung des Kaufs über deine Apple-ID abgerechnet. Das Abo verlängert sich automatisch, außer du kündigst es mindestens 24 Stunden vor Ende des laufenden Zeitraums. Kündigen und verwalten kannst du es jederzeit in den Einstellungen deines Apple-Accounts.

Nutzungsbedingungen: https://belg.app/de/terms/
Datenschutz: https://belg.app/de/privacy/

name: Bệnh Viện Nội Tiết Nghệ An
description:
Ứng dụng chính thức hỗ trợ khách hàng và bệnh nhân tra cứu thông tin và quản lý sức khỏe cá nhân tại Bệnh Viện Nội Tiết Nghệ An.

Đối tượng sử dụng: Bệnh nhân khám, chữa bệnh tại Bệnh Viện Nội Tiết Nghệ An.

Các tính năng nổi bật:
- Tra cứu kết quả khám bệnh: Dễ dàng xem lại lịch sử thăm khám và kết quả xét nghiệm, chẩn đoán nhanh chóng ngay trên điện thoại.
- Quản lý tài liệu y tế: Lưu trữ và quản lý các đơn thuốc, giấy tờ và tài liệu y tế cá nhân an toàn, thuận tiện.
- Quản lý gia đình: Thêm và quản lý hồ sơ sức khỏe của các thành viên trong gia đình trên cùng một tài khoản.
- Thông tin cá nhân: Quản lý thông tin tài khoản người dùng dễ dàng.

Chúng tôi không ngừng cập nhật và phát triển ứng dụng để mang lại trải nghiệm chăm sóc sức khỏe tốt nhất cho người bệnh tại Bệnh Viện Nội Tiết Nghệ An.

name: BensTenzkiz
description:
BensTenzkiz är ett personligt färdighetsalbum i form av resefrimärken. Varje färdighet är en station: plats, datum, foto från kamera eller galleri, bedömning och övningstid.

Anslagstavlan visar öppna stationer och årsöversikt över resor och timmar. Passpanelen öppnar märkesalbumet, platsatlasen och ateljén. Ingen nedre tabbar.

Lägg till ett område, skapa en station och markera ankomst. Kartan visar var du har övat. Allt stannar på enheten.

BensTenzkiz är anpassad för iPhone SE. Öppna den för en tydlig registrering av framsteg, som en frimärkssamling.

name: Besiden
description:
Besiden is a bookshelf for the ebooks you keep on your own device. Bring in TXT, EPUB, and PDF files, open a cover, and continue from where you left off.

Import one book, or bring in several at once from a ZIP archive or a folder. TXT files are read with their usual encodings and chapters when possible. Group books by author, series, or what you want to read next.

While reading, you can adjust type size and line spacing, turn pages by sliding or scrolling, open the table of contents, add bookmarks, and search the text. PDFs keep their original layout, and you can zoom and scroll. Backgrounds include paper, plain, and night. A reading calendar remembers what you read on a given day, and you can leave a short note that stays on this device. The interface is available in Simplified Chinese and English.

Books and reading history stay on this device. They are not uploaded, and there is no account to create.

Beside does not support online viewing. There is no bookstore and no online book source. Import ebooks you have the right to read.

name: Bet Calculus Discussion
description:
Explore the mathematical principles behind probability, expected value, and statistical uncertainty through educational explanations and practical examples. Learn how numerical relationships influence different outcomes, understand common misconceptions, and discover why experimental results can differ from theoretical expectations. Develop analytical reasoning and strengthen your understanding of mathematical calculations.

Apply mathematical concepts using five interactive calculators covering probability, numerical conversions, expected value, percentage analysis, and outcome calculations. Enter custom values, examine detailed results, and explore the formulas behind each calculation. Compare different scenarios using outcome matrices and visual probability distributions. Run numerical simulations to observe how changing input values and probability levels affects results across multiple rounds.

Improve your analytical skills through daily mathematical challenges featuring two different perspectives. Examine numerical evidence, select an answer, and review detailed explanations supported by mathematical reasoning. Revisit completed challenges, evaluate your assumptions, and develop a deeper understanding of probability, statistics, and uncertainty.

All calculations, challenges, and simulations are designed for educational purposes only and do not involve real-world payments or financial transactions.

name: BidBreak
description:
Most software helps you manage work. BidBreak helps you create it.

BidBreak turns construction drawings into a detailed, trade-specific estimate. Upload your bid set, pick your trade, and BidBreak builds a priced proposal with line items, sub-items, a material takeoff, clarifications and exclusions. Send it as is or edit anything.

Built for subcontractors, estimators and general contractors across 21 trades, including millwork, countertops, drywall and framing, finish carpentry, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, glazing and more.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Upload drawings and get a priced estimate for your trade
• Get a material takeoff by line item or by room
• Edit line items, quantities, rates and markup in the proposal builder
• Send RFIs and track answers
• Send proposals to clients, see when they're viewed, and collect e-signatures
• Track every bid from estimating through award on your dashboard and calendar

ON YOUR PHONE
Check estimates, review proposals, answer RFIs and follow up on bids from the job site.

Plans and Bid Credits are managed at bidbreak.com.

name: Big Red Button: Pocket Leader
description:
Meet the Supreme Deal-Maker of Grand Republica. He has a big red button, an even bigger ego, and absolutely no idea what he's doing. That's where you come in.

Pocket Leader is a funny, bite-sized pocket-pet game about a completely made-up world leader. Check in for a minute or two a few times a day, keep him happy, and help him make history (or at least the front page).

MAKE DEALS
Crises pop up on the desk globe while you play: a goat wandering across the Fjordistan border, a pizza shortage in Pastaland, aliens parking in the Banana Archipelago. Press DEAL and pick one of three deals. Every deal shows what it will do before you choose, and some come with side effects that start a brand new crisis.

WIN THE NOZEL PRIZE
Your first deal each hour moves the Nozel Prize scale up one step. Skip an hour and it slips back. Fill all 24 steps and he finally wins the Nozel Prize for Outstanding Deal-Making. He will not accept it humbly.

KEEP HIM HAPPY
Four needs to look after: Ego, Fizz, Approval and Energy. His hair shows how he feels: puffed up and proud, drooping when he's thirsty, sticking up like flames when the crowd boos.

DON'T OVERDO THE FIZZ
DRINK keeps him going, but one cola too many and he goes HYPER: sparks fly, he hiccups, and he starts pressing DEAL all by himself.

A WORLD THAT KEEPS TURNING
• The crowd outside his window cheers, shrugs or throws tomatoes, depending on Approval. Close the curtains if you can't bear it (they'll feel ignored).
• The sky follows your real clock, and at night he falls asleep at his desk.
• Ignore a crisis for too long and he prints a silly Proclamation in the newspaper.
• Come back to "The Grand Republica Times" to see what happened while you were away.
• Collect every front page, Proclamation and prize in the Hall of Deals.

MORE
• Fresh deals written on your iPhone by Apple Intelligence on supported devices, with hand-written deals everywhere else.
• A home-screen widget with his face, his mood and your Nozel progress.
• Gentle reminders when he's thirsty (never at night).
• Cartoon sound effects and haptics.
• Free. No ads. No accounts. No data collected.

Pocket Leader is a work of satire. The leader, his country and everyone in it are entirely fictional and are not based on any real person.

name: Birthday Reminder Midori
description:
REMINDERS THAT FIT YOUR LIFE
Get a reminder on the day, the day before, a week before, or whenever you like, at the time you pick. Set defaults once, then change them for anyone who needs an earlier nudge.

WISHES IN ONE TAP
Pick a tone (warm, funny or short), and Birthday Reminder Midori fills in a wish in your language. Send it by message, WhatsApp or email, or make a birthday card to share in Stories. Nothing is ever sent for you: you read it, change it if you like, and tap Send yourself.

EASY TO START
Import birthdays from your contacts or from yearly calendar events, or add people by hand. Import only who you choose.

WIDGETS, CALENDAR AND INSIGHTS
Put the next birthday or the next three on your home screen. Browse a month calendar, and see fun insights: the busiest month and season, the most common zodiac sign, the average age.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account and no sign-up.
- No ads, no analytics and no AI.
- Your list is stored on your phone. We never receive it.
- Contacts and calendar are read only when you import, and never uploaded.
- Back up with your phone's own backup

FREE, WITH AN OPTIONAL ONE-TIME PREMIUM
Everything you need is free, with no limits: unlimited people, reminders, imports, backup, export, widgets, calendar and insights.
Premium is a single one-time purchase, not a subscription. It adds the countdown and calendar widgets, the Pink, Space and Sage themes, more colors, patterns, icon avatars and card styles. It is our way of keeping the app ad-free, and it is entirely optional.

Available in English, Spanish, German, French, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese.

Happy birthday to everyone on your list.

name: BizSiz Koçluk
description:
BizSiz Koçluk, dershanesinde koçluk sistemi kullanılan öğrenciler için hazırlanmış öğrenci uygulamasıdır. Koçunuzun sizin için hazırladığı çalışma programını, ödevlerinizi ve gelişiminizi tek yerden takip edebilirsiniz.

BUGÜN
Günün çalışma bloklarını sırasıyla görün. Bir çalışmaya başlarken sayacı açın; süreniz kendiliğinden kaydedilir. Çözdüğünüz soru sayısını ve doğru sayınızı birkaç dokunuşla girin.

PROGRAM
Koçunuzun hazırladığı haftalık programı gün gün inceleyin, tamamladığınız çalışmaları işaretleyin. Geçmiş haftalara dönüp neler yaptığınızı görün.

ÖDEVLER
Koçunuzun verdiği ödevleri ve ne kadarını bitirdiğinizi takip edin.

GELİŞİM
Çalışma sürenizi, çözdüğünüz soruları ve doğruluk oranınızı günlük, haftalık ve ders bazında grafiklerle izleyin.

HATIRLATMALAR
Sıradaki çalışmanız ve koçluk görüşmeniz yaklaşınca telefonunuza hatırlatma gelsin.

BİRDEN ÇOK HESAP
Aynı telefonda kardeşlerin hesapları birlikte kullanılabilir; hesaplar arasında tek dokunuşla geçebilirsiniz.

HESAPLAR HAKKINDA
Uygulamada kayıt olma bölümü yoktur. Öğrenci hesapları yalnızca dershanenin yöneticisi tarafından, dershanenin web paneli üzerinden oluşturulur ve yönetilir. Giriş bilgilerinizi dershanenizden alabilirsiniz.

Uygulamada reklam ve üçüncü taraf takip bulunmaz.

name: Blaulino
description:
Blaulino.de zeigt aktuelle Einsätze in deiner Region auf einen Blick: Polizei, Feuerwehr, Rettungsdienst, Verkehr und Behördenwarnungen.

Auf der Karte siehst du, wo etwas gemeldet wurde. In der Liste filterst du nach Zeitraum, suchst nach Ort oder Titel und speicherst Meldungen, die du später noch einmal brauchst. Für neue Einsätze in der Nähe kannst du eine Mitteilung bekommen, auch wenn die App geschlossen ist.

Die Meldungen stammen aus öffentlichen Quellen, unter anderem Polizei- und Pressesfeeds, NINA, MoWaS, KATWARN, dem Deutschen Wetterdienst und der Autobahn GmbH. Fehlt ein verlässlicher Ort, setzen wir keinen Punkt auf die Karte. Über den Link in der Meldung öffnest du die Originalquelle, sofern eine Adresse vorliegt.

Du kannst selbst eine Sichtung melden, zum Beispiel einen Einsatz oder einen Kontrolleur. Andere können die Meldung bestätigen.

Blaulino.de ist keine amtliche Lage, kein Warnsystem einer Behörde und kein Notruf. Texte, Zeiten und Orte kommen von den jeweiligen Herausgebern und können unvollständig oder veraltet sein. In Notfällen immer 110 oder 112 wählen.

name: Blind Ranking: Rank Everything
description:
Rank Everything. Blind.

Blind Rank is the ranking game where you place each item into your list without knowing what comes next. Put your favourite in first place, then watch a legend show up right after. Trust your gut, commit to every pick, and see how your ranking compares to everyone else's.

HOW TO PLAY
- Pick a category
- An item is revealed: choose its position from 1 to 10
- Once placed, it's locked. No moving it later
- Keep going until your list is full, then see your score against the global average ranking

100+ CATEGORIES
- Football: current players, legends, teams, goalkeepers, dribblers, free-kick takers and more
- Basketball: current players, 2000s stars, teams, dunkers, shooters, clutch moments
- Other sports: fighters, boxing, wrestling, American football, racing, tennis, cricket and more
- TV and Film: shows, movies, superheroes, villains, cartoons, anime
- Music: rappers, songs, rock, metal, R&B, pop groups
- Video Games: popular games, weapons, characters, vehicles and more
- Food: fast food, snacks, chocolate bars, drinks, ice cream
- Internet: content creators, streamers, memes, brain rot, red flags and more

FEATURES
- Popular mode for well-known items, or All for the full list
- Choose 5 to 10 items per round
- Score system based on how everyone else ranked the same items
- Watch clips and play sounds right inside some categories
- Share your ranking as an image and challenge your friends

EXTRA GAMES (PREMIUM)
- Red Pill Blue Pill: pick the side with the better lineup
- Avoid The Same Answer: give an answer the game won't randomly pick
- Choose Your Table: pick which crowd you'd rather sit with

PREMIUM
One-time purchase, no subscription. Unlock all premium categories and extra games, and remove ads. Already bought it? Use Restore Purchase in the app.

No sign-up needed. Just pick a category and start ranking.

Can you rank it right without seeing what's next?

LINKS
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.blindrank.net/PrivacyPolicy

name: Blind Wings: Echo Bat
description:
A bat, a pitch-black cave and a serpent that hunts by sound.

Blind Wings is a one-touch arcade game. Hold to climb silently, flying blind. Let go to glide down and screech: your echo lights up the cave walls for a moment, and a longer hold makes a bigger echo.

But every screech leaves a sound mark, and the serpent dashes to the last one. Fly smart, stay quiet when it is close, and see how deep you can go.

A CAVE THAT CHANGES
Nine places on the way down. The cave mouth leads to the glowworm grotto, the underground river, where waterfalls hide your screech, and the crystal cave, where crystals fool the serpent with decoy echoes. Deeper down wait the underground forest, whose mushrooms glow in your echo, the ice cave, the lava cave, the autumn cave and, at the very bottom, the abyss. On the way: moonlight the serpent will not follow you into, brittle stalactites, owls that hear you and spiders that leap at low flyers.

TONIGHT'S TASKS
Three small tasks every night. Finish them to earn stars, and use stars or depth to unlock new bats.

SEVEN BATS
Night is your first bat. Ember, Forest, Frost, Autumn, Abyss and Gold each bring a small perk: a longer echo, a longer sprint, a slower serpent in water and more.

TODAY'S CAVE
One attempt a day in the same cave for everyone. Keep your streak going.

GOOD TO KNOW
• One finger, short runs.
• An echo map of every run.
• Original music and sounds.
• 13 languages.
• No ads, no in-app purchases.
• No account. Plays offline.

Follow us on YouTube and TikTok (@aiplaz).

Made by Aiplaz, a small indie studio. Questions or ideas? Write to support.aiplaz@gmail.com

name: BlockBeat: Tilt Puzzle
description:
Drop blocks on an 8×8 board, fill rows and columns, and watch them burst into sparks. Then earn the move that makes BlockBeat different: tilt the whole board.

EARN THE TILT
Clear a line within three blocks and you light up a dot. Three dots earn you a tilt. Tap a glowing arrow and every block slides that way, opening up space and forming new lines. Those lines can clear and set off a chain reaction, and every step of the chain scores more. Keep your tilt for the moment it saves you.

FAIR PIECES
You always get three blocks at a time, and they are dealt so that you can almost always place them. It can be tricky, but when the board fills up it is your own doing, never bad luck.

SET COMBOS
Clear a line with each of the three blocks in a set for a combo bonus, and keep the combos going for bigger scores.

LEARN IN A MINUTE
Tap "How to play" for a short interactive demo on the real board: drag a block, earn your dots, tilt, and see a chain reaction. The demo never touches your saved game or your best score.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• No ads. Not now, not later.
• No tracking, no account, no data collected. Plays fully offline.
• Upbeat synthpop music, made by the app itself, with gentle sound effects and haptics. Music, sounds and haptics can each be switched off.
• Tilt by tapping the arrows, or turn on "Tilt with iPhone" and tilt your phone for real.
• Leave at any time: your game is saved and you continue where you left off.
• Portrait or landscape, whatever is comfortable.
• Game Center leaderboard for your best score.
• In English and Dutch.

ACCESSIBLE
• Show symbols: every colour gets its own shape, so you never need to tell colours apart.
• Respects Reduce Motion: no sparks, shakes or flicker.
• Text follows your text size (Dynamic Type) where it fits, with large buttons.
• Fully playable without sound: everything you hear is also shown.

Calm when you want it, exciting when the chain starts rolling. Place, clear, tilt.

name: Blokla: Block Logic Puzzle
description:
The board is empty and the blocks are yours to draw. In Blokla you give every stone a block that fits, until no gap is left.

Drag on the board to draw a rectangular block. The number on a stone tells you how many squares its block needs. Shape stones ask for a shape instead: square, wide or tall. Each block holds exactly one stone, and the whole board must be covered.

• 300 levels from 4×4 to 12×12 with a shifting challenge, each with exactly one solution
• New rules with rocks, chained stones and locked blocks
• Move limits, with more stars for finishing fast
• A new daily puzzle with streak tracking
• Hint gifts at star goals and block colors that change as you progress
• Undo, hints, stars and combos for correct moves in a row
• No forced ads, no accounts, plays offline
• English and Turkish

name: BookR: Rent Local Equipment
description:
Rent it, don't buy it. BookR is a peer-to-peer rental marketplace for borrowing the things you need for a day or a weekend from people nearby, and for earning money from the things you already own.

Need a carpet cleaner for one afternoon, a tent for a camping trip or a projector for a backyard movie night? Someone near you probably has one sitting in a closet. BookR connects you.

BookR is starting in Woodstock, Illinois and Fort Collins, Colorado.

RENT FROM PEOPLE NEARBY
