• Browse tools, outdoor and camping gear, party supplies, electronics, home and garden equipment, sports and fitness gear, musical instruments, and costumes and formal wear
• See which dates are free on each listing's calendar
• Rent by the day, by the week, or for 4 hours when the owner offers it
• Every price shows the all-in total, fees included, before you book
• Message the owner with questions before you request
• Nothing is charged until the owner accepts your request
• Free cancellation up to 48 hours before your rental

LIST YOUR STUFF AND EARN
• Listing an item is free
• Add photos, set your own daily, weekly or 4-hour price and a minimum rental length
• Offer delivery if you want to
• Review every request and accept or decline it. You'll see whether the renter has verified their ID
• Get paid through Stripe after the rental is complete
• Track requests, bookings and earnings on your dashboard

POST AN ASK
Can't find what you need? Post an Ask describing the item and your dates, and owners nearby can respond.

BUILT FOR TRUST
• Both sides photograph the item at pickup and return, so there's a record of its condition
• If something goes wrong, you settle it between you first and BookR reviews the evidence if you can't agree. Any post-rental charge is capped at a limit shown before you book
• Reviews come only from renters who completed a rental, so every review is tied to a real booking
• Optional ID verification through Stripe
• Payments are processed by Stripe. Your card details never touch BookR
• Report any listing, message, review or person, and block anyone you don't want to hear from. BookR reviews every report within 24 hours

SIMPLE, CLEAR FEES
Renters pay an 8% service fee on top of the rental price, and owners pay 8% out of their payout (a $1.50 minimum on each side). Sales tax applies where required.

Questions? Email support@bookr-app.com or visit bookr-app.com/support.

name: BOOMOLE: Demolition Puzzle
description:
Boomole, a little mole with a leaf on his head, is the new kid at Bomtetsu & Co., a demolition crew.
Learn from tough-but-kind Boss Bomtetsu and become a true Blast Master!

Push the detonator and get to work!
Where should the bombs go so the building falls straight down?

■ HOW TO PLAY
Choose where to place bombs on the columns, then hit DETONATE!
Buildings collapse with realistic physics.
Land the rubble inside the lot and aim for a Blast Score of 100!
Scratch the house next door and you can only get 2 stars. Knock it down and you fail!

■ FEATURES
・100 stages, from a wooden shed to a skyscraper
・4 bomb types: standard, power, cutter and timer
・Many materials: wood, glass, concrete, reinforced concrete and steel
・Gas tanks explode! Set them off in a chain reaction
・Structure view shows the weak spots where the load gathers
・Collect 3 stars and 3 kinds of medals: Thrifty, Perfect and Chain Reaction
・Stuck? Use a spare bomb for one more push, or watch an ad for a hint that shows one bomb spot

■ STORY
10 episodes. Budget cuts, a stingy client, the Boss's bad back…
Each job brings a new impossible order.
Cute Molmy appears too. Play to the end to see the ending.

■ MORE TO DO
・Clear a whole chapter to unlock the Chapter Challenge: 10 stages in a row, one try each. Get an S to C rank!
・Earn Blast Score to raise your title, from Apprentice to Legendary Blast Master
・Use acorn rewards to dig rooms in Boomole House: bed, kitchen, hot spring, mushroom farm, theater and more

■ SAFE TO PLAY
・Nobody gets hurt. Only buildings are destroyed
・Your progress is saved on your device only. No name or email needed
・Ads use child-directed settings and show only content for all ages
・No ads while you are playing a stage. Reward ads play only when you choose

Languages: English, Japanese, German, Korean, Traditional Chinese

MORK STUDIO

name: Bounce Soccer
description:
Bounce Soccer is a happy, fast game for the whole family. Tap to drop the ball, tap again when it is in the ring to kick, then dive onto a girl's head to keep it bouncing.

Chain bounces from head to head for combos, coins and distance. Every run has a new goal, such as getting three head bounces in a row or hitting a balloon, and finishing one pays coins.

Spend your coins in the shop on new balls: a beach ball, a glitter ball and a rainbow trail. Then choose who kicks off, from the whole team of girls, or let the game surprise you.

Bounce Soccer is free. It has no ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts and no tracking. It works offline, and your progress stays on your device.

name: Brassbell Switchyard
description:
Small trains. Grand plans. Welcome to Brassbell Switchyard—a calm, tactile railway timetable puzzle designed for thoughtful play on iPhone.

Every route asks you to guide colorful locomotives safely to their matching platforms without shared-track collisions or head-on passes. Set each train's path with a tap of its brass switch, delay departures by a few calm ticks, and schedule mid-route waits at passing places until every arrival settles cleanly into place.

HOW DISPATCHING WORKS
• Tap a train chip, then toggle its brass track switch to trace its route toward its matching platform.
• Stagger departure steps—or work around fixed booked departures—so trains never share the same track or pass head-on.
• Plan waiting steps at brass pause markers and account for two-step workshop service stops on longer shifts.
• Preview your visual timetable chart before running a trial, then scrub the replay bar or step frame-by-frame to spot bottlenecks.

CRAFTED FOR UNHURRIED PLAY
• 60 Handcrafted Puzzles: Play Chapter 1's 8 introductory routes free of charge. Unlock the remaining 40 main routes across five chapters plus 12 expert dispatch challenges with the single one-time Complete Railway purchase—no subscriptions.
• Forgiving Tools: Built-in gentle hints, clearer hints, and a step-by-step solution preview that always preserves your own timetable plan.
• Gentle Tactile Polish: Custom vector track rendering, evolving illustrated station scenes as chapters are restored, crisp percussive track clicks, and subtle haptics.
• Single-Player Offline Mode Supported: Take your timetable anywhere without needing an account or timer pressure.

name: Break and Steal an Egg
description:
Break the egg. Grab the pet. Outrun the guardian.

Break and Steal an Egg is a fast-paced pet hunt where every egg you crack hides a pet, and every pet has to be carried home before the zone's guardian catches you.

HOW IT PLAYS
Grab your pickaxe and head out. Each zone is scattered with eggs resting on nests. Swing to break one open, watch the hatch reveal, then pick up the pet and carry it on your head. The moment you pick it up, the guardian of that zone wakes and gives chase. Reach your base or the safe zone and the pet is yours. Get caught and the pet drops to the ground, so grab it again and keep running.

FIVE ZONES, FIVE GUARDIANS
Explore the Forest, Desert, Snowy, Candy and Swamp zones. Each one has its own eggs, its own eight pets and its own guardian, and the guardians get faster the deeper you go. Every zone shows a recommended Speed when you enter it, so you always know whether you are ready.

GET FASTER
Speed is your progress. The first time you bring home a new species, you earn a cash bonus and a Speed bonus. The more Speed you collect, the faster you move across the whole map, and the easier it gets to leave the next guardian behind.

BUILD YOUR BASE
Pets you bring home live in your pen and earn cash every second. Heavier pets earn more. Expand your pen at the upgrade board to place more pets and watch your income grow. Open the Pets window to place your best earners, swap pets in and out, or sell the ones you no longer need.

STRONGER PICKAXES
Deeper zones have tougher eggs. Spend your cash at the pickaxe shop on ten pickaxes, from the Wooden Pickaxe all the way to the Rainbow Pickaxe. More power means fewer swings per egg.

COLLECT THEM ALL
40 pets to discover across nine rarity tiers, from Common all the way to Secret. The Pets window keeps count of how many you have found.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Touch controls with a floating joystick, a jump button and a dedicated swing button. Drag to look around and pinch to zoom. Music and sound volume, screen effects and pet visibility can be adjusted in the settings. Your progress saves automatically. No account and no sign-in needed.

name: Breakpoints: Responsive Design
description:
Check how a website looks at different screen sizes, right from Safari on iPhone and iPad. Breakpoints is a responsive design and layout testing tool for web developers, designers and anyone checking a site on the go.

• Open the Breakpoints Safari extension on the page you’re testing and switch between mobile and desktop viewports.
• Choose 402 × 874, 440 × 956, 1920 × 1080 or 2560 × 1440 CSS pixels, or enter a custom width and height.
• Pinch to inspect details in the Safari preview on supported sites. Tap Fit to return to the whole layout.
• Open a URL in the app for a full-screen preview. Try the built-in responsive demo, or pick up where you left off from Recent sites.

Open Breakpoints and tap Set up in Safari to enable the extension. If a site blocks embedded previews, choose Open in app.

One purchase. No account, subscriptions or ads.

name: Breath+Relax
description:
Breath+Relax is a short guide to a few breathing techniques, with routines you can practice.

A session shows a ring that grows as you inhale and shrinks as you exhale. A voice names the phase. A soft tone marks it. The phone gives a light tap. You can turn any of these off.

Routines you can start now:

• Coherent breathing. Five seconds in, five seconds out, about six breaths a minute.
• Cyclic sigh. A slow inhale, a second shorter inhale, then a long exhale.
• Box breathing. Four equal sides, using the study's 4-second example.
• 4-7-8. A longer exhale.

Learn explains each technique in plain language, including what a study found and what it did not. 4-7-8 and alternate-nostril breathing are there too, with a note on what is and is not known. Fast breathing with a hold on empty lungs is not taught.

You can copy a routine and change the counts, save your own pattern, and share a routine as a file. Reminders can nudge you on the days you choose. An overview keeps a simple record of sessions on this device.

Two minutes is enough for a first session.

This is not a medical treatment. The National Institutes of Health describe slow, deep breathing as a relaxation technique. It is not a substitute for care. Sit or lie down. Stop if you feel dizzy or uncomfortable. Do not practice while driving or in water. If you are pregnant, or you have a heart, lung, seizure, glaucoma, panic, or other medical concern, check with a clinician.

Your routines, settings, and practice history stay on this device.

name: Bright Days: Sobriety Tracker
description:
Bright Days is a calm, private companion for recovery from alcohol, drugs, or anything you're stepping away from. Day one or year ten, it helps you through hard moments, finds meetings, and celebrates how far you've come.

No accounts. No ads. Everything you add stays on your phone. And craving support is free, always. You'll never hit a paywall in the middle of a hard moment.

WHEN A CRAVING HITS (ALWAYS FREE)
• A 15 minute guided breathing timer, because most cravings peak and fade
• 5 4 3 2 1 grounding and a HALT check (hungry, angry, lonely, tired)
• Play the tape forward: picture how tonight and tomorrow really go
• Reach out to your people with one tap, using a message you've already written
• Your reasons, with photos, and your support circle close by
• Free helplines, including 988 and SAMHSA, always on screen

IF YOU SLIP (ALWAYS FREE)
• A gentle, judgment free path back, starting with a safety note
• Keep your count and note the slip, or start a new one. Both are valid
• A ready to send text to your sponsor, a kindness moment, and a plan update
• Your history keeps past counts, and slips never show anywhere else

FIND A MEETING (ALWAYS FREE)
• Search AA and NA meetings near you, by distance and day
• See online meetings starting soon, in your own time zone
• Each AA listing shows its local office, with a way to report a problem
• Log the meetings you go to, with your favorites one tap away
• Links to SMART Recovery and Recovery Dharma finders too

EVERY DAY
• A sober day counter with money and time saved. Tap for the full count, or hide it anytime
• Morning intentions and an evening reflection
• Quick check ins for mood, cravings, and sleep
• Your week: a look back every Monday at what went well
• Three good things, with look back cards from months ago
• Medication reminders, with a Taken button right on the reminder
• Reminders, with a discreet mode for your lock screen

YOUR PLAN
• A relapse prevention plan with your reasons, support circle, and warning signs

MILESTONES AND A JOURNAL
• Badges from day one through ten years, and a daily journal prompt

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• 12 pride flag themes, free, in light and dark mode
• English and Spanish
• Works with Larger Text, dark mode, and Reduce Motion

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No sign up and no tracking
• Lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID, or your passcode
• Restore from a backup anytime

BRIGHT DAYS PLUS
More support for every step of your recovery, with an optional upgrade:
• Step work for all 12 steps: guiding questions, a Step 4 inventory, and an amends list. Step 1 is free to try
• Worksheets like cost benefit and ABC, shareable as a PDF
• If, then plans, risky dates with reminders, and a coping library that shows what works
• Craving history, insights, charts, and a monthly summary to share
• Letters to your future self, sealed until a milestone
• Extra counters, your own milestones, and shareable milestone cards
• Meeting filters like LGBTQ+, women, newcomer, and Spanish, plus a PDF attendance record
• Journal prompt packs, search, and PDF export
• Color themes, a photo of your why, and backups

Plus is available monthly or yearly, each with a 7 day free trial for new subscribers, or as a one time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your App Store account settings.

Bright Days isn't affiliated with AA, NA, SMART Recovery, or Recovery Dharma. Please confirm meeting details before you go. It's a self help tool, not medical care. Stopping some substances suddenly can be dangerous, so talk with a doctor first. In crisis in the US, call or text 988.

Privacy policy: https://netrefajaz.github.io/brightdays/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://netrefajaz.github.io/brightdays/terms.html

name: BrokLeads: Lead CRM
description:
BrokLeads is a lead management app for sales teams. Every enquiry, conversation and follow-up lives in one place, on your phone and on the web.

Note: BrokLeads is a business app. You need a BrokLeads account created by your team or agency to sign in. New teams can start a free trial at brokleads.com.

CAPTURE LEADS AUTOMATICALLY
• Leads from Facebook and Instagram lead ads, TikTok lead ads and your website forms arrive in BrokLeads as they happen.
• New WhatsApp chats become leads, with the ad they came from attached when they started from an ad.
• Duplicates are matched by phone or email, so one customer is one record.

GET THEM TO THE RIGHT PERSON
• Auto-assign new leads to your team, round-robin, with daily and total caps per agent.
• Push notifications tell the agent the moment a lead is assigned.
• Agents see their own leads; managers and owners see the whole pipeline.

ONE SHARED WHATSAPP INBOX
• Reply to customers from your phone, with message templates for quick, consistent answers.
• Send and receive photos, documents, voice notes and more.
• Transfer a chat to a teammate and the lead moves with it.
• Set up automations for first replies and keyword triggers.
(BrokLeads connects to the WhatsApp Business Platform. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta.)

WORK THE PIPELINE
• Move leads through clear stages, with notes, tags and activity history.
• Create tasks and follow-up reminders tied to a lead or client, and see what is due today.
• Search and filter your whole pipeline in seconds.
• Call or message a lead in one tap.

CLIENTS, TEAMS AND APPROVALS
• Keep client contacts, history and deals together.
• Organise agents into teams and campaigns, and invite new members by email.
• Owners can approve or reject sales from their phone.

REPORTS AT A GLANCE
• New leads, sources, conversions and revenue on the dashboard.
• Team performance and lead-progress reports.

FOR REAL-ESTATE TEAMS
• Workspaces set up for real estate also get property inventory, listings and shareable social posts.

BUILT FOR TEAMS
• Secure sign-in with optional Face ID or Touch ID unlock.
• Role-based access, so people see only what they should.
• English and Arabic, with full right-to-left layout.

Questions or support: support@brokleads.com
Privacy policy: https://brokleads.com/privacy
Terms: https://brokleads.com/terms

name: BroSesh: Buds Nearby
description:
BroSesh is a buddy community for adult men. Find like-minded buds nearby or online, see who is free right now, and lock in a sesh with people who actually show up.

It is built around reliability and respect, not swiping.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

Vouches. When a bud shows up as agreed, you can vouch for him. Vouches sit on his profile, so reliable members stand out and flakes and fakes fade away.

Free now. Set your status when you have time and see who else is around. No guessing, no week-old messages.

Boundaries first. Every profile leads with boundaries and style tags: Side by side, No contact, Ask first, Go with the flow, Talkative, Quiet, Camera on, Camera off, Discreet, First timer and more. You know where you stand before you say hello.

Seshes. Host a meetup in person or online. Members ask to join and the host approves who comes.

Passing through. Travelling? Add your trip and appear on the Passing through list in that city so local buds can say hi before you arrive.

MADE FOR PRIVACY

Your location is never shown. Other members only see a rounded distance.
A face photo is optional.
No labels needed. Every adult man is welcome, however he describes himself or if he prefers not to.
Mark whether you can host or can travel.

CHAT IS FREE FOREVER

Messaging other members will never be locked behind a subscription.

BROSESH PLUS (OPTIONAL)

Every filter, see who viewed you, explore any city before you travel, incognito browsing, a bigger grid, and more seshes and trips. Plus is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your store account and renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in your account settings.

SAFETY

BroSesh is members only and strictly 18+. No nudity or explicit photos are allowed anywhere in the app, and every photo is checked before any other member can see it. No selling, advertising or promotion of any kind. Block and report are on every profile, chat and sesh, and our team responds to reports within 24 hours. You can delete your account at any time in Me > Settings and privacy > Delete account.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://brosesh.vercel.app/privacy.html

name: Brwlix Print
description:
Brwlix Print turns your iPhone or iPad into a complete printing tool for Bluetooth thermal printers – both label printers (TSPL) and receipt printers (ESC/POS, 58 mm and 80 mm).

Everything is rendered on the device, so Kurdish, Arabic and English text always prints correctly, whatever fonts the printer has.

LABEL DESIGNER
• Design labels of any size: text, barcodes, QR codes, logos, shapes, icons, tables, lines, date and time
• Barcodes: Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, Code 39, ITF, QR, DataMatrix – or scan one with the camera
• Layers, lock, groups, undo / redo, rotation, snapping guides, zoom
• Ready-made templates for price tags, product barcodes and shipping labels
• 2- and 3-column label rolls
• Expiry dates calculated automatically at print time

BATCH PRINTING
• Print hundreds of labels from a CSV file – one label per row
• Automatic serial numbers

RECEIPTS, PDF, PHOTOS, TEXT
• Build a sales receipt with items, discount, total and QR code
• Print PDFs page by page; white margins are cropped automatically
• Print photos with dithering

PRINT FROM ANYWHERE
• Share text, an image or a PDF from any app to Brwlix Print
• Web systems can print with a simple link

MORE
• Print history with one-tap reprint
• Backup and restore of all templates
• Light and dark mode
• Kurdish, Arabic and English interface
• No account, no ads, works offline

name: BubbleThornLift
description:
Your hero is a soap bubble. It is round, shiny, and will burst if it so much as touches a tile. Good luck.

Hold your finger down and the bubble grows on the wand. Let go and it floats up the bathroom wall. Tap the left or right side of the screen to puff it gently sideways, through floating hoops and past curling thorny vines, up to the foam at the top.

The interesting part is deciding how big to blow it. A big bubble rises slowly and steadily and the wall fans barely move it, but it fits through nothing and pops on any rim. A small bubble zips upward and bounces off the walls, but every fan gust sends it tumbling. Hold too long and it bursts right on the wand. Each lift wants its own size, and finding it is half the fun.

Every hoop you thread raises your score multiplier. Surface quickly for a time bonus, and collect every hoop for three stars.

There are 48 lifts, from a gentle first one that teaches you as you play to the bramble-choked Foam Peak. Each was built around a real, tested flight path, so three stars are always within reach. A fresh Daily Lift appears every day, the same for everyone, with a daily leaderboard next to the global one and a bubbler name picked for you.

The bubbles shimmer with shifting rainbow film, wobble as they rise and pop into droplets. Glassy harp music plays over the splashes, and the haptics swell as you blow, sparkle at each hoop and crunch on the pop.

Built for one thumb. No account, no typing, no ads, no in-app purchases. Plays offline.

name: BuddySmash
description:
BuddySmash organises your sports group, whether it's padel, tennis, beach volleyball or badminton: who's playing this week, who's on the waitlist, who won, and who's on a streak.

WEEKLY ABOS AND ONE-OFF MATCHES
• Set up your fixed weekly slot once: court, day, time, regulars. The next eight weeks appear automatically, with the regulars already in.
• Can't make it? Tap once and the spot opens up for the next person on the waitlist.
• Add one-off matches anytime. Everyone in the group can create, edit and delete matches.

ONE TAP "I'M IN"
• A big countdown to the next game, with who's in at a glance.
• A waitlist that promotes people automatically when someone drops out.
• Guests without the app, payment tick-offs, booking links and notes.

RESULTS, RANKINGS AND SEASONS
• Enter sets in seconds: pick the teams, tap the score.
• A live ranking by win rate, with trends, points per set and Man of the Match votes.
• Seasons with their own table, and all-time stats.
• Player profiles with badges, win-rate history and head-to-head records.

ALL YOUR GROUPS IN ONE APP
• Home shows every upcoming match from all your groups, with a filter per group.
• Start a group or join one with an invite code or link.
• See at a glance how you're doing in each group: rank, win rate and next match.

AND THE FUN STUFF
• XP and 16 levels, from "Regenwurm" to legend.
• A padel racket for your group's badge, because there's no padel emoji (yet).

Private by design: your groups are invite-only, nobody outside sees your data, and there are no ads or tracking.

name: Build Manage Tech
description:
SmartBarrier Tech is the official field technician and installer utility for provisioning, configuring, and diagnosing BuildManage Smart Controller hardware units on residential barriers, automatic gates, and building access systems.

KEY TECHNICIAN CAPABILITIES:
• BLE Hardware Provisioning: Pair directly over Bluetooth Low Energy to configure site Wi-Fi credentials, MQTT server endpoints, and hardware relay parameters on ESP32-S3 Smart Controllers.
• Courtyard & Site Setup: Create and configure residential courtyard profiles, GPS geofence coordinates, relay pulse durations, and administrator handoff settings.
• Dual-Channel Relay Diagnostics: Test Relay #1 and Relay #2 (Pulse, Hold, and Release modes) on-site over Cloud or BLE and inspect live hardware telemetry (Wi-Fi RSSI, uptime, firmware version, free heap).
• Resident & Device Management: Onboard courtyard administrators, manage authorized resident phone lists, and reset device locks when residents replace their phones.
• Secure Technician Authentication: Protected by server-verified 6-digit OTP authentication for authorized installation engineers.

Note: SmartBarrier Tech is intended for authorized field technicians and property engineers installing BuildManage Smart Controller hardware.

name: Bulkr: Gym & Workout Planner
description:
Bulkr builds your lifting program around your level, your equipment and your schedule, then coaches you session after session.
No account to create, no ads: your workouts and profile stay on your iPhone.
A PROGRAM THAT FITS YOU
A short intro questionnaire and a few strength tests: Bulkr suggests a program that takes into account your level, your training days, how long your sessions last and the equipment in your gym. You can also build your own workouts.
PLAN B: WHEN THE SESSION DOESN'T GO AS PLANNED
Machine taken, crowded gym, short on time? Plan B swaps the exercise or shortens the session while keeping the intent of your week. A missed day can be made up on another day.
WORKOUT TRACKING
Sets, weights, reps, a rest timer that stays visible on your lock screen, weight suggestions for your next session and automatic personal records.
YOUR STRENGTH RANKS
From Stone to Legend: your lifts, relative to your body weight, show where you stand and give you the next step to aim for. It's a reference to keep you motivated, not an assessment of your health.
YOUR WEEKLY REVIEW
Your sessions, your records and your strength rank, summed up so you know where you are. Add progress photos to compare before and now.
OVER 400 EXERCISES
Every exercise comes with animated illustrations, the muscles worked and form tips.
YOUR DATA, YOUR CONTROL
No account, no ads, no advertising tracking. Your workouts, profile and photos stay on your iPhone. Only app usage statistics and your subscription status go through our service providers (PostHog, RevenueCat), to improve Bulkr and manage your access. Export or delete your data at any time.
FEATURES
· Personalized program based on your level, equipment and schedule
· Plan B: swap an exercise or shorten the session on the spot
· Rest timer on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island
· "Your week" widget
· Workout reminders on your planned days
· Strength ranks and personal records
· Weekly review
· Progress photos
· Optional Apple Health integration (reads your weight, saves your workouts)
· Import your history from a CSV file, export to CSV and JSON
· Available in English and French
BULKR PRO
Bulkr is used with a Bulkr Pro subscription, yearly or monthly. The yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (or at the end of the trial); the subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.
Bulkr is not a substitute for medical advice and is not a medical device. If you have a health condition, an injury or pain, check with a doctor before you start, and stop an exercise if it hurts.
Terms of Use: https://getbulkr.app/cgu
Privacy Policy: https://getbulkr.app/confidentialite

name: Bushido Buddy
description:
Explore Inazo Nitobe’s Bushido with a curious little samurai and his professor.

Start with an everyday question, follow a prepared conversation, and open the original passage that inspired it. Bushido Buddy brings reflective reading, friendly dialogue, and warm acoustic music together.

• Explore 100 prepared conversations
• Discover 13 suggested topics based on your optional interests and everyday context
• Read all 17 chapters of Bushido: The Soul of Japan in English
• Switch between the original English and a Japanese learning translation
• Save passages with bookmarks and personal notes
• Enjoy five original acoustic swing tracks, rotating daily or selected individually
• Choose Japanese or English, and adjust music, button sounds, and animations in Settings

Text, conversations, and music are bundled for offline use. No account, advertising, or in-app purchases. Your optional profile, bookmarks, notes, and preferences stay in local app storage.

Conversations are prepared learning material. Entered keywords help find examples; this is not a live generative-AI chatbot.

Source: Inazo Nitobe, Bushido: The Soul of Japan, 13th edition (1908), Project Gutenberg #12096. Dialogue and modern examples are learning interpretations, not historical statements by Nitobe. The Japanese learning translation was created with AI and has not been professionally reviewed.

The original book includes historical attitudes and descriptions of suicide and violence. They are presented as historical text, never as recommendations for present-day action.

name: Cairnvel
description:
Every royal gift hides a little resistance.

Enter a candlelit jeweler’s cabinet and free the ruby from a collection of intricate caskets. Slide each jeweled setting along its own track, make room for the gold and silver keys, and plan the order in which you cross the wards.

THINK SEVERAL MOVES AHEAD
24 puzzles across three chapters progress from a simple blocked passage to interlocking gold and silver wards. Sometimes the way forward begins with a retreat. The final casket has a verified shortest solution of 28 moves.

TAKE YOUR TIME, THEN REFINE YOUR ROUTE
There is no countdown. Each casket has a clear move budget, and a shortest-route target for three stars. Undo a move, restart an attempt, or ask for a one-step hint. A hint limits that attempt to one star; your best result stays safe.

A CABINET MADE TO BE TOUCHED
Faceted gems, engraved keys, warm walnut and antique gold accompany an original chamber minuet. Practice the three mechanisms separately, adjust music, effects and haptics, and continue your saved attempt later.

Made for iPhone in landscape. Native controls and offline puzzles. No account and no in-app purchases. The game interface is in English.

name: Calmhum: Sleep Sounds & Noise
description:
Calmhum is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition.

Calmhum plays calm, steady sounds to help you unwind and fall asleep. Many people who live with ringing in their ears like to have a soft sound in the background at night. Calmhum makes that simple.

Everything plays through your iPhone or iPad speaker. You do not need headphones or any other device.

What you can do
- Mix brown, pink and white noise, soft rain and a fan. Set each sound's volume.
- Find a comfortable sound: move a slider, listen, and keep the tone you like.
- Set a sleep timer from 15 minutes to 2 hours, or play all night. Sounds fade out gently.
- Keep a short daily journal about your sleep and how noticeable the ringing was, and share it as PDF or CSV.
- Keep playing with the screen locked or while you use other apps.

Made with care
- Sounds are created on your device as you listen, so there is no audible loop.
- Built for the dark: a calm, dim screen that is easy on the eyes at night.
- No ads. No account. Your journal stays on your device.

Please keep the volume low, just loud enough to be comfortable. If ringing in your ears starts suddenly, is in one ear only, or comes with hearing loss or dizziness, please see a doctor.

Playing sounds requires Calmhum Premium (monthly or yearly) or a one-time Lifetime purchase after your first week. Your journal stays available without a plan.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://trendx-company.vercel.app/calmhum/privacy

name: Campeo: Field NDVI & Spraying
description:
Campeo is a free field tool for farmers, agronomists and spraying contractors. Tap a field on the satellite map and Campeo outlines and measures it for you. No drawing, no files, no account.

FOR EVERY FIELD
• Outline and area in hectares and acres
• Hours fit for spraying today and tomorrow, worked out from the hourly forecast of wind, gusts, rain, temperature and humidity
• Five seasons of NDVI from Sentinel-2 satellite images: how the crop grew year by year
• The rain that fell on the field and the forecast
• Soil and relief

TODAY
Save your fields and open Today: the day ahead on all of them at a glance.

WORK LOG AND MONEY
• Record sowing, fertilizer, spraying, tillage, irrigation, harvest and scouting with products, rates and costs
• Add photos and mark where each record was made
• See what each field has cost this season and keep a spraying register
• Export the log as a table, and outlines as KML, Shapefile or GeoJSON

IN THE FIELD WITHOUT SIGNAL
Saved fields, their work logs and the last weather you opened stay on your phone. What you record without signal is sent when the network is back.

WHEREVER THERE ARE FIELDS
From the Argentine pampas to the Free State, from Mato Grosso to the US corn belt. In English, Spanish, Portuguese and Russian.

Field outlines are found automatically (Fields of The World) and are working boundaries, not legal ones: if yours does not match, draw it by hand. Spraying hours and NDVI are estimates, so always check the conditions on site and follow the product label.

Missing a tool? Tap “What's missing?” in the app and tell us.

name: CampMemo
description:
CampMemo is a camping trip and gear organizer designed to keep equipment, packing details, trip records, and post-trip tasks in one structured place.
Build a gear library with categories, owners, storage locations, containers, quantities, ownership details, condition, essential status, notes, and photos. Search and filter equipment, archive items that are no longer in use, and review their trip, borrowing, and reset history.
Create reusable Loadout Cards for different camping contexts. Add gear, assign packers and containers, set planned quantities, and keep notes for each item. Loadout Cards support version history, allowing earlier trip records to remain connected to the version used at the time.
Plan trips with dates, destinations, trip types, campers, travel methods, access details, and either a saved Loadout Card or a blank packing list. During packing, record packed quantities, packing states, assigned packers, containers, essential items, and unresolved quantity differences. A pre-departure review brings outstanding packing details together before the trip.
During and after a trip, record whether equipment was used, shared, consumed, left at home, or not applicable. Track borrowed items from check-in through return, including owner, condition, return status, and notes. Post-trip condition reviews can create reset actions for cleaning, drying, repairing, replenishing, returning, finding, or storing equipment. Reset tasks include status, priority, owner, and notes.
Complete trip reviews, record observations, and prepare changes for a new Loadout Card version without altering previous records. Trip Insights provides an additional view based on saved trip information.
Generate, preview, and share PDFs for packing lists, family member packs, pre-departure reviews, reset packs, borrowed-item returns, trip reviews, and Loadout Cards. Group archives can be exported and imported with related attachments and generated reports.

name: Canadian Citizenship Test Hub
description:
DISCLAIMER: Maple Civics is an independent study app. It is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or representing Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) or the Government of Canada.

No ads, no paywalls, no hidden fees. A complete study guide for the Canadian citizenship test, with practice questions from every chapter of the official guide, Discover Canada.

Maple Civics is made for future citizens — clear, simple, and easy to use, even with limited English.

FEATURES
- Practice Quiz & Flashcards — study on the go or at your own pace.
- Practice Test — 20 questions, 15 to pass, just like the real test.
- Flashcards, Quick Review & Weak Spots — learn, test yourself, and focus on what you miss.
- Listen Mode — pre-recorded Canadian voices in English and French, female and male. Keeps playing with the screen locked, so you can study on the bus or on a walk.
- Learn about Canada — key facts from every chapter of Discover Canada and your province or territory.
- Exam Mode — a test-day simulation with a checklist, focus rule, and ID guide.
- Question of the Day and daily reminders.
- Made for iPhone and iPad.
- Find My MP — enter your postal code to find your Member of Parliament. Plus your premier and provincial capital.
- English or French — the whole app, including the questions and answers.
- No Ads. No In-App Purchases. Ever.

OFFICIAL SOURCES (please verify current information here)
- Citizenship test (IRCC): https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/canadian-citizenship/test.html
- Discover Canada study guide: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/corporate/publications-manuals/discover-canada.html
- Members of Parliament: https://www.ourcommons.ca/members/en
- Find your electoral district: https://www.elections.ca

This app is a study aid only and does not represent a government entity. Always confirm current questions, answers, and official names at the official Government of Canada sources listed above.

Good luck on your journey to Canadian citizenship!

name: Canopy Leap: Squirrel Jump
description:
Run, leap and soar through the treetops with one thumb! Grab glittering gems, master 32 handcrafted levels across four seasons, and take on a brand-new Daily Leap every evening.

Your squirrel runs on its own: you steer along the branch, and the leap happens when it ends. Take the bold line for the big gems, or play it safe and keep your streak alive.

FOUR SEASONS OF FOREST
Autumn Wind, Winter Frost, Spring Bloom and Summer, each with its own colours, music and surprises: glassy ice to slide across, blossom boughs that fling you sky-high, mushrooms to bounce on and more.

A NEW DAILY LEAP EVERY EVENING
A fresh course drops every night, each built around its own idea. Play every day to build your streak and earn bigger bonuses.

GEMS, STARS AND CROWNS
Earn up to three stars on every level, and a crown for a run with no falls. Spend your gems on coats, trails, hats and poses, and make your squirrel your own.

MADE TO BE PICKED UP ANY TIME
• No account needed
• Plays offline
• No ads in the game
• Haptic feedback on every leap and landing
• Short levels, perfect for a quick break

The treetops are calling.

name: Captive 3000
description:
Captive 3000 is an old-school, first-person dungeon crawler with a dystopian science-fiction setting.

Tile-based movement, real-time combat, resource management, maze exploration and handcrafted levels, drawn with traditional sprites.

—STORY—

Condemned to 1000 years in cryosleep…
You wake on a forgotten moon orbiting an unfamiliar singularity…
Memory wiped… cryogenic chamber smashed…
Alien shadows haunt the abandoned station…
Main power failing, an emergency console flickers to life…
The alarm repeats… EARTH HAS FALLEN…
The terminal reaches out to a decommissioned Optimus Mark I on a distant world…
Guide the ancient automaton through the vast expanse… find your lonely prison… and stage your own rescue...
But your identity, the tale of your incarceration, and the fate of humanity… is yet unknown...

—DESIGN—

BUILT THE OLD WAY
• No 3D engine.
• Uses traditional sprite-based, grid movement like the classic "blobbers".
• Stepping and shooting are instant.

50+ HOURS, THEN KEEP PLAYING FOREVER
• 13 handcrafted levels with multiple floors form Mission 01, more than 50 hours of exploration and combat.
• Levels start small and grow vast and complex, the final ones taking hours each.
• Illustrated story murals are hidden across the levels, each revealing a fragment of the truth.
• Then infinite unique new missions: seeded, not random, so every level always plays the same way.
• Replay any completed mission or level at any time.

FAST, TACTICAL COMBAT
• Dodge projectiles, strike enemies from behind while they turn, and step back into cover.
• Upgrade from slow, weak early weapons to rapid lasers, ion pulse weapons, flamers and more.
• Watch your shield, health and energy: every move and every shot drains your droid's power.

ROGUELITE TENSION
• Progress is saved only by finding well-hidden blockchain fragments.
• One enemy is immortal. Run into him with your shield down and it's instant death,
• But with skill you can trap him for the rest of the level.
• Far from a recharge station with your energy falling: do you press on, or turn back?
• Use ladders and pits to slip above or below the hardest zones.

MADE FOR iPAD
• Full touch controls, designed for the iPad mini and larger devices (phone screens are too small).
• Up to 10 characters on one iPad — choose different skill trees and upgrades.
• Plays fully offline. Absolutely no ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no data collected.
• 28 languages supported.

—DISCLAIMER—

Captive 3000 is inspired by a classic 1990 Amiga / Atari ST dungeon crawler. It is a completely new, independent game built from scratch, and is not affiliated with, copied from, or a remake of the original. It plays as a fast-paced action-RPG roguelite focused on exploration and combat.

name: Cargo Swing
description:
Run a busy little harbour. Tap a container and the crane swings it onto the ship that wants its goods: food, tools, medicine, electronics, cosmetics, sports gear, fashion or furniture. No ship for it yet? It waits on the dock, but the dock only has five spots.

Plan ahead: the next ship always waits offshore, so you can see what is coming. Fill a ship with three containers and it sails, and the next one docks.

• 200 levels that keep getting harder, with covered containers, chained containers and more kinds of goods. Every level is checked to have a winning solution.
• An event every five levels: a Gold Rush for a jackpot, a Pipeline to pump oil into the tanker, or a Pirate Raid where you fire containers from the quay cannon.
• A level map to see how far you have come and replay any level.
• Coins for every win, to spend on Undo or an extra dock spot.
• Day turns to night as you play, with a lighthouse, gulls and a harbour soundtrack.
• No ads, no purchases, no lives, no account. Plays offline. In English and French.

name: Carrier Wars
description:
Erobere das Meer – Insel um Insel.

Carrier Wars ist ein Strategiespiel auf hoher See: Du startest auf einer einzigen Insel mit Hafen und baust daraus eine Flotte, die das ganze Seegebiet einnimmt. Jede eigene Insel bildet laufend neue Soldaten aus – wie du sie einsetzt, entscheidest du.

LANDUNGSBOOTE
Landungsboote holen Soldaten im Heimathafen ab und nehmen zuerst neutrale Inseln ein, danach greifen sie die nächste gegnerische Insel an. An der Küste wird Mann gegen Mann gekämpft – zuerst gegen Raketenwerfer, Hafen und Flugfeld, dann gegen die Verteidiger.

FREGATTEN UND RAKETENWERFER
Schnelle Fregatten feuern Raketensalven – mit dem Schalter ESKORTE/ANGRIFF beschützen sie deine Landungsboote oder greifen feindliche Inseln an. Raketenwerfer auf deinen Inseln schützen das Meer in ihrer Reichweite.

FLUGZEUGE UND FLUGZEUGTRÄGER
Flugfelder bauen Flugzeuge, die deine Inseln umkreisen und feindliche Schiffe angreifen. Flugzeugträger bringen sie bis vor die Inseln des Gegners.

VERSORGUNGSLINIEN UND UPGRADES
Ziehe Linien zwischen deinen Inseln, und deine Boote bringen laufend Nachschub. Raketenwerfer lassen sich dreimal ausbauen.

IMMER DIE NÄCHSTE AKTION
Der AKTION-Button springt direkt zu der Insel, auf der du am frühesten wieder etwas bauen kannst.

LEVEL FÜR LEVEL
Level 1 beginnt mit Hafen, Landungsboot und Fregatte auf einem Meer mit 3 × 3 Quadranten. Mit jedem Level kommt Neues dazu, und das Meer wird größer. Ab Level 8 liegt in der Mitte ein Vulkan, der Lava aufs Meer schleudert. Jede neue Funktion wird vor dem Level mit einer kurzen Animation erklärt.

BESTENLISTE
Vergleiche dich weltweit und in deinem Land: höchstes Level, versenkte Schiffe und eroberte Inseln. Nach jedem Level siehst du deine Erfolge. Ohne Internet wird später nachgereicht.

EINFACH SPIELEN
• Level 1 bis 6 kostenlos – ein einmaliger Kauf schaltet alle weiteren Level frei, ohne Abo
• Keine Werbung
• Kein Konto, kein Tracking
• Spielbar ohne Internetverbindung
• Feedback-Formular direkt in den Einstellungen
• Level 1 auch als App Clip zum sofortigen Ausprobieren

Für iPhone und iPad.

AGB: https://kainzner.net/carrierwars-agb.html
Datenschutz: https://kainzner.net/carrierwars-datenschutz.html

name: Carrow: Parked Car Finder
description:
GPS can find your car in an open lot. In a six-story garage, it can’t tell P2 from P5. Carrow can.

Tap I Parked when you leave your car. Carrow saves where you are, notes which floor you’re on using your iPhone’s barometer, and can read the level sign for you. When you come back, it tells you how many floors up or down your car is and points you back to it.

BUILT FOR THE GARAGE
• One huge I Parked button you can hit without looking
• Bold floor display that’s easy to read in a dim stairwell
• Works one-handed, in Dark Mode, with Dynamic Type and VoiceOver

FLOOR DETECTION (CARROW PRO)
Your iPhone’s barometer senses height changes as small as a single floor. Carrow compares the reading where you parked with where you are now: “Your car is about 2 floors below you.” It shows a confidence level, because weather slowly changes air pressure, and it also measures your floor against the exit you walked out of, which stays accurate however long you’re away. You can adjust the floor height to match your garage.

READ THE SIGN (CARROW PRO)
Snap the pillar or level sign. Carrow reads “LEVEL 3”, “P2” or “BLUE 4B” right on your iPhone and fills in the level and section. A level you confirm always wins over the barometer.

WALK STRAIGHT BACK TO YOUR CAR
Tap Guide Me Back for a big arrow that points at your car and a step count that drops as you walk, using GPS, your steps and the compass together. With Carrow Pro, Carrow also records your walk out so the arrow keeps working underground, where GPS can’t. Indoor guidance is approximate, and Carrow tells you so. Prefer a map? See your car with walking directions.

METER TIMER (CARROW PRO)
Set your parking time and get a reminder before it runs out, with a countdown on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

SAVE AUTOMATICALLY
Add Carrow’s Save Parking Spot action to a Shortcuts automation that runs when your iPhone disconnects from CarPlay or your car’s Bluetooth. Carrow walks you through it. You can also use Siri (“Save my parking spot in Carrow”), a Control Center control, or a Home Screen or Lock Screen widget.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no servers, no analytics, no ads, no tracking
• Your spots, photos and notes stay on your iPhone
• Location is only used while you use the app. Never “Always”.
• Old spots delete themselves after 30 days (adjustable)

FREE
Save your spot with GPS, follow the live arrow back, see it on the map, add the level, section and a note, and use Siri, Shortcuts and the Control Center control.

CARROW PRO: ONE PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Floor detection, sign reading, the indoor walk-back route, meter timer with Live Activity, widgets and history.

TRY IT FREE FOR 7 DAYS
Start a free week of Carrow Pro from the app. When it ends, nothing is charged: Pro features simply lock again, and you can unlock them once if you’d like to keep them.

Floor detection needs an iPhone with a barometer (iPhone 6 and later). Indoor directions are estimates and can be affected by steel and concrete structures.

name: CatchItOn
description:
CatchItOn shows you where to watch movies, TV shows, and live sports.

TODAY
See today’s NFL, NBA, college football, men’s and women’s college basketball, and NHL games, and which streaming services or live TV apps carry them. Use the sport filter to show football, basketball, or hockey. Enter a ZIP code in My services to add local CBS and FOX broadcasts and regional sports networks in your TV market, plus the services that carry those channels there. Without a ZIP code, the list shows national broadcasts. You can also browse games later this week.

THEATERS
The Theaters tab lists movies now playing, with title, rating, runtime, and release date. Showtimes come from AMC Theatres and are updated daily. Open a movie’s AMC page to get tickets. CatchItOn is not affiliated with AMC Theatres.

SEARCH AND DETAILS
Look up movies, shows, and teams. Open a title to see where it streams, or a game to see where to watch it. On Search, Popular shows on your services lists the most-watched shows that are included on the services you checked, ranked by Nielsen’s latest Streaming Top 10. Buttons hand off to the service’s own app or website. CatchItOn does not play video.

FAVORITES AND MY SERVICES
Follow teams to pin their games on Today and see upcoming games for the next 4 weeks in Favorites, and optionally star shows to see where they currently stream. If a followed team’s game is a local or regional broadcast outside your TV market, Favorites and game details show an out-of-market line explaining where it airs and that it is not on local TV for you. Check the services you already use so CatchItOn can highlight games and titles available on them. Your service list and ZIP code stay on your device.

CatchItOn does not play video or show live scores. It does not use official league, network, or theater logos or posters. Names appear as text or monograms. CatchItOn is not affiliated with the NFL, NBA, NHL, NCAA, any college or university, any television network or streaming service, or any theater chain.

Listings are informational and can change. A title or game may not be in the list yet.

name: Catosophy – Daily Cat Facts
description:
Catosophy brings you one cat fact a day. Just one, short, at the time you choose.

Every fact comes with its own cat: a single white line that draws itself, opens its eyes and breathes.

WHAT’S INSIDE
• 1000 cat facts in 20 sections: body and senses, sleep, purring, body language, food, health, breeds, wild cats, history, myths, famous cats and more.
• No repeats for 1000 days.
• 20 cats drawn with a single line, one for each section.
• One notification a day, at the time you like.
• An archive of past facts, and favorites with a tap on the heart.
• Send a fact to friends as a beautiful picture.
• Widgets for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen.
• 6 languages: English, Greek, French, German, Italian and Turkish.

ON APPLE WATCH
• The notification comes to your wrist, and the cat draws itself first.
• Double-tap your fingers to keep a fact in your favorites (Series 9, Ultra 2 and later).
• Today’s cat on your watch face and in the watch’s widgets.

NOTHING EXTRA
No account, no ads, no data collection. Works offline.

The facts are for information only and are no substitute for a vet’s advice.

name: CCSE Prep: Nacionalidad 2026
description:
Prepare for the CCSE test (Constitutional and Sociocultural Knowledge of Spain), required for Spanish nationality by residence.

CCSE Prep covers every topic of the exam with 300+ original practice questions, written from the Spanish Constitution, Spanish law and other public sources. Every question shows its source and comes with an explanation: practise, understand why each answer is right, and know when you're ready.

Independent app: not affiliated with the Instituto Cervantes or the Spanish government. The questions are not the official exam questions.

LIKE THE REAL EXAM
• 25-question mock exams in 45 minutes, with the exam's own split across the five tareas (10 · 3 · 2 · 3 · 7)
• Pass with 15 correct; wrong answers cost nothing
• Results with your score and the breakdown per tarea

LEARN, DON'T MEMORISE
• Study by the exam's 5 tareas
• Untimed practice with the answer, an explanation and the source for every question
• Explanations in English, Spanish, French, Arabic and Portuguese (questions stay in Spanish, as in the exam)
• Smart Mistakes: review what you miss until you get it right twice in a row

KNOW WHEN YOU'RE READY
• Readiness against the pass mark, over the whole bank
• Progress per tarea and the questions you miss most
• Countdown to your exam date and an optional daily reminder

FREE AND PRO
Free: every feature on a sample of each tarea (65 questions) and one full mock exam.
Pro, one-time purchase (no subscription): every question, unlimited mock exams, the full results breakdown and your mistakes review.

Privacy: https://ipapapa.github.io/anavasis-apps/ccseprep/privacy/
Support: https://ipapapa.github.io/anavasis-apps/ccseprep/

name: CDL Exam - Practice Test
description:
Get ready for your CDL knowledge test with short practice quizzes and a clear explanation after every answer.

14 CDL SECTIONS, 140 TOPICS
Study the way the test is built: General Knowledge, Air Brakes, Combination Vehicles, Hazardous Materials, Tanker Vehicles, Doubles and Triples, Passenger Vehicles, School Buses, Vehicle Inspection, Basic Control Skills, On-Road Driving, Driving Safely, Transporting Cargo and Rules and Regulations. Each section is split into small topics, so you can practise one thing at a time.

PRACTICE TESTS
Take a simulated knowledge test for each section, sized like the real one: 50 questions for General Knowledge, 25 for Air Brakes, and so on. Score 80% to pass, then review every miss with its explanation.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Your overall accuracy and a readiness score for each section
• A daily streak
• Your test history and best scores

LEADERBOARDS
Every correct answer is a point. See where you stand this week, this month and all time, under a nickname you choose.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Open the app and start studying. We don't ask for your name, email or any personal details.

FREE AND PRO
Free: all of General Knowledge, with its full practice test, plus the first two topics of every other section. CDL Exam Pro opens every topic in every section and every practice test, including the endorsements. Choose a yearly subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase.

The yearly subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and you can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://studencity.in/privacy-policy/cdl-exam?platform=ios

Disclaimer: this app is not an official government app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or authorized by the FMCSA, AAMVA, any state DMV or any government agency. Questions are for practice only, and a practice score does not predict your result on the real test. Always check your state's CDL manual for the current rules.

name: Celestine Kiln
description:
Celestine Kiln brings thoughtfully selected porcelain and ceramic pieces to your everyday life. Explore distinctive glazes, graceful forms and craftsmanship, with pieces for your home, your table and meaningful gifts.

Discover collections inspired by celebrated kiln traditions, with product details to help you choose with confidence.

· EXPLORE THE COLLECTION
Browse porcelain and ceramics by kiln and style. View materials, dimensions and craftsmanship details.

· DISCOVER KILN TRADITIONS
Explore the stories behind the glazes, techniques and forms through our kiln guides and journal.

· SAVE YOUR FAVOURITES
Keep the pieces you love in your wishlist and return to them whenever you’re ready.

· SHOP WITH EASE
Add items to your bag, manage delivery addresses and place your order with cash on delivery.

· MANAGE YOUR ORDERS
View order details and status, and request cancellations or returns in line with our policies.

· YOUR ACCOUNT
Manage your profile, keep your delivery details up to date and share feedback.

Find a piece to cherish. Bring the beauty of ceramics into everyday life with Celestine Kiln.

name: Chain Leap
description:
Chain Leap is a calm, clever stone-jumping puzzle.

Tap a stone and leap it over its neighbour into an empty hollow. The stone you jump is taken off the board. Clear the board until a single stone is left standing.

• Hand-shaped boards: start on a simple square, then take on the Tower, Shield, Gate, Hourglass, Diamond, Pinwheel and more.
• Every puzzle can be solved. Solve it first try for a perfect three stars.
• Replay any puzzle to improve your score.
• Stuck? A hint shows your next leap. Two hints are free each month.
• Plays offline, with no ads and no account.

Guided by a cheerful old chain-skipping elder, Chain Leap is easy to learn and hard to put down.

name: Chala: Daily Moment Camera
description:
Chala calls you — and asks for one photo of right now.

At a random moment in the hours you allow, Chala rings like a phone call. Pick up, and a warm voice says hello and asks you to capture what's in front of you. Take a photo. Chala looks at it, notices what's there and asks you one small question. Whatever you answer becomes that photo's note, in your own words.

No feed. No followers. Just your days, one moment at a time.

HOW IT WORKS
• Chala calls at a random time on the days and hours you allow, or on a schedule you set.
• Answer, take a photo or a short video, and talk for a minute.
• What you say is saved as the photo's note.
• Home shows today's moments on film, and you can look back day by day.

A CAMERA THAT FEELS LIKE FILM
• 10 looks: Film, Instant, Gold, Fresh, Cinema, Faded, Vivid, Mono, Sepia and Original. Swipe the viewfinder to switch.
• Frames, date stamps and aspect ratios.
• Front-and-back shots in one tap on supported iPhones.
• Want a photo without a call? Open the camera any time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up.
• Your photos, videos and notes stay on your iPhone. Turn on Save to Photos if you want copies there too.
• Chala never watches your live camera. It only sees the photo you choose to take.
• Call audio is not recorded.

FREE
Chala is free, with a daily limit on calls. The camera has no limit.

Chala speaks English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Vietnamese and Indonesian.

Privacy Policy: https://chala.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://chala.app/terms

name: Chalk Talk: Exam Crash Course
description:
Chalk Talk turns your course material into a narrated chalkboard crash course, like having a tutor work it out on the board for you.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Upload your lecture notes, slides or practice exams (PDF).
2. Chalk Talk splits them into sections. Pick the ones on your exam.
3. Press play. The board writes out each idea, draws the diagrams and works the examples step by step while a natural voice explains.

PRACTICE LIKE THE REAL EXAM
• New practice problems modeled on how your professor writes questions: multi-part, geometry-heavy, real-world setups
• Add a theme for fun ("a superhero lifting a bus")
• Every answer is re-computed by code before you see it
• Hints, final answers and full solutions worked on the board

MADE FOR STUDYING
• Start watching as soon as the first lesson is ready
• Captions, chapters, skip and speed controls
• Everything is saved to your library to rewatch for free

Built by an engineering student, starting with statics and engineering courses, and works with any course material you upload.

SUBSCRIPTION
New accounts get 2 free credits. Chalk Talk Pro is $12.99/month and includes 20 credits each month (1 credit = 1 crash-course lesson or 1 problem set). Payment is charged to your Apple ID and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms: https://chalk-talk-r4pj.onrender.com/terms
Privacy: https://chalk-talk-r4pj.onrender.com/privacy

Chalk Talk is a study aid made with AI. Double-check important material with your course resources.

name: ChannelDeck Mobile
description:
ChannelDeck Mobile brings your authorized live TV sources and personal media to iPhone.

YOUR SOURCES, YOUR CHOICE
Connect an M3U playlist with an XMLTV guide, an Xtream Codes account, a compatible HDHomeRun antenna tuner or your own ChannelDeck Network server. ChannelDeck does not supply channels, playlists, subscriptions or media.

A FULL GUIDE IN YOUR HAND
Browse channel groups, search, save Favorites, set program reminders and manage guide matching. Double-tap either side of the screen to change channels during Live TV, touch and hold for playback options, and swipe right to return to the guide.

PERSONAL NETWORK LIBRARIES
Sign in to a Network household and choose your profile. Browse Movies, Series and Music, continue watching, review history and resume saved playback at home or away. Compatible server features add title Favorites, Recently Added date filters and automatic intro or credits markers.

CLEAR PLAYBACK CONTROLS
Playback controls show remaining time, expected finish time and episode controls. Series can play in order or shuffle across seasons.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose from ten themes, display the time or date in your preferred screen corner, and keep your audio, subtitle, picture and startup preferences. Advanced features include supported DVR, multi-view and encrypted setup backup with compatible sources, storage and plan access.

A ChannelDeck account and an authorized source are required. Premium is an optional one-time software upgrade. Network library features require a separately configured compatible server. DRM-encrypted broadcasts are not supported. ChannelDeck Mobile runs in landscape on iPhone.

name: CheckZero
description:
CheckZero helps you leave nothing behind when you check out of a hotel.
Record your belongings when you check in, then go through them before you check out.

- Record at check-in
Enter the hotel name and your planned checkout time. Pick from four time choices or set your own.
Choose from a ready-made list of things and places people often forget (chargers, wallet, the safe, under the pillow), and add your own items.
Take photos of your belongings. Photos are saved with the date and time, so they also work as a record if you need to contact the hotel about a lost item.

- Reminders before checkout
Get notified 30 minutes before checkout and right at checkout time.
If the check isn't finished, you'll be reminded again 15 minutes and 1 hour later (you can change this in Settings).

- Warning when you leave the hotel
If you leave the hotel before finishing your check, CheckZero notifies you.
So it won't go off when you step out for dinner or breakfast, you can choose how many hours before checkout the warning starts (5 hours by default), or start it once the date changes.

- Check one by one
Tick off each item. When everything is done, the stay is complete and saved to your history.

- Everything stays on your device
No account needed. Your records, photos and location are used only on your device and are never sent anywhere.

Available in Japanese, English, Chinese (Simplified / Traditional), Korean and Spanish.

Privacy policy: https://apps.oshilabo.app/checkzero/privacy.html

name: Chess Guru: Coach & Analysis
description:
A chess coach you can ask why. Paste a game from chess.com, lichess or any chess app and get a move-by-move review, or play the engine with every move graded as you go. Then ask the coach about any position and watch the answer play out on a board.

ASK THE COACH WHY
Why was that a blunder? What if I had played Nf3? What's the threat? Tap a suggested question or type your own. Every answer comes from the chess engine, and answers about moves play out on a small board, so you see the idea instead of reading coordinates.

EVERY MOVE EXPLAINED
Each move is classified, from Brilliant and Best to Mistake and Blunder, with a plain-English note on what it does and why. When a better move existed, the coach shows it on the board and says what it would have won. Try your own moves on the board at any point and get them graded too.

PLAY AND LEARN
Play the engine from the starting position at five levels, from Beginner to full-strength Master. Every move you play is graded straight away. When the engine slips, the coach tells you there's something to punish. Use Hint when you're stuck, Undo to try again, and review the whole game when it's over.

SEE WHERE THE GAME TURNED
Accuracy for both players, an evaluation graph with the key moments, a game rating, grades for the opening, middlegame and endgame, and the tactics you found or missed.

TRAIN YOUR SKILLS
41 skills, from forks and pins to king and pawn endgames, each with a lesson and a puzzle. Progress is counted across all your games, and every time you played a skill is one tap away.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
A grandmaster-beating chess engine runs on your iPhone or iPad. No account, no server, no ads and no tracking. Your games never leave your device.

ONE PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Your first 10 games are free, reviews and games against the engine alike. Games already in your history always stay free. After that, a single purchase unlocks unlimited reviews and games, for good. Family Sharing is supported.

Typing questions in your own words uses Apple Intelligence (iOS 26 or later, on a device that supports it). On other devices, the suggested questions and engine answers work the same.

name: Chord Halo
description:
Chord Halo listens to the music around you and shows the chord as it happens, the song's key, its tempo and where to put a capo. A custom AI trained on hours of real music runs entirely on your iPhone, so it works offline and your audio never leaves your phone.

LISTEN
• Live chord, key and tempo
• Guitar shapes for every chord, with capo suggestions
• Learn a song while it plays and keep a clean chord sheet
• Chords on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island

PLAY
• Chord pads in the song's key, plus borrowed chords
• A strum plate that follows the song or your fingers
• Acoustic guitar, piano and pad sounds, with haptics

Chord Halo Pro adds every sound, unlimited songs, Import, seventh chords, MIDI out, and piano and ukulele shapes.

No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: Chronarrow
description:
Chronarrow is a strategy puzzle game where arrows are more than directions—they are temporal operators capable of changing the past, reshaping the present, and influencing the future.

Step into the Chrono Observatory as a Time Restorer. Each puzzle presents a sequence of time nodes containing objects in different states. Study the timeline, predict the consequences, place temporal arrows, and run the simulation to create the required outcome.

Every action follows a distinct rule:

• Advance moves an object to its next state.
• Rewind returns it to an earlier state.
• Future Echo carries a state into the next moment.
• Past Echo borrows a state from the future.
• Loop alternates between states across multiple timeline runs.

All operators execute from the same temporal snapshot, so every result is determined by your strategy. Avoid conflicting changes, respect protected history, repair anomalies, and satisfy causal conditions to restore each timeline.

EXPLORE FIVE PUZZLE MODES

TIME PUZZLE
Transform object states and create the required outcome using a limited set of temporal operators.

REVERSE LOGIC
Begin with the expected result and reason backward to discover the operations that could produce it.

TIME LOOP
Build a repeating sequence and activate the correct state during a specific timeline cycle.

TIMELINE REPAIR
Locate broken events, resolve temporal anomalies, and restore valid causal connections.

ENDLESS CHRONO
Face generated timeline challenges with evolving combinations of states, nodes, and operators.

MASTER THE CHRONO OBSERVATORY

• Solve deterministic state-transformation puzzles
• Manipulate multiple moments within one timeline
• Experiment with cross-time echoes and repeating loops
• Undo actions and restore earlier snapshots
• Use progressive hints when a timeline becomes difficult
• Earn up to three stars based on your solution
• Revisit completed timelines to improve your record
• Track achievements and restoration statistics
• Learn every temporal operator through a guided tutorial
• Experience an astronomical interface inspired by precision clocks and celestial instruments

Chronarrow is not about moving a character with arrows. It is about understanding how one state affects another across time. Observe the timeline, predict each transformation, place your operators, and discover whether your plan can rewrite fate.

The Chrono Observatory is waiting. How many timelines can you restore?

name: ChronoStream TL
description:
夕方から夜、夜から朝へ。明るさが大きく変わるタイムラプス（ホーリーグレイル）を、カメラにつないだ ChronoStream 撮影装置をスマホから操作して撮影するアプリです。

※ご利用には ChronoStream 撮影装置が必要です。装置がなくても、デモで画面と動きを確認できます。

■ ホーリーグレイル
・撮った画像の明るさを見て、シャッター速度と ISO を自動で変えます
・露出の推移をグラフで確認できます

■ インターバル
・一定の間隔で撮り続けます
・撮影中に間隔と枚数を変えられます

■ 長時間露光
・バルブで最長 60 分
・ND フィルターの露光時間の計算付き

■ つなぎ方
・カメラに ChronoStream 撮影装置を USB でつなぎ、スマホは装置の Wi-Fi につなぎます
・撮影は装置が行うので、電話や画面オフ、スマホの電池切れでも止まりません

■ 対応メーカー
・Nikon、Panasonic LUMIX、Canon、Sony、FUJIFILM、OM SYSTEM ほか（機種により使える機能が異なります）

■ 仕上げ
・撮影ログを RAW と同じフォルダに入れて PrimeLapse HolyGrail で開けば、なめらかに仕上がります

日本語・英語、縦・横の画面、夜間の赤表示に対応。アカウント登録や広告はありません。位置情報は端末の中だけで使います。

name: Chuchero
description:
Chuchero turns your iPhone into a car stereo with a subwoofer in the trunk. Play a song, push the bass, and feel it.

FEEL IT
• SUB: your iPhone rumbles with the bass, hit by hit
• BASS: a bass boost you can push from sensible to ridiculous
• A display, meters and faders made like a real head unit

WATCH IT
• A 3D car that bounces, rocks and shakes to the low end
• 13 places to park or drive: a parking lot, a highway, a gas station, a car wash, a drive-in, a rooftop, an underpass, a drag strip, a pier, a junkyard, a desert road, an endless hall, and a sky full of clouds that turns from day to night with the song
• Turn BASS and SUB all the way up and the car turns into a dancing speaker robot

THE GARAGE
• Earn CRED by listening, a little faster when it's loud
• 31 upgrades: paint, tint, rims, spinners, underglow, hydraulics, body kits, roof speakers, a speaker wall, flames and more
• Try anything on before you buy it. Bigger upgrades open the longer you listen.

YOUR MUSIC
• 12 songs built in, each with its own place and dance
• Add your own songs from the Files app, other apps, or your music library (songs without copy protection)
• Keeps playing in the background, with lock screen controls

No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Chuchero never connects to the internet.

name: Cirurgia Integrada
description:
Cirurgia Integrada é o aplicativo de acompanhamento pós-operatório usado pelos pacientes da clínica. Ele reúne, em um só lugar, as orientações do seu cirurgião, o registro diário da sua recuperação e um canal direto de mensagens com a equipe que realizou o seu procedimento.

COMO FUNCIONA

1. Sua equipe médica cadastra o seu número de telefone no sistema da clínica.
2. Você abre o aplicativo, informa esse mesmo número e recebe um código de verificação por WhatsApp.
3. Ao entrar, você encontra as orientações da sua cirurgia e pode começar os check-ins diários.

O QUE O APLICATIVO FAZ

Orientações da sua cirurgia
Exibe as instruções escritas pela sua equipe médica para o seu caso: cuidados com o curativo, medicação, repouso, alimentação e sinais de atenção, organizadas por procedimento e por etapa da recuperação.

Check-in diário de recuperação
Um formulário curto em que você registra seu nível de dor em uma escala de 0 a 10, confirma se tomou a medicação prescrita, se realizou os cuidados orientados e pode escrever uma observação livre. Os registros formam um histórico que seu médico acompanha.

Aviso automático ao seu médico
Quando o nível de dor informado no check-in é alto, sua equipe médica é notificada automaticamente e você recebe a confirmação de que o aviso foi enviado.

Mensagens com a equipe médica
Conversa direta com o seu médico dentro do aplicativo. Você pode enviar texto, fotos, áudios, vídeos e documentos para tirar dúvidas sobre a sua recuperação, e recebe as respostas no mesmo lugar.

Seus documentos
Acesso às prescrições, atestados e relatórios emitidos pela sua equipe, para visualizar no aplicativo ou baixar em PDF.

Dúvidas frequentes
Perguntas e respostas sobre o pós-operatório, escritas pela própria equipe médica.

Lembrete diário
Notificação opcional para lembrar você de fazer o check-in, que pode ser ativada ou desativada a qualquer momento na tela de Perfil.

ACESSO RESTRITO

Este aplicativo não permite cadastro livre. O acesso é exclusivo para pacientes previamente cadastrados pela equipe médica da clínica. Se o seu número ainda não estiver cadastrado, o aplicativo informará isso na tela de entrada e você deverá procurar a sua equipe médica.

O acesso é feito sem senha: a cada entrada é enviado um código de verificação de uso único, válido por 5 minutos.

AVISO IMPORTANTE

Este aplicativo é um canal complementar de acompanhamento e NÃO substitui consultas presenciais, nem atendimento de urgência ou emergência. Ele não realiza diagnóstico, não prescreve tratamento e não emite recomendações clínicas automáticas: todas as orientações exibidas são escritas pela sua própria equipe médica e se referem exclusivamente ao seu caso.

Em caso de urgência, procure atendimento médico imediatamente ou ligue para o SAMU (192).

PRIVACIDADE E PROTEÇÃO DE DADOS

Seus dados de saúde são tratados conforme a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD - Lei nº 13.709/2018). Todas as informações trafegam criptografadas e não são compartilhadas com terceiros nem utilizadas para publicidade.

Na tela de Perfil você pode, a qualquer momento, exportar seus dados pessoais, revogar o consentimento para comunicação digital e excluir sua conta.

Política de Privacidade: https://cirurgiaintegrada.com.br/privacidade
Termos de Uso: https://cirurgiaintegrada.com.br/termos

name: ClariEdu
description:
O ClariEdu é o portal escolar e agenda digital completo para aproximar famílias e escolas.

Principais funcionalidades:
• Agenda Digital Diária: acompanhe alimentação, sono, higiene, atividades pedagógicas e recados da turma em tempo real.
• Comunicados e Mensagens: canal direto e seguro entre pais, responsáveis, professores e coordenação.
• Central de Medicação com Receita: envie solicitações de medicação anexando a foto ou PDF da receita médica diretamente pelo celular e acompanhe a administração na escola.
• Mural de Fotos e Calendário Escolar: veja momentos especiais da turma, eventos e cardápio semanal.
• Notificações Instantâneas e Acesso Rápido com Face ID.

name: ClashXP
description:
ClashXP is a social arcade: lots of games in one app, played against your friends.

PLAY
Pool, Chess, Ludo, Bowling, Basketball, Racing, Ping Pong, Darts, Air Hockey, Mini Golf, Paintball, Blocks, Words, Solitaire and Sky Hop. Every game is built for the phone: 3D tables and tracks, one-thumb controls, and rounds that fit in a few minutes.

DUEL
Challenge a friend to any game. You both play the same game, and the better score wins. Post an open challenge on the feed and let anyone try to beat you.

GO LIVE
Stream yourself playing, or just chat with your camera on. Viewers can talk in the live chat, send hearts, and ask to join you for a one-on-one game.

FEED AND CHAT
Share photos, videos and voice notes, reply to friends, and message them directly.

LEVEL UP
Gain XP with every game, complete daily missions, unlock achievements, keep your streak alive and climb each game's ratings.

YOUR CHARACTER
Build your own 3D character and take it into the games.

FAIR AND SAFE
Scores are checked on our servers, so results can't be faked. Report or block anyone from a post, a chat or a live; reports are reviewed within 24 hours.

ClashXP is for players aged 18 and over. Available in English and French.

name: Classic Chess - GoodChess
description:
Classic chess, beautiful and ad-free.

GoodChess is a calm, carefully crafted chess app: like a game at the corner café, with no rush and no interruptions.

■ PLAY
• Against the computer on Easy, Normal or Hard, adapting to your level
• Two players on the same iPhone or iPad
• No clock, or Standard, Rapid and Blitz
• Your Elo for each time control, with its chart
• The opening name as you play
• Undo, hints, and your unfinished game saved automatically

■ IMPROVE
• The daily puzzle, the same for everyone, with your streak
• 135 mate-in-1, 2 and 3 puzzles, all verified
• Game review with the engine: best move, inaccuracy, mistake…
• 12 short lessons, from the board to castling and en passant

■ YOUR WAY
• Achievements and leaderboards (Game Center, optional)
• Backgrounds to choose from and dark mode
• For iPhone and iPad

■ NO ADS, NO SUBSCRIPTIONS
Try everything free for 7 days. Then unlock it forever with a single purchase. The daily puzzle and the lessons are always free.
No ads, no subscriptions, no accounts, and no data collected. Works offline and supports Family Sharing.

GoodChess is part of GoodApps, a family of beautiful, calm, ad-free games.
Classic chess. No ads. Just play.

name: Clatter: Split Flap Board
description:
A split-flap board for your pocket, the kind that used to rattle over a station concourse. Type a line and every flap turns through its drum in order until it drops into place, with a clack for each one and a pulse in your hand to match.

MESSAGE
• Type anything, or tap a quick message: Welcome Home, Happy Birthday, Now Boarding
• Words wrap and center on a 6 x 14 board, like the departure boards in old stations
• Every module is simulated: they start a beat apart and turn at slightly different speeds, so no two flips match

CLOCK
• Weekday, time and date, flipping once a minute
• 12 or 24-hour time
• Full Screen keeps the display awake, so the board can sit on a desk or bedside table while it charges. Turn the phone sideways for a bigger board

COUNTDOWN
• Days, hours and minutes to a trip, birthday, wedding or launch

SHARE
• A short looping video of the board flipping into your message, with sound, in square, story or wide
• Or a still picture
• A small Clatter mark is optional

FIVE BOARDS
Midnight, Ivory, Amber, Seafoam and Tomato.

Every clack is synthesized, flap by flap. No recordings, no network.

Paid once at the gate: no ads, no sign-in, no tracking.

name: ClayCaliper
description:
ClayCaliper is an offline studio workbench built for ceramicists, potters, and glaze technicians.

1. Bidirectional Shrinkage Caliper & Blueprint
- Convert target fired dimensions into exact wet throwing measurements, or predict final fired dimensions from freshly thrown pieces.
- Visualize wet and fired vessel cross-sections side-by-side across cylinders, mugs, bowls, and lidded jars with gallery clearance tracking.
- Estimate required wet clay mass in grams or ounces, and calibrate custom clay bodies using a 100mm shrink-bar field test.
