2. Multi-Segment Kiln Ramp & Quartz Safety Planner
- Build and customize multi-segment firing schedules with rate-of-climb, target temperature, and soak hold durations.
- Inspect real-time temperature-time graphs highlighting 100°C moisture release and the 573°C quartz inversion band with thermal shock checks.
- Log finished firing runs with witness cone bend angles and kiln shelf zone notes.

3. Glaze Batch Scaler & Specific Gravity Slurry Math
- Scale 100% base oxide formulas and colorant additives to any dry batch weight.
- Estimate water volume in milliliters for your target specific gravity and check off each material as you weigh it on your studio scale.

4. Studio Ledger & Portable Spec Sheets
- Track projects across Wet, Bisque Fired, Glaze Fired, and Archived stages.
- Compare shrinkage yields across clay bodies and export clean PDF studio spec sheets, CSV tables, or JSON backups completely offline.

name: Clearwell: Transparent Icons
description:
Clearwell makes Home Screen icons and widgets you can see through. It cuts your own wallpaper into the exact pieces that sit under each icon and widget spot, so the spot disappears: empty gaps exactly where you want them, symbols that float on your wallpaper, a widget with nothing but the time.

LINED UP ON YOUR MODEL
Every icon and widget spot was measured on each iPhone and iPad screen, on iOS 26 and iOS 27, with small and with large icons: iPhone 18 Pro Max, 17, Air, 16e, SE and mini, every iPad, portrait and landscape. If your screenshot has icons on it, Clearwell reads the grid from them. You can also pick another grid by hand.

SHARP, NOT PIXELATED
The pieces come straight from your screenshot's pixels, never resized, so they match the wallpaper exactly.

WIDGETS WITHOUT SHORTCUTS
Small, medium, large, and extra large on iPad. Leave them empty or show the time, the date or your own text. Add the Clearwell widget and it already shows your newest piece of that size; edit the widget to choose another spot.

ICONS, STEP BY STEP
Blank, a symbol in any color, or your own image (a PNG with a transparent background keeps the wallpaper around it). Save it to Photos or Files and follow the shortest steps in the app to put it on your Home Screen with Apple's Shortcuts app, with an invisible name so no label shows. Open Shortcuts and Copy Blank Name are one tap each.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Touch and hold your Home Screen, swipe past your last page and take a screenshot of the empty page.
2. Choose it in Clearwell: every spot appears on it.
3. Tap a spot, make the icon or widget and put it on your Home Screen.

PRICE
Your first Home Screen is included, with everything. Clearwell Pro, a one-time purchase, unlocks as many Home Screen pages as you like, each from its own screenshot. No subscription, no account, no ads, no tracking.

Questions, or a model that does not line up: baltajmn@gmail.com

Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://clearwell.baltajmn.dev/privacy/

name: Clefdoc – Private PDF Scanner
description:
Clefdoc turns paper into clean PDFs right on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. Clefdoc never uploads your documents: they stay on your iPhone unless you export or share them.

Scanning, editing and text recognition run on the device and work offline.

SCAN
• Built-in iOS document scanner: automatic edge detection and perspective correction, up to 24 pages per session, saved in order as a single document.
• Manual mode, offered if you cancel the scanner: live camera with the detected document outlined, optional auto capture when the frame is steady, and batch mode.
• Import images from Photos or Files, with automatic edge detection.
• Add pages to an existing document.

EDIT
• Precise cropping: drag the corners and edges, with a 3x magnifier under your finger. “Auto” detects the edges again, “Full” keeps the whole image.
• Four filters: Original, Magic (evens out lighting, whitens the paper, keeps colors), Grayscale and Black & white.
• Rotate pages, adjust brightness and contrast.
• Reorder pages: touch and hold to drag, or use Move earlier and Move later.

TEXT RECOGNITION (OCR)
• Recognize the text of a page, one page at a time, even in airplane mode.
• Languages: English, plus French, Spanish or German when the app is set to that language.
• Copy the text or share it as a .txt file; it stays saved with the page. PDFs contain the page images, not searchable text.

EXPORT AND SHARE
• Export as PDF (A4 or Fit to image) or as JPEG images.
• Standard or Compact quality, with an estimated file size. No watermark.
• Share with the iOS share sheet, or Save to Files (iCloud Drive, On My iPhone).
• Share as PDF straight from your library.

LIBRARY
• Thumbnails, titles, page counts and dates at a glance.
• Full-screen viewer: swipe between pages, pinch or double-tap to zoom.
• Rename documents, delete documents or single pages.
• Settings: language, default filter, PDF page size and export quality.
• Interface in English, French, Spanish and German. Matches your iPhone’s Light or Dark appearance.

YOUR DATA
Documents are stored only in the app, on this iPhone. There is no cloud sync and no built-in backup. If iCloud Backup is turned on for your iPhone, it may include them. Deleting the app deletes your documents, so export the ones you want to keep.

CLEFDOC PRO
Scanning, importing images, adding pages, editing, cropping, reordering pages and running text recognition require Clefdoc Pro. To scan your first document, start the free trial or buy lifetime access. Two options:

• Yearly subscription, with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. You start the trial by subscribing in the app. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends, or when you confirm the purchase if no trial applies. The subscription renews automatically every year unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial or the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple Account settings.
• Lifetime access: a one-time purchase that unlocks all Pro features, with no subscription. It has no free trial. If you buy it during the trial, cancel the subscription so you are not charged when the trial ends.

Prices are shown in your local currency in the app before you confirm. Restore purchases is available on the offer screen and in Settings > Clefdoc Pro.

Read-only mode: without Clefdoc Pro (before the trial, or after a trial or subscription ends), you can still view, export and share your documents, copy or share text that was already recognized, rename documents and delete documents or pages. Your documents are never deleted when access ends.

Pro status is checked with the App Store on your iPhone. Offline, it stays active up to 7 days (subscription) or 30 days (lifetime) after the last check, then read-only mode applies until the next check.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://clefdoc.com/en/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://clefdoc.com/en/privacy/

name: ClipUnder: Video Compressor
description:
ClipUnder is a free, on-device video toolkit for iPhone and iPad. Set a custom MB limit, batch-compress your videos, and see the verified size of each successful export. You can also batch-extract MP3 audio, save full-resolution video frames, make Live Photos for your Lock Screen, convert MP4 and MOV, and mask faces before sharing.

• Set a custom MB limit or choose a quality preset. Adjust resolution, frame rate and audio. Compare the original and compressed videos side by side.
• Extract MP3, M4A or WAV from multiple videos and save the audio files together.
• Move frame by frame and export up to 20 full-resolution JPEGs per video.
• Make a vertical Live Photo up to 3 seconds long. Save it to Photos, then choose it in Settings → Wallpaper for your Lock Screen.
• Automatically mask faces with mosaic or black boxes. Review the result before sharing.
• Trim, split, merge, crop or convert videos. Make looping GIFs, add music or burn in SRT subtitles.

ClipUnder is free to use on iPhone and iPad. Video and audio processing takes place on your device. No account, ads, subscriptions or watermarks.

name: Cloud Shelter
description:
Cloud Shelter keeps an eye on your boat while you're away, and tells you the moment something needs you.

See your boat at a glance
• Batteries: charge, voltage, current and time left, with 24-hour history
• Shore power: whether the boat is plugged in, and switch the shore inlet remotely
• Solar and fuel, where your boat has them
• Position on a map, with the place name and when it was last heard

Know when something is wrong
• Leak and bilge sensors, doors, movement, smoke, temperature and humidity
• Push alerts for alarms, low batteries, lost shore power and a boat that has gone quiet
• A clear red warning when the boat stops reporting, so old readings never look live
• Acknowledge or snooze alerts from your phone

Security and anchor watch
• Arm and disarm the boat's security, sound or silence the siren
• Anchor watch with the boat's GPS, or with your phone's own GPS when the boat has none: set a radius and get an alarm if the boat drags, even with the screen off

Run the boat's paperwork
• Logbook with photos, maintenance tasks, and the boat's documents
• Share the boat with crew and skippers, each with the access you choose

Made for owners
• Unlock with Face ID or fingerprint
• Works offline: shows the last readings with their age until the connection is back

Cloud Shelter works with Cloud Shelter monitoring devices installed on your boat. You need a Cloud Shelter account: get one, and the devices, at cloud-shelter.com.

name: Club Empire: Nightlife Tycoon
description:
Start with a cramped basement bar, one rookie DJ and $3,000. End up running the most legendary club in the city.

CLUB EMPIRE is a pixel-art nightclub tycoon where every decision shows up on the dance floor.

RUN THE NIGHT
• Open the doors and play the night live, from 22:00 to 04:00
• Work the door, the bar or the floor yourself when the rush hits
• Tap guests for tips and chain combos
• Hype the crowd, launch happy hour and handle emergencies: fights, celebrities, blown speakers, power cuts

BUILD YOUR CLUB
• Buy speakers, spotlights, a disco ball, lasers and a giant LED wall, and watch every piece appear in your club
• Expand from a brick basement to a two-floor club, a rooftop terrace and a warehouse superclub
• Unlock new gear as your reputation grows

SIGN STAR DJS
• 16 DJs with their own style, skill and fans
• Follow the weekly music trend
• Renew contracts before a rival steals your headliner

BEAT VINCE
The club across the street wants your crowd. Race him for reputation, answer his taunts and take the city's crown.

• Three goals and stars every night
• Income, costs and best nights at a glance
• Random events keep every week different
• Retro soundtrack for every genre
• Plays offline, saves automatically

The party starts tonight.

Love nightclub tycoon and nightclub simulator games, idle business games or DJ games? Club Empire is your club.

name: Clumkyor
description:
Clumkyor is a warranty ledger for durable goods—electronics, appliances, furniture, and tools. Log purchase and end dates, optional store and serial fields, and browse what is still covered.

The Home tab groups active policies by time remaining (30 / 31–60 / 61–90 / beyond 90 days). The Ledger tab is a searchable coverage timeline. Workshop holds preferences, lapsed or shelved records, category browsing, tips, About, and the privacy policy.

No account, Notifications are optional and only requested when you enable expiry reminders in Preferences.

name: CNA Exam - Practice Test
description:
Get ready for your CNA certification exam with short practice quizzes and a clear explanation after every answer.

15 SECTIONS, 154 TOPICS
Study the material the nurse aide written test covers: Role of the Nurse Aide, Residents' Rights, Communication, Infection Control, Safety and Emergency Care, Personal Care, Nutrition and Hydration, Elimination, Mobility and Transfers, Vital Signs, Mental Health and Dementia, Common Conditions, and Restorative and End-of-Life Care, plus two sections on the skills test. Each section is split into small topics, so you can practise one thing at a time.

SKILLS CHECKLISTS
Step-by-step checklists for 24 hands-on skills, from hand hygiene and taking a pulse to transfers and range of motion, with the critical steps marked so you learn those first.

PRACTICE TESTS
Take a test for any section, or the full 60-question written exam drawn from every area. Answers stay hidden until you finish, like the real test. Score 75% to pass, then review every miss with its explanation.

A PLAN FOR YOUR TEST DATE
Tell the app which test you're taking, when, and how many questions a day you want. It counts down to your test day and can remind you to study.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Your overall accuracy and a readiness score for each section
• A daily streak
• Your test history
• Weekly, monthly and all-time leaderboards under a nickname you choose

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Open the app and start studying. We don't ask for your name, email or any personal details.

FREE AND PRO
Free: all of Infection Control, with its section test, the first two topics of every other section and three skills checklists. CNA Exam Pro opens every topic, every skills checklist, every section test and the full written exam. Choose a yearly subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase.

The yearly subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and you can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://studencity.in/privacy-policy/cna-exam?platform=ios

Disclaimer: this app is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or authorized by Credentia, Prometric, Headmaster, the NCSBN, any state nurse aide registry or any government agency. Questions are for practice only, and a practice score does not predict your result on the real exam. Always check your state's candidate handbook for the current rules.

name: CogTickMarrow
description:
A motor hums on an iron wall. Two clock hands sit dead still above it. Between them, a handful of empty pegs. You have a toolbox of brass gears and a gauge of steam that drops with every placement.

The rules fit on a workbench note. Gears that mesh turn opposite ways. A big gear driven by a small one turns slower, a small one driven by a big one spins faster, exactly by the ratio of their teeth. So each hand wants something specific, say clockwise at 45 RPM, and you work backwards from it: which size goes here, which way will it turn the next one, does it even reach.

Teeth line up for real. When the last gear drops in, the whole train starts ticking at once, and the hands either sweep the right way or they don't.

The wall gets fussier as you go:
- Copper belts join two pegs and keep the direction instead of flipping it.
- Bolted gears are already fixed. You build around them.
- Cracked gears jam the machine if anything touches them.
- Twin-hand stages ask for two different speeds from one motor.

There are 60 stages, laid out on a pocket-watch dial you turn to pick one. Each is checked solvable before it ships. Use the fewest gears for three stars, and keep steam in reserve for a better score.

Every day there is a Daily Gearwork stage, the same machine for everyone, with its own ledger next to the all-time one. Your operator name is generated for you, so there is nothing to type.

Ratchet clicks, clunks on placement, a chime when the hands come alive. It plays offline, with no account, no ads and no in-app purchases. Just the wall, the gears and you counting teeth.

name: Coil and Core
description:
Coil and Core turns electricity and magnetism into a circuit you complete yourself. The course is laid out as a glowing circuit board: each lesson is a node, and every lesson you pass lights up the next trace. There are 11 units and 44 bite-sized lessons, starting with atoms and electric charge and moving through voltage, current, resistance, Ohm's law, circuits, magnets and electromagnetism to induction, generators, motors and electricity at home. Every lesson combines short, friendly explanations and clear formulas with a quick quiz. Each unit ends with a challenge that earns you a badge. 

Don't just read about physics; play with it. Six live simulators run on real formulas. In Charge Playground you drag charges and watch the field lines and forces respond. In the Ohm's Law Bench you see a bulb brighten as current rises. Circuit Builder lets you wire your own series and parallel circuits, and it warns you about short circuits. You can also map a magnet's field with a grid of compasses, push a magnet through a coil to make the lamp flash, or spin a generator and watch the AC wave appear. Each simulator has hands-on challenges, such as "make the ammeter read 0.5 A".

Make the knowledge stick, then find it in your own home. Built-in spaced repetition brings back the right cards at the right time, and a formula reference and an Ohm & Power Solver are always at hand. The Lab Notebook guides you through safe experiments with only AA, AAA or 9 V batteries, from a lemon battery to a homemade electromagnet, and lets you log your results with photos. In Spot it, you photograph everyday devices and link them to what you've learned: motors, transformers, heating elements and more.

name: CometWhirlSling
description:
Pull back. Let go. The comet shoots off in a perfectly straight line for about half a second, and then the nearest planet gets hold of it.

CometWhirlSling is a little pixel sky full of gravity. You drag back anywhere on the screen to stretch the sling, release to launch, and try to land your comet on the target moon. Every planet pulls, and big ones pull harder, so the shot you would take on paper is almost never the shot that works. You learn to aim off to one side and let a planet swing you round.

The aiming guide only shows the start of the flight. The rest you work out. Miss, and a faint ghost of your last path stays on screen so you can nudge the next one.

The sky gets busier:
- Planets that orbit, but only while your comet is in the air
- Black holes that swallow anything that comes too close
- Stardust drifting along the way for extra points

There are 40 skies spread over five constellations on a star map, starting at The Kite and ending at the Nova Gate. Every sky was built from a real, tested launch, so all of them can be solved. Fewer launches mean more stars.

The Daily Sky is the same puzzle for every pilot that day, with a board of its own, and your total score climbs the all-time ranks under a pilot name you can reroll.

The comet leaves a tail of fading pixel particles that bends around everything it passes. Chiptune blips, a calm 8-bit loop, a stretchy haptic buzz as you pull, a burst when you hit. It supports Reduce Motion and plays fine one-handed.

No login, no ads, no in-app purchases, and it plays offline. Bend it round the planet. Hit the moon.

name: Compare Rideshare Prices
description:
Stop guessing which ride app is cheaper. Compare Rideshare shows what each of your ride apps would charge for the same trip, side by side, so you can take the lowest fare in seconds.

Enter your pickup and destination once. Compare Rideshare asks each ride service you've connected for a quote on that route and shows the prices and pickup times together. When you've chosen, tap to open that app and book as usual.

HOW IT WORKS
• Set your destination. Search any address or place, or start from your current location.
• See your options. Prices and pickup times from your connected ride services, together on one screen.
• You choose. You go. Open the ride you want in its own app and book it there.

WHY COMPARE
• Save money. Prices for the same trip can differ a lot between apps and ride types, and the lowest fare is marked for you.
• The cheapest ride isn't always the quickest, so price and pickup time sit together.
• Every ride type in one list: standard, comfort, XL, premium and more, where available.
• Past rides from your connected accounts in one History tab.
• Light and dark mode, designed to feel at home on iPhone.

YOUR ACCOUNTS STAY YOURS
• Connect the ride accounts you already use. Quotes come from those accounts, so you see the prices offered to you.
• Your ride-service sign-ins are saved in your iPhone's secure storage.
• Comparing is free. You book and pay directly with the service you choose. Compare Rideshare never books or charges for a ride.

WHERE IT WORKS
Compare Rideshare is designed for US cities and features Uber, Lyft, Waymo, Robotaxi, Zoox, Empower and Blacklane. The services you see depend on which ones operate in your area.

Compare Rideshare is an independent app from Rideshare Compare, Inc. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any of the ride services it compares. All product names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Questions? Email info@comparerideshare.com.

name: Contas da Obra: Orçamentos
description:
Para pintores, pedreiros, eletricistas, canalizadores e remodelações. A Contas da Obra faz o orçamento em PDF em 2 minutos e, no fim, responde à pergunta que importa: quanto ganhei de facto nesta obra e por hora?

PORQUE É DIFERENTE
• Lucro real por obra e por hora: «Orçamentou 2.000 €. Gastou 1.350 €. Trabalhou 74 horas. Ganhou 8,78 € por hora.»
• Guia rápido que faz consigo: toque em «Mostrar-me na app» e a app leva-o ao sítio certo e mostra onde tocar, passo a passo.
• Calculadoras da obra: m² das paredes, teto e chão de uma divisão (já sem portas e janelas). Tinta, azulejo e pavimento (pelo tamanho do azulejo e peças por caixa: diz logo as caixas a comprar), reboco, betonilha e pladur, com lista de compras para o fornecedor.
• Feita para Portugal: IVA português (23 %, 13 %, 6 %, isenção do art. 53.º, autoliquidação na construção, Madeira e Açores), euros e datas como cá.
• Quanto devo cobrar à hora? Calculadora a partir dos seus custos (carrinha, seguro, ferramentas, contabilista, Segurança Social) e dos ajudantes.
• Privado e sem conta: os seus clientes e os seus números ficam só no seu telemóvel, cifrados. Cópia de segurança com palavra-passe.

ORÇAMENTOS QUE DÃO CONFIANÇA
Linhas por m², hora, dia, unidade ou valor fechado; materiais; deslocações; desconto; sinal e prestações. PDF profissional com o seu nome, NIF e a cor que escolher, enviado por WhatsApp. Pode mostrar só o valor global e escrever o que «Não inclui». Quando o cliente aceita, a obra fica criada com um toque e a agenda marcada.

NA OBRA
• Gastei: foto do talão e pronto. Material, gasóleo por quilómetros, ajudantes.
• Comecei / Acabei: cronómetro de horas por obra.
• Trabalhos a mais, fotografias de antes e depois.
• Agenda: visitas, dias de trabalho, idas à loja e cobranças, com avisos. «Chuva: próximo dia livre.»

DINHEIRO
Quem me deve, sinais, prestações e lembrete de cobrança por WhatsApp (é sempre você quem envia). Relatório do mês: valor das obras, gastos, ganho e €/hora.

GRÁTIS E PREMIUM
Grátis: registar obras, gastos, horas e clientes; 2 obras em curso ao mesmo tempo; 4 orçamentos em PDF por mês (depois, cada vídeo curto liberta mais um); a conta dos m² da divisão. As calculadoras de material abrem com um vídeo curto durante 6 horas.
Premium (subscrição opcional): sem anúncios, obras e orçamentos ilimitados, orçamento por divisões e «o cliente só quer uma parte», logótipo e PDF sem a marca da app, PDF «mão de obra + materiais» ou detalhado, relatórios do ano e Excel, modelos de orçamento e calculadoras sempre abertas.

IMPORTANTE
A Contas da Obra faz orçamentos e contas. Não emite faturas nem recibos (em Portugal só os programas certificados pela Autoridade Tributária ou o Portal das Finanças o podem fazer) e não dá aconselhamento fiscal. Os valores de IVA e Segurança Social são indicativos: confirme com o seu contabilista.

Responsável: Luís Almeida (LFSA Apps) · lfsaapps@gmail.com

SUBSCRIÇÃO PREMIUM (OPCIONAL)
Mensal ou anual, paga pela sua conta Apple. Renova-se automaticamente, a não ser que a cancele pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período em Definições → o seu nome → Subscrições. Termos de utilização (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ · Política de privacidade: https://lfsaapps.github.io/contasdaobra/

name: Contextory
description: Contextory, haftalar sonra bile önemli olan şeyleri hatırlamanıza yardımcı olur; sadece gerçeği değil, neden kaydettiğinizi de. Her kayıt bir gerçek-bağlam zarfıdır: kısa bir gerçek satırı, etrafındaki hikaye, isteğe bağlı olarak kişilere, yerlere ve belgelere bağlantılar ve ne zaman tekrar önemli olabileceği. Taze, Eski ve Olay Sonrası rafları, haftalık inceleme ve hala geçerli kontrollerle kütüphanenizi dürüst tutar. Orbit, bir konuyu merkeze yerleştirir ve etrafındaki ilgili bağlamları haritalandırır. Ask, basit soruları zarflarınızdan derlenmiş cevaplara dönüştürür. Atlas, bağlantı türlerini ve kalıcı bağlam yazmak için basit bir yöntemi açıklar. Kiracılar, sürücüler ve onarımlar, kiralamalar ve servis detaylarıyla uğraşan herkes için tasarlanmıştır. Kütüphaneniz, cihazda yerel bir anlık görüntü olarak saklanır. Saniyeler içinde yeni bir zarf yakalamak, hızlı hatırlama için önemli bilgileri sabitlemek ve hafızadan silinmeden önce eski öğeleri takip etmek için Facts'i açın.

name: ConversationLab
description: ConversationLab, günlük durumları birkaç dakika içinde tamamlayabileceğiniz kısa İngilizce rol oyunlarına dönüştürüyor. Otel giriş işlemleri, havaalanı kapıları, restoran siparişleri, iş görüşmeleri, bakkallar ve taksi yolculukları gibi durumları deneyimleyin. Her sahne, net bir ortam ve gerçek hayattaki gibi konuşan dost canlısı bir karakterle başlıyor. Bir oturum sırasında, o anı okuyabilir, önerilen satırlardan birini seçebilir veya kendi cevabınızı yazabilirsiniz. Sesli konuşma pratiği yapmak istediğinizde ses kaydı yapın ve bir sonrakine geçmeden önce tekrar dinleyin. Sahne bittiğinde, yapılandırılmış bir özet, dilbilgisi düzeltmelerini, faydalı kelimeleri, daha akıcı ifadeleri, alternatif satırları ve aslında söylediklerinizle bağlantılı kısa kültürel notları vurgular. Senaryolar siz geliştikçe uyarlanır: Başlangıçta daha kısa ipuçları, daha fazla ayrıntıya hazır olduğunuzda daha zengin karşılıklı konuşmalar. Durum türüne göre göz atın, laboratuvar ana sayfasından ilerlemenizi takip edin ve pratik için tasarlanmış sakin, odaklanmış bir arayüzden istediğiniz zaman ayarları tekrar ziyaret edin—sonsuz menülerden değil. İster yakında seyahat edecek olun, ister iş görüşmelerine hazırlanıyor olun, isterse de daha akıcı bir sohbet ortamı yaratmak isteyin, ConversationLab size gerçek konuşma başlamadan önce özgüveninizi artıracak tekrarlanabilir anlar sunar.

name: Cortège Chauffeur
description:
Cortège Chauffeur est l'appli des chauffeurs dont l'exploitant (VTC, transport de personnes avec chauffeur) gère ses courses avec Cortège.

Il faut un compte : votre exploitant vous invite, ou vous créez le vôtre et rejoignez son équipe. L'appli ne sert pas à commander une course.

VOS COURSES
• Les courses du jour et celles à venir, avec l'heure, les adresses, les passagers, le vol ou le train, et les consignes du dispatch.
• Acceptez ou refusez une nouvelle course d'un geste.
• Ouvrez l'itinéraire dans votre appli de navigation.

PENDANT LA COURSE
• En route, sur place, à bord, déposé : chaque étape d'un geste, ou toute seule grâce à la position sur les transferts.
• Annoncez un retard, signalez un incident ou un client absent.
• Appelez ou écrivez au passager sans que personne ne voie le numéro de l'autre.
• Le dispatch et le passager suivent votre arrivée en direct, pendant la course seulement.

À LA FIN
• Signature du passager, photo, notes.
• Vos frais (parking, péage, attente) avec la photo du justificatif.

ET AUSSI
• Notifications : nouvelle course, changement d'heure, annulation, message.
• Sans réseau : les étapes sont gardées, puis envoyées dès que la connexion revient.
• Vos disponibilités, vos véhicules et vos documents dans votre profil.

VOTRE POSITION
Elle n'est partagée que pendant une course, y compris quand l'écran est éteint, pour que le dispatch et le passager sachent où vous êtes. En dehors d'une course, rien n'est envoyé.

name: Cove Pool Control
description:
Your pool, one tap away.

Cove is a fast, modern app for pools that use a Pentair ScreenLogic adapter. Lights, pumps, temperatures and schedules are right there when you open it, with no account and no cloud.

OPENS INSTANTLY
Your last status shows the moment Cove opens, then updates live as soon as it connects.

SEE WHAT MATTERS
Water and air temperature, pump speed, power and flow, and every circuit you actually use. Hide the ones you don't.

CONTROL YOUR EQUIPMENT
• Turn lights, features, the cleaner and pumps on and off
• Pick light colors and light shows
• Set the heat setpoint
• Change the speed programmed for each pump setting
• Add and edit the schedules stored on your controller, so they run even when your phone is off

FINDS YOUR ADAPTER
Cove finds your pool adapter on your home network automatically, even on larger networks.

MADE FOR YOUR SETUP
Cove reads your controller's own circuit names, so what you see matches the equipment you have. Works on iPhone and iPad.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Cove talks only to the pool adapter on your own Wi-Fi. Nothing is sent to us or anyone else.

REQUIREMENTS
A Pentair pool controller (such as EasyTouch) with a ScreenLogic adapter on the same Wi-Fi network as your iPhone or iPad. Cove works at home on your network, not over the internet.

Pentair, ScreenLogic and EasyTouch are trademarks of Pentair. Cove is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Pentair.

name: CoverTrack
description:
CoverTrack tracks your contractors' insurance certificates, so you know who is covered before they start work.

It is built for UK property managers, facilities managers and main contractors.

WHAT IT DOES
- Set the cover each type of contractor needs, in UK terms: public liability, employers' liability, professional indemnity, products liability and more.
- Upload a broker letter, certificate or policy schedule, or take a photo of it on site.
- CoverTrack's AI reads the insured name, insurer, policy number, cover types, limits and dates.
- If it can't read a detail clearly, it marks the certificate Needs review. It does not guess.
- Every certificate is checked against your requirements. You see what is missing, what has expired and what expires soon.
- One dashboard shows who is compliant, who has gaps and what needs attention first.
- Forward certificates to your own CoverTrack email address and they are filed for you.
- Track Gas Safe registration, trade accreditation, RAMS and waste carrier licences too.
- Optional reminder emails ask a contractor for a new certificate before the old one runs out.

WHAT COVERTRACK DOESN'T DO
CoverTrack checks the certificates you upload against the requirements you set. It doesn't confirm policy status with insurers or brokers, and it doesn't give insurance or legal advice.

Privacy policy: https://getcovertrack.co.uk/privacy
Terms of use: https://getcovertrack.co.uk/terms

name: CrateLane: Aisle Picker
description:
CrateLane is one aisle for a warehouse picker. The crate in front is marked picked or short, and the lane moves to the next crate.

HOW IT WORKS
- Lane: six crates open the walk, starting with spark plugs in Aisle 4. Picked advances to the next waiting crate. Short sends that crate to the short bin and advances the same way. When nothing is waiting, the lane says the aisle is clear and can reload the morning walk.
- Shorts: crates marked short. Put back places one in front of you again.
- Aisle: the whole walk, with the current crate outlined.

The marks stay on the iPhone. CrateLane does not talk to a warehouse system and it does not confirm stock in the bay.

name: Crayonshot: Photo to Coloring
description:
Turn the photos you love into printable coloring pages. Pick a photo of your dog, your kids, grandma's house or last summer's trip, and Crayonshot draws a clean black-and-white page you can print and color. Your first page is free.

A coloring page of your own pet beats a generic one every time. No drawing skills, no editing tools, no account.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a photo from your library or take one with the camera
• Keep the whole scene, or just the main subject on white for younger kids
• Your page is ready in about a minute
• Print it, share it, or save it to Photos

MAKE A COLORING BOOK
• Pick up to 30 pages, give the book a title and save it
• Print the whole book or share it as a PDF, one page per sheet
• Great for birthdays, road trips, rainy days and classrooms

MADE FOR FAMILIES AND TEACHERS
• Redo any page if you want a different take
• Your pages stay on your phone, in your library
• Light and dark mode, iPhone and iPad

SIMPLE, HONEST PRICING
• One free page on each phone
• Then one-time page packs: 3, 10 or 30 pages
• No subscription, nothing renews, no ads
• Pages never expire. 1 page makes 1 coloring page or 1 redo
• Prices are shown in the app before you buy

YOUR PHOTOS
Before your first page, Crayonshot asks your permission to send the photo you pick to OpenAI to draw the page. The photo is used only to make your page. We don't keep your photo or the page on our servers; the page is saved only on your phone. You can turn AI drawing off in Settings at any time. Only use photos of your family or people who said yes.

Page packs are one-time in-app purchases charged to your Apple Account. They don't renew. Refunds are handled by Apple.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://crayonshot.evtsoy.com/terms
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://crayonshot.evtsoy.com/privacy

Questions? crayonshot@evtsoy.com · https://crayonshot.evtsoy.com/support

name: CreaseVantFold
description:
A cream sheet lies on a navy desk, printed with two coral dots and a few dashed creases. Tap a crease. The half you touched lifts, turns over with a soft whoosh, and settles on top. The dots are now closer. One more fold should do it.

CreaseVantFold is a logic puzzle about paper that behaves like paper. Every fold mirrors the lifted half across the crease, reverses its layers and stacks it on the rest, and printed marks show through as faint rings so you can see where things went. The aim of each letter is to bring the marked dots onto one another within the fold limit. Undo is always there when you want to think again.

The 48 letters come in four bundles.
Plain Notes, where you learn how one fold moves half a sheet.
One-Way Mail, with arrowed creases that only fold one way.
Sealed Post, where wax seals pin squares to the desk so their side can never lift.
Coral Ink, where some squares are coral on the back and must finish on top, coral side up.

Each letter has a par. Meet it for three stars, beat it for a better score. A Daily Letter arrives every day, the same for everyone, with standings for the neatest delivery. Your totals go on the all-time standings under a pen name the game picks for you, re-rollable at will.

It looks like good stationery and sounds like it too: Playfair Display headings, paper whooshes, soft piano, and a crisp haptic snap on each crease.

No account. No ads. No in-app purchases. It works offline, and your data can be deleted from Settings.

name: CretanTherm
description:
CretanTherm είναι μια εφαρμογή για την εκτίμηση του θερμικού περιβάλλοντος παραδοσιακών λίθινων υπόγειων χώρων και στερνών, με έμπνευση από την Κρήτη.

Αντί για απλό υπολογισμό θερμοκρασίας, αντιμετωπίζει τον λίθινο χώρο ως ολοκληρωμένο θερμικό σύστημα: έδαφος, πάχος τοίχου, είδος λίθου, επίχωμα, όγκος, ανοίγματα και σκίαση συνεργάζονται για σταθερότερο εσωτερικό κλίμα.

Κύρια χαρακτηριστικά • Πρόβλεψη θερμοκρασίας — ετήσια καμπύλη εσωτερικής, εξωτερικής και εδαφικής θερμοκρασίας
• Χρήσεις αποθήκευσης — συμβουλές για ελαιόλαδο, κρασί, τρόφιμα, εργαλεία/σπόρους και ζύμωση
• Χρόνος αερισμού — πότε ο αερισμός ψύχει και πότε αυξάνει θερμότητα ή υγρασία
• Σχέδια βελτίωσης — σύγκριση επιχώματος, ανοίγματος, σκίασης, δαπέδου και τοίχου
• Αρχείο χώρων — αποθήκευση και διαχείριση πολλών λίθινων χώρων

Σημαντική σημείωση
Οι εκτιμήσεις θερμοκρασίας και καταλληλότητας αποτελούν βοηθητικό εργαλείο. Η ασφάλεια και η ποιότητα τροφίμων απαιτούν ανεξάρτητο έλεγχο και επαγγελματική κρίση.

Κατάλληλο για ιδιοκτήτες παραδοσιακών χώρων, μελετητές και όσους ενδιαφέρονται για τη θερμική συμπεριφορά λίθινων υπόγειων κατασκευών.

name: Crisp Light Meter
description:
Crisp Light Meter converts your iPhone camera's auto-exposure settings (shutter speed, ISO and aperture) into illuminance, then estimates a light's luminous flux from the measuring distance and beam angle.

Light meter
• Live illuminance in lux or foot-candles (fc)
• Logarithmic scale showing dim, indoor, bright and daylight levels
• EV100, uncalibrated lux, calibration factor, and the average, minimum and maximum of recent readings
• Lock the reading to note it down
• Works with both the front and rear cameras

Lumen estimate
• Estimates flux with Φ ≈ E × d² × Ω
• Pick the distance on a wheel, in meters or feet
• Common beam angles in one tap, or set any angle
• Multipoint sampling averages several readings to reduce the effect of uneven light

Calibration
• Compare against a reference lux meter; front and rear cameras keep separate calibration factors
• Calibration applies immediately

History
• Save readings with distance, beam angle and calibration factor
• Add a note to any record

Privacy
• The camera is used only to read exposure settings. No photos or videos are captured, saved or uploaded
• Everything stays on your device. No account, no network access, no data collection

About accuracy
A phone camera is not a professional instrument. Uncalibrated error can reach ±30%, and the device, light source and orientation all affect results. Use this app for everyday reference; it does not replace a professional lux meter or integrating sphere. Calibrating against a reference meter greatly improves accuracy.

name: Cristide
description:
O Cristide é uma ferramenta de registo para utilização no campo, que funciona offline e foi concebida para pequenos produtores de sal marinho tradicional, obtido por evaporação solar. A ferramenta permite gerir inspeções de tanques, operações com salmoura, registos de colheita, agendamentos e estatísticas básicas, tudo diretamente através do dispositivo móvel. Com isto, o utilizador consegue responder, diariamente, a três questões fundamentais: que tanques devo verificar em primeiro lugar? O que aconteceu desde a última intervenção? E qual foi a quantidade colhida desta vez?

A solução destina-se a pequenos produtores que operam um ou mais tanques de sal — incluindo trabalhadores e proprietários que precisam de realizar inspeções no local, acompanhar as colheitas e consultar dados históricos. É ideal tanto para quem se foca no "sal de fundo" (sal marinho grosso) como para quem também recolhe a "flor de sal".

Funcionalidade Offline: Comece a utilizar sem necessitar de uma conta; inspeções, gestão de salmoura, registos de colheita, estatísticas e backups funcionam perfeitamente sem ligação à internet.
Gestão de Tanques: Classifique os tanques por etapas (armazenamento, evaporação ou cristalização) e configure parâmetros como a área de superfície, a frequência de inspeção e as regras específicas para cada um.
Inspeções Rápidas: Registe detalhes como o nível da água, a espessura da camada de sal e a salinidade. O sistema aceita tanto medições precisas como estimativas, permitindo sinalizar anomalias, adicionar observações e anexar fotos.
Operações com Salmoura: Monitorize a entrada, a saída e a transferência de água entre os tanques; receba lembretes para verificar métricas relevantes após cada operação.
Acompanhamento da colheita: Diferencie os tipos de sal (por exemplo, sal de fundo versus flor de sal) e registe as quantidades por peso real, estimativas ou entradas pendentes — garantindo dados precisos, em vez de valores genéricos ou agregados.
Planeamento e Clima: Agende as tarefas com base na previsão meteorológica local; o sistema permanece totalmente funcional mesmo que os dados meteorológicos não sejam carregados ou que não exista uma localização definida.
Histórico e Estatísticas: Aceda e edite registos anteriores; visualize resumos de produção comparando os pesos reais com as estimativas. O sistema também emite alertas caso identifique possíveis registos duplicados.
Backup e Recuperação: Realize backups locais completos ou exporte os seus dados para folhas de cálculo, minimizando o risco de perda de informação caso a aplicação seja desinstalada.

name: Crochet Counter: Knit Rows
description:
Crochet Counter keeps your place so you can keep stitching. It's a row counter for crochet and knitting, a pattern keeper for your PDFs, and a set of free patterns and tools. The core app is free for good, with no ads and no account.

COUNT EVERYTHING
Every project gets its own counters. Stack a row counter, a repeat counter and a stitch counter on one screen. The buttons are big enough to tap with a hook in your hand, and the screen stays on while you work. Close the app mid-row and your count is still there when you come back.

YOUR PATTERNS, ROW BY ROW
Import a PDF or take a photo of a paper pattern. Drag the highlighter onto the row you're on and tap to move it down when you finish. Your files stay on your phone.

14 FREE PATTERNS
We wrote and tested these ourselves. They start with a first granny square and go up to small amigurumi. Each one lists the yarn and hook up front and has a checklist you tick off as you go. None of them are AI-generated.

STITCH DICTIONARY
Look up a stitch and get a clear diagram with short steps. Switch between US and UK terms any time, so a UK treble and a US double crochet stop getting mixed up.

CALCULATORS
Gauge, yardage, increase or decrease evenly across a row, and a hook and needle size chart.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
Unlimited projects. Export a backup file whenever you like and restore it on a new phone.

PRO, IF YOU WANT MORE
Pro adds notes on your PDF and photo patterns, time and stats for each project, colour themes for your counters, and 6 extra patterns of ours: a mug cozy, a market bag, a baby square, a crochet cowl, a knit cowl and wrist warmers. We add more patterns over time. Nothing in the free app gets taken away.

Pro costs $2.99 a month, $14.99 a year with a 7-day free trial, or $34.99 once for lifetime access. The trial is never forced on you.

Pro Monthly and Pro Yearly are auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription. Pro Lifetime is a one-time purchase.

Terms: https://crochet-counter.up.railway.app/terms
Privacy: https://crochet-counter.up.railway.app/privacy
Support: https://crochet-counter.up.railway.app/support

name: Crooked Crew
description:
Welcome to Old Town, where centuries-old architecture leans with historic charm—and urgently needs your engineering fix!

Crooked Crew is a single-player portrait structural restoration puzzle. Connect timber braces, run high-tension steel cables, and balance structural ballast to reinforce crooked facades and historic landmarks. Once you remove the temporary scaffolding, a custom physical simulation engine tests your structure against relentless gravity and sweeping crosswinds.

CORE RESTORATION FEATURES:
- 40 HANDCRAFTED ARCHITECTURAL JOBS: Progress across five distinct Old Town chapters, from delicate corner shops and clock towers to sprawling harbor warehouses, plus 10 bonus challenges.
- AUTHENTIC STRUCTURAL PHYSICS: Timber braces resist compression, tension-only cables slacken under load, and sustained overstresses cause realistic joint failure.
- SLOW-MOTION STRUCTURAL REPLAY: Watch stress propagation at half speed to diagnose exactly which brace failed first and iterate on your design.
- UNRESTRICTED SANDBOX: Build without budget limits! Test experimental high-rise trusses and cantilever designs under calm breezes or directional gale gusts.
- TACTILE CRAFTSMANSHIP: Subtle haptic snaps when joints lock into place and tactile feedback when structures withstand peak load.
- FREE TO START, ONE-TIME UNLOCK: Enjoy all 8 Chapter 1 jobs and both Sandbox layouts for free. Unlock the remaining 32 main jobs and 10 bonus challenges permanently with a single one-time purchase—no subscriptions or consumable currencies.

Pick up your tools, examine the blueprint, and give Old Town the clever fix it deserves!

name: Crosshour: Team Time Zones
description:
See what time it is for everyone you work with, and whether they're working, at a glance.

Drag the timeline to any moment and every row moves together: you, your teammates, your clients and your favourite cities. A red line shows the moment you're looking at, and each person's working hours are marked in blue, so you can see who's free without doing any maths.

MADE FOR DISTRIBUTED TEAMS
• Add people with their own working hours and workdays, or just a city
• See "Working · 2h left", "Probably asleep" or "Off work" for each person
• Clock changes (daylight saving) are flagged before they catch you out
• Jump to any date, then copy everyone's times to paste into a chat

FIND A TIME (PRO)
• Pick people and a length, and get the best slots ranked
• "Works for 3 of 4 · Maya is asleep": see why each slot ranks where it does
• Show a slot on the timeline, or copy it to share

WIDGETS
• Your people on the Home Screen in small and medium, plus Lock Screen
• Pro: the large widget, a widget for a single group, and Shift time, which moves everyone's time an hour at a time right from your Home Screen

GROUPS (PRO)
Filter the board by team or client, like "Acme" or "Design team".

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
Your people and places sync through your own iCloud, so they're on your iPhone and iPad.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. We never see your list: it stays on your devices and in your own iCloud.

PAY ONCE
The free version is fully usable, with unlimited cities and up to 5 people with working hours. Crosshour Pro is a single one-time purchase that unlocks everything, with Family Sharing. No subscription.

name: CrustRatio
description:
CrustRatio is a dedicated baking formulation and fermentation workbench built for sourdough artisans and home breadmakers.

TRUE HYDRATION AND FLOUR BLEND ENGINE
Stop guessing water percentages when working with active starter. CrustRatio automatically accounts for the flour and water inside your liquid or stiff levain to calculate true dough hydration. Combine up to six grain varieties—Bread, High-Protein, All-Purpose, Whole Wheat, Ancient Spelt, and Dark Rye—with live weighted protein indexing and scaling by exact loaf count and target loaf weight.

FERMENTATION CURVE AND LIVE FOLD TIMERS
Model bulk fermentation expansion against dough temperature and inoculation percentage. Drag across the interactive rise graph to inspect your ideal 50% to 75% shaping window, then plan forward from now or backwards from oven time with built-in timers for autolyse, mixing, coil fold sets, bulk rise, and preshaping.

MASTER FORMULAS AND CRUMB LOGBOOK
Start quickly with six calibrated presets—Tartine Country Boule, High-Hydration Ciabatta, Pan Hearth Focaccia, Whole Grain Rye Loaf, Stiff Levain Bagels, and Honey Brioche Boule—or record your own bake results with hydration, bulk timing, and Crumb, Spring, and Crust ratings.

MIXING WATER TEMPERATURE AND BAKER SHEETS
Dial exact mixing water temperature using room, flour, starter, and mixer friction heat in Celsius or Fahrenheit, grams or ounces. Export crisp offline Baker's Sheet PDFs or full JSON backups anytime.

name: Cul-de-Sac Wars
description:
Maple Hollow looks like any quiet suburb. Fifty homes, trimmed lawns, friendly waves. But ever since the Halberd Tonic went bad, every family on the street wants what the neighbours have, and nobody plans to share.

Cul-de-Sac Wars is a turn-based tactics game for one player. Pick your family of four from eighty residents, move into your house and outlast nineteen computer families, ten moves at a time.

PLAN EVERY TURN
Walk, run, crouch behind the fence, keep watch from the porch and pick your moment. Every step and every swing costs moves, and your family shares ten of them a turn.

TAKE THE STREET
Scavenge garden tools, lawn gnomes and supplies from garages and yards. Claim empty houses, chase the parachute supply drops and grab the ice-cream truck crates before anyone else does.

FOUR WAYS TO WIN
Be the last family standing, hold eight houses, keep the Golden Gnome for ten rounds, or reach 200,000 points first.

MISSIONS AND RIVALRIES
Every family gets its own jobs: break into a neighbour's garage, haul a hundred sticks, patch up a family member, settle a feud. Each one pays points and gear.

A FAMILY THAT GROWS
Earn upgrades as you score, choose who gets stronger, and welcome a baby who grows up over the match. The kids scout, fetch and carry; the fighting is for the grown-ups.

A STREET THAT LIVES
Day turns to night, autumn turns to winter, and the computer families each play their own way: aggressive, defensive, scavenging or balanced. Watch out when one of them hits ten knockouts: their eyes glow red and the frenzy kicks in.

FREE TO PLAY, ONE UNLOCK
Play every single-player match free up to round 20. One purchase unlocks the full game: matches to the end, all 150 rounds and every way to win. No ads, no subscription, no data collected. Your match saves itself every turn.

Made by an independent developer and published by Starr Studios.

name: Curso de Tarot – Mestre Cruz
description:
O Curso de Tarot do Mestre Cruz ensina-te a ler Tarot do zero ao nível profissional, ao teu ritmo e no teu iPhone.

O QUE APRENDES
• As 78 cartas, uma a uma: os 22 Arcanos Maiores e os 56 Arcanos Menores
• Significados, símbolos e combinações entre cartas
• Tiragens e como interpretar uma leitura completa
• Ética e postura numa consulta

COMO FUNCIONA
• 4 níveis, com lições curtas e claras, pela ordem do método
• Testes no fim de cada nível para confirmares o que aprendeste
• Treino diário com a carta do dia
• Progresso guardado na tua conta
• Diploma no fim do curso, com código de verificação

MÉTODO MESTRE CRUZ
O curso segue o método próprio do Mestre Cruz, tarólogo português com muitos anos de consultas, explicado de forma simples e prática.

ACESSO
Cria a tua conta, conhece o curso, lê os artigos e experimenta a carta do dia. O acesso completo ao curso desbloqueia-se com uma compra única dentro da app, sem subscrições. Podes restaurar a compra em qualquer iPhone com a mesma conta Apple.

O Tarot é apresentado como ferramenta de autoconhecimento e orientação espiritual. Não substitui aconselhamento médico, psicológico, jurídico ou financeiro. Para maiores de 18 anos.

name: Curvo
description:
Curvo times your runs from the phone's GPS and motion sensors. Mount the phone, tap Start and drive: every pass between the start and finish lines is timed on its own, both ways on a hill climb road and lap by lap on a circuit.

RUNS AND LAPS
• Run and lap times with your personal best and a live delta to it while you drive
• Sectors: each segment against your best one, and your theoretical best
• Hill climb roads timed in both directions from one recording, laps on circuits
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island

TELEMETRY
• Speed, longitudinal and lateral g, and altitude charts; drag along a chart to scrub the replay
• The run on the map, coloured by braking and acceleration
• Compare two runs side by side with a ghost that shows who is ahead

TRACKS
• Ready-made hill climb roads and circuits, or draw your own on the map in a few taps
• Distance to every track, and a hint when you are at a track's start

GARAGE AND SERVICE
• Pick your car from the catalogue or add your own: power, mass, tyres front and rear, paint and finish
• Every run keeps the car it was driven with
• Service log with costs, stats and a PDF report

SHARE AND IMPORT
• Share a run as an image card, a replay GIF, GPX, CSV or the full session
• Import RaceChrono (CSV and .rcz), Sensor Logger and GPX files
• External GPS (RaceBox) and OBD2 adapters over Bluetooth

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account, no ads, no tracking. Runs, cars and settings stay on your phone; back up to a folder you choose.

DRIVE SAFE
A public road is not a race track. Time your runs at organised events, on closed roads and on circuits. Everywhere else keep to the speed limit and the rules of the road.

Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life.

name: CW Compass
description:
CW Compass is the mobile app for teams that already run support and delivery in CW Compass. Sign in with your work account to see what is assigned to you and keep it moving when you are away from your desk.

You need a CW Compass account created by your organization's administrator. The app does not offer sign-up.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

Home
- See counts of your tickets, tasks, bugs and leads on one screen.
- See the items assigned to you and recent activity.

Tickets
- Browse and search tickets, and filter by status.
- Open a ticket to see its status, priority, assignees, customer and notes.
- Create a ticket or edit an existing one.

Tasks
- Browse and search tasks, and filter by status.
- Open a task to see its status, priority and assignees.
- Create a task or edit an existing one.

Bugs
- Browse and search bugs, and filter by status.
- Open a bug to see its status, priority and assignees.
- Log a new bug or edit an existing one.

Leads
- Browse and search leads, and filter by status.
- See company, contact details, source, status, estimated value, probability and expected close date.
- Create a lead or edit an existing one.

Reports
- Summary counts, status and priority breakdowns and trend charts for tickets, tasks, bugs and leads.

YOUR DATA STAYS IN COMPASS
The app shows the same records as the CW Compass web app and only what your role allows you to see. Sign-in tokens are kept in the device's secure storage.

Questions or problems? Visit https://cwsuite.com/contact.

name: CX Inbox
description:
CX Inbox es la app para que tu equipo de atención responda a los clientes desde el teléfono. Necesitas una cuenta de empresa de CX Inbox: la crea el administrador de tu organización y te llega por invitación.

CANALES EN UNA SOLA BANDEJA
• WhatsApp (API oficial de WhatsApp Business)
• Messenger
• Instagram
• Comentarios de Facebook e Instagram
• X
• Chat web en el sitio de tu empresa
• Correo
• Reseñas de Google Play y App Store

Cada conversación muestra el canal de origen, el cliente, el estado y quién la atiende.

LO QUE PUEDES HACER
• Ver y buscar conversaciones, filtrarlas por estado, canal o asignación.
• Responder con texto, fotos, videos, documentos y audios. El formato de cada canal se respeta: por ejemplo, la negrita y la cursiva de WhatsApp.
• Escribir notas internas que el cliente no ve.
• Usar respuestas rápidas, plantillas aprobadas y encuestas.
• Asignar la conversación a una persona o a un equipo, cerrarla o reabrirla.
• Abrir la ficha del cliente con su historial y sus datos de contacto.
• Revisar las conversaciones que atendió el bot y tomar el control cuando haga falta.
• Cambiar tu disponibilidad (en línea, ausente) para el reparto de conversaciones.

NOTIFICACIONES
Recibe un aviso cuando llega un mensaje nuevo o te asignan una conversación. Los avisos son genéricos: no incluyen el texto del cliente. Al tocarlos se abre la conversación. La pestaña Actividad guarda el historial de avisos.

SEGURIDAD
• La sesión se guarda en el llavero de iOS, solo en este dispositivo.
• Puedes proteger el acceso con Face ID, Touch ID o el código del dispositivo.
• Al pasar a segundo plano, la app oculta las conversaciones en el selector de apps.
• Los permisos de cada persona los define el administrador de la organización; el servidor los valida en cada acción.

Funciona en iPhone y en iPad, en modo claro y oscuro, con Texto Dinámico y VoiceOver.

Términos de servicio: https://cxinbox.ai/terms
Aviso de privacidad: https://cxinbox.ai/privacy

name: D2 Loot Alert
description:
D2 Loot Alert tells you when the loot you want is easy to get.

Pick the weapons you're after, and get a notification on the day one of them is an activity's bonus focus drop, with where to farm it. Pick raids and dungeons, and get a notification in the week they're featured. Pick exotic armor, and get a notification when Xûr is selling it.

TODAY
Every activity's bonus focus weapon, grouped like the game's Portal, plus this week's featured raids and dungeons and what Xûr is selling. Anything you watch that's available right now is pulled to the top, under READY TO FARM.

LOOT
Browse every weapon by activity category, and every exotic armor piece by class. Tap the bell on anything you want.

RAIDS & DUNGEONS
All raids and dungeons, with this week's featured ones first.

NOTIFICATIONS
Alerts arrive shortly after the daily reset, the weekly reset and Xûr's arrival. Each one says where to go.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
No sign-in, no ads, no tracking. Your watch list stays on your phone.

D2 Loot Alert is an unofficial fan app, not affiliated with or endorsed by Bungie. Destiny is a trademark of Bungie, Inc. Game images and data come from the Bungie.net API.

name: Dahab Spots & Chill
description:
Welcome to Dahab Spots & Chill, your ultimate digital pocket guide to the magic of South Sinai. Whether you are a digital nomad looking for the best coworking space, a diver heading to the Blue Hole, or just craving the best local seafood and Kushari, we have you covered.

Internet connections in Sinai can be unpredictable, which is why this app is built to work 100% offline. Every spot, location detail, and photo is packed right into your phone so you can explore Dahab freely without worrying about Wi-Fi or mobile data.

Key Features:

 170+ Local Spots: Discover cafes, restaurants, beaches, dive centers, and hidden local gems (like Blue Lagoon and Wadi Gnai).

 Fully Offline: All data and authentic local images are pre-loaded. No internet? No problem.

 Essentials & Emergencies: Instantly find ATMs, supermarkets, pharmacies, hospitals, and dental clinics when you need them fast.

 Categorized Navigation: Clean, organized categories make it easy to find exactly what you are looking for—from fast food to chill bedouin cafes.

name: Daily Bible Verse Feed: Sown
description:
Swap the doomscroll for Scripture. Sown is the Bible as a feed: one verse at a time, full screen, over a painted scene. Swipe up for the next. Tap any verse, and a short card tells you what it means in plain words.

No account and no ads. Open the app, and you're already reading.

HOW IT WORKS
• Swipe: For You serves verses that make sense on their own and learns from what you like and save.
• Tap: a ten-second card explains the verse, says who is speaking and when, and suggests related verses.
• Keep: like, save and share any verse as a beautiful image.
• Mark: hold a word and drag to highlight, in one of four colors from the paintings, and write your own notes. Free, and your notes stay on your iPhone.

A DAILY LAMP TO KEEP YOU READING
"Your word is a lamp to my feet." Read five verses a day and Sown's lamp lights. Watch your week fill with lit lamps. Miss one day and your run keeps going; Sown never makes you feel bad about a gap. A gentle reminder can bring you back at the time you choose.

A DAILY BIBLE VERSE ON YOUR HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN
Add the free Sown widget to your Home Screen in three sizes, or to your Lock Screen and StandBy, and a daily Bible verse waits for you over one of Sown's paintings. With Premium, it follows your own feed and shows another verse with one tap.

LEARN VERSES BY HEART
Learn your first verse free. Short practice brings it back on the right days, with a reminder and a card on your widget when a verse is due.

READ STRAIGHT THROUGH
Read any book of the Bible verse by verse, with the chapter and your place in it always in view, and pick up where you stopped. Or search the way you type: "rom 8 28", "psalm 23", "love one another".

THE BIBLE, EXPLAINED SIMPLY
Every explanation is written ahead of time and checked, so it opens instantly. Where Christians read a verse differently, the card says so. Ask about any verse and get an answer that cites the passages it draws on (3 free questions a week). Answers are AI-generated, so read the passages they cite. Sown asks before your words are sent to OpenAI.

YOUR BIBLE, YOUR LANGUAGE
Read in modern English (World English Bible) or the King James Version (KJV) where available, or in Tagalog, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German, Swahili, Hindi, Tamil and more: 26 translations in all. English explanations work offline; other languages download once.

VERSES FOR WHAT YOU'RE GOING THROUGH
Anxious about money? Can't sleep? Grieving? With Premium, choose from 40 topics or type your own, and get an endless feed of verses for exactly that. Premium also puts your own feed on your widget, lets you learn as many verses by heart as you like and gives you more questions.

ON IPHONE DUO
Folded, Sown reads like any iPhone. Open, the verse stays at a comfortable width over a wider painting.

FREE, AND STAYS FREE
The whole Bible, every explanation, Read, saved and liked verses, highlights and notes, sharing, the daily lamp and the widget's daily verse are free.

Premium is optional: monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan if you're eligible. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage it in your App Store account settings.

Open Sown and read your first verse in seconds.

Privacy Policy: https://sown.janusworks.dev/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Darkmatter: Manual RAW Camera
description:
Darkmatter puts every camera setting in your hands.

MANUAL CONTROL
• ISO and shutter speed on smooth scrolling dials, with a tick at every stop
• White balance by Kelvin and tint, plus quick presets
• Manual focus from macro to infinity, or tap to focus
• A live histogram and light meter so you nail exposure

SHOOT RAW
• RAW (DNG), RAW + HEIF, and Apple ProRAW on supported iPhones
• HEIF and JPEG at the highest resolution your camera offers

LIGHT TRAILS
• Turn traffic and city lights into ribbons of light with 5 to 30 second long exposures
• Watch the image build live, then save it to Photos

VIDEO
• 4K or 1080p at 24, 25, 30 or 60 fps
• Full manual control, with the 180° shutter rule built in

MADE FOR PHOTOGRAPHERS
• Switch between your iPhone's lenses and pinch to zoom
• Self-timer, rule-of-thirds grid and one-tap reset to Auto

No account, no ads, no tracking. Darkmatter collects no data.

name: Date Cheat Sheet: Questions
description:
Talking to someone you like? Keep Date Cheat Sheet open on your phone, glance at the next question, and the conversation never goes quiet.

490 QUESTIONS FOR EVERY STAGE
• Get to know each other — First meeting, Casual and Lifestyle (150 questions)
• Psychology picks — Open up, Real feelings, Love style and Make it spark (140 questions). Each one comes with a short tip: what the question really reveals and how to use the answer.
• Love talk — Soft, Hot, Hard and Extreme (200 questions). Hot and above are for adults 18+ and can be switched off in Settings.

MADE FOR A SNEAKY GLANCE
• One big question at a time — swipe for the next one
• Tap “Asked” once you’ve asked it so it won’t come back
• Glance mode dims the screen and shrinks the question
• The screen stays on while you play

LINES & REACTIONS
140 things to say when you’re lost for words: reactions, ways to dig deeper, empathy, compliments on their style and on who they are, heart-skippers and lines that set up the next date. Their name is filled in for you. Tap any line to copy it into a chat or dating app.

REMEMBER WHAT THEY SAID
Jot down their answer under any question. Notes are kept for each person, so on the next date you can say “You mentioned…”. Export your notes as text any time.

MY DECKS
Pick your favorite questions from all 490, add your own, put them in order and take your custom deck on a date.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Lock the app with Face ID
• No account, no ads, no tracking — everything stays on your iPhone
• Works offline
• English, Japanese and Korean

Free, with every deck included.

Please use the questions with respect: read the mood, only ask what feels right for both of you, and accept a “pass”.

Terms of Use: https://datecheatsheet-legal.pages.dev/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://datecheatsheet-legal.pages.dev/privacy/

name: Dawnpane
description:
Dawnpane is a spatial puzzle game where one arrangement of double-sided cards has to make two pictures. In a quiet conservatory, an unopened letter waits on the desk. Open it and begin bringing the windows back to light, one Morning and Evening view at a time.

Each card has a different pattern on either face. Slide, rotate, flip, and reorder the cards as each puzzle allows, then walk around the frame to see what changed on the other side. The nearest card covers what lies behind it, and even a blank corner can hide a mark that would spoil the picture. A window is restored when both views match their targets at the same time.

• Restore 72 handcrafted windows across six chapters. Start with a simple change in layer order, then turn patterns through narrow openings, work around pinned cards, and leave enough space to slide a card through a crowded frame. As the rooms light up, uncover Mira's letters and memories in the room journals.
• Explore 18 more windows on six field trips, each with its own closing letter. The daily invitation picks a window from the field trips. For a different challenge, try an Echo Study and arrange the cards after putting the targets away, or use a handful of observations to deduce a hidden layout in Keyhole Studies.
• Play at your own pace. A short, hands-on paper lesson shows how a patch of blank card can change both views. Undo a move or ask for a hint when you need one. There's no countdown, and unfinished arrangements are saved so you can pick up where you left off.
• Revisit your restored windows in Collection. Compare Morning and Evening, replay recorded moves, and keep your discoveries in the Field Notebook. Bring restored windows and Studio pieces together in a personal exhibition, choose the light for each piece, and write your own wall labels.
• Design a double-sided window in Studio. Choose two to five cards, edit the suit patterns printed on both faces, shape the window openings, and arrange the cards. Share the finished artwork or export a playable blueprint so a friend can try to recreate both of your pictures.

name: Daylight Alarm
description:
Wake up the way you would at sunrise: slowly, with light.

Daylight Alarm turns your iPhone flashlight into a gentle wake-up light. Before your alarm time, the light grows brighter minute by minute. Your body gets the signal to wake up before an alarm ever has to ring.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Set your wake-up time and choose how long the sunrise lasts, from 10 to 60 minutes.
2. In the evening, tap "Sleep now" or simply leave the app open. The screen goes dark.
3. Put your phone on the charger, standing up, with the flashlight uncovered.
4. In the morning, the light rises like a sunrise. If you like, the normal iPhone alarm also rings at your wake-up time.

WHAT YOU GET
• A wake-up light that gets brighter slowly, with no extra device to buy
• Light only, or light plus the iPhone alarm: it rings at alarm volume, even when the phone is locked or on silent
• Repeat on weekdays, weekends or every day, or set a one-time alarm for a specific date
• Try the whole sunrise in 10 seconds before you rely on it
• A dark night screen with warm, red-orange text that won't keep you awake
• Widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen show your next alarm
• A short tour the first time you open the app
• English, German and Spanish

GOOD TO KNOW
• The light needs the app to stay open overnight. iOS only lets an app use the flashlight while it is on screen, so keep your phone on the charger.
• If the app is closed or the phone is locked, there is no light. If the iPhone alarm is on, it still rings once you allow alarms for the app.
• If your phone gets warm, the light is dimmed a little so it keeps running.

PRIVACY
No data is collected. No account, no ads, no tracking. Your alarms stay on your device.

name: DC Authenticator
description:
DC Authenticator generates one-time verification codes and lets you approve sign-ins to compatible Digital Centar services.

• Add accounts by scanning a QR code or entering a setup key.
• Generate verification codes even when offline.
• Approve sign-ins with Face ID or Touch ID.

name: Deep Dive Dispatch
description:
It is a single-player casual game that combines underwater exploration, route planning, and operational challenges. You will navigate a submarine through underwater caves, collect lost treasures, avoid rock walls and mines, navigate ocean currents, and reach the exit before running out of oxygen or the countdown timer ends.

Click on the water area to set the destination, drag to adjust the course. Observe the terrain, arrange the collection sequence, and make a choice between exploration and safety. Route hints, sonar, and time replenishment tools can be used directly to help you complete the task.

name: Deepcore: Drill Rush
description:
Deep under the surface, a glowing planet core is waiting. Grab your drill and dig your way down!

Deepcore: Drill Rush is a fast, one-thumb digging game. Your drill bores down on its own: swipe left and right to pick your path through dirt, crystal caves, magma and ice. Grab fuel before your tank runs dry and reach the core.

◆ DIG, DODGE, SURVIVE
Boulders drop when you dig under them. TNT crates chain-explode. Lava melts your hull, and cave worms lurk in the dark. Every column is a choice.

◆ 60 LEVELS, 5 WORLDS
Rustroot Meadows, Crystal Caverns, Magma Depths, Frostbite Vault and the Void Heart. Each world ends with a Core Guardian boss.

◆ 3 STARS EVERY LEVEL
Reach the core, keep your hull intact and hunt down three hidden relic chests.

◆ UPGRADE YOUR RIG
Boost drill power, fuel tank, hull armor, thrusters and refinery. Unlock four drills: Rookie, Viper, Titan and Nova.

◆ BOOSTERS
Dynamite, shields and Overdrive for those tight spots.

Daily rewards, no internet needed. Ready to dig deep?

name: Defter Savaşı
description:
Okulda defterin arkasında oynadığın o oyun şimdi telefonunda!

Kâğıt ikiye katlanır: alt yarı senin, üst yarı rakibinin. Çöp adamlarını kendi yarına çiz, sonra sırayla rakibin kâğıdına bomba at. Rakibin adamlarını göremezsin; tahmin et, nişan al, bırak. Bütün adamlarını ilk patlatan kazanır!

• Robota karşı oyna — her seviyede robot biraz daha akıllanır
• Online oyna — rastgele bir rakip bul ya da 4 harfli kodla arkadaşını çağır
• Röntgen ve Dev Bomba gibi güçler
• Büyük patlama, keskin nişan, ekstra çöp adam yükseltmeleri
• Matematik, Coğrafya ve Fen defterleri
• Şapkalar, kalem renkleri ve bomba kostümleri
• Hesabını Apple ile bağla, telefon değişse de ilerlemen kaybolmasın

Reklam yok, gerçek parayla satış yok. Altını oynayarak kazanırsın.

name: Deness
description:
Deness helps authorized team members manage customer leads from their phone. Sign in with your existing Deness account to see the records and tools available to your role.

• Find leads and review customer details and activity.
• Update statuses and add feedback while working with customers.
• Receive lead alerts and open the relevant record directly.
• Assign or transfer leads and use team reports when your role allows it.
• Manage your profile and notification preferences.

An authorized Deness account and mobile access are required. An internet connection is required to save changes. This app is for the Deness team. It does not offer public account registration or equipment shopping.

For support, contact support@civsav.com.

name: Dera Jote
description:
Dera Jote is the simple way to find a home in Kosovo – to buy or to rent, from Prishtina to Prizren, Peja and every other municipality.

Every property comes from a registered estate agency or developer, shows its asking price in euro, and tells you whether it has ownership documents. No duplicates from anonymous classifieds and no "call for price" guessing games.

SEARCH YOUR WAY
• For sale or to rent, in any of Kosovo's 38 municipalities
• Filter by property type, bedrooms and price
• Sort by newest, price or size
• See properties on a map

EVERYTHING ABOUT A PROPERTY
• Large photos, full description and key facts: size, floor, year built, heating, furnishing
• Clear price in euro, and whether the price was reduced
• Whether ownership documents are in place

TALK STRAIGHT TO THE AGENCY
• Call or message on WhatsApp with one tap
• Or send an enquiry – it goes only to the agency that listed the property, and you get a copy by email

NEVER MISS A NEW HOME
• Save the properties you like
• Save a search and choose how often you hear about new matches: instantly, daily or weekly
• Get a notification on your phone when something new appears

IN ALBANIAN AND ENGLISH
Switch language at any time – ideal for families at home and in the diaspora.

Your account is the same as on derajote.com, so your saved properties and searches follow you between the app and the website. You can delete your account at any time from inside the app.

name: Dessoci
description:
Dessoci, Dessoci dijital ajansının müşterileri ve ekibi için hazırlanmış iş uygulamasıdır. Hesaplar Dessoci tarafından açılır; uygulamayı keşfetmek isteyenler giriş yapmadan tanıtım ekranından ajansa canlı yazabilir.

MÜŞTERİLER İÇİN
• Projeleriniz: web sitesi, SEO, sosyal medya ve reklam işlerinizin durumu ve ilerlemesi
• Aylık raporlar: ziyaret, sıralama ve etkileşim sonuçlarınız sade grafiklerle

name: DevanagariKeyPad
description:
DevanagariKeyPad is a Nepali keyboard for iPhone, built for people who want to type in Nepali without learning a keyboard layout first.
Easier than a traditional Nepali keyboard
Traditional Nepali keyboards make you work for every word. You have to memorise where each letter hides, remember which shift key gives you which vowel sign, or type in Roman letters and hope the transliteration guesses what you meant.
DevanagariKeyPad does it the easy way: you see the letter, you tap it.
Tap a consonant — क, ख, ग — and its vowel forms appear as suggestions above the keyboard. Pick ता, ति, ती, तु or ते, and keep going. That's it. No layout to memorise, no Roman typing, no guessing. Typing नमस्ते is a few taps, not a puzzle.
What you get
• The full Devanagari alphabet — consonants, vowels and conjuncts like क्ष, त्र and ज्ञ
• Smart vowel suggestions that appear as soon as you tap a consonant
• Nepali digits (०–९), punctuation and symbols, one tap away on the 123 key
• A clean, readable keyboard
Use it anywhere
Once it's set up, DevanagariKeyPad works in any app — Messages, WhatsApp, Notes, email, social media, anywhere you can type. Switch to it with the globe key, type in Nepali, and switch back the same way.
Set up in a minute
Open the app and tap Open Settings
Go to Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Add New Keyboard
Choose DevanagariKeyPad
Switch keyboards with the globe key
No Full Access needed — and no account or login. Your keystrokes stay on your device.
