name: Digi Feng Shui: Lunar Calendar
description:
Plan your days by the lunar calendar, the way East Asian families have for generations, now in plain English. See today's auspicious hours, find good days for a wedding or a move, and explore your Zi Wei birth chart, feng shui directions and the I Ching.

Everything runs on your iPhone: fast, offline and with no account.

YOUR DAY, THE LUNAR WAY
• Today's lunar date, solar term and Lunar Mansion
• Yellow Path and Black Path days, with a day score and why
• Auspicious hours for the day
• What the almanac suggests for today, and what to leave for later
• A Daily Horoscope from your birth date
• An optional morning note with the day's lunar date

AUSPICIOUS DAYS FOR BIG PLANS
Pick one of 14 plans, from a wedding or a move to opening a business or a trip, and see which days this month the almanac favors for your birth year, with every factor explained.

ZI WEI BIRTH CHART
Zi Wei Dou Shu (Purple Star Astrology) is a classic East Asian birth chart. Enter your birth date and hour to see all 12 palaces, the major stars and their brightness, with an English guide to each. Save charts for the family.

YEAR-AHEAD FORECAST
Your ruling star and yearly hurdle, how your sign meets Tai Sui, and a month-by-month view.

ZODIAC MATCH AND LOVE
• Zodiac match by birth-year sign, element and Kua number
• Good wedding years for a couple
• Love match, a love quiz and numerology, just for fun

FENG SHUI FOR YOUR HOME
Find your Kua number and your best and most challenging directions in Eight Mansions feng shui, with ideas for your door, bed and desk, and a compass that turns with your phone. Best Year to Build explains the checks families make before building a home.

I CHING, FORTUNE STICKS, CARDS AND PALMS
Cast an I Ching hexagram (all 64, each with its key idea), draw one of 300 temple fortune sticks from Guanyin, Lord Guan and the Le Van Duyet Temple, or try a card or palm reading. Moments for reflection, not predictions.

REMINDERS AND GUIDES
• Full moons, new moons and family memorial days, set by the lunar calendar and repeating every year
• 42 original guides to feng shui, the Five Elements, the 60-year cycle and lunar festivals

A VIETNAMESE TAKE
The app follows the Vietnamese lunar calendar and zodiac, where the Cat takes the Rabbit's place and the Buffalo the Ox's, with each custom explained for newcomers.

DIGI FENG SHUI PLUS
Much of the app is free: the calendar, day score, auspicious hours, your Zi Wei chart with the Life Palace reading, house directions, reminders, guides, and one I Ching cast, fortune stick and card reading a day. Plus adds:
• Readings for all 12 palaces of your birth chart
• Auspicious days for each of the 14 kinds of plans
• The full Daily Horoscope and the month-by-month Year-Ahead Forecast
• Good wedding years for a couple
• Unlimited I Ching casts, fortune sticks and card readings
• Unlimited family profiles, saved charts and memorial reminders

Plus is $2.99 a month or $19.99 a year in the US; your local price is shown in the app before you buy. The yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or when the trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; renewal is charged within the 24 hours before it ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings. On a new device, use Restore Purchases.

A NOTE ON THE READINGS
Readings come from traditional East Asian, especially Vietnamese, practice and are offered for cultural interest, reflection and entertainment. They are not predictions, promise no outcome, and are not medical, legal, financial or psychological advice.

PRIVACY
Your birth details stay on your phone and are used only after you agree. No ads, no tracking, no sign-up. For ages 13 and up.

name: DIGID: Senior Digital Aid
description:
DIGID is a digital survival tool for older adults: one app with big buttons and big words that helps you read, stay safe from scams, and reach your family.

STAY SAFE
- Is This a Scam? Paste a text or email, or use a screenshot or a photo of a letter. DIGID points out the warning signs in plain words, like gift card payments, fake bank alerts, and "grandparent" calls, and tells you what to do.
- What Is This? Confused by a pop-up, a bill, or a letter? DIGID explains what it is and what to tap, then reads it to you.

READ AND SEE
- Read to Me: paste text, scan a page, open a PDF or a web page, and DIGID reads it aloud with each word highlighted.
- Read My Screen: one tap, then use your e-book app or any other app, and DIGID reads each new page out loud.
- Magnifier: make small print big, with a light, a freeze button, and high-contrast colors.

TALK AND CONNECT
- Talk to write texts and emails. Hear them read back before you send.
- Translate other languages and hear them spoken.

HELP AND MY FAMILY (ALWAYS FREE)
- Call, FaceTime, or text family with one big button.
- I Need Help texts your family a map of where you are.
- Where Am I? reads your location out loud.

LEARN YOUR PHONE
- Simple step-by-step guides to turn on your iPhone's own reading tools, bigger text, and more.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
DIGID has no account and no ads. Your messages, pictures, and family list stay on your phone.

PRICE
Free for 7 days. Then unlock everything once for $7.99. No subscription, and you are never charged automatically. Help & My Family stays free forever.

name: Dishorb: Best Dish Near You
description:
Dishorb. The best dish, not just the restaurant.

A restaurant can be great and still have a dish you should skip. Dishorb ranks the plates themselves: the people who ate a dish give it 1 to 5 orbs, so you know what to order before you sit down.

MORE THAN 600 MENUS IN SOUTH FLORIDA
Miami, Fort Lauderdale and Palm Beach, with more than 70,000 dishes. Open a restaurant to see its whole menu by section, its best dishes, everyone's orbs and your friends', and Website, Call and Directions.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Rank a dish: 1 to 5 orbs, a photo and a few words
• Verified visits: a photo taken in the app at the restaurant marks your ranking as verified
• Explore a map of restaurants, each tagged with its best dish's score
• Search for a dish (ceviche, ramen, a burger) and see the best ones near you
• Keep two lists: the dishes you had, best first, and the ones you want to try
• Follow friends, see what they ranked, like and comment, and share a dish
• Climb your city's board of dish critics, ranked by verified dishes
• Calories and protein on a dish when known, with macros and ingredients on its page (marked "about" when estimated)
• Save your allergies and diet choices on your profile, kept private
• Send a private note to the kitchen: only the restaurant reads it, and they don't see who sent it

ASK THE MENU
Every menu has a talking menu. Type a question or ask out loud ("What's vegetarian?", "What's the spiciest dish?") and an AI waiter answers from that restaurant's menu, lighting up the dishes it names. It is an AI, not the restaurant's staff, and it can be wrong: always check allergens with the restaurant.

ADD A MENU
A place is missing? Photograph its menu or paste its website or a menu PDF, and Dishorb reads every dish (read by AI) so everyone can rank them.

FOR RESTAURANT TEAMS
Staff of a restaurant on Dishorb get the restaurant side of the same app: every ranking of their dishes and every private note in one inbox, their menu and their scores.

GOOD TO KNOW
Dishorb is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases. Nothing goes to an AI service until you agree in the app. Light and dark looks, in English, Spanish, French, Hebrew and Portuguese. You can download your data or delete your account in Settings.

name: DMAX: Film Negative Scanner
description:
Sharper images. Less noise. Grain that looks like grain. DMAX is a film negative scanner for iPhone built around one thing: fidelity to the film.

Most phone scanning apps hand your negative to the iPhone's photo pipeline, which smooths the grain, sharpens the edges and guesses a new exposure for every frame. DMAX reads the sensor directly in RAW, with every setting locked, so what you get is the negative, not a phone's opinion of it.

QUALITY

• Sharper. Focus is measured on the grain itself for every frame and corrected when the film curls, so edges are crisp across the whole frame, not just the center.
• Less noise. Each frame is captured several times and averaged, which cuts sensor noise in the dense shadows where phone scans fall apart. Grain stays; noise goes.
• True fidelity. Bayer RAW straight from the sensor, with focus, exposure and white balance locked for the roll. No smoothing, no sharpening, no HDR, no drift.
• Calibrated light. A quick flat-field capture measures your light panel and lens, and their falloff is divided out of every frame. Uneven light never shows up as uneven density.
• Maximum quality for your keepers: more focus positions and more averaged shots per frame.

EASE

• Set up in two taps. Calibrate over the bare light, then focus on the first frame, which DMAX keeps and measures: pixels across, ppi, and how much lower the camera can go for more detail. Quick Setup recommends settings for your film and lens.
• Frames found and straightened on their own, with rotation and keystone corrected. One editor for the rest: crop, rotate, flip, Auto Tone, brightness and contrast.
• Save to Photos as JPEG or HEIC, in albums that stay in sync as you scan.
• Rolls organized by film stock, name and date. Star your keepers.

SPEED

• Advance the strip, tap the shutter, repeat. Every frame is saved at full quality as you go, and you can review the batch mid-roll.
• Pro: a hands-free shutter on your Apple Watch, AirPods, Camera Control, the volume buttons or a Bluetooth remote. Your hands stay on the film and the rig never gets bumped.
• Pro: queue several rolls and scan them in one sitting.

FREE TO SCAN. PRO IF YOU WANT IT.

DMAX is free to download, and every free scan is a full-resolution scan, with no limit on how many. DMAX Pro is a one-time in-app purchase, shared with your family through Family Sharing. It adds:
• The hands-free shutter.
• Several rolls in one sitting.
• 16-bit TIFF export for your editor.
• Developer and camera details for every roll.

NO ADS. NO SUBSCRIPTION. NO UPLOAD.

No account, no servers, no analytics. Your scans are processed on your iPhone and never leave it.

WHAT YOU NEED

• A film holder that keeps negatives flat (DMAX is designed around the Lomography DigitaLIZA) and a diffused LED light panel larger than the frame. CRI 95 or higher gives the truest tones.
• A copy stand or arm that holds your iPhone level over the film.
• For the most resolution, a clip-on close-up lens over the main camera. No lens? On iPhone Pro models DMAX uses the Ultra Wide camera's macro focus instead, and it shows the resolution you'll get before you scan.
• Black-and-white negatives today. Color negative support is next.

name: DobaDoba Ball: Multiply & Drop

Multiply the balls with just one finger!

Hold the screen and balls pour out. Send them through the “×2” and “×3” gates to multiply them, and watch them flood into the bucket.

HOW TO PLAY

FEATURES

Perfect for a quick break. Clear your head and let the balls pour.

This app shows ads so that it can stay free. In some places you can watch a video ad to get extra balls (always optional).

name: DominoChimeTrail
description:
Plink, plonk, plink-plink. A tiny tune plays and then waits for you to copy it.

In Domino Chime Trail every domino is a bell. You drag tiles from a tray onto a winding trail, give the first one a nudge, and the falling chain plays your notes back one by one, each tile lighting up and sending a little note floating upward. If it matches the tune you heard, the whole music room joins in.

Two things decide whether it does.

Pitch. Every tile has its own note and its own number. The low ones are long bars and the high ones are short, so you can tell them apart at a glance.

Spacing. Gaps on the trail are rhythm. Tiles one dot apart ring quickly after each other, and a bigger gap holds the note longer. A tile can only reach a few dots ahead, though, so stretch a gap too far and the chain just stops. The melody card shows your row under the target, so you can see how close you are before you tip.

There are 48 levels in six chapters: First Chimes, Pentatonic Path, Hidden Bells, Full Scale, Long Trails and Maestro Hall. They start with three friendly bells and end with full eight-note scales. Along the way come pinned tiles that hold part of the tune for you, hidden notes you need to find by ear, and spare tiles that do not belong anywhere. Every level can be solved, and getting it right on the first tip earns all three stars. You pick levels by playing them on a strip of piano keys.

The Daily Tune is a new melody each day, the same for everyone, with its own board. Compose is the opposite of a test: every tile, no rules, knock it over as often as you like.

Glockenspiel and kalimba sounds, haptics that tap in time with the falling tiles, and a player name made up for you. No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, and it works offline.

Tip the first one and listen.

name: Doorstep Proof: Serve Tracker
description:
Doorstep Proof is the field log for process servers. Record every serve attempt at the door — time, live GPS, photos and what you saw — and turn it into a Proof of Service backed by records that can't be quietly changed.

WHY IT MATTERS
When a defendant claims they were never served, your notes are on trial. Doorstep Proof seals each attempt the moment you save it, so you can show exactly when and where you knocked — and that nothing was added later.

AT THE DOOR
• One tap starts the attempt; the time is captured immediately
• Live GPS with accuracy shown, refining until you save
• Evidence photos of the door, house number, mailbox or posted papers
• Results: personal, substitute, corporate/agent, posted, no answer, refused, avoiding, bad address, vacant
• Description of the person served and field notes
• Works offline in hallways, basements and rural roads

SEALED AND CHAINED
• Every attempt gets a SHA-256 fingerprint covering time, GPS, result, notes and every photo
• Each attempt is chained to the one before it, so attempts can't be removed or reordered
• Saved records are locked. Corrections are added as dated amendments — the original stays intact
• Built-in integrity check shows whether a record still matches its seal

RECEIPTS ANYONE CAN VERIFY (PRO)
• Each fingerprint is registered with doorstepproof.xyz and stamped by our server clock
• You get a receipt code (like DP-7KQ2-M9XA-4TRF) and a QR code for every attempt
• Clerks, judges and attorneys can scan the QR code or enter the code at doorstepproof.xyz/verify to see when the record was registered
• Export an evidence file; dropping it on the verify page re-checks every record and photo in the browser
• Only the fingerprint is sent — never names, addresses or photos

COURT-READY PDFs
• Proof of Service, or Declaration of Due Diligence when service wasn't completed
• Case caption, attempt log with GPS, your signature and a notary block
• Exhibit A: verification receipts with QR codes
• Exhibit B: photographs with their fingerprints

ORGANIZED JOBS
• Case number, court, parties, documents, client and due date
• Open / closed views, search, overdue highlights
• Directions to the address in one tap
• Syncs privately through your own iCloud

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your cases, addresses and photos stay on your iPhone and in your own iCloud account. No account, no ads, no tracking.

FREE AND PRO
Free: up to 3 jobs, GPS/time/photo logging, on-device seals, affidavit PDF with draft watermark.
Doorstep Proof Pro: unlimited jobs, server-verified receipts with QR codes, clean affidavit PDFs and evidence file export. Monthly or yearly subscription with a 1-week free trial.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; renewal is charged within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Doorstep Proof is a documentation tool, not a law firm, and does not provide legal advice. Always check documents against your jurisdiction's required forms before filing.

name: Dragger Synth
description:
Drag a finger and it always sounds musical.

Across is the note, up is the sound. Every note lands in key, so there are no wrong notes here, just attitude. You don't need to know theory. You just need to play.

THE PAD
• Slide across to play notes, up and down to shape the sound
• 39 scales in every key; leave it on the default and it sounds good anyway
• Optional note grid with note names, and an optional glide between notes for that theremin feel
• On drum kits, the higher you hit, the harder it hits

THE LOOPER
• Five parts, each with its own sound
• Hit Rec, play, it loops. Lay another take on top
• Undo takes back a whole take; quantise keeps it tight
• Projects save themselves, with a version history to go back to

THE SOUNDS
120 sounds made in the garage: fuzz leads, organs, theremin, basses, pads, FX and garage drum kits. No samples borrowed from anyone.

GET IT OUT
• Export your song as WAV or MIDI and share it anywhere
• Plug in a USB, Bluetooth or network MIDI keyboard and play the sounds from it

FOR EVERYONE
• iPhone and iPad, upright or sideways
• Works with VoiceOver, with a button-based note mode

NO NONSENSE
One price, once. No ads, no subscription, no account, no internet connection needed. What you make stays on your device until you decide to share it.

Made by VTRsoftware, a one-person garage that loves making music.

name: DragOnBoat Pro
description:
DragOnBoat is the season planner for Chinatown dragon boat crews getting ready for Duanwu. Choose the right hull, reserve your race weekend, and keep the whole crew's plan in one place.

The festival comes around once a year and the boat matters. Browse sixteen hulls, compare the details that decide a race, then follow your booking through to handover at your launch point.

THE FLEET
• Sixteen boats, from 10-seat junior hulls to 22-paddler village teak boats
• Length, seat count, crew range, hull material, carved head, drum platform and steering oar on every listing
• Daily and two-day race weekend rates, refundable deposit and boatyard preparation time shown up front
• Race, Traditional, Training, Community and Youth builds, each with its own handling notes
• Search and filter by build, capacity and price

CREW FIT
Tell us your crew size, paddling experience, water and occasion. Crew Fit scores the fleet and returns the three best matches with a plain reason for each — capacity, hull material, tracking or the kind of day you are planning — so a first-season crew is never pointed at a carbon race shell.

RACE DAY
Set the date of your own regatta and count down to it. Work through a six-step preparation checklist covering the roster, delivery window, drummer, paddles and vests, lane assignment and food for the crew. Short field notes explain the lunar calendar, the drummer's opening cadence and the eye-dotting ceremony.

BOOKING AND DELIVERY
• Reserve with your crew name, contact, phone, launch point, city, race date and rental days
• Every hull shows the preparation time it needs before it can leave the boatyard
• Review your booking, charge breakdown, order number and delivery details in Orders
• Follow the stages from preparation to handover
• Cash on delivery: nothing to pay when you book. The total due, including the refundable deposit, is settled when the hull arrives on its cradle at your launch point

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Create an account to keep your crew profile, bookings and festival plan together
• Edit your profile, read the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, sign out or close your account at any time

Made for neighbourhood crews, association teams, youth programmes and everyone lining up on the fifth day of the fifth month.

name: Dream: AI Dream Diary
description:

■ レポート
あなたのレポートでは、よく出てくることばや夢の中の気持ちの移り変わりが見えてきます。みんなのレポートでは、世界中の人がどんな夢を見ているのかを、名前を伏せたテーマと気持ちから見られます（参加は任意です）。

■ プライバシー
許可した情報は夢を読むためだけに使い、iPhoneの外には送りません。何を共有するかは、いつでもあなたが決めます。

■ 料金
最初の1か月は無料、その後は月額480円です。サブスクリプションは、期間終了の24時間前までに解約しない限り自動で更新されます。解約はiPhoneの設定（Apple ID → サブスクリプション）からいつでもできます。

name: Dropush Colors
description:
Experience a mesmerizing duel of kinetic forces and chromatic harmony.

In Dropush Colors, two opposing realms meet in a vibrant dance of twin gravity. Stacks of luminous blocks cling to the ceiling above and the floor below. Your mission is simple yet intensely tactical: drag, align, and release blocks across dynamic lanes to ignite spectacular color reactions.

DUAL-GRAVITY ATTRACTION
Release a block from the floor, and it surges upward toward the ceiling. Release a block from the ceiling, and it plummets downward toward the floor. When two identical colors collide, they vanish in a radiant burst of energy and celestial sparks. But beware: colliding mismatched shades locks them together, reshaping the board and demanding strategic realignment.

EVOLVING GEOMETRIC ARENAS
Conquer an ever-shifting spectrum of stepped contours. From sharp Triangles and brilliant Diamonds to organic Hearts and intricate Octagons, every stage sculpts the playing field anew with distinct column depths and tactical avenues.

RACE THE COUNTDOWN
Feel the rush as the clock ticks away. Every stage delivers a tailored timer crafted to test your instincts and swift decision-making. Plan your lane alignments, anticipate opposing stacks, and clear every solitary block before time reaches zero.

ELEGANT SENSORY DESIGN
Immerse yourself in rich, dynamic color palettes that transition across stages, accompanied by crisp audio resonance and fluid physics-inspired animations.

Step into the arena, command the opposing forces, and master the art of the perfect reaction.

name: Druka
description:
Give your weekend a little plot twist. Druka helps you pick your next outing from 24 built-in destinations in London, New York and Singapore.
Filter by city, date, duration, budget, group size, transport and interests. Reveal a matching place with a capsule, card or wheel. Keep favorites, edit itinerary stops, add notes and checklists, and share a plan using the iOS share sheet.
Your nickname, history, favorites and plans stay on this device, with no cloud account required. Core destination selection works offline. Optional location, maps and source websites may require permission or a connection. Costs are planning estimates; live opening hours, bookings and navigation are not provided.

name: Drumwell: Drum Head Tuner
description:
Tap next to each tension rod and Drumwell shows the pitch of the head at that lug, which rods to tighten or loosen, and when the whole head is even. Then it reads the drum's own pitch against the note you want.

HEARS YOUR TAPS ON THE LATEST iOS
Drumwell sets the microphone up for measuring, with no voice processing and no automatic gain, and listens through the iPhone's own mic. After a call, a headset or another app taking the microphone, it starts listening again by itself. A light tap with a stick is enough.

STEADY READINGS
Each tap is read from the head's fundamental, not from whichever overtone rings loudest, and each lug settles to one number. A reading that disagrees waits for a second tap before it replaces the last one, so the numbers stay put while you turn the key.

LUG BY LUG
- Tap about an inch in from the lit lug. The first time round, Drumwell moves on to the next lug by itself.
- Every lug shows its pitch in Hz inside the drawing of your drum, with an arrow up or down.
- A rod turns green when its lug is within 5, 10 or 20 cents of the others, as strict as you like.
- Plain words, one lug at a time: "Lug 4 is 4.5 Hz high: loosen it."

THE DRUM'S PITCH
- Strike the center with both heads free to read the drum's note.
- Pick a note as the target and see how many cents away the drum is.
- See where the resonant head sits against the batter, or set an interval for it: the same pitch, a minor third up, or anything else.

YOUR WHOLE KIT, WITH PRO
- More drums: snare, rack toms, floor toms and bass drum, in the usual sizes, with 4 to 16 lugs, batter and resonant heads.
- Saved tunings (jazz, studio, rock) that come back later as the target for every lug.
- Kit tunings: the whole kit's tuning saved for a gig and recalled in one go.

TRY IT ON YOUR DRUM FIRST
One drum is free for good, with everything it needs: the lug readings, the targets and the drum's pitch. Drumwell Pro adds more drums, more kits and saved tunings, paid once or by subscription.

No account, no ads, works offline. Nothing is recorded: the sound is analysed on your iPhone as you tap and kept nowhere.

No drum at hand? Turn on the sample drum in Settings: a synthesized drum read by the same tuner, to see how it works.

Questions or problems: write from Settings, Contact.

Yearly and Monthly renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel them in Settings, Apple Account, Subscriptions. Lifetime is a one-time purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://drumwell.baltajmn.dev/privacy/

name: Drypo: Speaker Water Eject
description:
Drypo plays tuned tones, sweeps and vibration through your phone speaker so you can clean it, test it and hear how it sounds.

Sound muffled after rain, a shower or a dusty pocket? A cleaning session helps shake drops and dust out of the speaker grille.

CLEAN
• 4 modes: Water, Dust, Vibrate and Deep clean
• Choose 15 s, 30 s, 60 s or Auto
• Checks your volume and warns you if headphones are connected
• Keeps the screen on while it plays

CHECK & TOOLS
• Sound check: a short tune and bass sweep to hear if it sounds clear
• Stereo test: play the left and right speakers one at a time
• Decibel meter: see how loud it is around you
• Tone generator from 10 Hz to 22 kHz with sine, square, triangle and sawtooth waves
• White, pink and brown noise

CARE
• Cleaning guide by phone model: where the speakers are and what to avoid
• 7-day routine to see when you last cleaned
• Reminders to clean regularly

ON YOUR PHONE
Sounds are generated on your phone. There's no account and no server. The microphone is used only for the decibel meter, and nothing is recorded.

DRYPO PRO
Free: Water mode for 15 and 30 seconds, sound check, stereo test, cleaning guide, reminders, 15-second decibel measurements and the sine tone generator.
PRO: all 4 modes, 60-second and Auto cleaning, unlimited decibel meter, all waveforms and left/right channels, and noise.
PRO is available as a weekly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your account settings.

Results vary by device and how wet it is. Drypo can't undo water damage; if liquid got inside the phone, contact the manufacturer.

name: Dualzo
description:
Dualzo runs AI coding tasks on your GitHub repositories: it plans the work, writes the code and opens a pull request. The Dualzo app keeps you in control when you're away from your desk.

APPROVE PLANS FROM YOUR PHONE
Before Dualzo changes any code, it shows you a plan: what it will change, the tasks, the risk and its confidence. Approve it, reject it or ask for changes in a tap. Approval requests arrive as notifications, and on supported phones you can approve or reject right from the notification.

START TASKS ANYWHERE
Describe what you need in plain words, pick the repository and send it. Attach screenshots or files for context. Dualzo suggests a suitable model for the job, and you can run the task now or schedule it for later.

FOLLOW EVERY TASK LIVE
See each task move from planning to pull request. Read the conversation, the timeline of what happened and the final result. Open the pull request when it's ready, or follow up with another instruction.

STAY ON TOP OF YOUR WORK
• Home: what's waiting for your approval, what's running and your credits at a glance
• Inbox: every update in one place, with an unread count
• Notifications for plans ready to approve, pull requests opened and tasks that need attention
• Scheduled tasks and your connected repositories

BUILT FOR TEAMS
Work across workspaces, see who approved what in the audit log and manage members. Admins can choose which tasks need approval and which run on their own.

SECURE BY DEFAULT
• Sign in with email, Google or GitHub
• Two-factor authentication, with recovery codes and a backup email code
• Your sign-in is kept in your phone's secure storage

Dualzo works with your existing Dualzo account. New to Dualzo? Create an account in the app or at dualzo.com.

name: DuckCollect
description:
DuckCollect helps you organize your trading card collection and check card prices.

COLLECTION
Record cards you own, quantities, language, condition and Raw or Graded versions. Browse cards and sets in the catalogue. An account is required to save your collection.

PRICES
Search cards and compare available pricing data. Checking a price does not add a card to your collection. Price coverage depends on the card and source. Prices and collection sync need an internet connection.

ON-DEVICE TEXT SCANNER
Choose a photo or take one with the camera. Your iPhone reads visible names and numbers. Select useful text, edit the query and search. Native scanner photos stay on your device. Only the text you confirm is sent to search and may be forwarded to external card catalogues.

HISTORY
Keep the last 100 scanner text queries on this device. Browse your history offline, share queries or delete them. No photos are stored in scan history.

The scanner and public price search work without an account. Use email and password to sign in within the app.

name: Duo Type: Compatibility Test
description:
12 questions. 16 animal types. One link to see how you match.

TAKE THE QUIZ
12 quick either-or questions, about a minute. Four scales decide your type: Loud or Low-key, Planner or Go-with-flow, Head or Heart, Words or Actions.

16 ANIMAL TYPES
Captain Lion, Golden Pup, Cool Black Cat, Cozy Panda and more. Which one are you?

SEND YOUR MATCH LINK
Share your link with a friend, partner or crush. The moment they answer, your match score shows up. They can answer in any browser, no app needed.

FULL MATCH REPORT
Where you'll clash, how to get closer and your match with all 16 types — unlocked with a short video.

A CARD WORTH SHARING
Your result comes as a slam-book style card with washi tape and handwriting. Save it or share it in your story.

NO SIGNUP
No account needed.

Just for fun. Not a scientific personality assessment.

Available in English, 日本語, 한국어, 繁體中文, Deutsch and Français.

Duo Type is free. A full-screen ad may appear at natural breaks, such as before your result.
Buy “Remove Ads” once to turn off full-screen ads and unlock every video extra.

name: Działka Mroźna
description:
Działka Mroźna – zimowa kronika Twojej działki

Zima na działce to nie przerwa. Odwilż w dzień, mróz w nocy – ta huśtawka rozsadza korę jabłoni, grusz i śliw, wykańcza porzosty bez osłony i rdzewieje sekatory w szopie. Działka Mroźna prowadzi domową kronikę tego wszystkiego. Bez prognoz pogody z internetu – liczysz tylko własne oczy i własne zapiski.

Cykle mrozowe i okno wybielania
Po każdym powrocie z działki odhaczasz, jak było w powietrzu: odwilż w dzień i mróz w nocy, mróz całą dobę czy plus całą dobę. App liczy kolejne mroźne dni, a gdy przekroczysz własny próg (np. 5 dni), przypomina: czas wybielić pnie. Dzień faktycznego malowania zapisujesz w kronice – sam ustalasz, kiedy to „na czas”.

Każde drzewo osobno
Jabłoń przy płocie, grusza od sąsiada, śliwa za szopą – każde drzewo ma własną kartę: czy wybielone w tym sezonie, z którego roku, jak oceniasz korę po malowaniu. Po kilku latach kronika pokaże czarno na białym, które drzewo zawsze umyka i w których latach kora czuła się lepiej.

Wizyta zimowa przy warzywach ozimych
Wpisz, co zostaje w ziemi: jarmuż, por, roszponka, szpinak zimowy… Przy każdej wizycie App przypomina trzy pytania: czy przymarzły, czy dociągnąć agrowłókninę, czy już coś zebrać.

Tylko rzut oka? To też się liczy
Polska zima: ciemno, ślisko, słońce zachodzi przed piątą. Czasem wchodzisz tylko do bramy. Oznacz wizytę „tylko rzut oka”, wybierz, co zobaczyłeś – równy śnieg, ślady zwierząt, ułamane gałęzie – i tyle. Kronika nie wymaga pełnej kontroli za każdym razem.

Oliwa na narzędzia
Zapisz raz na zimę: czy łopaty i sekatory dostały oliwę, czy drobny sprzęt pojechał do domu. Wiosną odhaczasz, czy rdza się pojawiła – i wiesz, która zima zrobiła swoje.

Roczny bilans mrozów
Na koniec roku lista faktów, bez kwot: które drzewa pękły, które wybielanie się odwlekło, które warzywa przepadły. Jesienią ta sama lista mówi, które drzewo pilnować pierwsze.

Słowo uczciwe: wskazówki oparte są na domowej praktyce ogrodniczej działek w Polsce i służą prywatnej kronice. Nie zastępują oficjalnych zaleceń instytucji doradztwa ogrodniczego.

name: Eagle Importación
description:
Eagle Importación es la app interna del equipo de Eagle Importación, distribuidor Chevron en México. Abre el sistema de la empresa (ERP) con tu cuenta de trabajo y lo lleva a tu iPhone, iPad o Mac.

• Entra con Face ID o Touch ID, sin escribir tu contraseña.
• Tu inicio con lo que le toca a tu puesto: cobranza, ventas del mes y más.
• Atiende tareas, aprobaciones y tickets de soporte desde donde estés.
• Registra tu asistencia y lee códigos QR con la cámara.

Para usarla necesitas una cuenta que te da Eagle Importación. No hay registro abierto.

name: Echo Relic
description:
Every footstep speaks in Echo Relic.

Navigate quiet limestone ruins in a calm, turn-based puzzle journey where sound is both your guide and your greatest risk. Move tile by tile, collect the golden keystone, uncover ancient rubbings, and reach the jade gate without crossing paths with the Watchers or rising floor traps.

SOUND IS STRATEGY
• Ordinary stone carries your footsteps 3 tiles.
• Resonant stone amplifies sound to 5 tiles, drawing distant Watchers away from your path.
• Soft moss absorbs every step in silence.
• Echo relay runes carry sound 2 extra tiles around corners, while walls and closed gates block it.

OUTSMART THE RUINS
• Watchers march toward the nearest audible sound source and pause when they arrive. Heavy Watchers move every other turn.
• Stand on pressure plates—or lure a Watcher onto one—to hold jade gates open.
• Read alternating stone teeth before stepping, and use Wait to let mechanisms shift on your terms.

DESIGNED FOR THOUGHTFUL PLAY
• Hold any adjacent tile to preview the complete turn—sound waves, Watcher steps, and traps—before moving.
• Free Undo, progressive Hints, and non-destructive solution playback that returns you to your saved position.
• 4 chapters featuring 48 Journey puzzles and 12 challenge Trials, each with a collectible rubbing to restore 12 relic stories.
• Single-player offline mode supported for puzzle levels, with local progress saved on your device.

Chapter 1 (12 Journey levels and 3 Trials) is free to play. An optional one-time Full Journey purchase unlocks Chapters 2–4 (36 Journey puzzles and 9 Trials) with no subscriptions or advertisements.

name: ECHOLOOM: Phaseweave
description:
What if sound could solve a puzzle?

Enter ECHOLOOM: Phaseweave, a glowing world where every wave has a purpose. Shape sound, change its path, and find the right balance to bring each chamber to life.

Every chamber begins with a single sound pulse. Your goal is to guide that pulse toward glowing nodes by placing and adjusting special devices. Each node needs the right tone and energy to activate.

Reflect waves around obstacles, change their frequency, strengthen or soften their energy, and discover how different waves interact.

Sometimes the answer is not a stronger sound. Sometimes it is complete silence.

A DIFFERENT KIND OF PUZZLE

Explore 12 handcrafted chambers filled with sound-based challenges. Each level introduces new ideas and encourages you to experiment with wave movement, reflection, and interference.

SHAPE EVERY WAVE

Use six interactive devices to control sound:

• Reflective Panels: Change the direction of traveling waves.

• Resonators: Strengthen a selected tone.

• Dampers: Reduce wave energy.

• Frequency Shifters: Change the tone of a wave.

• Prisms: Split one wave into three paths.

• Echo Gates: Allow selected tones to pass through.

Combine these devices to create your own solution.

FIND THE RIGHT FREQUENCY

Work with three tones: Low, Mid, and High.

Match the correct tone and energy at each target. Watch waves overlap, strengthen one another, or cancel each other out.

Some chambers contain silence nodes that require careful wave cancellation.

EXPERIMENT WITHOUT PRESSURE

Place devices, rotate panels, and press PULSE to see what happens.

If your solution does not work, adjust your layout and try again.

Use unlimited undo, reset a chamber, or reveal a hint when you need help.

Earn up to three stars for each completed chamber.

A WORLD OF LIGHT AND SOUND

Explore dark indigo chambers filled with glowing cyan, violet, and turquoise effects.

Animated pressure waves, gentle particles, and code-generated audio create an atmospheric puzzle experience.

GAME FEATURES

• 12 handcrafted sound puzzle chambers
• Interactive wave reflection and interference
• Six unique wave control devices
• Three frequencies to explore
• Tone and energy matching challenges
• Silence puzzles based on wave cancellation
• Simple drag-and-drop controls
• Unlimited undo and reset
• Helpful hints for every chamber
• One to three star level ratings
• Glowing visuals and atmospheric audio
• Landscape gameplay designed for iPhone
• Completely offline gameplay
• No advertisements or tracking
• No additional downloads required

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE

ECHOLOOM: Phaseweave is designed for iPhone players who enjoy creative puzzles, calm experimentation, and discovering how things work.

There is no need to rush. Explore each chamber, test your ideas, and find your own path to the solution.

Shape sound. Find balance. Complete the chamber.

name: EchoReefPulse
description:
Black water. Somewhere ahead, coral. Somewhere, an eel. You tap, a ring of cyan light rolls outward, and for about a second the whole cave is there. Then it's gone, and you have to remember.

In EchoReefPulse you are a small glowing jellyfish in a reef with no light of its own. Drag anywhere to drift. Tap to send a sonar ping. Your sonar holds two charges that refill slowly, so every look costs something. Brush a wall and your glow dims; three hits and the dive is over. Find the vent to go deeper.

Forty-eight levels run down a depth gauge from the Sunlit Shelf to the Trench Heart, and the deeper you go, the less the reef plays fair:
- eels that patrol the passages you mapped a moment ago
- currents that shove you off the line you planned
- ghost pearls that only show up where two pings overlap

One star for reaching the vent. Another for collecting every pearl. The third for beating par time without touching a single wall. Grab pearls in quick succession for an echo combo.

The Daily Trench is a new dive each day, the same for everyone, with its own leaderboard. Your best runs also add up to a career score on the global board, posted under a random diver name like Neon Manta 42.

Deep sine pings, bubbling textures, a low ambient hum. Haptics give you a crisp ping, a rolling echo and a heavy thud when you hit rock. Sound and haptics can be switched off, and Reduce Motion is respected.

Offline play. No sign-up. No ads, no in-app purchases.

Ping. Look. Remember.

name: Elekter24
description:
Elekter24 helps you follow electricity market prices in Estonia and plan when to use your appliances. The app interface is in Estonian.

PRICES AT A GLANCE See the current and next price interval, the daily average, lowest and highest prices. Explore an interactive colour chart with 15-minute or hourly values. Tomorrow’s prices appear when they are published.

YOUR OWN kWh FEES Choose whether to include VAT. Add your electricity margin, a uniform network fee and other kWh charges to estimate a price that includes your selected fees. Monthly fees and separate day/night network tariffs are not included.

PLAN APPLIANCE USE Enter average power, duration and a time horizon to find the cheapest continuous period among the available prices. Costs and potential savings are estimates based on constant consumption; the app does not control appliances.

PRICE HISTORY Compare market prices over the past week, month or year. History is shown without VAT or personal fees. Missing data is identified rather than treated as a zero price.

WIDGET AND LOCAL ALERTS Check market prices from your Home Screen widget. Set low- and high-price thresholds in the app. Alerts use prices already loaded on your phone, so open the app daily to refresh them. Widget refresh timing is managed by iOS.

OPTIONAL WEATHER See weather for a city you choose, with a matching background. GPS location is not requested.

No account, advertising or in-app purchases. Preferences and tariff inputs are stored on your device. Price and weather requests connect directly to their data providers.

Price data is retrieved from Elering’s price service; weather is provided by Open-Meteo. Elekter24 is an independent app and is not an official app of Elering, Nord Pool or an electricity supplier. Data may be delayed or unavailable. Always check your contract and the displayed update time.

Support: onnarahan@gmail.com

name: Emberline: Lantern Swing
description:
A tiny ember spirit, a sky full of floating lanterns and a darkness that never stops rising.

Hold to cast a thread of light to the nearest lantern, swing, and let go at the perfect moment to fly higher. Chain lanterns for combos, collect embers and keep climbing before the gloom swallows you.

◆ ONE THUMB, REAL PHYSICS
Hold to grab, release to fly. Your momentum carries into every swing. Release straight up for a PERFECT boost.

◆ 90 HANDCRAFTED LEVELS IN 6 WORLDS
Lantern Rooftops, Moonlit Cloud Sea, Aurora Heights, Starfall Expanse, Dragon Nebula and the Edge of Dawn. Every level has three stars to earn.

◆ BOSSES AT THE STAR GATE
Each world ends with a giant shadow guardian that hurls orbs at you while you race for the gate.

◆ 10 HEROES WITH ULTIMATES
Ember Fox, Frost Cat, Sky Jelly, Luna Moth, Comet Bunny, Phoenix Chick, Moon Dragon and more. Each has its own perk and an ultimate ability: Flame Dash, Frost Time, Light Barrier, Moon Leap…

◆ NEW TRICKS IN EVERY WORLD
Golden and drifting lanterns, fragile lanterns, updrafts, bounce clouds, star portals, shadow crows, meteors and icicles.

◆ ENDLESS MODE & DAILY GIFTS
Chase your best height in Endless, open star chests and collect a daily gift.

No account, no ads, plays offline. In-app purchases are optional ember packs and a one-time Starter Pack.

Support: iletisim@umutcetinkaya.com.tr

name: EMG Capture
description: EMG Capture is a photo booth and video guest book app for Elegant Music Group events. Staff can run iPad-based photo experiences, capture video guest book messages, and connect supported cameras and printers for event workflows. Guests can receive eligible photos through a QR code or text message. Event staff manage booth settings and troubleshoot connected devices through EMG Capture.

name: Emoji Sort: Sorting Puzzle
description:
Swipe, sort and score! Emoji Sort is the fast, colourful sorting puzzle where every emoji has a home. Flick each one into the right bin, build huge streaks and set the screen on fire.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Swipe sort: emoji fall, you swipe them left or right into the right bin. Animals or food? Hot or cold? Think fast.
• Tube sort: a relaxing brain teaser. Pour emoji between glass tubes until every tube holds one kind.
• Conveyor: tap to sort emoji off a moving belt before it jams.

67 WORLDS AND 335 STAGES
Travel from Farm Meadow to the Arctic, the Desert and beyond. Every world ends in a boss fight: sort fast to knock out the Scorpion King, the T-Rex and more.

A NEW DAILY CHALLENGE
Everyone gets the same daily puzzle. Play it, share your result grid with friends and keep your streak alive.

COLLECT AND LEVEL UP
• Fill your emoji book with 438 emoji, and hunt rare golden emoji
• Complete daily goals and earn 106 badges
• Fever mode: hit a 20 streak for double points
• Level up, earn coins and unlock power-ups like slow-mo, freeze and extra tube
• Climb the Game Center leaderboards in Endless and the daily

MADE TO FEEL GREAT
Bright visuals, satisfying bursts and confetti, punchy sound and haptics. Quick enough for a one-minute break, deep enough for months of play. Works offline, with no account needed.

Emoji Sort is free to play. Optional in-app purchases offer coin packs and a starter bundle; everything in the game can also be earned by playing.

Questions or ideas? Email support@r5iot.com.
Privacy: https://games.r5iot.com/emojisort/privacy

name: Emotion Dice
description:
Roll a feeling. Press it out.

Emotion Dice turns a mood into something you can actually hold: a soft 3D dice rolls, lands on a feeling, and becomes a squishy button you press, hold and squash until it lets go.

SQUEEZE IT OUT
- Hold to squash the soft candy, then let go and watch it bounce back
- Twelve moods, each with its own colour, sound and little scene: bubbles, clouds, tangles, a growing garden
- Fidget friendly: press as many times as you like, no timer and no score

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
- Unwind: no timer, no score. Squeeze until it feels better.
- Challenge: six rounds of five seconds, each with a tiny goal.

YOUR OWN VOICE
Record twelve short lines in your own voice and hear yourself instead of the built-in voices. Everything stays on your device - nothing is uploaded.

SMALL DETAILS
- Twelve emotion voices, recorded in both English and Chinese
- Waves that spread further across the screen the longer you press
- Haptics, quiet sound design, and support for reduced motion
- Works completely offline

PRIVACY
No account, no analytics, no ads and no tracking. The microphone is used only when you choose to record, and recordings never leave your device.

WHAT IT IS NOT
Emotion Dice is a playful way to let off steam. It does not measure real pressure and is not a medical or therapeutic tool.

name: Empire Forge
description: CityForge is a landscape strategy game set in a medieval valley. Shape an isometric village, gather wood, clay, and iron, and house the people who work your farms, camps, and mines. Upgrade your walls, barracks, and academy, then train infantry, cavalry, and siege engines. Neighboring villages fill the world map: scout them, trade with them, or march an army to their gates. Your lord spends skill points, spies keep talents of their own, and quests lead a new settlement toward a stronger hold.

name: EMULADOR VIEJOS
description:
EMULADOR VIEJOS opens your own classic handheld game files on your iPhone.

It comes with a homebrew puzzle game so you can try it right away. To play anything else, import your own .gb, .gbc and .gba files from the Files app.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Play in portrait or landscape with touch controls
• Save and load states at any moment
• Keep your in-game saves automatically
• Add cheats for each game and switch them on or off
• Restore a backup of your save if a cheat goes wrong

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
There are no accounts, ads or tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone.

The app includes no commercial games and doesn't download games. Only use files you have the right to use.

name: Energy Puzzle Worlds
description:
Power up your mind with three puzzle worlds in one game.

GRID MASTER: rotate wires and connect every building to a power plant. Mind the voltage, the transformers and the short circuits.
EMERGENCY FIX: repair cables, replace fuses and bring every critical system online in the right order before the reactor limit.
CIRCUIT FACTORY: place conveyors, splitters and machines, then press RUN and watch every part reach its storage.

- 400 hand-tuned levels that grow from relaxing to mind-bending
- Three stars per level, step-by-step hints and undo
- Daily reward and daily challenge
- Coins to unlock backdrops and tap effects
- Calm music and crisp electric sound effects
- Works fully offline. No account, no ads, no tracking
- Turkish and English, text size, colour-blind colours, reduced motion

name: Equal Access App
description:
Equal Access is a free iPhone app that helps you screen a photo of a place for potential access barriers, then opens plain-English guidance about what may be worth checking.

For adults aged 18 and over.

It is for disabled adults, adult carers, and other adults checking a place before a visit, and for business owners, managers, and access auditors who want to self-audit their premises and signage.

Take a photo, or choose one you already have, of a building, shop, venue or service. Equal Access can flag:

• potential physical access barriers, such as steps, narrow doors, no ramp or handrail, or poor signage
• missing reasonable adjustments
• signs or notices that may be worth reviewing

Notes point to human-written guidance in the app. You can save a scan to your history and export a PDF report for your own follow-up.

Photos are checked on your iPhone and never leave it. Equal Access does not send your photos to a server. There are no accounts and no tracking.

You can use Equal Access wherever you are. It is free, and it is listed worldwide. Legal background is provided only for England and Wales and for Scotland (the Equality Act 2010), for Jersey (the Discrimination (Jersey) Law 2013), and for the United States (federal ADA only — Title III of the Americans with Disabilities Act and the 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design; state and local law is not covered). Northern Ireland is not covered yet. In other places the app does not provide legal guidance: photo notes are general design observations only, and local laws differ.

Equal Access provides information only. It is not legal advice, architectural advice, or a decision about whether anything meets the law. A photo cannot measure a slope, weigh a door, or apply a legal test. If nothing is flagged, that means nothing was flagged — not that a place is clear.

Need help? Visit https://equalaccess.app/support or email info@equalaccess.app.

name: Esame RUI – Quiz e Simulazioni
description:
Tutte le 2255 domande del database IVASS dei quesiti per la prova RUI (sezioni A e B del Registro degli intermediari), riportate parola per parola, con simulazioni fatte come la prova vera: stesso numero di quesiti, stesso tempo, stessa penalità. Gratis, senza pubblicità, senza account, anche senza connessione.

SIMULAZIONI UGUALI ALLA PROVA
Scegli il tuo modulo e l'app ti dà il questionario giusto: assicurativo, 50 quesiti in 75 minuti; riassicurativo, 20 in 30; entrambi, 70 in 105. Il punteggio è quello dell'avviso IVASS: +1 la giusta, 0 la bianca, −0,5 la sbagliata. Si passa con 60 su 100. Hai poco tempo? Lo Sprint: 20 quesiti in 30 minuti.

LA PROVA VERA DI GIUGNO 2026
Il questionario ufficiale dell'11 giugno 2026, con i quesiti nel loro ordine e il tempo vero. Per misurarti su quello che è uscito davvero.

IMPARA QUANDO LASCIARE IN BIANCO
Con la penalità, tirare a caso su tre risposte in media non rende niente. Nei risultati vedi quanti punti ti sono costate le sbagliate e quanto avresti preso lasciandole in bianco: è lì che molti candidati perdono i punti che mancano.

IL DATABASE INTERO, SENZA MODIFICHE
Le domande sono quelle del database IVASS di dicembre 2025, estratte dal PDF ufficiale e ricontrollate una per una. Nessuna riscritta, nessuna corretta. Ogni domanda mostra il suo numero nel database, così la ritrovi nel PDF. E se una risposta ti sembra sbagliata, «Segnala un errore» ci arriva direttamente.

UN RIPASSO CHE NON TI FA DIMENTICARE
Gli errori tornano finché non li sai. E tornano anche le domande che sai, a intervalli sempre più lunghi: il modo più efficace per arrivare alla prova ricordando quello che hai studiato settimane prima.

QUIZ PER MATERIA E DOMANDE MAI VISTE
Le sette materie del modulo assicurativo e le due del riassicurativo, una alla volta, con la risposta giusta subito. Le domande che non hai ancora incontrato, nelle proporzioni della prova, finché non le hai viste tutte. Cerchi «IDD» o «surroga» e trovi tutte le domande che ne parlano. Su ogni domanda puoi scrivere una nota tua o metterla da parte.

QUANTO SEI PRONTO, E DOVE PERDI PUNTI
Sei requisiti chiari — domande viste, superate da solo, simulazioni complete e i loro punteggi, ogni materia sopra soglia — con dove sei e cosa ti manca. La mappa delle materie ti dice su cosa tornare.

IL METODO DI STUDIO
Rispondere invece di rileggere, distribuire nel tempo, mescolare le materie: le tecniche che la ricerca sull'apprendimento dà per efficaci, spiegate in tre minuti, con un piano di sei settimane. Imposti la data della prova e l'app ti dice quante domande fare al giorno; se vuoi, un promemoria la sera.

CHI L'HA FATTA
Athena SCF, società di consulenza finanziaria indipendente. Ci dici cosa migliorare direttamente dall'app.

Quest'applicazione è di Athena SCF e non è prodotta, approvata né certificata da IVASS — Istituto per la Vigilanza sulle Assicurazioni. Le domande sono quelle del «Database dei quesiti per le prove RUI» pubblicato da IVASS (dicembre 2025), predisposto con l'Università degli Studi di Firenze, riprodotte senza modifiche a fini didattici e non commerciali, come consentito dalla fonte.

name: Escambia FIG MOH
description:
Escambia FIG MOH (Middle of the House) is the delivery invoice app for Escambia County Public Schools food service managers, from FIG K-12.

When a delivery arrives at the kitchen, a manager can:

• Photograph every page of the vendor's invoice with the phone camera
• Sign for the delivery with their saved signature, stamped with the date and time
• Note anything wrong with one tap (short cases, damaged items, wrong product) or by talking instead of typing
• Find every invoice they sent in History, with Recent and Archive tabs

Invoices go straight to the district's FIG finance office, which reads the vendor, invoice number and total, so nothing has to be retyped and no paper gets lost between the kitchen and the office.

Escambia FIG MOH is for Escambia County Public Schools food service staff. Sign in with your FIG finance login or district single sign-on.

name: Escape Room - Samurai Castle
description:
Escape Room - Samurai Castle is a mystery puzzle adventure for adults: a Japanese escape room in an abandoned samurai castle. The gate is locked, the banners hang bare, and the clan is gone. Raise your lantern and the castle's last evening returns. Name the thirteen dead, open forty locks across four acts, and follow the clan into the mountain, back up the keep by night and out along the pale road.

You arrive at dusk. A pale man stands before the gate's lock, a spear at his side. He does not turn. He has forgotten his name. Every name in the clan's ledger is struck through, and only your lantern can read them.

THE SPIRIT LANTERN
• In the rooms of Act I, drag the lantern's pool of light across the painting to see the castle's last evening: its lamps lit, each of the clan at their post.
• Some things are there only by lantern: the verse on a stone worn blank, a key the gravel has covered. Everything else works as before, lit or unlit.

NAME THE DEAD
• Thirteen spirits stand in Act I's thirteen rooms. Tap one and its page opens in the Keeper's Ledger: a name and a last deed.
• Read the Clan Roll by lantern, match a line to what you see on the figure, and read the last deed in the room.
• Both right and the spirit is laid to rest. A wrong pair and the spirit does not turn. No penalty, no limit.
• Three bar the way until they hear their name. The Lord waits until the other twelve rest.

THE KEEPER'S LEDGER
• The castle opens on an old ledger, the room you left painted on its page. Its ribbons are the menu: Rooms, The Dead, Riddle, Storehouse and House.

FOUR ACTS, FIFTY-ONE PAINTED ROOMS
• Act I, The Outer Wards: from the Castle Gate to the Keep Hall.
• Act II, The Vow Beneath: from the Hall of Sandals to the Heart of the mountain.
• Act III, The Keeper Above: back up the keep at night, across the nightingale floor, to the lamp in the high window. Two endings: keep the vigil, or let the lamp go out.
• Act IV, The Pale Road: down the road the clan's guard walked, to a mountain shrine where something breathes.
• A point and click castle escape in first person. Rooms change as you play.

FORTY LOCKS, MANY KINDS OF PUZZLE
• Code locks, banner levers, star wheels, and moon mirrors that throw light across the floor.
• An altar that opens like a karakuri box, rings that turn each other, an armour chest of sliding lacquer panels.
• Ferry a load without sinking the boat, weigh steel on a smith's balance, read four swords by their temper lines.
• Every answer is in the castle.

A MYSTERY AT YOUR OWN PACE
• The clue journal keeps every clue you read, with a picture of where you found it.
• No enemies, no way to lose and no dead ends. The game saves after every move.
• Three hint steps for every lock. The nudge costs nothing and your first 10 methods and answers are on the house; after that they cost koban you earn in play. Short of koban? You pay what you have.

TRIALS, CRESTS AND A DAILY RIDDLE
• Race a finished act against the clock in the Trial of the Hour. Most locks change every run.
• Find five hidden clan crests in every act and hang the clan's masks on the Mask Wall.
• A new riddle every day, and koban for every right answer.

THE STOREHOUSE
• Act I is a complete chapter. Seal it and the castle gives you a journal cover, and the first room of every later act opens; the rest unlocks in story order, with koban earned in play or a one-time purchase.
• Journal covers and lantern lights to try in any room first, and Night Watch: every room by moonlight.
• The Collector's Edition: the Keeper's Chronicle and every room as a wallpaper.
• Seal an act without a single hint to earn the Master's Lantern.

FOR GROWN-UPS
A slow, eerie Japanese escape game for adults who like to look closely. The dead stand where they last stood and the story is unsettling, but nothing jumps out at you and no one is harmed. The clan did not flee and did not fight. They kept a vow, one lamp at a time.

The gate is waiting. Raise your lantern.

name: Essay Blueprint: Plan & Cite
description:
Essay Blueprint turns an assignment brief into a plan you can write from: the parts, the sections and how many words each one gets, with your sources and references kept beside them.

START WITH THE BRIEF
Paste the brief, take a photo of it or dictate it. Essay Blueprint finds the word count, any parts (Part A 2,000 words, Part B 500) and the referencing style, then suggests sections that fit. On iPhones and iPads with Apple Intelligence, the sections are worked out from your brief on the device itself. Without it, you get a standard structure for the kind of essay: critical essay, reflective piece, literature review, case study or report.

A PLAN THAT ADDS UP
Change the total, a part or a section, and the other sections make room, so the plan always matches the word count. Lock the sections you're happy with; add, remove and move sections; add parts. A clear marker shows whether you're on target and within your allowance.

YOUR SOURCES, SECTION BY SECTION
Add a source by DOI, by ISBN (or scan the book's barcode), from a web link or a photo of a reference, or type it in. Essay Blueprint fills in the details from Crossref, Open Library or the page itself. Note why you're using each source and keep your own notes for every section.

REFERENCES IN SIX STYLES
Harvard (Cite Them Right), APA 7th, Vancouver, MLA 9th, Chicago author-date and IEEE, with the in-text citation for every source. Numbered styles are numbered in the order you cite them. Switch style at any time.

READY FOR WORD
Copy the reading list into Microsoft Word with its italics and links, or share it as a Word file. The essay outline puts your headings, word targets, notes and sources in one document to write from.

• Two worked examples to explore: a philosophy essay and a two-part politics assignment
• Dark mode
• iPhone and iPad (on iPad your essays sit beside the plan)

YOUR WORK STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
No account and no sign-in. Your essays are kept on your iPhone or iPad. When you look up a source, only the DOI, ISBN, link or reference text is sent, to Crossref, Open Library or the web page itself.

Essay Blueprint helps you plan. It doesn't write your essay and it doesn't choose your sources.

ONE ESSAY FREE, THEN PAY ONCE
Your first essay is free, with everything in it. Unlock every essay with a single in-app purchase. No subscription, no ads.

Terms: https://www.sciencemadevisual.co.uk/essay-blueprint/terms · Privacy: https://www.sciencemadevisual.co.uk/essay-blueprint/privacy

name: Everything Kleinmond
description:
Everything Kleinmond is the free local directory for Kleinmond, Betty's Bay, Pringle Bay and Rooi-Els on the Whale Coast.

KNOW WHAT'S HAPPENING TODAY
• Live weather for Kleinmond: temperature, feels-like, wind, daily high and low, sea temperature, sunrise and sunset
• Today's tides: approximate high and low times
• Load shedding and planned electricity outages for the Overstrand
• Listen to local radio: Caledon FM and Whale Coast FM
• Emergency numbers one tap away: 112, police 10111 and ambulance 10177

FIND WHAT'S LOCAL
• Discover the beaches: Blue Flag Kleinmond Beach, Palmiet Lagoon, Silver Sands, Pringle Bay and more, plus tidal pools, lagoons and rock pools
• Visit Stony Point's penguin colony, Harold Porter National Botanical Garden and the Kogelberg Biosphere
• Browse more than 400 local listings in over 30 categories, from accommodation, restaurants and cafes to health, legal services, schools, vineyards and venues
• Explore the four villages: Kleinmond, Betty's Bay, Pringle Bay and Rooi-Els
• Daily restaurant specials
• Local Lowdown: markets, festivals and community events
• Near Me: see what is closest to where you are
• Buy and sell on the local Classifieds
• Browse local properties to buy or rent

STAY INFORMED
• Local news and community notices
• This week's e-editions of the Hermanus Times and The Village News

FOR LOCAL BUSINESSES
Create a free profile, list your business and reach the locals and visitors who use the directory. Paid listings start at R200 a month. List an event on Local Lowdown for free.

Everything Kleinmond is run locally and covers the greater Kleinmond area only. The directory is growing, and businesses can be added at any time at everythingkleinmond.co.za.

Tide times are approximate and modelled, not official. Check the SA Navy tide tables before boating or diving. Load shedding information should be confirmed with your municipality or the EskomSePush app.

name: Expecting Pregnancy
description:
Make room for the everyday moments of pregnancy with Expecting.

Follow your pregnancy week by week, explore articles and keep useful tools together in one app.

YOUR PREGNANCY AT A GLANCE
See your pregnancy week, due date and information about your baby’s development.

READ AND EXPLORE
Browse articles by category and pregnancy week. Articles are available in guest mode, without signing in.

KEEP PERSONAL RECORDS
Manually record weight, blood pressure and blood sugar, and view your entries in My body. Choose which measurements you want to see.

PREPARE TOGETHER
Organise shared lists for home and hospital bags. Add items from categories, create custom items and mark what you already have. Pair your account with your partner’s.

TOOLS FOR THE WEEKS AHEAD
Save favourite baby names. Movement tracking and a contraction timer are available from pregnancy week 37.

Available in English, Croatian, Czech, Slovenian, Spanish and Hungarian. Personal records and shared features require an account and internet access.

Expecting provides general information and personal record-keeping tools. It does not replace advice, diagnosis or care from your midwife or doctor.

name: Fair Farkle
description:
Farkle, but fair. Every player gets the exact same dice, in the exact same order — so when you beat your friends, it was all you.

Roll six dice, set aside the ones that score, and decide: bank your points, or risk it all on one more roll. Roll with no scoring dice and it's a FARKLE — your turn's points are gone.

SAME DICE, EVERYONE
• Daily — one shared dice sequence for the whole world, every day. Same rolls, same order. Beat the day in the fewest turns.
• Race — share a short code with a friend. They play your exact dice. Whoever reaches 10,000 in fewer turns wins. No accounts, no waiting, no servers.
• Solo — race yourself to 10,000 in as few turns as you can.

REAL FARKLE RULES
• 1s are 100, 5s are 50. Three of a kind, straights, three pairs, two triplets — all scored exactly like the game you know.
• Hot dice: score with all six and roll them all again.
• First to 10,000 wins. Fewest turns wins the day.

NO TRICKS
• No ads. No sign-in. No money, no wagering, no prizes — just points and bragging rights.
• Works fully offline. Your best scores and daily streak stay on your device.
• Silent by design — play it anywhere, one thumb, no sound needed.

Same dice. Your call.

name: Falaq — Meditate with the sun
description:
Meditation, timed by the sun.

The sun cuts the day into five moments. Falaq opens one at each of them.

Most meditation apps have to persuade you to open them. Falaq does not: the sun keeps the appointment for you. At dawn, at midday, in the afternoon, at sunset and at night, a moment opens where you are. Open it, close your eyes, and a few minutes later go back to your day.

No account. No streaks. Nothing counted, nothing kept.

FIVE MOMENTS, SET BY THE SUN
• Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha — dawn, midday, afternoon, sunset and night — worked out on your phone from where you are, every day
• A notification as each moment opens, one at sunrise as dawn's closes, and nothing else
• An alarm for the moments you choose, if you want one: tap the bell and pick. It rings as the moment opens, even on Silent. Every alarm stays off until you turn it on
• Miss one and nothing happens: no reminder, no guilt, nothing to catch up on

A SHORT PAUSE, AT YOUR PACE
• Pauses of four to eight minutes by default, the shortest at dawn
• One setting makes them all shorter or longer, from two minutes to twenty
• Three short lines before you start — what is outside, what is inside, then go. Reading them is never required
• Soundscapes for the length of the moment: nature, atmosphere, instrumental or drone. Earbuds in, eyes closed
• The screen goes dark and quiet while you sit; nothing on it counts down

MADE FOR WHERE YOU ARE
• Works offline: the moments are computed on your phone
• The calculation method follows your country — fifty named authorities, and you can pick another in Settings, as you can the Asr school
• A page with the five moments of any day, past or ahead
• Arabic, French and English, with full right-to-left support and Arabic-Indic numerals
• Light and dark themes

PRIVACY FIRST
No account. No analytics. No ads. No history: Falaq remembers whether you sat the current moment, and nothing else. Your location is used on your phone to compute the moments, and is never stored.

Privacy label: Data Not Collected.

WHY FALAQ EXISTS
Five short pauses spread across a day that was going to happen anyway are easier than one long one. Falaq gives the day that shape, and asks nothing in return.

Falaq — فلق — the daybreak.
All of us, gliding along our own course.

name: FamBase Stories
description:
Οργάνωσε τις μελισσοκομικές σου στιγμές σε όμορφες ιστορίες με φωτογραφίες, σημειώσεις και ηχητικές αφηγήσεις. Το FamBees Stories σου επιτρέπει να κρατάς συγκεντρωμένα όσα συμβαίνουν στην κυψέλη, να θυμάσαι τις αλλαγές με τον χρόνο και να μοιράζεσαι εύκολα υλικό από τις αγαπημένες σου μελισσοκομίες.

Κύριες λειτουργίες
- Οι μελισσοκομίες μου - δημιούργησε μία ή περισσότερες μελισσοκομίες με όνομα, περιοχή, περιγραφή και φωτογραφία εξωφύλλου
- Άλμπουμ φωτογραφιών - αποθήκευσε εικόνες από κυψέλες, μέλισσες, φυτά και μέλι, με υπογραφές και αναδιάταξη με μεταφορά
- Ιστορίες μελισσοκομίας - σύνθεσε φωτογραφικές ιστορίες με σειρά, τίτλους, κείμενο και πρόχειρη αποθήκευση για συνέχιση αργότερα
- Ηχητικά σχόλια - ηχογράφησε αφήγηση, άκουσέ την ξανά, κόψε τα άκρα και επανεγγράψ’ την όποτε θέλεις
- Κάρτες κυψελών - κράτα φωτογραφίες και καταγραφές με ημερομηνίες για να βλέπεις την εξέλιξη κάθε κυψέλης
- Εύκολος διαμοιρασμός - αποθήκευσε φωτογραφίες ή ηχητικά αρχεία και στείλ’ τα από το μενού του συστήματος

Ιδανικό για
- Μελισσοκόμους που θέλουν να οργανώνουν επιθεωρήσεις, αλλαγές και εποχικές εργασίες
- Χρήστες που θέλουν να δημιουργούν όμορφες, οπτικές ιστορίες από το μελισσοκομείο τους
- Καταγραφή προόδου σε κάθε κυψέλη με φωτογραφίες, σημειώσεις και φωνητικές παρατηρήσεις

Γιατί να το επιλέξεις
Το FamBees Stories είναι σχεδιασμένο για να δίνει έμφαση στις εικόνες και στην απλότητα. Με καθαρή εμφάνιση, μεγάλα στιγμιότυπα, ευανάγνωστες λεζάντες και χώρο για κάθε λεπτομέρεια, μετατρέπει το υλικό της μελισσοκομίας σου σε ένα προσωπικό αρχείο που παραμένει στο iPhone σου. Δεν χρειάζεται λογαριασμός, δεν απαιτείται σύνδεση στο διαδίκτυο για δημιουργία και προβολή ιστοριών, και όλα αποθηκεύονται τοπικά στη συσκευή.

Αν θες να συγκεντρώνεις φωτογραφίες, να θυμάσαι κάθε παρατήρηση και να αφηγείσαι εύκολα την πορεία των κυψελών σου, το FamBees Stories είναι το εργαλείο που χρειάζεσαι.

Κατέβασέ το και ξεκίνα να χτίζεις τις δικές σου μελισσοκομικές ιστορίες σήμερα.

name: Farmer Store
description:
Farmer Store brings a broad selection of products from Indian farmer groups, producer organisations and artisans into one easy shopping experience.

Browse the current catalogue, search by product or category, check live availability and save products for later. Product pages show current prices, descriptions and available customer reviews. Add products to your cart, enter a delivery address and complete payment securely for physical goods.

Your account keeps orders, invoices, wallet activity, saved products and review opportunities together. The app supports delivery-location assistance when you choose to use it, document downloads, product media uploads and direct links that open the right store page.

Highlights:

• Browse and search the live Farmer Store catalogue
• Shop food, craft, wellness and lifestyle products
• Save products and request restock alerts
• Track orders and view available invoices
• Access your HFN wallet and account preferences
• Review verified purchases and upload product photos or videos
• Continue securely to Razorpay for payment for physical goods

Farmer Store currently fulfils eligible orders according to the delivery coverage shown during checkout. Product availability and delivery charges are confirmed before payment.

name: FarmersTag: Farming Network
description:
FarmersTag is a social network for Nigeria's farming community. Meet farmers, agro-dealers, suppliers and experts, share what is happening on your farm, buy and sell farm products, and learn new skills, all in one app.

SHARE AND CONNECT
- Post farm updates, photos and videos to your feed
- Follow farmers and businesses, like, comment and repost
- Join communities for your crop, livestock or region
- Send private messages to buyers, sellers and fellow farmers

BUY AND SELL IN THE MARKETPLACE
- Browse listings for produce, livestock, equipment, inputs and services
- Post your own listing with pictures or a video
- Save listings you like and message sellers directly
- Rate and review sellers

LEARN NEW SKILLS
- Take farming courses with video lessons and quizzes
- Track your progress and earn certificates on selected courses
- Leave questions and comments on lessons

STAY INFORMED
- Read the FarmersTag blog for tips, news and guides
- Find farming events across Nigeria and say you are going
- Get notifications for messages, comments, followers and updates

TRUSTED MEMBERS
- Get a verified badge by confirming your identity
- Report or block anything that does not belong, and our team reviews it

Download FarmersTag and connect with Nigeria's farming community.

name: FATIMA SHAABIYAT|شعبيات فاطمة
description: Brand new look to make ordering easier and enjoyable. With faster performance and bug fixes, everything works better than ever! Enjoy the new design and improved features. Your favorite meal is just a tap away!

name: Favin: Find Your Circle
description:
Favin helps you turn what you already love into real plans with people.

Discover moments from people who share your interests, join a circle that matches your week, and ask to join a plan that puts a time and a place on it. Every plan keeps its meeting details inside the group that was accepted, so the details stay with the people who are actually going.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Discover moments with a photo and an optional sound note of up to 60 seconds.
- Like, save and comment on moments you want to come back to.
- Join interest circles, read their shared conversation, and meet the members.
- Host a plan with a time, a city, a capacity and the way people ask to join.
- Ask to join with a short note, then follow your requests in My Plans.
- Message people directly or inside a circle.
- Block or report a moment, person, circle or message from where you see it.

YOUR PROFILE, YOUR CHOICE
Your display name, bio, photo and interests are how people recognise you. Your city is a choice you make, not something the app tracks, and you can change or clear any of it whenever you like.

PRIVACY THAT MATCHES THE SCREEN
Favin has no advertising and no third-party analytics or tracking services. Your sign-in session is kept in the iOS Keychain, and photos or sound notes stay on your iPhone until you publish them. You can review every signed-in device, end a session, sign out everywhere, or delete your account from Settings.

Favin is for people who would rather do the thing than talk about doing the thing. Find your circle, then find a time.

name: FenceAcre: Fence Calculator
description:
Know your acreage and fence cost before you buy a single post.

FenceAcre measures your land on a satellite map and turns the boundary into a complete material list.

MEASURE ANY PIECE OF LAND
• Tap the corners on a satellite map to get acres, square feet and perimeter instantly
• Walk the boundary with GPS and FenceAcre traces it for you, smoothing out GPS wobble
• Measure a single fence line, like one side of a pasture, instead of a whole field
• Search an address to jump straight to the property
• Acres and feet, or hectares and metres

FENCE ESTIMATES THAT ADD UP
• Barbed wire, woven field fence, electric polywire, wood board, vinyl privacy and chain link
• Counts line posts, corner and gate posts, braces, wire rolls, boards, panels, clips, insulators, concrete and gates
• Adjust post spacing, strands or rails, gates, gate width and extra for waste
• Typical farm-store prices included, so you see a total right away

SAVE AND SHARE
• Keep your fields with notes like gate locations and who to call
• Share a one-page PDF report with the satellite map, measurements and material list, ready to send with a quote

BUILT FOR
Landowners, hobby farmers, ranchers, hunters planning food plots, homeowners fencing a yard and fence contractors quoting jobs.

No account needed. Your fields are saved on your iPhone.

FENCEACRE PRO
Free: measure as much as you like and save one field with a full estimate at typical prices.
Pro unlocks unlimited saved fields, PDF reports, and your own material prices and labor rate.

Pro Yearly: $29.99 per year after a 7-day free trial. Pro Monthly: $4.99 per month. Prices may vary by region.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage and cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Estimates are for planning. Check quantities and local prices before ordering.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://elevatemobilegroup.com/privacy-policy

name: Fernly: Plant Care & ID
description:
Fernly helps you keep your plants alive and thriving. Build your garden, get reminders that fit each plant and the weather where you live, and catch problems early.

WHAT'S FREE
• Your garden, care reminders, weather-aware watering and the full plant library: no subscription needed
• A light meter that uses your camera to measure each spot and shows which suits each plant
• 3 plant IDs and 3 health checks a month. A photo with no plant in it doesn't count
• No ads, no tracking and no account needed

YOUR GARDEN
• Add plants from a library of 266 houseplants, succulents, flowering plants, herbs and trees, each with care notes and sources
• See whether a plant is toxic to cats, dogs or children, from the ASPCA and poison-control plant lists, with the source for each
• Filter the library for plants the ASPCA lists as non-toxic to cats and dogs
• Group plants into collections by room or balcony
• Log care as you go and track each plant's progress with photos

WATERING THAT WON'T DROWN YOUR PLANTS
• Fernly tells you when to check the soil instead of watering on a fixed schedule
• Each soil check says roughly how much water to give, from the pot size and the kind of plant
• Choose your city: reminders adjust for heat, cold and rain, and forecast rain never marks a plant as watered
• Add your room temperature and humidity for indoor plants
• A daily care reminder plus per-plant reminders at the times you choose

IDENTIFY AND CHECK PLANT HEALTH
• Take up to three photos to identify a plant
• Plant Doctor suggests possible causes for yellow leaves, spots, wilting and more, shows how sure it is about each one, and asks for another angle when it isn't sure
• A recovery journal follows a sick plant with dated photos and reminds you to take a follow-up photo

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed: your garden lives on your phone. Sign in to back it up and restore it on a new phone
• Photos are sent only when you allow photo analysis for a scan
• Light readings stay on your phone; the light meter deletes its photo as soon as it has read the exposure
• Export or delete your data any time in Settings

Plant guidance is informational. Photo assessments suggest possible causes, not a certain diagnosis. Never eat a plant or mushroom based on an app.

Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0). Plant identification by Kindwise.

Questions or feedback: fernlyfarm@gmail.com

name: Fib Club: Party Bluffing Games
description:
Fib Club is the party game for people who think they can keep a straight face.
