One of you is the imposter. Everyone else knows something they don't. Talk it out, spot who is fibbing, and vote them out before they bluff their way to a win.

START IN SECONDS
No account, no sign-up, no waiting. Open the app, add your friends, and play. Works offline, so it is perfect for trains, camping trips and house parties.

ONE PHONE OR EVERYONE'S PHONE
Pass a single phone around the group, or create a room and let everyone join from their own device with a four-letter code. Cast the game to a TV with the Fib Club display page so the whole room can follow along.

THE GAMES
- Classic Imposter: everyone gets the secret word except one player. Describe it without giving it away.
- Question Imposter: everyone answers the same question, except the imposter only has a hint. Whose answer doesn't fit?
- Who Dis?: a name on every card, and one player sees a question mark.
- Exposed: how well do you really know each other? Answer, guess and find out.

BUILT FOR 3 TO 20 PLAYERS
Small group or full-on party, the games scale with your table.

PACKS FOR EVERY CROWD
Pick from clean everyday packs, or switch on spicier ones for adults.

FIB CLUB PLUS
Unlock every game and every pack. Rules for Plus games are always free to read. In rooms, only the host needs Plus.
- Annual: £19.99 per year, with a 3-day free trial
- Weekly: £4.99 per week
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://fibclub.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://fibclub.app/privacy

name: FieldProof - Site Inspection
description:
FieldProof is an offline inspection and photo-report tool for contractors, home inspectors, property managers and site supervisors.

FEATURES
• Project title, client and site
• Items with title, notes, recommendation and photo
• Automatic timestamp
• PDF report with cover, photos and notes
• Share or save to Files
• Saved locally; photos never uploaded
• Chinese / English, iPhone + iPad
• No account, no ads, no subscription

The report is for field documentation; it does not replace formal inspection, code review or professional advice.

name: Fieldwing: Butterfly Journal
description:
Fieldwing is a field journal for anyone who stops to watch a butterfly.

It brings together the four things a lepidopterist actually keeps: a species list, a dated record of sightings, a life-cycle diary for rearing, and a specimen catalogue — in one calm, paper-inspired app that works entirely offline.

**A library to learn from**
Start with 46 carefully written butterfly and moth profiles, from the Monarch and Old World Swallowtail to the Luna Moth and Death's-head Hawk-moth. Each entry includes scientific classification, wingspan, flight season, rarity, conservation status, range, larval host plants and identification notes, illustrated with a plate drawn procedurally for that species. Add your own species, colour plates, photos and notes at any time.

**A log that remembers the details**
Record the date and time, location, coordinates pinned on a map, habitat, weather, temperature, behaviour, sex, life stage, count, host plant, tags and up to four photographs. Search the log by species, place, tag or note. Star the sightings you want to remember, share them, and revisit the conditions of a perfect afternoon years later.

**Follow a caterpillar all the way**
Rearing records follow egg, five larval instars, pre-pupa, pupa and adult. Each stage entry keeps a date, note and optional photo, so the days in each stage are counted for you. Mark a batch as emerged, released or unsuccessful and see your rearing success rate in Insights.

**A real specimen catalogue**
Catalogue numbers are assigned automatically in the `FW-26-0001` format. Record sex, collection date and locality, collector, method, preservation, condition, storage drawer and determination status. Fieldwing generates a collection label with a Code 128 barcode, shares a single label or exports a full A4 sheet of labels as a PDF — ready for the drawer or the printer.

**Know your patch**
The host-plant library links 71 trees, shrubs, herbs, vines and grasses to the species that use them, with your own plant photos and notes. The field map shows every geotagged record. Insights turns the season into a life-list ring, a monthly chart, family and life-stage breakdowns, hotspots, a host-plant leaderboard and a collection health check.

**Private by design**
No account. No analytics. No ads. No cloud. Your journal lives in UserDefaults on your device, and you can export a complete JSON backup or CSV files whenever you like.

name: Finn by OZ Maritime
description:
Finn by OZ Maritime is the customer portal of OZ Maritime, the marine safety service company. It shows the expiry date of every safety certificate across your fleet, reminds you before anything runs out, and lets you follow each service on board as it happens. Quotations, purchase orders and invoices are handled in the same place, on the office screen and on the bridge.

An OZ Maritime customer account is required to sign in. To request access or a demo, write to finn@ozmaritime.com.

NEVER MISS AN EXPIRY
- One calendar for every certificate and service date across the fleet: overdue, due within 60 days, valid
- Reminders 90, 60, 30, 14, 7 or 1 day before, in the app and by e-mail
- Your own vessel documents with your own reminders
- A monthly fleet summary: what has expired, what is coming up, what awaits your approval

SEE EVERY JOB AS IT HAPPENS
- Technician attendance: day and time, and any change
- Service completed notice with a short summary
- Critical findings reported at once, not with the final report
- Key photos from the job

FROM REQUEST TO INVOICE
- Quotation request in one tap
- Approve online with your PO number; revisions show exactly what changed
- Invoices: paid, due and overdue, with totals per currency

MADE FOR THE SHIP, NOT ONLY THE OFFICE
- Weekly and monthly LSA-FFE checks on a phone, with a dated record
- Defect report with a photo, straight to the vessel's OZ Maritime contact
- Next ports and ETA, so the service is planned around your route
- Messages per vessel and a 24/7 emergency button

READY WHEN THE INSPECTOR BOARDS
- A QR code on every OZ Maritime certificate proves it is genuine
- Inspection pack: current certificates and the latest service reports in one file

ASK FINN
Ask about your fleet in plain language, for example "Which certificates expire within 60 days?". Finn answers from your own vessels' records. Before anything is sent to Finn, the app asks for your permission.

YOUR COMPANY, YOUR RULES
- Your company sees only its own vessels and documents
- Office, ship and administrator roles; you choose who sees which vessel
- Two-step sign-in for portal administrators and ship users
- Optional Face ID lock and notifications on your iPhone and iPad
- The portal works in English, Turkish, Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Greek

OZ Maritime services lifesaving and fire-fighting equipment on board ships from Türkiye and Europe.

name: Firefly Garden: Glow Puzzle
description:
A garden at night. Some flowers glow with fireflies, some are dark. Tap a flower and it switches, along with the flowers around it: dark ones light up, lit ones go dark. Light every flower to wake the garden.

One rule, no timer, no lives. Just a quiet "aha!" in every garden.

SIX GARDENS, SIX FLOWERS
Each garden brings a new flower with its own power:
• Daisy: switches itself and its four sides
• Lily Pad: switches itself and its four diagonals
• Blossom Tree: switches its whole row
• Mushroom Ring: switches the eight around it, but not itself
• Stone: can't be tapped and never lights, so gardens take new shapes
• Night Flower: must end the puzzle dark
180 gardens that grow from 3×3 to 7×7, and a new daily garden every day.

THREE STARS FOR THE FEWEST TAPS
Every garden can be solved, and each one knows its shortest solution. Match it for three stars. Undo and Restart are always free, so you can keep trying as long as you like.

HINT FIREFLIES
Stuck? A hint firefly lights one flower from the shortest solution. Earn coins for every new star and spend them on hints.

MADE TO FEEL CALM
• Glowing flowers and drifting fireflies on a deep night sky
• A soft chime on every tap that rises as the garden fills
• Press and hold a flower to preview what it will switch
• Gentle haptics; sound and haptics can be switched off

PLAY ANYWHERE
No ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking, no sign-up. Works offline. Your progress is saved on your iPhone and comes back even if you reinstall.

GAME CENTER
Signed in to Game Center? Your total stars count on the leaderboard.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/gamerkit/home
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Flare – 80s Brass Synth
description:
Flare is a 6-voice analog-style polysynth for iPhone and iPad with two oscillators per voice, built for one sound first: big 80s sync brass. Bright, punchy and wide – and everything else a classic two-oscillator polysynth does.

SOUND ENGINE
• 6 voices, two oscillators each, with sync and cross-modulation
• Mixer with an envelope on the second oscillator
• Resonant 24 dB low-pass filter plus a high-pass filter
• Two envelopes, LFO with delay, noise
• Velocity dynamics on the envelopes and level
• Stereo chorus

ONE CONTROL PER PARAMETER Every parameter has its own slider or switch on the panel, laid out like a classic hardware programmer. No menus to dig through.

PLAY IT YOUR WAY
• Poly, unison and solo modes, portamento
• Aftertouch to vibrato, brilliance or volume
• Bend and mod wheels and an on-screen keyboard in three sizes – or hide it and play from your MIDI keyboard
• The full panel on iPad, a dedicated landscape layout on iPhone

SOUNDS
• 32 built-in presets: sync brass, brass sections, leads, pads, strings, basses, bells and keys
• Import classic 80s .syx tone banks and audition every tone with a tap
• Favourites, rename and export your own presets

CONNECT
• Standalone app and AUv3 instrument for your favourite host app
• Compact plugin window for small AUv3 views, on iPad and iPhone
• One purchase for iPhone and iPad
• MIDI on any channel, SysEx tone dumps in (check: parameter changes out)
• USB, network and Bluetooth MIDI

THREE LOOKS Pick the 80s, Classic or Era panel. The sound stays the same.

Flare is made by Maxcommerce in the Netherlands.

name: Flercee
description:
Every little space has the potential to become something beautiful.

Flercee is a community for those who find joy in growing things, making the most of small spaces, and bringing a little more green into everyday life.

From a sunny balcony to a quiet windowsill, discover fresh inspiration for your own little garden. Explore creative planting ideas, find plants that suit your space, and see how others turn ordinary corners into personal green retreats.

Share your designs, thoughts, and growing moments with a community that appreciates the beauty of every little leaf. Make plans for what you'd love to grow, keep track of the plants you care for, and watch your small garden take shape, one moment at a time.

Whether you're just starting with your first plant or already have a little green corner of your own, there's always something new to discover.

A little space. A little green. A lot of life.

Welcome to Flercee.

name: FlickerStarStitch
description:
Warm grass, crickets, and a field full of fireflies, each one glowing with a small number. Put your finger on 1. Without lifting it, glide to 2, then 3, then 4, and a golden thread follows you from light to light.

Close the last one and the whole shape peels off the meadow and floats up into the night, a new constellation of your own making.

It sounds easy for about a second. The fireflies wander while you draw. Their glow slowly fades, so a slow hand loses the last few to the dark. The rose-coloured ones are shy and slip away from your thread unless you come at them with purpose. And if you lift your finger, the thread snaps. Each meadow is a small plan: where to start curving, which drifting light to grab before it is too far away.

What you will find:
- 48 constellations across four chapters, Meadow's Edge, Willow Brook, Hayloft Rise and Old Orchard
- Every meadow checked solvable before you see it
- Up to three stars for a quick, clean stroke
- A Sky Album that keeps the exact star picture you stitched for every level
- Tonight's Sky, a new daily meadow shared by every player, with a nightly board
- Endless Meadow, round after round of wilder skies
- The Star Keepers board for all-time scores, under a name chosen for you

Celesta notes rise with each connection over soft night pads, and a light sparkle of haptics marks every stitch, swelling warmly when a picture is complete. The first level shows you how by letting you do it.

It plays offline, with no account, no ads and no in-app purchases. Settle into the grass and catch the light while it lasts.

name: Flight Lady: Flight Deals
description:
Flight Lady finds rare flight deals from your home city, and the cheapest real dates to fly them.

Pick your departure city and a dream place. Flight Lady then shows the deals from your city: mistake fares,
flash sales and prices far below the usual price.

For each deal, Flight Lady checks the live prices on Google Flights and shows:
- The price, and the usual price range for that route
- The cheapest dates, on a calendar
- The airline, the stops and the flight time

Tap a date to book it on Google Flights. Flight Lady does not sell tickets, so you always book with the airline
or the booking site that you pick.

Flight Club membership: 7 days free, then $39.99 a year. You pay on the Flight Lady website, and you can cancel at
any time in Settings, Membership.

Terms: https://flightlady.com/terms/
Privacy: https://flightlady.com/privacy/

name: Flowiax Call
description:
No more buzzers, no more waiting at the counter. At restaurants that use Flowiax, scan the QR on your receipt or at the counter with the camera, pick your number, and that is it: your order shows on the lock screen and your phone rings when it is ready.

• No sign-up: no name, e-mail or phone number.
• On the lock screen: your order number and its state, live.
• Rings until you see it: the alert comes back every 30 seconds until you tap «I got the call».
• Several orders at once: in a food court, follow orders from different restaurants in one place.
• Mall points: earn points at any restaurant of the mall and spend them at any of them, with a six-digit code at the counter.
• The restaurant’s offers, menu, WhatsApp and Instagram, and a rating after pickup.

No restaurant nearby? Tap «Try a demo order»: your phone rings in 45 seconds.

Flowiax is the restaurant system that turns your phone into the buzzer.

name: Fold Club
description:
Clocked out? One quick round.

Fold Club is a pocket arcade: a dozen-plus minigames that are over in two or three minutes. Kill time on your own, or settle the score with friends.

CHUNKY 3D MACHINES
• Claw Machine: five coins, a messy pile of plushies. Line up the shadow, then drop.
• Night Pinball: fire the marble, tilt your phone, and watch it really drift.
• Bar Slide: push the mug and let go. Stop closest to the coaster, or send it off the end of the bar.
• Crate Stacker, Clock-In Dash, Boss Alert… every cabinet is a little 3D model.

SHARP EYES, FAST HANDS
• Spot the Swap: two cabinets. What changed?
• Cash Counter: a stack of bills with fakes mixed in. How many can you count in fifteen seconds?
• To-Do Smasher and Whack a Jerk: clear out today’s to-dos, and today’s jerks.

BETTER ON IPHONE DUO
• Angle Master: asked for 87 degrees? Fold your phone to exactly that, by feel.
• Mosquito Clap: the moment it lands, snap your phone shut.
• Sneak Peek: open to start the clock, close when you think time is up.
• Half open on a table, the screen splits around the hinge: one half to watch, one half to press.
Every other game plays on any iPhone or iPad.

PLAY ONLINE
Connect through Game Center. 2 to 4 players at one table, the host picks a game, everyone gets the exact same challenge, and the top score takes the round. Every game has a leaderboard.

ALSO
• Four games on Apple Watch.
• On devices with Apple Intelligence, the bartender has a freshly made remark about your score.
• English and Traditional Chinese.

PRO
Free to download, with most games ready to play. Pro is a one-time purchase (not a subscription) that unlocks the Pro-only games and removes the ads in the lobby. Family Sharing supported.

More minigames are on the way.

name: Folhito: Plants and Self-Care
seller_name: WILTON RIBEIRO CRISPIM NETO & CIA LTDA
description:
Folhito turns your real houseplants into little pets with a personality. You water them, and they check on you. It's plant care and self-care in one cozy routine: watering reminders, a 30-second mood check-in and a private journal that fills itself as you go.

BRING YOUR PLANTS TO LIFE
Snap a photo of a houseplant and Folhito recognises the species. Then it hatches as a character with its own personality, quirk and voice. Your snake plant might be royalty. Your pothos, a sunny optimist. Your cactus, a sarcastic roommate.
• 20 personalities, from Dramatic Diva to Stoic Elder
• Give each plant a name and a pot, and watch it react to you

YOU CARE FOR THEM
• Watering reminders in your plant's own voice: "I'm wilting over here. Dramatically. A sip, please?"
• See at a glance who's thirsty and when each one drinks next
• Every watering gets a happy thank-you (and the occasional diva moment)

THEY CARE FOR YOU
• After each watering, your plant asks how you are: a 30-second check-in on your mood and what you did for yourself
• One small question a day, like "What tiny thing are you enjoying this week?", and a reply in your plant's voice
• Your moods and answers become a mood journal, with a calendar of your days
• A gentle self-care streak, with a rest day every week for when life gets busy

GROW TOGETHER
• Your friendship with each plant grows with care and never goes down
• Level up together and unlock pots, hats, accessories and cozy scenes
• No guilt, ever. Missing a day is fine

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your journal is yours. No one on our team reads it.
• No feed, no likes, no ads.
• Your plants' replies to what you write are made by Folhito's AI, and you can report any reply that feels off.

FOLHITO+
Your first plant comes with everything above at no cost. Folhito+ is an optional subscription, monthly or yearly, that adds more plants and nine exclusive looks, and helps keep Folhito going for everyone. Both plans start with a 7-day trial and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your App Store account settings.

A GENTLE NOTE
Folhito is a self-care companion for everyday wellbeing. It is not therapy and not a medical device, and it does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition. If you are going through a hard time, please reach out to a health professional. Folhito is for people aged 18 or older.

Terms: https://wndevelopmentservices.com/#/terms_and_conditions/en/folhito
Privacy: https://wndevelopmentservices.com/#/privacy_policy/en/folhito

name: Folido
description:
Folido brings your file tools together in one app: PDF, images, scanning, text recognition and ZIP archives. Everything happens on your iPhone or iPad, with no account and nothing uploaded: your files never leave the device.

PDF TOOLS
• Merge PDFs; reorder, rotate and delete pages
• Split or extract pages
• Number pages, add a watermark
• Sign with your finger or Apple Pencil
• Flatten filled-in forms
• Compress a PDF, protect it with a password or remove the password
• PDF to images (JPEG, PNG, HEIC), images to PDF with searchable text

BATCH IMAGES
• Convert to JPEG, PNG or HEIC, set size and quality
• Remove GPS location and metadata before sharing
• Rotate, mirror, add a watermark

SCAN AND READ TEXT
• Scan documents with the camera into a searchable PDF
• Text recognition (OCR) for a PDF or an image
• Text, RTF or HTML to PDF

ALSO
• ZIP archive of the files you choose
• Folido folder visible in the Files app
• Actions for the Shortcuts app
• Drag and drop and sidebar on iPad
• Works offline, light and dark, 45 languages

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no server: conversions, compression and text recognition run on your device
• Only advertising uses the network

FREE, AND AD-FREE IF YOU WISH
Folido is free and funded by a banner ad. An optional short video gives 6 hours without ads. Every feature stays free: the optional Ad-Free subscription only removes ads. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, from your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Foreman: Remote Agents
description:
Foreman puts the coding agents running on your Mac onto your iPhone. Send one prompt and watch the agent read code, edit files, and run commands in your project. When it needs permission, approve it from your phone.

- 6 agents supported: WorkBuddy, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Trae CN, and Qoder CN
- Streamed replies and tool cards: thinking, tool calls, and command output arrive live
- Approve on your phone: file writes and commands wait for your confirmation before running on the Mac
- Live simulator preview: start a simulator remotely and tap or swipe it from your phone
- Remote desktop: view and control your Mac desktop
- Remote build and install: trigger an Xcode build and install the new build on the connected iPhone
- Photos, video, and dictation: attach from the camera or library, or hold to talk with on-device transcription
- Multiple Macs and workspaces: pair several Macs and switch pinned or recent workspaces
- Inbox, archived sessions, notifications, widgets, and Live Activities
- End-to-end encryption with X25519 and AES-256-GCM; the relay only forwards ciphertext

WHO IT IS FOR
- Developers running AI coding agents on a Mac
- Anyone who wants to monitor tasks, approve permissions, and collect results away from the desk
- iOS developers who need to check the simulator remotely

WHY FOREMAN
- It connects to your own Mac and the agents you are already signed in to, so your projects, dependencies, and sessions stay where they are
- Permission checks stay on your phone, and long tasks can wait behind a push alert
- One app for several Macs, several agents, and several workspaces
- Built on a common agent protocol, so you are not locked to one model or vendor

FREE TIER AND FOREMAN PRO
- The free tier includes 20 chat messages per month, counted on-device by calendar month
- Push alerts are available to everyone and are not a subscription benefit
- Pro unlocks unlimited chat, per-task model selection, live simulator preview, remote desktop, multiple Macs, and remote build and install

BEFORE YOU START
- Install the Foreman desktop app on your Mac and complete pairing
- The coding agent you use must already be installed and signed in on that Mac
- A local demo is available from the pairing screen, so you can try the full flow without a Mac

PRIVACY FIRST
Code, transcripts, and command output travel encrypted only between your iPhone and your Mac. The relay cannot read them.

Privacy Policy: https://github.com/wangzz/md-doc/blob/main/Foreman/PRIVACY_POLICY.md
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: FormatWord
description:
Format any Word (.docx) document to the right standard in one tap. FormatWord helps students, lecturers and office staff format theses, dissertations, reports and administrative documents in seconds instead of hours of manual work.

WHY FORMATWORD
• Standards of 78 Vietnamese universities: HaUI, HUST, NEU, PTIT, TDTU, FTU, UEH, HCMUT, FPT and many more. Detects your university from the cover page.
• Vietnamese administrative documents per Decree 30/2020/ND-CP: margins, fonts, line spacing and page numbers exactly as required.
• International styles: APA 7, IEEE, Harvard, MLA.
• Exams and tests: detected automatically and laid out neatly.

AUTOMATIC FORMATTING
• Margins, fonts, sizes, line spacing and indentation for each standard.
• Detects headings (Chapter, 1.1, 1.1.1…) and builds an automatic table of contents.
• Roman page numbers for front matter, Arabic numbers for the main body.
• Proper table and figure captions.
• Cleans text pasted from ChatGPT or the web: removes stray formatting, odd characters and extra spaces.
• Fine-tune every setting when you need to.

WORD VIEWER & EDITOR
• Open, view and quickly edit .docx files on iPhone and iPad.
• Compare before and after, share the result via Files, Mail and more.
• History: revisit and reopen processed files.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• 100% on-device processing, works offline. Your documents never leave your device.
• No account, no tracking, no data collection.

COMPLETELY FREE
No subscription, no ads, no in-app purchases.

How to use: open FormatWord → pick a .docx from Files → choose a standard (or let the app detect it) → tap “Format now” → save or share.

Web version: formatword.com

name: FrameFerry
description: Record edit segments with an in point, an exclusive out point and a frame rate. FrameFerry calculates the frame count and elapsed seconds. Choose 24, 25, 30 or 60 fps, or 29.97 drop-frame. Save segments by name and compare running-time totals grouped by rate. The tool works with timecodes within the same day and requires no access to your footage. Your log stays on this device.

name: FretGauge
description:
FretGauge is an offline luthiery geometry and string tension workbench built for guitar makers, bass builders, repair techs, and players who dial in custom setups.

Design exact 12-TET and multi-scale fanned-fret fingerboards, balance per-string tension with Mersenne physics, compute bridge saddle setback compensation, and store repeatable workshop builds right in your pocket.

SCALE CAD BLUEPRINT
- Draft straight-scale or multi-scale fanned-fret fingerboards from 22.5 to 38.0 inches across bass and treble sides.
- Pick any perpendicular fret from nut (0) to fret 27 and watch nut and bridge slant angles update live.
- Touch or drag along the interactive fingerboard blueprint to inspect exact fret distances, fret-to-fret steps, slant angles, and tapered board widths.
- Switch between exact 12-TET math and the traditional 17.817 workshop rule, toggle millimeters or inches, and export full fret schedules as CSV.

STRING TENSION EQUALIZER
- Evaluate per-string and total neck pull across 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8-string instruments in kilograms-force or pounds.
- Choose from curated tuning presets or transpose individual strings semitone by semitone and test virtual capo positions up to fret 7.
- Select core and wrap alloys including Nickel-Plated Steel, Pure Nickel, Stainless Steel, Phosphor Bronze, 80/20 Bronze, and Fluoro-Carbon / Nylon.
- Run the one-tap Auto-Balance solver with customizable target tension and progressive bass taper to match string gauges evenly across any fanned or standard scale.

SETUP & BREAK-ANGLE DESK
- Calculate saddle setback compensation offsets based on 12th-fret bass and treble action, fret crown height, and string core stiffness.
- Track neck relief against your active playing profile and see truss-rod load deltas relative to a standard baseline set.
- Visualize headstock nut and bridge saddle break-angle ray diagrams to prevent buzz or excessive friction.

OFFLINE BENCH ARCHIVE & SPEC PDFS
- Start immediately with five pre-loaded reference instruments, or save, duplicate, search, and filter your own builds.
- Compare any two builds side-by-side with overlaid tension curves and scale metrics.
- Export vector Luthiery Bench Spec Sheet PDFs and JSON blueprints on demand.

FretGauge runs completely offline with zero accounts, zero subscriptions, and zero tracking.

name: Front Desk Sign: Kiosk Display
description:
Front Desk turns an iPhone or iPad into the sign your counter, lobby or door is missing. Pick a template, type your details, and show it full screen. There is no account, no subscription and no internet connection needed.

SEVEN SIGNS, READY IN SECONDS
• Welcome: greet visitors with a headline and a short note.
• Opening Hours: your week at a glance. A badge switches between "Open now" and "Closed" by itself and tells visitors when you open next.
• Now Serving: a ticket number you advance with a tap, with an optional chime and spoken announcement.
• Open / Closed: any two states you flip with a tap. Available and In Use, Free and Busy, On Air and Off Air.
• Guest Wi‑Fi: a QR code guests scan with their camera to join your network. No more spelling out the password.
• Back Soon: a return time with a live countdown.
• Message: big text that fills the screen, still or scrolling.

MADE TO BE LEFT RUNNING
• The screen stays awake while a sign is showing.
• Rotation cycles through several signs on a timer.
• Hold to Show Controls keeps a passing tap from closing your sign.
• Works in portrait and landscape on iPhone and iPad.
• Use a keyboard's arrow keys to call the next number from behind the counter.
• Includes step-by-step instructions for locking the device to your sign with Guided Access.

YOURS TO STYLE
• Twelve color themes and four typefaces.
• A live preview while you edit.
• Share any sign as an image to print or post.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Front Desk collects no data. Your signs, including your Wi‑Fi details, stay on your device. There are no ads, no analytics and no sign-up.

FOR ORGANIZATIONS
Front Desk supports managed app configuration. Send signs and settings from your device management (MDM) server, open straight into full screen on kiosk devices, and lock editing on shared ones. It pairs well with Single App Mode.

One purchase. Yours to keep.

name: Fuel Rush: Gas Station
description:
Fuel Rush is a quick, tactile time‑management game about a small petrol station during a fuel crisis.

Cars line up on the road, each with its tank on the left or the right. Drag the first car in line to a pump on the matching side, keep an eye on four fuel tanks, and order a tanker before the rumours send everyone rushing for the same fuel. Every shift is two and a half minutes of real decisions: which lane to free, which fuel to restock, when to let the lorry in.

Thirty days of crisis, each a little denser than the last. Earn coins, buy a second, third and fourth pump, waiting places, attendants, a bigger tanker, pay‑at‑pump and more. Earn up to three stars a day. When the crisis is over, move to a new town and do it again with loyal regulars behind you.

• One‑finger drag controls, built for the phone
• Four fuels, panic waves, tankers that take time to arrive
• A lorry a day: a long fill for a big payout, if you can spare the lane
• Seventeen upgrades from waiting places to a separate tanker bay
• A 30‑day crisis, then a new station with denser traffic and loyal regulars
• Plays offline, no ads, no in‑app purchases, no data collected
• English, Russian and Serbian

name: Fuse Boxe
description:
Fuse Boxe is a puzzle about having too little and wanting too much.

Each board is a small town with one fuse box in the middle. The box holds a fixed amount of charge, and every house, oven, mill and workshop around it draws some of that charge and matters a certain amount. There is never enough to go round. Drag a wire from the box to a building, or simply tap the building, and watch the meter fill. When the town is wired the way you want, light it up and see how close you came.

Every board has one best wiring. Find it for three marks, or come within a tenth of it for two.

Eighty boards are spread over eight districts, and each district adds one new idea. Long wires cost charge for every segment. Some buildings only work while a partner is lit. Some pairs let you light one or the other, never both. Later on, several fuse boxes share a town, the charge arrives in turns, draws change from one turn to the next, and a jar keeps leftover charge for later.

Your Home brings your own things into the game. Photograph the kettle, the laptop or the record player, say how much each one draws and how much it matters to you, and Fuse Boxe builds a board from them. You can share a picture of the finished board.

Once the districts are behind you, a long mode keeps sending new towns until your three spare fuses have blown, and Records keeps every mark you have earned.

Terms of Use: https://tuesdayaudit.pics/fuseboxe/termsofuse/
Privacy Policy: https://tuesdayaudit.pics/fuseboxe/privacypolicy/

name: Galaxy Nexus
seller_name: GALAXY TECHNOLOGY SERVICES JOINT STOCK COMPANY
description:
Galaxy Nexus is an HR app for employees of organizations that use Galaxy Nexus. Check in, submit requests and approve them right from your phone.

Accounts are provided by your organization; there is no public sign-up.

ATTENDANCE
• Check in and out by location or your organization's Wi-Fi network.
• View your attendance history by day and by month.
• Submit attendance corrections for missed or incorrect check-ins.

REQUESTS
• Submit leave, work-from-home, business trip and other requests.
• Attach files, save drafts and track each approval step.
• Comment and mention colleagues right in the request.

APPROVALS
• Approve or reject employee requests.
• Get notified when a new request arrives or yours has been decided.

REPORTS
• View working days, late arrivals, early departures and remaining leave.
• Managers can view their team's attendance.

PROFILE
• View your personal information, organization details and org chart.

COURSES
• View assigned courses and check in to sessions by scanning a QR code.

name: Galaxy Tycoon: Space Miner
description:
Build a mining empire across the stars.

Start with one small planet and a single ship. Put miners to work, send haulers back and forth to your mothership, and sell the ore for credits. Reinvest everything: better drills, bigger holds, faster engines, more ships. Before long, a whole fleet is flying routes across your galaxy.

MINE AND HAUL
• Chart planets, each with its own ore
• Upgrade drills and miners, and expand your hangar
• Watch your ships fly, load and unload in real time

CRAFT AND TRADE
• Smelt ore into bars in the Refinery
• Turn bars into rare materials in the Lab
• Upgrade your mothership's trade hub for better prices

HIRE MANAGERS
• Managers run your planets, docks and workshops for you
• Each has their own bonus and a special ability
• Collect rarer managers and level them up

WARP TO NEW GALAXIES
• Build the Warp Gate to leave your galaxy behind
• Every new galaxy has its own planets, and brings new challenges
• Earn dark matter for upgrades that stay with you forever

AND MORE
• Pirate raids that test your defences in later galaxies
• Events like solar flares, rich veins and meteor showers
• Quests, milestones and daily rewards
• Your fleet keeps earning while you're away

Galaxy Tycoon is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases.

name: GastroPOS Mitarbeiter
description:
GastroPOS Mitarbeiter verbindet dich mit deinem Mitarbeiterportal – direkt auf deinem Smartphone.

• Starte und beende deine Arbeitszeit und erfasse Pausen.
• Wähle beim Schichtstart deinen zugewiesenen Standort aus.
• Reiche Urlaubsanträge ein und verfolge ihren Status und die Entscheidung.
• Sieh Mitteilungen deiner Verwaltung ein.

Für die Anmeldung benötigst du die Betriebskennung und dein Mitarbeiterportal-Konto. Dein Arbeitgeber richtet den Zugang ein. Für die Nutzung ist eine Internetverbindung erforderlich.

name: GearRatio: Tyre & Gear Calc
description:
Fitted bigger tyres? Your speedometer is now lying to you, and GearRatio tells you by exactly how much.

Type the size your vehicle came on and the size on it now. You get the speedometer error, the diameter change, revs per kilometre or mile, and a drawing of both tyres to true scale.

WHAT IT WORKS OUT

- Speedometer error, the figure you get fined for
- Overall diameter and the difference, in millimetres or inches
- Revolutions per kilometre or mile
- Engine speed in every gear, at any road speed
- Crawl ratio, with what it means for off-road use
- The exact differential ratio that restores your original gearing

All of that is free. Every calculation, always.

MEASURE INSTEAD OF GUESSING

A tyre marked 35 inches usually measures nearer 34.5. That gap is the single biggest source of error there is, far bigger than anything in the arithmetic. So GearRatio lets you enter what yours actually measures, three ways: across it, around it with a tape, or by rolling it one full turn. A measured size then overrides its label everywhere in the app.

GEARRATIO PRO, ONE PAYMENT, NO SUBSCRIPTION

- Every ratio your axle actually sells, side by side, each with its crawl ratio, its motorway revs and how far it lands from stock gearing, and a flag when it needs a new carrier as well as gears
- A speedometer card for the car: every limit you drive to and what to hold the needle on, shareable to your notes or printable for the glovebox
- More than one saved vehicle

SIXTEEN AXLES, OR YOUR OWN

Dana 30, 35, 44 and 60. Ford 8.8 inch and 9 inch. GM 14-bolt. Land Rover Rover axle and Salisbury 8 inch. Nissan H233B and C200. Suzuki Samurai. Toyota 8.2 inch, 8 inch high-pinion, 9.5 inch and 8 inch IFS.

Not there? Add your own with the ratios your supplier lists, and the rest of the app works exactly the same.

BUILT TO BE RIGHT

Ratios are calculated from tooth counts where those are known, not from the number printed on the box. Axle availability comes from gear makers' and suppliers' catalogues, cross-checked where they overlap. "How the numbers are worked out" in Settings shows the method and says plainly which parts are approximations and which are exact.

No account. No analytics. No ads. Nothing leaves your phone.

English, Ellinika, Deutsch, Espanol, Francais.

name: Geotakt
seller_name: Jakobs & Dingel Real Estate Advisory GmbH
description:
Geotakt ist die Mitarbeiter-App für Unternehmen, die Arbeitszeiten, Planung und Kommunikation an einem Ort bündeln – im Büro, in der Gastronomie, im Handwerk, im Einzelhandel, in der Reinigung oder in mehreren Filialen.

ARBEITSZEIT
• Arbeitsbeginn, Pausen und Feierabend mit einem Fingertipp
• Optional mit Standortprüfung beim Arbeitsbeginn – keine dauerhafte Ortung
• Funktioniert auch ohne Netz: Buchungen werden automatisch nachgesendet
• Zeitkonto mit Soll, Ist und Saldo jederzeit im Blick

PLANUNG
• Veröffentlichte Einsätze und Schichten im Kalender
• Urlaub, Freizeitausgleich und Krankmeldungen direkt in der App (ohne Diagnose)
• Korrekturen beantragen statt Zettelwirtschaft

ZUSAMMENARBEIT
• Aufgaben mit Checklisten, Fotos und Kommentaren
• Material- und Bedarfsanfragen
• Tätigkeitsberichte mit Fotos
• Gehaltsabrechnungen sicher abrufen
• Mitteilungen bei neuen Plänen, Genehmigungen und Aufgaben

FÜR ALLE
• 23 Sprachen, hell und dunkel, große Schrift

Geotakt setzt ein Unternehmenskonto voraus. Ihr Arbeitgeber lädt Sie ein und legt fest, welche Funktionen genutzt werden.

name: GetPlace: запись клиентов
description:
Без цен, «бесплатно» и упоминаний оплаты на сайте — Apple отклоняет направление к оплате цифровых услуг вне App Store (3.1.1 / 3.1.3).

GetPlace — CRM для мастеров и студий, которые работают по записи: маникюр и педикюр, парикмахерские услуги, брови и ресницы, массаж, косметология, репетиторы и другие специалисты.

Приложение для владельцев и сотрудников: расписание, клиенты и касса всегда под рукой.

ЗАПИСИ
• Расписание на неделю: кто, когда, на какую услугу
• Цифры дня: сколько записей и выручка сегодня
• Новая запись за минуту: клиент, услуга, мастер и свободное время
• Перенос, отмена с причиной, возврат отменённой записи
• Несколько услуг и мастеров в одной записи
• «Все / Мои» — для студий с несколькими сотрудниками

КЛИЕНТЫ
• Клиентская база с поиском по имени и телефону
• История визитов, скидки, группы, чёрный список
• Добавление клиента из контактов телефона
• Счёт клиента: предоплата и сдача на счёт

КАССА И ОПЛАТЫ КЛИЕНТОВ
• Отметка оплаты визита: наличные, карта или перевод
• Кассы, приход и расход, расходные материалы
• Абонементы: на количество визитов, на срок или на сумму

СТАТИСТИКА
• Выручка за месяц и сравнение с прошлым
• Средний чек, визиты, новые клиенты, отмены
• Заработок мастера за месяц

КОМАНДА
• Сотрудники, графики работы и права доступа
• Задачи с исполнителями и сроками
• Записи и задачи в календаре телефона

КЛИЕНТЫ БЕЗ ЗВОНКОВ
• Онлайн-запись на странице вашей студии
• Напоминания клиентам о визите в Telegram и ВКонтакте
• Рассылки клиентам об акциях и свободных окошках

Вход по паролю, Face ID или Touch ID, отдельные права доступа для каждого сотрудника.

name: Ghost Laps: One Tap Dodge Game
description:
Tap to switch lanes. Dodge your own past laps.

Ghost Laps is a one tap arcade game with one simple twist: every lap you finish comes back as a ghost that replays your moves. The further you go, the busier the track gets. How many laps can you survive?

It plays offline, with no wifi or internet needed. If you like dodge games or no wifi games, this one is for you. Purchases and the world leaderboard need a connection, the game itself does not.

HOW IT PLAYS
- One finger, two lanes, one circle track. Tap anywhere on the screen to switch.
- Finish a lap and it turns into a ghost on the track. Most ghosts copy the exact moves you made.
- A faint path shows where each ghost is heading, so you can plan ahead.
- Stuck between ghosts? Hold your finger down to Phase through them. Dodges and close calls fill the bar.
- Speed climbs every moment. It starts easy and gets hard so smoothly you barely notice.

ONE RUN, NO INTERRUPTIONS
It is one endless run. There are no modes to pick and nothing stops the run to ask you a question. After each level up you get a safe bonus lap with one perk in each lane. The lane you are in is the perk you get, so choosing is the same tap you already know.

ON THE TRACK
- 9 power-ups: Shield, Slow-mo, Magnet, Double Stars, Ghost Hunter, Tiny, Star Burst, Turbo and Mystery Box
- 13 perks that last for the rest of the run
- 3 more ghost types as you go deeper: Fast, Weaving and Twins
- Stars in lines, waves, steps and zigzags, with a PERFECT bonus for taking a whole shape
- Close calls build combos, and a x3 combo starts Fever
- Golden Stars and 4 kinds of bonus lap
- Music that adds layers the further you go

REASONS TO COME BACK
- Daily Challenge: a different twist each day, with the same stars and power-ups for everyone
- Today's Best resets every day, so there is always a number to beat
- Daily reward, lucky spin, 3 daily missions and 22 achievements
- Coins buy permanent upgrades, 17 dot skins, 12 trails and 10 track themes
- Share your lap card and challenge friends
- Light and dark mode

PURCHASES
You can revive with the coins you earn in the game.

Coin packs are available as in-app purchases. Ghost Laps Plus is an optional auto-renewing subscription, weekly, monthly or yearly: 2x coins from runs, 3 free revives per run, 200 coins a day, an extra daily spin, Streak Freeze, Past Challenges, monthly Recap and loyalty looks.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.bigbrain.ltd/p/ghost-laps-ios-privacy-policy.html

name: Giornata
description:
Wet plaster gives you one day. After that, the wall decides.

Giornata is a painting puzzle. Each day you lay a fresh patch of plaster and paint it before it dries. Mix earth pigments, fill each region, and watch the set line creep toward you.

Paint too slowly and the colour will not hold.

- Plan each day's patch, then race the drying plaster
- Six earth pigments to mix by hand
- Walls, lunettes and a curved vaulted ceiling
- Humid days and hot days that change the clock
- A gallery of finished walls
- A shared ceiling built from every player's work

Paint while it is wet.

name: GKS Geçiş Kontrol Sistemi
seller_name: REFERANSSOFT EGITIM YAZILIM DANISMANLIK LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
GKS, kurumların kullandığı GKS Geçiş Kontrol Sistemi'nin mobil uygulamasıdır. GKS kullanan okulların ve kamu kurumlarının görevlileri, öğrenci velileri ve öğrenciler aynı uygulamayı kullanır.

Uygulama yalnızca GKS kullanan kurumlarda çalışır. Giriş bilgileriniz kurumunuz tarafından tanımlanır. Veriler kurumunuzun kendi sunucusundan, GKS Gateway üzerinden şifreli bağlantıyla gelir.

TEK UYGULAMA, ÜÇ HESAP TÜRÜ
Aynı telefonda görevli, veli ve öğrenci hesaplarınızı yan yana tutabilir, hesap değiştirici ile aralarında geçebilirsiniz. Etkin hesabın türüne göre ilgili ekranlar açılır.

KURUM GÖREVLİLERİ İÇİN
Güvenlik görevlisi, resepsiyon, güvenlik amiri, birim yöneticisi (ör. okul müdürü), öğretmen ve sistem yöneticisi rolleri için. Giriş kurum kodu, kullanıcı adı ve şifre ile yapılır; kurum kodu QR ile de okutulabilir. Hangi ekranları göreceğiniz kurumunuzdaki yetkinize bağlıdır.
• Özet: içerideki kişi sayıları ve günün sayaçları
• Canlı akış: turnike ve kapılardan gelen geçişler anlık olarak
• Kişi arama ve kişi kartı, son geçişleriyle birlikte
• İçeridekiler: şu an kurumda bulunan kişiler
• Kapılar: yetki kapsamınızdaki kapılar ve onay adımıyla uzaktan kapı açma (yetkili hesaplarda)
• Görev yeri: nöbet tuttuğunuz kapıyı ya da binayı seçin, ekranlar o yere odaklansın
• Nöbet durumu ve görev geçmişi (amir ve yöneticiler için)
• Binalar ve alanlar: kim nerede
• Cihazlar: turnike ve okuyucu cihazların bağlantı durumu
• Bugün: günlük yoklama panosu ve yemek sayacı
• Sınıfım ve yoklama (öğretmenler), Sınıflar genel görünümü (okul idaresi)

VELİLER İÇİN
Giriş T.C. kimlik numaranız ve okulun kayıtlı telefonunuza SMS ile gönderdiği kod ile yapılır. Şifre gerekmez.
• Çocuklarım: okulda kayıtlı çocuklarınız
• Çocuğun günü: günün giriş, çıkış ve yemekhane hareketleri
• Bildirimler: son 30 günün hareket bildirimleri, uygulama içinde
• Bildirim tercihleri: her çocuk için giriş, çıkış ve yemek
• Farklı okullardaki çocuklarınız tek hesapta; her okul kendi SMS koduyla eklenir

ÖĞRENCİLER İÇİN
Giriş veli girişiyle aynıdır: T.C. kimlik numarası ve okulun kayıtlı telefona gönderdiği SMS kodu.
• Bugün: kendi giriş ve çıkışların

HERKES İÇİN
• Karekodum: turnikede okutulan kişisel karekod; telefonda ekran kilidi varsa Face ID, parmak izi ya da cihaz şifresiyle açılır
• Yemek menüsü: kurumun aylık yemek menüsü (kurum yayınlıyorsa)
• Uygulama kilidi: Face ID, parmak izi ya da cihaz şifresiyle
• Açık ve koyu tema, telefonun ayarına göre

GİZLİLİK VE GÜVENLİK
• Şifreniz telefonda saklanmaz. Oturum bilgileri cihazın güvenli deposunda (iOS Anahtar Zinciri, Android Keystore) tutulur.
• Kişi fotoğrafları yalnız bellekte ve en çok 5 dakika tutulur; galeriye kaydedilmez, paylaşılamaz.
• Android'de görevli ekranlarında ekran görüntüsü alınamaz.
• Reklam, izleme ya da üçüncü taraf analiz aracı yoktur.
• Veli ve öğrenci hesabı uygulama içinden silinebilir (Ayarlar > Hesabımı sil). Görevli hesapları kurum tarafından yönetilir.

Kurumunuz GKS kullanmıyorsa uygulama sizin için çalışmaz. Kurum kodunuzu ve giriş bilgilerinizi kurumunuzun GKS yöneticisinden alabilirsiniz.

name: Glasshearth
description:
The cottage is dark except for the hearth, and the copper pot of sugar is climbing past a hundred and forty degrees. On the board lie strawberries, grapes, a bruised cherry and a paring knife left in the way.

Draw one straight line and the skewer takes every fruit it crosses, handle to tip. The Baker's slip wants strawberry, grape, strawberry, so the angle has to be exact. Then hold the skewer in the sugar and lift it while the thermometer sits in the glass band. Too early and it stays sticky; a moment late and it turns to amber.

Apple wedges take a skewer only along their length, mandarin segments only through the thick middle, pineapple rings only through the hole. Each finished slip goes into a jar on the shelf, and the crystals scraped from the pot rim buy a copper pot that heats more slowly.

name: Glassy Hour
description:
Glassy Hour is the surf forecast built for the Canary Islands. More than 100 spots across all eight islands, each with a 15-day hour-by-hour forecast and a clear rating, from Flat to Epic, so you know at a glance whether it is worth the drive.

WHAT YOU GET
• A map of the whole archipelago with the wave height and rating of every spot right now.
• A 15-day forecast for each spot: height, period, power, swell direction, wind, gusts and tide, by part of the day or hour by hour.
• "Where to go": the best spot for the day, time and level you choose.
• Atlantic maps: where the swell comes from and when it arrives, plus wind on the coast with live stations.
• Alerts: get notified when your spot is the way you like it (minimum rating, time of day and days).
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widget with the best spot on your island or your favourite spot.
• No signal at the beach: the latest forecast stays saved on your iPhone.
• Create your spot: mark where your wave breaks and how it works, and get its forecast.

MADE FOR THE CANARY ISLANDS
Every spot takes into account where it faces, the swell that gets in, the shelter of the islands, the wind on its coast and the tide. The forecast is refreshed every 3 hours.

ALSO
• What wetsuit to wear based on water, wind and sun.
• First light, sunrise and sunset.
• Nearby webcams where available.
• In Spanish, English, French, Italian, Dutch and Portuguese.
• Free. Everything works without an account; with your email, favourites and alerts follow you to any device.

The forecast is a guide: the sea changes. Always check conditions before paddling out and know your limits.

name: Glava: Audiobook Player
description:
Glava is a player for the audiobooks you already own. No ads, no subscription, no listening limits, no account.

The app contains no books — it plays your files: MP3, M4B, M4A, AAC, FLAC, OGG, Opus, ZIP archives and folders of chapters.

ADD A BOOK IN ONE TAP
• From Telegram: open the file → Share → Glava
• From Files, iCloud Drive or any cloud that shows up in Files
• ZIP archives with folders, even a ZIP inside a ZIP — we unpack them for you
• The book shows up in your library right away, with import progress

NEVER LOSES YOUR PLACE
• Position is saved every five seconds and on every pause — even if iOS unloads the app or a call comes in
• Smart rewind: after a long pause we step back a few seconds so you catch the context
• Bookmarks with notes — one tap, or from the lock screen

CHAPTERS IN ORDER, TAGS READ RIGHT
• "Chapter 2" comes before "Chapter 10", not after
• Chapters from M4B, from tags or from file names — and you can always reorder by hand
• Legacy Cyrillic (Windows-1251) tags display correctly. We never modify your files
• Cover from the folder, from the tag, or your own from Photos

COMFORTABLE LISTENING
• Speed 0.5–3.0× in 0.1 steps, voice stays natural
• Sleep timer by minutes or to the end of the chapter, with fade-out; shake to add 10 minutes
• 15 / 30 second skips (adjustable), pause when headphones disconnect
• Lock screen, Control Center, widgets, Siri
• Dark theme for bedtime, light for daytime
• Interface in 15 languages

FREE. REALLY.
Glava is completely free: no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions. Every feature is available to everyone.

Your books stay on your phone. No account needed, and the app collects no data.

name: Glim: Anxiety & Stress Relief
description:
Feeling anxious, stressed, sad or just tired? Glim helps you feel better in 2 minutes. Say how you feel, read a few kind words, and do a gentle exercise picked for your mood. Free, with no account and no ads.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick your mood: calm, joyful, sad, anxious, angry or tired
• Read a few kind words, written for how you feel right now
• If you like, name what's on your mind, in one tap
• Do a short guided exercise, made for that mood
• Count one more gentle day

EXERCISES FOR EVERY MOOD
• Breathing exercises: box breathing, 4-7-8 breathing, cardiac coherence, physiological sigh, long exhale
• Grounding: the 5-4-3-2-1 senses exercise, feet grounding, hand on heart
• Gentle stretches, shown move by move by the mascot
• Gratitude: 3 good things, savor a moment, thank someone
Every exercise is guided step by step, with a timer and a calm rhythm to follow. Nothing to write, nothing to get right. New exercises every month.

A GENTLE COMPANION
Glim's little mascot changes with your mood. It greets you, comforts you and shows you each stretch. No pressure, no judgment: just a friendly moment for yourself.

GENTLE DAYS, NOT STREAKS
Every day you take a moment for yourself counts as a gentle day. The counter never goes down, even after a break. Come back whenever you need it.

YOUR WEEK AT A GLANCE
See your moods of the last 7 days, the exercises that helped you and the days you visited. No score and no comparison, just what you went through.

A DAILY REMINDER, IF YOU WANT IT
Choose a gentle nudge in the morning, at lunch or in the evening. You can turn it off at any time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• Your moods and your history stay on your phone
• We never collect your moods or what you share in the app
• No ads

WHEN IT'S REALLY NOT OKAY
A support screen is always one tap away, even offline, with what to do if you need help right now.

Glim is a self-care app for small daily moments. It is not a medical device and does not replace a doctor, a therapist or emergency services.

Available in English and French.

name: Glimby
description:
A little light. More local context.

Glimby helps you explore published police incident reports around an address using native Apple Maps. Choose a radius, filter categories, and read available incident dates, approximate locations and source information.

Save places as bookmarks on your device, then return to them whenever you want. Find walking directions with Apple Maps and continue navigation in Maps.

Available feeds include Chicago, San Francisco, Seattle, Los Angeles, New York City, and parts of England, Wales and Northern Ireland. Coverage is incomplete and publication is delayed. Source refresh dates and reporting limits are shown in the app. UK reports provide a month rather than an exact incident day.

Glimby does not provide a safety score, assess walking routes using crime data, monitor saved places, or send alerts. No reports does not mean no incidents. Reports are not findings of guilt, and locations may be approximate. Official registry searches open government websites; Glimby does not map personal registry records.

Free to use, with no account, subscription or advertising. Location permission is optional. Saved places stay on your device; search areas are sent to Glimby's service to retrieve reports. See our privacy policy for Apple Maps and hosting-provider data handling.

Also available through a free web explorer, JSON API and MCP server. See the website for connection details and the same source information and reporting limits.

name: GlobeFlakeHush
description:
You hold a glass globe in your hand. On its floor, faint as breath on a window, there is the outline of a little cabin. You give it a shake, and thousands of flakes fill the glass.

Now you guide them home.

Drag your finger around the globe and it tilts toward your touch. The snow follows gravity, drifting and fluttering as it falls, sliding along the curve of the glass when you lean. Rock it gently side to side and loose snow sweeps across the floor. Where it crosses the frosted picture, it clings and packs, a little at a time. Hold the globe still and everything settles where it lies, so choose your moment. Turn it right over to lift stubborn snow into the air and carry it somewhere new.

Each globe is scored on how much of the picture you filled and how little snow ended up outside it, with up to three stars and a small bonus for finishing before the globe hushes on its own.

Forty globes sit on the shelf, in four groups:

Still Air, where you learn to tilt, sweep and pack.
Gusts, where wind breathes through the glass and nudges the snow aside.
Berry & Frost, where coloured flakes only stick to their own coloured parts of the picture.
Twin Globes, where a glass wall splits the globe and you have to lift snow over it.

The pictures are small and friendly: a drift, a pine, a cabin with a chimney, a sitting fox, a snowman in a berry hat.

A new Daily Globe arrives each day, the same for everyone, and a second board adds up your best scores across every globe.

Soft celesta, sleigh bells, a hush of winter wind. Haptics that shimmer while the snow swirls and land with soft thuds. Nothing hurries you.

No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, and it plays offline. Pick up a globe and give it a shake.

name: Glow – 80s Chorus Synth
description:
Glow is a 6-voice analog-style polysynth for iPhone and iPad, built around the warm 80s chorus pad: slow PWM strings that shimmer, deep sub basses and soft brass.

SOUND ENGINE
• 6 voices, one oscillator each with saw, pulse with PWM, a sub oscillator and noise
• Stepped high-pass filter and a resonant 24 dB low-pass filter
• One envelope, LFO with delay
• Chorus I, II and both: the classic stereo shimmer

BANKS AND NUMBERS Pick sounds the 80s way: a bank button, a number button and a two-digit display.

PLAY IT YOUR WAY
• Poly and unison modes, portamento
• Bend and mod wheels and an on-screen keyboard in three sizes – or hide it and play from your MIDI keyboard
• The full panel on iPad, a dedicated landscape layout on iPhone

SOUNDS
• 32 built-in presets: pads, strings, brass, basses, leads, keys, bells and effects
• Import classic 80s .syx tone banks and audition every tone with a tap
• Favourites, rename and export your own presets

CONNECT
• Standalone app and AUv3 instrument for your favourite host app
• Compact plugin window for small AUv3 views, on iPad and iPhone
• One purchase for iPhone and iPad
• MIDI on any channel, SysEx tone dumps in
• USB, network and Bluetooth MIDI

THREE LOOKS Pick the 80s, Classic or Era panel. The sound stays the same.

Glow is made by Maxcommerce in the Netherlands.

name: Glowtube: Nixie Tube Clock
description:
A nixie tube clock for the desk and the nightstand, every tube drawn in code rather than filmed.

Inside each tube sit a glass dome, a honeycomb anode mesh and ten wire cathodes stacked one behind another. The lit digit glows warm orange through the ones in front of it, the idle digits catch a faint ghost of light behind, and a new digit strikes with the soft ignition of the real thing. A gentle flicker keeps the whole row breathing.

Lay your iPhone on its side, on a charging stand or propped against a lamp, and the tubes line up on a walnut or steel base. The controls fade away on their own; tap the tubes to bring them back.

• Clock in 12 or 24 hours, with or without seconds, and a blinking colon
• Timer with presets from 1 to 60 minutes, flashing tubes and a soft chime at zero
• Date in your region's order
• The Cathode Show: real tubes need every digit lit now and then to keep the cathodes clean, so at the top of each hour Glowtube sweeps through them one tube at a time and settles back on the time (or every 15 minutes, or never)
• Night mode dims the glow to a low red, with one tap or on your own schedule
• Keeps the screen on while charging, or all the time if you like
• Three glows (neon, ember, argon) and three bases (walnut, brushed steel, bare glass)
• Optional ticking and relay clicks, silent until you switch them on
• A looping video of the tubes lighting up, or a still picture, of the time or of any 4 to 6 digit number: a birth year, an anniversary, a score

No sign-in, no ads, no tracking, and the tubes glow just as warmly with Wi-Fi off.

name: GoClocktap
description:
Clocktap is the time clock that lives on your team's phones. Employees clock in with a tap or a quick scan, and managers see who's working, fix shifts and approve time off from wherever they are. Every punch lands on the same timesheets your company already uses on the Clocktap website.

CLOCK IN WITH A SCAN
Put a clock station on any screen at the work site: a tablet, a TV, a spare monitor or a manager's phone. It shows a code that changes every 20 seconds, so a photo of it won't work from home. Employees scan it with the Clocktap app or their iPhone's Camera to clock in or out, and each shift records which station was used.

FOR EMPLOYEES
• Clock in and out with one tap, or by scanning a station
• Start and end breaks
• Pick the job you're working on
• See your shifts and total hours for the past seven days
• Request time off and see when it's approved

FOR MANAGERS
• See who's clocked in right now, who's on a break and who isn't in yet
• Spot scanned and off-site clock-ins at a glance
• Fix a missed punch or add a shift by hand
• Clock out someone who forgot
• Approve or deny time off requests
• Turn your phone or a tablet into a clock station

RESPECTFUL OF YOUR TEAM
• Location is checked once, at the moment of clock-in, and only if your company turns on job site checks. Never in the background.
• The camera is used only to read a station's code. Nothing it sees is saved or uploaded.

WORKS WITH YOUR CLOCKTAP ACCOUNT
Clocktap needs an account. Your company's administrator adds you, and you sign in with the same email and password you use on the website. Reports, payroll exports and company settings stay on the website, where a bigger screen helps.

Some features, such as clock stations, job codes, time off and job site checks, depend on your company's Clocktap plan and settings.

name: Golf Director: Sport Tycoon
description:
Two holes, a clubhouse and a dream: build a golf course fit for a Major.

Golf Director is a turn-based golf course tycoon. Draw every hole from tee to green, grow the membership, sign the sponsors, then take your club from a one-day members' championship onto the pro tour, all the way to a four-day Major.

DESIGN EVERY HOLE
• Drag the tee, up to three bends and the green. Par follows the yardage.
• Drop pot bunkers, lakes, creeks and copses, then rotate and resize them.
• Watch difficulty, appeal, cost and build time change as you draw.
• Or start from a library of 75 ready-made holes, from the Redan to the Cape.
• Designs tire as golfers learn them. Reshape a hole to make it fresh again.

GROW A REAL CLUB
• Your club rating comes from the course and the facilities: clubhouse, pro shop, range, greens and carts.
• A better club draws more members at a higher fee.
• Every hole you add costs more to build, to maintain and to staff than the last.
• Buy the Back Six for a full nine, then the Championship Land for eighteen.

HOST THE OPEN
• Start with a Club Championship for your members.
• Open nine holes to join the tour, then climb from Challenger to Regional, National and Major.
• Play tournament week a day at a time: the weather, the crowd, the gate, a cut after Friday and a Sunday leaderboard.
• Set the purse, the field and the course set-up, and court ranked pros with appearance fees.

DO THE DEALS
• Sign a title sponsor and partners for one, two or three seasons, with signing bonuses and renewals.
• Sell TV rights once you're on the tour, and run campaigns to build hype.
• Hire a tournament director, a marketing lead and more.

RUN THE BOOKS
• Green fees, memberships, bar takings and sponsorship against upkeep, crews, rates and payroll.
• Borrow interest-only or on a repayment loan, at rates that float with an economy that has good years and bad.
• Let your greenkeeper service tired holes automatically.

PICK YOUR GROUND
• Six countries, from Scotland to the UAE, each with its own demand, prices, costs and sponsor market.
• Three landscapes: lush parkland, firm heathland or wild coastal links.
• Three difficulties and three save slots.

NO ADS, NO TIMERS
No ads, no tracking and no energy timers. Golf Director plays fully offline, and nothing happens until you advance the week, so you can put it down whenever you like.

Optional in-app purchases add cash to a club, or unlock Signature Holes (island greens, stone bridges and lighthouses), the Resort Hotel and Grandstands, and Golf Empire, with a sister course abroad and a junior academy. The whole game, from two holes to a Major, plays without them.

All players, clubs, tournaments, sponsors and broadcasters in the game are fictional.

Terms of Use: https://director.games/golf-director/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://director.games/golf-director/privacy/

name: GradeGoal
description:
Your target grade, with a clear path to it.

GradeGoal helps college students understand what they need on remaining assignments and exams. Enter the grading rules from your syllabus, add the scores you know, and choose a target. See your current grade and what it would take to finish where you want.

• Try the calculator before creating an account.
• Use weighted categories or total-points grading.
• Explore hypothetical scores without replacing actual grades.
• Keep multiple courses organized by semester.
• Share a class template so classmates can copy the syllabus setup into their own private calculators.
• Export your data or delete your account from the app.

GradeGoal is free to use. There are no subscriptions, paid feature tiers, advertisements, or school-account requirements.

Results depend on the syllabus rules and assignments you enter. GradeGoal is not your instructor’s official gradebook. Curves, dropped scores, exam replacement, and unusual extra-credit policies are not modeled in this version.

name: Granimble
description:
Step into the Granimble, where every legend ever whispered still breathes.
Granimble is an illustrated bestiary, an alchemy laboratory and a strategy game in one. Discover
thirty mythical creatures drawn from Greek, Norse, Egyptian, Asian and Ukrainian folklore, raise
them through four stages of evolution and lead them into elemental duels.
DISCOVER THE BESTIARY
Browse a living encyclopedia of dragons, phoenixes, griffins, hydras and stranger things: the World
Serpent Jörmungandr, the eight-headed Yamata no Orochi, the Firebird Zhar-Ptytsia and the forest
spirit Mavka. Every entry carries its legend, habitat, historical sources, signature ability and full battle
attributes. Filter by element, realm or rarity, search the archive in seconds and compare up to three
creatures on a radar chart of power.!
EVOLVE THROUGH FOUR STAGES!
Spend essence to carry a creature from Fledgling to Awakened, Exalted and finally Ascended. Each
evolution plays a full ritual: runes ignite, energy converges, light floods the chamber and a stronger,
more radiant form emerges with permanently boosted attributes.
MASTER THE ELEMENTAL LABORATORY
Drag fire, water, earth, air, light and darkness into the crucible of an alchemy wheel. Twenty-one
compounds wait to be discovered, from Steam and Magma to Aurora and Eclipse, and some of them
call forth rare creatures of their own.
EXPLORE THE MYTHOLOGY LIBRARY
Travel five realms of legend. Unfold the Twelve Labours, Ragnarök, the Night Journey of Ra,
Susanoo and the eight-headed serpent, and the Ukrainian tale of Kyrylo Kozhumiaka, then see
which creatures of each realm you have already bound.
BREAK THE RUNE SEALS
Memorise Elder Futhark runes, match their pairs and shatter six ancient seals to free rare creatures
such as Pegasus, the Qilin and the Dragon King Ryūjin. Prefer pure logic? Crack the four-rune
cipher using gold and violet clues.
DUEL IN THE CREATURE ARENA
Build a team of three and challenge six rivals at Kharkiv landmarks, from Shevchenko Garden to
Derzhprom and Freedom Square. Water quenches Fire, Fire consumes Air, Air erodes Earth, Earth
drinks Water, and Light and Darkness wound each other. Strike, unleash elemental attacks, raise
wards, swap champions and charge devastating ultimates.
BUILD THE LEGENDARY COLLECTION
Every creature is a collectible card framed by rarity: Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary and Mythic.
Summon through a glowing portal with rarity-based reveals, track completion by tier and realm,
watch the appraised value of your collection grow in hryvnias and claim rewards for fourteen feats.
DESIGNED FOR QUIET HOURS
No account, no ads and no in-app purchases. Granimble works fully offline and keeps your
progress on

name: GT ROAD
description:
GT ROADは、スマホ向けのドット絵GTレース育成シミュレーションです。

あなたはメカニックとしてレースチームに加わり、エンジニア、そして監督へと駆け上がり、シリーズチャンピオンを目指します。

■ パドックを歩いて人と話す
見下ろしのパドックをタップで移動。チーフメカ、エンジニア、ドライバー、オーナーと話して、整備や作戦、チーム運営を進めます。

■ パーツを買ってセッティングする
パーツ屋で直線・コーナー・安定のバランスを考えてパーツを選び、7つの部位を組み合わせてマシンを仕上げます。パワーに対して安定が足りないとスピンやリタイアが増えます。

■ レースは見守る
横スクロールのレースを観戦。メカニックならピット作業のリズムゲーム、エンジニアなら雨やセーフティカーでの判断、監督なら指示を出して見守ります。

■ 走らせるほどマシンが育つ
走った周回数でマシンが熟成し、性能が上がっていきます。

■ シーズンを戦い抜く
300/500の2クラス混走、義務ピット、サクセスウェイト、スポンサー契約、ドライバーの引き抜きなど、シーズンを通した駆け引きがあります。

登場するチーム、サーキット、ドライバーはすべて架空です。

name: GustRopeWander
description:
Warm grass, crickets, and a field full of fireflies, each one glowing with a small number. Put your finger on 1. Without lifting it, glide to 2, then 3, then 4, and a golden thread follows you from light to light.

Close the last one and the whole shape peels off the meadow and floats up into the night, a new constellation of your own making.

It sounds easy for about a second. The fireflies wander while you draw. Their glow slowly fades, so a slow hand loses the last few to the dark. The rose-coloured ones are shy and slip away from your thread unless you come at them with purpose. And if you lift your finger, the thread snaps. Each meadow is a small plan: where to start curving, which drifting light to grab before it is too far away.

What you will find:
- 48 constellations across four chapters, Meadow's Edge, Willow Brook, Hayloft Rise and Old Orchard
- Every meadow checked solvable before you see it
- Up to three stars for a quick, clean stroke
- A Sky Album that keeps the exact star picture you stitched for every level
- Tonight's Sky, a new daily meadow shared by every player, with a nightly board
- Endless Meadow, round after round of wilder skies
- The Star Keepers board for all-time scores, under a name chosen for you

Celesta notes rise with each connection over soft night pads, and a light sparkle of haptics marks every stitch, swelling warmly when a picture is complete. The first level shows you how by letting you do it.

It plays offline, with no account, no ads and no in-app purchases. Settle into the grass and catch the light while it lasts.

name: GWG POS
description:
GWG POS is the internal point-of-sale app used by Good Will Grow outlet staff on iPad: sales (dine-in, take-away, delivery), recording cash / QRIS / card-terminal payments, member lookup, kitchen and queue displays, shifts and end-of-day closing, with offline support. It is not for the general public; real devices are paired with a code issued in our back office.To review: on the pairing screen tap **"Masuk Mode Demo (Peninjau)"** →
> cashier **Rina** PIN `111111` (supervisor **Yuni** PIN `999999`) → enter
> opening cash (e.g. Rp 100.000) → make a sale. Demo mode uses sample data.
>
> External services: our own backend (Good Will Grow ERP). Payments are only
> recorded; QRIS and card terminals are separate devices. No in-app purchase,
> analytics or AI services. Regions: Indonesia only, used in our own outlets.
> Regulated industry: not applicable.
> Because the app is only for our employees, we request distribution as an
> **Unlisted App**.

name: H3XED
description:
H3XED is the iPhone and iPad app for Hexed, a media server you run yourself on a Mac, Windows PC, Linux machine or in Docker. Your movies, shows and videos stay on your own server. H3XED is how you watch them on your iPhone and iPad, at home or away.

H3XED needs a Hexed server to work. It does not include any media and it is not a streaming service. Get the server free at h3xed.app/downloads.

WATCH YOUR LIBRARY
- Browse movies and shows with posters, ratings, cast and descriptions.
- Pick up where you left off with Continue Watching, and see what's next in a series.
- Subtitles, multiple audio tracks, and a Skip Intro button on titles that have one marked.
- Your server converts video when your device needs it, so playback works without you fiddling with settings.
- Download movies and episodes to watch offline.
- AirPlay to a TV, and keep watching in Picture in Picture.

PROFILES FOR EVERYONE AT HOME
- Each person gets their own profile, with its own history and an optional PIN.
- Kids profiles are managed by an adult, and limit what can be watched.

WITH FRIENDS
Sign in with a free h3xed.app account to link your profile with friends. Send a recommendation, talk about a title in its discussion thread, and join a friend's watch party so everyone is on the same scene. You can report a post or recommendation and block people at any time. Social features are optional.

AWAY FROM HOME
If remote access is turned on for your server, you can watch from anywhere.

GETTING CONNECTED
On first launch, sign in with your free h3xed.app account, or tap Connect by address and sign in with your server's own username and password.

Questions or problems? You > Report a problem, or support@h3xed.app.

name: Hamstronaut
description:
Meet Hamstronaut, a tiny hamster in a bubble spaceship who is a very long way from home!

Help our brave little astronaut float from planet to planet. Your hamster orbits each planet automatically. Tap at the perfect moment to slingshot out of orbit and glide to the next one. Collect sunflower seeds on the way, dodge sleepy asteroids and guide your hamster back to the Cheese Moon.

HOW TO PLAY
• Watch your hamster circle the planet
• Tap at the right moment to launch
• Collect sunflower seeds along the way
• Reach the Cheese Moon to finish the level

FEATURES
• 60 handcrafted levels across 6 colorful worlds
• Simple one-tap controls that anyone can learn
• Every planet has its own gravity, so timing matters
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level
• A new Daily Orbit challenge every day
• Unlock cute hamster outfits: Astronaut, Pirate, Chef and Ninja
• Soft music, gentle haptics and a relaxing space atmosphere
• Short levels that are perfect for quick breaks
• Play offline, no internet needed

Easy to start, satisfying to master. Ready for liftoff?

name: Hangora
description:
Hangora is a wall layout planner for people who want to hang frames, mirrors, and shelves with accurate measurements instead of guessing.

THE PROBLEM
Hanging art on a wall often leads to uneven gaps, off center pieces, and extra holes. Measuring by eye is easy to get wrong when more than one object shares the same wall. A tape measure helps, but it is hard to see the full arrangement before you drill.

HOW TO USE HANGORA
1. Measure the real wall width and height with a tape measure.
2. Create a project and enter those sizes in centimeters or inches.
3. Add picture frames, mirrors, shelves, or decorative squares on a canvas that matches the wall.
4. Drag objects to move them, resize with corner handles, and type exact values when you need precision.
5. Align edges, center on the wall, space objects evenly, or start from a ready layout idea.
6. Select more than one object when you want to move or align a group.
7. Open project details for hanging numbers from the left, from the top, and from the floor.
8. Export a PDF measurement plan or a PNG layout image with the system share sheet when you are ready to hang.

WHO IT IS FOR
Hangora is for homeowners, renters, and anyone planning a gallery wall at home. It is also for people who want a quiet offline tool with no account and no internet requirement.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
Create and save wall projects on this iPhone. Open recent work from Home or browse saved walls in My Projects. Duplicate a layout to try another arrangement. Use the spacing calculator for even gaps in a row. Use the wall center calculator to find the midpoint. Open the measurement guide for short illustrated lessons. Switch centimeters or inches, choose light or dark appearance, and keep your work on the device.

Hangora calculates from the sizes you enter. It does not inspect your physical wall. You still confirm real measurements and use safe hanging hardware.

name: Harbor-Family
description:
Harbor Family is the phone app for Harbor, the family computer control that you run on your own server. Your children's Windows and Mac computers report to your server and you manage everything from here. There is no account with a third party and nothing is sold or shared.

What you can do
- See who is signed in on which computer, which app is in front and which site they are on.
- Lock a computer now, on a schedule, or when the daily limit is used up. Add time with one tap.
- Choose what each child can open: blocked sites, categories such as adult, gambling and social, ask-first sites, or approved sites only.
- Answer requests. When a child hits a blocked page and taps Ask permission, your phone gets a notification and you allow 15 minutes, an hour, today, always, or say no. Time requests work the same way.
- Read the activity log: sites, searches, blocked attempts, apps and sign-ins, with a flag for search words you care about.
- Use ready-made word packs for searches about violence, self-harm, drugs, bullying and more. Set each pack to off, alert or block.
- Watch a live view of a child's screen when you need to.
- Add more computers with a one-time code, invite another parent, and sign in with Face ID, Touch ID or a passkey.

Private by design
- Harbor does not record keystrokes.
- The app locks behind Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode.
- Your data lives on your own server. The app has no ads, no analytics and no tracking.

Harbor needs the Harbor server and the Harbor agent installed on the children's computers. You can try the whole app without any setup: tap "Explore with sample data" on the sign-in screen.

name: Hasic Express Driver
description:
Hasic Express Driver is the official app for Hasic Express company drivers, owner-operators and fleet-partner drivers. Sign in with the same account you use for the Hasic Express driver portal.

• Active, future and previous loads — pickup and delivery addresses, appointments, commodity, weight and instructions, with one-tap directions
• Four quick trip updates: Arrived at pickup, Loaded, Arrived at delivery, Unloaded
• Scan bills of lading, PODs and receipts with the iPhone document scanner — edges found automatically, multiple pages, sent as one PDF to the right load
• Dispatch Chat with Hasic Express dispatch and Jarvis, our AI dispatch assistant, including live translation
• Settlements and pay statements, company and equipment documents, maintenance and expense receipts
• Push notifications for new loads, appointment changes, messages and paperwork requests
• GPS tracking during your loads so dispatch and customers see accurate ETAs

Location: during an active load (or when you mark yourself on duty), the app uses your location — also in the background — so dispatch can see your truck while you use another navigation app or lock the phone. Location is not collected when you are off duty. You can change location access at any time in Settings.

An account issued by Hasic Express is required.

name: Hausfrieden
description:
A house full of music – and neighbors who need some quiet.
