Laura is practising the piano, Andreas is playing a DJ set, and Mara wants to sleep after a night shift. In Hausfrieden, you decide which sounds reach each apartment.

Open or close doors, change the direction of vents, and place the rug to dampen rumbling. Bring the right sounds to their listeners and protect the quiet rooms. Peace returns only when every neighbor’s wishes are met.

FIND YOUR WAY THROUGH THE HOUSE
• 200 logic puzzles with different layouts and increasing complexity.
• Musicians, dancers, party guests, and neighbors who need to focus or sleep.
• Any valid solution unlocks the next level. Use the optimal number of moves to earn a mastery rating.
• Limited hints offer a nudge without revealing the complete solution.
• See happy and unhappy neighbors directly in their apartments.
• Play without a time limit, with sound on or off.

BUY ONCE, PUZZLE IN PEACE
All 200 levels are included. No ads, in-app purchases, subscriptions, or sign-up. No internet connection is needed to play. Your progress is stored on your device.

The game adapts to portrait and landscape screens. Choose from 27 game languages, follow your system language, or change languages later in Settings.

Who wants to hear the music – and who needs it quiet?

name: He Planned: Date Night Ideas
description:
She'll know you planned it.

He Planned turns "I should do something" into a finished night for her: date nights, anniversaries, birthdays and proposals.

Tell it who it's for and what she loves, by voice or by text. In a few minutes you get the whole night, hour by hour: real places, travel time, the budget, and the one thing most likely to go wrong at each stop, with what to do about it.

THE NIGHT, PLANNED
• An hour-by-hour plan for your city, date and budget
• Real places with photos, ratings, hours and reviews
• Change anything by asking: swap dinner, move a time, add a stop
• A reveal moment: the part where you tell her how it came together, in your words

THE CALLS, SCRIPTED
• Word-for-word scripts for every reservation and special request
• What to confirm before you hang up
• Track who said yes and who needs a follow-up

UNTIL THE NIGHT, AND ON IT
• Reminders on the right days: what to book three weeks out, one week out, the day before
• Tonight mode: what's next, how long until it, directions and the number to call
• The morning after, note how it went. Next year's plan starts smarter.

EVERY WORD IS YOURS
• The letters workshop asks the right questions and puts your answers together. It never invents a word you didn't say.

PRIVATE TO YOU
Your plans and people are visible only to you. Lock the app with Face ID, keep notifications quiet so they don't spoil the surprise, or switch to a plain app icon. No ads. No selling your data. Delete everything anytime in Settings.

PRICING
Build your first night plan free. Unlock its call scripts, countdown and letters with a one-time purchase (nothing renews), or go Unlimited with a monthly subscription for every plan, call script and letter.

Unlimited is an auto-renewing subscription billed monthly to your Apple Account. It renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://heplanned.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://heplanned.com/privacy

He Planned is for adults 18 and over.

name: HeadTick
description:
Can you keep the count when the clock disappears?

Head Tick shows you the first four seconds. Then the timer hides. Keep counting in your head and tap when you think you’ve reached the target. Every fraction of a second matters.

Practise your timing, see how long you can last in Solo Streak, or follow the Ultimate Challenge path from 5 seconds to 2 minutes. Complete missions to earn coins, buttons and backgrounds.

Try it free with Ultimate Challenge targets from 5 to 15 seconds, four missions, ten Solo Streak rounds and quiet Practice with Easy or Classic timing tolerance at targets up to 20 seconds. The Collection and Your Best Times are also available free.

A one-time purchase unlocks the full Ultimate Challenge, all missions, daily challenges, unlimited Solo Streak rounds, all Practice settings and local multiplayer for two to four players on one iPhone.

name: HelperHub: Household Tasks
description:
HelperHub keeps chores, errands, and household routines in one shared place. Householders can plan the work, and helpers can see what’s assigned, what’s open, and what’s coming up.

PLAN THE HOUSEHOLD
Create tasks with clear instructions, choose who’s responsible, and schedule repeating chores for regular routines. See upcoming work on a shared calendar.

KNOW WHAT TO DO NEXT
Helpers can check their daily itinerary, claim open tasks, and mark assignments complete. Householders can review completed work and see what still needs attention.

KEEP UPDATES WITH THE TASK
Use a task conversation to ask questions and share updates. Add a photo when a task calls for it, and turn on notifications for new task messages.

GET STARTED
Create a household or join one with an invitation code.

name: HeroPup
description:
Meet your hero and make something fun.

HeroPup is a creative app for a cartoon animal hero you design yourself. Pick a look—dog, cat, bunny, or fox—then a cape and a power. Turn that hero into wallpapers, cards, posters, stickers, and short stories on your phone.

HOW IT WORKS

name: Hohtosieni
description:
Hohtosieni on muistipeli, joka piirtää korttinsa metsän luonnon mukaan. Taustan hehkuvat sammalet, kivet ja kukkat eivät ole koristetta: jokainen kortti laskeutuu paikalleen, jonka olen valinnut kuvarahan luonnosta, ja kääntyy yhdellä napautuksella.

MITÄ PELISSÄ ON

Muistipeli on tuttu, mutta toteutus on oma. Tavallisissa muistipeleissä kortit asetetaan suorakulmaiseen ruudukkoon. Hohtosienessä ruudukkoa ei ole lainkaan. Kortit levittäytyvät metsänäkymän päälle kymmenelle eri merkin ympärille, hieman toisistaan eri kulmissa, aivan kuten ne leisisivät maassa. Taustapiirros on täysiä verhoa, mutta silti näkyvissä jokaisen kortin alta.

Peli toimii iPhonella ja iPadilla, pystysuunnassa ja vaakasuunnassa. Asettelu mukautuu näytön kokoon, eikä yksikään kortti koskaan painu päällekkäin tai katkea näytön reunalta.

KOLME LUKUA JA VIISITOISTA TASOA

Matka kulkee kolmen luvun läpi, ja jokainen luku on oma maisemansa.

Sammalten valo on aamunkoitteinen metsä, jossa ensimmäiset kortit heräävät. Hohtava virta on taikajoki, joka kantaa valoisa kuplia. Kristallinen onkalo on syväinen luola, jossa kristallit laulavat.

Jokaisessa luvussa on viisi tasoa, joissa korttien määrä, vaikeus ja tunnelma muuttuvat. Ensimmäinen luku avautuu heti. Toinen luku avautuu, kun metsästä on kerätty kaksikymmentä taikakristallia. Kolmas luku kahdeksankymmentäyhdeksän kristallin kohdalla. Kiteet kertyvät tasojen läpäisystä, täydellisistä suorituksista, päivän haasteesta ja metsän merkkien keräämisestä.

PÄIVITTÄINEN HAASTE

Joka päivä metsä herää uuteen haasteeseen. Haasteen korttijako, korttikoko ja maisema määräytyvät päivämäärästä, joten haaste on aina sama kaikille, jotka pelaavat samana päivänä. Päivittäinen haaste uusiutuu keskiyöllä, ja siitä saa oman kristallipalkinnon ensimmäisenä kertana.

TAIDON TASOT JA PISTEET

Jokainen taso antaa yhdestä kolmeen tähteä. Tähtiä kertyy, kun läpäiset tason ripeästi, kun avaat kaikki kortit vain tarvittavan monta kertaa tai kun löydät jokaisen parin ilman yhtään virhettä. Pisteitä kertyy peräkkäisistä osumista: sarjaa jatkuessa jokainen uusi osuma kasvattaa pistemäärää, ja nopeasti löydetyt parit muodostavat oman yhtäjaksoisen putken.

TAIVAKRISTALLIT JA VÄLINEET

Kristalleista voi ostaa neljä kertakäyttöistä välinettä kaupasta. Lisävihje paljastaa yhden kortin hetkeksi. Paljasta pari kääntää yhden kokonaisen parin auki lyhyeksi ajaksi. Järjestä kortit sekoittaa kentän uudelleen. Jääkello pysäyttää ajastimen viisi sekuntia. Jokainen väline säilyy seuraavaan tasoon asti.

KOKOELMA JA SAAVUTUKSET

Kymmenen metsän merkkiä kuvastavat kokoelmassa. Merkki avautuu, kun sen on nähnyt kortissa. Saavutuksia on kolmetoista, ja ne mittaavat muun muassa läpäistyjä tasoja, täydellisiä suorituksia, kerättyjä merkkejä, päivittäistä pelisessiota, käytettyjä vihjeitä, avattuja lukuja ja käännettyjä kortteja. Jokainen saavutus antaa kristalleja, ja ne voidaan käyttää uusien lukujen avaamiseen.

Sijoitukset ja tilastot kokoavat kaiken yhteen paikkaan: läpäistyt tasot, täydelliset suoritukset, käännetyt kortit, käytetyt vihjeet, kerätyt kristallit, päivittäinen putki ja nykyinen arvo. Arvo nousee tähtien mukana aina Vaikkijasta Hohtotähteen asti.

TOIMINTOJEN SÄÄTÄMINEN

Asetuksista voi mykistää äänet ja värinät, käynnistää synkronoinnin uudelleen tai pyyhkiä tallennuksen. Edistys tallentuu laitteelle ja synkronoidaan omalla pilvitilillä, joten peli jatkuu siellä missä sen jätitkin.

Peli toimii kokonaan omalla laitteellasi. Se ei pyydä tunnusta, ei näytä mainoksia eikä sisällä maksullisia ostoja. Kaikki välineet ostetaan pelin aikana kerätyillä taikakristalleilla.

name: HTS Code Finder : TariffAI
description:
Find the HTS code for your product and see what you'll pay in U.S. import duty before you ship.

IDENTIFY YOUR PRODUCT (PRO) Describe what you're importing, or take a photo of the product or its label. TariffAI works down the U.S. tariff schedule step by step, from heading to the full 10-digit code, and shows why each step fits. If a detail would change the code, such as knitted or woven, cotton or polyester, or the age group of a toy, it asks, and you can switch answers instantly to see each code.

ESTIMATE THE DUTY Enter the HTS code, the country where the goods were made, the customs value and the import date, and see the duty line by line: • The base duty from the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States • Extra tariffs for your product and origin: Section 232 (steel, aluminum, copper, autos and parts), Section 301 and other Chapter 99 measures • Merchandise processing fee (MPF) and harbor maintenance fee (HMF) • The total duty, its share of the value, and the total with fees

THINGS TO CHECK Many tariffs depend on facts about the shipment. Each estimate lists them: exemptions you may qualify for, trade agreement rates such as USMCA, quota rates, metal or U.S. content rules, and possible antidumping or countervailing duty cases. When one applies to you, update the estimate in one tap.

SEARCH THE TARIFF SCHEDULE Search by words ("steel bolts") or by the start of a code ("7318"). Each tariff line shows the general, trade agreement and column 2 rates, the more specific codes under it, and the extra tariffs listed for a country of origin.

UP TO DATE Rates come from the official U.S. tariff schedule published by the U.S. International Trade Commission. The data is checked every day for new revisions, Federal Register notices and CBP messages, and each estimate shows which revision it used.

SAVED ESTIMATES Estimates are kept on your iPhone, so you can open them again or share them with your broker or supplier.

FREE AND PRO Try one search and one duty estimate free. TariffAI Pro adds product identification from a description or photo, unlimited searches and estimates, one-tap updates, all detail fields and saved estimates. Pro is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.

SOURCES • U.S. Harmonized Tariff Schedule (USITC): https://hts.usitc.gov • Federal Register: https://www.federalregister.gov • U.S. Customs and Border Protection: https://www.cbp.gov

IMPORTANT TariffAI gives estimates and suggested codes, not legal or customs advice. U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) decides the code and the duty owed at entry. Confirm them with a licensed customs broker or a CBP binding ruling. TariffAI is not affiliated with CBP, the U.S. International Trade Commission or any government agency.

description:

That is the whole idea of HueDrip Vessel. Each order is a paint swatch, and you mix it from cyan, magenta and yellow, with white and black further along the rail. Paint here mixes the way real paint does, so magenta and yellow give you a warm red, white softens everything, and a single drop of black can sink a good cup. A small meter tells you how close you are, a chime climbs in pitch as you get warmer, and the Serve button turns gold once the match is good enough. Fewer drops earn more gold drops, up to three per level.

There are 40 levels across eight swatch decks. The early ones are two-paint primaries. Later decks bring in tints and shades, pipettes that drip different sizes, a cup that slowly leaks while you think, and a Café Counter where a queue of customers wants their colours before time runs out. The last deck, Rush Hour, puts all of it together.

When the campaign is done, the studio stays open. The Daily Order is five swatches, the same for every player that day, with its own leaderboard. Open Studio is an endless café rush for fast, accurate hands. Your studio points add up on a global board under a name picked for you, which you can re-roll whenever you like.

You will hear drips, glass clinks and a little lo-fi jazz piano, and feel each drop land through gentle haptics. Spill a cup and you simply tip it out and start again.

No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, and it plays offline. Pick up a pipette.

name: HUMTTO
description:
Shop HUMTTO hiking shoes, casual shoes and outdoor clothes in Iraq from the official agent.

- Browse the full range for men, women and kids, with real photos of every colour
- Check sizes and stock before you order
- Pay by card, or cash on delivery
- Delivery to all of Iraq in 2 to 4 days
- Follow your order and get a notification at every step
- One year warranty on manufacturing faults
- Keep your orders, addresses and wishlist in your account, and delete your account at any time from the app
- Available in English, Arabic and Kurdish (Sorani and Badini)

Questions? Contact us from the app or at humttoiraq.com.

name: Hush Counsel: Legal Notes
description:
Hush Counsel records and transcribes client meetings, interviews and negotiations in the room, and writes them up the way a lawyer needs, on your iPhone or iPad and nowhere else. One purchase covers the Mac too, where it also hears both sides of a call.

NO CLIENT INFORMATION LEAVES THE DEVICE
Speech is transcribed and the notes are written by the models Apple builds into iOS. Nothing is sent to an AI provider, a transcription service or any server. No account and no subscription.

THE TIME ENTRY, WRITTEN FOR YOU
When you stop, the time is rounded up to your billing increment, a tenth of an hour unless you bill in 10 or 15 minutes, with a description in the usual form: "Conference with client re: severance offer; advise re: release terms." Copy it into your billing system.

CONSENT, NOTED
A statement to read before you start. While you record, Hush Counsel listens for the answer and notes who consented and when, or that no consent was heard.

EVERY DATE AND DEADLINE
"Within 30 days", "the hearing on the 12th", "the offer expires October 2": every date said is worked out from the day it was said, labelled as a filing, hearing, response or limitation date, and added to your calendar when you ask.

NOTES SHAPED FOR THE CONVERSATION
Client consultation: facts as told, advice given, client instructions. Negotiation or mediation: positions, offers and demands, concessions, terms agreed. Also new client intake, witness interview, deposition prep, hearings and internal case strategy.

NAMES FOR YOUR CONFLICT CHECK
Every person and organization named, ready to paste into your conflicts search.

PRIVILEGE LEGEND AND CITABLE TRANSCRIPTS
Every PDF and text export carries your privilege legend, the client and the matter on every page. Export the transcript in numbered pages and lines and cite a passage as 4:12.

LOCKED, REDACTED, YOURS
Face ID before anything is shown. Redact a name everywhere it appears, or list words that are never written down at all.

Requires iOS 26. Written notes and the drafted time entry need Apple Intelligence; without it, simpler rules pick out the notes. An iPhone or iPad records the room it is in; it cannot hear the other side of a phone call. Hush Counsel is a note-taking tool, not legal advice; check every date against the rule or order, and whether a recording is privileged is for you to judge.

name: Hush Minutes: Meeting Notes
description:
Hush Minutes sits in the meeting with you and writes it down, on your iPhone or iPad and nowhere else.

THE AI YOU ALREADY OWN
Hush Minutes runs on the speech and language models Apple builds into your device. No API key, no credits, no fee per minute, and no other AI behind it.

NOTHING IS UPLOADED
Speech is turned into text and the notes are written by the models already on your device. No audio, transcript or note is sent to us or to anyone. There is no account and no subscription. If you want your meetings on your other devices, you can switch on your own iCloud; it is off unless you turn it on.

PUT IT ON THE TABLE AND PRESS RECORD
The transcript appears as people speak, and it keeps listening with the screen off. People sharing the room are told apart by their voices, and you can name them.

NOTES THAT WRITE THEMSELVES
When you stop: a summary, decisions, action items with who they belong to, and open questions, using only what was said. Pick the kind of meeting and the notes take that shape.

YOUR OWN NOTES
Type a line while people talk. It is kept word for word, and the written notes lean on it.

CATCH ME UP
Looked away? One tap gives you the last few minutes in three lines.

NOTHING GETS LOST
Follow-ups from every meeting sit in one list: everything, yours, and what you are waiting on. People shows everyone you have met, with what you owe each other. Every decision is in one searchable log.

THE WEEK IN ONE PAGE
What was decided, what is still to do and what nobody answered, across the last seven days.

INSIGHTS
Hours in meetings week by week, how much of the talking is yours, and who you meet most.

A CLEAN TRANSCRIPT
Ums, uhs and stammers are taken out as you speak. Mask swearing, redact card and ID numbers, and list the words that must never be written down. Redaction happens before anything is saved.

YOURS TO KEEP
Share the notes, export a PDF, subtitles or plain text, or translate the notes on your device. Meetings are plain files you can see in the Files app. Audio is kept only if you ask.

LOCKED WITH FACE ID
Ask for Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode before your meetings are shown.

MADE FOR IPAD TOO
The list of meetings beside the one you are reading.

ONE PURCHASE
Buy it once for iPhone, iPad and Mac.

An iPhone or iPad records the room it is in. It cannot hear the other side of a phone or video call; Hush Minutes for Mac does that.

Requires iOS 26 or iPadOS 26. Written notes need a device with Apple Intelligence turned on; without it, simpler rules pick out the notes and the app says so. Please tell people when you are taking notes.

name: Hydra by Photon Brothers
description:
Hydra is Photon Brothers' operations system, for Photon Brothers employees and subcontractors. It is the same Hydra as hydra.photonbrothers.com: the day's jobs, schedules, job forms and photos, and the office's dispatch board.

Employees sign in with their Photon Brothers Google account, and subcontractors with a code emailed to them. There is no public sign-up.

Location while you are clocked in: with your permission, Hydra collects your phone's location while you are clocked in for paid work, including when the app is closed or the phone is locked, and stops when you clock out. The office uses it for your time on site at each job and for its live map. You can turn it off at any time in Settings, and Hydra works without it.

name: IBCSC Jobs
description:
IBCSC Jobs puts jobs.ibcsc.be in your pocket: IT and cybersecurity jobs in Belgium from verified employers.

Your profile comes first. A completeness ring shows what is still missing for a recruiter to notice you, and every job shows how well it matches your skills, languages, experience and conditions.

• Verified employers: every company is checked with its Belgian enterprise number (BCE/KBO).
• Clear offers: salary, contract and remote work are visible right in the list.
• Search with filters by contract, remote work, specialisation and city, and save jobs for later.
• Apply in a few taps with your CV, a message and the employer's questions.
• Follow each application step by step on a timeline.
• Chat directly with recruiters.
• Import your CV as a PDF: experience, education, skills and languages fill in your profile.

One free account for IBCSC Jobs and IBCSC Market. No ads and no trackers. Your data stays on the servers of the Institut Belge de Cybersécurité Citoyenne in Belgium, and you can delete your account from the app at any time.

name: IcePantryOrbit
description:
Keep track of pantry batches and shopping items in IcePantryOrbit for iPhone and iPad.

Add food with a name, quantity, unit, storage location, and printed date. Shelves orders batches by date, highlights the earliest, and lets you search or filter by storage location and deadline. Record food as used or discarded, and optionally add its name to your shopping list.

Find products in the on-device catalog or search Open Food Facts by name, brand, or barcode. You can also enter product details by hand or scan a barcode on a supported device.

Market keeps shopping items in one list, where you can mark purchases and clear purchased items. Ledger shows movement history and counts of use and discard entries from the past seven days.

A small or medium widget shows the earliest batch, with the next batch also shown in the medium widget.

The app interface is in English. Pantry, shopping, and movement data are stored locally.

name: IDEA House ClassHub
description:
IDEA House ClassHub brings class members and class organizers together in one simple app. Browse yoga, fitness, dance, language and other classes, join with a tap, and keep track of your schedule. If you teach or run a studio, publish your classes and sessions and see who is coming.

FOR MEMBERS
• Browse classes: search by title or location and filter by class type.
• See the organizer, location, capacity and next session at a glance.
• Join a class in one tap. If it is full, join the waitlist and get a notification when a place opens.
• My schedule: all your upcoming classes in one list, shown in your local time.
• Follow organizers you like and see their new classes first under “Following”.
• Notifications: new classes from organizers you follow, booking confirmations, waitlist updates, cancellations and a reminder 15 minutes before each class.
• Message organizers you follow, one-to-one in the app.

FOR ORGANIZERS
• Create a class with a title, type, location, capacity and description.
• Add one-off sessions or a weekly schedule (for example every Monday, Wednesday and Friday).
• Save a class as a draft and publish it when you are ready.
• See who has joined and who is on the waitlist for each class.
• Cancel a session or a whole class; members are notified automatically.
• See how many people follow you.
• Message members who follow you.

ACCOUNT AND PRIVACY
• Sign in with email and password, with Sign in with Apple, or with Google.
• Choose your role when you sign up: member or organizer.
• Pick a light or dark theme, add a profile photo and edit your display name.
• Contact support from inside the app.
• Delete your account at any time from Profile & settings.

ClassHub is made by IDEA HOUSE SOLUTIONS CO., LTD in Yangon, Myanmar. Privacy policy: https://ideahousesolutions.com/privacy

name: IDFA Vault
description:
IDFA Vault shows your device's advertising identifier (IDFA) behind a biometric lock, so you can copy it in seconds whenever you need it — for example, to register a test device in an ad SDK, or when a carrier or a service asks for it.

■ Locked every time
• Face ID, Touch ID or Optic ID (or your passcode) is required at launch and when you return to the app
• The app switcher never shows your IDFA
• Optionally hides itself during screen recording or mirroring

■ Copy, share and QR code
• Copy the IDFA in uppercase with hyphens. It is cleared from the clipboard after 60 seconds
• Share it, or show it as a QR code on iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro
• On Mac, press ⌘C or use the menu bar

■ All your devices in one place
• See the IDFA of your other devices signed in with the same Apple Account, synced through your private iCloud database
• Other devices' IDFA stay masked until you tap them
• Delete all synced data at any time

■ Private by design
• No ads, no analytics, no third-party SDKs and no servers
• Your IDFA is stored only in your own iCloud. Not even the developer can see it
• The tracking permission is used only to show the IDFA on screen, never for advertising or tracking

Designed for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro. macOS and visionOS don't provide the IDFA to apps, so Mac and Apple Vision Pro show the IDFA of your iPhone and iPad.

name: İki Pota Tek Top Word Game
description:
How well do you know basketball? Three new players are waiting for you every day, across three series.

In the daily basketball puzzle from the İki Pota Tek Top YouTube channel, your goal is to find the hidden player's surname letter by letter. You have 6 guesses; after each one, the letters change color to guide you.

THREE SERIES EVERY DAY • Today's Stars: players on the court right now • European Hoops: names from European and Turkish basketball • Legends: players who made history, worth 1.5x points

STUCK? TAKE A HINT Three optional hints such as jersey number, country and career path. Solve it without hints to earn the most points.

POINTS, STREAKS AND SEASONS • Keep solving every day to grow your streak and earn bonus points • A new season starts every month • Climb the leaderboard and win your medal • Track your total and per-series stats

EASY TO START Play as a guest without an account, or sign in with Apple. Available in Turkish, English and Spanish.

The first puzzle of the day is always ad-free. Prefer no ads at all? Get the weekly or monthly Ad-Free subscription.

Subscriptions renew automatically; cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period in your App Store account settings. 

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/iki-pota-tek-top

name: İmam Tercüman: Canlı Meal
description:
Okunan Kur'an'ın anlamını, okunduğu anda öğrenmek ister misiniz?

İmam Tercüman, Kur'an okunurken çalışan canlı bir meal uygulamasıdır: okunan ayeti telefonunuzun mikrofonundan dinler, Kur'an içinde bulur ve o ayetin Türkçe mealini okuyuşa yetişecek hızda sesli okur.

Kur'an okunan her yerde

• Bir hafızın ya da hocanın canlı tilavetinde  
• Mukabele ve hatim okumalarında  
• Radyo, televizyon veya internetten dinlediğiniz Kur'an okuyuşlarında

İnternetsiz ve gizli

Konuşma tanıma tamamen telefonunuzda çalışır. Ses kaydedilmez, hiçbir yere gönderilmez. Uygulama reklam, takip veya analiz aracı içermez; hesap açmanız gerekmez. Bir kez satın alırsınız; uygulama içi satın alma veya abonelik yoktur.

Kur'an tilavetine özel konuşma tanıma

Kur'an tilaveti üzerine eğitilmiş bir yapay zekâ modeli kullanılır. Fatiha ve sık okunan sureler (son on sure ve diğerleri) için özellikle titizlikle ayarlanmıştır. Uygulama emin olmadığı ayeti okumaz; yanlış tahmin ettiğinde kendini düzeltir. Okuyuşun sırayla ilerlediğini bilir; okuyan kişi yavaşladığında veya ses kısıldığında kaldığı yeri unutmaz.

Okuyuşa yetişen meal

Meal, okuyuşun hızına göre otomatik hızlanır ya da yavaşlar. En yavaş ve en hızlı okuma hızını kendiniz ayarlarsınız. Çok geride kalınırsa eski ayetler atlanır, böylece meal hep okunan yere yakındır.

Elmalılı Hamdi Yazır meali (orijinal)

Hak Dini Kur'an Dili (1935–1938) içindeki orijinal, sadeleştirilmemiş Elmalılı meali kullanılır. İsterseniz parantez içindeki açıklamaları atlayabilirsiniz.

Rahat dinleme

• Kulaklık takılıysa meal kulaklıktan, değilse hoparlörden okunur.  
• "Sadece kulaklık" seçeneğiyle hoparlör tamamen kapatılabilir; kulaklık yoksa uygulama sessiz kalır.  
• Ekranı karartabilirsiniz; dinleme ve meal devam eder.  
• Okunan ayetin adı, Arapça metni ve meali ekranda gösterilir.

Gereksinimler

• Mikrofon izni (ses yalnızca cihazda işlenir).  
• Türkçe metin okuma sesi. iPhone’da hazır gelir; daha doğal bir ses için Ayarlar › Erişilebilirlik › Seslendirilen İçerik › Sesler › Türkçe’den gelişmiş bir ses indirebilirsiniz. Ses bulunamazsa uygulama sizi uyarır.  
• Tek kulaklık kullanmanız önerilir: böylece hem okuyuşu hem meali duyarsınız. Hoparlörden okunan meal mikrofon tarafından da duyulduğu için takip zorlaşabilir.

Önemli uyarı

Uygulama, namaz esnasında kesinlikle iki kulaklık birlikte (her iki kulağa birden) takılarak kullanılmamalıdır. Tek kulaklıkla kullanımın dinen caiz olup olmadığı hususunda ise kullanmaya başlamadan önce ehil bir din âliminden görüş alınmalıdır.

Not: Tanıma her zaman kusursuz değildir; ortamın akustiği, hoparlör yankısı ve okuyuş hızı sonucu etkiler. Meal, Kur'an'ın anlamının bir yorumudur; Kur'an'ın kendisi değildir.

Kaynaklar: Arapça metin Tanzil Project (tanzil.net, CC BY 3.0). Konuşma tanıma: Tarteel AI whisper-base-ar-quran (Apache-2.0), whisper.cpp ve whisper.rn (MIT). Ayrıntılar uygulamadaki "Hakkında" ve "Lisanslar" ekranlarında.

Gizlilik politikası: https://alpsoftstudio.com/imam-tercuman-privacy

İletişim: alpsoftstudio@gmail.com

name: Immersive Comms
description:
Immersive Comms je vysílačka v telefonu pro štáb akcí spolku Imerze. Moderátoři mají telefon v kapse a sluchátka v uších, režie je slyší a mluví na ně.

• Místnosti (smyčky): každý mluví do své místnosti, režie může poslouchat i další.
• Šeptání: režie mluví jen na vybrané lidi a ostatní nic neslyší.
• Tlačítka jako u intercomu: klepnutí mikrofon zamkne, podržení mluví jen po dobu držení.
• Hlásím se o slovo: dej režii vědět, že chceš mluvit; režie vidí frontu a odpoví jedním klepnutím.
• Apple Watch: zapni a vypni mluvení nebo se přihlas o slovo přímo z hodinek, telefon může zůstat v kapse.
• Režie přesouvá lidi mezi místnostmi, vypíná jim mikrofon a ztlumuje si je jen pro sebe.
• Telefon v kapse: zvuk hraje i se zamčeným displejem.
• Přihlášení jedním odkazem od režie, bez hesel a registrace.

Appka je určená pro štáb, kterému organizátor pošle pozvánku. Bez odkazu od režie se do ní nepřihlásíte.

Hlas se nenahrává ani neukládá, jde v reálném čase přes server v EU. Žádná reklama, žádné sledování. Účet si smažete v Nastavení.

name: Independent Messenger
description:
END-TO-END ENCRYPTION FOR YOUR SECURITY

Independent is a messenger for personal, one-to-one conversations. Create an invitation, share a link or QR code and start chatting with someone you trust. No phone number or address-book upload is required.

MESSAGES, PHOTOS AND FILES
Exchange text messages, photos and files up to 20 MB. Save the photos you want to keep to Photos, and documents to your chosen folder.

PROTECT THE CONTENT OF YOUR CONVERSATIONS
Messages and attachments are encrypted on the sender’s device and decrypted on the recipient’s device. Compare the security code with your contact and confirm the connection on both devices.

INVITE SOMEONE TO A PERSONAL CHAT
Connect using a single-use link or QR code. Saved contacts remain in your chat list so you can continue your conversation later. Give each contact a local name that only you see.

A LIMITED MESSAGE HISTORY
Messages and attachments expire automatically after their retention period. Copies you or your contact export to Photos or Files remain in the selected location and may sync according to device settings.

Independent keeps the focus on personal conversations, with a simple interface and end-to-end encryption.

name: Infinite - החוגים שלי
description:
Infinite - החוגים שלי היא האפליקציה של המרכז, המתנ"ס או החוג שלכם. הורים וצוות נמצאים בה יחד, וכל ארגון רואה אותה בצבעים ובלוגו שלו.

להורים:
• בוחרים את המרכז מתוך רשימה, ומהפעם הבאה האפליקציה נפתחת ישר שם
• הרשמה לחוגים, לסדנאות ולאירועים
• מערכת שעות, נוכחות ועדכונים על הילדים
• הודעות מהמרכז ומהמורים, עם התראות לטלפון
• תשלום מאובטח על חוגים ופעילויות
• קבלות ומסמכים נשמרים ומשותפים ישר מהטלפון

לצוות ולמנהלים:
• לוח בקרה של המרכז
• סימון נוכחות מהטלפון
• ניהול תלמידים, קבוצות וחוגים
• שליחת הודעות לקבוצות ולהורים
• דוחות שיוצאים לאקסל ונפתחים בחלון השיתוף של הטלפון

פרטיות: המידע שייך לארגון שלכם ונשמר בצורה מאובטחת. אפשר למחוק את החשבון מתוך האפליקציה.

האפליקציה מיועדת לארגונים שמשתמשים במערכת Infinite. ארגון שרוצה להצטרף פונה אלינו דרך האתר.

name: InkSproutDrift
description:
A seed lets go of a branch and drifts sideways on the wind. You draw one slow line of black ink beneath it. For a breath the ink is wet, and the seed slips straight through. Then the stroke dries, the seed lands, rolls down your line, and drops into a clay pot. Two small leaves open.

InkSproutDrift is a physics puzzle painted in sumi ink on rice paper. Seeds fall with the wind, and your brush strokes become the ramps that carry them home. The only rule that matters is the one about wet ink: every stroke stays soft for about a second before it hardens. Paint too late and the seed passes through. Paint early, read the wind, and the line is ready when it's needed.

Ink is limited. Each garden gives you one inkstone, and your score is the seeds you sprout plus the ink you didn't spend, so one calm, well-placed line is worth more than a nervous scribble.

The 48 gardens are hung as scrolls across four seasons. Spring is for learning the brush. Summer lays down blotting felt that drinks wet ink before it can set. In autumn the pots drift slowly from side to side. Winter turns the wind around in sudden gusts while your inkstone runs low.

A new Daily Scroll is painted each day, the same garden for every player, with its own board beside the all-time ranking. You appear there under a gentle brush name such as Misty Crane 17, which you can re-roll.

Strokes taper and bleed softly into the paper as they dry. Sprouts spring open. There is a bamboo flute, the sound of water drops, and a light haptic drag under your finger as you paint. The first garden teaches you as you play.

It works offline, respects Reduce Motion, and asks for nothing: no account, no ads, no in-app purchases.

name: InkTrail
description:
Guide the octopus Nerix through sunken temple ruins. Every step matters in InkTrail: visit the rune tiles, release their light and return to the starting stone with your final move.

SIMPLE TO LEARN, INTRICATE TO SOLVE
The first puzzles introduce the rules one step at a time. Later levels add tiles that need several visits, currents, whirlpools, key runes and locked seals. Plan your route at your own pace, with no time limit.

TWO WORLDS
• Sunken Ruins: 30 free levels in the base game.
• Deep Vaults: 30 more levels in an optional one-time purchase, with no subscription. The price is shown before you buy.
• Complete each world's levels in sequence to unlock the next puzzle.

YOUR PROGRESS
Earn up to three stars per level and build a daily streak. If a route goes wrong, restart the level and try again. Dead-end warnings help in the first five levels; you can enable them for later puzzles in Settings.

BENEATH THE WAVES
Explore a three-dimensional underwater world with calm music and haptic feedback. Adjust music, sound effects, ambience and haptics separately.

PLAY OFFLINE
All levels are included in the app. Progress and settings stay on your device. No game account, advertising or tracking. Buying and restoring the extra level pack requires an internet connection to the App Store.

Available in English and German. For iPhone with iOS 27 or later.

Support: https://sidipixel.com/en/inktrail/support/
Privacy: https://sidipixel.com/en/inktrail/datenschutz/

name: Insiemo
description:
Insiemo è l'app degli eventi aziendali che si costruiscono insieme.

Entri con il codice che trovi nell'invito e la tua email di lavoro. Da quel momento l'evento comincia sul tuo telefono, settimane o mesi prima della grande giornata.

UNA MISSIONE AL MESE
Ogni mese si apre una missione nuova, con la sua scadenza: inventare una parola che racconta la tua azienda, scattare una foto, rispondere a una domanda. Le prossime missioni sono già lì, in attesa di sbloccarsi.

VOTA
Quando una missione diventa un voto vedi solo le parole, mai i nomi. Un voto a testa, e la classifica compare subito dopo.

INCONTRA CHI NON CONOSCI
Dici cosa ti va e l'app ti abbina a un collega di un'altra area dell'azienda. Vi dà un posto dove trovarvi e una piccola prova da fare insieme.

IL MURO E LA CLASSIFICA
Le foto approvate finiscono sul muro e sugli schermi dell'evento. Ogni missione vale punti, la giuria aggiunge bonus a chi fa le cose migliori, e la classifica ti accompagna fino alla festa.

Ogni contenuto passa dalla regia dell'evento prima di essere pubblicato, e ogni contenuto si può segnalare. Le notifiche ti avvisano quando si apre una nuova missione.

Insiemo è di Masters of Magic: 18 anni di eventi, più di 1.800 realizzati nel mondo.

name: INTELLECT
description:
INTELLECT — видеоуроки и тесты для подготовки к вступительным экзаменам в вузы Таджикистана.

Что внутри:
• Предметы, разбитые на разделы и темы
• Видеоуроки преподавателей учебного центра INTELLECT
• Тесты для проверки знаний
• Интерфейс на русском и таджикском языках

Вход по номеру телефона с кодом из SMS, без паролей.

Учитесь в своём темпе: возвращайтесь к урокам, пересматривайте сложные темы и готовьтесь к экзамену шаг за шагом.

name: Interchange: London Tube Map
description:
No ads. No subscription. Nothing to unlock. Pay once and all of Interchange is yours, and it works with no signal at all.

Interchange is a clear map of London's Tube, Elizabeth line, DLR and Overground, with a journey planner built into the app. Pick where you're starting and where you're going, and it gives you two or three ways to go: the fastest, the one with the fewest changes, or one with no change at all when there is one. Open a journey to follow it step by step.

NO ADS, NO PAYWALL
One purchase and that's it. There are no adverts, no subscription, no in-app purchases and no "pro" version: every feature is included from the day you buy it, and future updates are free. No account, no sign-in and no tracking.

WORKS WITH NO SIGNAL
The whole network is built into the app: 420 stations on the 11 Tube lines, the Elizabeth line, the DLR and the six Overground lines. Journeys are planned on your phone in a moment, in a tunnel, on a plane or abroad with data roaming off. The map, the planner, Home and Work and your recent trips all work offline.

WHICH LINE, WHICH DIRECTION
Every step tells you the line to take and the direction to follow, as the platform signs say it: Northbound, Southbound, Eastbound or Westbound. It names where the train is heading, the platform it usually leaves from where that's known, how many stops to ride and where to change. Where the signs don't use compass directions, as on the DLR and Overground, it shows the destination and the way the train is heading instead.

FOLLOW YOUR JOURNEY
On iPhone, press Start on a journey to follow it on your Lock Screen, in the Dynamic Island and in the Smart Stack on Apple Watch: the line, which way, where to change and a countdown to your stop. Tap Next step once you've changed.

A CLEAR MAP
Our own map of the network in the classic diagram style: straight lines, ticks for stations, rings where you can change, and the fare zones shaded behind. Every station is named, and the names grow as you zoom in. Tap a station to see its lines, zone and line status, a street map of the area around it, and Route to plan a trip there.

LIVE LINE STATUS
When you have a signal, Interchange shows TfL's line status as you open it: good service on all lines, or which lines have problems and why. Any line on your journey that isn't running a good service gets a warning, so you know to check before you travel. With no signal it shows the last status with its time, and everything else works as before.

• Save stations as Home and Work, then plan a trip to either in one tap
• Station search that finds a station as you type
• Your recent trips, one tap away
• A dark map for late journeys
• iPhone and iPad (on iPad the planner sits beside the map)

GOOD TO KNOW
Journey times are estimates from the timetable, with a few minutes added for each change. Routes are planned from the full network and don't steer around delays or closures, and Interchange doesn't know about step-free access, so glance at the station boards before you travel. Trams, the cable car, buses and river boats aren't included.

YOUR PRIVACY
No account, no location and no tracking: what you search for and plan never leaves your phone. The only things the app asks the internet for are TfL's public line status and, when you open a station's street map, Apple Maps.

Powered by TfL Open Data. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database rights 2016 and Geomni UK Map data © and database rights [2019]. Interchange is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Transport for London.

Terms: https://www.sciencemadevisual.co.uk/interchange/terms · Privacy: https://www.sciencemadevisual.co.uk/interchange/privacy

name: Invite Studio: Wedding Cards
description:
Make a wedding invitation that feels like you.

Create photo invitations for weddings, save-the-dates and engagements on your iPhone. Choose a template, add your details and share a finished invitation cover as a PNG image.

18 TEMPLATES
Explore 12 wedding designs, 3 save-the-date designs and 3 engagement designs. Personalize colors, fonts and your cover photo to suit your celebration.

FOUR SIMPLE STEPS
Work through Details, Photos, Style and Music. Add names, a date, time and venue, then crop and position your own photos. Keep up to 12 photos in each invitation's in-app preview.

DRAFTS ON YOUR IPHONE
Save invitations locally, return to edit them, duplicate a design or delete drafts you no longer need. Creating, editing, previewing and exporting work offline. No account is required.

A COVER TO SAVE OR SHARE
Export a 1080 x 1920 PNG cover with your chosen photo, names or title, date, time and venue. Use the iOS share sheet to choose where to save or send it.

MUSIC IN THE APP
Try six bundled tracks while previewing your invitation. Music plays when you choose to play it.

WHAT YOUR IMAGE INCLUDES
The shared PNG is a static cover. Music, the full photo gallery, stories and schedules remain in the app preview. The image does not include clickable maps, public invitation links or online RSVP. There is no guest-response tracking or cloud synchronization. The app interface is in English.

Invitation text and selected photos are stored locally and are not uploaded by the app. Umeng+ provides basic app usage analytics and may process device and usage information when online. Editing and export do not depend on analytics connectivity.

1. This service is a subscription based paid service, which means you will prepay for future subscription usage. You can currently choose to use this service on a quarterly basis. At the end of each subscription period, your subscription will automatically renew by default, unless you cancel the automatic renewal yourself or we cancel the service.
2. Unsubscribe: To cancel the renewal, please cancel at least 24 hours in advance. You can unsubscribe by opening System Settings, clicking on Apple ID, clicking on Subscription, selecting Premium, and then unsubscribing.
3. Restore purchase: If you receive a prompt saying "You have already subscribed to this project" during the payment process and confirm that you have completed the purchase before, you can click "Restore Purchase" in the upper right corner to restore the purchase.

name: Ippon Gestion
description:
Ippon Gestion est l'application de gestion des clubs de judo : l'équipe du club tient ses licenciés, ses cours et sa saison au même endroit, et chaque famille suit ce qui concerne son judoka.

Pour le club
• Licenciés : fiches, groupes et cours, documents de licence.
• Appel des présences à chaque cours, et fréquentation suivie sur la saison.
• Grades et UV : passages et progression de chaque licencié.
• Compétitions : inscriptions et résultats.
• Agenda du club : cours, séances et événements.
• Suivi des cotisations : montants dus et règlements enregistrés par le club.
• Messages et emails aux familles, notifications automatiques.
• Plusieurs administrateurs par club.

Pour les familles
• L'agenda, les présences, les grades et les compétitions de votre judoka.
• Les messages du club, et les notifications sur votre téléphone.
• Les documents partagés par le club.

Données et confidentialité
• Chaque club ne voit que ses propres données, et chaque famille que ce qui concerne son licencié.
• Données hébergées dans l'Union européenne.
• Les données d'un licencié mineur ne sont traitées qu'avec l'accord de son responsable légal.
• Aucune publicité, aucune donnée vendue.
• Suppression du compte à tout moment, depuis l'application.

Accès
Ippon Gestion s'utilise au sein d'un club : votre club vous invite par email à activer votre compte. Disponible en français et en anglais.

name: ISPPro
description:
Manage your ISPPro internet account from your iPhone.

• View your subscriptions and service information.
• Check invoices and payment status.
• Contact technical support by phone or email.
• Update your account details and profile photo.
• Check your connection speed with ISPPro Speedtest.
• Sign in with email, phone, Google or Apple.

An ISPPro customer account is required to access subscriptions, invoices and account support. Available services depend on your account. ISPPro provides internet services in Albania. The app supports Albanian and English.

name: IZIROVA Portal
description:
Discover IZIROVA Portal, the jewellery catalogue and customer workspace from IZIROVA Jewellery L.L.C in Dubai.

EXPLORE THE COLLECTION
Browse jewellery photographs and piece details. Explore available sizes, individual pieces and set configurations, then add your selections to your bag where ordering is enabled for your account.

KEEP YOUR ORDERS TOGETHER
Review your bag before submitting it to our team. Follow order progress, exchange messages about your orders, and download or share PDF invoices when available. You can also request custom pieces and attach reference photographs.

CLEAR QUOTES BEFORE PAYMENT
Estimates are indicative. Our team confirms availability, order details and the final quote, including the amount due and applicable terms. Submitting your bag does not itself charge you.

FOR PERSONAL CUSTOMERS, RETAILERS AND WHOLESALERS
New registrations start as Personal Customer accounts. Retailers and wholesalers can contact our sales team to request the appropriate catalogue access and ordering permissions. Catalogue access and ordering options depend on your account permissions.

Use IZIROVA Portal in English, French or Arabic. Optional notifications help you keep up with order updates and new collections.

name: Jaffna Racer
description:
Race through the real streets of Jaffna.

Jaffna Racer turns the city into your race track. Every road, junction and lagoon edge is built from real map data, so you can speed past Nallur Kandaswamy Kovil, round Jaffna Fort, along the lagoon and through the Town Centre, then try to beat your best time.

SEVEN ROUTES
Six circuits and one sprint across Jaffna: Town Centre, Chundikuli Beach, Nallur Kovil, Fort & Esplanade, University, Hindu College, and Nallur to the Fort.

THREE WAYS TO RACE
- Race: you against up to five rivals.
- Time Trial: just you and the clock.
- Knockout: the last car at the end of each lap is out.
Choose 1 lap for a quick race, or the full race, at Easy, Normal or Hard.

DRIVE IT YOUR WAY
Pick a hatchback, a family wagon or a tuk-tuk. Use the steering wheel or the tilt controls, nitro, ABS and the handbrake. Health pickups along every road keep you going after a crash.

A CITY THAT FEELS ALIVE
Palmyra palms, temples, churches, shops, people on the footpaths, bunting, tuk-tuks and cows on the road, big billboards of Jaffna culture, and the sound of temple bells as you pass.

DISCOVER JAFFNA
Before you race, flip through postcards of Jaffna: Nallur, the Public Library, the Fort, the beaches and islands, and the food to try.

No account, no sign-in and no tracking. Plays offline.

Made in Jaffna by AIRIZ. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

name: Jägarklar – Jägarexamen
description:
Plugga till jägarexamen med Jägarklar – gratis, utan konto och utan reklam.

Jägarklar hjälper dig att klara teoriprovet i jägarexamen. Över 2 000 övningsfrågor täcker alla ämnen i Naturvårdsverkets kompetensbeskrivning, och varje svar förklaras: varför det rätta är rätt och varför de andra alternativen lockar men är fel.

LÄS, ÖVA OCH TESTA DIG
• Läranderesa: gå igenom ämnena nivå för nivå med läsning, övning och nivåtest
• 17 teorikapitel med bilder, källor och förklarade begrepp
• Dagens pass: frågor valda efter vad du behöver öva på mest
• Repetition av det du svarat fel eller varit osäker på
• Klassiskt quiz med 10–50 blandade frågor
• Teoriprov med 70 frågor på 60 minuter, precis som det riktiga provet

ÄMNEN
Säker vapenhantering, jaktlagstiftning, artkännedom, vapen och ammunition, ballistik, jaktetik, jaktmetoder, eftersök, jakthundar, viltvård, ekologi, naturhänsyn, viltförvaltning, viltforskning, fångst och viltkött.

MER ÄN FRÅGOR
• Viltuppslagsverk med 87 arter: bilder, kännetecken och status
• Ordlista med 140 jakttermer och vändbara begreppskort
• Spel som tränar artkännedom, läten och säkra skottbeslut
• Studieplan och nedräkning till provdagen
• Påminnelser som hjälper dig att plugga lite varje dag

Frågor och teori bygger på gällande lagtext och myndigheternas information, med källor till varje avsnitt. Regler ändras, så kontrollera alltid aktuella bestämmelser hos myndigheterna.

Ingen inloggning, ingen spårning. Dina framsteg sparas bara på din telefon.

name: Jelly Ruler
description:
Jelly Ruler is a playful, precise vector editor for logos and icons.

Open a picture of a logo and Jelly Ruler peels it apart into smooth shapes: one clean Bézier path per part, not thousands of pixel steps. Then move, turn, resize, round and recolor every part, and export it as SVG, PNG or a ready-made app icon.

PEEL A PICTURE APART
• Two tracing engines: one for logos with a few flat colours, one for photos and artwork
• Gradients and shines come through as real gradients
• The picture stays underneath, so you can compare

MAKE IT YOURS
• Drag, snap, turn and squash parts with your finger or Apple Pencil
• Round corners, merge parts, cut gaps, and edit any path point by point
• Add shapes, or type a word in the Jelly Ruler Display typeface and bend each letter
• Keep versions side by side and step through them on a timeline

READY FOR EVERYWHERE
• Frames for iOS, iPadOS, macOS and watchOS app icons, the menu bar, favicons and link previews, each with its safe area
• Export SVG, PNG at every size a frame needs, or one zip with everything
• Save to Files, AirDrop, or share anywhere

SOFT INTERACTIONS, SHARP PRECISION
Jelly Ruler wobbles, sparkles and squishes while you work, and every number underneath stays exact.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Your logos stay on your iPad.

name: Jibby: Learn to Sail
description:
Learn to sail with Jibby, a friendly seagull who explains everything simply. Short lessons, real-feel simulators and quick quizzes take you from your first day on a yacht to a confident crew member.

LEARN BY DOING
• Trim the sails on a live simulator and watch the telltales react
• Steer with the wheel, tack and gybe, feel the points of sail
• Tie knots step by step: bowline, figure-eight, clove hitch, cleat hitch
• Moor alongside and stern-to in a marina, with wind and prop walk
• Give way correctly in crossing, head-on and overtaking situations
• Find the channel by buoys and marks, by day and at night
• Work the VHF radio: MAYDAY, PAN PAN and cancelling a false alert

10 MODULES
Wind and points of sail · Sails and speed · Knots · Life in a marina · Mooring and leaving · Rules of the road · Buoys and marks · Navigation and anchoring · Equipment · VHF radio

MADE FOR BEGINNERS
• Lessons take a few minutes
• Every new term comes with a picture
• Know some of it already? Take a skip test and jump ahead
• Review your mistakes and random questions from passed lessons

STAY MOTIVATED
Earn stars and XP, keep your streak, and rise through the ranks from Novice to Captain.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Russian, German and Greek. Switch any time in your profile.

EARLY ACCESS
Right now every module is free. Later the app will cost a little, and early users will get a special badge.

Jibby helps you learn and prepare. It does not replace a sailing school, a licence or practice on the water with an instructor.

name: JLPT Mock Test N5–N1
description:
JLPT mock tests N5–N1, with listening audio

Full practice tests in the JLPT format. Score by section with the pass mark the moment you finish.

Mock test 1 of every level (N5–N1), with audio, score and explanations.

The full exam, timed · Listening with audio · Score and pass mark at once

Scores are practice estimates calculated from correct answers, not a JLPT result.

Mistake notebook · Reminders · Saved for offline use

One payment. All levels, all tests, including future additions. No subscription.

Purchase through your app store. Purchases restore on devices using the same store account.

No account needed

Progress, answers and reminder settings stay on this device. No analytics, advertising or personal data collection. Store purchases are processed by Apple or Google.

JLPT Mock is an independent practice site and is not affiliated with the Japan Foundation or JEES. All questions and audio are original practice material in the JLPT format; scores are estimates.

name: jlptest
description:
Study Japanese for the JLPT with a course that runs in order from beginning to end, N5 through N1. All the content is open and free.

WHAT'S INSIDE
· 9,833 words arranged into 600 themed units of 20, not loose lists.
· 1,981 kanji with their readings, stroke counts and the words they appear in.
· 873 grammar points, from the simplest to the most complex, with sentences to practise on.
· 600 reading passages written to level: each one uses only the vocabulary and kanji you have already seen.
· News from Japan told at your level, five new stories every day, read aloud.
· Practice exams with the structure and the scoring of the real JLPT.

HOW YOU STUDY
· Spaced repetition flashcards: each word comes back just as you are about to forget it.
· A test for every unit, with a medal for your best score.
· Listening exercises: hear the sentence without seeing it, then answer.
· Rebuild the sentence piece by piece, with the translation beside it.
· Tap any word for the dictionary, furigana you can switch on and off, and kanji coloured by level.
· A daily review reminder, at the time you choose.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
The whole interface and every translation is in English and Spanish.

YOUR PROGRESS
A day streak, XP, mastered words and a ring for each level and topic showing how far you have come. You can study without an account; if you create one with your email, your progress follows you from one device to another.

FREE, WITH ADS THAT STAY OUT OF THE WAY
jlptest is supported by ads. They never appear during a test, an exam, a review or a reading.

name: Jokerise
description:
Jokerise is a roguelike autobattler set in a travelling puppet theatre. You lead Jest, a wooden jester in a bone-white mask, and a troupe of living masks. Win twelve shows across four Courts and crown Jest as the king of fools.

BUILD YOUR TROUPE:
Hire masks from the Wagon and drag them onto a 3×3 stage. Guards hold the Front row, Strikers hit hardest from the Mid row, and Muses charge their tricks from the Back. Hire a second copy of a mask to polish it to two stars. Two of those make three.

FIND THE HARMONY:
Each mask belongs to one of four Guises: Bell, Thorn, Mirror or Moth. Put two or four different masks of one Guise on stage to unlock its harmony. Jest counts for all four, so build around him.

TIME YOUR PRANK:
Shows play out on their own. You watch the Laugh meter fill and choose the moment to strike. Fire a Confetti Cannon at a wounded line, drop the strongest foe through a Trapdoor, or heal your troupe with a Standing Ovation.

NO TWO RUNS ALIKE:
The Courts arrive in a new order on each run, and each Court enforces its own Edict. You pick Trinkets after your first win in a Court and an Ascension for Jest after each Court Finale. Four bosses wait at the end: Duchess Briar, the Twin Regent, Abbot Dusk and King Carillon.

KEEP GROWING:
Earn Applause after every run and spend it in the Dressing Room on new masks, Pranks, Trinkets and stages. Climb five Encore levels once you take the crown.

FEATURES:
• 16 masks plus Jest, each with its own animated trick
• 4 Court bosses with unique tricks
• 14 Trinkets, 8 Ascensions and 6 Pranks
• 4 stages to unlock
• 12 reviews to earn

name: Jongle Garden Pals
description:
You start with 7 cards, drawing one more card and discarding another each turn. Try to form two sets of three and a pair to complete your hand. A set of three can be three identical cards or a sequence of three consecutive cards of the same suit. You can also use your opponent's recently played cards to complete your hand. The first player to reach 5 cups of tea wins the game. A small Mahjong table, adorable animal friends, and 1v1 matches lasting only a few minutes. This is a gentle way to get acquainted with Mahjong, hone your observation skills, and enjoy fun competitions.

There are 12 friends with 12 unique skills, from drawing more cards and reading your opponent's cards to changing cards in hand. Each skill can only be used once per game, so choosing the right moment will make all the difference.

Test your skills against 12 increasingly skillful opponents in Tea Ladder, compete against anyone in Quick Match, or step into Gauntlet to see how many consecutive wins you can achieve. Additionally, the 36 Mahjong puzzles offer engaging challenges where you need to complete the puzzle within the allowed number of draws.

Each victory earns you achievements, allows you to collect tea leaves, and unlock new decks. From emerald green to cherry blossoms and moonlit lakes, each deck possesses its own unique beauty.

With easy-to-understand instructions, one-touch hints, cute 3D graphics, and soothing sounds, the game is perfect for relaxing while still offering a bit of a challenge.

name: JP Stock Time — Market Hours
description:
Is the Tokyo market open right now, and what time is that for you?

Japan has three markets that keep different hours. The Tokyo Stock Exchange trades in a morning and an afternoon session. PTS venues (Japan's proprietary trading systems) keep trading at night. Nikkei 225 futures on the Osaka Exchange trade through the night until 6:00 Tokyo time, and on some holidays when the stock exchange is shut. JP Stock Time shows all three on one dial, counts down to the next change, and writes every time in your own time zone. It shows no prices.

◆ What it does

・Three markets on one 24-hour dial
The Tokyo Stock Exchange, PTS and futures are three rings, with a marker at the current moment. The dial follows your time zone, so you see when in your day Tokyo is trading.

・Your time, with Tokyo time alongside
Every time on screen, from the market cards and the hours table to notifications and widgets, is in your device's time zone, with Tokyo time (JST) next to your clock. Daylight saving on your side is handled for you. The 12- or 24-hour format follows your device.

・Counts down to the next change
Hours, minutes and seconds to the lunch break, the afternoon session, the close or the end of night trading. When everything is shut, it counts down to the next open.

・PTS hours for your broker
Choose "Japannext hours" to see the PTS venue's own schedule, with night trading until 6:00 Tokyo time, or pick one of five Japanese brokers whose night trading ends earlier: 23:59 at SBI Securities and Rakuten Securities, 2:00 at Matsui Securities, and none at Monex or Mitsubishi UFJ eSmart.

・Holidays, holiday trading, SQ and the year's first and final sessions
A calendar of Tokyo Stock Exchange holidays, the days when only futures open for holiday trading, the monthly SQ (major SQ in March, June, September and December) with the last trading day before it, and the first and final sessions of the year.

・Notifications, all off until you turn them on
15 minutes before the open and the close, when night trading starts, 15 minutes before PTS night trading ends, and on the business day before a weekday Tokyo holiday.

・Widgets and Apple Watch
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets keep counting without opening the app. The Apple Watch app runs on its own, and complications put the market's state on your watch face.

・Siri and Shortcuts
"Check the TSE in JP Stock Time" answers without opening the app.

・iPad and landscape layouts

◆ Who it is for

・Investors outside Japan who hold Japanese stocks or trade Nikkei 225 futures
・Anyone who wants to know when Tokyo opens in their own time zone
・Anyone who wants holiday trading days and SQ dates ahead of time

◆ About the hours

Hours follow the schedule in effect since 5 November 2024 (Tokyo Stock Exchange close at 15:30, futures day session to 15:45, night trading from 17:00, Tokyo time), checked against announcements by Japan Exchange Group (JPX), the PTS operator and each broker as of November 2026. Unscheduled halts and system outages are not reflected. For years JPX has not listed yet, holidays are estimated from Japan's national holiday law, and holiday trading shows as TBA until it is announced. Overseas brokers may set their own hours, so check with yours before trading. This app is not investment advice.

◆ One small ad, and nothing sent to us

On iPhone and iPad a single banner sits at the bottom of the screen, and a one-time purchase removes it. The Apple Watch app and the widgets have no ads.
The "Location" and "Tracking" entries in the App Store privacy section come from the ad (Google AdMob). The ad estimates a rough area from your IP address; the app never asks for location permission. The app asks once whether it may use your advertising identifier, and declining changes nothing. Your settings, such as your broker, stay on your device.

name: Juntos: Valencia Friends
description:
Juntos is a free app for making friends in Valencia. It is for people who live here or have just arrived and want a coffee, a walk, a language exchange, or a weekend plan — not a dating app.

Create a profile with your name, photo, neighbourhood (barrio), languages, and interests. Say hi to people you would like to meet. If you both say hi, you can chat. You can also join or host small group activities around the city.

You must be 18 or older. There is no advertising, and we do not sell your data.

Community rules (also in the Terms and in the app):

- 18+ only
- No harassment, hate, or sexual or otherwise objectionable content
- No spam or commercial abuse
- You can report and block
- We may remove content and warn, suspend, or delete accounts

Report and block are in the app. You can delete your account from Profile, or email hola@juntosspain.com. More detail: https://juntosspain.com/delete-account

Privacy policy: https://juntosspain.com/privacy
Terms of use: https://juntosspain.com/terms
Support: https://juntosspain.com

name: K2T – Planning restaurant
description:
K2T est l'application des managers et des gérants de restaurants, brasseries, snacks et hôtels qui utilisent le logiciel K2T. Elle reprend sur le téléphone ce qui compte pendant le service : le planning, l'équipe et les demandes à traiter.

AUJOURD'HUI
- La date, l'heure et l'établissement en tête d'écran.
- Le service en cours : qui est en poste selon le planning, qui arrive et à quelle heure, les services encore à pourvoir.
- La journée en chiffres : heures planifiées, coût estimé et part du chiffre d'affaires prévu quand votre rôle y donne accès.
- Ce qui attend votre décision : demandes de congés, planning modifié et pas encore envoyé.
- Les absents du jour et les jours fériés.

PLANNING
- Vue semaine : toute l'équipe sur sept jours, groupée par cuisine, salle et bar, avec le code de poste dans chaque case.
- Vue jour : une frise heure par heure pour repérer les creux et les chevauchements, avec l'heure actuelle.
- Les changements non envoyés sont signalés, comme les alertes de règles (pause, repos).
- Publier : un récapitulatif indique les services nouveaux, modifiés ou supprimés et la liste des salariés prévenus. Chacun reçoit son planning à jour par e-mail, sans avoir besoin de l'application. Les salariés sans adresse sont signalés pour que vous les préveniez de vive voix.

ÉQUIPE
- Les salariés qui travaillent aujourd'hui, tout le monde, ou seulement les dossiers à traiter.
- La fiche de chaque salarié : poste, contrat, semaine en cours, coordonnées, contact d'urgence.
- Appeler, envoyer un SMS ou un e-mail en un geste.
- Envoyer le lien d'embauche : le salarié dépose ses pièces depuis son téléphone, sans compte ni mot de passe.

DEMANDES D'ABSENCE
- Valider ou refuser une demande de congé, avec un motif si besoin.

PLUSIEURS ÉTABLISSEMENTS
- Passez d'un établissement à l'autre depuis le haut de l'écran. Les droits sont appliqués établissement par établissement.

SÉCURITÉ
- Connexion par adresse e-mail et mot de passe, avec double authentification quand votre compte l'exige (code à 6 chiffres ou code de secours).
- Les échanges sont chiffrés. Les données sensibles des salariés (sécurité sociale, coordonnées bancaires, santé) ne sont jamais envoyées à l'application.

LE MODE DÉMONSTRATION
Touchez « Voir la démo » sur l'écran de connexion pour parcourir K2T avec un restaurant fictif. Rien n'est envoyé à nos serveurs.

À SAVOIR
K2T s'utilise avec un compte ouvert par votre établissement. La création des services, les contrats et les réglages se font dans l'espace web K2T. Les salariés n'ont pas besoin de l'application : ils reçoivent leur planning par e-mail ; s'ils ont un compte, ils y voient leur planning publié.

K2T est un logiciel de Tourak Digital Group, à Troyes.

name: KaamBook
description:
**KaamBook – Household Staff Manager**

Managing household staff shouldn't be complicated. KaamBook makes it simple to organize staff details, track daily attendance, manage wages and payments, and maintain accurate household employment records—all from your phone or tablet.

Whether you employ a maid, cook, driver, gardener, nanny, or other household helper, KaamBook helps you manage everyday responsibilities in one convenient place.

**KEY FEATURES**

**1. Easy Household Staff Management**
- Add and manage multiple household staff members.
- Record names, roles, contact details, and wages.
- Choose monthly, daily, hourly, or per-visit payment arrangements.
- Configure working days and staff schedules.

KaamBook is useful for families and individuals who want a convenient way to manage domestic helpers without maintaining paper registers or complicated spreadsheets.

Simple to use. Flexible wage options. Organized records. Convenient reminders. Offline access. Privacy-focused design.

Make household staff management easier with KaamBook.

**Developed by ResoluTech Solutions.**

name: Kalkan Mail
description:
Kalkan Mail is a free email service by Karakaş Digital. Create your own @kalkanmail.com address in seconds and manage your mail in a clean, simple interface.

YOUR OWN ADDRESS
• Pick an available username and your address is ready in seconds
• Free plan: 1 GB storage, no card required

A SIMPLE MAILBOX
• Inbox, Sent, Drafts, Spam and Trash
• Write, reply and forward; attach files and open attachments
• Search your mail, mark as unread, report spam

PRIVACY AND SECURITY
• Connections are encrypted; the mail you send is authenticated with SPF, DKIM and DMARC
• Remote images in emails are not loaded until you allow them
• No ads, no tracking

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Display name, recovery email and password change
• Open support requests in the app and follow the replies
• Permanently delete your account in the app whenever you want

Available in Turkish, English, Arabic and Russian.

name: kanade: Retro Music Player
description:
kanade puts a tiny music player on your screen. Spin the click wheel to find a song, press the center button, and listen.

CLICK WHEEL CONTROLS
• Spin the wheel to move through menus, click by click
• While playing, spin to change the volume. Press the center button to scrub through the song or give it a star rating

YOUR MUSIC
• Playlists, artists, albums and songs from your library
• Recently Played and recommendations from Apple Music
• Shuffle Songs, plus shuffle and repeat settings

LOCK SCREEN AND WIDGETS
• A retro LCD "Now Playing" on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• A small wheel widget (play, previous, next) and a widget that shows the last song you played

Please note
• Playing songs from Apple Music requires an Apple Music subscription. Purchased songs in your library play without one.
• Star ratings are saved only in kanade on this iPhone.
• kanade does not collect any data and has no ads.

name: Kanjilla
description:
Learn to read Japanese, one character at a time.

Kanjilla brings hiragana, katakana and all 2,136 common-use kanji into a visual flashcard library. Discover familiar shapes, understand how characters fit together and spot the small differences between similar-looking kanji.

START WITH KANA
Browse hiragana and katakana with romaji and stroke-order animations. Practice recognizing characters with short quizzes.

FIND PATTERNS IN KANJI
Explore by school grade, frequency, stroke count, shared components or meaning topics. See which parts characters have in common and compare similar kanji with their distinguishing strokes highlighted.

MAKE CHARACTERS MEMORABLE
Explore different Japanese typefaces and illustrated memory aids. Illustrations are available for a growing selection of kanji.

READ IN CONTEXT
See meanings, on and kun readings, vocabulary and example sentences. Explore Japanese in posters, signs, packaging and magazine covers.

PRACTICE AT YOUR OWN PACE
Save cards to revisit, test yourself with mixed-script quizzes and review your most-missed characters in quiz statistics.

STUDY OFFLINE
The character library, stroke animations and bundled examples work without an internet connection. External source links require internet access.

name: Kara Dosya
description:
Kapanmamış dosyalar seni bekliyor, dedektif.

Kara Dosya, gerçek bir dedektif masasına oturduğun bir gizem oyunu. Yıllar önce "kaza" denip kapatılan davalar yeniden açıldı. Elinde yalnızca dosya var: ifadeler, otopsi raporları, gazete kupürleri, telefon dökümleri, mektuplar, krokiler ve fotoğraflar. Gerisi senin aklına kalmış.

NASIL OYNANIR
• Zarfları sırayla aç. Her zarf yeni kanıtlar, yeni şüpheler getirir.
• Her belgeyi dikkatle oku. Saatleri yan yana koy, çelişkileri yakala.
• Önemli satırları seçip panoya as, kırmızı iple birbirine bağla.
• Şüphelileri işaretle, notlarını tut, şifreli kilitleri çöz.
• Hazır olduğunda suçlunu seç. Üç hakkın var; ilk denemede bulursan üç yıldız!

ARKADAŞLARINLA OYNA
Oda kur, 6 haneli kodu gönder, en fazla 6 kişi aynı dosyayı aynı anda çözün. Açılan zarflar, pano ve işaretler herkesin ekranında anında güncellenir.

50 DAVA, 5 BÖLÜM
Boğaziçi yalılarından Eski Çarşı'nın dar sokaklarına, İngiliz malikânelerinden Fransız şatolarına ve İspanya'nın sıcak avlularına uzanan elli özgün dava. Her bölümün sonunda en büyük ve en zor dosya seni bekliyor: Özel Dosya.

ÖZELLİKLER
• Gerçekçi fotoğraflar, el yazısı notlar, eskimiş belgeler
• Ses kayıtları, mesaj dökümleri, QR kodlu kanıtlar ve şifreli kilitler
• Takıldığında seni doğru yere yönlendiren ipuçları
• Türkçe ve İngilizce
• Hesap gerekmez; ilerlemen cihazında saklanır

Tüm kişiler, kurumlar ve olaylar kurgudur.

Not: Her bölümün final dosyası (Özel Dosya) uygulama içi satın alma ile açılır.

name: Katkı Takvimi
description:
Katkı Takvimi, bireysel emeklilik (BES) ve otomatik katılım (OKS) sözleşmelerinizin tarihlerini ve hesaplarını tek ekranda toplar. Hesap açmanız veya giriş yapmanız gerekmez; bilgileriniz yalnızca telefonunuzda kalır.

Neler yapar?
• Hakediş takvimi: Sözleşmenin sisteme giriş tarihinden, devlet katkısı hakediş oranınızın %15, %35 ve %60 olacağı günleri ve 10 yıl + 56 yaş kuralına göre tahmini emeklilik tarihinizi gösterir. 2013 öncesi ek süreyi de hesaba katar.
• Çıkarsam ne alırım?: Birikiminizi, ödediğiniz katkıları ve devlet katkısı bakiyenizi yazın; stopajı, hak kazandığınız ve kaybedeceğiniz devlet katkısını ve elinize geçecek yaklaşık tutarı görün. Bir sonraki hakediş adımı bir yıldan yakınsa, beklemenin farkını da söyler.
• Yıllık limit: Bu yıl ödediklerinize göre ne kadar devlet katkısı alacağınızı, limite ne kadar kaldığını ve kalan aylarda ne kadar ödemeniz gerektiğini hesaplar.
• Kısmen ödeme: Evlilik, konut veya doğal afet nedeniyle kısmen ödeme alıp alamayacağınızı, nedenini ve alabileceğiniz en yüksek tutarı gösterir.
• Takip: Çıkış, cayma, belge ve toplu ödeme sürelerini izler; son günden bir gün önce ve son gün hatırlatır.
• Aile: Çocuklarınızın veya eşinizin sözleşmelerini ayrı ayrı ekleyin; her kişinin tarihleri ve yıllık limiti ayrı hesaplanır.
• Rehber: Kuralları sade bir dille, resmî kaynak bağlantılarıyla anlatan 9 kısa kart.

Tutarları Türkçe yazdığınız gibi girin: "1.234,56" veya "1.250" doğru okunur. Tarihler takvimden seçilir.

Ne yapmaz?
Katkı Takvimi hesabınıza bağlanmaz, bakiyenizi okumaz, emeklilik planı satmaz, fon veya şirket önermez ve sizden kişisel bilgi istemez. Kendi sözleşmelerinizi EGM'nin resmî mobil uygulamasında veya e-Devlet'te görebilirsiniz.

Kaynaklar
Kurallar Emeklilik Gözetim Merkezi (EGM) yayınlarından, 4632 sayılı Kanun'dan, Gelir Vergisi Kanunu md. 75 ve 94'ten, 10811 sayılı Cumhurbaşkanı Kararı'ndan ve 2025/1 sayılı Asgari Ücret Tespit Komisyonu Kararı'ndan derlenmiştir (11.11.2026 itibarıyla). Her sonuçta kaynak ve tarih gösterilir.

Bağımsız bir hesaplayıcı
Katkı Takvimi bağımsız bir hesaplayıcıdır; emeklilik şirketi, resmî bir hizmet veya yatırım danışmanı değildir. Emeklilik Gözetim Merkezi, e-Devlet Kapısı, SEDDK, Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı veya herhangi bir emeklilik şirketiyle bağlantılı değildir; resmî bir uygulama değildir.
Resmî kaynaklar:
https://www.egm.org.tr/katilimcilar/katilimci-bilgilendirme-rehberi/
https://www.egm.org.tr/bireysel-emeklilik/devlet-katkisi/
https://www.turkiye.gov.tr/emeklilik-gozetim-merkezi

Gizlilik
Hesap yok, analiz yazılımı yok. Girdiğiniz tarihler, adlar ve tutarlar yalnızca telefonunuzda saklanır.

Uyarı
Bu uygulama bilgilendirme amaçlıdır; yatırım, vergi veya hukuk danışmanlığı değildir. Hesaplamalar tahminidir. Kesin tutarlar emeklilik şirketinizin belgelerine göre belirlenir.

name: Kelime Öğreniyorum: Kartlar
seller_name: Diyalektik Insaat Yazilim Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Sirketi
description:
Kelime Öğreniyorum ("I am learning words") is a calm, simple picture word game for families with little ones (ages 1 to 4) learning their first words in Turkish and English.

There is one big card on the screen: a real photo with the word below it. Your little one taps the card to see the next word and taps the speaker to hear it. No reading required.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 165 built-in words in 14 categories: animals, food, vehicles, family, body, feelings, nature, toys and more
• Real photos for more than 150 words, or switch to friendly illustrations or emoji
• Natural, human-like Turkish and English voices
• Animal sounds: first the animal's sound, then its name
• Your own words: take a photo, type the name, record it in your own voice (mum, dad, grandpa, the family cat)
• Switch between Turkish and English with one tap

MADE FOR LITTLE HANDS
• Big cards, one tap to advance, a screen that does not scroll away
• Rapid repeated taps don't skip cards or restart the sound
• Settings, adding words and the report button are behind a parental gate

SAFE AND PRIVATE
• No ads, no purchases, no account
• No tracking, no analytics
• Your photos and recordings stay on your device
• All photos and sounds are built in; works without an internet connection

Photos are openly licensed from Wikimedia Commons; sources are listed inside the app.

name: Keybo: AI Keyboard & Reply
description:
Keybo is an AI keyboard that helps you say the right thing, in any app. Messages, email, social, work chat: open Keybo, tap once, done.

REWRITE IN ONE TAP
• 13 styles: Proofread, Tactful, Casual, Work, Compliment, Decline, Apologize, Follow up, Thank, Comfort, Funny, Email, Social post
• Stack tweaks: Shorter, Longer, Politer, More casual, Add emoji, Bullet list
• Save your own instructions, reorder or hide styles
• Not happy? Tap again for a fresh version. Your original is always one tap away

SMART REPLY
• Copy a message, get 5 different replies: agree, decline politely, ask more, funny, caring
• Tell Keybo who you're talking to: friend, partner, crush, family, boss, client
• Set your persona and paste a few of your own messages, so replies sound like you
• Read screenshot: take a screenshot of the chat and Keybo reads the conversation on your device for full context
• Got several messages in a row? Copy them one by one or read a few screenshots: Keybo keeps the whole conversation for context
• Pick a reply and Keybo remembers it, so the next suggestion follows the chat

TRANSLATE AS YOU TYPE
• Write in your language, send natural English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German and more
• Keeps your tone, emoji, names and links

A REAL KEYBOARD
• Swipe typing with a live trail, word suggestions, double-space period
• Text shortcuts: type a few letters (or the first 4 characters) and Keybo completes your address, email or phone number
• Clipboard history with pins, 100+ keyboard themes
• Chinese Pinyin and 9-key input built in
• Works on iPhone and iPad

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• What you type stays on your device
• Only the text you send to AI leaves it, and it isn't stored on our server
• Screenshots are read on-device and never uploaded
• No account, no ads, no tracking

KEYBO PRO
• Free trial: 80 AI requests
• Pro: 800 AI requests a day
• Monthly, quarterly or yearly
• Or unlock “Use your own API” once and add your own model key for unlimited requests

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.
Terms: https://keybo.ragcodes.com/terms
Privacy: https://keybo.ragcodes.com/privacy

name: Khoman Siege
description:
Defend the core. Master synergies. Survive wave 100.

Khoman Siege is a futuristic Tower Defense designed for portrait, one-handed play. Build towers beside the path, choose their specializations, and combine their effects to stop increasingly difficult waves.

• 8 towers and 16 specializations: upgrade every tower and choose its path at level 4.
• 13 synergies: placement matters. Combine towers to unlock powerful bonuses.
• Story mode: clear 16 levels across four islands and earn all three stars.
• Endless Survival: every map is generated from a seed you can share.
