• Permanent talents: earn Cores and improve your arsenal.
• 11 enemies with abilities: armored units, healers, shields, splitters, bosses, and more.
• Built-in Codex: browse every tower, enemy, and synergy.

Play offline. Runs save automatically. Speed up the action at x1, x2, or x5.

name: Kick The Goose
description:
One farm kid. One very surprised goose. One perfect kick.

Stop the power meter dead in the middle, send your goose tumbling into the sky, then tap to flap and keep it flying. Every flight is real ragdoll physics, so no two launches land the same.

KICK, FLAP, FLY
• Time the meter: Perfect kicks fly furthest
• Tap to flap mid-air and turn a fall into a climb
• Bounce off hay bales and trampolines, grab bread for extra flaps and chilli for a burst of speed
• Dodge crows and fences that knock you off course

CHAIN THE MAYHEM
• Sheep, cows, trucks, fireworks and even a UFO fling your goose further
• Hit them in a row to build a mayhem chain for bonus coins

UNLOCK 17 SKY GADGETS
• Balloons, kites, paragliders, bouncy clouds, geysers, pocket rockets, tornadoes and more
• Upgrade each one to make every flight wilder

FLY FURTHER, FLY HIGHER
• Travel from the farm through the village, suburbs, city, harbour, desert and snowfields
• Climb past the clouds to the edge of space, the Moon, the galaxy and beyond

BUILD YOUR FARM
• Collect 55 pets: one from every landing, more from pet bubbles caught mid-flight
• Pets in your pen earn coins while you play, and a little while you are away
• Merge copies to give your favourites stars
• Train on the treadmill to make every kick stronger

16 GEESE TO COLLECT
• Classic, Chonky, Ninja, Frost, Ember, Cosmic and more, each with its own flight style
• Dress them up with hats and accessories

Plays offline. No ads. Play in English or Simplified Chinese.

name: Kill Karen
description:
The mall is overrun. Somebody has to work the shift.

Kill Karen is a one-thumb arena shooter set across ten floors of a mall on the worst sale day in history. A strange green smoke has turned every entitled shopper into a zombie Karen, and they all want to speak to the manager.

You are Erin, a department store employee with a pump shotgun. Your sidekick Jim from Fragrances brought a lighter and a bottle of cologne. Together you clear the mall one floor at a time.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Drag one thumb to move. Erin aims and fires on her own.
• Short runs you can finish in a queue.
• Level up mid-fight and pick one of three power-ups.
• Every floor ends with a boss Karen with her own attacks and her own complaints.

TEN FLOORS, TEN BOSSES
The Department Store, the Main Mall, the Food Court, the Shoe Store, the Toy Store, the Movie Theater, the Parking Garage, the Pet Store, the Mall Office and Center Court. Meet Linda at the returns desk, Brenda the queen of the food court, General Deborah the soccer mom supreme, and Karen Prime, patient zero.

THE PRO SHOP
• Three weapons to buy and upgrade: the pump shotgun, the machine gun and the BFG.
• Permanent perks for Erin and Jim.
• Daily bonus, daily missions and an endless Overtime mode.

FAIR ABOUT ADS
Ads only ever appear between levels, never during play. Optional ads can double your coins or revive you. One purchase removes ads for good.

Kill Karen is a work of comedy fiction from the makers of the film of the same name.

name: Kipo
description:
Kipo è la suite per progetti, CRM, vendite e spese. Con l'app ritrovi sul telefono il lavoro che fai sulla web app, con lo stesso account.

La tua giornata
Attività del CRM, task in scadenza e cose in ritardo in un'unica schermata. Chiami o scrivi a un cliente con un tocco.

Task e progetti
I tuoi task divisi per progetto, con filtri e ricerca. Cambi lo stato, commenti e registri le ore. Segui l'avanzamento dei progetti e delle release.

CRM
Pipeline con valori e deal fermi, attività, contatti e aziende. Sposti un deal di fase o pianifichi una chiamata in pochi secondi.

Vendite, commesse e spese
Preventivi in attesa, fatture scadute e da incassare, valore e residuo delle commesse. Le note spese si compilano con la foto dello scontrino e partono verso chi le approva.

Kipo AI
Fai domande sui tuoi dati: cosa hai in programma, quali task sono in ritardo, come va la pipeline. Se propone di modificare qualcosa, te lo chiede prima.

Anche offline
Task, attività e contatti restano consultabili senza rete; le modifiche partono appena torni online.

Per usare l'app serve un account Kipo: lo crei su getkipo.cloud.

name: Kippari: Quit & Habit Tracker
description:
Alcohol, smoking, snacking, social media, staying up late. Working out, reading, early rising.
Whatever you want to quit or build, Kippari turns it into a buddy that slowly evolves.

HATCH AND EVOLVE
Day one starts with an egg. After 1 day it hatches, then evolves at 3 days, 1 week, 1 month and beyond, with big evolutions at 1 month and 1 year. Choose from 30 original buddies: plants, small animals, big animals and mythical creatures.

QUIT OR BUILD
For habits to quit, your buddy grows with the time since you stopped. For habits to build, it grows with your streak of daily "Did it today!" check-ins.

MADE TO KEEP YOU GOING
- Rest tickets: miss a day without breaking your streak (1 per month free)
- Pet your buddy once a day to bring evolution a little closer
- Collect forms and badges
- Create a room with friends and see each other's buddies
- Comeback bonus: 1.5x faster evolution for 3 days after a reset
- Notifications at evolution time and reminders when you haven't checked in
- Home Screen widget to check your progress

SEE WHAT YOU SAVED
Enter what you used to spend each day and see the money and time you've saved.

YOUR BUDDIES STAY
Even after a reset, the buddies you raised stay in "Past partners".

KIPPARI PRO
- No ads
- Choose from all 30 buddies (5 in the free version)
- 3 rest tickets every month
- Sign in with Apple to back up your records to iCloud and restore them on a new phone
- Analyze your full history, even from before you upgraded
- Unlimited habits
- Check in from the widget

Monthly trial, yearly and lifetime options. Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period.
The free version shows a banner ad. This app does not provide medical advice or treatment.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1By64Xj56mo0CMjReGkyPq7x-MfWHMsnBMvAsFoCCTgo/view

name: Kitchen Planner 3D: Cabinets
description:
Plan your new kitchen in minutes, right on your phone.

Choose the shape of your kitchen, set your wall lengths, and the cabinets lay themselves out for you: base cabinets, uppers, the sink under the window, room for the stove, dishwasher and fridge. Everything is in 3D, so you can walk around it, open the doors and pull out the drawers.

MAKE IT YOURS
- Drag the sink, stove, fridge, windows and doors along the walls; the cabinets rearrange around them
- Tap any cabinet to change its type: drawers, doors, a trash pull-out and more
- Put the dishwasher on either side of the sink
- Uppers to the ceiling, or the shorter, simpler kind
- Try different finishes: Classic White, Navy Blue, Sage Green, Warm Walnut, Natural Oak and more, each with a feel for how the price moves
- Shaker or slab doors

REAL CABINETS, NOT A PICTURE
Every cabinet comes from the library of a working custom cabinet shop, built the way they are really built. What you see is a kitchen that can be made.

SHARE IT
Save a picture of your kitchen and send it to your family, your contractor or your cabinet maker.

TELL US WHAT YOU NEED
Tap the feedback button on any screen, circle what you mean and write a line. We read every one and reply.

name: Kite Voice: AI Dictation
description:
Kite Voice is a voice keyboard: tap the mic in a text field that supports third-party keyboards, speak, and the text goes in.

The best recognition happens on your own Mac. The audio travels encrypted over Tailscale straight to the Mac you paired, where Whisper transcribes it. Then Claude Code or Codex, already signed in on your Mac, turns it into clean text: filler words removed, punctuation fixed. Before you pair a Mac, the iPhone's own speech recognition works too. Kite Voice has no servers of its own and collects no data.

Made for
- People who use a Mac and code with Claude Code or Codex on it
- Anyone who wants high-quality dictation without handing their voice to a third-party cloud service

Features
- A system keyboard that works in apps that allow third-party keyboards: Messages, Mail, Notes, Safari, ChatGPT and more
- Three languages: Chinese, English and Spanish, detected automatically, also mixed within one sentence
- AI polish: removes fillers, fixes typos and punctuation, aims to preserve your meaning; review important names and numbers; can be turned off for recognition only
- Noisy places: turns on the iPhone's own voice processing, with Voice Isolation as an option
- Typing layer: type without Full Access (letters, numbers, symbols, long-press for accents)
- Ready microphone: after a dictation, tap the mic in any app to start right away within a time you choose, or never keep it ready

Without a Mac
- The iPhone's own speech recognition, one language per dictation, no AI polish
- Recognition happens in Kite Voice: after dictating in another app, it opens Kite Voice for a moment

With your Mac (recommended)
- Kitestring for Mac installed with dictation on, the Mac and the iPhone on the same Tailscale network
- Recognised by the Mac: more accurate, mixed languages in one sentence, no switching apps
- AI polish: Claude Code or Codex signed in on the Mac (your own subscription)

The app's interface is currently in Simplified Chinese; dictation works in Chinese, English and Spanish.

Privacy
- Records only after you tap the mic
- With a Mac paired, audio and text go only to your own Mac; with polish on, the text is processed by your own Claude or Codex account
- Without a Mac, the iPhone's speech recognition handles it: on the phone when it supports the language, otherwise Apple's speech recognition service
- What you type is never stored or sent; only the text around a dictation and your edits to it go to your own Mac, to make recognition more accurate
- The last 100 dictations stay on the phone and can be cleared at any time

Purchases
The app is free to download; ordinary typing is free. All voice features require a subscription or lifetime purchase. US pricing is $5.99 per year or $19.99 once; local prices are shown before purchase. Both options unlock the same voice features. No free trial. Annual subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage subscriptions through your Apple account. A lifetime purchase does not cancel an existing subscription. Mac recognition requires your own Mac and network; AI polishing uses your own configured AI account.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Knack: Social Skills
description:
Knack helps you get better with people by practicing, a few minutes at a time.

Reading about social skills doesn't build them. So Knack has three parts: learn one idea, practice it safely, then try it for real. Bo, a capybara who gets along with everyone, keeps you company the whole way.

LEARN ONE IDEA
• 32 short lessons on four paths: Conversations, Listening, Confidence and Hard moments.
• Each lesson takes about four minutes and is built on published research or a well-known book, which it names at the end so you can check it.
• You answer questions and type your own replies. Your replies are checked on your iPhone, so "idk" doesn't get a gold star.
• Lessons unlock one after another along a path, so you can see how far you've come.

PRACTICE IT SAFELY
• Whole practice conversations: a new coworker, a friend with bad news, a first date, asking for a raise, a party where you know no one.
• The other person reacts to what you choose, a rapport bar moves, and you get a reason for every reaction.
• Run each one as often as you like. Nobody is watching.

TRY IT FOR REAL
• Three small missions a day at the level you choose: Gentle, Stretch or Bold.
• Write your own, log how they went, and keep a streak.

MADE TO FIT YOU
• A few optional questions set your starting path and which conversations you see.
• Quiet people are welcome. There's a lesson on connecting without wearing a mask.
• Bo earns a scarf, a flower, a bow tie, a cape and a crown as you level up.
• A Home Screen widget with Bo and your streak. Choose its colors, and whether Bo teases you or stays gentle.

HONEST BY DESIGN
• No account, no email, no sign-up.
• Nothing you do or type leaves your iPhone. No ads, no tracking.
• Your whole starting path, the first step of every other path, and all missions are free.
• No free trial that turns into a charge.

KNACK PRO
Knack Pro unlocks every path and every practice conversation. It is an auto-renewing subscription, available monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Knack is educational. It is not therapy or medical advice.

Privacy Policy: https://knack-app.netlify.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: KNOBSOCK
description: KNOBSOCK is an entertainment and social media app (and website) centered around the NYC art collective of the same name.

name: KokiNest
description:
KokiNest – Your Koki Corn Cooking Companion
Discover a creative way to plan, prepare, and perfect Koki Corn, a traditional Cameroonian dish made with fresh corn, leafy greens, and palm oil.
KokiNest is a dedicated cooking companion designed to help you organize recipes, explore wrapping techniques, plan steaming sessions, discover meal pairings, and keep track of your cooking experiences. Whether you are preparing Koki Corn for the first time or refining your favorite homemade recipe, KokiNest brings every part of the preparation process into one convenient place.
Key Features
Formula Lab – Create Your Perfect Recipe
Build personalized Koki Corn recipes by recording ingredients, quantities, corn varieties, seasonings, and preparation preferences. Organize your favorite combinations and keep your recipes ready for future cooking sessions.
Leaf Workshop – Plan Your Wrapping Process
Organize banana leaf or foil wrapping preparations, record parcel sizes, wrapping techniques, material requirements, and portion details. Keep your preparation plans structured for a smoother cooking experience.
Steam Station – Organize Cooking Sessions
Plan steaming sessions by recording cooking methods, parcel quantities, temperatures, durations, and preparation details. Maintain a convenient record of your cooking process and preferred steaming approaches.
Pairing Table – Explore Serving Combinations
Create personalized meal combinations featuring Koki Corn. Record complementary dishes, ingredients, serving styles, occasions, and portion preferences to organize complete meal ideas.
Batch Journal – Learn From Every Preparation
Keep a detailed cooking journal to document completed Koki Corn batches. Record texture, flavor, moisture, preparation methods, cooking observations, and personal ratings to identify your favorite results.
More Reasons to Love KokiNest
	•	Five dedicated sections for organizing Koki Corn preparation.
	•	Personalized recipe and ingredient records.
	•	Wrapping and steaming preparation management.
	•	Custom meal pairing and serving plans.
	•	Cooking history and batch evaluation.
	•	Visual summaries and helpful statistics.
	•	Simple tools for adding, editing, and managing entries.
	•	A colorful interface inspired by corn, banana leaves, and traditional cooking.
	•	Convenient local storage for personal cooking records.
Celebrate Cameroonian Culinary Tradition
KokiNest brings inspiration from Cameroonian food culture into a modern cooking organizer. Explore ingredients, experiment with preparation techniques, preserve your favorite recipes, and develop your cooking skills through your own experiences.
From your first ingredient selection to your final serving, KokiNest helps you create a more organized and enjoyable Koki Corn cooking journey.
KokiNest – Craft Your Recipe, Preserve the Flavor.

name: Kolena Agents
description:
Kolena Agents brings your organization's Kolena Agents to iPhone and iPad. Send documents to an Agent from wherever you are and follow the results as they arrive.

Kolena Agents for iOS is for teams that already use Kolena. Sign in with your Kolena account. Your organization's administrator manages who has access.

SEND DOCUMENTS
• Scan paper documents with the camera, pick photos or attach files
• Record a voice note or type notes to send along with the documents
• Add a reference ID so the Run is easy to find later

FOLLOW RESULTS
• Watch each Prompt complete as the Run progresses
• Read tables, forms, classifications and summaries, with the source pages they came from
• Track every Run in Activity, filter by status, or search by reference, file or Agent

KNOW YOUR AGENTS
• Browse Agents by workspace
• See each Agent's Prompts, document filters and output templates before you send

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• Agents and Runs side by side on iPad and larger screens
• Light and dark appearance

The app has the same access you have on the web. It signs in with its own key, which you can revoke from your Kolena profile, and signing out deletes it.

Requires a Kolena account provided by your organization.

name: Ksppow
description:
Welcome! We hope to provide you with a pleasant experience and look forward to your feedback.

Ksppow keeps time for everything in your home that can go off, so you use it before it turns.

Milk, spinach, last night's curry, the open jar of pesto, the frozen peas, and the stuff outside the fridge too: painkillers, sunscreen, mascara, batteries, warranties, even your passport renewal. Add an item in seconds and Ksppow puts it on the right shelf with a ripeness ring that drains from green to yellow to red as the date gets close.

USE FIRST, EVERY DAY
Your home screen is a "use first" list sorted by urgency: Gone off, Today & tomorrow, This week, Later. One tap marks something as used. Tap an item to log it as tossed, give it a few more days, edit it or delete it. An overall freshness ring tells you how your kitchen is doing at a glance.

DRAWERS FOR EVERY PLACE
Fridge, Freezer, Pantry and Cabinet are drawers on a fridge front. Pull one open to see everything that lives there and how fresh it is.

FAST ADDING WITH SMART PRESETS
Milk +7 days, Bread +5, Eggs +21, Leftovers +3, Open sauce +30, Sunscreen +1 year and many more. Pick a preset, choose quick days or a date on the calendar, and add an optional quantity and price. Save your own presets for the things you buy every week.

REMINDERS THAT ARRIVE ON TIME
Choose to be nudged on the day, or 1, 2 or 3 days before, at the time that suits you. Reminders are scheduled on your phone.

YOUR KSPPOW SCORE
See what you used and what you tossed this month, a money-saved estimate from item prices, your streak of zero-waste weeks, the category you toss most, a six-week chart and your full history. Put an item back on the shelf if you tapped it by mistake.

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
Start without an account, or sign in with email, Google or Apple to keep your shelf across devices. Guests can save their data to an account later without losing anything. Delete your account and all of its data from Settings at any time. Ksppow works offline and syncs when you are back online.

Toss less. Save more. Use it first.

name: Kubi Duel: Trivia Battle
description:
In Kubi Duel both players get the same question at the same time, and the first one to miss loses. If you both get it right, the duel goes on and the clock gets shorter every round. After 10 rounds, the fastest correct answers win.

LIVE DUELS
• Get matched live with real players around the world.
• You see when your opponent answers, never what they picked.
• The timer starts at 15 seconds and shrinks every round.
• If no opponent turns up within 20 seconds, a computer opponent clearly labeled "COMPUTER" steps in, so you never wait.
• Inappropriate player names are filtered, and after every live duel you can report or block your opponent.

4 TOPICS
• Math: quick sums and missing numbers
• Logic: sequences and "find the odd one out"
• General Knowledge: science, geography, art, animals and more
• Mixed: a bit of everything

4 LANGUAGES
English, Turkish, Spanish and German. Everyone sees the question in their own language, so players of different languages can meet in the same duel.

LEAGUE AND RANKINGS
A weekly league and a Top 10 board, with a separate rating for every topic.

FAIR PLAY
• 12 cute avatars; the starred ones unlock with coins earned in the game.
• You only lose a heart when you lose; hearts refill over time and reset at midnight.
• Practice mode is free and never costs a heart.
• No pay-to-win. No account, no ads, no in-app purchases.

Kubi is the mascot of the Zeka Küpü channel on YouTube. Made by Ekapex.

name: KurdSign: Kurdish Sign
description:
KurdSign helps deaf and hearing people talk to each other in Kurdish. Point your phone's camera at a signer: KurdSign recognises the signs, writes them as text and can read them aloud in natural Sorani Kurdish.

ON-DEVICE AND PRIVATE
Hand tracking and sign recognition run entirely on your phone. No image or video is ever recorded or uploaded.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Translate: live camera hand tracking that turns Kurdish fingerspelling and community signs into text.
• Speak: read text aloud in a clear Sorani Kurdish voice, or in English or Arabic.
• Quick phrases: 72 everyday phrases in 6 categories (basics, health and emergency, daily life, shopping, transport, offices) with search. Tap one to show it full screen and hear it.
• Community: record a new sign in a few seconds, review signs others added (correct / wrong) and report anything inappropriate. Approved signs become available to everyone.
• Letter guide: see how each Kurdish letter is signed.
• Three languages: the app is available in Sorani Kurdish, English and Arabic.

FREE, NO ADS, NO ACCOUNT
KurdSign is free and has no ads. You don't need an account. You can delete everything you added at any time in Settings.

KurdSign is in beta. Recognition gets better as the community adds and reviews more signs. Made by Lara-IT in Kurdistan.

name: La Source Distribution
description:
lasourcedistribution : Votre solution ultime d'approvisionnement alimentaire pour restaurants et cafés
Marre des factures interminables et des appels téléphoniques nocturnes ? lasourcedistribution facilite et améliore la commande auprès des distributeurs, gratuitement. Conçu pour les chefs, les gérants et les entreprises de restauration, lasourcedistribution rationalise le processus de commande, le rendant plus rapide, plus précis et sans tracas.

Pour les chefs et les responsables des commandes :

- Commandez de n'importe où : Passez des commandes directement auprès de votre distributeur via l'application, disponible sur tous les appareils mobiles et tablettes.
- Guides de commande numériques : Restez organisé avec des guides de commande numériques personnalisables et catégorisés pour votre commodité.
- Parcourez les catalogues des distributeurs : Découvrez des produits nouveaux et passionnants adaptés à vos besoins.
- Communication d'équipe : Discutez avec votre équipe et les représentants commerciaux ; les appareils sont synchronisés dans toute votre équipe pour tenir tout le monde informé.

Découvrez la commodité de lasourcedistribution et révolutionnez votre gestion d'approvisionnement alimentaire. Téléchargez maintenant et rejoignez une communauté d'entreprises prospères grâce à des commandes fiables et efficaces, le tout sans frais.

name: Labelfit: Address Labels
description:
Print the addresses from your Contacts onto the label sheets you already bought. Print one test page on plain paper and Labelfit lines the labels up with your printer.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Add addresses: pick people or a whole group from Contacts, paste a list or a spreadsheet, or type them in. Tick who gets a card this year.
2. Choose your label sheet by the number on the pack, such as 5160 or L7160, or enter your own sizes.
3. Print. You see the whole sheet before you print, and you can start on a part-used sheet.

LINED UP WITH YOUR PRINTER
Every printer puts the page in a slightly different place, and many stretch it a little along the paper path. Lay Labelfit's test page on a label sheet, hold both up to a window and read four small scales. No ruler needed. Labelfit corrects the shift and the stretch to within about a millimetre and keeps text 2 mm in from every edge, so addresses stay inside the label. Corrections are saved for each printer.

SHEETS IT WORKS WITH
Works with Avery 5160, 8160, 5161, 5162, 5163, 5164, 5167 (return address), 22807 (2 in round), L7160, L7163, L7161, L7159 and Avery Zweckform 3422, 3475, 3474. Any other sheet: enter its sizes. Avery and Zweckform are trademarks of their owners; Labelfit is not affiliated with them.

ALSO
- Several named lists, such as Christmas 2026 or Wedding, kept for next year
- Return address labels: fill a whole sheet with one address
- Four fonts, centered or left, bold names, optional country line
- Print with AirPrint or export a PDF that is exactly the paper size

PRICE
Test pages are always free. Your first two prints are free, the first sheet each time, with no watermark. Labelfit Full is a one-time purchase that prints every sheet of every list. No subscription. Family Sharing is on.

PRIVACY
Your addresses stay on your device. Labelfit has no account and no server and sends nothing anywhere. Contacts are read only when you choose to import, and only on your device.

HOW DO I…
How do I print address labels from iPhone contacts?
Open Addresses, tap Add from Contacts, choose a group or pick people, then Print.

How do I print on Avery 5160 from an iPad?
Choose Label sheet, pick 5160 / 8160, check the preview and tap Print. In the print options choose 100% or Actual Size.

Why are my labels printing off-center?
Your printer shifts or stretches the page a little. Print Labelfit's test page once, read the four scales and save; later prints are corrected.

How do I print on a sheet that is already partly used?
Tap the first free label in the preview, or use Start at label.

How do I print a sheet of return address labels?
Choose a return address sheet such as 5167, then set Fill sheet with to your own address.

How do I keep last year's Christmas card list?
Lists stay on your device. Open Lists and duplicate last year's to start this year's.

How do I print labels from a spreadsheet?
Copy the rows with a header (Name, Street, City, State, ZIP), then use Paste addresses or open a CSV file.

name: Lahmacun Fabrikası
description:
Lahmacun Fabrikası’nın lezzetleri ve ayrıcalıkları şimdi cebinde!

Favori lahmacun ve pidelerini keşfet, gel-al veya adrese teslim seçenekleriyle siparişini kolayca oluştur. Uygulamaya özel kampanyaları takip et, biriken puanlarını kullan ve QR kodla pratik ödeme kolaylığından yararlan.

• Menüyü keşfet
Ürünleri, içeriklerini ve güncel fiyatlarını incele, canının çektiği lezzetleri seç.

• Siparişini oluştur
İster gel-al ile şubeden teslim al, ister adrese teslim seçeneğiyle lezzeti kapına getir.

• Kampanyaları takip et
Uygulamaya özel fırsatları görüntüle, siparişlerini daha avantajlı hale getir.

• Puanlarını kullan
Biriken puanlarını kolayca takip et ve alışverişlerinde değerlendir.

• QR kodla öde
Uygulamadaki QR kodunu açarak ödemeni kolayca tamamla.

• Şubelerimize ulaş
Şubelerimizin konumlarını, çalışma saatlerini ve hizmet seçeneklerini görüntüle.

Lahmacun Fabrikası’nı hemen indir, bir sonraki lezzet molanı planla!

name: LampOff: Lighting Plot & Rider
description:
LampOff is a lighting plot and rider tool built by a working theatre lighting designer, for touring shows, rehearsals and production meetings. No account, works offline, collects no data.

PLOT
• Set the stage size or start from a template: proscenium, black box, thrust, arena, traverse or concert stage.
• Hang trusses and towers, or a whole set of evenly spaced trusses in one step.
• Tap to place fixtures; they snap to the truss and never overlap.
• Pan with one finger, zoom with two. Select and Move are separate, so nothing slips by accident.
• Scenery, drapes, performers (seated too), trees, tables, chairs and more objects.

FIXTURE LIBRARY
• More than 10,000 GDTF and Open Fixture Library models built in, available offline.
• Robe, Martin, Clay Paky, GLP, Ayrton, ETC, ARRI, ADB, Robert Juliat and more, with modes and channel maps.
• Import GDTF, Open Fixture Library and QLC+ files.

PATCH & DMX
• Fixture number = console channel. Universe, DMX address and footprint.
• Address a selection in one tap; conflicts show up instantly.
• Patch list, DMX map and fixture groups.

3D & FOCUS
• Top plot, front and side elevations, perspective and a 3D stage.
• Realistic 3D beams, color, gobos and haze; light lands on drapes and scenery.
• Pan / tilt joystick, dimmer, color and gobo; gather a selection onto one point.
• Lee and Rosco gels; symbols take the gel color.
• Photometrics: throw, beam diameter, approximate lux; truss loads and power.

OUTPUT & EXCHANGE
• One-file rider PDF: scaled plot, equipment and power list, patch list, instrument schedule, magic sheet, truss dimensions and loads.
• PDF and PNG plot, CSV patch list, USITT ASCII, MVR (grandMA3, ETC Eos, Vectorworks, Capture) and grandMA2 patch.
• Import PDF plots from other lighting programs.
• Revisions: save versions, compare, see what changed on the plot.
• Projects live in a LampOff folder on the device; share and open them as .loff files.

Available in English and Turkish.

name: Lanceerbasis
description:
Op de Lanceerbasis oefent je kind voor groep 3 tot en met 8, in korte rondes en op het eigen niveau. Kies een voertuig, vlieg naar een planeet en verdien sterren. Geen account, geen reclame.

ELKE DAG EEN DAGMISSIE
Drie korte stops, samen ongeveer vijf minuten. Elke dag een andere mix, passend bij de groep van je kind. Zo wordt oefenen een gewoonte.

NEGEN VOERTUIGEN, ALLE VAKKEN
• Rekenraket: tellen, plussen en minnen, tafels, breuken, cijferen en verhaaltjessommen
• Taaltelescoop: spelling, van klanken tot werkwoorden
• Zinnenzender: taal en grammatica, woordenschat en zinsdelen
• Leeslander: technisch en begrijpend lezen
• Meetrover: klokkijken, geld, meten, grafieken en vormen
• Wereldsatelliet: topografie van Nederland, Europa en de wereld
• Tijdmachine: geschiedenis in tijdvakken
• Ruimtestation: Engelse woorden en zinnen
• Boordcomputer: digitale vaardigheden, programmeren met een robotje en mediawijsheid

HULP ALS HET LASTIG IS
Na twee keer fout laat de Lanceerbasis zien hoe het moet, met uitleg erbij. Oefeningen die nog niet in één keer goed gingen, komen later vanzelf terug bij Lastige oefeningen. Opdrachten kun je laten voorlezen.

VOLGENS DE KERNDOELEN
De oefeningen volgen de kerndoelen en de leerlijnen per groep, in de volgorde van de meest gebruikte methodes. De Lanceerbasis is extra oefening naast school en vervangt school niet. Legt de juf of meester het anders uit, volg dan de juf of meester.

LANCEERBASIS PLUS
Alle oefeningen en de dagmissie zijn gratis. Met Lanceerbasis Plus, één keer betalen en geen abonnement, krijg je er dit bij:
• Meerdere kinderen, elk met eigen groep, sterren en lastige oefeningen
• Ouderoverzicht: per voertuig wat goed gaat en wat nog lastig is
• Weekrapport: hoeveel dagen en vragen er geoefend is
• Een dagelijkse herinnering voor de dagmissie
• De voortgang via je eigen iCloud op je andere iPhone of iPad
• Een widget met de dagmissie en de sterren
Plus werkt ook voor je gezinsleden met Delen met gezin. Met je aankoop steun je de verdere ontwikkeling: nieuwe oefeningen en voertuigen, voor alle kinderen.

GEMAAKT VOOR IPHONE, IPAD EN IPHONE DUO
Op de iPad staan de vraag en de toetsen naast elkaar. Op de iPhone Duo kun je het scherm openklappen als een boek: de vraag links en de toetsen rechts van de vouw. Met een toetsenbord aan de iPad typ je de antwoorden gewoon in.

JE PRIVACY
Geen account, geen reclame en geen tracking. Namen, groepen en sterren blijven op je eigen apparaat, of in je eigen iCloud als je dat aanzet. Een voornaam of bijnaam is genoeg. Links naar buiten, de aankoop en het wissen van gegevens zitten achter een ouderslot.

name: LaneClock: Swim Stopwatch
description:
Time a swim group from one screen. Start swimmers together, then tap each swimmer’s card after each pool length. See individual splits and total times.

Free training tools
Up to 4 swimmers · 25/50 m pools · 100/200 m targets · Timing, undo and interruption recovery · All saved records · JSON backup and restore

Full-version extras
• Time 5–8 swimmers together
• Add 400 m and 800 m targets
• Search the complete training history
• Export all recorded splits as CSV

One-time unlock. No subscription. Your saved training records remain available in the free version. The App Store shows your local price before purchase. Restore purchases with the same Apple Account.

All saved records and JSON backups remain available, even without the full version.

English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese interfaces.

The screen stays awake while timing. Timing continues through backgrounding or locking while the app process remains alive. After an app restart, the set is marked interrupted. Try it before training and keep a stopwatch ready.

Training records are stored locally. We do not run accounts, advertising or analytics. Device backups may include your data according to your settings. Apple processes purchases; we do not receive your payment details.

A poolside training aid, not an official competition timer, medical device or water-safety device. Test before training and keep a backup stopwatch ready.

name: LanternKeelRow
description:
On the festival river, the shrine on the near bank holds a warm light, and the gate on the far bank is waiting for it. Between them, paper lanterns drift by on the current. Turn the right ones at the right moment and the light hops from window to window across the water.

Each lantern has paper windows on some of its sides. Tap a lantern to turn it a quarter turn. When the windows of a row line up from shrine to gate, the ray races across and the gate lights. The catch is that the river keeps moving. The row that would work now will float past in a few seconds, so you're always turning lanterns for the row that is about to arrive. You can hold to hurry the current when you're ready.

When a gate lights, the lanterns that carried the light lift off the water and float up into the sky.

The route has 48 ferry stops, from Willow Ford down to the Moon Delta, and each chapter brings one new idea:
- vermilion paper that tints the light red, for gates that only open to red
- waterlogged lanterns that sink if you turn them once too often
- twin gates that need light at the same time, split with three-window lanterns

Every stop is built around a solution that is known to work. Cross early and turn carefully for three stars.

Night Run is the endless version: every crossing refills your lamp oil, and the river slowly picks up speed. Daily Crossing is one new river each day, shared by all players, with a daily board next to the global one.

Koto plucks climb in pitch as the light travels, the river murmurs underneath, and turning a lantern gives a small click you can feel.

No sign-up, no ads, no in-app purchases. It plays offline, and your data can be deleted from Settings whenever you like.

name: Lapis Gate
description:
An empty place can be the most important piece of a puzzle.

Inside Lapis Gate, two carved rings carry stones through an Egyptian temple mechanism. Drag the outer ring and the inner ring answers in the opposite direction. When the pair a lock is asking for lines up beneath it, seat the stones and leave two gaps behind. The pair you choose now decides what can still meet later.

Every turn burns lamp oil, so the shortest path matters. Across twenty-two seals the temple adds a moon gate that flips stones between Sun and Moon, locks that take their pairs in order, ruby bars and a scarab wing that moves one ring alone. Undo is free, and a hint reads the rings for you.

Match the master's count of turns and the seal leaves a gilded imprint in the limestone.

name: Larderline
description: Larderline te ajută să organizezi mesele de familie, pregătirile și alimentele din congelator. Adaugă propriile rețete, ingredientele și porțiile, stabilește data mesei și numărul de adulți și copii, apoi alcătuiește meniul. Aplicația estimează cantitățile, grupează lista de cumpărături și generează sarcini zilnice de pregătire. Înregistrează tăvile pe congelatoare și sertare, urmărește termenele de păstrare și planifică decongelarea. După masă, notează cât s-a mâncat și ce a rămas, pentru recomandări de cantitate la următoarea ocazie.

name: Last Ember: Maze Puzzle
description:
The Great Forge has gone out. Cold crept through every hall of the mountain, and every fire spirit froze where it stood. All but one.

You are Wick, the last spark. Swipe to send it flying through the dark: relight every torch it passes, gather the shards of the Forge's cracked heart, and go deeper, toward the Forge itself.

ONE RULE
Wick is a spark, and sparks fly until they hit something. Swipe once and Wick dashes all the way to the next wall. Every maze is a puzzle about where you can stop.

A DARK MOUNTAIN
Wick only lights what it can see. Everywhere it has been stays dimly remembered, and every torch it relights keeps that corner warm for good. Clear a level and the dark lifts, leaving a warm map of the way you went.

FOUR WORLDS, 120 LEVELS
• Frozen Halls: ice, icicles and torches sealed in frost
• Flooded Crypt: moss, meltwater and murkwings that never stop moving
• Crystal Mines: abandoned carts, violet crystal and spikes on a timer
• The Forge: iron, sleeping magma and everything at once

Every level hides three heartstones. Find them all, or just find the door.

HOW IT'S SOLD
World 1 (30 levels) is free. One purchase unlocks Worlds 2 to 4 (90 levels) for good. No ads, no energy bars, no waiting. Plays offline.

name: Laundry POS: Kasir Laundry
description:
Laundry POS adalah aplikasi kasir laundry untuk UMKM Indonesia yang bekerja 100% OFFLINE. Catat order kiloan maupun satuan, cetak struk thermal, kirim nota lewat WhatsApp, dan pantau omzet harian — tanpa internet, tanpa server, data tersimpan aman di iPhone atau iPad Anda.

KENAPA LAUNDRY POS?
• Cepat: buat order dalam hitungan detik, berat desimal (1,5 kg), multi-layanan, diskon Rp atau %.
• Lengkap: DP, lunas, kembalian, tanggal ambil otomatis, dan status Pending → Proses → Siap Ambil → Selesai.
• Rapi: data pelanggan, riwayat order, dan tagihan belum lunas dalam satu tempat.
• Offline: tetap jalan saat sinyal hilang. Tidak perlu daftar akun online.

FITUR UTAMA
• Order & nota laundry kiloan/satuan dengan nomor invoice otomatis
• Cetak struk ke printer thermal Bluetooth 58 mm & 80 mm
• Kirim struk, pengingat ambil, dan tagihan lewat WhatsApp
• Daftar "Perlu Perhatian": order terlambat, siap diambil, dan belum lunas
• Data pelanggan lengkap dengan statistik dan order ulang satu ketukan
• Laporan omzet, uang diterima, piutang, metode bayar (Cash/Transfer/QRIS), dan layanan terlaris
• Atur sendiri paket layanan, harga, dan durasi pengerjaan
• Nyaman dipakai di iPhone, iPad, dan iPhone Duo (layar luar maupun layar dalam)

LAUNDRY POS PRO
Upgrade untuk usaha laundry yang terus berkembang:
• Order tanpa batas (paket Gratis: 50 order per bulan)
• Bebas iklan
• Catat pengeluaran & lihat laba bersih otomatis
• Export laporan ke Excel
• Backup & restore data
• Akun kasir karyawan dengan akses terbatas
• Catatan kaki struk untuk syarat & ketentuan laundry Anda

Laundry POS Pro tersedia sebagai langganan Mingguan, Bulanan, dan Tahunan yang diperpanjang otomatis. Pembayaran ditagihkan ke akun Apple ID saat pembelian dikonfirmasi. Langganan diperpanjang otomatis kecuali dibatalkan paling lambat 24 jam sebelum periode berjalan berakhir, dan biaya perpanjangan ditagihkan dalam 24 jam sebelum periode berakhir. Kelola atau batalkan langganan kapan saja di Pengaturan › Apple ID › Langganan.

Paket Gratis didukung iklan.

Syarat Penggunaan (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Kebijakan Privasi: https://diponten.com/2026/11/11/laundry-pos-kasir-laundry/
Pertanyaan & saran: diponten.com@gmail.com

name: LavaHushBridge
description:
Dusk on a volcanic island. A line of tired villagers leaves camp and heads for the houses on the far hill. They will not stop. Between them and home, rivers of lava glow and churn.

You have water. Tap a stream and it hisses into a slab of dark, cracked stone. The villagers can walk across it. For a few seconds.

Then the cracks begin to glow, the crust warms, and the river takes it back.

Lava Hush Bridge is all about that moment. Cool a stream too early and the stone is already breaking up when someone steps on it. Too late and they walk straight into molten rock. Pulsing rings show where a villager is about to step. The glow in the cracks tells you how long a bridge has left. Fast flows, marked by drifting arrows, reheat much sooner than the slow ones. Tap between two lanes and a single crust can carry both walkers, which matters, because water is limited and spending less of it earns more stars.

The island has 48 volcanoes across eight regions, from Ash Shore through Cinder Steps and Obsidian Ridge up to Hush Caldera. The difficulty climbs steadily, and each volcano is built around a known solution, so every one can be cleared. The first volcano teaches you by pointing at where to tap.

Every day there is a Daily Eruption, one level shared by every player, with its own board. Your total score across the island goes on a second board, under a village name like Ember Heron 42 that you can reroll whenever you like.

Lava really flows here. Crusts crack and steam, embers drift up, and the sound is deep taiko drums, sizzle and low rumbles, with haptics that grow heavier as lava gets close.

No account, no ads, no in-app purchases. Plays offline, a volcano or two at a time. Get them home.

name: Layers of Steps
description:
Your daily steps, layered.

Layers of Steps is a pedometer that turns your daily step counts into layers of earth. Connect to Apple Health to look back on your activity and enjoy building a walking habit at your own pace.

A layer for each day
Your walks gradually build a personal landscape. Tap a layer to see that day's step count.

Your days, month by month
Open the monthly list to review your daily records, including quieter days.

Find fossils along the way
Cumulative steps since your first launch unlock opportunities to discover 30 illustrated fossils. Find them one at a time and build your collection.

A quiet notice of new discoveries
Optionally enable local notifications when a discovery is ready. Notifications may be delayed by step updates and the state of your iPhone.

Your steps stay on your device
The app reads only step counts from Apple Health. It does not persist step values or transmit them to a server. No account is required.

Before you begin
• Step-count read access to Apple Health is required.
• Only records from your first-launch day onward are used. Earlier history is not imported.
• Layer thickness is a decorative representation of steps, not walking distance or geological age.
• Your start date and fossil progress are stored locally. Sync, backup and recovery after reinstalling are not supported.
• This app is not intended for medical use or diagnosis.

name: Le Mow du Jouw
description:
Un mot de cinq lettres. Six essais. Un seul mot par jour, le même pour tout le monde. Tu le trouves, ou tu attends demain.

Le Mow du Jouw ne t’encouragera pas. Il constate. Poliment. Tape un mot qui n’existe pas : il te le fera remarquer. Trouve en six essais : il trouvera que c’était juste. Trouve du premier coup : il ne te croira pas.

COMMENT ÇA SE JOUE
Tape un mot de cinq lettres. Chaque lettre se colore : à sa place, dans le mot mais ailleurs, ou absente. Six lignes pour conclure. Après, c’est trop tard.

LE MODE HARDCORE
Un chrono d’une minute quarante-cinq, lancé dès ta première ligne. Moins de temps pour réfléchir. Moins d’excuses aussi.

TA SÉRIE ET TES STATISTIQUES
Les jours gagnés d’affilée, la répartition de tes essais, tes meilleurs temps en hardcore. Des chiffres honnêtes. Parfois trop.

LES JOURS PASSÉS
Un jour oublié ? Le calendrier le garde. Rejoue-le quand tu veux.

LE PARTAGE
Partage ta grille sans dévoiler le mot. Ou ne la partage pas. On comprendrait.

CE QU’IL N’Y A PAS
Pas de publicité. Pas d’achat. Pas de compte. Aucune donnée collectée : tes parties restent sur ton téléphone, et le jeu marche sans connexion.

Mots du jour en français, ou en anglais si tu préfères.

name: Leadlight Rose
description:
Have you ever thought that familiar Mahjong tiles could become a stained glass artwork? In Leadlight Rose, each tile is a small piece of a Gothic rose window. The more you learn and answer correctly, the closer you get to the complete artwork.

Start with the 42 classic Mahjong tiles. Each tile has its own story, from its symbolic meaning to its pronunciation in Mandarin, Cantonese, and Japanese. You can listen to the pronunciation, discover interesting facts, and find any tile again with just a few taps.

Learning becomes more fun as each piece of glass is blown, colored, assembled with pencil, and placed in the window. Correct answers will help complete the artwork, while those pieces that haven't been reviewed in a long time will need your revisit.

Once you're familiar with the tiles, try finding the missing piece in Ready Hand or use the Hand Checker to check the deck you're holding. You'll know which cards you're waiting for, whether your hand is complete, and which cards to discard to get ready.

Short quizzes, memory games, daily challenges, and card combination puzzles will help you learn a little more each time you visit. For deeper exploration, Scriptorium also features 19 famous card combinations, guides on how to create sets, and stories about Mahjong history. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced player, Leadlight Rose is a fun place to learn more about the game's origins and culture!

name: Learn Bambara Language Easily
description:
Learn Bambara (Bamanankan) with simple, enjoyable audio lessons. Skip registration and long questionnaires. Just open the app and start learning.

NO LOGIN. NO ACCOUNT. NO QUESTIONNAIRES.
Skip complicated sign-up screens and lengthy onboarding forms. Open the app, choose a lesson, and start learning Bambara right away.

LISTEN TO BAMBARA AUDIO LESSONS
Explore useful words and everyday expressions through audio lessons. Browse the lesson library, search for topics, and continue where you left off.

CONTROL YOUR LISTENING
Choose 0.5x, 0.75x, 1x, 1.25x, or 1.5x playback speed. Skip backward or forward by 10 seconds and use auto-play to continue to the next lesson.

SAVE FAVORITES AND TRACK PROGRESS
Bookmark lessons for easy access. Follow your daily streak, best streak, completed lessons, listening time, and recent learning activity.

DAILY REMINDERS
Choose a reminder time that fits your schedule and build a consistent Bambara learning habit.

SLEEP TIMER
Relax while listening and stop playback automatically. The 15-minute timer is available without watching an ad. In the free version, watch an ad to select 30, 45, 60, or 90 minutes, or stop at the end of the lesson.

UNLOCK MORE WITH PREMIUM
A-B Repeat: Select the start and end of an audio section to loop difficult words and expressions.
Offline Downloads: Save lessons for listening without an internet connection.
Ad-Free Listening: Enjoy your lessons without regular ads.

LEARN BAMBARA YOUR WAY
Whether you are planning to visit Mali, connecting with Bambara-speaking friends and family, or exploring Malian culture, improve your listening skills at your own pace.

No login. No account. No questionnaires. Just open the app and start learning today!

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: LearnVibe: Learn a Language
description:
LearnVibe. Learn a language freestyle, face to face.

Freestyle means you learn what you want to learn. No fixed course, no lesson you didn't ask for: tell your AI avatar teacher what you need, from ordering in a café to a job interview, a trip, your partner's family or the words of a song, and the lesson is built around it. She speaks, a card shows the line, you say it back. Say it right and the card turns green; if not, she shows you how, sound by sound.

12 LANGUAGES, ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD
English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, German, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Hindi, Arabic and Hebrew. Switch language at any time, even in the middle of a lesson.

WHAT YOU GET
• Live face-to-face lessons with a lifelike AI avatar
• Freestyle lessons on whatever you choose
• Cards that turn green when you say it right
• Pronunciation tips: she listens, and with your camera on she can see your mouth
• Levels, stars and streaks for every language, kept on your account

GOOD TO KNOW
Your teacher is an AI, not a person, and says so; the AI label stays on screen for the whole lesson. The camera is off unless you switch it on.

SUBSCRIPTION
LearnVibe is one plan with everything included, at $19.99 a month or $119.99 a year. Start with a 7-day free trial with 3 face-to-face lessons of up to 30 minutes each. After the trial, practise face to face within fair use, up to 30 minutes a lesson; when every teacher is busy you may wait a moment or practise by voice. We remind you 2 days before your trial ends. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it at any time in your store account settings. Prices are in US dollars; the store shows the price in your currency.

Terms: https://learnvibe.ai/terms
Privacy: https://learnvibe.ai/privacy-policy

name: LessonTrim
description:
Όταν ένα μάθημα 90 λεπτών πρέπει να χωρέσει σε 60, η αφαίρεση μιας επίδειξης μπορεί να αφήσει δύο ασκήσεις χωρίς την απαραίτητη προετοιμασία. Με το LessonTrim βλέπετε τι επηρεάζεται, δοκιμάζετε μια άλλη σειρά ή μια συντομότερη δραστηριότητα και κρατάτε ένα σχέδιο που μπορείτε να ακολουθήσετε στην τάξη.

1. Οργανώστε το πλήρες μάθημα
Ξεκινήστε με το επεξεργάσιμο παράδειγμα ή δημιουργήστε μάθημα από τη βιβλιοθήκη. Προσθέστε δραστηριότητες, διαλείμματα και χρονικά περιθώρια. Ορίστε προβλεπόμενη και ελάχιστη διάρκεια, σημειώσεις, προϋποθέσεις και αποδεκτές εναλλακτικές. Συνδέστε κάθε μαθησιακό στόχο με μία ή περισσότερες μεθόδους διδασκαλίας.

2. Προσαρμόστε το σχέδιο στον διαθέσιμο χρόνο
Δημιουργήστε ένα νέο σχέδιο με δικό του στόχο διάρκειας. Η χρονογραμμή δείχνει 15 λεπτά ανά γραμμή και το κίτρινο όριο δείχνει τον χρόνο που έχετε στη διάθεσή σας. Αλλάξτε τη σειρά και τη διάρκεια των δραστηριοτήτων ή δοκιμάστε μια εναλλακτική. Πριν αφαιρέσετε μια δραστηριότητα, δείτε ποιες ασκήσεις και ποιοι στόχοι επηρεάζονται.

3. Κρατήστε όσα είναι απαραίτητα
Ορίστε υποχρεωτικές δραστηριότητες και στόχους. Για έναν στόχο αρκεί μία πλήρης μέθοδος διδασκαλίας. Ελέγξτε τι αφαιρείται, τι αντικαθίσταται και τι συντομεύεται σε ένα προτεινόμενο σχέδιο πριν το εφαρμόσετε. Ο υπολογισμός της ελάχιστης διάρκειας δείχνει τον χρόνο που χρειάζεται για να τηρηθούν οι απαιτήσεις σας, τις δραστηριότητες που περιλαμβάνονται και τη σειρά τους.

4. Συγκρίνετε εκδόσεις και εξαγάγετε τη ροή
Δείτε την προβλεπόμενη κάλυψη σε πίνακα στόχων και συγκρίνετε τα λεπτά ανά κατηγορία σε μπάρες με κοινή κλίμακα. Αποθηκεύστε εκδόσεις και εξαγάγετε τη ροή μαθήματος σε PDF, με χρόνο έναρξης, διάρκεια, στόχους και σημειώσεις. Ο πίνακας στόχων και οι διάρκειες εξάγονται επίσης σε CSV.

5. Διδάξτε και αξιοποιήστε τους πραγματικούς χρόνους
Ξεκινήστε τη διδασκαλία από ένα έτοιμο σχέδιο, χρονομετρήστε τις δραστηριότητες και καταγράψτε τυχόν παραλείψεις. Στον απολογισμό συγκρίνετε τον προβλεπόμενο με τον πραγματικό χρόνο. Εξαγάγετε τις καταγραφές ή δημιουργήστε προσχέδιο για το επόμενο μάθημα.

Το LessonTrim λειτουργεί χωρίς σύνδεση και χωρίς λογαριασμό. Τα μαθήματα αποθηκεύονται στη συσκευή, με δυνατότητα εξαγωγής και επαναφοράς πλήρους αντιγράφου ασφαλείας. Η εφαρμογή διατίθεται στα ελληνικά και στα απλοποιημένα κινεζικά. Το κείμενο που καταχωρίζετε διατηρείται στην αρχική του γλώσσα.

name: Liberdade FM
description:
O app oficial da Rádio Liberdade FM 104.9, de Santa Bárbara do Sul/RS. Ouça ao vivo, de onde estiver.

• Rádio ao vivo: toque e ouça. A rádio continua tocando com a tela bloqueada, com controle na tela de bloqueio e no fone de ouvido.
• No ar agora: veja qual programa está tocando, quem apresenta e o que vem a seguir.
• Programação completa: todos os programas da semana. Toque no sino e receba um lembrete na hora do seu programa preferido.
• Câmera ao vivo: quando o estúdio liga a câmera, você assiste por aqui.
• Notícias e avisos: novidades da rádio e da região, com avisos no celular quando tiver algo importante.
• Peça sua música: mande recado ou pedido de música para o estúdio pelo WhatsApp.
• Timer para desligar: escolha quanto tempo a rádio vai tocar antes de desligar sozinha.
• Apoiadores, Instagram e contatos da rádio num só lugar.

Liberdade FM — a rádio que toca a sua vida.

name: Limitados FC
description:
Limitados FC é o aplicativo oficial do clube e de suas competições esportivas. Tenha acesso em tempo real a todas as informações dos campeonatos, partidas e do elenco de atletas.

Recursos em destaque:

• PARTIDAS E RESULTADOS:
Confira o calendário completo de jogos, placares em tempo real, súmulas oficiais com gols, assistências e cartões de cada confronto.

• CLASSIFICAÇÃO E TORNEIOS:
Acompanhe a tabela atualizada da Liga e das Copas, fases de grupos, chaveamentos de mata-mata e o histórico das temporadas anteriores.

• ESTATÍSTICAS E ATLETAS:
Consulte a ficha técnica de cada jogador, estatísticas de desempenho, artilharia, assistências e comparativo direto entre atletas com radar de atributos.

• VOTAÇÕES E DESTAQUES:
Participe das votações oficiais de Melhor em Campo (MVP), Melhores da Rodada e Melhores do Ano.

• INSCRIÇÕES E CONFIRMADOS:
Acompanhe a lista de atletas confirmados para as próximas partidas e confira as novidades do clube.

Baixe agora e acompanhe o Limitados FC onde você estiver!

name: LineManager for Smart Glasses
description:
LineManager turns Mentra Live smart glasses into a hands-free inspection tool for production lines, plants and field service.

Look at the equipment, press the button on your glasses, and LineManager finds every QR code in view. If there is more than one, you choose the right asset on your iPhone or with the glasses button and capture the incident right away.

SCAN WHAT YOU SEE
• Take a photo through your glasses with one button press
• Finds several QR codes in one photo and numbers them left to right
• Read directly on your iPhone with Apple's Vision framework

PICK THE RIGHT ASSET
• Tap a code in the list or on the photo
• Or stay hands-free: press the glasses button to move, long-press to choose
• Spoken feedback reads each code aloud

REPORT INCIDENTS IN SECONDS
• Captures an incident photo and records a video from your point of view
• Uploads the recording and sends a report that includes the scanned QR code
• Review before sending, or discard with one tap

KEEP YOUR GLASSES READY
• Connects to Mentra Live over Bluetooth and reconnects automatically
• Shows battery, software version and Wi-Fi status
• Installs matching glasses software updates from inside the app

REQUIREMENTS
LineManager requires Mentra Live smart glasses. Your iPhone and glasses should be on the same Wi-Fi network for the fastest photo transfer.

name: LineSwitcher: Dual SIM Manager
description:
LineSwitcher helps manage two iPhone cellular plans by place. Save up to ten circles around locations where you prefer your secondary plan. When you enter a circle, the app requests your secondary data line. Outside all circles, it requests your primary data line. A Shortcut you import during setup makes the cellular change and reports whether it completed.

See each request and confirmation in History. Pause automatic switching, hold the secondary line for a chosen time, or send a missed switch again.

REQUIREMENTS
• iPhone with iOS 27 or later and two active cellular plans
• The shared LineSwitcher Shortcut and its notification automation
• Notification permission and Always location permission for background region monitoring

The app itself cannot switch cellular plans or read their labels; the Shortcut does those jobs. Outside your circles, the Shortcut turns the secondary plan off. Calls and texts to that number will not arrive until the plan is turned on again. Your coverage areas and request history stay on your device.

name: Linicro
description:
Remember when your phone was a games console in your pocket? Linicro brings back the keypad era with ten arcade games on a phone that never was.

TEN RETRO GAMES
Six classics-with-a-twist are ready to play from the start: Snake: Trail, Bounce: Flip, a side-scrolling space shooter, Bricks: Chain, Blocks: Quake and a reverse memory game. Unlock four more as "WAP downloads": Signal Hopper, Buzz Fishing, Ring Rhythm and Dial-Up Rally.

A PHONE WITH A LIFE OF ITS OWN
Boot it up, watch the battery, read your texts. Cheeky in-game mates text you daily dares, Mum checks you are not up too late, and mysterious messages hint at secret codes.

DAILY CHALLENGE
A new seeded run every day, the same for everyone. Keep your streak going and climb the Daily Challenge leaderboard.

COLLECT PHONES
Earn points to unlock nine invented handsets, from the Graphite Brick to the Neon and a secret see-through prototype. Each has its own look, boot animation and perk.

RAISE A POCKET PET
Your pet grows as you play. Keep it happy and raise it to adult.

SECRETS EVERYWHERE
Punch codes into the keypad, fill your code book and find the hidden easter eggs.

GAME CENTER
12 leaderboards and 15 achievements. Share your best score as a pixel score card.

NO ADS. NO IN-APP PURCHASES. NO ACCOUNTS.
Linicro plays fully offline and keeps your progress on your device.

Support: DialInnStudio26@protonmail.com

name: Lissava
description:
Hear it. Keep it.

Lissava is an audio-first English vocabulary learning app that helps you turn the expressions you encounter into words you can understand, remember, and use.

Instead of simply memorizing written words, Lissava makes listening a natural part of your vocabulary practice.

**HEAR ENGLISH NATURALLY**

Listen to high-quality English audio for vocabulary expressions and example sentences. Practice understanding English by ear, at your own pace.

**CREATE CARDS WITH AI**

Enter an English word or phrase, or describe what you want to say in Japanese. AI helps you create vocabulary cards with translations, English definitions, pronunciation guides, and natural example sentences.

**THREE WAYS TO LEARN**

Practice your vocabulary through three complementary modes:

- Listening: Hear an expression and recall its meaning.
- Speaking: Practice producing English from a prompt.
- Reading: Read expressions and check your understanding.

**BUILD YOUR OWN COLLECTIONS**

Save expressions from conversations, books, movies, work, and everyday life. Organize them into personal collections and customize your vocabulary cards.

Import and export vocabulary using CSV files, or create a full backup of your study data.

**REMEMBER FOR THE LONG TERM**

Lissava uses spaced repetition to schedule reviews based on your learning progress. Focus on expressions you are still learning and mark familiar cards as mastered.

**LEARN ON YOUR TERMS**

Your vocabulary and study history are stored on your device. Create cards manually and review saved vocabulary without an account. Previously cached audio can also be replayed offline.

Sign in with Apple to access optional AI card creation and new high-quality cloud audio generation. These services are subject to usage limits.

No personal API key is required.

Make the English you encounter part of the English you remember.

Lissava. Hear it. Keep it.

name: Little Notes: For Two
description:
Send little love notes that land right on your partner's lock screen.

Little Notes is a private space for the two of you. Write or draw something in your own hand, add a sticker, an emoji or a photo, and send it. It shows up on their lock screen and home screen widget, so the first thing they see is you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- End-to-end encrypted. Notes are sealed on your iPhone and travel through iCloud. Only the two of you can read them; not even we can.
- No sign-up, no account, no ads, no tracking and no analytics.
- Lock screen previews are off by default: it just says a new note arrived, until you choose to show the note itself.

PAIR IN ONE TAP
- Tap Invite your partner and send the invite by AirDrop, Messages or Mail. They open it with Little Notes installed and you are paired.
- The invite only works for the person you sent it to. One partner at a time.

IN YOUR OWN HAND
- Draw with your finger, write in handwriting, add stickers, emoji and photos.
- Home screen and lock screen widgets show their newest note.
- A gentle heartbeat haptic when a note arrives.
- Every note you share is kept on a pinboard, week by week.
- Sent one by mistake? Long-press it to unsend it from both phones.
- Unpair anytime. Each of you decides what happens to your own copy.

FREE, WITH AN OPTIONAL PRO
Notes, drawings, photos and widgets are free. Little Notes Pro is $4.99 once, no subscription: Scrapbook and Soft note styles, every theme, sticker packs, inks and pens. Buy it once and it unlocks for both of you.

For iPhone and iPad. Both of you need the app and iCloud turned on.

name: Little Orbit: Space Adventure
description:
Little Orbit is a cozy roguelite defense game you can play with one hand.

A tiny planet floats alone in space, and waves of enemies are drifting toward it. Your turrets circle the core and fire on their own — your job is to choose how they grow.

PICK AN UPGRADE EVERY WAVE
After each wave you choose one of three upgrade cards. More turrets, faster orbits, a slowing Gravity Well, a Supernova blast — every run builds differently.

BUILD POWERFUL COMBOS
Common, Rare and Epic cards stack into combos that can turn a fragile core into an unstoppable one.

BEAT THE DEVOURER
Bosses arrive between waves and test everything you have built so far.

GROW STRONGER BETWEEN RUNS
Spend the stardust you earn in the Workshop on permanent upgrades, so every run starts a little stronger.

THREE CORES, THREE WAYS TO PLAY
Each core arranges its turrets differently and changes how you defend.

COZY, CALM AND ONE-HANDED
Warm colors, short sessions, portrait mode. Play a quick run whenever you have a few minutes.

How far can you hold out?

Little Orbit is free to play and contains ads and optional in-app purchases.

name: localhost.md — Agent Skills
description:
Find useful skills for your AI agents, wherever you are.

localhost.md brings a source-linked skills catalog to your iPhone and iPad. Browse by task, search for what your next project needs, and filter listings for Codex, Claude Code or Cursor.

INSPECT BEFORE YOU INSTALL
Read skill instructions in the app. Check the source repository and pinned commit, then copy the installation command for use at your computer. The app does not execute skill instructions or install skills on your phone.

KEEP A PERSONAL COLLECTION
Save skills for later and share useful discoveries. Your saved collection stays on your device, with no account required.

FOLLOW WHAT MATTERS
Choose categories and agents you want to follow. Receive a daily digest at your preferred local hour or instant alerts for matching new publications. Notifications are optional and can be turned off at any time.

MAKE IT YOURS
Enjoy light and dark appearances, hide listings you do not want to see, and report content to the catalog operator.

localhost.md is an independent catalog. Listed agents describe the intended targets declared by the listing; they are not compatibility certifications. Source authors retain their rights to their work.

name: Looking Up: Affirmation Widget
description:
Looking Up is an affirmation widget for your Home Screen and Lock Screen. A short daily affirmation changes every 30 minutes, matched to your day: sharpening in the morning, grounding at midday, calming in the evening. You never have to open the app. No ads on any plan.

"One thing at a time. That's enough."

JUST GLANCE
There's nothing to open and no routine to keep up. The Home Screen widget sits where you already look, dozens of times a day, and hands you a clearer thought on the way to whatever's next. Daily affirmations that work in the background of your day, not another app asking for your time.

MATCHED TO YOUR TIME OF DAY
• Morning affirmations that sharpen you for what's ahead
• Grounding lines at midday, when things pile up
• Calming ones in the evening, when it's time to wind down
The widget refreshes on its own every 30 minutes, so you're not looking at the same line all day.

THINGS YOU'D ACTUALLY THINK
Not forced positive thinking, and not posters. 480+ positive affirmations in a plain, grounded voice, short enough to take in at a glance. Kinder self-talk for ordinary days:
"Clarity comes from action, not overthinking."
"I step away from urgency that isn't mine."

10 CATEGORIES, YOUR PICK
Choose from 10 categories of positive affirmations: Confidence, Calm, Focus, Resilience, Gratitude, Parenting, Career, Relationships, Self-Worth and Health. Pick what matters to you right now and change it whenever life does.

DAILY AFFIRMATION REMINDERS, IF YOU WANT THEM
Set up to 3 reminders a day, at the times that suit you. The whole line is right there in the notification, so you get it without opening anything. Handy for morning affirmations with your coffee, or a quieter end to the day.

SMALL THINGS THAT HELP IT STICK
• Save favorites to come back to
• A day count of the days you've shown up
• Share a line as an image card
• Light and dark app theme
• Works offline: everything is already on your device

WIDGET SIZES AND THEMES
The Home Screen widget comes in small, medium and large, and there's a Lock Screen widget too, in rectangular and inline styles. The Clean theme follows your light or dark mode. Premium adds five color themes: Midnight, Sandstone, Ocean, Slate and Ember.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 5 full categories: Confidence, Calm, Focus, Resilience, Gratitude
• A taste of the other 5 categories: five lines from each (276 lines in all)
• The Home Screen widget in all three sizes, with the Clean theme, plus the Lock Screen widget
• Up to 3 affirmation reminders a day
• Favorites, day count and share cards
• No ads

WHAT PREMIUM ADDS
• The other 5 categories in full: Parenting, Career, Relationships, Self-Worth and Health, for all 480+ lines
• 5 widget color themes: Midnight, Sandstone, Ocean, Slate and Ember

Premium comes three ways:
• Annual: $29.99 a year, with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers
• Monthly: $6.99 a month
• Lifetime: $79.99, a one-time purchase
Prices are in US dollars and may differ in your country. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel, which you can do anytime in your Apple Account settings. No ads on any plan, paid or not.

WHO IT'S FOR
Busy people who want a calmer, clearer, more hopeful mindset on ordinary days, without turning it into a project. It isn't a meditation app or a journal. It's a steady voice in the background of your day.

Available in English, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hebrew and Japanese.

Add the widget, and let your next glance be a good one.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when a trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel them anytime in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://steady.bodycrush.fit/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://steady.bodycrush.fit/privacy/

name: LoomRiftTala
description:
Thwack. A saffron row slides up to the gold beater, you swipe from the left, and the shuttle flies through the warp right on the beat. The row packs in tight. Another rises. Madder red this time, so you swipe from the right.

LoomRiftTala is a rhythm game played on a royal hand loom. The side you swipe from picks the dye: left spool or right spool. Throw on the beat and the row is beaten in thin and neat. Throw a touch late and it sits looser. Miss it and the cloth keeps a frayed gap, because the loom remembers everything.

Then come the rifts. Partway through a bolt the spools swap sides, or one is suddenly re-dyed raw silk, and the hand that knew the pattern has to listen again. Tala rests ask you to hold still. Half-beat syncopation and tempo shifts arrive in the later bolts.

There are 40 pattern bolts pinned on a merchant's cloth rack, from simple stripes to dense master patterns, each scored up to three stars on how tight your weave is. Chain perfect rows and the threads ripple faster while the whole bolt starts to glow.

Two more ways to play:
- Endless Tapestry, where the tempo climbs and three frays end the run
- Daily Bolt, one new pattern a day, shared by every weaver

Both sit on the Weavers' Guild leaderboards alongside your all-time score.

The sounds are plucked sitar-like strings and tabla-like taps over a soft drone, with a crisp haptic tick on every beat and a long satin buzz when a row lands perfectly. When a bolt is done, the cloth you actually wove unrolls off the roller, snags and all.

No account, no sign-in, no ads, no in-app purchases. It plays offline, and you get a weaver name like Saffron Shuttle 42 that you can re-roll anytime.

name: LoudToucan
description:
LoudToucan is je marketingteam in je broekzak. Toco, onze toekan, leert je zaak kennen via je website en kanalen en maakt elke week berichten, korte video's en advertenties die bij je merk passen. Jij houdt de controle: met de app keur je alles goed, pas je het aan of wijs je het af, waar je ook bent.

Wat je met de app doet:
• Vandaag: zie in één oogopslag wat Toco klaarzette, wat gepubliceerd is en hoe het loopt.
• Goedkeuren: swipe door voorstellen voor Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn en meer. Eén tik om goed te keuren, of vraag Toco om iets aan te passen.
• Inspreken: spreek een idee in en Toco maakt er een bericht of video van.
• Filmen: neem zelf beelden op; Toco monteert er een video van met ondertitels en je huisstijl.
• Leads: volg nieuwe aanvragen op en houd bij wat ze opbrengen.
• Meldingen: krijg een seintje zodra er iets klaarstaat of een nieuwe lead binnenkomt.

Je maakt je account aan op loudtoucan.com. Daar koppel je ook je website en sociale kanalen. Daarna meld je je in de app aan met hetzelfde e-mailadres en wachtwoord.

name: Lovira Stamp
description:
Lovira Stamp keeps the stamp cards of the restaurants and cafés you visit.

At the counter, tap Scan stamp and hold the top of your iPhone to the Lovira stamp. The stamp lands on your card straight away. When your card is full, tap Use reward and show the number on your screen to staff.

- One card per place, all in one app
- No account, no name, no email, no phone number
- With iCloud Keychain, your cards move to your next iPhone
- English, Dutch and Japanese

Not at a partner place yet? Tap Try a demo card to see how it works.

name: Lumbrera: Biblia diaria
description:
Lee la Biblia entera sin darte cuenta: un versículo por pantalla, deslizando hacia arriba.

Lumbrera muestra el texto completo de la Reina Valera 1909, tal cual, y lleva la cuenta de todo lo que lees. Cada versículo suma a tu porcentaje de la Biblia, así que ves tu avance desde el primer día.

LO QUE ENCONTRARÁS
• Un versículo por pantalla, con letra grande y cómoda de leer.
• Tu porcentaje de la Biblia leída, siempre a la vista.
• Racha diaria para crear el hábito, con celebraciones al terminar capítulos y libros.
• Mis versículos: toca dos veces cualquier versículo para guardarlo.
• Widgets «Versículo del día» y «Tu racha» para la pantalla de inicio y la de bloqueo.
• Recordatorio diario con el versículo del día, a la hora que elijas.
• Sonido ambiente para leer en calma.
• Empieza por el Evangelio de Juan y sigue un orden pensado para no soltarla.
• Elige cualquier libro y retoma donde lo dejaste.
• Comparte cualquier versículo como imagen en WhatsApp, Instagram o donde quieras, con varios diseños.
• Invita a tu familia o a tu iglesia a leer contigo.
• Modo oscuro y tamaños de texto grandes.
• Sin cuenta ni registro: tu progreso se guarda en tu iPhone y se copia en tu iCloud para que no lo pierdas al cambiar de teléfono.

GRATIS, CON ANUNCIOS OPCIONALES
Cada día tienes versículos nuevos gratis. Cuando los terminas, puedes ver un anuncio corto para seguir leyendo, volver mañana o pasarte a Premium. Releer lo que ya leíste es siempre gratis.

LUMBRERA PREMIUM
Quita los anuncios y el límite diario, y añade iconos de la app, diseños exclusivos para compartir y más sonidos ambiente. Suscripción mensual o anual con renovación automática; el precio se muestra en la app antes de comprar. El pago se carga en tu cuenta de Apple al confirmar la compra y la suscripción se renueva automáticamente salvo que la canceles al menos 24 horas antes del final del periodo. Puedes gestionarla o cancelarla en Ajustes > tu nombre > Suscripciones.

Términos de uso: https://lumbrera-app.vercel.app/terminos
Política de privacidad: https://lumbrera-app.vercel.app/privacidad

name: Lumen: RAW Camera & Looks
description:
Lumen is a camera and a darkroom for iPhone. Shoot with real manual control, see your Look live in the viewfinder, develop RAW files properly, and finish the photo in a full editor. Every edit stays reversible in Apple Photos, and everything runs on your iPhone.

48 ORIGINAL LOOKS
• Eight families: Everyday, Portrait, Colour, Outdoor, Urban, Analog, Cinema and Mono.
• Every Look was made for Lumen. None copies a film stock or another app's preset.
• Skin tones are protected, so faces stay natural as the colour changes.
• Set the intensity from 0 to 100%, or save any edit as your own Look.
• Bring your own .cube LUTs, including Apple Log grades for stills.
• Recipes save a Look with your adjustments, and export as a file you can share.

A CAMERA WITH REAL CONTROLS
• Shutter speed, ISO, focus and white balance, each automatic or manual. Shutter and ISO priority come from whichever you set by hand.
• Focus peaking, a focus loupe, zebras, histogram, level and grids.
• Spot metering apart from focus, and grey-card white balance.
• RAW, RAW+HEIF, RAW+JPEG, HEIF or JPEG. ProRAW and 48 MP on supported iPhones.
• HDR photos, burst, 3 and 10 second timers, and exposure brackets that merge into an editable HDR photo.
• 4:3, 3:2, 16:9 and 1:1 frames, kept as a reversible crop so the full frame is never lost.
• Front and back cameras, macro on supported iPhones, and flash.
• Camera Control on supported iPhones: exposure, Look and Look intensity.

VIDEO
• 4K and 1080p, up to 60 fps, and 120 or 240 fps at 1080p on supported iPhones.
• HEVC, or ProRes with Apple Log on supported iPhones.
• Record with the Look baked in, or record clean for your own grade.
• Waveform, false colour, zebras, audio meters and gain, pause and resume.
• Record to a USB-C drive on supported iPhones. If the drive fills up or is unplugged, recording carries on to the phone.

DEVELOP RAW
• Natural rendering by default: no decoder sharpening and no local tone mapping.
• Highlight recovery, white balance, noise reduction and lens correction in the RAW decoder.

A FULL EDITOR
• Light, colour, white balance presets and eyedropper, HSL in eight bands, tone curves and colour grading.
• Masks: subject, sky and person found on device, plus brush, linear, radial, luminance and colour range. Combine them by adding, subtracting or intersecting.
• Heal and clone, including brush strokes for wires and dust.
• Perspective, auto upright, auto level, crop, straighten and manual lens corrections.
• Grain, halation, bloom, fade and vignette.
• Always-on histogram with clipping warnings, and type an exact value into any slider.
• Hold for the original, or drag a split view. Full history with named versions.
• Copy and paste edits, and apply a Look to many photos at once.
• Export HEIF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF or AVIF, with HDR, resizing, a text watermark and control over metadata.

LIBRARY AND CULLING
• Your Apple Photos library, with no import step.
• Pick and reject with a swipe, add 1 to 5 stars and colour labels.
• Bursts and brackets stack into one tile. Compare up to 12 photos side by side.
• Search by date, file name, type, rating or album. Export or share many photos at once.

ALWAYS READY
• Open the Lumen camera from Control Centre, the Lock Screen or the Action button. Photos taken while locked move into your library the next time you open Lumen.
• Shortcuts actions: open the camera, set the camera's Look, or apply a Look to photos.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Lumen has no account, no ads and no analytics, and it makes no network requests. Your photos stay in Apple Photos, and your originals are never overwritten. Location is off until you turn it on, and then it is only written into your photos.

Some features depend on your iPhone model: ProRAW, 48 MP, Apple Log, ProRes, high frame rates, drive recording, macro and Camera Control. Lumen offers only what your iPhone's camera reports it can do.

name: LuthierBench
description:
LuthierBench is a precision workbench built for luthiers, guitar technicians, and instrument builders designing straight-scale and multi-scale fanned-fret instruments.

Every geometric layout, Mersenne string tension curve, neck relief clearance envelope, and bridge saddle setback is computed directly on your device with no account sign-in or network dependency.

KEY WORKBENCH MODULES

1. Fretboard Blueprint & Multi-Scale Fan Layout
- Model straight scales or custom multi-scale instruments (380 mm to 940 mm across 12 to 28 frets) with selectable neutral perpendicular fret placement.
- Inspect every fret interactively on a proportional CoreGraphics fingerboard blueprint, or switch between Full Neck and Frets 1–12 detail views.
- Read exact treble-side and bass-side distances from the nut, fret-to-fret pitch increments, fan slant angles in degrees, tapered fingerboard width, and compound radius progression in millimeters or inches.
- Open the full Fret Coordinate Ledger to review every fret from Fret 1 to Fret 28 in a single structured table.

2. Mersenne String Tension & Gauge Equalizer
- Calculate per-string pull in kgf or lbs across 4-string, 5-string, 6-string, 7-string, and 8-string configurations using calibrated linear densities for Plain Steel, Nickel Wound, Phosphor Bronze, 80/20 Bronze, Stainless Wound, Nylon Treble, and Silverplate Wound wire.
- View a visual tension balance chart with a ±12% target zone, total neck load summary, and treble-to-bass force split.
