- Tap any string to customize pitch, diameter gauge, or alloy, or run Auto-Equalize Gauges to compute matched diameters for custom or drop tunings.

3. Action, Neck Relief & Saddle Compensation
- Simulate 7th-fret truss-rod relief bow, 1st-fret nut clearance, 12th-fret bass and treble action heights, fret crown height, and saddle break angle.
- Inspect a longitudinal string-oscillation clearance schematic that flags tight fret margins before cutting nut grooves or filing saddles.
- View a top-down bridge saddle setback map showing individual octave compensation offsets (+ΔL) and effective scale length for every string.

4. Workshop Specs Archive & Sheet Export
- Start immediately with six built-in reference instrument builds, or save your own custom specs locally on your device.
- Search and filter builds by category, compare any two builds side by side with delta readouts, and export formatted PDF blueprints, CSV fret tables, or JSON spec archives.

name: MACro Pad
description:
남는 아이폰을 Mac 전용 리모컨으로 바꿔 보세요.

MACro Pad는 Mac에서 재생 중인 음악과 영상을 아이폰에서 바로 조작하는 앱이에요. 브라우저의 YouTube, Apple Music, Spotify 등 Mac에서 재생되는 대부분의 미디어에 쓸 수 있어요.

■ 미디어 조작
· 재생/일시 정지, 5초 앞뒤로, 이전/다음 곡
· YouTube 쇼츠도 다음/이전으로 넘기기
· 제목, 아티스트, 앨범 아트와 재생 위치 표시
· 진행 막대를 끌어 원하는 위치로 이동

■ Mac 볼륨

· 통신은 암호화되고 같은 Wi-Fi 안에서만 이루어져요
· 계정, 광고, 데이터 수집 없음

name: MAELIA
description:
MAELIA es un equipo de abogados constitucionalistas en Ecuador. Con esta app pides un abogado gratuito si no puedes pagar uno, presentas tu caso y ves en qué va tu solicitud, todo desde tu celular.

PIDE UN ABOGADO GRATUITO
• Si enfrentas una vulneración grave de tus derechos y no puedes pagar un abogado, cuéntanos tu historia.
• Te hacemos preguntas sencillas, una por pantalla. No necesitas saber de leyes.
• Revisamos tu solicitud y te decimos si podemos asumir tu defensa sin costo.

PRESENTA TU CASO
• Cuenta lo que pasó con tus palabras y adjunta tus documentos.
• Toma una foto de tu cédula, una resolución o un certificado directamente desde la app.
• Tu avance se guarda solo: puedes seguir después, donde lo dejaste.

MIRA EN QUÉ VA
• Sigue cada paso de tu solicitud: recibida, en revisión, en evaluación y respuesta.
• Si el equipo necesita un documento más, te llega un aviso al celular y lo subes en un momento.
• Recibe los mensajes del equipo jurídico en el mismo lugar.

CITAS Y CAPACITACIONES
• Agenda una cita si quieres contratar una defensa.
• Pide una capacitación sobre tus derechos para tu comunidad u organización.

TU INFORMACIÓN ES CONFIDENCIAL
• Solo el equipo que atiende tu caso ve tus datos.
• Puedes eliminar tu cuenta desde la app cuando quieras.

MAELIA no es una entidad del Estado. Presentar una solicitud no garantiza que asumamos tu defensa: el equipo revisa cada caso y te responde.

name: Magic Camera: LUT & Manual
seller_name: Qian Gu Internet Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
description:
Your color. Your camera.

Magic Camera brings live LUT previews and manual controls into one focused camera experience. Capture everyday moments, travel stories, and creative projects with a look that feels like you.

FIND YOUR LOOK
Explore cinematic, film-inspired, monochrome, and soft looks. Preview colors as you compose and adjust filter intensity to suit the scene.

CAPTURE PHOTOS AND VIDEO
Switch between photo and video capture in portrait or landscape. Record an ungraded video for editing later, or export a video with your selected look after recording.

TAKE CREATIVE CONTROL
Adjust available ISO, shutter speed, exposure compensation, white balance, and focus controls. Tap to focus and meter, or lock focus and exposure for a consistent shot.

SEE MORE WHILE YOU SHOOT
Use a brightness histogram, zebra patterns, focus peaking, false color, and composition guides to help evaluate your image. Monitoring overlays stay in the viewfinder and do not appear in your captures.

BRING YOUR OWN LUTS
Import compatible .cube LUT files or download additional looks from the library. Keep downloaded looks available offline and build a collection that matches your style.

KEEP IT PERSONAL
No account required. Photos and videos are processed on your device and are not automatically uploaded by the app. Save your work to Photos for easy viewing and sharing.

Available lenses, manual controls, resolutions, frame rates, and recording formats depend on your iPhone and capture configuration. Optional LUT downloads require an internet connection.

name: Magic Hours: Film & LUT Camera
description:
Have you ever seen a photo and wished you could keep its colors? Maybe it was a street at dusk or a picture a friend took of you. Magic Hours turns that look into a filter for the next time you shoot.

KEEP A COLOR YOU LOVE AND USE IT AGAIN

Choose one photo, and Magic Hours picks up its color, grain, and vignette and turns them into a filter of your own. Set how strong it should be, or keep skin tones looking natural. From then on it's in your camera, ready for the next shot.

SEE IT BEFORE YOU PRESS THE SHUTTER

Your style appears live in the viewfinder, so you can see how the photo will look. Choose from 44 original styles with film, CCD digicam, and instant-snapshot looks, each with sample scene photos. Keep favorites and adjust the strength to suit the light.

Tap to focus and drag to adjust exposure. Styles that suit flash remind you to turn it on; the front camera can use your screen as a fill light. Choose a 3:4, 2:3, 1:1, or 9:16 frame, a 3- or 10-second timer, and 0.5×, 1×, 2×, or telephoto depending on your iPhone.

GIVE PHOTOS YOU ALREADY TOOK ANOTHER TRY

Pick a photo from your library, apply a style, and press and hold to compare it with the original. Fine-tune light, color, tone curves, HSL, and split toning, or add grain, a date stamp, or light leaks depending on the style. Crop, undo, and redo as you go. Your original and settings stay with the edit, so you can reopen it later. If you like where an edit ended up, save it as a filter. You can also build one from scratch with the same tools, starting from a built-in style if you want.

Have a few photos that belong together? Apply one set of settings to 2 to 5 photos and export them at once as HEIC or JPEG. Shots are kept in the app's own library, and you can also save each one to Photos automatically.

FOR LUT USERS

Already have a .cube or image LUT? Import up to 20 files at once, or send one from another app with "Open in." Your filters can be exported as .cube LUTs (33 or 64 points) for desktop photo and video editing, or saved as a file for a friend to import.

YOUR PHOTOS STAY ON YOUR iPHONE

Everything runs on your iPhone, and the app makes no network connections. No sign-up, ads, tracking, or analytics. It asks only for camera access and permission to add photos. You choose library photos with the system picker, so the app can't see your whole library. Exported photos keep their capture time and camera details, and location data is always removed.

name: Maia Go 2.0
description:
Maia Go 2.0 es la app de los colaboradores de las empresas que usan MaiaHR. Todo tu día laboral, en tu bolsillo.

Marca tu asistencia
Registra tu entrada y salida con un toque. La app usa la ubicación de tu teléfono solo en el momento de marcar, para validar tu marcación.

Tu día de un vistazo
Consulta tu turno de hoy y el siguiente, tus fondos de vacaciones e incapacidad, y los anuncios de tu empresa.

Solicitudes
Pide vacaciones, permisos e incapacidades, adjunta tu evidencia en PDF y sigue el estado de cada solicitud.

Historial de marcaciones
Revisa tus marcaciones día por día y por período, con su estado de verificación.

Cartas laborales
Genera cartas de trabajo y otros documentos a partir de las plantillas de tu empresa, y descárgalos al instante.

Documentos
Consulta tus comprobantes de pago y documentos adjuntos, guárdalos o compártelos.

Beneficios (próximamente)
Muy pronto, cupones y descuentos exclusivos en marcas aliadas.

Importante: Maia Go es solo para colaboradores. Tu cuenta la crea tu empresa; si no tienes acceso, solicítalo a Recursos Humanos. Puedes ingresar con tu correo y contraseña, o con tu cuenta de Google o Microsoft.

name: Mail Zone
description:
Mail Zone لتنظيم حسابات بريدك من مكان واحد.

• عرض الوارد والمميزة والمرسلة والأرشيف وغير المرغوب والمهملات.
• كتابة الرسائل والرد عليها وإضافة المرفقات.
• وارد موحّد مع عرض كل حساب على حدة.
• حفظ المسودات محلياً وتخصيص توقيع كل حساب.
• تنظيم الحسابات ضمن مساحات، وتثبيت وتأجيل الرسائل محلياً.
• واجهة عربية وإنكليزية، ووضع فاتح وداكن.

وظائف البريد تحتاج اتصالاً بالإنترنت وربط حسابك لدى المزوّد. المسودات والتأجيل محليان؛ البحث والفلاتر ومركز المرفقات يعملون على الرسائل المحمّلة. لا يحتوي التطبيق على إعلانات.

name: Maioris Baker
description:
Maioris Baker reúne en una sola app todo lo que necesitas para hacer pan en casa: calcular tus masas, guardar tus fórmulas, aprender con guías y vídeos, y compartir tus panes con otras personas que hornean.

CALCULADORA DE PANADERÍA
Crea tus fórmulas con porcentajes de panadero. Ajusta harinas, hidratación, sal y demás ingredientes, y calcula las cantidades según el número de piezas y su peso. Trabaja con masa directa o con prefermentos como masa madre, poolish o biga.

Puedes usar la calculadora sin cuenta. Si entras con la tuya, tus fórmulas se guardan de forma privada.

TUS FÓRMULAS, ORDENADAS
Organiza tu recetario con categorías, colecciones y favoritas. Consulta también las fórmulas públicas de Maioris Baker y guarda las que quieras probar. Exporta tus fórmulas a un archivo para tener una copia e impórtalas cuando lo necesites.

GUÍAS Y VÍDEOS
Aprende paso a paso con guías de panadería, desde cómo crear tu masa madre hasta tus primeros panes. Mira los vídeos del canal, ordenados por temas, sin salir de la app.

UNA COMUNIDAD DE PANADEROS
Publica fotos de tus panes, añade la receta si quieres y comenta las de los demás. Sigue a otros miembros, guarda las publicaciones que te gusten y comparte historias del día a día. Suma puntos de comunidad con tu participación.

MENSAJES PRIVADOS
Conversa con otros miembros. Nadie puede escribirte sin que aceptes antes su solicitud, y puedes bloquear a quien quieras.

TU CUENTA Y TUS DATOS
Entra con Apple o con tu correo. Tú decides qué mostrar en tu perfil y qué avisos recibir. Tus fórmulas personales son privadas: solo las ves tú. Desde Mi cuenta puedes descargar tus datos o eliminar tu cuenta. La comunidad tiene normas y puedes denunciar el contenido inapropiado.

name: Manabig Offline Translator
description:
For travel and places with unreliable connectivity. After you prepare the required language and voice data, Manabig can recognize speech, translate and read aloud on your device. Conversation text is not sent to a translation service.

OFFLINE AFTER SETUP
Internet is required to download language, voice and high-quality data initially. After preparation, supported speech recognition, translation and on-device voices can work offline.

CONTINUOUS MODE: KEEP TALKING WITHOUT REPEATED TAPS
Start Continuous mode once. You do not need to press a recording or translation button for each utterance. About one second after speech stops, the app automatically ends that segment, translates and reads aloud. When playback finishes, listening starts again automatically. Wait for playback to finish before speaking again.
Available for a selected pair of Japanese, English, Mandarin Chinese and Korean.

CHOOSE HOW TO COMMUNICATE
• Hold-to-talk voice input
• Continuous mode that translates after an utterance and listens again after playback
• Typed translation
• Automatic translation direction for a selected pair of Japanese, English, Chinese and Korean
• Conversation history with original text and translations

FREE STANDARD TRANSLATION
Standard text translation supports 58 languages after you prepare the required data. Speech recognition and read-aloud support depend on the language, device and installed data.

OPTIONAL HIGH QUALITY
High-quality text translation supports 23 languages. The available on-device engine depends on the OS, device, language and preparation status.
Choose Start 30-day free trial to try high quality for 30 days. The trial does not charge you automatically. To continue using high quality afterward, you can choose a one-time purchase: JPY480 in Japan. Check the App Store purchase sheet for your local price. There is no monthly fee or automatic renewal. Standard translation stays free after the trial. Restore purchases is supported.

FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
Requires iOS or iPadOS 18 or later. High-quality processing speed and available engines vary by device. Initial setup requires storage space and internet access.

Automatic recognition and translation can contain errors. Check the original text for important information. Model downloads, starting the trial, purchases, restoration and SDK diagnostics may use the network.

name: Mannequo: AI Product Photos
description:
Mannequo turns an ordinary phone photo into a studio-quality product image. Hold the product up or lay it down, take a photo, and Mannequo removes the background, straightens and lights the product, and places it on your web shop's own background and format.

It works for clothing (on an invisible mannequin), shoes, bags, jewellery, cosmetics, home goods, electronics and more. From the same packshot you can also make photos on an AI model, close-up detail shots and short product videos.

What you can do:
• Studio packshots from a phone photo, no studio or photographer needed
• Your own house style: format, background and framing, the same for every photo
• Find the product by name, SKU or barcode and put the photo straight into your web shop (Shopify, WooCommerce or product feed)
• Model photos, detail shots and short videos from the same packshot
• Work as a team: invite colleagues, permissions per role
• Pay per credit, no subscription. New accounts get 5 free credits.

The photos are yours to use anywhere.

name: MapNinja: Game Maps & Guides
description:
Find your way around your favourite games with MapNinja.

Browse a growing library of interactive game maps, search for locations and narrow the map to the categories you need. Open location details, view screenshots and read guides while you explore.

EXPLORE INTERACTIVE MAPS
Pinch to zoom, drag to move and use map controls to get a closer look or see the whole area.

FIND WHAT YOU NEED
Search locations and filter markers by category. Use available location notes, images and guides to help plan your next step.

KEEP TRACK OF YOUR DISCOVERIES
Sign in with email, Google or Apple to mark locations as found. Your account progress syncs with the MapNinja website and your other devices. Pending changes are saved on your device and sync when you reconnect.

SAVE YOUR FAVOURITE GAMES
Keep games in your Saved tab for quick access. Saved games and your theme preference stay on your device.

READ GAME GUIDES
Open published guides from each game's page. Tap guide and location images to view them in a gallery.

Browse maps without creating an account. Sign-in is needed to track progress. An internet connection is required to load maps, images and guides. Available maps and location details vary by game; upcoming maps may be unfinished.

Visit www.mapninja.io for the latest library.

name: MarkSpindle

Layouts stay on your device and work offline.

name: Master Office
description:
Master Office: all your documents in one app.

Open PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, TXT and ZIP/RAR files fast; merge, split, sign and convert PDFs. Your documents open on your device and are never uploaded. Every tool works offline.

VIEW DOCUMENTS

name: Measurements: Body Tracker
description:
Track your body with the measurements that matter to you: waist, weight, body fat, chest, hips, arms, legs, water, or anything else with your own unit, like PRs.

GUIDED CHECK-INS
Group your measurements and measure them one by one in a set order, with instructions on how to take each one. Left and right sides are separate steps. Stop halfway and continue later. Set weekly reminders so you never miss a check-in.

LONG-TERM GOALS
Set a target like reaching 75 kg or an 80 cm waist. See how far you've come, how much is left, and when you'll get there at your current pace. Add an optional target date to see whether you're on track. Weight and body fat use your 7-day average, so one unusual day doesn't count. When you reach a goal, keep it with a maintenance range or set a new one.

CLEAR CHARTS AND HISTORY
See every measurement over a month, three months, a year or all time, with your goal drawn on the chart. Water shows daily totals with one-tap buttons for a glass or a bottle.

APPLE HEALTH
Weight, body fat, lean body mass, height, waist and water stay in sync with Apple Health in both directions. Data from your smart scale or other apps appears automatically.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your data is stored on your device, with optional sync through your private iCloud. Export everything to CSV at any time, or import from a spreadsheet.

FEATURES
• Recommended measurements to start in seconds, or track anything with your own unit
• Metric and imperial units
• Guided check-ins with how-to-measure instructions
• Weekly check-in reminders
• Long-term goals with progress, estimated date and maintenance mode
• Apple Health sync
• Optional iCloud sync between iPhone and iPad
• CSV export and import
• Light and dark mode

Measurements is a personal tracking tool, not a medical device, and doesn't provide medical advice.

name: Megdan
description:
Megdan je kviz bitka na ploči. Znanje je tvoje oružje.

Odaberi svoju legendu i izađi na megdan. Svako polje na ploči je jedno područje znanja. Želiš li polje, odgovori točno na pitanje. Želiš li srušiti protivnika, odgovori točno prije njega.

KAKO SE IGRA
• Pomakni figuru na susjedno polje i odgovori na pitanje.
• Točan odgovor osvaja polje. Krivi odgovor znači izgubljen potez.
• Napadni protivničku figuru i sruši je znanjem.
• Tko zadnji ostane s figurama, pobjeđuje.

ŠTO TE ČEKA
• Više od tisuću pitanja na hrvatskom: povijest, zemljopis, znanost, sport, film, glazba, književnost, kultura, priroda i opće znanje.
• Četiri legende s vlastitim pričama: Grmislav, Mrakovid, Zlatogriv i Šumorod.
• Brzi meč protiv botova koji se prilagođavaju tvojoj razini.
• Lokalni meč za 2 do 4 igrača na jednom uređaju.
• Online meč protiv prijatelja ili nasumičnih igrača.
• Značke za pobjede, nizove točnih odgovora i hrabre obrane.

Igraj odmah kao gost ili napravi račun da sačuvaš napredak. Bez oglasa.

Misli. Osvoji.

name: Meltaway: Visual Timer
description:
Ever look up and an hour is gone? Meltaway makes time visible.

Pick a duration and watch it melt away: a glowing block of wax that drips into a puddle, water draining from a glass, sand running through an hourglass, or a classic shrinking disc. You can tell how much time is left at a glance, without reading numbers.

Built for time blindness
• Big, calm visuals that show time instead of counting it
• Gentle mode: "About 10 minutes" instead of ticking seconds, or hide numbers completely
• Heads-up chime and notification 5 minutes and 1 minute before the end
• Label your timer ("Homework", "Tidy my room", "Leave the house") so you remember what it was for

Everywhere you look
• Lock Screen and Dynamic Island: the bar keeps melting even when the app is closed
• Pause, add a minute or stop right from the Lock Screen
• Home Screen widget: start 5, 15, 25 or 45 minutes with one tap
• Control Center button and Siri: "Start a melt timer with Meltaway"

Calm by design
• Six warm color themes and four looks
• Soft chimes made for this app, haptics you can turn off
• Works offline. No account, no ads, no subscriptions
• Your labels never leave your phone

Meltaway is great for focus sessions, homework, chores, transitions, screen-time limits for kids, cooking, workouts and getting out the door on time.

Meltaway is a timer, not a medical device.

name: Mentornity
description:
Mentornity is the mentoring platform used by companies, universities, accelerators and associations to run their mentoring programs. This app is for the mentors, mentees and admins of those programs.

• Your home screen: upcoming meetings, your matches and your program's announcements at a glance.
• Find and match: browse mentors or mentees, request a match, or accept one your program suggests.
• Meetings: book a time inside a mentor's published hours, join video meetings in the app, and fill in the meeting form afterwards.
• Messages: talk to your match and your program team in one place, with notifications on your phone.
• Mentoring tools: goal setting, SWOT, career maps and more, shared with your mentor.
• Certificate: complete your program and earn a verifiable certificate you can add to LinkedIn.

You need an invitation from a program that uses Mentornity to sign in. Program admins manage their programs at mentornity.com in a browser.

name: Mescid Cami Kıble Bul
description:
Mescid Bul, yakınındaki cami ve mescitleri bulmanı, namaz vakitlerini takip etmeni ve kıbleyi doğru bulmanı sağlar.

YAKINDAKİ CAMİ VE MESCİTLER
• Camiler, AVM, akaryakıt istasyonu ve dinlenme tesisi mescitleri haritada ve listede
• Yürüme süresi ve tek dokunuşla yol tarifi
• Sıcak su, kadınlar bölümü, abdesthane, otopark gibi özellikler
• Kullanıcıların güncel tuttuğu ortak bilgi: işaretle, puan ver, not bırak
• Bilmediğin bir mescit mi var? Haritaya sen ekle

NAMAZ VAKİTLERİ
• Diyanet takvimiyle ilçe ilçe vakitler
• Sıradaki vakte saniye saniye geri sayım
• Vakit aralıkları ve ezan bildirimi
• Hicri tarih, kandiller ve mübarek günler

İBADET

name: METRAI
description:
METRAI es la plataforma todo en uno para agencias y agentes inmobiliarios. Tu cartera trabaja sola: tú cierras operaciones.

Para usar la app necesitas una cuenta de METRAI de tu agencia.

PROPIEDADES Y WEB
• Toda tu cartera en un sitio, sincronizada con tu CRM.
• Web de la agencia y web personal de cada agente, siempre al día.

CAPTACIÓN Y DEMANDA
• Captación de propietarios en tu zona, con su seguimiento en un tablero.
• Demanda: tus clientes compradores y las propiedades que encajan con cada uno.
• Difusión: leads de tus anuncios y de los portales, repartidos al agente que toca.

MARKETING CON IA
• Carteles de escaparate, imágenes para redes sociales, vídeos, dossieres y revista con la imagen de tu marca, en segundos.
• Edición de fotos: mejora, ordena y prepara las fotos de cada propiedad.

VALORACIONES
• Informes de valoración con datos oficiales de precios y testigos de mercado.

METRA, TU ASISTENTE VIRTUAL
• Pídele lo que necesites por texto o por voz: buscar una propiedad, preparar un cartel, revisar tus leads del día…

EQUIPO Y GESTIÓN
• Agenda de citas de cada agente.
• Reclutamiento de nuevos agentes.
• Documentos y firma electrónica de contratos y encargos.
• Dashboard con la actividad y los resultados del equipo.
• Avisos al momento en el móvil: nuevos leads, citas, firmas…

Disponible en 22 idiomas.

name: Milk Frog Adventure Challenge
description:
Join the lovable on a side-scrolling adventure at your own pace.

COLLECT MILK BEANS, CHOOSE WHEN TO FIRE
Start each fresh run with 20 milk beans. Jump to collect supplies, tap to fire one bean, or hold to fire continuously. Leap past foes to save your supplies, or seize an opening to clear the way.

THREE SETTINGS, DIFFERENT RHYTHMS
Windmill Garden: Hit the windmill targets to unfold leaf bridges and explore paths at different heights.
Rooftop Lane: Jump across rooftop platforms, watch for patrolling umbrella foes, and collect airborne supplies.
Autumn Woods: Climb root ledges, watch pinecone foes wind up and hop, and choose when to fire or leap past.

MOVE AT YOUR OWN PACE
Move left or right and release to stop. Tap jump again in midair for an additional jump. Push forward or pause to observe, and find your own approach to each challenge.

UNLOCK YOUR JOURNEY, AIM FOR THREE STARS
Levels unlock in order. Clear all five levels in a chapter to open the next chapter. Each level keeps separate completion, stars, and best records, so you can return to improve your performance. If a run goes wrong, retry from a rest stop you have reached during that run.

No registration, ads, or in-app purchases. Play offline. Designed for landscape play on iPhone.

name: Mind Notes: Project Map
description:
Mind Notes keeps every project and goal on one mind map, so you can see where each one stands without rereading old notes.

A topic is one project or goal: a newsletter, a shop launch, a training plan, a language you are learning. After each session you add a short dated entry: what was done, the results as numbers, what you learned and the next steps. Mind Notes draws the map and keeps the history.

WHAT YOU GET
• One map of all your topics, grouped by area, with the status of each
• A map and a document view of every topic
• Results with history: keep the same label from entry to entry and see how the number changed
• Expectations with a date, marked as open, met or missed
• Tasks with due dates and an owner, and one list of the tasks of all projects: overdue, today, next 7 days
• Your own free-form notes on every topic
• Search across all notes
• A sample project to see how it works

ON THE MAC
Notes are plain JSON files in a folder you choose. You can write them by hand in the app, or let an AI coding assistant such as Claude Code write the entries into that folder as it works; the app reloads within seconds.

MIND NOTES PRO
The app is free for up to 3 topics on one device. Mind Notes Pro adds:
• Unlimited topics
• Sync between Mac, iPhone and iPad with a Mind Notes account

Mind Notes Pro Monthly and Mind Notes Pro Yearly are auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. One purchase covers the Mac, iPhone and iPad apps.

No ads, no analytics, no tracking. Without an account, your notes stay on your device. You can delete your account and everything stored on the sync server from inside the app at any time.

name: Minufold
description:
An email attachment. A photo upload. A video for your friends. When file size gets in the way, open Minufold.

Choose a size limit and make photos and videos easier to send—all on your iPhone. Preview the result before you save or share.

CHOOSE YOUR SIZE
Set a size limit in MB. Compare the original and compressed result, zoom into photos, or play the compressed video with sound. Adjust the limit and try again when you need a different result.

PHOTOS AND VIDEOS, NEATLY APART
Separate workspaces keep each type easy to find. Browse records by date, search, filter, sort, or swipe to delete. Select multiple files for batch compression and preview. Pro adds batch export.

TRIM AND SHARE
Choose the part of a video you want to keep. Save completed files to Photos or Files, or send them through the iOS share sheet.

ON-DEVICE PROCESSING
Compression runs locally on your iPhone. Import the files you choose from Photos, Files, or the share extension. Built-in photo and video examples let you try the workflow right away.

FREE TO TRY
Compression and previews are free, including batch compression. Your first successful single-file export is free. Saving to Photos, saving to Files, and sharing each count as an export. Minufold Pro unlocks unlimited saving and sharing, plus batch export, through a yearly subscription or one-time lifetime purchase.

The yearly subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage subscriptions or restore purchases from Settings. A lifetime purchase does not cancel an existing yearly subscription.

name: MirrorTwinStride
description:
You drag left. Across the glass, your twin drags right.

That is MirrorTwinStride. A neon hall split down the middle by a shimmering seam. Your runner on one side, a mirror copy on the other, both moving with one finger. The twist is that the halls are not mirror images. Pink barriers and cyan orbs come down each side in different places, so a lane that is clear for you can be a wall for your twin.

Every stride is a quick sum: where am I safe, where is my twin safe, where are both of us safe at once.

Then a chrome gate rolls through. Pass it and control swaps to the other runner. The seam flares, reflections ripple, and your drag suddenly feels backwards. Breathe, read the hall again, keep going.

How a run works:
- Drag anywhere to steer. The other runner mirrors you.
- Dodge pink bars on both sides. Three hits and the run shatters.
- Grab cyan orbs on either side to build a combo multiplier.
- Chrome gates swap which twin you steer.

Levels come in four halls, First Reflections, Split Signals, Prism Rush and the Infinite Mirror, 48 in all. Each one is built around a guaranteed safe line, and stars come from orbs collected on both sides.

Endless mode keeps speeding up until something breaks. The Daily mode is one hall, the same for everyone that day. Both go on global boards under a runner name you can re-roll.

Synthwave bass and glittering arpeggios. Haptics that tap left, right, left when control swaps, and buzz hard when you crash.

Plays offline. No login, no ads, no in-app purchases. One finger, two runners.

name: Mister Botola - فانتازي الكرة
description:
Mister Botola هي لعبة فانتازي كرة القدم المجانية لتلعبها مع أصدقائك.

أنشئ دوريًا خاصًا، ادعُ أصدقاءك بكود، واحصل على فريق بقيمة 60 مليون للبدء. في كل جولة يحصل لاعبوك على نقاط حسب أدائهم الحقيقي في الملعب.

ما يمكنك فعله:
• سوق يومي: زايد على اللاعبين قبل إغلاق السوق، وأعلى مزايدة تفوز.
• الشرط الجزائي: احمِ نجومك أو اخطف لاعبي منافسيك بدفع شرطهم.
• التشكيلة والقائد: اختر الخطة والقائد الذي يضاعف نقاطه.
• قيمة اللاعبين تتغير يوميًا حسب أدائهم والطلب عليهم.
• الترتيب العام وترتيب كل جولة، مع رسوم بيانية لنقاط كل لاعب.
• جدول المباريات القادمة ومواعيدها.
• حائط الدوري: منشورات، تعليقات، إعجابات وكل حركات السوق.
• صاحب الدوري يضبط القواعد: المكافآت، مواعيد السوق، الديون وغيرها.
• صورة شخصية وشعار نادٍ خاص بك.
• بالعربية والفرنسية والإسبانية.

بدون إعلانات، بدون مشتريات، وبدون أموال حقيقية: المال داخل اللعبة افتراضي فقط.

Mister Botola تطبيق مستقل وغير تابع لأي دوري أو نادٍ أو اتحاد.

name: Mistly: Nearby Dating
description:
Mistly is a dating app for meeting people nearby without giving away where you are or what you look like until you both want to.

FOGGED UNTIL IT'S MUTUAL
Everyone's photos are fogged. You get to know someone through what they write: their bio and their answers to prompts. Like an answer you love and, if they say yes back, the fog starts to lift.

ZONES, NEVER PINS
Your phone turns your location into a rough zone before anything is sent. Others see "same block", "walkable" or "across town", never your street, never a distance in metres. Your exact location never leaves your phone.

THE FOG LIFTS AS YOU TALK
A mutual yes opens a chat. Photos clear in stages as you both keep talking, or right away if you both choose to lift the fog.

CHATS THAT DON'T PILE UP
Messages fade 24 hours after they're read. No archive of old conversations, no screenshots of last year.

BUILT FOR SAFETY
- Report or block anyone from their profile or your chat
- Messages are checked for abusive wording before they're sent
- Every report reaches a real person on our safety team
- Pause your profile any time to disappear from Nearby
- Discreet lock-screen notifications: no names, no message text
- Delete your account in the app, in one step

NO ADS, NO TRACKING
We don't show ads, sell your data or use tracking tools.

Mistly is for adults aged 18 and over.

Privacy: https://fogly-api.fleuvetech.com/privacy

name: Mivrek
description:
Mivrek turns photos, ticket stubs, and postcards into digital fridge magnets you can arrange on a realistic door-style canvas. Travelers, families, and friends can keep memories from the same occasion on one board, making them easier to revisit.

Import a photo or take one, crop it into a magnet shape, or give it an instant-photo frame. Move, rotate, resize, and layer items by hand. Add clips, pin a written note, or record a voice memory of up to 60 seconds to play from its card.

Keep a board for everyday moments and create separate boards for trips or family events. Layouts save automatically on your device. Export a finished board as a high-resolution image to share.

name: Mom & Me
description:
Home? Turn your light on. Family far away sees it right away.

Mom & Me is the lightest way for families who live apart to check in. When a call feels like too much and a text feels like a chore, one light says it all.

• One light says "I'm home"
Tap "I'm home" when you get in, "Heading out" when you leave. Your family gets a gentle notification.

• See everyone at a glance
Each person's light and their local time — Seoul, New York, Auckland, wherever they are.

• Leave a note
A one-line note like "Back from the doctor — all fine." No reply needed, just "Seen". Notes come down at midnight.

• Knock knock
Their phone gives two gentle taps. A quiet "thinking of you".

• Home-screen widget
See your family's lights without opening the app.

• No location tracking
No GPS. Only the city you choose.

Up to 5 family members. Free for 7 days, then one person pays once and the whole family keeps it — no subscription.

Terms: https://mom-me.pages.dev/terms
Privacy: https://mom-me.pages.dev/privacy

name: Monster Video Call: Kid Habits
description:
Won't sleep? Won't brush? Won't listen? Just tap the moment and a character video-calls your child for you!

Made for busy parents — no typing needed.
① Pick the moment → ② Pick a tone (Reward · Gentle · Firm) → ③ Tap a character. Done!

■ Moments
Won't sleep · Won't brush teeth · Won't listen · Picky eating · Won't clean up · Won't take a bath · Won't turn off screens · Getting ready to go

■ Not just scolding — a praise call when they do it
After the call, the app asks "Did they do it?"
Tap [Done!] and the same character calls back to praise them, plus a sticker.
Collect 10 stickers to become a Super Star

■ Praise anytime
Brushed teeth, ate well, played nicely — pick what they did and a praise call goes out.

■ Feels like a real video call
• The phone rings, and when your child answers, the character in the video talks to them
• Every character has its own voice and expressions
• Korean characters speak Korean, Japanese characters speak Japanese, American characters speak English (on-screen text stays in your language)

■ Scheduled calls
In 1, 3 or 5 minutes, or every day at a set time — 8:30 PM "Time to brush", 9 PM "Time for bed"

■ 27 characters — Cartoon · Real · Scary
[USA] Cartoon: Alien · Teddy Bear · Baby Dino / Real: Police Officer · Firefighter · Santa / Scary: Witch · Vampire · Boogeyman
[Japan] Cartoon: Little Oni · Kappa · Tanuki / Real: Police Officer · Firefighter · Teacher / Scary: Oni · Namahage · Yamauba
[Korea] Cartoon: Little Dokkaebi (Korean goblin) · Baby Tiger · Bunny / Real: Police Officer · Firefighter · Teacher / Scary: Dokkaebi · Gumiho (nine-tailed fox) · Sack Grandpa

■ Works offline
All character videos are built into the app — no extra downloads, calls work without internet.

■ Write your own
You can also type your own words. Enter your child's name and the character calls them by name. Voices for your own words are made on the phone. Saved words can be used again.

■ Safe to use
• Starts in the cartoon version. The scary version is behind a parent lock
• Real-life characters (police officers, firefighters…) only praise and remind gently — they never scare
• No violent words or bloody pictures
• Your words, your child's name, voice and face are never sent anywhere
• No sign-up

※ Character videos and voices are AI-generated.
※ Please use the firm tone and scary version only now and then. Don't use them for fears your child already has (dark, doctors), and not for children under 3.

name: Moonlight Realty
description:
Moonlight Realty Group brings Austin home search and AI design together in one app.

SEE IT REDESIGNED
Take a photo of any room or yard, pick a style, and see it redesigned in seconds. Paint, cabinets, counters, flooring, lighting or landscaping: you choose exactly what changes, and everything else stays the same. Renting? Renter-safe mode only suggests changes you can take with you.

KNOW WHAT IT COSTS
Every design comes with an Austin-area cost estimate for the updates you picked, plus a project brief you can send to local pros.

MOVE THE WALLS
Upload a floor plan, PDF or photo. Moonlight traces the walls so you can move, remove or add them, then view the new layout in 3D.

FIND A HOME
Browse homes and rentals across Austin and the Hill Country, save favorites, check payments, book showings, and reimagine any listing with AI before you tour it.

SELLING?
See which pre-listing updates pay off in Austin, backed by published remodeling data, and get a home value from a local agent.

HOME HELP
Pest control, lawn care, HVAC, plumbing, cleaning and more: tell us what you need and we'll connect you with trusted local pros.

Moonlight Realty Group is a team at JBGoodwin REALTORS® in Austin, Texas. AI redesigns are concept images, not a promise of how a project will turn out.

name: Moonlit Seats
description:
The attic is quiet, but its guests have opinions. Lamp wants to sit beside Book. Clock dozes off next to Pillow. Fan can send a page fluttering. Find an arrangement that lets the bedtime story begin.

SWAP A SEAT
Tap two guests or drag one onto another to swap their chairs. Watch how they react and check the clues as you go. Some guests need to sit together, others need space, and some have their eye on a particular chair. Undo a swap, reset the table, or ask for a hint if you get stuck.

TURN THE PAGE
Solve 24 puzzles across four illustrated chapters. Each solution reveals a passage and saves your finished table in the Storybook. Read the unlocked pages in order or replay a favorite puzzle for a better score. Meet the swap target without a hint to earn three stars.

STAY FOR AN ENCORE
Finish a chapter to unlock its Moonlight Encore. Try a different opening arrangement, work around a guest whose chair is fixed, and use clues that involve three guests at once. In select deals, turn the fan dial to change who feels the breeze. After a clear, deal another table and try again.

Play offline at your own pace. Your story and encore attempts are saved separately, so you can leave a table mid-puzzle and pick it up later.

name: Morse Training (KDMorse)
description:
Learn Morse code by ear, the way radio operators do.

Morse Training teaches every letter and number through short listening lessons. Start with E and T, add a few new sounds in each lesson, and review until you recognise them without counting dots and dashes.

LEARN STEP BY STEP
• 12 lessons from 1-sound letters to every letter and number
• Each letter shown as dots and dashes, then played for you
• Listen, type what you hear, and get instant feedback
• Your progress is saved, so you always know what's next

TRAIN YOUR EAR
• Practice with random letters, numbers, a mix, or real sentences
• 8 whistle sound levels, or a clean CW tone
• CW speed from 20 to 180 characters per minute
• Check your copy and see the right answer when you miss

PLAY YOUR OWN TEXT
• Type any message and see it in Morse code instantly
• Play it back as whistle or CW at your chosen speed

No account, no ads, no data collected. Works offline.

name: Movie Quire
description:
Movie Quire is a local-first studio for filmmakers, critics, and cinephiles who need film knowledge and pre-production tools—not another video player.
ARCHIVE
Browse an offline film vault with rich poster cards, craft notes, themes, production details, shelves, favorites, and personal ratings. Add your own titles and attach custom covers from Photos.
STORYBOARDS
Build projects with scenes and panels. Capture sluglines, intentions, action, dialogue, shot size, camera move, lens notes, sound cues, and timing—written for sets, not feeds.
REFERENCES
Create mood boards for lighting, palette, composition, and atmosphere. Pin notes and optional photos that stay on your device.
JOURNAL
Keep spoiler-aware craft notes linked to titles in your vault. Private by default.
TOOLKIT
Quick reminders for shot sizes, coverage, aspect ratios, structure beats, lighting, and sound—ready when you’re packing a shot list.
BUILT FOR QUIET CRAFT
• Offline-first local storage
• No account wall
• No social graph
• No short-video feed
• Export a JSON backup when you need it
Movie Quire helps you study films, plan coverage, and organize visual references with a dark, cinematic interface designed for serious creative work.

name: MovieBoard AI
description:
MovieBoard AI turns a video of you talking into a short, edited reel. Record in the app while you read from the teleprompter, or pick a video you already have. MovieBoard AI cuts your retakes and long pauses, adds captions, graphics and your brand's look, and you post the finished video to Instagram or YouTube.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Tap + and choose the kind of video you want.
2. Record yourself, or upload a clip from your phone.
3. MovieBoard AI keeps your best take of each line, writes the captions from what you said and adds graphics that match your words.
4. For a Crafted video, check the draft first: change a caption, drop a scene or switch the layout, then finish it.
5. Save the video to your phone, share it, or post it to your own Instagram or YouTube account from the app.

THREE KINDS OF VIDEO
• Flash: record or upload, and MovieBoard AI picks the best takes, adds captions and cleans up your voice. Ready to post in minutes.
• Crafted: your own video with graphics, a style and any extra clips you add. You check the draft before it's finished.
• AI Voice: no filming. Write a script and a ready-made voice reads it over graphics.

YOUR LOOK, SET UP ON DAY ONE
The first time you open the app, tell us what your videos are about, your name or brand, and the language you speak. MovieBoard AI picks colors, fonts and a caption style that suit your field and adds a name card with your name. You can change all of it later in Settings → Brand kit, including your logo.

CLIPS WITH NO TALKING
A walk-through of an apartment, a product close-up, a before-and-after: when nobody speaks in your clip, MovieBoard AI uses a layout made for clips without speech instead of waiting for words that aren't there.

ALSO IN THE APP
• A teleprompter that scrolls your script while you record.
• Ideas: video ideas and scripts for your field, ready to record.
• Captions in English, Hindi or Hinglish, and Telugu.
• A score for each finished video, with tips on what to fix next time. It's a quality check, not a prediction of views.
• An email when your video is ready.

YOUR FILES
The videos you upload are deleted 3 days after your video is finished, and finished videos are kept for 7 days, so save the ones you want to keep. Your videos and voice are not used to train AI models. You can delete your account and everything in it from Settings at any time.

GOOD TO KNOW
• You need a MovieBoard AI account to make videos.
• Posting to Instagram needs an Instagram Professional account (Creator or Business). Posting to YouTube needs a YouTube channel. You can always save the video and post it yourself instead.
• Videos are made on our servers, so you need an internet connection while you upload.

MovieBoard AI is made by Outstretch Technologies Private Limited.
Privacy policy: https://movieboard.ai/privacy
Terms: https://movieboard.ai/terms
Help: support@movieboard.ai

name: MUDARKWORLD
description:
MUDARKWORLD es un MMORPG de fantasía oscura con mundo abierto y miles de jugadores en un mismo servidor.

Elige tu clase, sube de nivel, consigue alas y sets legendarios y enfréntate a jefes de mundo junto a tu clan.

CARACTERÍSTICAS
• Mundo abierto con decenas de mapas: ciudades, mazmorras, desiertos, hielo y lava.
• Más de 10 clases con sus propias habilidades y evoluciones.
• Jefes de mundo, invasiones y eventos todos los días.
• Clanes, alianzas y guerras por el castillo.
• Combate en tiempo real con controles táctiles pensados para el móvil.
• Ayudante de combate para seguir progresando mientras descansas.
• Misiones, mascotas, monturas y cientos de objetos por mejorar.
• La misma cuenta y el mismo personaje en iPhone y en PC.
• Entra en segundos con tu cuenta de Apple.

La primera vez el juego descarga los datos del mundo (alrededor de 1,5 GB); se recomienda usar wifi.

Soporte: https://mudarkworld.com

name: Muratore
description:
Muratore is a simple way to look for something to buy at stores near you.

Type what you need, like a storage tote, a gallon of milk or a drill bit set, and tap Search. When a store has a match, Muratore shows the price, whether it's in stock, and whether you can pick it up nearby or have it shipped. Tap the item to open the item on the store's own website and buy it there.

Store results are rolling out as Muratore adds partner stores, so some searches may not show results yet.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Search by typing what you need
- Set your location with GPS, or type a ZIP code or city. Muratore uses it only to find stores near you and never stores it.
- Filter results by pickup or shipping, and by store
- Mark how you like to pay, such as Apple Pay or PayPal
- Choose from three text sizes. Muratore also follows your iPhone's text size
- Sign in with Apple, Google or X to keep your searches and preferences. Signing in is optional, and every screen works without it
- Delete your account at any time in Settings

HONEST BY DESIGN
- No checkout. Muratore never takes payment and never buys anything for you.
- Stores Muratore isn't partnered with are clearly marked "Not a partner store".
- Prices and stock come from each store and can change, so check them on the store's site.
- Links to partner stores may include an affiliate code that earns Muratore a fee at no extra cost to you.

Muratore is available in the United States.

name: Murex - Life
description:
Murex — a little care, every year.
Remember birthdays, plan thoughtful celebrations, and keep the moments that matter with words and photos.
• Birthday countdowns and reminders
• Planning checklists and gift tracking
• Photo journaling and English voice input
• Memories by year and reusable checklists
• Keepsake cards to save and share
No account required. Records stay on your device. English interface; Gregorian calendar dates.

name: Muslim Kids World: Learn
description:
Ten warm, joyful minutes a day to help your children grow in faith, good manners and confidence, in both Arabic and English.

Muslim Kids World is a gentle daily routine for Muslim families with children aged 4 to 16. Each day brings a bite-size bilingual lesson guided by three friendly hosts, Adam, Maryam and Noor, who make learning feel like time with good friends.

A 30-DAY JOURNEY YOUR FAMILY WILL LOVE
Follow a colourful Journey map of 30 lessons. Each completed day earns golden stars and a checkmark when the role-play is watched, so children see their progress grow and parents know exactly where they are.

ONE ARABIC PHRASE A DAY
Learn a beautiful phrase each day, such as Bismillah or Sabrun jamil, with clear transliteration and meaning. A playful phrase matching game helps the words stick and turns review into fun.

SHORT VIDEOS AND HOST ROLE-PLAYS
Short animated lessons and role-play conversations in Arabic and English show good character in everyday moments. Children hear both languages side by side and learn how to bring Islamic values into real life.

FOUR MEANINGFUL THEMES
Lessons cover Islamic manners and ethics, inspiring stories, practical life skills and staying safe. Stories are told respectfully, and no prophets are ever depicted or voiced.

THE RIGHT LEVEL FOR EVERY CHILD
Choose from three age tiers, 4-7, 8-12 and 13-16, so siblings, homeschool groups and classes each get content that fits their age and understanding.

STUDIO FOR PARENTS AND TEACHERS
Print ready bilingual scripts as PDFs for family time, classrooms or weekend school. With Pro, create AI-written scripts on any topic you choose.

MADE FOR PARENTS, WITH CARE
A daily star tracker and a gentle reflection log help you talk with your children about what they learned. A parental gate keeps settings and purchases in grown-up hands.

MUSLIM KIDS WORLD PRO
Upgrade to Pro, available as a monthly or yearly subscription, to unlock all 30 days, every age tier, unlimited PDFs and AI scripts. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.

Start your family's 30-day Journey today and make ten minutes a day a beautiful habit, in sha Allah.

Terms of Use: https://muslim-kids-world-backend.rork.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://muslim-kids-world-backend.rork.app/privacy

name: MVK Inside
description:
MVK Inside bringt Q-Shot auf iPhone und iPad. Die App der Metallveredlung Kotsch GmbH ist für den eigenen Betrieb gemacht und läuft nur im Firmennetz.

ARTIKEL FINDEN
Suche über Artikelnummer, Bezeichnung oder Zeichnungsnummer, zusätzlich nach Kunde. Die Suche startet von selbst beim Tippen. Artikelnummern lassen sich auch als QR-Code vom Laufzettel scannen.

BILDER AUFNEHMEN UND BEARBEITEN
Foto mit der Kamera aufnehmen oder ein vorhandenes Bild laden. Die Arbeitskopie lässt sich drehen, zuschneiden, mit Messpunkt-Pfeilen versehen und beschriften — Farbe, Größe und Drehung frei wählbar. Jeder Schritt lässt sich einzeln zurücknehmen; das Original auf der Ablage bleibt davon unberührt.

AUF DIE BILDPLÄTZE LEGEN
Jeder Artikel hat feste Bildplätze für Artikel-, Behängungs- und Fehlerbilder. Belegte Plätze werden nie still überschrieben: Die App fragt nach und nennt beim Namen, was ersetzt wird. Die letzte Änderung lässt sich rückgängig machen.

AUF DEM IPAD
Zwei Spalten wie am Windows-Arbeitsplatz: links Suche und Bearbeitung, rechts das Raster der Bildplätze. Auf dem iPhone untereinander.

IMMER SICHTBAR: DER NETZZUSTAND
Ein Band über allen Bereichen zeigt, ob die App im MVK-Netz ist und ob die Bildablage steht. Wer außerhalb des Netzes fotografiert, arbeitet umsonst — deshalb steht das oben und nicht erst in einer Fehlermeldung.

ZUGANG
Die App wird mit einem Betriebskennwort geöffnet, das die Verwaltung herausgibt. Danach bleibt das Gerät angemeldet.

PRIVATSPHÄRE
MVK Inside erfasst keine Daten und verfolgt niemanden. Die Bilder liegen auf der Freigabe im eigenen Firmennetz, sonst nirgends. Das Kennwort für die Bildablage liegt im Schlüsselbund des Geräts und verlässt es nur zur Anmeldung an der Freigabe.

name: My Horse World
description:
Behalte deinen Pferdealltag im Blick: Mit My Horse World legst du Pferde an, planst Reitplatzzeiten und Fütterungen und organisierst deine Stallaufgaben.

Deine Übersicht zeigt die nächsten Reiteinheiten, offene Fütterungen und Aufgaben. Plane einstündige Reitplatztermine mit Prüfung auf Überschneidungen und hake erledigte Fütterungen und Stalldienste ab. Deine lokalen Einträge werden auf deinem iPhone gespeichert.

Mit Ponky versorgst du zwischendurch dein virtuelles Pferd. Anschließend kannst du zur Planung zurückkehren. Auch der Spielstand bleibt auf deinem Gerät.

Im separaten Bereich Gemeinsamer Hof kannst du dich mit deinem Konto anmelden und deine freigegebenen Höfe ansehen. Die lokalen Einträge und der gemeinsame Hof sind getrennt; gemeinsame Änderungen und ein automatischer Datenabgleich sind in dieser iPhone-Fassung noch nicht enthalten.

name: My Own Tutor 6-12
description:
My Own Tutor 6-12 is a one-on-one AI teacher plus real lessons for middle and high school.

ASK MY TUTOR
Ask about homework, a lesson or an idea that isn't clicking. The tutor explains in proper terms, tries another way when you are stuck, and asks questions so you do the thinking. It sticks to schoolwork.

HOMEWORK HELP THAT TEACHES
Snap a photo or type the problem. Get the method, a worked example with different numbers, and a check of your own answer, including algebra, derivatives, integrals and limits. A parent decides by subject whether answers are ever shown.

LESSONS
238 lessons in English, math, science and social studies for grades 6-8, and 94 high-school math lessons from Algebra 1 through Geometry, Algebra 2, Precalculus and AB-level Calculus.

CHECK-UPS AND A PLAN
Find what you know, what is shaky and what to practice next, including gaps from earlier grades.

FLASHCARDS AND DRILLS
Turn notes or a study guide into flashcards with a photo. Spaced review brings back the ones you miss. Math drills with levels and timers.

FOR PARENTS
The AI tutor stays off until a parent turns it on. No accounts, no ads, no tracking. AI can make mistakes; any answer can be reported.

AP is a trademark registered by the College Board, which is not affiliated with, and does not endorse, this app. Published by Vilasi, Inc.

name: My Own Tutor K-5
description:
My Own Tutor K-5 gives your child a patient one-on-one teacher, with lessons for every subject from kindergarten through grade 5.

ASK MY TUTOR
An AI teacher that explains at your child's grade level, one small idea at a time, and asks questions so your child does the thinking. Ask about a lesson, a homework problem or anything from school. It sticks to schoolwork.

HOMEWORK HELP THAT TEACHES
Snap a photo or type the problem. Get the method, a worked example with different numbers, and a check of your child's own answer. You decide by subject whether answers are ever shown.

LESSONS
416 lessons in reading, math, science and social studies, K-5: explained, worked examples, practice with hints, then a check. Kindergarten through grade 2 explanations are read aloud by Dr. Robert Clinton.

CHECK-UPS AND A PLAN
A short check-up finds what your child knows and what to practice next, including gaps from earlier grades.

FLASHCARDS, SPELLING AND DRILLS
Turn homework, notes or a study guide into flashcards with a photo. Spaced review brings back missed cards. Spelling lists, math drills with levels, timers and a race against your best.

FOR PARENTS
The AI tutor stays off until you turn it on, behind a parent question. You see each question in the tutor log. No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Choose a Faith-based or Standard approach for lessons. AI can make mistakes; your child can report any answer.

Published by Vilasi, Inc.

name: MyCemro Pulse
description:
Quand on pratique plusieurs disciplines, la semaine devient vite un casse-tête. Yoga le lundi, natation le mercredi, vélo le samedi : chaque activité a ses horaires, ses règles, ses réservations et parfois son propre abonnement. À force de jongler avec tout ça, on passe plus de temps à organiser ses séances qu'à les vivre.

MyCemro Pulse s'attaque au problème à la racine. L'application réunit toutes vos activités en un seul endroit : choisir un cours, le réserver et le suivre ne vous oblige plus à changer d'outil à chaque étape. Elle s'adresse à celles et ceux qui pratiquent plusieurs disciplines et veulent voir leur semaine comme un tout cohérent.

Tout commence par un catalogue d'activités. Parcourez les disciplines proposées à votre rythme, sans savoir à l'avance ce que vous cherchez. Le catalogue vous permet aussi bien de découvrir une nouvelle pratique que de retrouver celle que vous suivez déjà, et de comparer les propositions avant de faire votre choix.

Un cours vous tente ? Réservez-le, et il rejoint aussitôt votre planning de la semaine. Ce planning est bien plus qu'une simple liste : il vous offre une vue d'ensemble des jours à venir et vous montre d'un coup d'œil comment vos séances se répartissent entre les disciplines. Un équilibre qu'on ne remarque d'habitude que lorsqu'il est déjà rompu.

Le second pilier de l'application tient en une idée simple : un seul pass. Fini la multiplication des accès et des formules selon les disciplines : MyCemro Pulse vous propose un pass unique qui couvre toutes les activités du catalogue. Vous le suivez directement dans l'app, au même endroit que vos réservations, sans avoir à reconstituer votre situation à partir de plusieurs sources.

Cette approche est idéale pour celles et ceux qui enchaînent différents types de cours dans la même semaine, qu'ils soient sportifs réguliers ou simplement amateurs de variété. La question n'est plus de savoir où se trouve chaque réservation, mais de choisir la séance qui viendra compléter la semaine.

MyCemro Pulse ne prétend pas changer vos habitudes à votre place. L'app s'efface devant l'essentiel en réduisant toute l'organisation qui se glisse entre vous et vos séances.

name: MyLilMatrix
description:
One purchase. Every feature, yours to keep. No subscriptions, ads, or in-app purchases.

MyLilMatrix helps you see what needs your attention. Sort tasks into four quadrants by importance and urgency, then take things one step at a time.

For busy days, scattered thoughts, or trouble staying focused, a clear list can make a little room.

- Keep everyday tasks and bigger projects on separate boards.
- Break tasks into subtasks, with notes and pictures close by.
- Set recurring tasks and optional reminders.
- Keep your priorities in view with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.
- Edit loaded boards offline. Changes sync when you reconnect; conflicting edits ask you what to keep.
- Use your boards on the web too, included with your app purchase.

Sign in with Apple to keep your boards across devices. Reminder changes made offline take effect after they sync.

name: MySkylink
description:
MySkylink puts your Skylink broadband, TV and OTT connection in your pocket.

• See your plan, speed, data and renewal date at a glance
• Pay bills and recharge in a few taps
• Compare plans and upgrade, or build your own Broadband + TV + OTT bundle
• Run a speed test and check your network
• Check if Skylink fiber reaches your address on the coverage map
• Get help 24×7: call support right from the app, chat live, raise a ticket or ask Skylink AI
• Refer friends and earn wallet credit
• Get alerts for bills, renewals and outages

Available in English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam and Kannada.

name: MyTurn Pro Barber
description:
MyTurn Pro is the app for barbers who work at barbershops that use MyTurn.

Your barbershop invites you, you sign in, and your day is in one place.

YOUR LIVE QUEUE
See the clients waiting for you and for "anyone available" in real time. Swipe to start a cut and swipe to finish it. Call the next client, skip, or mark a no-show. Add a walk-in client yourself with "Add guest".

APPOINTMENTS
See today's appointments and who already arrived. Start and finish appointments the same way as walk-ins.

GO ONLINE
Turn yourself available with one switch. If your barbershop uses check-in, the app confirms you are at the shop with your location only at that moment. Your location is not stored.

NOTIFICATIONS
Get a notification when a client joins your line or books with you.

YOUR PROFILE
Your photo, title and bio are what clients see. Track your level, your rating and your cuts.

HISTORY AND STATS
Review your cuts by day, week and month.

THANK-YOU MESSAGE
When you finish a cut and the client does not have the MyTurn app, you can send a thank-you text from your own phone's messaging app. MyTurn never sends texts on its own.

TIPS AND DIRECT PAYMENTS
Add your Cash App, Venmo or Zelle so clients can tip or pay you directly in those apps. MyTurn does not process these payments.

SETTINGS
Language (English or Spanish), alert sound, permissions, privacy policy, and "Delete my account".

MyTurn Pro requires an account created by a barbershop that uses MyTurn. Barbershop owners manage their shop at myturnapp.app.

name: Nanopic
description:
Nanopic is a paint app that lets you draw in PSD and bring your drawings to life. It runs on Mac and iPad.

Layers and folders are saved as standard PSD files, so you can move your work back and forth with other painting apps.

DRAW
• Brushes including G-Pen, Mapping Pen, Pencil, Airbrush, Blender, Smudge and Liquify
• Pressure taper, stabilization and detailed settings for each brush
• Fill with gap closing and reference layers, plus Lasso Fill
• Rectangle, ellipse, lasso and Magic Wand selections; move and transform

LAYERS
• Layers and folders with opacity, blend modes and clipping
• Switch folders show one layer at a time, perfect for swapping expressions

ANIMATE
• Frame-by-frame animation on a timeline
• Rigs: deform and move your drawing with deformers and parameters
• Auto Motion adds breathing, swaying or floating with one command
• 3D Head Turn turns a face (or any folder) left, right, up and down
• Export to MP4 video or GIF

EXPORT
• Set the area and size once, then press Option-Cmd-E to export PNG or JPEG with the same settings

IPAD
• Apple Pencil pressure and prediction
• Documents live in the Nanopic folder on your iPad and in iCloud Drive

FILES
• Saved as PSD; app-specific information goes into a small file with the same name (.nanopic)
• No account, no network access, no data collection
• Available in English and Japanese

name: Nature ID: Plant & Animal ID
description:
Nature ID identifies plants, trees, flowers, birds, insects and animals in seconds, right down to the exact species.

Point your camera at something living and watch it light up. Nature ID finds the subject in your photo, outlines it with a glowing phosphorescent highlight and tells you exactly what it is, together with its scientific name.

UNLOCK ONCE, USE FOREVER
Nature ID is not a subscription. Most identification apps charge you every week or every month, forever. With Nature ID you try every feature free for 7 days, then unlock the full app with a single one time payment and keep it for life. No recurring charges, no renewals, no surprises.

KEY FEATURES
• Exact species: recognizes over 120,000 species of plants, trees, flowers, birds, mammals, insects, reptiles, amphibians, fish and fungi.
• Glowing highlight: see precisely which subject was identified, outlined in phosphorescent green.
• Private by design: identification runs entirely on your device. Your photos are never uploaded.
• Works offline: identify nature on a hike, deep in the forest or abroad, with no connection needed.
• Apple Intelligence: read descriptions and interesting facts on supported devices.
• Other possibilities: compare similar species and choose the best match.
• Search the web: learn more about any discovery with one tap, using the private search engine DuckDuckGo.
• Nature journal: every discovery is saved with its photo, ready to search, filter and mark as a favorite.

PERFECT FOR
Gardeners, hikers, birdwatchers, families, students, teachers and anyone curious about the living world around them.

Try Nature ID free for 7 days. Love it? Unlock it once and it is yours forever.

name: naughty-md
description:
naughty-md is a quiet place to read Markdown. Open a .md file and it fills the screen with clean, comfortable type. No toolbars, no clutter, and no editing to worry about.

OPEN FILES FROM ANYWHERE
Open Markdown from the Files app, iCloud Drive, Mail attachments, Safari downloads or any app's share sheet. naughty-md reads your actual file in place rather than making a copy, and it never changes it.

BEAUTIFUL, READABLE TYPE
A serif reading face (or sans-serif, if you prefer), generous spacing and a warm page that looks right in light and dark mode. Code blocks get syntax highlighting with a language label. Tables scroll sideways on their own, and task lists, block quotes, footnotes and links all look the way they should.

PINCH TO RESIZE THE TEXT
Spread two fingers to make the text bigger, or pinch to make it smaller. Instead of zooming into a corner of the page, the text grows and re-wraps to fit your screen, so there's never any sideways scrolling. Each file remembers its own text size.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Close a file at any point. Next time you open it, naughty-md goes straight back to the same paragraph, even if you've rotated your iPad or changed the text size since.

NOTHING ON SCREEN BUT YOUR DOCUMENT
A single, faint menu button in the corner shows which file you're reading, opens another one from Files, switches between serif and sans-serif type, and leads to a short help page.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no tracking, no ads, and no internet connection needed. naughty-md keeps a small list of the files you've opened, with your place and text size in each, on your device only.

Supports headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, links, ordered and unordered lists, task lists, block quotes, tables, footnotes, horizontal rules, web images and fenced code blocks. Works on iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape, and in Split View.

name: Navatom
seller_name: HIVE BILISIM VE YAZILIM ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
Navatom is the ship management software that runs in real time. Planned maintenance, crew, procurement, HSEQ, safety and documentation work together on one cloud platform, and ship and shore always work on the same live data. The Navatom app puts that platform in your pocket, on board and ashore.

ONE PLATFORM. EVERY MODULE YOUR FLEET NEEDS.
More than 40 deeply integrated modules on one data layer:
• Technical management: Planned Maintenance System, Drydock
• Inventory management: Inventory, Material, Procurement
• Operation: Voyage, Logbooks, Consumption and Waste
• Documentation: Manuals, Circulars, Certificates, Forms
• Safety: Masters' Reviews, Safety Meetings, Drills, Training, Risk Assessments
• Issues: Deficiencies, Non-Conformities, Accidents, Near Misses, Technical Findings
• Assessment: Audits, Inspections and Visits, Vettings, Findings, Evaluation and Feedback
• Human resources: Crew Manager, Work and Rest Hours, Payroll, Crew Planning
• Business intelligence: Dashboard, Analytics, KPIs

SHIP AND SHORE ON THE SAME LIVE DATA
Every change reaches everyone who needs it the moment it is made. No more separate systems, separate data and separate problems: one platform, one data layer, complete visibility.

KEEPS WORKING AT SEA
Navatom is built for satellite links. With Continuum, the ship keeps working when the connection drops: changes made at sea wait safely on the device and sync on their own when the link returns.

NAVATOM AI, NATIVE ACROSS THE PLATFORM
Ask your fleet anything in plain language. Navatom AI answers from your own live crew, maintenance, procurement and HSEQ data, grounded in your manuals, circulars and maritime regulations, and every answer cites its source. It only sees what you are allowed to see, and your data is never used to train AI models.

CHAT AND VIDEO CALLS
Ship and office in one conversation: channels, direct messages, threads, photos and files, and voice and video calls, with push notifications so nothing urgent waits.

NEWSFEED AND SEARCH
See what changed across your fleet the moment it happens, and find any record on any vessel from one search box.

BUILT FOR MARITIME COMPLIANCE
ISM Code, TMSA, SIRE 2.0, MLC and STCW rest hours, EU MRV, IMO DCS, CII and EEXI, FuelEU Maritime and EU ETS: compliance is built into the modules your people already use, so your fleet stays compliant by default.

FOR EVERYONE IN YOUR FLEET
Crew report, log and read on their phones. Masters and officers keep the ship's records moving. Superintendents run audits and inspections on board. The office sees the whole fleet, one ship or all of them, on one screen.

TRUSTED SINCE 2015
• More than 10 years running real fleets
• 99.5% platform uptime
• Encrypted connections and storage, hosted in the EU, with a separate database for every customer
• From a single vessel to large fleets, across 57 vessel types from tankers and container ships to tugs and yachts
• Permissions per vessel, module and action; seafarers see only the vessel they are assigned to, with rights that follow their rank
• 20 languages, light and dark mode

Sign in with the Navatom account your company gives you. New to Navatom? Visit navatom.com to see the whole platform. Need help? Write to support@navatom.com.

name: NerDesk: Canlı Destek
description:
NerDesk, işletmenizin web sitesine eklediği canlı destek penceresinin temsilci uygulamasıdır. Ziyaretçileriniz sitenizde yazdığı anda sohbet iPhone'unuza ya da iPad'inize gelir; masa başında olmasanız da müşterilerinizi bekletmezsiniz.

ANINDA YANIT
• Yeni sohbet istekleri ve mesajlar gerçek zamanlı gelir; ziyaretçi yazarken ne yazdığını canlı görürsünüz.
• Tek dokunuşla sohbeti kabul edin, görsel gönderin, sohbeti sonlandırın.
• Okundu bilgisi, gün ayraçları ve gönderilemeyen mesajı yeniden deneme.

BİLDİRİMLER TAM KONTROLÜNÜZDE
• Yeni canlı destek talebi, yeni mesaj, sohbet yanıtlandı, sohbet bitti, kaçırılan sohbet, puanlama, çevrimdışı mesaj, siteye ziyaretçi girdi / çıktı.

EKİP İÇİN GÜÇLÜ ARAÇLAR

ZİYARETÇİLERİNİZİ TANIYIN
• Sitenizde o an gezen ziyaretçileri canlı izleyin, onlara sohbet başlatın.

İSTATİSTİKLER
• Günlük sohbet, yanıtlanan / kaçırılan, ortalama ilk yanıt süresi, puan, en yoğun saatler, ülke ve cihaz dağılımı.

iPAD İÇİN TASARLANDI

GÜVENLİ

• İki adımlı doğrulama (doğrulayıcı uygulama, WhatsApp, e-posta, yedek kod).
• Reklam ve izleme yoktur. Hesabınızı uygulamadan silebilirsiniz.

NerDesk web paneliyle aynı hesabı ve aynı veriyi kullanır: telefonda yanıtladığınız sohbet panelde, panelde yanıtladığınız sohbet telefonda anında görünür.

name: Nest Fit
description:
NEST FIT — SNAKE HOME is a grid puzzle game with gravity. This is not a snake that chases food: here you have to THINK before you crawl.

The rule fits in one line: eat every dish on the map, then fit your whole snake body PERFECTLY into the nest that is already shaped for it. One segment too few or too many and the level is not cleared.

■ GRAVITY IS THE REAL OPPONENT
With nothing to hold on to, the snake falls. Fall onto thorns and you die. Fall off the edge and you die too. Every move needs a plan for where your body can still hold on.

■ 16 DISHES — EACH ONE GROWS A SEGMENT WITH ITS OWN POWER
The segment you just grew carries the power of the dish you ate, and it stays on your body until the end of the level:
• Apple: +1 segment · Mango: +2 · Lemon: drops the tail
• Hot chili melts nearby ice · Ice cream freezes water
• Sticky rice clings to the ceiling · Bubble floats up · Heavy pebble breaks planks
• Popcorn blasts loose rock · Fish swims across rivers · Watermelon bounces up to the ceiling
• Firefly lights up the night · Magnet pulls wooden blocks · Iron ball smashes through thorns
• Stone ball cannot turn corners · Swap fruit trades head and tail

■ 9 CHAPTERS × 11 LEVELS = 99 LEVELS, DIFFICULTY RISES STEP BY STEP
Paddy Edge · Fence · Well · Bakehouse · Quarry · High Sky · Deep River · Moonlit Night · Hive.
Each chapter opens a new mechanic and mixes it with the old ones. The minimum number of moves for EVERY level comes from a real solver; no level has a hidden shortcut.

■ SNAKE ART — 99 MORE LEVELS
A second mode with its own 9 chapters of picture puzzles.

■ NEST FIT'S OWN MECHANICS
• Molting: leave your old skin behind as a solid block and climb on it
• Portals: the head enters one end and comes out the other, the body follows segment by segment
• Darkness: you only see around fireflies, the snake's head and the nest
• Two snakes in one level: switch between them, one becomes a step for the other — if one dies, you lose

■ HOW TO PLAY
Swipe or tap the four arrow buttons. Unlimited undo — experiment freely. Clear a level in the minimum number of moves for a GOLD STAR, or clear it normally for a bronze star.

■ DRESS UP YOUR SNAKE
10 hand-painted East Asian mythical heads — Thunder Gold Dragon, Jade Qilin, Black Tortoise, Fire Phoenix, White Tiger, Roaring Lion, River Dragon, Bai Ze, Pixiu, Dragon Horse — and 10 body colors. Buy them with coins earned in the game.

■ GOOD TO KNOW
• An internet connection is required to start a level
• The game contains ads. Rewarded videos only play when you tap to watch
• Each play costs one life; when you run out, watch an ad or use coins
• Single player, no account or login needed

name: Nestoria – Gestion locative
description:
Nestoria est le logiciel de gestion tout-en-un des propriétaires, hôtes et conciergeries en location courte durée. Calendriers synchronisés, accueil des voyageurs, check-in et fiche de police en ligne, états des lieux, ménage, factures et dossiers de litige : tout est réuni dans une seule appli, pour Airbnb, Booking, Abritel et vos réservations en direct.

Une alternative simple aux channel managers pour les hôtes et conciergeries qui veulent tout gérer depuis leur téléphone.

LE CALENDRIER
• Vos calendriers Airbnb, Booking et Abritel synchronisés par liens iCal, pour éviter les doubles réservations
• Toutes vos réservations et vos voyageurs au même endroit, logement par logement
• Le parcours de chaque voyageur suivi étape par étape

LE LIVRET D'ACCUEIL
• Un livret clair, ouvert d'un simple QR code ou d'un lien, sans appli à installer pour le voyageur
• Traduit automatiquement dans sa langue
• Wi-Fi, arrivée, règles de la maison, bonnes adresses, consignes de départ
• Nestor, l'assistant, répond aux questions des voyageurs 24 h/24 à partir de vos informations

L'ARRIVÉE DES VOYAGEURS
• Enregistrement en ligne avant l'arrivée, avec fiche de police pour les voyageurs étrangers
• Vérification d'identité et contrat signé si vous le souhaitez
• Code d'accès envoyé seulement une fois l'enregistrement fait
• Compatible avec les serrures connectées

LA PROTECTION DE VOTRE LOGEMENT
• États des lieux photo datés à l'arrivée et au départ
• Inventaire des équipements relié à vos factures
• Dossier prêt à envoyer en cas de dégât : photos, factures, chronologie et PDF

LE MÉNAGE

• Checklist, photos à prendre et liste de courses
• Vous suivez tout depuis votre téléphone

ET AUSSI

• Aide à la déclaration fiscale de vos revenus locatifs
• Notifications pour ne rien manquer

Une offre gratuite permet de commencer avec un logement, sans carte bancaire. Les offres complètes s'activent sur nestoriapp.com.

Une question ? Notre équipe basée en France vous répond 7 j/7 : bonjour@nestoriapp.com

name: NexCRM

NexCRM puts your sales desk in your pocket. It is the official mobile app
for NexCRM, the CRM built for service businesses, digital agencies
and real estate teams.

Sign in with your workspace account and pick up exactly where the website
left off — the same leads, the same pipeline, the same follow-ups.

WORK YOUR LEADS
• Every lead with its stage, score, owner and full history
• Add a lead in seconds, from the field or the showroom
• Your workspace's own custom fields, exactly as your admin set them up
• Search and filter by stage, owner, source or date

NEVER LOSE A FOLLOW-UP
• Today's callbacks and everything overdue, on one screen
• Reschedule with a tap, and book the next step while you are still on the call
• Reminders so nothing slips

CALL FROM YOUR OWN SIM
• Dial a lead straight from their record
• Save the outcome the moment you hang up
• Calls sync from your phone's log, so nothing goes unrecorded
• Work a queue back to back with the dialer

AI CALL SUMMARIES
• Recorded calls transcribed and summarised for you
• The headline, the budget, what you promised, how interested they sounded
• The next move suggested, and booked in one tap
(Available when your workspace has AI summaries switched on.)

WHATSAPP, INSIDE THE CRM
• The lead's full WhatsApp thread, sent from your workspace's number
• Approved templates once the 24-hour reply window has closed
• Every message on the lead's timeline for the whole team to see

DEALS, QUOTATIONS AND INVOICES
• Move deals through your own pipeline stages
• Write a GST quotation or invoice on the spot
• Record payments and watch the balance come down

PROPERTIES AND SITE VISITS
• Your inventory in your pocket
• Match a buyer to what actually suits them
• Book and run site visits
(Real estate workspaces.)

YOUR NUMBERS
• Calls dialled, connected, talk time and conversions
• Your targets, and where you stand against them

BUILT FOR TEAMS
• Your role decides what you see, set by your administrator on the web
• Read-only users see no edit buttons at all
• Every signed-in device listed, and revocable if a phone goes missing

ACCOUNT REQUIRED
NexCRM is a companion app for an existing NexCRM workspace. Accounts are
created by your workspace administrator at nexcrm.solutions — you cannot
sign up inside the app.

PERMISSIONS, AND WHY WE ASK
• Phone and call log — to place a call from a lead's record and log it
  against that lead automatically, so your team's history stays complete.
• Notifications — reminders for callbacks and tasks due.
• Display over other apps — to show the outcome form the moment a call ends.
Decline any of them and the app keeps working; you just log those calls by hand.

name: Nexus Chess: Хүүхдийн шатар

Nexus Chess teaches chess to children aged 5 to 12, fully in Mongolian.

—

name: NEXUS JLPT – Монголоор бэлд
description:
NEXUS JLPT бол Япон хэлний түвшин тогтоох шалгалт (JLPT)-д монгол хэлээр бэлдэх апп юм. N5-аас N1 хүртэлх бүх түвшний үг, ханз, дүрмийг монгол тайлбар, галигтай нь нэг дороос сур.

АЯЛЛЫН ЗАМААР СУР
• Хичээл бүр богино шат. Шатаа давж од цуглуул, тамга даруул.
• Тосгон, хулсан төгөл, Фүжи уул, далайн эрэг, цайз гэсэн таван бүсээр аялна.
• Сонгох, тааруулах, сонсож таних дасгалууд. Тоглож байгаа мэт тогтооно.

МОНГОЛ ТАЙЛБАР, ГАЛИГ
• 8,000 гаруй үг: уншлага, монгол утга, жишээ өгүүлбэр.
• 2,200 гаруй ханз: он, кун уншлага, зурлагын дараалал, тухайн ханзтай үгс.
• 500 дүрмийн хэлбэр: монгол тайлбар, жишээ.
• Хирагана, катаканагийн хүснэгт.
• Япон үг бүр кирилл галигтай тул эхлэн суралцагчид амар.

УХААЛАГ ДАВТАЛТ
• Сурсан зүйлээ мартахын өмнөхөн давтуулна.
• Өдөр бүр хэдхэн минут. Өдөр бүрийн сануулга тавьж болно.

ЦАГТАЙ ЖИШИГ ШАЛГАЛТ

• Жинхэнэ шалгалттай адил хэсэг, цагтай: үсэг ба үгийн сан, дүрэм ба уншлага, сонсгол.

ЯРИХ ДАДЛАГА
• Япон өгүүлбэрийг чанга уншиж, дуудлагаа шалгана.

ШАЛГАЛТЫН ӨДРӨӨ ТОВЛО
• Шалгалт өгөх өдрөө оруулбал хэдэн өдөр үлдсэнийг нүүр хуудаснаас харна.

N5-ын эхний хэсэг бүх хэрэглэгчид нээлттэй. Бусад агуулга Pro эрхтэй бүртгэлд нээгдэнэ.

Анхаар: «JLPT» нь Japan Foundation болон Japan Educational Exchanges and Services (JEES)-ийн зохион байгуулдаг шалгалт. NEXUS JLPT нь албан ёсны бус, бие даасан бэлтгэлийн хэрэгсэл бөгөөд жишиг шалгалтын асуултууд нь манай багийн зохиосон асуултууд юм.
