name: Night Haul - Cliff Basket
description:
Night Haul is a portrait card game for one person on iPhone. The deck is fifty-two rope cards. Hearts are hemp, spades are steel, diamonds are wood, and clubs are knot. The rank printed on the face is the load that span can carry.

The valley opens with three spans, two towers, and one basket already on the line. Tap NIGHT HAUL. Hook a card onto a span, then tap while the needle sits in the green bite. A miss adds one step of tension and the basket stays put. Two snaps drop the basket and close the night. Wind, rain, and storm arrive as the beats pass. Thirty sacks inside one hundred fifty beats finish the shift, and any extra sacks remain on the result.

ROPE RESCUE is a shorter table. A break is hanging a load. Splice cards across the gap, brace one when the hold is short, and winch two of the three breaks back up. A fall or an empty beat count ends that rescue.

LOWERING is another short table. Three loads leave the ridge. Ease lets the basket drop, brake slows it, and swap pad changes the worn shoe. A crash, a pad worn through, or beats running out ends that lowering.

The rope store, the shift log, and the almanac stay on this iPhone. A shift can be played with the network off. The valley has no account to sign in to, no place to post a night, and no price on a card. Words on screen follow the language chosen on the iPhone. In settings, reduce motion holds the needle and the dust still, the bite hint thickens the edge of the window, and show slack prints the spare load on the sample card.

name: Ninja Water Sort
description:
Ninja Water Sort is a water sort puzzle and color sort game set in the shrines of feudal Japan. Walk three hundred rites through ten painted shrines, pour three new ways at the Poisoner's Table, the Spigot Casks and the Hourglass Tube, then enter the Shadow Shrine and descend into Endless. And now the liquids themselves come alive.

The cups wait on the poisoner's lacquer table. The casks sleep in the cellar. Below the shrines, a black torii stands in a moonlit cedar forest, and the stair beneath it has no bottom. Eight sacred liquids have run together, and only a master's pour can part them again.

TEN SHRINES, THREE HUNDRED RITES
• The classic water sort campaign: ten painted shrines, thirty rites in each, every fifth rite a Trial worth double koban.
• New rules in every shrine: frozen vessels that thaw, corked vessels, veiled layers, twin vessels bound by a red cord, vessels of many sizes.
• One star for any solve, two without help, three for the Master's Path.
• Eight elements, each with its own color, pattern and kanji sign for color-blind players, and eight spirits to call onto your scrolls.
• Today's Offering: a new water sort rite every day, with its own rule for each weekday.

THREE NEW WAYS TO POUR
• The Poisoner's Table: every cup carries a paper tag. Pour only the layer its order asks for next.
• Spigot Casks: sake casks pour from the tap at their base, so every cask is a queue.
• The Hourglass Tube: tap its knot and its layers reverse, and the buried layer comes up ready to pour.
• Thirty levels each, an illustrated How to Play for every mode, and a mastery seal for every act you three-star.

THE SHADOW SHRINE
• 150 harder rites in five halls, opened by the Gate of Heaven or by mastering all three modes.
• Hidden liquids: only a shrouded tube's top shows. Pour it away to see the next.
• Frozen tubes, and lids that lift only when their key liquid is sealed.
• Six new shadow liquids, up to fourteen on one board: Blood Moon, Sakura Dew, Sun Gold and more.
• Every hidden rite can be won without a guess, and each hall teaches its idea in pictures.

ENDLESS
• New levels, ever deeper: more liquids as you descend, with hidden liquids, ice and lids mixed in.
• A new climb every week, the same for every player, and your deepest depth is kept.

LIQUIDS THAT COME ALIVE
• Nine living liquid looks that move inside every vessel, never still.
• Living Ink blooms and curls, molten gold runs through Living Kintsugi, and in Living Yurei Mist a drowned face drifts by.
• Also Living Gold Leaf, Starlight, Sakura, Quicksilver, Dragon Scale and River of Heaven.

40 PAINTED SHRINE LOOKS
• Violet Dusk, Moonlit, Sakura and Ember Glow each repaint all ten shrines.
• Fourteen vessel sets, from Red Lacquer to Ember Forge split by white-hot lava.
• Legendary works: the Ryujin Reliquary held by two sea dragons, the Gashadokuro Reliquary of a starving giant's bones, River of Heaven and Yurei Mist.
• Still liquid looks and pour effects: ink wash, gold leaf, sakura petals, dragon scales, ember sparks, spirit mist.

THE SHRINE TREASURY
• Koban earned in every mode buys every look, and your rank never falls when you spend.
• Every look can also be bought outright. The Legendary Four gathers the four legendary works, The Whole Treasury every vessel set, still liquid look, shrine light and pour effect, and the Welcome pack lets you pick one Epic vessel set and one Epic liquid.
• Patron of the Shrines: thirty-six wallpapers and your thanks in the credits. Hint pouches for the hardest levels.

THE MASTER'S TOOLS
• Undo, a spare vessel and a restart on every level. Ask the master and the next winning pour is shown.
• Play on a phone or a tablet, upright or turned.

FOR ADULTS
A calm, beautiful water puzzle with a dark edge: a poisoner's table, sake cellars, vessels of bones and demon urns, liquids that carry ghosts. Nothing jumps out at you.

The water is blessed. Make the first pour.

name: Ninniyle Uykuya
description:
Ninniyle Uykuya, bebeğinizi tatlı bir uykuya hazırlamak için özenle hazırlanmış Türkçe ninnileri tek bir uygulamada toplar.

NİNNİLER
• 9 albümde 59 ninni: Annemin Ninnileri, Babamın Ninnileri, Masalsı Ninniler ve daha fazlası
• Anne ve baba sesinden ninniler
• Ekran kapalıyken ve kilit ekranında çalma
• Uyku zamanlayıcısı: 15, 30, 45 veya 60 dakika sonra kendiliğinden durur

BEBEĞİMİN EN SEVDİKLERİ
Bebeğinizin en sevdiği ninnileri tek dokunuşla kaydedin. Bu listeyi çaldığınızda yalnızca seçtiğiniz ninniler çalar.

PREMIUM
• Tüm ninnilere sınırsız erişim
• Çevrimdışı dinleme: ninnileri indirin, internetsiz çalın
• Uyku takibi: bebeğinizin yaşına göre önerilen uyku süreleri, günlük uyku kaydı ve uykudan 15 dakika önce hatırlatma

ÜCRETSİZ PLAN
Dilediğiniz 5 ninniyi seçip ücretsiz dinleyebilirsiniz.

ABONELİK BİLGİLERİ

Abonelik, dönem bitiminden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse otomatik olarak yenilenir. Aboneliğinizi App Store hesap ayarlarınızdan dilediğiniz zaman yönetebilir ve iptal edebilirsiniz.

name: Noctinaut Dream Interpretation
description:
Noctinaut is a dream journal you never lose, with lucid dreaming taken seriously.

TELL IT IN THE DARK
Wake from a dream, open Noctinaut from the Lock Screen, Control Center or the Action button, and speak. A black screen with no light to wake you, and your words written on your iPhone as you say them. Several dreams a night, each one kept for the morning.

COMPLETE IT IN THE MORNING
Give each dream its emotions, the people, places and things in it, how vivid it was and whether you knew you were dreaming. A minute is enough, and over the weeks your patterns appear: the signs that come back, the nights you remember, your lucid dreams.

TRAIN FOR LUCID DREAMS
• MILD and SSILD, guided by voice while you lie in bed (Pro).
• An alarm in the night to wake and go back to a dream (Pro).
• A sound cue played during sleep, after a short training in the evening (Pro).
• Dream goals, kept in view as you fall asleep (Pro).
• Reality check reminders through the day.

UNDERSTAND A DREAM (Pro)
When you ask, a reading of a dream's images and emotions, the signs that showed you were dreaming, and a question to take with you. Nothing is sent before you agree, and you can turn it off entirely.

YOUR NIGHTS IN VIEW
Statistics, and ranks that light up dream after dream. With Pro, a calendar of your nights and your streaks. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, Pro also makes a picture of a dream with Image Playground, on your iPhone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your journal stays on your iPhone and in your own iCloud, across your iPhones.
• An optional Face ID lock, which never makes you wait at night.
• Export everything at any time: PDF, text, CSV or JSON, with your recordings.
• Sounds to fall asleep, made on your iPhone.

The journal, voice capture, search, statistics, iCloud, export, reality checks and the sounds to fall asleep all work without Pro. Noctinaut Pro is a yearly subscription, with a trial week the first time, or a single purchase for life. The subscription renews each year unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Noir MC Esports
description:
Noir MC Esports es la app oficial del equipo de deportes electrónicos de Jaén.

RETOS SEMANALES
Completa retos de EA SPORTS FC y Valorant, suma puntos y enséñalos en el Discord del equipo. El reto «Gana al equipo» te lleva directo a la prueba.

AVISOS
Activa los avisos y la app te recuerda los retos nuevos cada domingo y los torneos del fin de semana.

COMPETICIONES
Consulta en qué torneos y ligas oficiales online compite el equipo.

FICHA DE JUGADOR CON BAREMO
Rellena tu ficha y recibe al momento una nota de 0 a 100 según tu nivel, tus victorias, tu disponibilidad, tu experiencia en torneos y si tienes Discord y micrófono. Con 60 o más, pasas a la prueba online.

INVITA A TUS AMIGOS
Comparte la app y forma parte de la comunidad de jugadores de Jaén.

Sin apuestas, sin compras y sin publicidad. Los menores de 18 años necesitan la autorización de sus padres para formar parte del equipo.

name: Nook: Daily Footprints
description:
Where did the week go? Nook quietly records the places you visit and how long you stay: home, the office, the gym, a neighborhood café. No check-ins, and no need to open the app. Leave your phone in your pocket, and let your days take shape on their own.

- Automatic recording: Logs arrivals and departures in the background, even when the app is closed
- Today: See where you are now, how long you’ve stayed, and your day as a timeline and map
- Review: Look back by week, month, or year with category totals, highlights, and trends versus your usual
- Places: Your regular spots on a map, with visit counts, weekly time, and usual hours for each place
- Simple edits: Fix a stay that is off, or add a missed one by hand
- Widget & sharing: Home Screen widget, share images, a monthly report, and a year poster
- No continuous GPS: Records from iOS arrival and departure events, not constant tracking
- Quiet & private: No account, no ads, no analytics. Your places and stays are stored on your iPhone

Free: automatic recording, Today, Places and the map, the widget, and this week and last week in Review.
Nook Pro: every earlier week, month and year, highlights and trends, weekly time and usual hours for each place, the monthly report and the year poster. Monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. The subscription renews every month until you cancel in the App Store.

Terms of Use https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy https://sites.google.com/appmakerz.ca/nook/home

name: Nookline: Shelf Post
description:
A little joy is waiting to find its way home.

Welcome to Nookline: Shelf Post, a cozy routing puzzle set inside a woodland post office. Help Milo, a tiny dormouse postkeeper, send tea, biscuits, lanterns, and other thoughtful gifts to the neighbors.

The shelves move. The hatches stay put. And every parcel has its own little order.

SLIDE A SHELF. FIND A ROUTE.
Move an entire shelf to line up its nooks with the shelf above or below. Lift a gift into an empty nook, borrow a corner, and bring it to the right delivery hatch. Gifts cannot simply slide sideways on their own, so a small change can open a lovely new path.

ONE SLIDE, TWO CONSEQUENCES
Every whole-shelf slide also switches the Route Dial between Leaf and Moon. Marked lanes open only in their matching phase. A move that lines up one gift may close the route for another. Read the symbols, plan the switch, and make the empty nooks work together.

PACK WITH A LITTLE FORESIGHT
The first gift sent for a clamped parcel locks its shelf in place. Gifts can still pass through, but that shelf cannot move again until the parcel is complete. Stage the next gifts before you start, or build a relay with the shelves that remain free.

EVERY PARCEL TELLS YOU WHAT COMES NEXT
Your neighbors need different gifts in a visible order. Deliver the next requested item, wrap up the parcel, and make room for the one that follows. Some deliveries open postmark gates and reveal new connections.

100 COZY ROUTING CHALLENGES
Travel through ten woodland chapters, from Acorn Counter to The Great Dispatch. Discover one-way lanes, shelves that move together, fragile gifts with two careful lifts, shared delivery hatches, and little plants that make every empty nook count. Each level has a fixed layout and a complete route to success.

TAKE YOUR TIME
There is no countdown. Think through each route within its move budget, undo freely, or explore an unlocked level in Practice without a move limit. Verified hints can help you find the next step.

LITTLE REASONS TO RETURN
Claim a Daily Gift, collect Postmarks, and choose a favorite shelf frame. Seven visits bring seven little joys, and missing a day never resets your visits. Collect chapter postcards as your deliveries reach more neighbors.

YOUR BEST ROUTES, CLOSE TO HOME
The local leaderboard keeps your best successful runs on this device. Compare your own scores, moves, and hints for each level. Practice runs stay separate, and there are no invented online competitors.

MADE FOR QUIET MOMENTS
Enjoy rounded cartoon artwork, soft original music, lively shelf motion, and gentle delivery feedback. Adjust sound, music, and haptics, turn on item labels, or reduce motion. Tap to select and place gifts, or drag them between aligned nooks.

No account. No ads. No in-app purchases. The complete campaign works offline. Opening the Privacy Policy or Terms of Use uses an internet connection. Progress and records are stored locally; the game does not provide developer-operated cloud synchronization.

Slide shelves. Send little joys.

name: North Pole Calling
description:
What if Santa called your child, by name, right before bedtime?

North Pole Calling lets you set up a phone call from Santa in a minute. Tell the app your child's name, a few things on their wish list and something good they did this year. Santa does the rest, in a warm, jolly voice.

A REAL CONVERSATION
Santa asks questions and waits while your child answers, then carries on. No talking over them.

MAKE IT THEIRS
• Pick the occasion: Christmas countdown, Christmas Eve or the Nice List
• Choose a quick, regular or long call
• Add a story: the elves, a reindeer race, a giant snowman, the toy workshop and more
• Mention a good deed, a pet, school or bedtime
• Shuffle for a fresh call every time

A SURPRISE THAT RINGS
Schedule the call for later. The phone rings with sleigh bells, even on the lock screen.

THE WISHLIST
Keep every wish your child tells Santa, sorted by kind of gift. Mark gifts as bought or wrapped, see how many are found, and tap age-based gift ideas to add them. Santa can mention the top wish on the next call.

FOR PARENTS
• Hear Santa for free before you start
• Your first call is free
• Replays are always free
• Call packs never expire and work for all your kids
• Purchases sit behind a grown-ups-only check
• Your child's name, wish list and call history stay on your phone
• The microphone only listens for when your child stops talking. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.

Santa's voice is made with AI.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: NotePulse: Synth
description:
NotePulse Synth is an interactive music creation studio that makes playing, composing, and exploring sound intuitive and engaging.

Whether you're discovering musical notes for the first time, experimenting with melodies, or creating layered musical arrangements, NotePulse Synth brings creative music tools together in one streamlined experience.

PLAY — YOUR INTERACTIVE KEYBOARD

Discover the joy of making music through a responsive virtual keyboard.

• Play notes using an interactive piano-style keyboard.
• Explore a variety of instrument sounds.
• Experiment with melodies, harmonies, and musical ideas.
• Enjoy responsive controls designed for an engaging playing experience.

CREATE — COMPOSE YOUR OWN MELODIES

Transform musical inspiration into compositions with an intuitive visual melody editor.

• Create melodies using a visual note grid.
• Arrange musical notes across multiple bars.
• Experiment with rhythm, timing, and note placement.
• Build and refine musical patterns at your own pace.

FOUR TRACK STUDIO — BRING SOUNDS TOGETHER

Take your musical ideas further by combining multiple tracks into layered arrangements.

• Create arrangements using four musical tracks.
• Combine sounds and melodies into compositions.
• Adjust tempo and experiment with playback.
• Explore how musical elements work together.

EXPLORE — LEARN THROUGH MUSIC

Discover musical concepts and get familiar with the app through guided instruction.

• Explore the features of NotePulse Synth.
• Learn about musical concepts and creative workflows.
• Follow organized topics and instructions.
• Develop confidence through hands-on experimentation.

SOUND AND CREATIVE EXPRESSION

Experiment with instrument sounds and audio controls to discover new possibilities for musical expression.

DESIGNED FOR IPHONE AND IPAD

NotePulse Synth features a modern interface designed for touch interaction, with responsive layouts that adapt to supported screen sizes.

Its midnight-blue design, carefully organized controls, and visual composition tools make it easy to focus on the music.

FOR EVERY MUSICAL JOURNEY

Whether you're a beginner learning the fundamentals, a music enthusiast exploring new sounds, or a creator developing musical ideas, NotePulse Synth offers an approachable environment for musical experimentation.

PLAY. CREATE. EXPLORE.

Bring your musical ideas to life with NotePulse Synth.

name: Nudge Ledger
description: Stop keeping follow-ups in your head. Nudge Ledger groups requests by check-in date and offers gentle, standard or urgent rhythms with editable, stage-aware wording. Log what happened, review response time and overdue items, and close with a useful outcome. Offline, bilingual and account-free.

name: NULVORA
description:
The shape you need to find is the space you leave behind.

NULVORA is a minimalist spatial puzzle about carving away matter to reveal an invisible form. Every level begins with a solid block. Your task is to remove exactly the right cells until the empty space matches three target shadows at once.

FRONT. SIDE. TOP.

Each view reveals only part of the answer. A cut that completes one shadow might disrupt another. To solve the puzzle, you must understand how a single three-dimensional void appears from three different directions.

CARVE WITH INTENTION

Choose a viewing direction and a depth layer, then tap individual cells to remove them. All three target panels react immediately. Icy cyan shows matched cells, faint outlines reveal what is missing, and copper highlights cuts that have gone too far.

Experiment, rethink and refine. Undo a move, reset a level or use a hint when you need a fresh perspective. The puzzle is complete only when all three shadows agree.

THREE WAYS TO THINK

Explore handcrafted puzzles across Discovery, Perspective and Precision. Start with compact 3 x 3 x 3 forms and advance to intricate 5 x 5 x 5 spaces. Some challenges limit the number of cuts, asking you to look beyond merely finding a solution and consider how efficiently you can reach it.

DESIGNED FOR FOCUSED PLAY

A three-lesson interactive tutorial introduces carving, depth and matching projections. Your progress, unlocked levels and best-cut records are saved locally. A restrained palette of charcoal, ivory and icy cyan gives every decision room to breathe, while ambient music and optional sounds and haptics shape the atmosphere.

No accounts. No ads. No purchases. No tracking. No internet connection required.

NULVORA asks a different kind of puzzle question: not what should you add, but what can you afford to remove?

Carve the void.

name: Nymvar: Fantasy Name Generator
description:
Weave names for characters, kingdoms, dragons and spells in Nymvar, an illustrated fantasy naming studio for writers, roleplayers and tabletop game masters.

Choose one of 16 original generators, set a tone and reveal a fresh batch on your device. Copy a result, favorite it, or save it in My Worlds. Add tags and notes, browse your history and export or merge a library backup.

Eight generators, an included world, favorites and basic export are free. A one-time Lifetime Premium purchase unlocks the other eight generators, deeper naming controls, larger batches, batch saving and additional worlds.

Name generation and your library work offline. Store purchases and restoration use your store account. The names and lore are fictional suggestions for your own stories.

name: NyzquorTeb
description: yzquorTeb is a personal stargazing notebook. Record observations with notes and optional photos, manage observing sites and gear rigs, plan and run night sessions, and track bucket lists and sky challenge packs. Moon phase and simple stats help you plan tonight from the Observatory tab. Everything is stored locally in Core Data. No login, no sync, and no telescopes or mounts are controlled by the app.

name: Offgrid Coder
description:
Offgrid Coder turns your iPad Pro into a private AI server for software development on your Mac. The language model runs directly on the iPad – your prompts and source code never leave your devices. Made for trains, planes and ships, for dead zones and for projects whose code must not go to a cloud.

Please note: the app's interface is currently in German.

HOW IT WORKS
• The iPad runs a quantized language model using Apple's MLX framework.
• Your Mac connects to the iPad with a USB-C cable and offers your developer tools an OpenAI-compatible interface on your own machine.
• On the Mac this is done by Offgrid Coder Companion for macOS. Download and help: zerfas.de/offgrid-coder/en
• A guide in the app walks you step by step through the setup with Visual Studio Code and the Continue extension.

RIGHT ON THE IPAD
• "Chats" area: conversations with the local model, answers appear word by word, code blocks come with a copy button.
• System prompt and temperature can be set per conversation.
• History stays in memory only. If you like, turn on "Verlauf speichern" (save history) – it is then stored encrypted on the iPad and excluded from backups.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
• No cloud, no account, no data collection, no tracking, no ads.
• No internet connection is needed during use – Offgrid Coder works in airplane mode.
• The connection to your Mac is encrypted and requires a one-time pairing code over the cable.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
• The server never starts on its own. You start and stop it deliberately.
• Stopping fully unloads the model.
• A resource guard watches memory, temperature and battery, checks before start-up whether the model fits your device, and pauses it before the iPad is overloaded.
• After a period of inactivity the server stops by itself.

MODELS
• Built-in catalog of open Qwen models from 0.6 to 9 billion parameters (Apache 2.0 license, roughly 0.4 to 6 GB). Nothing is downloaded unless you explicitly ask for it.
• Copy your own model folders in MLX format from your Mac to the iPad with Finder file sharing – no internet required.
• Every model file is verified with a SHA-256 checksum.
• Depending on model and device, up to 32,000 tokens of context and tool calls for agent mode.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The app stays in the foreground while serving; a power adapter is recommended.
• One request is handled at a time.
• Answers from a language model can be wrong. Review generated code before you use it.

REQUIREMENTS
• iPad Pro with an Apple M-series chip; developed and measured on the iPad Pro with M5. Large models need a lot of memory.
• For use with developer tools: a Mac with macOS 26 and Offgrid Coder Companion.
• Free storage for the model you choose.

name: OGCIHub
description: OGCIHub is a quiet place to write down the numbers behind your work. What something took, what you asked for it, what came back — one line at a time, in your own words, until the total is simply there. Finished work stays on the page: an amount, a note, a photo, a reminder of how it went. There is no account to make and nothing to connect; what you write stays on your device, and leaves only when you choose to export it. Think of it as a notebook that adds up, rather than an accounting system — it keeps what you tell it, and works nothing out behind your back.

name: Oh So Lawny
description:
Oh So Lawny is where lawn lovers log, share and compete. Life is greener together.

LOG EVERY SESSION
- Mow, water, feed, aerate, level, weed, edge or scarify, with time, area, cut height, passes and photos
- Before and after posts that show how far your lawn has come
- A weekly care streak and a season log of everything you have done

SHARE WITH PEOPLE WHO GET IT
- Your sessions become your feed: Green Thumbs, comments and replies from other lawn lovers
- Follow lawns near you and lawns like yours, wherever they are
- Clubs for your grass type and your area
- Keep your account private if you prefer

LAWN PULSE
- What lawns like yours, near you, should be doing this month, timed to your grass type, hemisphere and season
- A five-day weather outlook for your area, with simple advice for the week
- See how many lawns nearby have done each job, and log it with one tap

COMPETE FOR THE CROWN
- A new competition every month: enter your best lawn and the community votes, one to five stars
- Monthly tables for your area, region, country and the world
- Top of the table on the last day takes the champion crown, and it stays on your profile
- Propose community competitions, or start a challenge with friends just for the badge
- Fair by design: one entry each, ten votes a day, no voting for yourself. Votes and rankings are never for sale

MARKET
- Lawn Clinic: ask with a photo and your grass type, get answers from people who have fixed it before
- Post a lawn job with photos and get quotes from verified pros
- Verified pros carry a shield badge, everywhere

Your address is never shown. Oh So Lawny works at suburb level: your suburb, region and country.

Oh So Lawny is free to use, with a few clearly labelled ads.

LAWNY PLUS
Lawny Plus is an optional subscription that removes the ads and lets you use the streak saver without watching an ad. It does not change votes, points or rankings.
Lawny Plus is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your account when you confirm the purchase. It renews automatically at the same price each period unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in your account settings on your device.

Terms of use: https://ohsolawny.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://ohsolawny.com/privacy
Support: support@ohsolawny.com

name: OKJ Nova
description:
What happens to a material when heat builds slowly or pressure changes suddenly?
OKJ Nova gathers ten analytical methods for exploring those different responses.

THE LONG CLOCK OF HEAT
Explore creep under the conditions entered for the selected method.
Study thermal stress when temperature changes affect a material.
Review expansion estimates for a chosen thermal scenario.
Keep long-term behaviour separate from an immediate response.

WHERE TEMPERATURE IS UNEVEN
Examine local hot-spot conditions.
Consider temperature gradients across a material.
Explore temperature-induced effects with the relevant input values.
See how a different temperature assumption changes the result.

THE PRESSURE MOMENT
Review pressure-rise calculations for a selected case.
Examine pressure shock as a distinct loading event.
Explore combined pressure–temperature behaviour.
Keep a rapid pressure event separate from gradual thermal loading.

CYCLES AND COMPARISONS
Study temperature-cycle behaviour across repeated changes.
Choose a method that matches the question being examined.
Enter the quantities requested on its calculation screen.
Read the output together with its formula and stated assumptions.
Change an input to examine a second operating scenario.

ENGINEERING CONTEXT MATTERS
Results are calculated estimates, not physical measurements.
They cannot establish a safe operating condition by themselves.
Verify inputs, applicability and design requirements with qualified engineering review.
OKJ Nova makes heat-and-pressure questions easier to examine one method at a time.

name: On-Call Pay: Greek Doctors
description:
How many on-call duties did you do this month? How much are you owed? Has it all been paid?

Doctors’ On-Call is your personal on-call diary, made for residents, specialists and directors in Greek public (ΕΣΥ) hospitals.

ON-CALL CALENDAR
• Tap a day and choose active, mixed or standby
• Hours fill in by themselves: 15:00–08:00 on weekdays, 08:00–08:00 on weekends and holidays. Two taps and the duty is in
• Quick entry: one tap on each day of your roster
• All Greek holidays, including Easter and the movable feasts, plus your own local holidays
• Mark rest days and leave

PAY ESTIMATE
• Hourly on-call pay by rank, as in force from 1 January 2024 (Law 5092/2024)
• Night, Sunday and holiday surcharges and the flat sum per duty
• A breakdown of every duty by time band, to compare with your payslip
• The monthly cap by rank and zone: what is regular and what is extra, or mark it yourself on each duty
• Changed rank or hospital? Earlier months keep their amounts
• The amount after the separate tax on duties (22% in 2025, 20% from 2026)

PAYMENTS
• For every month: what you expect and what was paid, regular and extra duties apart
• Spot unpaid months and cuts at a glance
• The 3-month approval deadline for extra duties and the total you are owed
• A month statement in plain text, for an email or message to payroll

HOURS AND REST DAYS
• Warnings for weeks over 60 hours and a four-month average over 48
• Reminders of the rest day owed after a weekend or holiday duty
• How often you also worked the day after a duty

YOUR OWN VALUES
Every legal value can be changed in Settings if your payslip shows otherwise.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no internet. The app does not send your data anywhere. Keep a copy whenever you like, or erase it all with one button.

Important: amounts are a gross estimate based on Greek law, not an official calculation. The app is not linked to the Ministry of Health, regional health authorities or any hospital. It does not calculate social insurance deductions. Always check your payslip.

name: Onyx Phone
description:
Onyx Phone puts your business phone lines on your iPhone. Answer calls for every line you're on, text customers from your business number, and listen to voicemail, while your teammates ring at the same time.

CALLS
• Calls to your business numbers ring your phone, your browser and your teammates together. The first to answer gets the caller.
• Put a caller on hold with your own hold music, take another call, swap between them, or merge them into one.
• Add a teammate to a call, or transfer it, talking to them first or handing it straight over.
• Call out from any of your lines, so customers see your business number, not your cell.
• Recent calls, with recordings and summaries where your account records calls.

TEXTS AND VOICEMAIL
• Text customers from your business number, photos included.
• Voicemail with transcripts. Mark each one returned when you call back.
• Notifications for new texts, voicemails, missed calls and tags, kept quiet outside your alert hours.

BUILT FOR TEAMS
• Alert hours for when calls and texts reach you.
• Block numbers on one line or across the whole account.
• Your own ring and text tones.

Onyx Phone works with an Onyx Phone business account. Calling 911 from an internet phone line works differently from a cell phone; the app explains how before your first call.

name: OpenHangul - Korean Lessons
description:
10 minutes a day, from Hangul letters to native Korean expressions.

OpenHangul is a Korean study app for learners from outside Korea. It includes the full one-year course of 82 lessons from the website hangul.openblog.com, with four teachers guiding you step by step.

Key features
• One-year course, 82 lessons: The Story of Hangul → First Steps in Hangul → Beginner → Intermediate → Advanced → Like a Native
• Today's lesson, study streak and daily goal
• Spaced-repetition review cards: words you learned come back just as you start to forget them
• Animated Hangul stroke order and finger tracing (check stroke order and direction)
• Picture dictionary with 863 words: pictures, native pronunciation, example sentences and word quizzes
• Conversation stories: dialogues from life in Seoul and travel scenes, with native audio
• Play the videos for all 82 lessons and the conversation videos right in the app
• Learn Korean sentences and words from K-POP news added every day
• 12 lessons on Korean culture and etiquette
• Explanations in 21 languages, romanization on/off, dark mode
• Daily study reminders
• Sign in with an OpenBlog account (Google or Apple) to keep your lesson progress in sync with the website. Everything also works without signing in.

name: OpenHWP
description:
OpenHWP는 한글(HWP, HWPX, HML) 문서를 아이폰과 아이패드에서 열고, 고치고, 저장하는 무료 앱입니다. 광고와 회원가입, 인앱 결제가 없습니다.

■ 주요 기능
• HWP, HWPX, HML 문서 열기와 편집
• 글자 모양, 문단 모양, 표, 그림, 도형, 머리말·꼬리말, 각주 등 문서 서식 지원
• PDF로 저장하기, 인쇄하기
• 파일 앱, Safari 다운로드, 메일 등 다른 앱에서 "다음으로 열기"와 공유로 바로 열기
• 아이패드 Apple Pencil 필기: 문서 위에 서명하거나 체크 표시를 하면 쓴 위치 그대로 문서에 들어갑니다
• 그림, 표를 손가락으로 끌어 옮기고 크기 조절

■ 이런 분께
• 받은 HWP 파일을 폰이나 태블릿에서 급히 확인하거나 고쳐야 할 때
• 서류에 서명하거나 체크 표시를 하고 바로 돌려보내야 할 때

■ 안내
• 한컴 오피스에서 만든 문서의 모양이 일부 다르게 보일 수 있습니다. 글꼴은 기기에 있는 글꼴로 대체됩니다.
• OpenHWP는 오픈소스 rhwp(MIT 라이선스)를 기반으로 만든 독립 앱이며, 한글과컴퓨터와 제휴하거나 보증을 받은 제품이 아닙니다.
• 문의: adgk2349b@gmail.com

name: OpenPocket
description:
A little intelligence. All yours.

OpenPocket brings private AI conversations to your iPhone and iPad. Choose a model that suits your device, download it and explore your ideas without sending your conversation to a cloud AI service.

FIND YOUR MODEL
Browse a selection of 4-bit models, with guidance based on your device’s memory and storage. Manage your downloads and switch between installed models.

KEEP YOUR TRAIN OF THOUGHT
Ask questions, organise your thoughts and find the right words. Save conversations on your device, search them, rename them and pick up where you left off.

BRING YOUR OWN WORDS AND IMAGES
Import text, Markdown or text-based PDFs. Review and edit the extracted text before adding it to a conversation. With a compatible vision model, ask questions about a selected photo or screenshot. Images are resized for on-device processing. Input limits depend on the model, and scanned PDFs are not supported.

LISTEN YOUR WAY
Have responses read aloud using available system voices. Adjust the speaking rate, pause playback or stop whenever you like.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
No account, analytics or cloud conversation sync. Model downloads need an internet connection and enough free storage. Once a compatible model is installed, you can chat offline. You choose which conversations and models to keep.

AI responses can be inaccurate or inappropriate. Check important information and use the flag beneath a response to prepare an optional report. Nothing is sent automatically.

Model availability, speed, memory use and battery use vary by device. Larger models and longer conversations need more memory.

name: OpoSkill Psicotécnicos
description:
Prepara las pruebas de aptitud de la oposición de controlador aéreo desde el iPhone o el iPad. OpoSkill Psicotécnicos te ayuda a entrenar las capacidades que se evalúan en estas pruebas: razonamiento espacial, atención, memoria, cálculo, lógica, reacción y tareas de contexto aeronáutico.

QUÉ INCLUYE
- 27 tipos de test organizados en 9 categorías.
- 3 niveles de dificultad: Fácil, Media y Difícil.
- Preguntas generadas nuevas en cada sesión, para que entrenes la capacidad y no memorices respuestas.
- Corrección explicada de cada pregunta.
- Historial de resultados en tu cuenta para ver cómo evolucionas.

LAS 9 CATEGORÍAS
- Visual-espacial: cubo desplegado, cubos construidos, palos superpuestos y rellena el hueco.
- Atención y percepción: matriz de símbolos, velocidad perceptiva, figura oculta, puntos en figuras y diferencias entre imágenes.
- Memoria: memoria visual de posiciones, memoria visual de símbolos y memoria auditiva con tonos.
- Razonamiento abstracto: dominó y serie de cuadrículas.
- Numérico: matemáticas, series de números y valor de figuras.
- Verbal: series de letras, sinónimos y antónimos.
- Lógica: ordenación lógica.
- Psicomotor y reacción: coordinación mano-ojo, reacción selectiva y reacción al pitido.
- Aeronáutico: orientación aeronáutica, tráfico aéreo, comprensión de mensajes ATC y colación ATC.

PENSADA PARA PANTALLAS TÁCTILES
Los tests de reacción usan un botón grande y miden tus tiempos con precisión. Los tests de sonido necesitan el volumen activado.
Los 27 tests funcionan en iPhone y en iPad. Los de dibujos más grandes (como cubos construidos o diferencias entre imágenes) se ven mejor en el iPad.

UNA SOLA CUENTA
Usa la misma cuenta de OpoSkill en iPhone, iPad, ordenador y web. Tus resultados se guardan en el mismo historial. Si ya eres alumno de OpoSkill Academy, entra con tu cuenta.

AVISO
OpoSkill Psicotécnicos es una herramienta de entrenamiento independiente. No es una app oficial ni está vinculada a ningún organismo convocante. Sus tests están pensados para practicar y no reproducen los del examen.

SUSCRIPCIÓN
- OpoSkill Psicotécnicos ofrece una suscripción mensual con 3 días de prueba gratuita.
- El pago se carga en tu cuenta de Apple al terminar la prueba gratuita.
- La suscripción se renueva automáticamente cada mes salvo que la canceles al menos 24 horas antes de que acabe el periodo en curso.
- Si cancelas durante la prueba gratuita, no se te cobra nada.
- Puedes gestionarla o cancelarla en Ajustes > [tu nombre] > Suscripciones.

Términos de uso: https://oposkill.com/terminos
Política de privacidad: https://oposkill.com/privacidad

name: Orange Aparts
description:
Orange Aparts is the private portal for residents of the Orange Aparts villa complex in Fethiye, Türkiye.

• News and announcements from the management
• Community discussions and topics for your villa
• Direct messages between neighbours
• Polls and voting on decisions for the complex
• Villa expenses: who paid what, balances and settlements
• Deliveries waiting for you at the gate

The app is for residents only: sign in with the account you use on orangeaparts.online. New residents register in the app and choose their villa.

name: Orbicut
description:
Shoot. Orbicut does the edit.

Orbicut is the automatic video editing app by Pixdoo. Import your clips: the app cuts silences and filler words, adds animated captions, reframes to follow the subject and hands you a ready-to-post video in seconds. Then you stay in control of every detail in a complete multitrack editor.

AUTO-EDIT
• Import one clip or many from your camera roll, Files or by drag and drop on Mac.
• Automatic cutting of silences, hesitations, false starts and scene changes. Adjustable threshold, padding around speech and jump cuts.
• Ready-made auto-edit templates; everything stays adjustable on the timeline.
• Subject-tracking reframe: go from 16:9 to 9:16 without losing anyone.

ANIMATED CAPTIONS
• Word-by-word transcription, with Clean, Pop, Karaoke, Box and Typewriter styles.
• Position, size, words per line, colours and fonts from your brand kit.

MULTITRACK EDITOR
• Video, image, text, sticker, audio and effect layers on multiple tracks.
• Opacity, blend modes, masks, position, scale and rotation with keyframes and easing curves.
• Animated titles, about thirty effects (motion, look, glitch), transitions centred on the cut, zooms, per-clip speed from 0.25x to 4x.
• Brand kit built from your logo: colours and fonts applied to titles and captions in one tap.

MUSIC AND SOUND
• Import music and voiceovers, music that ducks automatically under the voice, fades and looping.
• Sound effects, with a suggested sound every time a title, sticker or transition appears.

PRO EXPORT
• 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9, up to 4K. H.264, H.265, ProRes, GIF or audio only (M4A, WAV), with an export queue.
• Save to Photos or to a folder, share with a link.

AI GENERATION (optional, uses credits)
• A complete video from a prompt: script, shots, animated titles, voiceover and music, delivered as a real project you can edit layer by layer.
• Translation into 5 languages, voiceover, automatic zooms, illustrations, audio clean-up.
• AI panel inside the editor: describe a change at the right moment of the video, it is applied to the project and can be undone in one tap.

ONE APP, ALL YOUR SCREENS
• iPhone, iPad and Mac with a single account. Wide timeline and side panels on iPad, keyboard shortcuts and drag and drop on Mac.
• .orbicut project file, with or without the source media, to move from one device to another.
• Everything in the editor works offline.

FREE PLAN AND SUBSCRIPTIONS
Editing, captions, reframing and export are included for free, with 30 AI credits to start. Optional subscriptions (Starter, Starter+, Pro, Business) add monthly AI credits, watermark-free export and cloud storage for backup and sharing. No commitment, cancel anytime.

PRIVACY
Your videos are analysed on your device (silences, scenes, captions, reframing). Your projects stay with you, synced through your own iCloud. Your media is only sent to our servers when you ask for an AI generation or share a link. We never sell your data.

Sign in with Apple or with your e-mail. Questions? support@orbicut.com
Terms: https://orbicut.com/en/terms/ · Privacy: https://orbicut.com/en/privacy/

name: Oscivra
seller_name: Shaodong Jixun Network Technology Co Ltd
description:
Welcome to our app! We’ve designed simple and intuitive pages to provide a smooth and complete user experience. Our focus is on making everything easy to use while offering you the most convenient features. We value your feedback and are committed to continuously improving based on your needs. Download the app and enjoy — and feel free to share your suggestions and ideas with us!

Observe vibration. Explore its frequencies. Keep a record of change.

Oscivra uses your iPhone's built-in motion sensors to capture three-axis acceleration and organize measurements around your equipment. Follow a complete workflow from machine profiles and live capture to frequency analysis, baseline comparisons and shareable reports.

A WORKSPACE FOR YOUR EQUIPMENT
Create profiles for motors, fans, pumps, compressors, machine tools or custom equipment. Record operating speed, location and reference parameters. Add measurement points, direction, mounting details, equipment photos and position markers.

REAL SENSOR CAPTURE
Capture X, Y and Z acceleration using gravity-compensated user acceleration or raw accelerometer data. Set the requested sample rate, recording duration and placement countdown. Watch live waveforms and X-axis RMS, peak and peak-to-peak statistics. Pause the display while acquisition continues.

EXPLORE THE SIGNAL
Browse saved waveforms with zoom, pan and time cursors. Select an interval to calculate RMS, peak, peak-to-peak and mean values for the selected axis or vector magnitude.

Use FFT spectra to inspect dominant frequency components. Choose Hann, Hamming or rectangular windows, adjust the FFT length when enough samples are available, and enable segment averaging. Inspect frequency and amplitude with a cursor, or add harmonic and RPM-based reference lines.

SEE FREQUENCY OVER TIME
Explore a spectrum waterfall with frequency-range and time-window controls. Inspect individual time slices and read the amplitude color scale.

BUILD A BASELINE
Save named baseline versions and compare two measurements. Overlay spectra, review changes in acceleration statistics and check the recorded measurement conditions. Follow per-machine RMS or peak trends and add observation or maintenance notes with photo attachments.

KEEP AND SHARE YOUR WORK
Generate measurement, comparison and historical trend PDF reports. Export raw acceleration or spectrum CSV files and annotated chart PNG images. Use local backup and restore, choose whether to retain raw samples, and display acceleration in m/s² or g.

OFFLINE BY DESIGN
No account is required. Measurements, notes and photos are stored locally. Sharing and backup exports are initiated by you. Clearly labeled generated examples let you explore the workflow before taking your own measurements.

KNOW THE MEASUREMENT LIMITS
Real capture requires a compatible physical iPhone. Actual sample rate is calculated from sensor timestamps, and the displayed frequency range is limited by that rate. Sensor hardware, mounting, contact and operating conditions affect the results. Features that reprocess samples require retained raw data.

Oscivra supports preliminary vibration observation and trend recording. An iPhone is not a calibrated industrial vibration analyzer. The app does not diagnose equipment faults, certify safety or apply industrial vibration severity standards. Acceleration values are not vibration velocity or displacement measurements. Use only safe, stable measurement positions away from moving parts and hot surfaces.

name: Ownhand
description:
Ownhand turns the letters you write with your finger into a font file on this iPhone.

You write each letter, number, and punctuation mark once. Ownhand builds a TrueType font from those strokes. A sample sentence, a card, a note, and a tag are set in that font inside the app. When every lowercase letter or every capital is written, you can share the .ttf.

Try the sample font if you want a finished hand before you write your own. Tune the weight, spacing, and kerning, and watch the sample change. Write a card, pick a paper and an ink, and export a picture or a PDF.

The font file can go to a computer, or to an app that imports fonts. iPhone does not let apps add new system fonts, so Ownhand uses the font inside the app and in the file you share.

Your strokes and fonts stay on this phone. There is no account and no sign-in.

name: Palette: Color Logic Puzzle
description:
Paint every cell red, yellow or blue… and watch the grid turn into a mosaic!

Palette is a colorful logic puzzle in the spirit of sudoku, without numbers. Blots tell you which mix of colors surrounds them: your job is to deduce where each color goes.

• Just two rules: a blot shows the exact mix of the colors touching it (orange = red + yellow, green = yellow + blue…), and two touching cells never share a color.
• Always logical: every grid has a single solution you can find by deduction, never by guessing.
• One daily grid, the same for everyone, plus a daily streak to keep alive.
• 250 levels in 5 packs, from 4×4 to 9×9: Discovery, Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert.
• Hints that explain: a hint doesn’t just paint a cell, it shows you the reasoning.
• Notes, unlimited undo, drag to paint.
• Accessible: colorblind mode with patterns (stripes, dots, waves), dark mode, “Reduce motion” option.
• Color themes to unlock: pastel, fruit, neon, watercolor.
• No forced timer, no pressure, even offline.

Free with ads. Video ads are always your choice (extra hint, past grid, theme trial). A one-time “Remove ads” purchase removes ads between levels.

name: Panelling Planner
description:
Plan your wall panelling, see the layout and take a clear cut list to the workshop.

Choose from ten styles: Shaker, slats, picture frame, board & batten, tongue & groove, shiplap, acoustic panels, herringbone, open chevron and staircase.

Enter your wall and material dimensions. See the measured layout, choose a finish and adjust the design. Open the cutting list for cut sizes, marking positions and stock quantities, with saw width and spare allowance where applicable. Save each wall and share a PDF for the job.

- Millimetres or decimal inches
- Boards or grooved sheets for tongue & groove
- Numbered profiles for shaped cuts
- Local saved projects and draft restoration
- Works offline, with no account, ads or subscription

Built for rectangular walls and single straight stair flights. Linear stock packing is suggested, not guaranteed optimal. Whole-panel and herringbone quantities use one source item per retained section without offcut reuse. Check your product's fitted coverage and the notes in your plan. Skirting, adhesive and fixings are separate; recheck measurements before cutting.

name: Paper Printout: Print & Scan
description:
Print and scan from your iPhone to the Wi-Fi printer you already own. Free, with no subscription and no ads.

Paper Printout finds AirPrint printers on your network, checks what your printer can do before you pay for anything, and shows its real status: ready, out of paper, ink levels and job progress.

FREE, FOREVER
• Print photos, PDFs, files, web pages and the clipboard
• Real printer status and ink levels
• Scan multi-page documents from the printer glass or your camera
• Merge, split, compress (even to under 100, 200 or 500 KB), sign and fill PDFs
• Read text from scans (OCR) and search inside your documents
• Print 2 or 4 pages on one sheet
• Free printables: graph paper, lined paper, planners, calendars, tracing worksheets
• Printer Doctor: step-by-step fixes when a printer won't print
• Print from any app with the Share sheet

PRO: ONE PAYMENT, YOURS FOREVER
• ID card printing: both sides on one page at real size
• Passport and visa photo sheets for US, UK, Schengen, Canada and India, with cut lines
• Posters tiled across several sheets
• Scan from the document feeder, two-sided where supported
• Scan cleanup: photocopy look, whiteboard, shadow removal
• PDF passwords and photo resizing for online forms
• Save home, office and more printers
Pro is a one-time purchase, shared with Family Sharing. Restore it at any time.

WORKS WITH YOUR PRINTER
Most Wi-Fi printers that support AirPrint, from HP, Canon, Epson, Brother and others. Scanning needs a printer that supports AirScan (eSCL). Older USB-only printers aren't supported.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no analytics, no tracking. Your documents stay on your iPhone and go only to your own printer.

Paper Printout isn't affiliated with HP, Canon, Epson, Brother or any printer maker.

Support: https://paperprintout.netlify.app/support/
Privacy: https://paperprintout.netlify.app/privacy/

name: Paper Snowflake
description:
Paper Snowflake is a calm fold-and-cut puzzle game. Every level shows a target snowflake. Fold a paper circle into a narrow wedge, snip a few stencil shapes out of it, then unfold to see your snowflake bloom. The closer it matches the target, the more stars you earn.

Easy to start, hard to master. Every cut is copied all the way around the paper, so a single circle near the fold edge becomes a ring of holes, and a shape at the tip of the wedge opens the very middle. Each level is a small puzzle in symmetry: where does this shape have to go on the wedge to make that pattern on the paper?

1000 LEVELS IN 57 PACKS
Start with six-point snowflakes and three folds. Later packs bring four-point folds, eight-point folds with four folds, and small, medium and large stencils. Each pack opens as you collect stars. Earn up to three stars per level by how closely your snowflake overlaps the target: 95%, 85% or 70%.

PLAN EVERY CUT
- A few cuts per level, so every snip counts
- Cut too much and the paper falls apart
- Tap the target to see it large while you fold
- Snap to symmetry and preview guides help you place shapes
- Stuck? Peek at the unfolded result, add a cut, get a hint or undo a cut with an optional video

SEASONAL PACKS
Lunar New Year, Valentine, Halloween and Diwali, each with 12 levels and its own stencils (hearts, stars, moons, diamonds) that you can rotate. Each pack opens only during its season.

DAILY SNOWFLAKE
One new snowflake every day, the same for every player. Finish it on consecutive days to grow your streak.

ENDLESS
Collect 15 stars to open Endless: new snowflakes without an end, mixing every fold and stencil the campaign has taught you.

STUDIO AND THE WINTER WINDOW
No target, no limits: cut freely with every stencil in Studio, and keep your favorite snowflakes in your Winter Window.

FROST AND PAPERS
Finish levels to earn Frost. Unlock Blue Foil, Rose and Gold Leaf paper with stars or Frost, and fold every level in the color you like. Mint, Lavender, Peach and Aurora paper come with the optional Snow Pack.

MADE TO RELAX
- No timers and no lives
- A music box tune on the menus and a cozy loop in levels
- Sound effects, music and haptics each have their own switch
- Reduce effects option for calmer animations
- No account needed; progress is saved on your device
- Plays in 11 languages
- Works offline; only the optional ads and the purchases need a connection

Paper Snowflake is free to play with ads. Rewarded videos are always your choice (peek, an extra cut, a hint, undo a cut, double your Frost). A one-time Remove ads purchase turns off the banner and the ads between levels; the optional videos stay available. The one-time Snow Pack removes ads too and adds four exclusive papers and 500 Frost.

Questions or feedback: support@agochar.com
Privacy policy: https://agochar.com/games/privacy-policy

name: Paperweight: Private Scanner
description:
No ads ever. No data tracking. No account creation.

Paperweight scans your paperwork and keeps it on your phone, and only on your phone. The app contains no application networking code and never uploads your documents. Apple handles the optional purchase.

SCAN
• Multi-page scanning with automatic edge detection, cropping and cleanup
• Add pages to a document any time, or import photos from your library

FIND
• Text on every page is read on your device, automatically
• Search across titles and the text inside your scans
• Copy the text from any page

ORGANIZE
• Rename documents, and reorder, rotate or delete pages
• Simple, fast library with thumbnails

SHARE AND EXPORT
• Export to PDF: original size, A4 or Letter
• Export the text as a plain .txt file
• Share through any app you choose, or save to Files

LOCK WHAT MATTERS
• Optional app lock with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode
• Lock individual documents with a passphrase. Their pages and text are encrypted on your phone (AES-256)
• Forget the passphrase and nobody can open that document, including us

BACK UP YOUR WAY
• One backup file with every document, page and its text
• Save it wherever you like: iCloud Drive, another Files provider or your device
• Optional passphrase protection (AES-256). If you forget it, nobody can open that backup, including us
• Optional reminders to back up

FAIR PRICING
• Free for 7 days with every feature
• Then a single $1.99 in-app purchase unlocks it for good. No subscription, ever
• If you don't buy, nothing is held hostage: you can still view, search, export, share and back up everything you scanned

PRIVACY, PLAINLY
• No account, sign-in or email
• No ads, analytics, crash reporting or tracking SDKs
• No application networking code
• Your documents live in the app's private storage until you share or back them up

Scanning uses Apple VisionKit and text recognition uses Apple Vision, on this device. You can also import photos.

Made by Southwest Blueprints with AI assistance.

name: PARPOL
description:
PARPOL adalah portal project untuk klien PASTI. Semua yang Anda lihat di web PARPOL kini ada di iPhone, dengan akun dan data yang sama.

Untuk klien:
- Lihat progres setiap project, milestone, dan tenggat dalam satu layar.
- Setujui deliverable atau minta revisi langsung dari ponsel.
- Buka dan bagikan dokumen project.
- Baca update terbaru dari tim PASTI.

Untuk tim PASTI:
- Kelola project, milestone, task, dan deliverable.
- Publikasikan update ke klien.
- Atur klien, akun, dan penugasan (Super Admin).

Keamanan:
- Masuk dengan email atau Google memakai akun yang sudah didaftarkan admin.
- Kunci aplikasi dengan Face ID (opsional).
- Akun bisa dihapus dari menu Akun.

PARPOL hanya untuk klien dan tim PASTI. Akun dibuat oleh admin, tidak ada pendaftaran terbuka.

name: Part Weigh
description:
Part Weigh is a cute tray for one paint mix on this iPhone. Name the recipe, set the total grams, and give each pigment the parts it takes.

Each pigment gets the target times its parts, divided by all the parts. The last pigment takes the rounding. The tray shows the next pigment and the grams the scale should reach. If the scale goes past that mark, Part Weigh stays on this pigment until you fix the mix.

Find a recipe by name. Change the name, the target, or a pigment. Delete a recipe you no longer need. The records stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Pásale: Learn Mexican Spanish
description:
Spend a month in Mexico City and learn the Spanish people really speak.

You are Mia or Ben, renting the rooftop room at Casa Bugambilia, an old family house with a courtyard in Coyoacán. Doña Lupita the landlady, Javi with his taco stand at the gate, Vale from downstairs, Chloe who lived in your room before, don Chepo at the corner shop and Frijol the dog are waiting. Each episode is a new day of your month in Mexico City, and you say your own lines out loud.

ONE EPISODE, FIVE MINUTES
• Watch the scene and hear every line, slowly or at natural speed
• Understand it line by line: Spanish and English, the words broken down one by one, and a short note on how Mexican Spanish works
• Say your lines out loud: Pásale listens on your iPhone and shows which words came through
• Try the casual version: a second scene with tú, the way friends talk

USTED OR TÚ, LIKE IN REAL LIFE
Every episode comes with usted (formal) and tú (casual). Live the morning doña Lupita tells you háblame de tú, and learn when people in Mexico switch.

START FROM ZERO
New to Spanish? A free seven day course, about five minutes a day, teaches the sounds, numbers and prices, ordering tacos, the Metro, telling the time, and when to say usted or tú. On day 7 you land in Mexico City, take an authorized taxi and hear doña Lupita's first words in episode 1.

SPANISH ALL DAY
• Today's phrases on your Lock Screen and Home Screen, with ¡Ya! and Todavía buttons right on the widget
• The people you meet text you after each episode, and you answer out loud
• Two minutes of review in the evening, with flashcards of your phrases and words
• Add your flight date and count down the days to Mexico City, with texts from Vale as the day gets close

YOUR ROOM, YOUR CARDS
Every episode leaves a new thing in your room, and its Spanish name is a word to keep. Collect a photocard from every episode.

SEASON 1: AUTUMN IN MEXICO CITY, 30 EPISODES
Tacos al pastor at the gate, the Metro, the market, a cough at the pharmacy, rain on the rooftop, Frida Kahlo's Casa Azul, football, lucha libre night, a boat at Xochimilco, marigolds and pan de muerto for Día de Muertos, the parade, and one evening near the end of the month that you spend with Vale or with Javi.

FREE TO START
The seven day course and the first 3 episodes are free, and you can play them all on your first day. Widgets, texts, the evening review, your room and photocards stay free.

PÁSALE SUBSCRIPTION
With a subscription, the story goes on from episode 4 to the end of the season.
• Yearly: $29.99 a year, with the first 7 days free
• Monthly: $4.99 a month
Prices are in US dollars and vary by country.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends if you start one. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it any time in your Apple Account settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account to make. Your voice is recognized on your iPhone and never leaves it. Your progress follows you to another iPhone through iCloud.

Terms of Use: https://www.mangolab.app/pasale/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.mangolab.app/pasale/privacy-policy

name: Pasty - クリップボード同期
description:
Pasty は、Mac 用クリップボード履歴アプリ「Pasty」のコンパニオンアプリです。Mac でコピーしたものが iPhone に届き、いつでも見返してコピーできます。

■ できること
・Mac でコピーしたテキスト、リンク、画像、カラーなどの履歴を iPhone で表示
・タップして詳細を表示、長押しでコピー・共有・削除
・キーワード検索と、種類（テキスト・リンク・画像）での絞り込み
・iPhone のクリップボードの内容を Mac へ送信
・削除した項目はすべての端末から消えます

■ プライバシー
・履歴は端末の中で暗号化（AES-256-GCM）してから送信します。暗号鍵はお使いの端末にしか保存されず、サーバーには暗号文だけが保存されます。運営者を含め、第三者が内容を読むことはできません。
・新しい端末を追加するときは、Mac に表示される QR コードを読み取るか、復元コードを入力します。
・広告やトラッキングは一切ありません。

■ 使い始めるには
1. Mac に Pasty をインストールします（https://pasty.kiichi.dev から無料でダウンロード）。
2. Mac の Pasty で 設定 → 同期 から同期をオンにします。
3. iPhone の Pasty で Mac に表示される QR コードを読み取るか、Apple または Google でサインインします。

Mac がなくても、iPhone と Android の間で履歴を共有できます。

name: Paylalo Go
description:
Paylalo Go is the delivery app for companies that run on the Paylalo ERP. Drivers run their trips with it, and gate guards confirm deliveries leaving the yard.

For drivers
See the trips assigned to you and start one when you roll out. Each stop shows the customer, the address and the delivery receipt. At the customer, take a photo or collect a signature as proof of delivery and mark the stop delivered. If the signal drops, the app keeps your update and sends it when you are back online.

Trip map and notes
While a trip is running and the app is open, the map shows where you are and the road you have covered, and your dispatcher can follow the trip's progress. Send a note to dispatch when something comes up on the road.

For gate guards
Scan the QR code on a delivery receipt to confirm the load before it leaves the gate, or pick it from the list of deliveries waiting at the gate.

Customer rating
After a hand-off the app can show a QR code. The customer scans it with their own phone to rate the delivery.

Who it is for
Paylalo Go is for employees of companies that already use Paylalo. Sign in with the username and password your company's Paylalo administrator gave you. There is no sign-up in the app.

name: Paz· Cinema and Theater
description:
Paz. Cinema and theater.

Stories don't end when the lights go out.

PAZ is a space where cinema, theater and people meet. A place to discover, share and connect through art.

Here there is space for those who create, those who act, those who tell stories and those who simply enjoy them.

Share your experiences, discover other perspectives and be part of a community where everyone has something to contribute.

Because art belongs to everyone.

Paz.

The art of representing life and moving human beings.

name: Peilscheibe
description:
An aid, not navigation – the nautical chart rules.

Peilscheibe uses the camera of your iPhone or iPad to measure how far away something on the water is: a buoy, an island, a beach, a shore. Aim, tap – the app gives the distance and tells you honestly how precise it is.

AUTO: YOU AIM, THE APP CHOOSES
No need to know the methods. “Auto” picks the right one and states the reason. Known data comes first: a seamark in the crosshair, then shores and islands from the offline chart, then the horizon, a known height, the waterline. A cross-check with a second method is shown in small print. Prefer to choose yourself? Tap a method.

SIX WAYS TO MEASURE
• Horizon – from the angle to the horizon
• Known height – lighthouse, mast, beacon
• Known size – width across the line of sight
• Coordinates – seamarks from the offline chart
• Chart – shores, islands, beaches, piers
• Waterline without horizon – when land lies behind the target

HONEST ±
Every value comes with its deviation in metres and per cent, plus a traffic light. If chart and measurement disagree, the app says “Target uncertain” instead of showing a neat number.

MAGNIFIER
Tap the centre: the magnifier enlarges the target, the app measures for three seconds, averages and holds the value – ready for the logbook or to measure again. On iPhone and iPad the magnifier enlarges a section of the camera image digitally; the ± is larger accordingly.

IPHONE AND IPAD
On iPhone and iPad, the lens and compass have not yet been measured on the device. The app therefore shows a larger ±, and the traffic light shows at most amber until you have calibrated each zoom level. Bearings, the offline chart and the logbook need GPS – on iPad only cellular models have it.

SEAMARKS AND HAZARD GUIDE
Seamarks from OpenSeaMap appear in the camera image. If a hazard from the offline chart lies ahead, the app paints it red and hatched on the water and shows the safe side in green – following the buoyage system of the area, and only when position and bearing are accurate enough.

OFFLINE
Measuring needs no network. The app loads seamarks and shorelines for your area beforehand – on Wi-Fi only if you wish.

LOGBOOK
Every saved measurement with time, position, bearing and ±. Export as CSV or GPX via the share menu.

IN PREPARATION
Tides and the link to an AIS receiver on board are visible in the app but not yet proven – please do not rely on them. An AIS playback with exercise data shows how it will look. No AIS receiver is needed.

FOR THE NIGHT AND THE BATTERY
Red-light mode, five designs, portrait and landscape. Without a touch the app rests after 20 seconds.

LANGUAGES
German, English, French.

COSTS AND DATA
Free, no account, no ads, no purchases. Logbook and measurements stay on your device; camera images are analysed on the device only. For the offline chart the app asks public OpenStreetMap servers (Overpass) for the area around your approximate location. Details in the privacy policy.

WHAT IT CANNOT DO
Peilscheibe does not replace the chart, radar, plotter or a lookout. It helps you estimate and check; the official nautical chart and a look outside are what count.

Seamark, reef and coastline data © OpenStreetMap contributors, OpenSeaMap – Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0. Tidal constants: TICON-3 – Hart-Davis, Dettmering, Seitz (2022), PANGAEA, doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.951610, licence CC BY 4.0; tide gauge data from GESLA-3. Not an official tide table.

name: Penaltı Gecesi
seller_name: Medusa Atelier Kuyumculuk Sanayi Ticaret Limited Sirketi
description:
Send your friend a 6-character code and start an online penalty duel! Penaltı Gecesi (Penalty Night) is a 1-on-1 penalty shootout game. When you shoot, you pick the part of the goal to aim at; when you are in goal, you guess where your opponent will shoot and dive there. Same zone is a save, different zone is a goal. You have 10 seconds for each pick.

A match is 5 penalties each. If it is still level, sudden death begins.

HOW DO YOU WANT TO PLAY?
• Against the computer: 3 difficulty levels. The goal is split into 3 zones on Easy, 6 on Medium and 12 on Hard. More zones make the keeper's job harder.
• 2 players on one phone: take turns shooting and keeping. This mode does not cost lives.
• Online random match: get matched with a player waiting at the same difficulty. Send quick reactions (applause, fire, shocked…) during the match and ask for a rematch.
• Play a friend with a code: create a match, send the 6-character code or invite link to your friend, and the match starts when they join.
• Tournament: you and 15 computer opponents, 4 knockout rounds. All tournament opponents are computer players, not real people. The further you go, the more coins you win; the champion also gets unlimited lives for a while.

MISSIONS AND DAILY STREAK
• Complete daily and weekly missions to collect coins. Finish them all to open the chest.
• Come back every day for your daily streak reward. Keep the streak going to open a surprise box; miss a day and it starts again.

LEAGUE AND FRIENDS
• Goals, saves and wins earn league points. See where you stand on the weekly and all-time tables.
• Search for friends by username, add them, see who is online and invite them to a match. The league has a separate friends table.
• Stats: matches, wins, scoring rate, save rate, best streak and recent matches.

COINS AND LIVES
• You have 10 lives. Each lost match costs 1 life (except 2-player matches on one phone). One life refills every 30 minutes.
• Earn coins by winning matches and from missions and chests; spend coins on lives.
• You can also watch a short ad to get a life (up to 5 a day).
• Choose your kit, shirt number and avatar in your profile.

ADS AND PURCHASES
The game is free and contains ads. Optional in-app purchases: coin packs, unlimited lives for a set time, a one-time starter pack for new players, and the No-ads membership: a monthly subscription that removes ads between matches and gives you 1000 coins every month. It renews automatically each month and you can cancel anytime in your App Store settings. You can still watch reward ads if you want. Your iPhone asks for permission before ads are personalised; the game works the same if you say no.

ACCOUNT
You can play as a guest without signing up; a guest account stays on that device only. Sign in with email or with Apple to keep your progress on every device. Adding friends requires an account. You can delete your account at any time from Profile → Delete my account.

Available in Turkish and English. An internet connection is required.

Send the code, let your friend join: who reads whom? Find out tonight!

Support: https://penaltigecesi.com/destek
Privacy policy: https://penaltigecesi.com/gizlilik
Terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Penguin Bridges: Logic Puzzle
description:
Every penguin on the ice wants to hold a bridge. Can you connect the whole colony?

Penguin Bridges is a calm logic puzzle with a clever twist on the classic bridges puzzle (Hashi): the number on each floe is its penguins, and each penguin holds one end of a bridge. Every level has exactly one solution, so you never have to guess.

HOW TO PLAY
• Each number is how many penguins live on that floe: that many bridge ends leave it.
• Bridges run straight, across or up and down, never diagonal, and never cross.
• Two floes share one or two bridges, never more.
• In the end every floe joins one colony.
• Drag from a floe toward a neighbour to build; drag again for a double bridge.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 200 handmade-feel levels that grow from tiny boards to big ones.
• Four icy worlds: Ice Shore, Fjord, Northern Lights and Iceberg Bay.
• Real 3D penguins that grab every bridge end and hop when the colony joins up.
• A new Daily Puzzle every day. Keep your streak going.
• The colony village: build igloos, stalls and slides with the fish you catch.
• Collect eight penguins in the album, each with its own story.
• Hints that explain why, so you learn the logic instead of just getting the answer.
• Mistakes are shown, never punished. No lives, no energy.
• Play offline, anytime.

If you enjoy sudoku, nonograms or other brain puzzles, you will feel right at home. Relax, think it through and bring the colony together.

name: People-Watching
description:
Turn people watching into a race. Everyone gets their own bingo card full of funny things people do, from socks with sandals to a dog riding in a stroller. Spot one, stamp it. Five in a row wins!

HOW IT WORKS
• One player hosts, and friends nearby tap Join. No accounts, no sign-up and no internet needed.
• The host picks where you are, and everyone gets a different card for that place.
• Keep your eyes peeled. Spot something on your card? Tap it to stamp it.
• First to stamp five in a row, across, down or diagonal, wins the round.

PICK YOUR SPOT
Play anywhere, or choose a Retail Store, Shopping Mall, Outdoor Event or Cruise Ship for sightings made for that place. With nearly 300 sightings in the mix, every card is a fresh shuffle.

PHOTO MODE
Want proof? The host can turn on Photo Mode, so claiming a square means snapping a photo of it. When someone calls BINGO, everyone watches a slideshow of the winner's photos. Photos only go to players in your game and are never saved to your photo library.

FEEL THE PRESSURE
• Live rings show how close everyone is to bingo.
• "ONE AWAY!" alerts crank up the tension.
• See what your friends just spotted the moment they stamp it.
• Countdowns, confetti, sound effects and haptics make every round a party.

PLAY TOGETHER
Up to 8 players per game. Phones nearby connect directly to each other, with no internet needed, so it works on a cruise ship, at a festival or anywhere the signal is spotty. Perfect for road-trip stops, mall trips, vacations and family days out.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your name and progress go only to players in your game, and nothing is sent to us.

Be kind: it's about funny moments, not making fun of anyone. Grab your friends and start watching!

name: PerCep
seller_name: NOYASIS OTOMASYON YAZILIM SISTEMLERI SANAYI VE TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
PerCep, fiziksel 101 Okey taşlarını fotoğraftan tanıyarak elini düzenlemene, perlerini oluşturup puanını hesaplamana yardımcı olan ücretsiz bir uygulamadır.

**PerCep ile neler yapabilirsin?**

• Kameranla 101 Okey taşlarının fotoğrafını çekebilir veya galerinden fotoğraf seçebilirsin.

• Fotoğraftan tanınan taşları ıstaka üzerinde inceleyebilir, sayılarını ve renklerini düzeltebilirsin.

• Gösterge taşını seçerek okey taşını belirleyebilirsin.

• Per önerilerini görüntüleyebilir ve elinin hesaplanan puanını inceleyebilirsin.

• Alternatif taş dizilimleri arasında geçiş yapabilir, perlere dahil olmayan taşları ayrı görebilirsin.

**Ücretsiz ve reklamsız**

PerCep ücretsizdir ve reklam içermez. Üyelik oluşturman veya sunucu ayarı yapman gerekmez.

Fotoğraftan taş tanıma işlemi için internet bağlantısı gereklidir. Fotoğraflar analiz amacıyla güvenli bağlantı üzerinden sunucuya gönderilir. Hizmetin kullanım sınırları bulunabilir.

Taş tanıma ve per önerileri yardımcı sonuçlardır. İşlem sonrasında taşlarını kontrol etmeni öneririz.

PerCep para veya ödül karşılığında oyun oynatma hizmeti sunmaz.

name: Perfortear
description:
Every stamp has a row of tiny holes around it. The trick is to tear exactly along them.

Perfortear is a game of steady hands. Customers at the post office window ask for a pair, a block of four or a strip with its margin. Drag along the perforations at just the right speed and feel each hole tick past.

Rush it and you rip the picture.

- A haptic tick for every single perforation
- A speed band that keeps your tear clean
- Blocks, strips, coil stamps and souvenir sheets
- Rare error stamps hidden in some sheets
- An album for every rare find
- A bulletin of rare finds from other players

Steady. Steady. Done.

name: Pet Wiki: dog and cat care
description:
Pet Wiki is a care diary for your dog or cat. It keeps your pet's whole story in one place: the weight curve, vet visits, vaccinations, symptoms and photos, all dated. And it reminds you when something is due.

You do not need an account. There are no ads and no tracking. Your diary is stored on your phone.

FREE, FOR ONE PET

- A profile for your pet: name, breed, birthday, sex, neutered or not, microchip number, vet name and phone, and a photo.
- A diary for weight, vet visits, vaccinations, flea, tick and worm treatments, medicines, symptoms, food changes, photos and notes.
- Reminders based on your breed's care rhythm and on the "next due" dates you enter, with one notification on the day.
- Breed facts that work offline.
- Backup and restore as a file that you keep.

PET WIKI PLUS (SUBSCRIPTION)

Plus is optional. The free app keeps working without it. Plus adds:

- An AI assistant that knows your pet. It knows the breed and reads the diary before it answers, so the answer is about your pet. Up to 40 questions a day and 300 a month.
- Trip planner: entry rules and breed rules for each country, with a dated checklist.
- Alerts when breed rules change.
- A vet sheet as a PDF that you can share with a vet or a sitter.
- Real costs: what you spend on food, vet, medicines, insurance, grooming and more, by month and by year.
- Insurance details with a renewal reminder.
- Food bag tracker that reminds you before the food runs out.
- Tick protection reminders that follow the weather.
- Several pets.
- Family sharing: share one pet between family phones with an invite code and see who did what. Family members who join with a code do not need their own Plus.

Both plans include the same features. Pay monthly or yearly, with a 3 day free trial for new subscribers. The exact price is shown in the app before you subscribe. The subscription renews automatically until you cancel. You can cancel at any time in your App Store account settings, under Subscriptions.

THE ASSISTANT IS NOT A VET

The assistant gives general care information. It does not diagnose and it does not give medicine doses. It cannot examine your pet. If your pet is unwell, contact your vet. If the signs look urgent, the app tells you to contact a vet or an emergency clinic right away.

YOUR DATA

- The diary, photos and profile stay on your phone.
- If you use the assistant, your question and some facts about your pet (such as species, breed, age, weight and diary entries) are sent to our server and to an AI provider to write the answer. Your pet's name, your vet's details, the microchip number and your photos are not sent. We do not store your questions or the answers.
- If you turn on family sharing for a pet, that pet's profile and diary (without photos) and the first names of the family members are stored on our server so the other phones can load them. They are deleted when the last member stops sharing.

Travel and breed rules are provided for information. Rules change, so always confirm with the official source before you travel.

Pet Wiki is made by 4V3D OÜ in Estonia. Questions: support@petwiki.app
More breed guides: https://petwiki.app
Terms of use: https://petwiki.app/terms/
Privacy policy: https://petwiki.app/privacy/

name: Phoenix Operations
description:
Phoenix Ops is the internal field-operations companion for Phoenix Group employees. It brings work-order maintenance, shipment receiving, and procurement and logistics approvals out of the office and onto the site floor, so the people closest to the equipment can act on it immediately instead of waiting for a desk.

Report and triage work orders from wherever an issue is spotted, scanning asset barcodes to attach the right miner, container, or infrastructure item in seconds. When shipments arrive, receivers accept items straight into inventory and document any damage with proof photos on the spot, keeping the paper trail attached to the moment it happened rather than reconstructed later. Approvers can review and act on procurement and logistics requests — quotes, purchase orders, GRNs, ATNs — from a phone, and a live site monitoring feed keeps everyone aware of fleet health without needing to be at a terminal.

Phoenix Ops is not a public app — it requires an active Phoenix Group company account. Sign-in is passwordless: enter your company email and a one-time code sent to it, no password to remember or leak.
