name: Photo & File Vault - CalcLock
description:
YOUR EQUATION. YOUR PRIVATE VAULT.

CalcLock looks and works like a calculator. Enter your exact equation and press equals twice to open your private vault. The answer alone is not the key: 123+123 and 200+46 can open different vaults, even though they give the same result.

KEEP YOUR FILES PRIVATE
Import photos and videos from Photos, add documents and audio from Files, or take a photo directly inside a vault. Swipe through pictures, pinch to zoom, play supported media and select items to delete.

SEPARATE VAULTS, SEPARATE EQUATIONS
Create independent vaults with different equations. Open the one you need without displaying a list of your other vaults. Return to the calculator with the back button, and your vault locks when the app leaves the foreground.

ENCRYPTED ON YOUR DEVICE
CalcLock combines your exact equation with a device-only secret stored in the Keychain, then derives keys to encrypt file contents and names using AES-256-GCM. Your vault stays on your device. No account, server upload or cloud sync is required.

A GALLERY THAT FEELS NATURAL
Browse photos full screen, swipe between them, zoom in for detail and tap to hide or reveal controls. Import multiple items at once and manage your files inside each vault.

MAKE IT YOURS
Use CalcLock in English, French, German, Polish or Spanish. You can hide the calculator settings button and access settings from inside a vault instead.

IMPORTANT TO KNOW
Remember your exact equation. There is no recovery or portable backup: forgetting the equation or losing the device means losing access to its vaults. Imported originals remain in Photos or Files until you delete them yourself. A stronger equation is harder to guess.

name: PhotoSweep: Swipe to Delete
description:
Clean up your camera roll, one swipe at a time.

PhotoSweep makes tidying thousands of photos and videos quick, safe and even a bit fun. See one photo at a time: swipe right to keep it, swipe left to delete it. Made a mistake? Undo is always one tap away.

SWIPE TO DECIDE
- Big, beautiful cards: right to keep, left to delete
- Undo any decision instantly
- Videos and Live Photos play right on the card
- Tap any photo to view it full screen and zoom in
- Share a photo or video straight from the swipe screen

TIDY MONTH BY MONTH
- Work through your library in small, satisfying chunks
- Progress rings show how far you've got in every month
- "On this day" brings back memories from past years
- Random mix gives you a surprise batch when you just want a quick clean

COLLECTIONS
- Jump straight to Screenshots, Live Photos, Videos and Selfies
- Duplicates: identical photos grouped together
- Similar: near-identical shots (bursts and retakes) grouped together
- Open any group and keep only the best one

SAFE BY DESIGN
- Nothing is deleted until you review the list and confirm
- Tap any photo on the review page to change your mind
- Deleted photos go to Recently Deleted, so you have 30 days to get them back
- Your progress is saved automatically

PRIVATE AND FREE
- Everything happens on your iPhone. Your photos are never uploaded
- No account, no ads, no tracking
- No subscriptions, no in-app purchases. Free, with nothing locked away

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Watch your streak grow and see how much space you've freed up

PhotoSweep works with Full Access or Limited Access to your photos. Requires iOS 26 or later.

Questions or ideas? Email michael@pheel.co.uk.

name: Pichchrapa: Casting & Reels
description:
Pichchrapa is where actors get discovered.

FOR ACTORS
- Record auditions with Shot Check: light, angle and framing checked before you roll
- Get your Actor Score and climb the city and India leaderboards
- Build a professional portfolio with photos, details and showreel
- Watch other actors' auditions in the Audition Feed, clap and leave helpful, respectful feedback
- Weekly acting tasks to keep improving

FOR CASTING TEAMS
- Verified casting profiles only, so actors stay safe
- Search talent by city, age, gender and language
- Post casting calls and shortlist actors

FOR BUSINESSES
- Turn short customer videos into polished Reels with your shop promo
- One Instagram bio link with all your Reels

One login per world (Actor, Casting or Business), each with its own profile.

Made in Lucknow by film director and acting coach Yogesh Chaitanya.

name: Pikpico - Pixel Movie Maker
description:
Pikpico lets you make pixel-art movies that look like a retro game, right on your phone.
You don't need to be able to draw. Lay out floors and furniture, place characters, add dialogue, and you have a short skit.

■ Build a stage by placing tiles
・Comes with lots of pixel-art floors, walls, furniture, props and characters
・Just place them on the grid. Drag to fill a whole floor at once
・Pick hair and clothes to make your own characters

■ Tell a story with moves and dialogue
・Walk, jump, spin, fall over, emotes and more with a tap
・Dialogue in RPG-style boxes or speech bubbles, with text sounds added automatically
・Screen shake, flash, zoom, weather and scene transitions
・About 40 tunes, including classical favorites, in a chiptune sound

■ Draw your own pixel art
・A drawing screen with pen, fill, line, selection and layers
・Use what you draw on the stage just like the built-in sprites
・Draw walking frames for your own characters

■ Share it right away
・Export as an MP4 video and save it to your photos
・Share straight to LINE, X and other apps
・Landscape (16:9), portrait (9:16) or square. Great for short videos
・Join several movies into one

■ Start from a sample
・Open a sample movie and just change the dialogue or the characters

■ Pricing
・The main features are free (with ads)
・Ad removal pack: removes banner ads, and no video ad is needed to remove the logo when exporting
・Christmas pack: 79 Christmas sprites, Santa outfits and hats for the character maker, and 2 tunes. You can also collect them one at a time from the gacha by watching a video

No account needed. Your movies are saved on your device.
An internet connection is needed when you start the app (not with the Ad removal pack).
Items may be added, changed or removed. Items already placed in your movies will keep showing.

name: Pimicio
seller_name: THANH LOAN EVENT AND MEDIA COMPANY LIMITED
description:
Thanks for downloading and trying out our app—we truly value your support and feedback.


Pimicio turns each day into a kite you fly with intention.

Every morning, launch one kite: a single intention for the day, the thing you most want to lift. Tie up to three small "tail steps" to it, the little moves that keep it in the air. Then pick the wind that matches your energy: calm, breezy or gusty.

During the day, tick off tail steps as you finish them. Each one turns its ribbon bow mint, and you can watch your kite's tail flutter as it climbs.

In the evening, reel it in. Drag the kite up or down its string to rate how high the day flew, from "Barely off the ground" to "Touching the clouds", and write a short reflection about what lifted it or pulled it down.

YOUR SKY
Every day you fly becomes a kite in your Sky, placed at the altitude you gave it and spread across a scrolling sky. Tap any kite to open that day, change its intention, tail steps, wind, altitude or reflection, or delete it.

WIND REPORT
See how your kites have been flying:
• Current streak and best streak
• Average altitude for each weekday, drawn as kite strings
• The tail steps you finish most often
• Your mix of calm, breezy and gusty days
• Totals for kites launched, reeled in and tail steps tied off

GENTLE REMINDERS
Choose a morning launch reminder and an evening reel-in reminder at times that suit you. They're local notifications scheduled on your phone.

YOURS, AND PRIVATE
Start right away with "Skip for now", or create an account with email, Google or Sign in with Apple so your sky follows you to a new phone. Guests can save their data to a full account later without losing a kite. Your journal syncs privately and keeps working offline. You can delete your account and all of its data from the Spool screen at any time.

Pimicio has no ads and no tracking. It's a calm, simple place to choose what matters today and notice how it went.

name: PinlabelLoupe
description:
PinlabelLoupe brings food-label information and your personal choices together in one place.

Find products in the bundled catalogue, search Open Food Facts online by name or barcode, scan a barcode, or enter a product manually. Open a dossier to see available ingredients, allergens and nutrition values per 100 g. Missing information is marked as unlisted or shown with a dash.

Save labels to your collection, log dated choices and compare two distinct products side by side. The comparison shows seven nutrient values and the difference between them. Your Desk keeps recent dossiers close at hand, while the Archive holds your collection and choice history.

The Home Screen widget shows your latest choice and journal counts.

Always check the package for current ingredients and allergen warnings. Catalogue data comes from Open Food Facts contributors.

name: PinweDaily
description:
PinweDaily brings you one classic line a day, at the time you choose, and every line can be traced to its original source. Lines are picked for your age, your work and your recent moods. After reading, note how you feel, write a few words, or save and share the card as an image. No account, no ads, and your data stays on your phone.

Every line has a source
• Over 2,400 lines, each checked word for word against the original text or a public-domain translation; lines from contemporary speakers are checked against official transcripts
• Each card names the author, the work and the passage, and the translator of the English
• East: the Analects, Mencius, Zhuangzi, Tao Te Ching, Xunzi, the Great Learning and the Doctrine of the Mean, Chuanxilu, Caigentan, Weilu Yehua
• West: Seneca, Marcus Aurelius, Epictetus, Emerson, Thoreau, Goethe, Benjamin Franklin, Francis Bacon
• Modern: Tagore, Helen Keller, Kahlil Gibran, Robert Louis Stevenson, L. M. Montgomery, Chekhov's letters, William James, Walt Whitman, Robert Frost, Mark Twain, Natsume Soseki, Akutagawa Ryunosuke, Miyazawa Kenji, Fukuzawa Yukichi, Nitobe Inazo, Lu Xun, Zhu Ziqing, Liang Qichao, Xu Zhimo, and university commencement and Nobel lectures
• About a third of days each come from the East, the West and modern writers

Picked for where you are
• When you first open the app, choose your age range and your work; your recent moods also shape each day's theme
• "Why this one" under the card says in one sentence why today's line was picked for you
• Two people whose settings differ in a single item never get the same line on the same day
• A line you have had will not come back within a year

Bilingual cards
• Your phone's language on top, English below; on an English phone the card shows English only
• On a Chinese phone, Chinese classics appear in the Classical Chinese original
• On a Japanese phone, Chinese classics appear as kakikudashi (the traditional Japanese reading) and Japanese writers in the original Japanese
• App languages: English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese

A daily notification
• One notification a day at the time you choose; tap it to open today's card
• Scheduled on your phone, with no server involved
• Change the time whenever you like in Settings

Mood journal
• After reading, tap today's mood (5 levels), pick up to 3 feelings and write a short note if you like
• Favorite the lines you want to keep
• Review shows past lines, moods and notes as a list or a month calendar
• If you choose the lowest mood five days in a row, a gentle card lists free, confidential help lines (Taiwan, Japan, US). PinweDaily is not a medical service and does not give advice

Save and share
• Save a card as an image in 9:16, 4:5 or 1:1, with the source and a QR code
• Print your nickname on the card if you want
• Saving asks only to add photos; the app cannot see your photo library
• Share with the system share sheet

Your data stays on your phone
• No sign-up, no account, no server
• No ads, analytics, tracking or crash reporting; the app makes no network connections and collects no data
• Moving to a new phone: export an encrypted .pinwedaily file protected by your own password, then import it on the new phone
• Export your notes as Markdown

Price
Everything in PinweDaily 1.0 is free, with no in-app purchases.

Privacy Policy: https://pinwelife.com/privacy/

name: Pip Roll
description:
Meet Pip, a cheerful rubber ball with places to be.

Pip rolls by itself and turns around when it hits a wall. You only have one job: tap anywhere to flap upward. Tap again in the air to go higher, let go to drop. Simple to learn, tricky to master.

Collect every pink gem in a level to open the portal, then roll into it.

30 handmade levels
• Springs that throw you sky-high
• Wooden ledges you can fly up through
• Sand blocks that crumble right after you land
• Lagoons where you swim with a tap, and grumpy fish
• Golden keys, locked doors and checkpoint flags
• Spiky urchins, flapping bats and sharp grass

Made to feel good
• Smooth, colorful art and soft sounds
• Full-screen landscape play, one-finger controls
• Best time saved for every level
• Works offline, no ads, no accounts, no in-app purchases

name: Pipe Saddle Layout Calc Pro
description:
Pipe Saddle Layout Calc Pro is a pipe saddle layout calculator for centered round pipe joints. Enter your pipe sizes and the angle, then follow numbered cut marks or generate a printable wrap template.

Keep one complete saved layout free. Revise it, mark it and print it whenever you need. A one-time purchase adds an unlimited layout library.

FROM PIPE SIZES TO A USABLE LAYOUT

• Enter measured outside diameters or choose supported nominal pipe sizes.
• See the actual outside diameter used in the calculation.
• Work in inches, mixed fractions or millimetres.
• Set the angle between the pipe centerlines with a visual joint diagram.
• Choose an outside-edge or inside-edge reference. Inside-edge layouts use your entered branch wall thickness.

MARK DIRECTLY ON THE PIPE

• Follow numbered stations around the branch.
• Read each station’s distance around and setback from the reference line.
• Choose 8, 16 or 32 stations.
• Highlight a station for a larger readout or use the complete table.

PRINT A WRAP TEMPLATE

• Create A4 or Letter PDFs with automatic page tiling.
• Assemble pages using alignment marks and tile labels.
• Check horizontal and vertical calibration rulers before marking.
• Save, share or print the generated PDF from your iPhone.

KEEP THE SETUPS YOU USE AGAIN

Name layouts, add notes and favorite useful setups. With the full unlock, save separate jobs and duplicate a setup for the next cut. Calculations, saved work and PDF generation run on your device and work offline.

SUPPORTED JOINTS

Straight round branch pipes meeting straight round headers with intersecting centerlines. Included centerline angles from 30° to 90°. Branch outside diameter must be no larger than the header outside diameter.

The app generates geometric branch-end profiles. Check the supported layout and chosen edge reference for your job. Follow the app’s guidance for finishing, grinding and fit-up.

Verify actual dimensions, orientation, print scale and fit before cutting. Use the job’s approved drawings and welding procedure. Structural suitability, pressure ratings and code compliance require appropriate professional assessment.

One saved layout is free. An optional one-time purchase adds unlimited saved layouts and duplication. Restore an existing purchase from Settings or the unlock screen.

name: Pipl Manager
description:
Pipl Manager is a password manager built like an old library card index. Every login, Wi-Fi network, ID and note gets its own index card, filed in a drawer for the person it belongs to: you, your work, your parents.

Pipl never goes online. There is no account to create, no server, no cloud sync, no ads and no analytics. Your vault is one encrypted file on your device.

FILED BY PERSON
• Personas: separate colour-coded drawers for you, your work and the family members whose accounts you look after
• Hidden drawers that stay out of counts and search until you show them
• Logins, Wi-Fi networks, IDs and secure notes
• Search the whole index, filter by type, star your favourites

ONE CARD, EVERYTHING
• Built-in 2FA: one-time codes (TOTP) right next to the password. Scan the QR code or paste the key
• Passwords coloured by character type (digits, letters, symbols) so you can retype them without mistakes
• Dictation: step through a password one character at a time with its spoken name, for typing it on a TV or reading it out over the phone
• Share a Wi-Fi network as a QR code
• Password history and reminders to change old passwords

CONSTELLATION
See the health of your passwords as a night sky. Strong passwords shine white, weak ones glow red, old ones turn amber, and a line links passwords you have used more than once. Every check runs on your device against Pipl's built-in list of common passwords. Nothing is sent anywhere.

CIRCLE OF TRUST
Forgot your master password? Pipl can make recovery cards for people you trust, for example any 3 of 5. One card alone reveals nothing; enough of them together open your vault. No company and no server is involved.

SECOND CODE
If someone forces you to open Pipl, enter your second code instead of the master password. Pipl opens a harmless decoy vault, and the vault file looks the same whether a second code is set or not.

RELAY
Move drawers to another device using only the camera. One screen plays a loop of QR codes sealed with a one-time code; the other device reads them. No network, no cable, no cloud.

GENERATOR
Random passwords, memorable passphrases, PINs and believable answers for security questions, with an honest estimate of how long each would take to crack.

PROTECTION
• Everything is encrypted with a key made from your master password
• Unlock with Face ID or Touch ID; the master password is still asked after a restart
• Face down = locked: put the device face down and the vault locks at once
• Auto-lock after you leave the app, and copied secrets are cleared from the clipboard
• The vault file is excluded from cloud backups, and the app hides its contents in the app switcher
• Encrypted .pipl backups sealed with a separate passphrase
• Import from a CSV file exported by your browser

Your passwords stay on your device. Make a backup or a Circle of trust, because nobody, including us, can recover a vault without them.

name: Pisteclub
description:
Pisteclub – Your ski holiday starts here

A ski holiday starts long before you hit the slopes. With Pisteclub, you can discover ski resorts, plan your holiday and keep everything organised in one place.

Whether you're going skiing for the first time or have been enjoying winter sports for years, Pisteclub helps you prepare for your next trip.

Discover ski resorts

Looking for a great destination for your next ski holiday? With Pisteclub, you can explore ski resorts in Austria, Germany, France and Switzerland.

Find information about slopes, ski lifts, altitude and what each resort has to offer. Compare destinations and discover which ski resort suits you and your travel companions best.

Plan your ski holiday

Our ski holiday planner helps you organise everything before you leave. Create a trip, add your accommodation and keep all your important travel details together.

You can plan your days, create a packing list and keep track of things you still need to arrange before departure. You can also save information about your ski equipment.

Everything is in one place, so you don't have to search through different apps, messages and notes.

Ski together

Planning a ski holiday with your partner, friends or family? Add your travel companions and keep everyone's preferences and skiing abilities in mind.

Whether you enjoy taking it easy on blue slopes or prefer something more challenging, a little preparation can make your holiday even better.

Skiing information and tips

Pisteclub also offers articles and useful information about skiing and winter sports. From tips for beginners to information about ski equipment, destinations and everything else that comes with a ski holiday.

We're continuously improving Pisteclub and regularly adding new features and updates.

For everyone who loves skiing

Pisteclub is made for people who enjoy winter sports and want to spend less time organising and more time enjoying their holiday.

Whether you're planning a weekend in Winterberg or a full week in the Austrian Alps, the excitement starts at home.

Download Pisteclub and start planning your next ski holiday.

Find out more at www.pisteclub.nl

name: PIT CREW by ETERNYTIME
Pitchlight: Silent Fire
description:
Pitchlight is a top-down stealth shooter played in the dark. You only see what your flashlight shows. Every step and every shot makes a sound, and enemies hear it too.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Left thumb moves, swipe on the right to turn. Push lightly to walk silently.
• Stop when an enemy steps into your light and you fire automatically.
• Sonar reveals what is behind walls, but it gives away your position.
• Flares light up a whole room for a few seconds.

MODES
• Night Raid: 3 zones × 5 rooms. Beat the Warden and reach dawn.
• Daily Blackout: the same night for everyone, with 2 special rules. One try a day.
• Survival: endless waves, a Warden every 5th wave.
• Arena: 3v3 to 10 echoes, or a 6-player last-one-standing with a shrinking ring of light. Play live with friends by room code or quick match; AI fills empty seats.

YOUR SQUAD
8 heroes with their own weapon and skill: a silent SMG runner, a shotgun with a shield, a medic, a sniper, an invisible assassin, a sonar tracker, an arc gun that stuns and a flamethrower. Upgrade them and pick modules such as silencer, soft steps, wider light cone, ricochet or piercing rounds.

Daily missions, login rewards and night chests keep every session short and rewarding.

Free to play with optional rewarded ads and in-app purchases. A "Remove ads" purchase turns off interstitial ads.

name: Pitterpat: Couples Games
description:
Pitterpat is a game for every couple: a surprise question, fifteen seconds and a heart that drains away. And whoever gets it wrong pays with a Love voucher.

THE SURPRISE CHALLENGE
Pick a question about yourself or write your own, mark the right answer and choose the prize. The other person gets a notification: when they open the challenge the heart starts, and they have 15 seconds to answer. Guess right and the point is theirs. Guess wrong and they owe you the Love voucher. Don't agree with the result? You can contest it, nicely.

LOVE VOUCHERS
"You make me dinner tonight", "I pick the movie", or anything you come up with. Win them through challenges, or give one for no reason at all.

GAMES FOR TWO
Draw and Guess, Same answer! and Four hearts: from a distance on your own phones, or on one phone passed back and forth. There's also a turn-based question game with no waiting.

FREE ANSWER AND "TELL EACH OTHER"
A free answer to read at your own pace. In "Tell each other" you both write, and you can only read the other person's answer after writing yours.

LITTLE NOTES
"Thinking of you", "I miss you", "Good night": one tap, from the app or the widget, and it's on its way.

THE DISTANCE BETWEEN YOU
"You're 7 mi apart." It only turns on when both people say yes, and either person can turn it off. Before it turns on, the app asks each of you to accept using your real GPS location: you see the real distance, down to meters, but never a spot on a map or a history.

YOUR PLACES
The bench where you had your first coffee, the spot where you got lost: put the places that matter to you on the map.

MADE YOUR WAY
Each of you picks your own color out of eight, and nobody ever asks your gender: heart, score, widget and icon all follow your couple's colors. A light and a dark theme that follow your phone. Topics, day streaks, moods and quizzes you write yourselves.

HOW TO CONNECT
One person starts the couple and gets a six-digit code. The other types it in, and whoever started the couple accepts. The code is a free invitation, not a purchase. Until you're accepted, you see nothing.

YOUR THINGS STAY YOURS
No account, email or phone number. No ads, no purchases, no tracking. In the app, what you write is seen only by the two of you. You can delete everything from Settings whenever you like.

Pitterpat is for people aged 13 and over. Tender and playful, with no sexual content. Notifications need both people to have the app installed and connected.

name: Pixel Car Garage
description:
Build your dream garage, tune every part, and dominate the drag strip in pixel-art style.

Pixel Car Garage is a retro drag racing game where every upgrade matters. Collect cars, customize them, and chase the perfect launch.

REALISTIC CARS & UPGRADES
• Cars with real-feeling stats: horsepower, weight, top speed and 0-100 times
• Upgrade your engine, turbo and tires, and feel the difference on the strip
• Advanced tuning options for those who love to fine-tune
• Car prices and rewards that scale with performance

YOUR GARAGE, YOUR STYLE
• Build a collection of cars in your own garage
• Visual mods: spoilers, rims, paint, decals and license plates
• See every upgrade and part live on your car
• Photo mode: pose your car and share it with friends

RACE YOUR WAY
• Drag races against rival drivers
• Quarter mile, half mile and full mile modes, unlocked as you win
• Nitro boosts and perfectly timed gear shifts
• Racing in different environments, plus day, night and rain conditions

MORE THAN A STRAIGHT LINE
• Police pursuit mode: stay ahead and escape before you get busted
• Rise through the ranks and earn rewards to grow your garage

Retro pixel visuals, realistic engine sounds and satisfying progression. Start your engine!

name: Pixel Golfer
description:
Pixel Golfer is golf boiled down to decisions. Pick a club, set the distance, aim, then stop the swing bar in the green. Every shot is a choice between going for it and playing safe.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Driver, wood, iron and putter, each with its own range and timing bar
• The closer you aim at the flag and the longer the shot, the faster the bar
• Miss in the red and the ball slices, hooks, gets chunked or thinned, or tops along the ground
• Wind, rain and snow change how far the ball flies and rolls
• Sloped greens: read the break, then judge the pace

COURSES
• 18 hand-made holes with creeks, lakes, doglegs, island greens and pot bunkers
• Play 3 random holes, 9 holes or the full 18
• Explore real courses hole by hole: Dai Lai (3 routes) and Doi Rong, a seaside 18
• A course map at the start of every hole zooms you from the whole round down to the tee

LEVELS: PIXEL GOLF RUN
• Six worlds: Meadow, Seaside, Desert, Forest, Snow Peaks and Volcano
• Six random holes and a fixed number of strokes per world
• Beat a world to unlock the next

RULES TRAINER
• Learn the Rules of Golf one situation at a time
• 37 situations in 6 lessons: the basics, playing the ball, bunkers and greens, free relief, penalty areas, and OB, lost and unplayable balls

ALSO
• Daily practice: a driving range and a putting green
• Hazards that play like the real thing: water, red stakes, OB, bunkers, trees, kick-backs off firm banks
• One Settings tab: English or Vietnamese, sound and music for every game
• No ads, no accounts, plays offline

name: PlacerPro: Gold Prospect Map
description:
PlacerPro rates every creek for placer gold, so you spend your weekends digging, not guessing.

Built for hobby prospectors, panners and sluicers, PlacerPro combines old mine and prospect records, geologic maps,
USGS stream-sediment lab results, USGS panned concentrates and mining claim records into one simple map:

• Every creek rated: green is your best chance, yellow is worth a look, orange is a long shot.
• Tap any creek and it tells you what that rating is built on: old gold workings upstream, the rock it drains, lab
  results from stream sediment, USGS panned gold nearby. It also tells you what is missing, so you can judge a
  rating for yourself instead of taking it on faith.
• Places you are allowed to pan: official public panning areas across 11 states, each with its rules, season, any
  fee, and a link to the agency page we took it from.
• Public land at a glance: national forest and BLM land you can usually pan, and the places that are off limits.
• Active mining claims marked, with a warning on every creek and spot inside one, so you don't trespass on a claim.
• Best near me: the top-rated creeks within a few hours of home.
• Save areas offline before you go, and they keep working with no signal at all. Most good creeks have none.
• Drop pins with notes on what you found and what you tried. They sync to your account.
• Lidar, slope and contour layers to spot old diggings, benches and terraces.
• Directions to any creek in Apple Maps.

Coverage: Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Alabama, Tennessee, Vermont, New Hampshire, Maine,
California, Colorado, Arizona, Nevada, Oregon, Washington, Idaho, Montana, New Mexico, Utah, Wyoming, South Dakota and
Alaska, with more coming.

Free to try. Sign in with your email; no password to remember.

PlacerPro shows estimates from public records, not a promise of gold. Always confirm land ownership, claims and local
rules before you dig.

name: Plant an App
description:
Plant an App brings the apps your organization built with Plant an App to your phone. Connect once by scanning a QR code from your Plant an App site, and use its pages, lists and forms in a native app that keeps working when the signal drops.

CONNECT IN SECONDS
On your Plant an App site, open the user menu and choose "Connect mobile app". Scan the QR code with the app and you're in, with the same account, pages and permissions as on the web. No password to type on the phone.

YOUR LISTS AND FORMS, BUILT FOR A PHONE
• Browse your site's menu and pages
• Search and scroll through lists, open a record to see every field
• Fill in forms with phone-friendly fields for dates, times, choices and checkboxes
• Run the buttons your site builders set up: add, edit, delete and more

KEEP WORKING OFFLINE
• Lists your administrator makes available offline are saved on your phone, so you can browse and search them without a connection
• Forms that accept offline entries save them on the phone and send them when you're back online
• An amber header always tells you when you're offline, and an outbox shows what's waiting to be sent

SECURE BY DESIGN
• Your saved pages, lists and entries are encrypted, with a key that never leaves the device
• Lost your phone? Disconnect it from your Plant an App site and its saved data is deleted the next time it connects
• Saved data expires automatically

SEVERAL SITES, ONE APP
Connect every Plant an App site you use and switch between them from one list.

Requires a Plant an App site with the mobile app enabled. Ask your administrator.

name: PlatuSalmon
description:
Platu and Salmon were about to go on a Work & Travel trip. But their dream came to an end when they were tricked into signing a contract that would cause them trouble later! Now they have to work to pay back their debt to a Mysterious FOX and escape from the Floating Island. Will their hard work be enough to pay off their debt and set them free?

PlatuSalmon is a casual cooking game that you can enjoy anywhere! All the cute animals and adorable art styles will make you want to keep playing again and again. But don't let the cute world fool you! Get ready for the busy life of running a restaurant. You'll experience time management challenges as you prepare foods and serve customers. Customers won't be happy if you don't serve them on time, so be quick and stay focused!

PlatuSalmon Features
- Choose Your Favorite Character! Who would you want to be Platu or Salmon?
- An Interesting Story! Follow their journey and discover what happens next.
- Explore the many restaurants waiting for you on the Floating Island!
- Cute Animal Customers! Meet adorable animal customers who are ready to order!
- Keep Track of Your Days! Time flies when you're busy serving customers!
- Collect Coins! Earn coins to unlock more restaurants!
- Recipe Book! Follow the recipes to make each menu correctly. Don't worry, we don't expect you to be a great chef on your first day!
- Learn While Playing! Discover new food-related vocabulary, improve your time management skills, and learn so much more!

You'll like our game if you are
- Casual-Gamer! Enjoy making orders and serving adorable Animal Customers!
- You like all type of food!
- You like adorable animal especially Cats and Dogs!

name: PlotPlan: Garden Planner
description:
Plant on time, every time.

PlotPlan builds your vegetable garden calendar from YOUR frost dates, not a generic chart. Pick your USDA hardiness zone, or type in your own last-spring and first-fall frost dates, and every date in the app moves with them.

PLANTING CALENDAR FOR YOUR ZONE
• When to start seeds indoors, harden off, transplant and direct sow, for 79 vegetables, herbs, fruit and companion flowers
• Succession sowings for beans, lettuce, carrots, radishes and more, stopped automatically before it gets too late in your season
• Fall crops counted back from your first frost: broccoli, kale, spinach, lettuce, garlic and more
• Warns you when your season is too short for a crop
• "Plant in the next two weeks" list so you always know what to sow now
• Season chart showing indoor starts, growing time and harvest windows against your frost dates

SQUARE FOOT GARDEN PLANNER
• Lay out raised beds, in-ground plots or patio containers on a 1-ft grid
• Drag seed packets onto the bed, or tap a packet and tap squares
• Square-foot spacing built in: 16 carrots, 9 beets, 4 lettuce or 1 tomato per square; squash and pumpkins take a 3×3 block
• Spacing warnings when big plants crowd their neighbours
• Companion planting checks: see good pairings (tomato and basil) and clashes (beans and onions) as you plant
• Copy a bed to next season and rearrange

REMINDERS
• A notification on each planting day for the crops in your plan, at the hour you choose

HARVEST LOG
• Log every picking by weight (lb, oz, kg, g), count or bunch
• Season totals and a chart of your top crops

EXPORT YOUR DATA
• Harvest log as CSV for Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets
• Planting calendar as an .ics file for Apple Calendar or Google Calendar, or as CSV
• Printable PDF garden plan with bed maps, calendar and harvest totals

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your garden stays on your iPhone.

PlotPlan Pro is an auto-renewable subscription, offered yearly (with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers) or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Planting dates, spacing and companion notes are general home-garden guidance. Your local weather, soil and seed variety have the final word.

Terms: https://nooton.com/apps/plotplan/terms
Privacy: https://nooton.com/apps/plotplan/privacy

name: Plumbtrue
description:
Every great wall was checked with a weight on a string.

Plumbtrue is a tower-building game where patience is the skill. Hang the plumb bob, let it settle, mark the true line, and set the next stone on it. Rush it and the lean creeps in, course after course.

The ghost tower shows you where perfect would be.

- A real swinging plumb bob you calm with gentle touches
- Mark-and-set stone placement
- A ghost overlay that reveals every bit of lean
- Wind, rain and night builds
- 30 target towers and an endless mode
- A board for the tallest true tower

Wait for it. Then build.

name: PlushiePlanetAs
seller_name: ARDA EGITIM TESISLERI TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
Welcome! Your approval keeps us moving forward—please feel free to share your suggestions.

PlushiePlanetAs keeps every bit of home upkeep on one tidy workshop wall, so nothing quietly goes stale.

Change the HVAC filter every 90 days. Water the fern every 4. Descale the kettle monthly, test the smoke alarm every six months, clean the fridge coils once a year. Each job becomes a "chirp": a swing tag that hangs on your pegboard and counts down in big painted numbers. When one comes due it turns safety orange. When it's overdue it shakes on the wall until you get to it.

HANG A TAG FOR EVERY CHORE
• Give each chirp a room, a cycle (every few days up to every two years) and a tool icon
• Rooms come ready: Kitchen, Bath, Living, Bedroom, Outdoor, Garage. Add, rename or remove your own
• A starter library of 31 common household jobs with sensible intervals and quick tips. One tap hangs it

MARK IT DONE, HEAR IT RESET
• Tap done and the tag flips to its green side. The cycle starts again from today
• Add an optional note ("used the 16x25 filter") and what it cost
• Not today? Snooze it 1, 3 or 7 days

SEE WHAT'S DUE AT A GLANCE
• The Due wall sorts everything into Chirping now, This week, This month and Further out
• Morning reminders on the day something's due, at the time you choose. One nudge per day, never a pile of alerts

KNOW WHAT UPKEEP COSTS
• The Logbook keeps your done history for every task, by task or as a timeline
• Your total upkeep spend this year adds itself up

YOURS, AND PRIVATE
• Sign in with Apple, Google or email, or just skip and try it as a guest. You can save a guest wall to an account later and keep everything
• Works offline. Your data syncs to your private account when you're back online
• No ads, no tracking. Delete your account and all your data from inside the app at any time

PlushiePlanetAs is a reminder tool. Follow manufacturer guidance and call a professional for gas, electrical or structural work.

name: PO ZHEN: Voxel Three Kingdoms
description:
Cut through ten thousand men. Take the banner at the heart of the formation.

PO ZHEN is a voxel hack-and-slash set in the Three Kingdoms. Hundreds of soldiers pour in and a single sweep sends them flying — but the enemy marches in formation.

THE FORMATION IS THE ENEMY
Every chapter brings a battle array with a name out of history: sidestep the Arrowhead cavalry and smash the drums at its tail, break out of a tightening encirclement, find the right gate through the Eight Gates or be trapped in Death. Cut down the banner and the whole army breaks.

EIGHT HEROES
Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, Huang Zhong, Lü Bu and Cao Cao, each with their own combos, charge attacks, aerial moves and Ultimates. Swap heroes mid-battle and unleash duo and trio combined attacks.

TOLD AS MARIONETTE THEATRE
Between battles the lamps rise on a puppet stage: marionettes before painted scrolls, a storyteller's gavel, and the great tales of the Three Kingdoms.

FULLY VOICED IN CHINESE
An original Chinese voice cast performs every line, with interface and subtitles in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English and Japanese.

BUILT FOR TOUCH
A virtual stick and an arc of skill buttons that change with your hero's weapon. MFi, Xbox and PlayStation controllers are supported too.

AFTER THE CREDITS
Five rewritten tales, eight hero epilogues, four trials, twenty emblems and an endless gauntlet.

Free to play: the prologue, Chapter 1 Hulao Gate, Chapter 2 White Gate Tower and the first 6 waves of Ceaseless Battle; free mode with Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei. The "Full Game" in-app purchase is a one-time purchase that unlocks every chapter, hero and trial, and can be restored on your other devices.

Voice acting is in Chinese only. Developed entirely with AI: the portraits, voices, music, text and translations were generated by AI and shipped as final, and the game generates nothing while it runs.

name: Pocket Steps
description:
Pocket Steps is a pixel pet that grows with your steps.

Pick a baby, give it a name and look after it. Feed it, play with it, clean up and tuck it in for a nap. Your daily steps turn into stars, and stars buy treats, hats and new homes.

HOW IT GROWS
A day of care gives 1 growth point. Every 1,000 steps gives 1 more, up to 2 a day. At 7 points your baby reaches LV2, at 21 points LV3. Points never reset, so a lazy day never undoes your progress.

WALK FOR REWARDS
- 100 steps = 1 star
- Daily bonuses at 3,000, 6,000 and 10,000 steps
- Walk 8,000 steps in a day for a mystery capsule
- 3 small missions every day and one bigger mission each week

COLLECT
- 10 creatures to raise, from common to legendary
- Hats and face accessories that fit each creature
- Six homes: Room, Meadow, Beach, Snow, Space and Candy

GRADUATE
When your baby is fully grown, you decide when it graduates. It leaves a keepsake card on your shelf and drops by now and then to visit the new baby.

DON'T FORGET IT
If you leave your baby alone until its health runs out, it runs away. Stars bring it back, and its growth is kept.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Add the widget and your baby lives there too, with today's step count right under it. The count refreshes from your iPhone's motion sensor even when the app is closed.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your steps are read from your iPhone's motion sensor and never leave your device.

The Starter Pack is an optional one-time purchase that adds the Space and Candy homes and 2 widget frames. Everything else is earned by walking.

name: PokeCollect
description:
PokeCollect tracks your Pokémon card collection and answers questions about it. The AI runs on your iPhone, so it works in airplane mode.

Ask in plain words
Type or say a question:
• "Which Gen 3 cards am I still missing?"
• "How many fire types do I have?"
• "Show me the water cards from Gen 1"
Apple's on-device model turns the question into a search. The app runs that search on your collection and shows you the answer, plus how it understood the question. The numbers come straight from your collection. The model never guesses them.

Say the cards you just got
Opened a few packs? Tap the mic and read the names out: "Gengar, Lapras, Scyther." Speech recognition runs on the iPhone too. The app matches each name it heard, flags any it isn't sure of and lets you pick the right one. Tap "Mark caught" and they're in. You can type the names instead.

Your collection in one list
• All 1,025 species, Gen 1 to Gen 9, one entry each
• Find any of them by name or National Dex number
• See how many you have from each generation
PokeCollect tracks which species you have. It doesn't track sets, printings or prices.

Private by design
• No account, no ads
• Your collection stays in a database on your iPhone
• Works in airplane mode
• The microphone listens only when you tap it, and the audio stays on your iPhone

What you need
• iOS 26 or newer
• For questions in your own words: an iPhone with Apple Intelligence turned on (iPhone 15 Pro or newer). On other iPhones the collection, search and adding cards by name all work.
• For voice: on-device speech recognition for English

PokeCollect is a free, unofficial fan app. It isn't affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Nintendo, Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK or The Pokémon Company. Pokémon and Pokémon character names are trademarks of their owners. Pokémon sprites © 1995–2026 Nintendo / Creatures Inc. / GAME FREAK inc.

name: PolarTramZest
description:
One finger. Two poles. A little yellow tram hanging from a broken overhead line, and a gap coming up fast.

Hold anywhere on the screen and the tram switches to S, pulled up toward the magnets that hang over the line. Let go and it switches to N, pushed away. That is the entire control scheme of PolarTramZest, and it goes further than you'd think.

Hold to cross. Gaps in the rail can only be crossed while a magnet is holding you up, field lines bending and sparking between your roof and the pole.

Let go to shove. Hold as you roll toward a magnet, release just after you pass it, and the repulsion kicks you forward. Chain a few shoves to climb ramps the motor can't manage alone.

Let go to brake. Red signs mark the sharp curves. Release before a magnet to bleed off speed, or the tram leaves the rails.

Stop on the mark. Riders wait at every platform. Hold under the yellow platform magnet to glide in and dock gently, then the tram departs with a magnetic launch.

What's in the depot:
- 48 lines, from one easy gap to long routes full of hills, curves and stops
- every line checked by a built-in driver, so each one can be finished
- stars for beating par time, and a score on every run
- Night Line, an endless route that keeps going as long as you do
- Daily Line, one fresh route a day for every rider
- global and daily leaderboards under an auto-made conductor name

The sound is electric hum, tram bells and synth arpeggios, and you can feel the magnets pull through the haptics. The look is retro transit: steel blue, spark yellow, signal red and ticket-shaped menus.

No account, no typing, no ads, no in-app purchases. Plays offline. All aboard.

name: Port: Cargo Puzzle
description:
Make room. Find the route. Deliver the cargo.

Port is a colorful sliding puzzle where every move changes what is possible. Guide containers to docks with matching colors and symbols. Delivering one cargo color can open the way for another, so a little planning goes a long way.

120 PUZZLE VOYAGES
Begin with clear, gentle puzzles and work toward tightly packed boards that reward careful planning. Every layout is fixed and every voyage can be solved.

TWO KINDS OF BONUS PUZZLE
Take a break with 20 deck-packing puzzles: fit the entire shipment around the equipment without rotating containers. Or try one of 6 short voyages for a compact challenge with familiar controls. Bonus invitations are optional.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
There is no timer, life system or limit on attempts. Undo a move, restart a puzzle and look for a cleaner solution. Earn up to three stars and improve your move count.

MADE FOR QUIET FOCUS
• Play offline, without an account.
• No ads, purchases or subscriptions.
• English and Russian, with an in-game language choice.
• Separate sound, haptic and reduced-effects settings.
• Current puzzles, undo history and progress save on this device.

A calm port. A board full of possibilities.

name: PortalC
description:
PortalC es una plataforma de gestión de personal para empresas de cualquier rubro y tamaño. Funciona como servicio (SaaS): cada empresa que contrata PortalC tiene su propio espacio independiente, con su configuración, sus módulos y sus usuarios. Hoy la usan varias empresas distintas, y un mismo colaborador puede pertenecer a más de una.

QUÉ PUEDEN HACER LOS COLABORADORES
• Marcar entrada, salida y break desde el celular, con verificación facial, PIN o código QR según lo que defina su empresa.
• Revisar su asistencia, permisos y justificaciones.
• Consultar y descargar sus boletas, contratos y documentos.
• Usar su correo corporativo con calendario y notificaciones al instante.
• Recibir los comunicados de su empresa.
• Crear tickets de soporte y solicitudes de proyectos, y seguir su avance en línea.
• Ver su carnet y su firma de correo.

PARA LAS EMPRESAS
• Cada empresa activa solo los módulos que necesita.
• Su administrador crea los usuarios y define roles y permisos.
• Los datos de cada empresa están aislados y protegidos.
• Disponible en web, iPhone, iPad y Android.

CÓMO EMPEZAR
Para ingresar necesitas el usuario que te entrega tu empresa. Si tu empresa aún no usa PortalC, puede solicitarlo desde nuestro sitio web: portalct.azurewebsites.net/plataforma

name: POS Live
description:
POS Live هو لوحة المتابعة الخاصة بمتجر قروث أوف غرين: يعرض لصاحب المتجر وفريقه أرقام البيع مباشرة من نظام الكاشير والمتجر الإلكتروني، بدون ما تحتاج تفتح الكمبيوتر أو تنتظر تقرير آخر اليوم.

اليوم
• صافي مبيعات اليوم لحظة بلحظة، مع المقارنة بنفس اليوم من الأسبوع الماضي لنفس الساعة.
• عدد الفواتير، متوسط الفاتورة، المرتجعات والخصومات.
• طرق الدفع: نقداً، كي نت، ماي فاتورة، ديمة.
• الوردية المفتوحة والنقد المتوقع في الدرج، وآخر الفواتير.

المبيعات
• يوم، أسبوع، شهر، سنة أو أي فترة تختارها، مع رسم بياني.
• الأكثر والأقل مبيعاً من المنتجات بالقيمة أو الكمية.
• ساعات الذروة.
• الربح الإجمالي والتكلفة لمن عنده الصلاحية فقط.

المرتجعات
• كل مرتجع بتفاصيله: الكاشير، العميل، طريقة الاسترداد، والأصناف.
• بحث برقم الفاتورة أو اسم العميل أو الهاتف أو الصنف، وفلاتر للكاشير والنوع.

الورديات
• الوردية المفتوحة الآن، والورديات المغلقة مع العجز أو الزيادة في الدرج وتقرير الإغلاق.
• عمولة الكاشيرية لكل شهر.

الإشعارات
• افتتاح وإغلاق الوردية، كل مرتجع، كل فاتورة، وملخص مبيعات آخر اليوم — تختار اللي يهمك.

الأمان والصلاحيات
• الدخول بالدعوة فقط، وبصمة الوجه عند كل فتح.
• صاحب المتجر يحدد لكل مستخدم الفروع والأقسام اللي يشوفها، ويقدر يلغي الوصول فوراً.
• الأرقام ما تنحفظ على الجهاز، وما فيه إعلانات ولا تتبّع.

ملاحظة: التطبيق مخصّص لفريق متجر قروث أوف غرين، والحسابات يسويها صاحب المتجر بالدعوة.

name: PrépaBus - Examen Permis D
description:
PrépaBus t'aide à préparer le plateau du permis D, l'épreuve hors circulation du permis autocar et autobus. Chaque jour, une séance d'environ 15 minutes te fait réviser l'écrit, les vérifications sur le bus et les fiches orales. Mets-toi ensuite en situation avec l'examen blanc.

TA SÉANCE DU JOUR
• Trois petites tâches par jour, adaptées à ton avancement : au début tu découvres, à la fin tu t'entraînes comme le jour J
• Les tâches se cochent toutes seules quand tu les termines
• Ta série de jours et ton niveau de préparation

LE BUS EN PHOTOS
• 6 vues de l'autocar : avant, arrière, flanc gauche, flanc droit, poste de conduite et habitacle
• 22 zones à toucher : ce que tu montres et ce que tu dis, à lire ou à écouter
• Les 6 thèmes de vérification, des documents et équipements jusqu'au transport de personnes
• Vérifications comme le jour J : un thème tiré au sort, tu montres et tu expliques chaque point à voix haute, puis tu te notes sur 3
• La checklist du plateau, dans l'ordre de l'examen, avec chronomètre

ÉCRIT
• Les 482 questions de la banque officielle de l'écrit plateau, reformulées et classées par thème : conducteur, équipements, masses et dimensions, circulation, réglementation sociale, transport, situations dégradées, mécanique
• Des questions en plus sur les vérifications du bus et les fiches orales
• Chaque réponse expliquée, et reliée au bon point du bus
• Mode examen : 10 questions en 6 minutes, avec correction à la fin

ORAL
• Les 12 fiches orales, à lire ou à écouter, avec vitesse réglable
• La méthode de réponse : définition, dangers, précautions, conduite à tenir, règle
• Écoute en continu de toutes tes fiches, même écran verrouillé : en voiture, à pied, partout
• Mode oral : tu réponds à voix haute, tu t'enregistres, tu te réécoutes et tu compares avec la réponse modèle
• Des mini-quiz liés aux fiches pour vérifier ce que tu as retenu

MANIABILITÉ
• Le créneau et l'arrêt de précision en schémas vus de dessus, étape par étape
• Ce que regarde l'inspecteur : 5 minutes au maximum, aucun plot déplacé, aucun pneu sur les lignes

EXAMEN BLANC
• Le plateau complet, dans l'ordre du jour J : écrit, vérifications courantes, thème tiré au sort, interrogation orale et maniabilité
• Chronomètre, auto-évaluation et score indicatif, avec ce qu'il te reste à revoir
• L'examen pas à pas, avec un lexique des mots du plateau : vérifications courantes, ajourné, seuil de réussite…

AU QUOTIDIEN
• Date du plateau facultative et compte à rebours
• Rappel quotidien à l'heure de ton choix
• Progression pour repérer les points à travailler
• Mode sombre et taille du texte réglable

GRATUIT POUR ESSAYER
La vue avant du bus, les fiches orales 1 à 3, 20 questions d'écrit, un examen blanc, la checklist, les thèmes tirés au sort et les schémas de maniabilité. L'achat unique débloque tout le reste. Sans abonnement.

SANS PUB, SANS COMPTE
Aucune publicité ni compte à créer. Ta progression et tes enregistrements restent sur ton téléphone. Les photos, fiches et questions restent disponibles hors connexion ; l'achat et la restauration nécessitent une connexion aux stores.

Les photos sont des supports pédagogiques générés par IA : repère aussi les éléments sur ton véhicule de formation.

APPLICATION NON OFFICIELLE
PrépaBus est une application indépendante, sans lien avec l'État ni les organismes chargés des examens du permis de conduire. Son contenu est pédagogique : il ne remplace pas la formation, la réglementation en vigueur ou les consignes de l'examinateur. Nous ne garantissons pas la réussite et ne saurions être tenus responsables du résultat obtenu à l'examen, sous réserve des droits prévus par la loi.

name: Pressio: Blood Pressure Log
description:
Pressio is a simple blood pressure diary for your home monitor. Write down readings in seconds, see your averages and trends, and bring a clear report to your doctor.

FAST ENTRY
• Big keypad that jumps from SYS to DIA to PUL by itself
• Measure twice, as doctors advise: Pressio keeps both readings and shows the average
• Arm, position, notes and tags: after coffee, after medication, stress
• On iPhone with Apple Intelligence, photograph the monitor screen: the numbers are filled in, you check them and save.

CLEAR ZONES
• Every reading is marked by the ESH 2023 or AHA/ACC 2017 table — with color, word and icon
• A separate warning for very high blood pressure

AVERAGES AND CHARTS
• Morning and evening averages for the last 7 days
• Charts for a week, month, 3 months or all time, with pulse and the high blood pressure line

REPORT FOR YOUR DOCTOR
• PDF with averages, readings by zone, chart, medications and every reading
• Send it by email or messenger, or print it; CSV table for Excel

MORE
• Morning and evening reminders
• Before the doctor visit: a 7-day home measurement plan, the average without the first day compared with 135/85
• Medications with reminders and a “taken” mark
• Profiles for your family on one phone

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Stored only on your phone. No account, no ads, no cloud of ours
• Optional copy to Apple Health and a backup file you can save anywhere

PRESSIO PRO
Charts and reports for any period, the 7-day plan, medications and family profiles. Yearly with 7 days free, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

IMPORTANT
Pressio does not measure blood pressure: use a validated blood pressure monitor. Pressio is not a medical device and does not replace your doctor. Discuss your results with a doctor.

Privacy policy: https://pressio.sanjardev.uz/privacy
Terms of use: https://pressio.sanjardev.uz/terms

name: PressPeek
description:
PressPeek is a file viewer for people who take print, signage and design jobs. Open the AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, DWG, DXF and PSD files your clients send, right on your iPhone, iPad or Mac, without installing Illustrator, CorelDRAW or CAD software.

PROFESSIONAL FORMATS
· Adobe Illustrator (AI), EPS and CorelDRAW (CDR) artwork, plus print-ready PDFs
· AutoCAD drawings (DWG, DXF) that stay sharp as you zoom in
· PSD, RAW, HEIC, plus JPG, PNG, GIF, SVG and other common formats
· Page through multi-page and multi-artboard files

PREFLIGHT CHECK
· See at a glance whether text is outlined, which fonts are used and whether they are embedded
· Catch common problems: small rich-black text, white overprint, RGB colors, hairlines, missing bleed, low-resolution images
· Spot colors and color modes at a glance; export a check report

ORGANIZE AND TRANSFER
· Recents, Favorites and folders for the files you use most
· Send files between iPhone, iPad and Mac on the same Wi-Fi
· Upload from any computer's web browser, no software needed; Windows PCs can also use the companion PressPeek Send
· WebDAV, FTP and NAS network locations (Pro)

PRIVACY
Every file is read on your device. Nothing is uploaded and no data is collected.

PRESSPEEK PRO
The free version shows 3 design files (including PDFs), drawings or PSDs a day in full quality (up to 10 MB each); photos are unlimited. Pro removes the daily and size limits, shows the full check details and unlocks network locations.
· Yearly (first week free) and monthly plans; one subscription works on iPhone, iPad and Mac
· Subscriptions renew automatically. Cancel any time in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Pressure Washing Calculator+
description:
Turn a customer's message into a clear, professional pressure washing quote.

Paste the text a customer sent you. The app picks out the services, sizes, name, address and budget, and asks you about anything it can't be sure of. It never guesses a size or turns a budget into a price.

PRICE YOUR WAY
- Your own rates per square foot, per linear foot, per step or a flat price
- Driveways, walkways, patios, steps, house washes, roofs, decks, fences and gutters, plus anything else you add
- Measure tool for odd shapes (rectangles and triangles), in feet or meters
- Minimum charge, trip fee, discount, tax and deposit

KNOW IF THE JOB IS WORTH IT
- See what a visit pays per hour after your costs, privately
- Never shown to the customer

SEND IT
- Share a clean PDF quote or text it straight from Messages
- Corrections and re-sending are always free
- Mark quotes Sent, Accepted or Declined and keep a record of every version

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
- No account. Jobs and customer details stay on your iPhone
- Back up and restore whenever you like

Try it with the built-in example message before quoting your own job.

PRO
3 free quotes, then Pro for unlimited quotes: $9.99 per month or $59.99 per year. No free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://wash-wizard.replit.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://wash-wizard.replit.app/privacy

name: ProChatDesk IVR
description:
ProChatDesk IVR is the phone app for agents of businesses that use the IVR and calling module of Pro Chat Desk.

Sign in with your Pro Chat Desk account and the app sets up your own extension automatically — no SIP settings to type.

• Keypad – call customers (Indian numbers) and colleagues on their extensions
• Incoming calls – answer or decline calls from your IVR and queues while the app is open
• In-call controls – mute, speaker, keypad for menu choices (DTMF), hang up
• Recents – every call of your organisation: incoming, outgoing and missed, with search
• Call details – who called, which line, how long, which IVR options they chose, which agent answered
• Recordings – play call recordings when your organisation records the line
• Lines – see your phone lines, their mode (IVR, AI agent, forward) and whether they are online
• Multiple organisations – switch between the businesses you work for
• App lock with Face ID

Calls ring while the app is open. Ringing when the app is closed comes in a later update.

You need a Pro Chat Desk account with an extension set up by your admin on the IVR page. Lines and IVR menus are managed in the Pro Chat Desk portal.

name: projectM-iOS
description:
projectM turns audio into full-screen visuals, using the open-source projectM engine and a collection of classic Milkdrop presets.

Choose a source:
• System/App Capture: visualize audio from content you choose to share, where iOS allows it. iOS asks each time and shows that sharing is on.
• Microphone: visualize sound in the room.
• In-App Playback: visualize the built-in reference track.

Browse presets, mark favorites, or jump to a random one. Controls fade away so the visuals fill the screen, in portrait or landscape.

Your audio stays on your device: it is processed in memory only, never recorded or sent anywhere. The app collects no data and makes no network connections.

Photosensitivity: the visuals can flash. Turn on Reduce flashing in Settings (on by default when Reduce Motion is on).

Free and open source: https://github.com/Coastrnaut/projectm-ios

name: ProofRack: Sheet Pans
description:
ProofRack is the speed rack in a bakery. A baker sees which sheet pans are still proofing, which are in a deck, and which have been pulled for the case.

HOW IT WORKS
- Rack: eight morning pans are already on the board. Tap a proofing pan and it moves into the deck or the hearth that has room. Each oven holds three pans. If both are full, the rack says so and the pan stays put.
- Ovens: Deck and Hearth show the pans inside. Tap a pan to pull it.
- Pulls: pans that left the oven. Return sends one back to the rack. Reload the morning rack restores the sample load.

The board is a shop note for the open. It does not time a bake and it does not promise a finished loaf.

name: Prudentia Sciences
description:
Prudentia is the scientific intelligence layer for life sciences deals. The Prudentia app brings the parts business development teams need away from their desk: their pipeline, and a conference QR code that turns a hallway conversation into a lead.

The app is for teams that already use Prudentia. Sign in with your work email and your company's Prudentia account. If you don't have one yet, ask your Prudentia administrator for an invitation.

Your pipeline
• Home shows your opportunities past Sourcing, Diligence first, then Evaluation and Screening, with high-priority deals at the top.
• Browse active Sourcing leads and Screening prospects. Switch between the deals you're on and every deal you can see, search by name, company or asset, and sort by last updated, name or time in stage.
• Open any opportunity for its stage, status, priority and strategic-fit rating, its assets, the deal team, and how a lead came in (source, conference, contact and whether their deck has arrived).
• Need to do more? Open the opportunity in Prudentia on the web in one tap.

Your conference QR code
• Your personal QR code is always one tap away: from the centre of the tab bar, from Home, or by touching and holding the app icon on your Home Screen.
• Pick the conference you're at, or use your always-on code for meetings and dinners.
• The code screen opens at full brightness and stays on, so it scans easily on a busy floor.
• Prospects who scan it land on a short form to share their details and deck, and the submission arrives in your Sourcing list.
• Share or copy your link, or hand your iPhone over so a prospect can fill in the form there and then, in a secure Safari view that keeps them out of your account.
• Your codes still show when conference Wi-Fi doesn't.

Secure by design
• Sign-in uses your company's Prudentia account, with single sign-on where your company has it set up.
• Your session stays in the iOS Keychain.
• Unlock with Face ID or Touch ID. The app locks again after five minutes away and hides its contents in the app switcher.

Prudentia for mobile works alongside Prudentia on the web, where assessments, data rooms and deal work happen.

name: Puffstead: Bellows & Burrows
description:
A little air. A lot of heart.

Meet Pippa, a small engineer with a very big idea: a little home that can walk, float, and carry everyone to safety.

Welcome to Puffstead: Bellows & Burrows, a cozy construction puzzle game about making every puff count. Connect a room-sized air network, read the weather, and guide a soft little fortress through 100 rescue journeys across ten chapters.

BUILD A BREATHING HOME

Place rooms on a 4-by-3 board and turn their ports to share one air supply. Cork frames, stitched bellows, and plump little tool rooms make your creation feel like a living toy. A room needs a connected air path before it can help.

EVERY PUFF HAS A PURPOSE

Most beats give you three air units. Spend them on Stride Bellows, Bubble Shields, Float Pads, or the Rescue Winch. Later journeys add branching valves, boiler heat, repair kettles, and cloud anchors. Carrying passengers and seedpods changes the cost of the road ahead.

READ THE WEATHER. PLAN THE RESCUE.

See the forecast before you act. Choose the right shield direction, lift passengers from high porches, or time a sail-assisted step with a friendly breeze. Plan up to three beats, preview your next landing, and move at your own pace. There is no reaction timer.

100 LITTLE JOURNEYS

Travel from Meadow Workshop to Lantern Heights, Patchwork Reefs, and the Homebound Parade. Bring every required passenger and seedpod to the exit and earn up to three stars per level. Want a helping hand? Auto Guide builds and plays each rescue step by step. Watch the actions, or stop anytime to take over.

YOUR OWN LITTLE CARAVAN

Compare real player profiles on the same device with Local Rankings. Keep your best results and completed builds, collect optional daily cosmetic gifts, and spend earned Stitches on a new look. Missing a visit never resets your reward cycle. Guided and Standard records stay separate.

MADE FOR AN UNHURRIED MOMENT

• Play the campaign offline.
• Retry and undo freely.
• Use tap placement or drag rooms from the tray.
• Adjust music, sound effects, haptics, motion, and color assistance.
• Play without advertisements, purchases, or an online account.

Build with care. Breathe a little. Bring everyone home.

name: Pufoo: Virtual Pet
description:
Hatch an egg and raise a tiny, fluffy friend who is truly one of a kind.

Pufoo is a cozy virtual pet you care for in short, sweet visits. Feed your Pufi, give them a bath, tuck them into bed and go for walks together. Their day carries on even while you're away, and one day they start talking in a language all their own.

NO TWO PUFIS ARE ALIKE
Color, ears, eyes, markings and personality are decided the moment the egg cracks. Foodie, sleepyhead, social or shy: there will never be another one like yours.

LEARNS PUFSPEAK
At first it's all coos and babbles. After a few days comes the first word, then whole sentences. Every new word goes into your Pufspeak dictionary.

A REAL CARE RHYTHM
Food, energy, hygiene and joy change through the day. Feeding, bathing and bedtime matter most when the timing is right.

WALK TOGETHER
Your real steps fill Pufi's joy. Pick a daily goal and find little surprises along the way.

FOUR MINI GAMES
Candy Road, Candy Tower, Pufi's Bakery and Dance Floor. Every game makes Pufi a little happier.

DRESS THEM UP
Bows, hats, wings and tiny buddies, with a fresh collection every season.

GROWS UP WITH YOU
Baby, kid, teen and grown-up: every new stage brings a celebration and a gift, all the way to the first birthday.

NEVER TRULY ALONE
Away for too long? Auntie Lily next door takes Pufi in and keeps them fed until you're back.

FRIENDS
Swap a friend code with people you know, visit their Pufis, send gifts and chat with friendly preset messages and stickers. There is no free-text chat, and you can block or report anyone.

GOODNIGHT, PUFI
At bedtime Pufi curls up under the blanket. Tap gently and they roll over. As they grow, they even talk in their sleep.

No ads. Your save stays on your device.

Pufoo is free to play. Optional in-app purchases include gem packs, a one-time Starter Pack and Pufoo Club, an auto-renewing monthly subscription that gives +5 gems every day. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://pufoo.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://pufoo.app/privacy

name: PullTogether
description:
這是一款透過機器學習來判斷引體向上是否標準的 App，在 1 分鐘內盡可能做出標準且快速的引體向上。與來自世界各地的愛好者一起切磋，來 PullTogether 發佈你的亮眼表現！

【怎麼開始】
把手機架在單槓前，按下開始就能挑戰。每一下引體向上都由演算法判定，參考金氏世界紀錄，雙手伸直、下巴過槓才算標準的引體向上。

【每一輪結束後】
可以查看這一輪的詳細數據，例如每一下的手肘角度和用時秒數，追蹤自己的表現。

【排行榜】
分為限時 1 分鐘挑戰賽與年度總量挑戰賽，與引體向上高手們一起爭奪前三名的寶座。

【訓練紀錄】
用長條圖查看近 30 天或每個月的訓練量，也能做成短影片分享給朋友。持續突破自己的 PR（Personal Record），一起變強吧！

name: PULSE - 실시간 심박 공유
description:
가까운 사람과, 함께 콩닥콩닥.

PULSE는 Apple Watch로 측정한 심박을 가까운 상대방과 실시간으로 공유하는 앱입니다. 런벨리의 강아지와 고양이가 각자의 심박에 따라 표정을 바꿉니다.

• 내 심박과 상대 심박을 iPhone과 Apple Watch에서 함께 확인
• 두 iPhone의 Bluetooth 연결로 심박 공유
• 같은 6자리 코드 확인 후 서로 승인하여 연결
• 측정값이 지연되거나 오래되면 화면에 상태 표시
• 그림으로 따라 하는 사용 설명서와 예시 화면 미리보기

두 사람의 공유에는 각자 iPhone과 페어링된 Apple Watch가 필요합니다. 두 iPhone을 Bluetooth 연결이 가능한 가까운 거리에 두어야 하며, 각 Watch와 자신의 iPhone 사이 연결도 필요합니다. Watch 두 대만으로 직접 공유하거나 원거리 인터넷 공유를 제공하지 않습니다.

3일 무료 체험은 시작부터 72시간 동안 제공되며 자동 결제되지 않습니다. 평생 이용권은 한 번 구매합니다. 한 사람만 평생 이용권을 보유하면 초대받은 한 사람은 연결된 세션 동안 추가 결제 없이 참여할 수 있습니다. 평생 이용권 보유자가 없다면 두 사람 모두 유효한 무료 체험 중이어야 공유할 수 있습니다.

연속 심박 측정에는 Apple 운동 세션을 사용하며, 측정 종료 후 건강 앱에 운동으로 기록됩니다. PULSE는 심박 공유용 자체 서버를 사용하지 않습니다. 캐릭터 표정은 재미를 위한 표현이며 의료 진단이나 응급 알림 기능을 제공하지 않습니다.

name: Purr & Form
description:
A little wordplay. A little more time.

Meet Lucy, a curious black cat who loves a good word. Start with three minutes, connect neighboring letters, and see how long you can keep the words coming. Longer words earn extra seconds, used letters fall away, and fresh possibilities take their place.

A DAILY LITTLE ESCAPE
Everyone gets the same Daily board and rules. Your first attempt is your Daily result, with a new board at midnight in Boston.

ROOM TO PLAY
Settle into Practice whenever you like. Try a different letter mix or wild-paw rule, then return to your saved Daily board, clock and score.

A LITTLE MAGIC
Wild paws can stand for any letter. One well-timed Lift clears a little space when you need a fresh possibility.

KEEP LUCY COMPANY
Lucy follows your play, cheers for long words, and brings you a little word-shaped trophy when your run is done. Tap her to say hello.

MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME
Choose Dark Mode or double-tap to submit. Pause whenever life calls; your game stays saved on your device. Practice works offline.

SHARE YOUR LITTLE WINS
Share your score and colorful word string through Messages, or copy the text into a conversation of your own.

Play free as a guest. An optional account lets you post Daily scores to the leaderboard. Purr & Form and Letter & Form share a sign-in, so your existing email works here too.

No ads. No in-app purchases. Just a few good minutes with words and a cat.

Made by Tiny Dale Creative.

name: Putfolio: Find Your Things
description:
Never lose track of where you put something.

Putfolio is a simple, personal inventory app that helps you remember where your belongings are stored. From everyday essentials to things tucked away for later, keep a clear record of what you have and where to find it.

A PLACE FOR EVERYTHING

Create rooms, places, and containers that reflect how you organise your space. Whether something is in a cupboard, drawer, storage box, or on a shelf, Putfolio helps you remember its spot.

KEEP YOUR THINGS ORGANISED

Add belongings and assign them to saved places.

Organise rooms, cupboards, drawers, boxes, and other containers.

Add personal notes to remember useful details.

Mark frequently needed items as favourites.

Search your inventory to find things quickly.

RETRACE WITH MEMORY TRAIL

Moved something and forgotten where you put it?

Memory Trail lets you review an item's saved location history and follow the places it has been. When you find what you were looking for, use "Found it" to remember when you last located it.

MADE FOR EVERYDAY LIFE

Keep track of household essentials, spare cables, accessories, seasonal belongings, storage boxes, and all those little things you put somewhere safe.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Putfolio works completely offline. Your inventory is stored locally on your iPhone, with no account or cloud synchronisation required. Your device's backup settings may separately include app data in iOS backups.

No ads. No tracking. No unnecessary complexity.

Just your belongings, your places, and a simpler way to remember where everything goes.

Put it away. Find it again. Putfolio.

name: Qamelis
description:
Qamelis es el panel para vender en Mercado Libre. Conectás tu cuenta y tenés todo en un solo lugar, desde el celular.

Respondé más rápido
Preguntas y mensajes en una sola bandeja. QamelisAI te prepara un borrador y vos decidís si lo mandás.

Mirá cómo viene tu negocio
Ventas, facturación, productos más vendidos y provincias, actualizados a medida que pasan.

No te pierdas nada
Notificaciones de ventas, preguntas y mensajes nuevos.

Trabajá en equipo
Sumá a tu gente y elegí qué ve cada persona.

Seguridad
Bloqueá Qamelis con Face ID para que sólo vos veas tus ventas.

Qamelis es una herramienta independiente y no tiene relación con Mercado Libre.

Necesitás una cuenta de vendedor de Mercado Libre.

name: Qiro - Canvas
description:
A little sky. A world of your own.

Turn the clouds you notice into something only you could imagine. Qiro is a drawing app that makes sky photos your canvas, from a whale drifting through the clouds to a sunset with a personal message.

Made for cloud watchers, casual doodlers, and photo lovers, Qiro gives everyday moments room for a little creativity. No drawing experience or account needed.

START WITH A SKY
Take a photo, import one, or choose from 8 included skies. Frame your canvas in Original, square, 4:5, or 9:16.

MAKE IT YOURS
Draw with 5 brush styles, including Glow and Dashed. Adjust color, size, and opacity. Add playful stickers and text, then move, resize, and rotate them. Explore drawing prompts when you need an idea.

KEEP CREATING
Undo and redo as you experiment. Keep a draft, save editable creations to your in-app Gallery, and collect your favorites to revisit later.

SAVE AND SHARE
Export your artwork as PNG or JPG to Photos, or share it through the system share sheet.

Photo editing happens on your device and uses a copy of your photo. Gallery projects stay in the app; exported images are separate copies.

Your sky. Your imagination. Your little daydream.

name: Quick-Estimate AI
description:
QuickEstimate AI is the fastest way for general contractors, tradespeople, and field service professionals to create accurate estimates, capture binding client signatures, and send professional PDF invoices on the spot.

Whether you're in residential remodeling, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping, HVAC, or handyman services, QuickEstimate AI turns spoken job descriptions into organized, itemized quotes in seconds.

KEY FEATURES:

• Voice-to-Estimate AI: Speak naturally about the job scope, materials, and labor while walking the job site. QuickEstimate AI transcribes and structures your notes into clean, itemized line items automatically.

• Smart Contractor Calculations: Instantly compute labor hours, material costs, overhead markups, local sales tax rates, and required deposit amounts without errors.

• On-Screen Digital Signatures: Hand your iPhone or iPad directly to the client to capture their signature immediately, turning quotes into signed work authorizations before you leave the property.

• Professional Branded PDF Invoices: Generate polished, downloadable PDF estimates and invoices featuring your company name, logo, contact details, payment instructions (Cash App, Venmo, Zelle, Card), and signed contract terms.

• Local-First Privacy: Zero account registration or login required. All your estimates, client details, and signatures remain stored securely on your device.

• Multi-Device Support: Optimized for iPhone with Dynamic Island, iPhone Duo workflows, iPad large contractor dashboards, and Apple Watch job tracking.

Stop spending late nights doing paperwork. Win more jobs on the spot with QuickEstimate AI.

name: QuickOpen-Account Spaces
description:
QuickOpen brings account records and client follow-ups together. Organize accounts by work, personal life or another context, and connect client details with your communication history.

ACCOUNTS AND SCENES  Save platform, username, password and notes, and favorite frequently used records. Switch the quick account to view or copy its locally saved details, or browse accounts by scene.

CLIENTS AND FOLLOW-UPS  Keep contact information, labels and client status alongside the related account. Record conversations and outcomes, then view, complete or reschedule follow-up items by date.

VOICE MEMOS  Record or import audio, link it to a client and account, and replay key details. Voice memos and other features require full access.

ENCRYPTED RECORDS AND BACKUP  Set a vault password to encrypt saved information. Lock the vault manually or automatically, export an encrypted backup and restore it with your vault password. Keep the password safe.

FULL ACCESS  Unlock additional account, scene, client and follow-up records, as well as advanced features such as voice memos.

name: Quizard: Pocket
description:
Quizard turns your lecture slides into exam questions. This app is the pocket half.

Pick the times you want a nudge. Each one is short, a little blunt, and asks for one thing: 5 questions. Tap it and you get questions and flashcards written from your own slides, with the ones that are due first. Two minutes, then back to your day.

What it does
• Nudges at the times you choose: morning, lunch, after class, evening
• Quick 5 or Quick 10 from your own material, not someone else's deck
• Flashcards on spaced repetition, so each card comes back just before you'd forget it
• Your streak, your exam countdown and your due cards in one place
• Once you've studied for the day, the rest of that day's nudges stay quiet

Same account, same progress
Every answer updates the same review schedule and study plan as Quizard on your laptop. Upload slides, read your lectures and ask the tutor at quizard.io, and keep it going here.

You need a Quizard account. Make one free at quizard.io.

name: Quorum: Daily Questions
description:
Twelve short questions a day. One answer from you.

Quorum gives you 12 yes-or-no questions every day: 9 for the whole world and 3 about your continent. Topics range from science, technology and philosophy to world affairs and seasonal subjects. Each question takes about a minute and has four steps:

• Learn: a key concept explained in a few lines, plus the strongest argument for each side.
• Predict: estimate what share of the world will vote Yes.
• Vote: Yes, No or Not sure. Your vote is final.
• Compare: see the worldwide result and how far your prediction was from reality. With Quorum+, also the result by continent and the crowd's average prediction.

NEUTRAL BY DESIGN
Questions are about open issues, worded neutrally, and always show the strongest argument on both sides. Today's results stay hidden until you vote, so the majority doesn't steer your answer. Questions are written with AI assistance and reviewed for neutrality. If one seems unfair, you can report it.

TRAIN YOUR CALIBRATION
Predicting before you vote shows how well you read the world outside your bubble. With Quorum+, your archive keeps every answer, your average calibration error and a calendar of the days you took part.

YOUR REGION, ONE LIST
Choose your continent: South America, North America, Europe, Africa, Asia or Oceania. It is suggested from your device's region setting, without location access, and you can change it anytime. With Quorum+, you also see results by continent once there are enough votes.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
The app is available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German and Japanese. When a question isn't available in your device's language, it can be translated automatically on the device itself, and you can switch back to the original at any time. Nothing is sent to a server for translation. You can turn this off in Settings.

PRIVATE FROM THE START
