• No sign-up, no e-mail, no password
• No ads and no tracking
• Votes are stored under a pseudonymous key and published only as totals
• Delete your account and archive anytime in Settings

ALSO
• Optional daily reminder at the time you choose
• Turn individual topics on or off
• Several color themes, including dark mode
• New questions every day at midnight UTC

QUORUM+ (OPTIONAL)
Quorum is free to use, every day. Quorum+ is an optional monthly subscription that adds:
• How every continent voted on each question, and the crowd's average prediction
• Your full archive, calibration and stats
• A daily recap of the question that split the world
New subscribers can try it free for 7 days.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Quorum+ is an auto-renewing monthly subscription. New subscribers get a 7-day free trial; when it ends, the subscription starts and payment is charged to your account. It renews automatically each month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your account settings, under Subscriptions. The price is shown in the app before you subscribe.

Terms of Use: https://lucasmqar.github.io/quorum-site/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://lucasmqar.github.io/quorum-site/privacy.html

name: Qur'an & Do'a for the Car
description:
Qur'an & Do'a for the Car is a recitation player made for listening in the car. One tap starts a playlist, a surah or a doa, and the recitation keeps playing with the phone locked. Play, pause, next and previous work hands-free from the car's Bluetooth or steering-wheel controls and from the Lock Screen, and next and previous move one verse at a time.

On iPhone and iPad you can read along when you are not driving: every verse in Uthmani script with its Indonesian or English translation, and the verse being recited is highlighted as it plays. A Live Activity and a Home Screen widget show what is playing, with one play/pause button.

On Apple Watch you can control what the iPhone plays, or listen on the watch with Bluetooth headphones: Juz 30 and the recited doa, which you can save to the watch to play without a connection.

• 114 surahs and short doa such as Ayat Kursi, Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas, ready from the first launch
• A doa and dzikir library of 260 entries in 20 categories to read, with a recitation for 14 of them
• 15 reciters, chosen for each playlist
• Playlists for the morning drive, the evening traffic and Friday's Al-Kahf, or make your own
• Picks up where you stopped, down to the verse
• Download surahs and playlists over Wi-Fi to listen without a connection
• Works on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch
• Light and dark appearance and larger text sizes
• No account, no ads, no data collected

Qur'an text: The Noble Qur'an Encyclopedia (QuranEnc). Indonesian translation: Ministry of Religious Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia. English translation: Saheeh International. Recitations: EveryAyah. Doa texts: bekalislam.online. This app is an aid for listening and reading, not a substitute for learning with a teacher.

name: Raah: Scroll For Sawab
description:
Turn your scroll into sawab.

Raah brings the Qur'an to the swipe you already know. Swipe up for the next ayah, read its meaning in your language and hear it recited, in the small moments that usually slip away.

ONE AYAH AT A TIME
• The full Qur'an in clear Uthmani script, one ayah per screen
• Swipe up for the next ayah, just like the feeds you already use
• Pick any surah and ayah, or let Raah surprise you

YOUR LANGUAGE
• English: Saheeh International and Rowwad
• Urdu: Muhammad Ibrahim Junagarhi
• Hindi: Azizul Haq al-Omari
• Optional transliteration

LISTEN AND REFLECT
• Beautiful recitation for every ayah, also available offline
• Tafseer for every ayah
• Save ayaat and write your own notes and reflections

BUILD A HABIT
• Reading plans, daily streaks and gentle reminders
• Celebrate every surah you complete
• Share any ayah as a beautiful image card
• Play on your TV with Google Cast

FREE, NO ADS, NO SIGN-UP
Every feature of Raah is free. There are no ads and you do not need an account. Your bookmarks, notes and progress stay on your phone.

Raah is a reading aid. Translations convey meaning; they are not the Qur'an itself. For questions of faith and practice, please consult qualified scholars.

Website: https://raahquran.com
Questions or feedback: hello@raahquran.com

name: Radar Mendoza
description:
Radar Mendoza muestra las imágenes del radar meteorológico de Mendoza sobre Google Maps, casi en tiempo real, para que veas dónde llueve y dónde hay tormentas con granizo.

• Última imagen del radar, actualizada con un toque.
• Animación de la última hora, para ver hacia dónde se mueven las tormentas.
• Búsqueda de celdas de granizo sobre el mapa.
• Tus lugares guardados: mantené presionado el mapa para agregar tu casa, tu finca o tu trabajo, con el color de marcador que prefieras.
• Tu ubicación en el mapa, para ver las tormentas cerca tuyo.
• Referencias para leer el mapa: qué significa cada color según la intensidad del eco (dBZ).

Datos: Red de Radares MRL5 de la Dirección de Agricultura y Contingencias Climáticas (DCC) del Gobierno de Mendoza.

Radar Mendoza es una aplicación independiente y no está afiliada al Gobierno de Mendoza ni a la DCC. Es gratuita y se mantiene con publicidad.

name: Radio Espérance de Tunis
description:
Radio Espérance de Tunis — la radio de tout espérantistes.

Écoutez la radio en direct et suivez toute l'actualité de l'Espérance Sportive de Tunis, en français et en arabe.

LA RADIO EN DIRECT
• Le direct démarre automatiquement à l'ouverture de l'application (option désactivable dans les Paramètres).
• Écoute en arrière-plan, même téléphone verrouillé.
• Commandes sur l'écran verrouillé, dans le centre de contrôle et depuis vos écouteurs Bluetooth.
• Titre diffusé et programme du moment.
• Reconnexion automatique après une coupure du réseau.

ACTUALITÉS
• Les dernières actualités sportives par rubrique : football, handball, volleyball, mercato, analyses, interviews, vie du club…
• Articles complets avec photos et galeries, partage en un geste.

PODCASTS ET VIDÉOS
• Podcasts audio avec reprise de l'écoute, avance et retour de 15 secondes et vitesse de lecture réglable.
• Podcasts vidéo et émissions en vidéo.

PROGRAMMES ET ÉMISSIONS
• Grille des programmes du jour et de la semaine, à l'heure de Tunis.
• Présentation des émissions et de leurs épisodes.

SPORT
• Calendrier des matchs de l'Espérance, résultats et fiches de rencontre.
• Classements des compétitions suivies : football, handball, volleyball.

LE STAFF
• Découvrez les membres de l'équipe de la radio.

RECHERCHE
• Retrouvez un article, un podcast, une émission ou un membre du staff.

FRANÇAIS ET ARABE
• Interface en français ou en arabe, avec affichage de droite à gauche.

Sans compte et sans publicité.

Radio Espérance de Tunis est un média indépendant de supporters. Cette application n'est pas l'application officielle de l'Espérance Sportive de Tunis et n'est pas affiliée au club.

name: Rahlenur: Quran, Prayer, Dua
seller_name: PNET BILISIM TEKNOLOJILERI TELEKOMUNIKASYON INTERNET VE DANISMANLIK HIZMETLERI TICARET LTD. STI.
description:
Rahlenur brings the Holy Quran, prayer times, adhan notifications, a Qibla compass, a dhikr counter and a dua library together in a calm, simple design.

THE HOLY QURAN
• All 114 surahs: Arabic text, translation (Saheeh International) and transliteration
• Verse-by-verse audio; continue where you left off
• Juz list, bookmarks and khatm progress
• Verse of the day

PRAYER TIMES AND ADHAN
• Accurate prayer times for your location
• Separate adhan notification for each prayer, with an optional reminder before
• Countdown to the next prayer
• Mark prayers as prayed and track missed (qada) prayers

DUAS AND DHIKR
• 234 duas in 14 categories: duas from the Quran, prayers of the prophets and of the Prophet (pbuh), daily life, healing, repentance, family, provision
• "How are you feeling today?": verses chosen for your mood
• Morning and evening adhkar
• Dhikr counter with goals, streaks and daily count
• Asma ul-Husna: the 99 Names of Allah with meanings
• Personal dua journal

HIJRI CALENDAR
• Hijri date, blessed nights, Eids and special days
• Countdown to upcoming religious days

4 LANGUAGES
English, Turkish, German and French. Choosing a language is free for everyone.

RAHLENUR PREMIUM
Try it free for up to 7 days:
• Unlimited verse listening and 19 reciters
• Bilge Nihat: instant answers to your religious questions from a scholar-prepared Q&A pool
• Listening with the screen off and in the background
• Unlimited dhikr counter
• Qibla compass
• Download surahs and listen offline
• Unlimited dua journal
• 6 background themes

Plans: monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage and cancel your subscription in your store account settings.

Reading the Quran, translations and prayer times are always free.

Privacy: https://rahlenur.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://rahlenur.com/kullanim-sartlari#en
Contact: destek@rahlenur.com

name: Ralkage FX
description:
Ralkage FX is Zimbabwe's forex signals academy — live trade ideas from real mentors, a community that trades together, and the tools to learn the craft.

WHAT YOU GET

• Live signals — gold, forex and Weltrade synthetics (GainX, PainX and more), each posted with its entry, stop loss and targets, and the mentor's reasoning. Shared as opinion and education, never a guarantee.
• A trading floor — one live room where every signal drops and the community talks each trade through.
• Signal chats — each trade opens its own room, so you can ask questions and share your entry.
• Lot-size calculator — set your account balance once and every signal arrives sized to your risk.
• An academy — short lessons that take you from reading a candle to building a trading plan.
• A VIP inner circle — trade under Ralkage FX with our partner broker and unlock inner-circle signals, with no monthly fee.
• Your own journal — log every trade and see your pips, win rate and streak.
• Push alerts — a notification the moment a signal goes live or a target is hit.

HOW IT WORKS

Sign in with your phone number — a one-time code over WhatsApp, no passwords. The app is free. You place every trade in your own broker account; Ralkage FX never touches your money and never asks for a broker password.

IMPORTANT — RISK WARNING

Ralkage FX provides education and market information only. Nothing in the app is investment advice, and no result is promised. Trading foreign exchange, CFDs and synthetic instruments carries a high level of risk and you can lose all of your capital. Past performance is not an indication of future results. You trade through your own third-party broker account; we never hold your funds. For adults 18 and over.

name: Randevizyon
seller_name: TEKNOROVA BILISIM SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Randevizyon ile bulunduğun şehirde randevu alabileceğin işletmeleri tek yerde gör.

• Yakınındaki işletmeler: Berber, kuaför, güzellik salonu, klinik, nail art ve diyetisyenleri şehrine göre listele; bugün boş saati olanları hemen gör.
• Saniyeler içinde randevu: Hizmeti ve uzmanı seç, takvimden gün ve saati belirle, onayla. Randevun anında işletmenin takvimine düşer, onay işletmenin WhatsApp numarasından gelir.
• Randevularım: Farklı işletmelerdeki yaklaşan ve geçmiş randevularını tek ekranda takip et, takvimine ekle, gerekirse iptal et.
• Değerlendir: Randevundan sonra puan ver; puanın işletmenin Randevizyon puanına katılır.
• Favoriler: Sık gittiğin yerleri kaydet, tek dokunuşla yeniden randevu al.
• Şifre yok: Telefon numaranla, WhatsApp'a gelen kodla giriş yap.

Konumun yalnız bulunduğun ili bulmak için cihazında kullanılır, saklanmaz.

name: Raquel’s Chroma Room
description:
Edit photos with layers, masks, creative filters, and portrait retouching. Compare three editable looks with Pick My Edit and share your favorite as a square or story card. Use Vegas After Dark to fine-tune night colors, or Best Face Merge to blend a selected face from a second photo.

Save an editable project to revisit your work, or export a layered PSD for compatible workflows. PSD support varies by document and feature.

name: Rarchive
description:
Rarchive lets you open, create and share archives on your iPhone and iPad — quickly and privately. Everything happens on your device: your files are never uploaded anywhere.

FREE
• Open and create ZIP files, unlimited
• Open encrypted ZIPs (ZipCrypto and AES)
• Open TAR, GZ, BZ2 and XZ
• Browse the contents of RAR and 7z archives
• Extract and preview single files (images, PDF, text and more)
• Fix garbled file names in ZIPs made on Turkish Windows (CP857)
• Works right from the Files app and the Share menu
• No ads

RARCHIVE PRO
• Extract RAR and 7z archives
• Create AES-256 encrypted ZIPs
• Create 7z and TAR.GZ archives
• Split large archives into parts
• Extract several archives at once
• Shortcuts actions

SAFETY
Rarchive protects you from malicious archives: files that try to write outside their folder and symbolic links are blocked, and "zip bombs" that would explode in size are stopped before they are extracted.

Subscription info: Rarchive Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. The yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Read It: Text & Image to Voice
description:
Read It turns text into speech, right on your iPhone.

Paste a message, an email or an article, press one button, and listen while you commute, cook or work. Got a screenshot instead? Pick the image and the app reads the text in it.

• Natural voices: 25 English voices, American and British, each with a sample to hear first.
• Fully offline: the voice runs on your iPhone. No internet needed, no account, no sign-up.
• Private: what you paste is never uploaded.
• Follow along: the sentence being read is highlighted, and a marker follows the words.
• In your pocket: keeps reading with the screen locked, with play, pause and 15-second skips on the lock screen and your headphones.
• Your pace: 0.75× to 2×.

Free with ads. One subscription removes them.

English only. The word marker is an estimate and may run a word ahead or behind.

Subscription: Ad-Free, monthly, auto-renewing, billed to your Apple ID. Cancel anytime in Settings.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://luxuriant-front-a88.notion.site/Read-It-Privacy-Policy-Support-4140f7d779d8804bb941d0684f971430

name: Red Lock
description:
Red Lock, c'est la baston de rue façon arcade rétro, à jouer à plusieurs sur le même écran.

• De 1 à 4 joueurs sur le même iPhone, iPad ou Mac : manettes Bluetooth (Xbox, PlayStation, MFi), clavier ou commandes tactiles.
• Contre l'ordinateur : 1 à 3 adversaires, trois niveaux de difficulté, chacun pour soi ou en équipe.
• 8 combattants aux qualités bien différentes (le plus rapide, celui qui saute le plus haut, le plus costaud…), avec chacun 3 coups spéciaux : tir direct, dribble, contre, sprint éclair, onde de choc, téléportation…
• Équipe-les : épées, lances, bottes… ou à mains nues. Et change leur tenue.
• Chaque combat fait monter ton personnage de niveau : pièces, titres (« Explosif Cat », « Vipère Tonique »…) et nouveaux modes de jeu à débloquer (Mort subite, Pluie d'objets, Géants, Survie).
• Gagne des pièces en combattant et dépense-les au magasin pour débloquer personnages, armes et tenues.
• 11 arènes en haute définition : stade, rue sombre, toit d'immeuble, station de métro, docks avec plateforme mobile, gymnase…
• Des événements qui arrivent tout seuls selon la saison : rue hantée à Halloween, bataille de neige à Noël, chasse aux œufs à Pâques, plage en été.
• Des codes secrets à découvrir.
• Plusieurs joueurs sur le même appareil, chacun avec son pseudo, ses pièces et ses objets.

Sans publicité, sans achat intégré, sans compte et sans internet. Aucune donnée collectée.

name: Red Plus+
description:
Red Plus brings the best local shops and brands to your phone.

Browse stores near you, order for delivery, and track every order in real time from checkout to your door.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Discover shops and brands around your delivery address
• Grab Surprise Boxes from your favourite stores at special prices
• Search products, save favourites, and reorder in a few taps
• Pay your way and keep your balance in the RED Wallet
• Earn loyalty points on your orders and redeem them for rewards
• Invite friends with your referral code
• Get notifications about your order status and new offers
• Manage multiple delivery addresses and your order history

SIMPLE AND SECURE
Sign in with your phone number, confirm your delivery point on the map, and you're set. You can edit your profile or delete your account at any time from within the app.

Available in English and Arabic, with full right-to-left support.

Need help? Reach us any time from Help & Support inside the app.

name: Red+ Driver
description:
Red Driver is the app for delivery partners of the Red Plus network.

Sign up, get approved, and start delivering orders from local shops to customers around you.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Register with your ID, driver's licence and vehicle details
• Go online and receive incoming delivery orders in real time
• Navigate to the store and then to the customer
• Confirm pickup and capture proof of delivery with your camera
• Track your earnings and order history
• Add your bank details and request withdrawals
• Get notifications for new orders and application updates
• Report an issue with any order

BUILT FOR THE ROAD
Live location is used only while you are on shift or delivering, so dispatch and customers can follow the order. You are always in control of when you are online.

Available in English and Arabic, with full right-to-left support.

Need help? Reach us from Help & Support inside the app.

name: Red+ Store
description:
Red Store is the app for shop owners on the Red Plus delivery network.

Register your shop, get approved, and start selling to customers around you.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Register your store with its licence, ID and documents
• Receive new orders instantly and prepare them step by step
• Manage your products, categories and option groups
• Create Surprise Boxes at special prices and pack them for pickup
• Update stock in bulk and set your operating hours
• Follow sales, product performance and reports
• Add staff accounts for your team
• Manage your store profile, bank details and subscription plan
• Get notifications for new orders and updates

Available in English and Arabic, with full right-to-left support.

Need help? Reach us from Help & Support inside the app.

name: Redlamp
description:
Under the red lamp, a blank sheet slowly becomes a picture, and it is the one you made.

Redlamp Prints is a darkroom puzzle. Study the target print, then expose your paper under the enlarger. Hold back light with your fingertips, burn in the edges, and develop by rocking the tray until the image is just right.

Stop too soon and it is pale. Wait too long and it is lost.

- Real-time exposure with fingertip dodging and burning
- A developer tray where the image appears as you rock it
- Test strips to guide you
- 40 negatives, filters and high-contrast paper
- A clothesline of every print you have made
- New negatives each week

Patience in the dark.

name: Reel Delve
description:
Reel Delve is a portrait puzzle about three cave reels.
The miner stands on a reel. That reel does not spin. Tap a lit cell to walk. Walking costs oil. Sideways is open; up or down needs a ladder. Holes block the way.
Hold another reel, then tap Pull. Only the reels you did not hold will turn, and the pull costs oil. ▲ and ▼ shift one reel by a single cell and spend a gear. Shift the reel under your feet and you ride with it.
Line up three of the same symbol. Holes become a bridge, lamps add oil, gears add a gear, and gems are collected together. Step on a bat only if you can spare the extra oil.
Collect the gems the level asks for, then step into the lift before the lamp goes out. Chapter 1, Lamp Drift, has ten levels. The first levels teach one action. Later levels mix them. Your best score and an unfinished level stay on this iPhone.
There is no account, and no in-app purchase. Settings holds sound, haptics, reduce motion, and the privacy policy.

name: Refinery Custom Cabinets
description:
Refinery is the staff app of The Refinery Custom Cabinets, a custom cabinet shop in Birmingham, Alabama. Our install crews and shop team use it to keep every job's photos, punch list and schedule in one place.

• Jobsite photos and video, filed to the right job, with markup, tags, captions and comments
• Punch lists by room: add an item, swipe to mark it done
• One running note for each job
• The field schedule: deliveries, installs and go-backs on a month calendar
• Directions to the job, and the job's files
• Works with no signal: everything is saved on the phone and sent when the signal is back
• Shop mode: scan a cart card or cabinet label to record its step in production

Refinery is for employees of The Refinery Custom Cabinets. Sign-in uses a company account. There is nothing to buy and no public sign-up.

name: Regwell: FAR/AIM & 14 CFR
description:
The FAR/AIM on your iPhone and iPad: the regulations kept current from the eCFR, and highlights that are never lost when a rule is amended.

Regwell has all of Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (all 198 parts in force, from Part 1 to Part 1310), the Aeronautical Information Manual with its figures, and the Pilot/Controller Glossary. It also has 49 CFR Part 830 (NTSB accident and incident reporting) and Part 1552 (TSA flight training security).

ALWAYS CURRENT
Regwell checks the eCFR once a day and downloads only the parts that were amended, so the rules on your phone match the ones in force. No yearly edition to buy again. Each page says which issue of the eCFR it comes from. The AIM and the glossary come with each app update, and Regwell tells you when faa.gov has a newer AIM change.

HIGHLIGHTS THAT STAY
Highlight in five colors, add notes, and bookmark sections with your own titles. Highlights are tied to the words, not to a page: when a section is amended they stay on the same words, or on what those words became. If the words are removed, your highlight is kept and shown apart as "from an earlier text". Nothing is deleted by an update.

WHAT CHANGED
See every amendment of the last two years, section by section, with its date. Regwell Pro adds the word-by-word view of the words added and removed. The AIM's own list of changes is there too.

SEARCH THE WAY PILOTS DO
- Type a reference and go straight to it: 91.103, 61.113(i), 14 CFR 91.155, Part 107, AIM 5-1-1
- Words find sections that have all of them, and the exact phrase ranks first
- Pilot shorthand works: ELT, PIC, BasicMed, drone, inop, TFR
- Search all texts, only the regulations, only the AIM or only the glossary

MADE FOR READING
- The parts of a FAR/AIM first: 1, 61, 67, 68, 91, 103, 107, 135, 141 and the rest, then all of Title 14
- Paragraph levels (a), (1), (i), (A) indented the way the rule reads
- Remembers where you stopped in every section
- Serif or sans serif, adjustable text size, dark mode
- Next and previous section in one tap
- Copy a passage with its citation
- Works offline: the texts are on your device

FOR STUDENTS, PILOTS, INSTRUCTORS AND MECHANICS
Private, instrument and commercial checkrides, Part 107 drone pilots, flight instructors, A&P mechanics and Part 135 operators.

REGWELL PRO
Reading, search, updates and bookmarks are included for everyone, with 5 highlights or notes. Regwell Pro adds unlimited highlights and notes, bookmark folders, iCloud sync between your iPhone and iPad, and the word-by-word view of what changed. Pro is a yearly or monthly subscription that renews automatically until you cancel it in your Apple account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Highlights you made stay yours if Pro ends.

PRIVATE
No account and no tracking. Your highlights and notes stay on your devices and, with sync on, in your own iCloud.

SOURCES AND DISCLAIMER
The regulations are the eCFR, published by the Office of the Federal Register and the Government Publishing Office. The eCFR is an editorial compilation and not an official legal edition of the CFR. The AIM and the Pilot/Controller Glossary are published by the Federal Aviation Administration. Regwell is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to the FAA, the U.S. Department of Transportation, the NTSB, the TSA or any government agency. Always check the official sources before you rely on a rule for a flight.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://regwell.baltajmn.dev/privacy/

name: Rekam - Smart Voice Recorder
description:
Record a meeting. Get to-dos. Send them to WhatsApp.

Most recorder apps stop at a transcript. Rekam stops at something you can act on: a short list of what now needs to happen.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Tap record. Lock your screen, put the phone down.
2. Tap Done. Rekam transcribes the audio and finds the action items.
3. Check them, then send to WhatsApp in one tap.

WHAT YOU GET
• Summary — the topic, what was discussed, and what was decided
• To-dos — who owns what, with a deadline when one was mentioned
• Transcript — every line, tap any line to hear that moment
• Follow-up — to-dos you have not sent or completed stay visible

BUILT FOR REAL MEETINGS
• Records with the screen off, through phone calls and app crashes. Audio is saved in short segments, so a crash costs seconds, not the whole meeting.
• Understands Indonesian, Malay, Vietnamese, Filipino, Thai and English — including the English words people mix in.
• Detects the spoken language automatically. You never pick it.
• Speaker labels show who promised what.

HONEST BY DESIGN
• Rekam never sends anything for you. It prepares the text and opens WhatsApp; you tap send.
• Tap play on any to-do to hear the exact few seconds it came from — before you send it.
• No covert recording. Recording starts only when you tap the button, and a notification is shown while it runs.

PRIVACY
Recordings stay on your phone. Audio is uploaded only when you ask for a transcript, is processed by our speech provider, and is not stored on our servers. No account, no ads, no tracking.

FREE TO TRY
Every feature is free for 7 days, up to 90 minutes of transcription. After that, subscribe to keep going: Basic gives 600 minutes a month for US$4.99, Pro gives 1,200 for US$9.99. No limit per meeting. Cancel anytime in Settings.

Terms: https://rekam-site.pages.dev/terms
Privacy: https://rekam-site.pages.dev/privacy

name: Relay VNC
description:
Relay VNC puts every computer you run one tap away. Connect to any standard VNC server, including macOS Screen Sharing, Windows, Linux and Raspberry Pi, and control it comfortably from your iPhone or iPad.

BUILT FOR EVERY SCREEN
• iPhone: trackpad mode gives you a precise cursor without your finger covering what you're clicking
• iPhone Duo: unfold to see your servers on one half and the live session on the other
• iPad: a sidebar for your servers, tabs for every open session, and two sessions side by side
• Full screen, pinch to zoom, and three input modes: Touch, Trackpad and Pan & zoom

MANY SERVERS, MANY SESSIONS
• Save every machine with its own icon, color, group and tags
• Keep several sessions live at once and switch between them instantly
• Search and filter by group, tag or favorite
• Live status shows which servers are online before you connect
• Find servers on your network automatically
• Wake sleeping computers with Wake-on-LAN
• Jump straight to recent servers from the app icon's quick actions
• Sync your servers and groups across your devices with iCloud

SECURE BY DEFAULT
• TLS encryption with certificate checks you approve
• SSH tunnels with password or private-key login and host-key verification
• Passwords and keys stay in the Keychain on your device
• Require Face ID to connect to a server, or to open the app
• With app lock on, remote screens are hidden in the app switcher
• Optionally clear the clipboard when a session ends

A REAL KEYBOARD AND MOUSE EXPERIENCE
• Built-in keyboard with Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, Cmd/Win and function keys
• Send Ctrl-Alt-Del with one tap
• Full support for hardware keyboards, mice and trackpads, including right-click and scrolling
• Two-way clipboard sharing with the remote computer
• Natural or traditional scrolling, and a larger cursor if you prefer

FAST AND SHARP
• Adaptive quality adjusts to your connection; choose Speed or Quality any time
• Efficient compressed encodings, drawn with Metal
• Set the remote resolution to fit your screen or pick 720p, 1080p or 1440p
• Choose a single display or all of them on multi-monitor computers
• Sessions pick up again when you come back to the app

HANDY EXTRAS
• Save screenshots of the remote screen to Photos or share them
• Refresh the screen, change quality and resolution from the session menu
• Pick an accent color to suit you

WORKS WITH YOUR VNC SERVER
Relay VNC speaks the standard RFB protocol, so it works with the VNC servers you already use:
• Mac Screen Sharing and Remote Management (sign in with your Mac user name and password)
• VNC servers on Windows, Linux and Raspberry Pi
• Virtual machine consoles that offer VNC
• Any server using VNC password authentication, connected directly, over TLS or through an SSH tunnel

Pay once and it's yours: no subscription, no ads and no account to create. Crash reports and anonymous usage data help fix problems, never include remote screens, passwords or what you type, and can be turned off in Settings. Your servers stay on your devices and in your own iCloud, and passwords stay in the Keychain.

name: Relay Yard
description:
A parcel is approaching a split. Can your signal reach the gate first?

Relay Yard is a single-player puzzle game about timing a conveyor line. Drag across the grid to lay belts and corners, rotate equipment, and set belt speeds. Read parcel colors and shapes, then use delayed signals to switch gates and release buffers.

Build a line and put it to work
Tackle stations and dispatch orders with mixed cargo, shipment batches, and equipment interruptions. Try different routes and signal timings to reduce congestion and deliver parcels to the right bins.

Take manual control
Play First Switch, Buffer Rhythm, and Twin Switches. Start with one gate, move on to releasing queued parcels one at a time, then sort by both color and shape across two gates. Review correct sorts, rejections, undelivered parcels, and elapsed time. Retry to beat your personal best on this device.

Follow a parcel and replay a mistake
Track an individual parcel, pause or step through the signal timeline, and jump to the moment a sort went wrong. Experiment freely in Sandbox and save different layouts as local snapshots.

Play offline on iPhone. The conveyor rules are fictional and designed for gameplay.

name: Remember Why
description: «Пам’ятай чому» – це особистий журнал рішень для людей, які хочуть, щоб їхнє майбутнє «я» бачило обґрунтування свого вибору, а не лише результат. Фіксуйте кожне рішення разом із зробленим вами вибором, основною причиною, супровідними нотатками, категорією та тим, наскільки впевнено ви себе почували на той момент. Встановлюйте дати повторного перегляду, щоб важливі причини поверталися, коли вони ще мають значення. Вкладка «Повторний перегляд» ставить у чергу рішення, які вже назріли, або ті, що втрачають впевненість. Підтверджуйте те, що все ще актуально, скоригуйте переконання або відмовтеся від причини, яка більше не підходить. Записуйте реальні результати в розділі «Результати», позначайте, чи відповідають вони вашим очікуванням, і створюйте карту наслідків для дому, грошей, роботи, здоров’я та стосунків. Шаблони виявляють рівень несподіванок, повторювані фрази причин та упередженість категорій, щоб ви могли помітити, куди зміщуються ваші припущення. «Огляд» надає часову шкалу, діапазони впевненості та підказки до переконань, коли докази та пам’ять розходяться. Додаткові зразки даних показують повний потік, перш ніж ви додасте свій перший запис. Все залишається на вашому пристрої. Обліковий запис не потрібен.

name: Rental List Pro
description:
Rental List Pro brings room inspections, furniture, damage notes and keys into one place. Add written notes and photos, then create PDF reports to review and share. Designed for tenants, landlords and property managers who want an organized record of a rental home's condition.
1.Inspect Room by Room
Create a property and add its address, move-in date and planned move-out date. Start with preset rooms and inspection items, or add your own. Mark items as normal, an issue or not applicable, then add notes and photos to document what you find.
2.Track Furniture and Damage
Record furniture quantities, condition and room assignments. Keep damage records with severity, discovery dates and repair details, and link them to relevant furniture or inspection items. Attach up to 12 photos per item for later review.
3.Compare Move-In and Move-Out
Complete the move-in inspection to establish a baseline. Review inspection items, furniture and damage during move-out, and track how many keys were received and returned to help keep the handover organized.
4.Dictate Your Notes
Type notes or choose Mandarin Chinese or English voice input. Review and edit recognized text before adding it to a note. Dictation uses Apple speech recognition, may require the internet and may send audio to Apple for processing. The app does not save recordings.
5.Export PDF Reports
Create move-in inspection and move-out comparison reports using Chinese or English templates. Choose whether to include photos and location coordinates, preview the PDF and share it through the system share sheet. Manage previously exported versions separately. Text you enter stays in its original language and is not automatically translated.
6.Local Records for Everyday Use
Property records, imported photos and reports are stored on your device, with no account required. Text entry and PDF export work offline. Address lookup, iCloud photo downloads and speech recognition may require the internet. Chinese and English interfaces and light, dark and system appearance options are supported.
Reports summarize the information you enter and do not establish legal responsibility. Imported photos are resized and re-encoded. Keep original photos separately if you need them.

name: Restos Dashboard
description:
Restos Dashboard is the companion app for restaurants and cafes that take orders on their own Restos.io website. Your orders, your menu and your opening hours, in your pocket.

NEVER MISS AN ORDER
Get an instant notification when a customer places an order. Open it, see exactly what was ordered, and confirm it with one tap. Orders that are not acknowledged keep reminding you.

RUN THE KITCHEN FROM ANYWHERE
Switch ordering on or off, set your opening hours and pause for a busy evening without opening a laptop.

KEEP YOUR MENU CURRENT
Mark a dish as unavailable, change a price or add a new item in seconds, and the change is live on your ordering website straight away.

SEE HOW YOU ARE DOING
A simple daily summary shows orders, revenue and your best sellers, so you know what is working.

ASK THE ASSISTANT
Not sure how to do something? Ask the built-in assistant in plain language and it helps you set it up.

BUILT FOR SMALL RESTAURANTS
No commission on your orders. Your customers order on your own website, and you keep the relationship.

Restos Dashboard needs a Restos.io account. Create one free at restos.io.

name: Riff Trainer: Ear Training
description:
Stop reading tabs. Start playing guitar by ear.

Riff Trainer is ear training made for guitar players. Train a few minutes a day. You listen, you answer, and you see the answer on the fretboard. Bit by bit, you learn to hear a song and find it on your guitar.

WHO IT IS FOR
• You look up a tab for every song
• You want to work out songs and riffs by ear
• You want to solo, jam and write your own riffs
• You are new to ear training, or you tried it and it did not stick
You do not need music theory. The first lessons use just three notes, and every new sound is explained in plain words.

SIX TRAINERS
• Notes: name every note by ear. All 12 notes, low, middle and high on the neck.
• Intervals: hear the distance between two notes. 12 intervals, going up, going down and played together.
• Chords: tell major from minor, then power chords, sus chords and sevenths. 10 chord types.
• Scales: know a scale by its sound. 10 scales, from major and minor to pentatonic, blues and the modes.
• Chord progressions: spot the chord moves behind thousands of songs. 8 progressions.
• Riff Recall: hear a short riff and tap it back note by note. From 3 notes up to 6, in any key.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Listen. A guitar plays a note, a chord or a riff. Replay it as often as you like.
2. Answer. Tap what you heard. If you miss, you get a tip on what to listen for and another try.
3. Find it on the neck. The answer lights up on a fretboard, so your fingers learn where the sound lives.

WHAT YOU GET
• A clear lesson path for each trainer. Each lesson teaches one new sound.
• A daily session built for you: first the sounds you need to review, then your next lesson
• Unit reviews and final tests. Already know a unit? Pass its review and skip ahead.
• Three guitar tones: steel acoustic, clean electric and nylon
• Your weak spots, your day streak and your minutes trained, all in one place
• Ranks you climb by earning XP
• One gentle daily reminder, if you want it
• No account and no sign up
• The app never uses your microphone. Train anywhere, with or without your guitar.

RIFF TRAINER PRO
The setup questions and a short ear test are free. To train after that you need a Riff Trainer Pro subscription.
• Weekly: 7 days free, then $6.99 per week
• Yearly: 7 days free, then $39.99 per year
Prices are in U.S. dollars and may be different in your country.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. With a free trial, you pay when the trial ends. Your plan renews on its own unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://rifftrainer.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://rifftrainer.com/privacy/
Questions? Email arshpreet@billionweb.co

name: RIFTAP
description:
Every touch comes back.

RIFTAP is a one-touch physics puzzle. Tap the empty space near the light and watch it move away. Three seconds later, the same point briefly pulls it back. Plan the move you make now and the one that follows.

Collect every light shard, let at least one echo appear, and reach the exit ring. Avoid the coral cores and bounce off walls to change direction. Each course gives you limited time and touches. Sometimes the best move is to wait for the echo you already left behind.

6 BASE COURSES + 12 MIRRORED MASTERY VARIATIONS
Learn pushing, pulling and timing in First Echo, Round the Corner, Close Call, Slingshot, Orbit and Butterfly Effect. Then approach those six layouts from new directions in 12 mirrored mastery variations, for 18 selectable courses in total. Place up to three rings at once and plan the order of their effects.

TRY THE DAILY COURSE
Open the daily course variation and find your own way through. Enter a course code to try the same challenge as a friend. Use your phone's share menu to send the code.

LEARN FROM YOUR LAST ATTEMPT
Watch your attempt replay inside the game and try again. Track your best successful score, touch count and time on your device. Reset your records whenever you choose while keeping your preferences.

PLAY OFFLINE
The courses are included in the app. After installation, the game itself does not need an internet connection. The app you choose for sharing, or an external support link, may use the internet.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Pause and resume when you need a moment. Turn sound effects and supported-device haptics on or off, reduce motion effects, and switch between English and Turkish.

The echo that pulls you back could carry you to the exit. Set your next move in motion.

name: RightsCard: Know Your Rights
description:
RightsCard puts a know-your-rights card on your phone.

One side is for you, in your language: keep your door closed, stay silent, sign nothing, ask if you are free to go. The other side is for the agent, in English. It says you are using your right to remain silent, that you do not consent to entry or a search, and that you want to talk to a lawyer. One tap fills the screen with it and keeps the screen bright. The app can also read it aloud.

IN 12 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, Arabic, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), French, Haitian Creole, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Tagalog and Vietnamese. Outside English the text is a machine translation that no fluent speaker has reviewed yet; the app says so.

MAKE A SMALL PLAN
Five steps you can do at home with people you trust: who to call, a paper contact list, family care, where documents are, and practice finding your card. Only checkmarks are saved.

HELP CLOSE TO HOME
A short directory of nonprofit, legal-aid and community organizations: detention hotlines, free legal help, rapid-response lines, family preparedness guides. It starts with the Lehigh Valley and Pennsylvania, plus national hotlines. No for-profit providers are listed.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No analytics. Nothing leaves your phone. The card and the checklist work without a connection.

RightsCard gives general information about rights under the U.S. Constitution. It is not legal advice and does not create an attorney-client relationship. A rights card communicates a choice; it cannot guarantee an outcome. RightsCard is an independent project and is not affiliated with any government agency.

name: Ring Release: Clip Puzzle
description:
Turn the rings. Set them free.

Every ring is held in place by clips. Drag a ring around its center, and when its gap slides past a clip, the clip lets go. A ring with nothing left holding it shatters. Clear every ring to finish the level.

Sounds simple, until a ring refuses to move: a ring can't turn while its own clips still hold another ring. Find the right order and the whole puzzle comes apart in one satisfying chain.

• One simple move, lots of thinking: no timers, no lives, no pressure.
• 500 levels across colorful chapters, with hard levels and big boss puzzles.
• Earn up to three stars on every level, and replay any level for more.
• Stuck? Earn a free hint every 3 levels.
• Crisp, calm feel: snappy clips, glassy shatters, gentle sounds and haptics.
• Plays offline. In English and Turkish.

The first 100 levels are free. The full game is a single one-time purchase that unlocks levels 101 to 500 with three new ring types (padlocks, bombs and frozen rings) and removes the ads between levels. No subscriptions.

Optional extras: a pack of 5 hints and level skips for the hardest levels.

Questions or ideas? Write to support@criccletech.com.

name: Rise Rumble
description:
Twelve heroes. One arena.

Rise Rumble is a pixel fighting game built from THE RISE COLLECTION. Every fighter steps out of one of our games or apps: the Ronin from Lantern Ronin, Mr. Baaa from Baaridge, the Scarecrow from Last Harvest, Big Red from Keep On Trucking, Mr. Bird from Attack Of The Circle, and seven more.

EASY TO PICK UP
Walk, hit, jump, guard. Tap HIT as each blow lands for a three-hit combo. Press GUARD just before a hit lands to parry it and leave your rival reeling. A guided first fight teaches it all in a minute.

EVERY FIGHTER IS DIFFERENT
Each hero has their own speed, power and reach, and a signature special: the Ronin's iai dash, Big Red's big rig that roars across the screen, BR4KE's red light that freezes you in place, Kessler's rain of space junk, Point Five splitting in two. Plus two command moves each: launchers, cross-ups, counters, armored charges.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Arcade: six rivals, then a shadow boss. Every fighter has an ending.
- Online: fight a friend on their own phone with a 4-digit code.
- Versus: any fighter against any fighter, on your terms.
- Survival: one health bar. How many in a row?
- Training: practice combos on a dummy.

FIGHTER FILES
Read the story of every fighter and the game they came from.

MADE TO PLAY WELL
Twelve home stages, a chiptune soundtrack, a sound for every special, haptics, Game Center leaderboards and 24 achievements, game controller support, Reduce Flashing, left-handed controls and big buttons.

No ads. No account. Plays offline. Every fighter and mode is included. An optional Supporter Pack adds alternate colors for every fighter.

name: RishiOra – Vedic Puja
description:
RishiOra – Step-by-Step Vedic Puja

Perform Hindu puja at home with clear, traditional, step-by-step guidance. RishiOra shows you what to do, which mantra to chant, which samagri to use and when to move to the next step.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Follow puja vidhi step by step
• Listen to Sanskrit mantras and shlokas, and chant along with the audio
• Read each mantra in Devanagari, Roman transliteration and with its Hindi meaning
• Know exactly what action to perform at each step
• Follow the sankalp, puja, havan, aarti and katha in order
• Prepare the puja samagri with a checklist
• Use the chanting audio offline once it has downloaded

GUIDED PUJA EXPERIENCE
Instead of reading one long procedure, RishiOra guides you through the ritual in sequence. Each step can show:
1. What to do
2. What to say
3. The Sanskrit mantra or shloka
4. Its transliteration
5. Audio of the chanting
6. Its meaning
7. The samagri needed
8. When to continue to the next step

TRADITIONAL PUJA VIDHI
• Daily puja for Ganesh, Lakshmi, Shiv, Vishnu, Krishna, Hanuman and Durga
• Navratri puja for all nine days, with Ghatasthapana (Kalash Sthapana), Kanya Puja and Visarjan
• Diwali Lakshmi Ganesh puja, Dhanteras, Chhoti Diwali and Govardhan puja
• Ganesh Chaturthi, Janmashtami, Mahashivratri, Ram Navami, Holi, Dussehra and Kali puja
• Karwa Chauth, Raksha Bandhan, Hartalika Teej, Vat Savitri, Ahoi Ashtami and Varalakshmi vrat
• Satyanarayan puja and katha, Griha Pravesh, Griha Shanti, Navagraha puja, Rudrabhishek, Lakshmi Kuber and Saraswati puja, Annaprashan
• Havan vidhi: Ganapati and Durga havan, with a safety checklist

ALSO INSIDE
• Hanuman puja with the Sankat Mochan Hanuman Ashtak
• Auto pooja: plays every mantra of a puja in order, with a short pause after each shloka
• 16 sanskars, from Garbhadhana to Vivaha
• Aarti collection
• Hindu Panchang calendar with festival dates
• Hindi and English, with a larger-text option

ABOUT THE AUDIO
The chanting voice is AI-generated; it is not a recording of a real priest. The puja audio downloads in the background after you install the app, and then works offline.

DAKSHINA – SHARE THE BHAKTI
Share RishiOra with family and friends on WhatsApp to earn dakshina points (up to 3 a day). At 151 points you can request a Kamadhenu Puja, performed by a priest in your name; you send your name, gotra and place by email. We never call you and never ask for money for this puja.

PRIVACY
No account and no sign-in. Your profile and progress stay on your phone. The app sends no data; the App Store delivers the audio.

PLEASE NOTE
RishiOra is an independent app; it is not affiliated with any ashram or temple. RishiOra gives traditional guidance for puja at home; it does not replace a priest for ceremonies that need one. Check your local panchang for muhurat. Keep children near a diya or havan only under adult supervision.

RishiOra – Step-by-Step Vedic Puja.

name: Rocklume Nova Factory
description:
Rocklume Nova Factory is a casual game app with three original games — two puzzle games and one quick mini game. Each one is easy to learn and made for short, relaxing breaks.

FLUX CYLINDERS — Pipe Puzzle · 20 Levels
Spin the cylinders to line up the pipes and guide the glowing plasma from IN at the top to OUT at the bottom. Earn up to 3 stars per level by solving within the target spin count. Stuck? Use the hint button to see how far the plasma reaches.

STAR TETHERS — Star Puzzle · 20 Levels + Daily Challenge
Move stars across the sky chart until every light tether shines. Crossed tethers go dark, and black holes swallow any tether that touches them. Locked stars can't move — plan your path carefully. A brand-new puzzle appears every day in the Daily Challenge.

NOVA MILL — Mini Game · Easy, Medium & Hard
Drop rocks from the hopper into spinning rotors that crush them into crystal shards. Tap glowing jars before they spill and launch them for points. Build rush combos by launching consecutive jars within seconds. Upgrade your hopper, rotors, and pods to push your score higher.

FEATURES
• 40 handcrafted puzzle levels across two games
• A new Daily Challenge every day (works offline)
• 20 achievement badges to collect
• Three difficulty modes in Nova Mill
• Score history with up to 300 rounds
• Sound effects and haptic feedback
• Shape markers for colour-blind accessibility
• Larger game text option
• Dynamic Type support
• Works fully offline — no internet needed
• No account, no sign-in
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking

MADE FOR EVERYONE
Simple rules, bright visuals, and helpful accessibility options. Suitable for all ages. Points and stars only show your progress — they have no real-world value.

YOUR PRIVACY
We collect no data. Everything you do stays on your device. No analytics, no ads, no tracking. Nothing is ever sent anywhere.

name: Rockwell Island Residences
description:
Rockwell Island Residences is the private app for homeowners of Rockwell Island in Bimini, The Bahamas.

It has one job: tell the community gate who is allowed in, and tell you when they arrive.

FOR HOMEOWNERS ONLY
Your account is created by the Rockwell Island office. There is no public sign-up. If you own on the island and do not have an account yet, ask the office for an invitation.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Add renters with their dates of stay, so the gate expects them.
- Add family and friends who are welcome any time.
- Add a visitor for one day, such as a contractor or a delivery.
- See who arrived at the gate, and when.
- Get an alert on your phone or an email when someone arrives (optional).
- Keep a do-not-admit list for people the gate must not let in.
- Make the text bigger if you want it easier to read.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
- Large buttons and plain words.
- Only gate security and office staff see what you enter. Other homeowners never do.
- Unlock the app with Face ID or your fingerprint (optional).
- We do not sell your information, show ads, or track you.
- Delete your account yourself, any time, from the More tab.

Questions? Open More, then Help and contact, or email alvarez.brendon10@gmail.com.

name: Roofstead
description:
Roofstead is the roofing CRM built by roofers, for roofers. Your office and your crews work the same jobs in one place, and the iPhone app puts all of it in the truck with you.

This app is for roofing companies already running on Roofstead. Your company admin adds you, then you sign in with your work email or Google.

ON THE ROOF
- Shoot photos and video straight into the job file, or pull them from your camera roll
- Scan contracts, insurance paperwork and receipts into clean PDFs
- Get a heads-up the moment your upload is saved
- Lose signal up top? The app tells you and picks back up when you're in range

IN THE TRUCK
- Pipeline, schedule and job files sized for your phone
- Homeowner's phone, address and directions one tap away
- Estimates, invoices, material orders, work orders and supplements on every job
- Tag the office on a job note so nothing slips through the cracks
- Hail maps for the areas you work

FOR YOUR CREWS
- A crew view with today's jobs, addresses and what to bring
- Crews upload photos, invoices and receipts from the job site
- Spanish for crews that want it

BUILT AROUND ROOFING
- Insurance and retail jobs side by side
- Supplement tracking and insurance worksheets
- A Roofstead job link in a text or email opens right in the app

Roofstead is a product of Roofstead LLC.

name: Rostra: Give Words a Voice
description:
Rostra reads text aloud in clear, natural-sounding voices, on your iPhone. Paste an article, an email or your own draft, share a web page from Safari, or open a text, Markdown, RTF or PDF file, and listen while you walk, cook, commute or give your eyes a rest.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
The text you read is never uploaded. There is no account to create and nothing tracks you. Reading works offline, so a flight or a weak signal does not stop it.

ADD SOMETHING TO READ
• Paste: tap Paste and Rostra starts reading what you copied.
• Share: in Safari or any app that shares text, tap Share, then Rostra.
• Open a text, Markdown, RTF or PDF file.
• Your library remembers where you stopped, so you can pick up later.

LISTEN YOUR WAY
• Hazel and Isabella, in American and British accents, each with a lighter, quicker version.
• Speeds from 0.8× to 2×.
• Follow along: the part being read is highlighted.
• Keeps reading with the screen locked, with controls on the lock screen.
• Pause, skip back and skip ahead.

MAKE IT SAY IT RIGHT
• Smart Text Cleanup takes out citation numbers, chat markers and other clutter that sounds wrong aloud.
• Prices, dates and abbreviations are read the way you would say them.

FREE
Rostra is free. You can read up to 7,500 words a week, and the count starts again every Monday.

Questions or a problem? Write to support@userostra.com.

name: Rotaray: Metro & Rail Planner
description:
Rotaray helps you plan metro, tram, suburban rail and metrobus journeys in Istanbul, Izmir, Ankara, Bursa, Eskisehir and Kocaeli. Find nearby stations with walking times to their entrances, then plan a route with transfers and an estimated arrival time.

NEARBY STATIONS
• See walking times and distances to station entrances.
• Check lines, upcoming departures and last trains, using scheduled departure times where available.

ROUTE PLANNING
• Follow your journey step by step: transfers, stops, waiting times and estimated arrival.
• See when a route would miss the last train.
• Accessible routes use entrances known to support wheelchair access.
• View fares based on published operator tariffs.

LAST TRAIN REMINDERS
• Get a notification before you need to leave to catch your route's last train. Reminders are scheduled on your iPhone; no account is needed.

SHARE YOUR ROUTE
• Share a short route link that opens in Rotaray when the app is installed. Your current location is never included in the link.

LINES AND STATIONS
• Explore line guides, station sequences, nearby places and maps across six Turkish cities.

PRIVACY
• No account required and currently no ads. Your location is used to find nearby stations and walking directions; it is not stored.

Rotaray is an independent project and is not affiliated with any municipality or transit operator. Timetables and fares come from published operator sources. Check operator announcements before travelling.

name: RoundQuota
description:
Plan how to divide limited places across groups, then use what actually happened to guide the next round.

RoundQuota helps workshop coordinators, community organizers, and teams manage recurring allocations. Start a project for each activity, enter the places available, and set a weight for every participating group. Add minimums or caps where needed. RoundQuota shows which rules conflict if they cannot fit within the total.

Compare two plans for the same round
• Round Only uses the current total, weights, and limits.
• Carry Forward also accounts for the difference between each group's target share and what it received in earlier rounds.
• See how many whole places each group would get and how each option would affect its balance.

Record the distribution
Save the plan you intend to use. When the round takes place, enter the actual count for each group. If you followed the plan, you can fill blank counts from it and review them before confirming. The ledger tracks places that went unused. You can correct a past distribution and review how the change affects later balances.

Keep planning across rounds
View each group's cumulative balance and compare planned, target, and actual counts in History. Start the next round from the previous setup and adjust its total, groups, or limits as needed. Try the built-in workshop example to see why two plans with the same total can assign places differently.

Keep a record you can take with you
Manage separate projects on your iPhone or iPad. Import CSV records, export allocation details or a comparison report, and share a project backup. Restore a backup as a separate project to keep both copies available in your project list.

RoundQuota works offline and requires no account.

name: Run My Turf
description:
Walk. Run. Join in.
RunMyTurf is a calm, welcoming walking and running companion built for everyday movement, friendly neighbourhood competition, and live community events. Start an outdoor walk or run immediately as a guest, or sign in with Apple or Google to back up your progress, join group runs, claim local territories, and take part in organised races.

EVERYDAY WALKING & RUNNING (NO SIGN-IN REQUIRED)
• Instant Start: Record outdoor walks and runs right away as a guest—no account wall required to get moving.
• Daily Step Ring: Track your daily step goal, active time, and distance in one clean, distraction-free dashboard, with optional Apple Health step integration.
• Clear Live Coaching: Follow your live GPS route, pace, distance, elapsed time, and kilometer splits with optional voice cues.
• Offline Maps: Download your local area beforehand so maps stay crisp even when mobile signal drops.

ORGANISED COMMUNITY EVENTS (FROM REGISTRATION TO FINISH LINE)
• Discover Nearby Events: Browse upcoming public walks, 5K/10K runs, and community race days happening around you.
• One-Tap Registration & Digital Bib: Register in seconds, pick your distance category, and receive your personal bib number.
• Arrival Self Check-In: Arrive at the venue on race day and tap "I've arrived" when you enter the check-in zone, or check in via QR code.
• Live Start Horn (3... 2... 1... GO!): Get a pre-start alert to lock your GPS at the starting line. When the organiser sounds the wave start horn, your phone vibrates and counts down 3... 2... 1... GO! to start recording automatically.
• Host Your Own Events: Organisers and race volunteers can set up multi-distance events, manage wave starts, and record finish-line times with built-in organiser and staff tools.

MOVE TOGETHER: GROUP RUNS & WEEKLY CHALLENGES
• Group Runs: Plan a casual morning walk or evening run with friends, share a single invite code, and see everyone's completion status.
• Weekly Habits & Challenges: Build steady consistency together with shared step, distance, or active-day goals.

EXPLORE TURF: TERRITORIES & RACE TURF
• Claim Neighbourhood Territories: Walk or run a closed loop (at least 0.5 km) that returns to your starting point to claim your local Turf on the map.
• Defend & Expand: Walk or run your loops regularly to keep your territories active.
• Race Turf Courses: Follow fixed neighbourhood routes from start to finish and beat the elapsed-time record to earn the course crown.

DESIGNED FOR TRUST, PRIVACY & CONTROL
• Private by Default: Your activity history and routes stay under your control.
• Easy Cloud Backup: Sign in anytime with Apple or Google to sync your walks, runs, territories, and event results safely across devices.

name: RunStat: Run Art
description:
RunStat turns the routes you run into drawings and grows a character as you run.
It reads the runs saved in Apple Health and shows each route as a drawing card, and the time and days you ran as your character's stats.

[YOUR RUN BECOMES A DRAWING]
- The shape of every route becomes a drawing. There is no map, only the line.
- Name the drawing and pick a card color: Paper, Night or Track.
- The card shows distance, time, pace and the date. You can leave the date off.
- Share the card as an image, or send a link. Whoever gets the link sees the drawing on the web.
- "Hide the first and last 150 m" is on by default, so the place you set off from does not show in the drawing.

[A CHARACTER THAT GROWS AS YOU RUN]
- Your runs become three stats: Endurance, Consistency and Art. Their sum is your Total.
- Everyone starts from the same egg. When Total reaches 100 it hatches as Strider, Ticktock or Doodle, depending on your highest stat.
- The character grows every time Total rises by 100 and evolves to Lv.2 at 500.
- Running faster or farther does not earn more. Endurance stops rising after 60 minutes a day, and three or four runs a week are plenty for Consistency. Streaks are not counted, so rest days are fine.

[YOUR RECORDS STAY ON YOUR IPHONE]
- Imported runs and drawings are stored only on your iPhone. They are not uploaded to iCloud and are left out of iPhone backups.
- There is no developer server. Your records are not sent to the developer or any other company, and the developer cannot see them.
- Where you ran (latitude and longitude) is never stored. A route is turned into the shape of a drawing on your iPhone and then discarded. Shared cards and links contain no location either.
- No account, sign-up or login. Install it and start.
- No ads, analytics or tracking. No subscription and no in-app purchases.

[APPLE HEALTH]
- Access is requested only when you tap "Connect Apple Health". RunStat reads Workouts (running) and Workout Routes only.
- It is read-only. Nothing is written to Apple Health.
- When you first connect, runs from the last 90 days are imported and shown as drawings. Only runs from the day you connect count toward your character's growth.
- The data is not used for advertising or marketing and is not uploaded anywhere.
- Run with the Workout app on Apple Watch, or any app that saves your run to Apple Health as a workout. A drawing needs a workout that includes a route.

[LOOK AROUND WITH SAMPLE RUNS]
- No runs in the Health app yet? "Look around with sample runs" lets you see the screens first.
- The samples are made up. They are not saved and are never mixed into your own records.

[GOOD TO KNOW]
- A run without a route, such as an indoor run, is imported with distance and time only. No drawing can be made for it.
- The shape of a route alone can hint at a neighborhood. Take a look at a card before you share it.
- There is no sync between devices. On a new iPhone you can import from the Health app again, but names you gave your drawings do not carry over.
- Settings > Delete all records removes everything imported. Runs in the Health app are not deleted.
- Distances are shown in kilometers or miles, following your iPhone's measurement system.
- Available in English and Korean.

[NOT MEDICAL OR TRAINING ADVICE]
RunStat is an app for enjoying your running records. It does not provide advice, diagnosis or treatment about your body, injuries or training, and it is not a medical device. Stats are just your records turned into game numbers; they do not assess your health or fitness. Talk to a doctor or another professional about health decisions.

Contact: choishiam@gmail.com
Privacy Policy: https://runstat.boxlogodev.workers.dev/en/privacy/

name: RynquessaCondensate
description:
A surface-temperature reading is more useful when its cylinder context travels with it.
Rynquessa Condensate organizes cylinder references, observations and planned checks.

CYLINDER IDENTITY
Identify the machine, section and installed position.
Associate the steam group and paper grade with the cylinder.
Keep its supporting references close to the equipment record.

RECORDED THERMAL EVIDENCE
Add a date to each surface-temperature observation.
Preserve the temperature in its original measurement unit.
Specify the measurement method and the exact reading position.
Include steam and condensate notes with the observation.
Return to individual measurements without losing their context.

COMPARISONS WITH BOUNDARIES
Review summaries only across compatible measurement groups.
Keep unlike readings out of direct comparison.
Open the individual measurements supporting each summary.
Understand a result from its actual sources rather than assumed values.

HISTORY AND NEXT CHECKS
Revisit dated entries as cylinder details evolve.
Keep earlier observations available for historical review.
Schedule a reminder for a future surface check.
Keep planned work separate from checks already recorded.
Review notes, measurement locations and conditions together.
Use recorded evidence to prepare for the next inspection.
Rynquessa Condensate supports careful review, not automatic verification.
Operating decisions still require approved site procedures and qualified judgment.

name: Samurai Archery
description:
Samurai Archery is a bow and arrow archery game set in feudal Japan, on kyudo's Way of the Bow. Draw the yumi, breathe out and loose. Read the wind, lob arrows over castle walls, shoot yabusame from a galloping horse and hold the gate against an oni charge, across sixty stages and six rival archers.

You begin at the dojo range with a plain bamboo bow and four arrows, and a senior who has never lost on his range. Beyond the dojo the road climbs to marks on high mountain ledges, runs down a riding track at full gallop, and ends at a burning castle and a shrine in the storm, where a dragon waits above it all.

DRAW, BREATHE, LOOSE
• Pull back to draw and aim with one finger. The aiming arc shows the flight.
• Hold through the sway and loose on the exhale for a clean release and more points.
• Real bow and arrow shooting: gravity, drag and the wind decide where every arrow lands.

FIVE PLACES, SIXTY STAGES
• The Dojo Range, the Mountain Field, the Riding Track, the Castle Siege and the Dragon Shrine.
• Lob over walls in a mountain wind, ride at the gallop, hold the gate against oni.
• Three stars on every stage, each one a goal of its own.

THE FLETCHER'S ROAD
• After the dojo, twelve trials of the crafted arrow.
• Fire arrows light braziers, kegs and paper walls. Rope arrows carry a line for a messenger.
• Whistling arrows scare crows and horses. Split arrows strike two marks at once.
• Gather feathers, iron heads, hemp and pitch, and craft your own arrows.

RIVALS AND BOSSES
• Six rival archers shoot the same marks in a duel. You take turns, and you watch each rival draw and loose his own arrow. Beat his total to pass.
• An oni general at the castle gate and the storm dragon above the shrine, and neither falls to one arrow.

PLAY AS A LEGENDARY HEROINE
• Twelve heroines, from Kagari the Ember Ronin to Kurenai the Blood-Moon Miko.
• Ten heroes in traditional dress, from Jubei the Grey Ronin to Lord Masakage.
• Each painted for every draw, on foot and on horseback.
• Looks only: whoever you play, you aim and score the same.

THE ARMOURY
• Six yumi, eleven fletchings and five outfits to win on the road, or to buy.
• Plus three legendary bows and three legendary fletchings.
• Every bow has its own hand: a steadier hold, a longer exhale, less wind, a quicker nock.
• Painted fletchings leave their own trail: crane mist, sakura petals, ember sparks, phoenix flame.

A DAILY MARK AND THE SAMURAI RANKS
• A new daily stage every day, with a streak to keep.
• Every stage pays koban. Rise from Ashigaru through the samurai ranks to Daimyo, from novice to archery master.

THE FLETCHER'S WORKSHOP
• Supplies for a hard stage: Spirit Draught, Calm Tea and Hawk's Eye.
• Arrow trails and painted rival scrolls for your collection.
• Pay with koban earned in play, or buy outright. The heroines, two legendary trails and two boss scrolls are sold for money only.
• Patron of the Range: sixteen wallpapers from the game's paintings and your thanks in the credits.

FOR GROWN-UPS
A samurai archery game made for adults. The paintings are dusk, fire and storm, the heroines are painted for grown-ups, and oni fall with arrows in them as the strike throws red. The range is played in landscape, on iPhone and iPad.

Draw. Breathe. Loose.

name: SANDER – Beach Volley
description:
SANDER è l'app del beach volley in Riviera. Trovi con chi giocare, organizzi la partita e vedi come cresce il tuo livello, tutto in un posto.

PARTITE VICINO A TE
• Crea una partita 2v2, 3v3 o 4v4 in pochi secondi e trova i giocatori che mancano
• Vedi le partite con posti liberi nel tuo comune e nel tuo bagno
• «Sono libero»: fai sapere quando puoi giocare, mattina, pomeriggio o sera

SCOPRI: TROVA CON CHI GIOCARE
Scorri i profili dei giocatori della tua zona: foto in campo e tre risposte («Il mio colpo migliore è…»). Metti like a una foto o a una risposta e scrivi un commento. Se il like è reciproco è match: chattate, scegliete giorno e bagno, e la partita finisce in calendario.
Scopri è riservato ai maggiorenni.

COPPIE 2V2
Forma la tua coppia fissa, sfida le altre coppie e scala la classifica. Potete anche iscrivervi insieme ai tornei.

TORNEI
King of the Beach, gironi, eliminazione diretta e Chicece, con iscrizioni e risultati in diretta.

LA TUA CARTA GIOCATORE
Livello, partite, percentuale di vittorie, rating e classifica del tuo comune. Dopo ogni partita vedi quanto sei cresciuto. Ogni bagno ha il suo Re.

GIOCATORI AFFIDABILI
Chi si presenta alle partite ottiene il badge verificato e sale nei suggerimenti.

SICUREZZA
Puoi bloccare e segnalare un giocatore in ogni momento, anche per una foto o un messaggio. Le segnalazioni vengono controllate dal nostro team. Puoi eliminare il tuo account dall'app in qualsiasi momento.

Fatto in Romagna, da chi gioca, per chi gioca. Ci vediamo in spiaggia.

name: Sands: Hourglass Timer
description:
Sands is a timer you can watch.

Every grain in the glass is simulated one by one. The sand pours through the neck, builds a pile, and the last grain lands exactly when your time is up. Tilt your iPhone and the sand leans with it. Turn the phone over and the hourglass turns too.

SET IT IN A SECOND
• Slide the dial from 1 to 60 minutes and press play
• Seven sand colours: Golden, Ivory, Rose, Obsidian, Azure, Sage and Terracotta
• Soft sand sound, a chime at the end, and haptics you can feel as the grains fall

MADE FOR FOCUS, TEA AND EVERYTHING BETWEEN
• Presets for the timers you use every day: Focus, Tea, Break, Meditate, or your own
• Sequences run timers back to back, such as Pomodoro rounds of focus and break
• History shows your sessions for today and this week

EVERYWHERE YOU LOOK
• Rings when time is up, even in silent mode, with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy widgets
• Control Centre controls, Siri and Shortcuts: "Start Tea in Sands"
• Set a preset and sand colour for each Focus

ON YOUR WRIST
• An Apple Watch app with its own hourglass, presets and complications
• Shows the timer running on your iPhone, or runs one on its own

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Sands collects no data
• Optionally saves finished sessions to Apple Health as Mindful Minutes

SANDS PLUS
Sands is free to use in full for one week. After that, starting a timer needs a Sands Plus subscription: $11.99 a year or $1.99 a month (prices vary by country).
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://ardisol.com/apps/sands/privacy

name: Sato Mura
description:
Sato Mura is a village builder with a long memory. You start with a bell, four villagers and a patch of land. You grow it into a town that mines, trades and builds one great work.

Choose one of six cultures: Japan, Vikings, Egypt, the Andes, the Mediterranean or the Pacific islands. Each has its own look, names, landscape and one small trait. The rules are the same everywhere.

What you do
- Gather timber, stone and clay. Better tools let you mine deeper, from wood to stone, copper, iron and a rare material.
- Watch villagers chop, plant, dig and carry. Trees fall and regrow. Worn paths become roads.
- Claim land chunk by chunk. Send an explorer to find clay, ore and good places to expand.
- Found new villages at mountains and mines. Link them with routes and carts.
- Trade with neighboring partners when your own deposits run out.
- Upgrade buildings, choose policies, and finish the Great Bell, your final project.

Your village keeps working while you are away. Time passes in the village, but the game only works it out when you return. Nothing is lost or broken while you are gone.

What it does not do
- No account.
- No ads.
- No tracking.
- No data leaves your phone.
- Every feature is free. If you like it, there is a small tip jar.

Also in the game: seasons and weather, a quiet ledger of firsts, a photo mode for sharing your village, and a soft sound world for each culture. All of it is optional.

Made by one person. The art and the sound are drawn with code.

name: Scan2Approve
description:
Scan2Approve is the approval app for companies that run on the Paylalo ERP. Every document Paylalo prints carries a QR code. Point your iPhone at it and the document opens on your screen, ready for your decision.

Scan and read
Scan the QR code on a purchase request, canvass, purchase order, sales order, delivery receipt, payment request, voucher and more. You can also pick a saved photo of the code. The app shows the header, the line items and the totals, the same figures the web app shows.

Approve, post or sign
If the document is waiting for you, the buttons you are allowed to use appear at the bottom: approve, post or sign. Where a signature is needed, sign with your finger and it is stamped on the printed document.

Your access, your rules
The app follows the same rules as the Paylalo web apps. You only see documents from your own company, and you can only act on a document when your role and its approval hierarchy say you can. Documents that have no approval step open as view only.

Comments
Read the comments on a document and add your own before you decide.

Who it is for
Scan2Approve is for employees of companies that already use Paylalo. Sign in with the username and password your company's Paylalo administrator gave you. There is no sign-up in the app.

name: Schoolkid Engage
description:
Schoolkid Engage is a calm, fast way for parents to keep up with school. Sign in with your school's existing SEQTA Engage account and everything is laid out clearly for each of your children.

RESULTS AND FEEDBACK
• Marks, grades and percentages at a glance, with teacher feedback, rubrics and marked work in one place
• Photos, PDFs and Word documents open right in the assessment, full width and easy to read
• See who the class teacher is, and email them in a tap

NEVER MISS WHAT'S NEW
• Get an alert when new assessment results or feedback are released
• A badge shows how many updates you haven't seen yet
• Upcoming work is listed with due dates, and anything overdue is flagged

TIMETABLE
• The whole week at a glance, or a day at a time
• Knows the school cycle: "Day 3, Week A" right at the top
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show the day and the next lesson

MORE
• School news and notices, and academic reports as PDFs
• Several children and several schools, each kept separate
• Works on iPhone and iPad

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Schoolkid Engage talks directly to your school. Your sign-in stays in your device's Keychain, nothing is sent to us, and there are no ads or tracking. It's read-only: it never submits work or sends messages on your behalf.

Try it without an account: tap "Explore the demo" to look around with fictional data.

Schoolkid Engage is an independent app. It is not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by SEQTA, Education Horizons or your school. It requires a school that uses SEQTA Engage for parents.

name: Schspd
seller_name: ARDA EGITIM TESISLERI TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
Thanks for downloading and trying it out—your support is our motivation, and your feedback shows us the way forward.

Every urge is a glitch. Schspd helps you ride it out.

The mindless scroll. The bored snack. The 1 a.m. shopping cart. Biting your nails, or putting off the one thing you meant to start. Urges like these peak and fade, often within a minute or two. Schspd gives you something to do in those minutes, and a record of how it went.

HOW A ROUND WORKS
• When the pull hits, open the app and slam the big red GLITCH! stamp.
• Log it in seconds: which habit, how hard it's pulling (1 to 5), and an optional trigger tag such as bored, stressed, tired, social or restless.
• Draw a counter-move card from your own deck: ten slow breaths, a glass of water, stand and stretch, write one line, step outside. Don't like the card? Shuffle for another.
• Press and hold the clock to start a 90-second fight round. Call it early if the urge passes, or wait for the bell.
• Mark the round WON or LOST. Either way it goes on the record, honestly.

THE RECORD
• Win rate, rounds this week and your current win streak.
• An hour-of-day by weekday heatmap that shows when your urges hit hardest.
• Top triggers and a breakdown for each habit, with how often you win against each one.
• Your full round history, with the option to delete any entry.

YOUR CORNER
• Add, rename or remove your own glitches. Edit your move deck so every card fits your life.
• Pick a round length of 60, 90 or 120 seconds, choose whether the week starts on Monday, and turn haptics on or off.

BUILT LIKE A FIGHT POSTER
A punk-zine look with riso inks: photocopy grey, heavy black, red and blue printed slightly out of register. The two colours snap together when you win and shake apart when you lose.

PRIVATE, SYNCED, OFFLINE-FRIENDLY
Sign in with Apple, Google or email, or skip and start as a guest. You can save your guest data to an account later. Your data syncs securely and only you can read it. The app keeps working offline. You can delete your account and everything in it from the Corner at any time.

Schspd is a habit and focus tool. It is not medical advice or treatment.

name: Scope Tally
description:
Keep the extras in scope. Scope Tally helps freelancers and small studios record extra client requests, prepare clear PDF proposals and remember approved work that still needs invoicing.

START WITH THE AGREEMENT
Save the original deliverables, fee and currency. Add each extra request with its proposed scope, added fee, estimated effort and schedule impact.

MAKE THE NEXT STEP CLEAR
Preview and share a PDF through your chosen app. Mark the proposal sent, record the client's actual response and keep its source reference. Sent proposals stay fixed; revisions become separate drafts while preserving the original history.

REMEMBER TO INVOICE
