See approved extras still to invoice, with separate totals for each currency. Add your invoice reference when you have issued it. Archived projects remain available.

USEFUL FOR FREE
• Two active projects
• Unlimited requests within projects
• PDF proposal exports
• Project archives
• JSON backup and restore
• AUD, USD, GBP, EUR, CAD and NZD records, kept separate

OPTIONAL ONE-TIME PLUS
Unlock unlimited active projects and your business name on PDFs with one non-consumable in-app purchase. No subscription. Existing projects remain readable and editable without Plus.

PRIVATE AND PRACTICAL
No account, ads, analytics or app server. Project work stays on your iPhone and works offline. Purchases and restores require an internet connection. Export a private backup before changing phones or uninstalling.

Scope Tally records what you enter. It does not send proposals automatically, verify client approvals, generate tax invoices, calculate tax, determine contract rights or process payments. Keep original agreements and correspondence separately. Invoiced does not mean paid.

Privacy: https://jk-207.github.io/ledger-app-support/scopetally/#privacy
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Scoreloaf
description:
A loaf only opens where you tell it to.

In Scoreloaf you are the baker before dawn. Test the proof, score the dough with quick, sure strokes, and slide it into the oven. Then watch through the oven window as every cut you made blooms open.

A proud ear means a happy customer.

- Swipe to score: speed sets depth, order sets shape
- A large oven window that plays each bake as a time-lapse
- Batards, boules, baguettes and rye
- Leaf and wheat patterns for decorative orders
- A gallery of cut patterns from other bakers
- A log of every loaf you have baked

Sharp blade. Calm hand.

name: SCPT – Pentecostal Theology
description:
The official app of the Society for Caribbean Pentecostal Theology (SCPT), the bilingual community of scholars, ministers and students advancing Pentecostal theology in the Caribbean and its diaspora.

• Watch the full recordings of the 2026 Inaugural Conference and jump straight to any session. Members watch free.
• Start each day with a Bible verse and a short prayer, and share them as images.
• Read the Society's blog in the same design as the website, save articles and adjust the text size.
• Browse the Journal and the monograph series, and submit your own work for review.
• See the conference programme and add sessions to your calendar with reminders.
• Apply for membership, carry your digital member card and view your certificates.
• Read the Rules of the Society, search any section and open the official PDF.
• Support the Society's work with a one-time or monthly gift.

Everything is available in English and Spanish. Members sign in with the same account they use on scptheology.org.

name: Scroll the Epics: The World
description:
The great epics of the world, each told in about 75 minutes, one card at a time. Every card is read aloud, so you can read, listen, or do both.

THREE EPICS TO START
• The Ramayan: Rama and Sita, fourteen years in the forest, Hanuman's leap and the road home
• The Mahabharat: two families of cousins, a game of dice, and the war at Kurukshetra
• The Odyssey: Odysseus's ten years at sea, the Cyclops, Circe, and the long way back to Ithaca

A NEW EPIC EVERY MONTH
Twelve more arrive one a month in free updates, through November 2027: Journey to the West, the Iliad, Gilgamesh, the Shahnameh, Beowulf, the Aeneid, the Kalevala, the Divine Comedy and more. Fifteen epics, one price.

IN ENGLISH AND HINDI
Read and hear the Ramayan and the Mahabharat in English or Hindi, or see both on screen together, with the Hindi read aloud and the English beneath.

MADE FOR READING
• Each epic keeps your place, so you can move between them
• Auto-scroll carries you from card to card, at the speed you choose
• Explain notes open up names, places and ideas
• Save the cards you love
• All narration is in the app, so it works offline

One payment. No subscription, no ads, no account.

Want every card? The complete Ramayan, Mahabharat and Odyssey are their own apps, from Scroll the Epics.

name: Scrummz
description:
Never pay full price for your meal.

Scrummz finds the best restaurant deals across Southern California and puts them in one place: happy hours, coupons, BOGOs, birthday freebies, app-only offers and seasonal specials.

DEALS THAT ARE ACTUALLY ON
• See what’s happening right now and what starts soon, with times for today
• Every deal is checked against the restaurant’s own website or official social post, and shows when it was last verified
• Tap “Was this a good deal?” to tell us if a deal worked, so everyone gets fresher info

FIND THE RIGHT ONE FAST
• Sort by distance from your zip code, city or current location
• Filter by deal type and cuisine, or search any restaurant
• See the biggest savings near you at a glance
• List or map view, with directions, call and share in one tap

MAKE IT YOURS (free, optional account)
• Save deals and keep them on every device
• Follow your favorite restaurants
• Get birthday freebie reminders and alerts for new deals you care about
• Delete your account anytime from your profile

Know a deal we’re missing? Suggest it in the app.

Scrummz is free. Deals change, so always confirm with the restaurant before you go.

name: sebete
description:
Sebete brings your local bazaar to your phone. Order from the groceries, markets, and shops near you, and get it delivered to your door or pick it up yourself when it's ready.

SHOP FROM REAL LOCAL SHOPS
• Browse the shops in your area and everything they sell, with real prices in IQD
• Deals and bundles: see what's on offer today and save on combos
• Search across every shop for the product you need
• See each shop's opening hours, delivery fee, minimum order and preparation time before you order

DELIVERY OR PICKUP: YOUR CHOICE
• Home delivery to any of your saved addresses
• Or choose pickup and collect your order from the shop when it's ready
• Save several addresses (home, work, family) with a pin on the map, so the driver finds you first time

FOLLOW YOUR ORDER LIVE
• See every step: accepted, preparing, on the way, delivered
• Once the driver picks up your order, follow them live on the map until they reach your door
• Call the shop or the driver from the order screen
• Get a notification at every step

MORE
• Save your favourite shops
• Rate and review shops after your order
• Your order history in one place
• Kurdish, Arabic and English, with full right-to-left support

Sebete is made in Kurdistan for the shops and families of Kurdistan.

name: Seccade: Quran Verse & Prayer
description:
A verse every time you look. Seccade puts the verse of the day and the time left until the next prayer on your Lock Screen: a quiet reminder every time you pick up your phone.

LOCK SCREEN AND HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
• Verse of the day: Arabic text with its meaning, framed in thin gold like a mushaf page
• Prayer times: the next prayer and a live countdown
• Lock Screen verse, countdown and circular gauge
• Small, medium and large sizes

PRAYER TIMES
• Calculated on your phone with the Diyanet method
• Your current location or a city from the list
• Reminders for Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha
• The next prayer and time left, all five prayers in one clear list

THE HOLY QURAN
• All 114 surahs, Arabic text with the Pickthall translation
• Continue where you left off
• Save and share verses

DUAS
• Rabbana supplications from the Quran, in Arabic with their meaning
• A dua for every day

SHARE
Send any verse as a story-sized card in one tap.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
No ads, no account. Your location is only used on your phone to calculate prayer times and is never sent to any server.

Sources: Quran text from Tanzil.net (Uthmani), translation by Marmaduke Pickthall.

Terms of use: https://metehanbicer.com/apps/seccade/terms/
Privacy: https://metehanbicer.com/apps/seccade/privacy/

name: Secret Santa: Secret Kringle
description:
The easiest way to do Secret Santa, Kris Kindle or Kris Kringle with family, friends or work.

No more names in a hat, no one drawing themselves, and no one losing their bit of paper.

HOW IT WORKS
• Type your name and pick Family, Friends or Work
• Type everyone's first names (no emails needed)
• Share one link in the group chat
• Everyone taps their own name and picks an envelope
• They see who they're buying for, and what that person wants

WISH LISTS
Everyone can add a wish list, so nobody has to guess. Ask your person a question anonymously, and mark gifts as bought without spoiling the surprise.

3,400+ GIFT IDEAS
Stuck? Browse real gifts by person, age and budget, from €5 stocking fillers to bigger treats.

MADE FOR THE APP
• My draws: every draw and wish list on your phone, one tap away
• Christmas countdown widget for your Home Screen and Lock Screen
• Gift reminders on 1 and 18 December
• Share your link straight to WhatsApp, Messages or anywhere

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Nobody sees the full draw, not even the organiser. No accounts, no passwords.

Free for groups of up to 60. Made in Ireland.

As an Amazon Associate, Secret Kringle earns from qualifying purchases.

name: SETH Vet DICOM Viewer
description:
SETH is a DICOM medical image viewer built for veterinary medicine, now on your iPad.

• Receive studies straight from your PACS, scanner or Horos: the iPad works as a DICOM node.
• Open CT, MRI, X-ray and more from Files, AirDrop or Mail.
• 2D viewer with window/level, color tables, measurements and annotations.
• Axial, coronal and sagittal reconstruction, plus thick slab (MIP, MinIP and mean).
• 3D volume rendering (VR) and 3D MIP, with anatomical views and scissors to crop.
• On-device AI image enhancement (Neural Engine) — nothing is sent to the internet.
• Several series side by side with reference lines.
• Includes sample studies (dog and cat) so you can try it right away.
• In English and Spanish.

SETH collects no data: your studies stay on your iPad.

One purchase includes SETH for Mac and iPad.

Notice: SETH is a display aid and does not replace the veterinarian's judgment; it is not intended for human diagnosis.

name: Shadow Bonds
description:
Shadow Bonds: Embark on a Brand-New Adventure
Step into a challenging world of ninjas, recruit allies with diverse abilities, and assemble your own elite squad. Explore uncharted territories and set off on an exhilarating, action-packed adventure!

Strategic Formations: Build the Ultimate Team
Every ninja possesses unique skills and specific combat roles. Adapt your lineup based on enemy traits, combine abilities, and use clever strategy to emerge victorious in every battle!

Awaken Secret Arts: Push Beyond Your Limits
Strengthen your ninjas through training, advancement, and awakening. Unlock powerful skills and unleash spectacular ultimate moves to turn the tide of battle when it matters most!

Forge Bonds: Fight Side by Side
Find like-minded ninja allies to activate special synergy effects. Build your team strategically, allowing different powers to resonate and unleash even greater combat potential!

Arena Challenges: Compete for Ultimate Glory
Enter the arena to face off against other players in strategic duels. Continuously strengthen your squad, climb the rankings, and prove your true power!

Abundant Rewards: Keep Growing
Complete daily quests and limited-time events to earn a wealth of resources. Effortlessly develop your ninjas, boost your combat power, and forge your own legendary team!

Join the ninja world today—awaken your power and begin your own legend from the shadows!

name: Shardfall: Puzzle Adventure
description:
Shardfall is an isometric 3D adventure RPG with logic puzzles. The world has shattered and the runes that held it together are scattered. Set out from the island village, talk to the villagers, solve the shrines, gather the rune shards and step through the portal to restore the world.

8 KINDS OF PUZZLE SHRINES
• Weights: push the crates onto the glowing plates (Sokoban).
• Runes: step on a rune and it flips along with its neighbours. Light them all.
• Logic: levers and lamps with AND / OR / NOT formulas.
• Echo: remember the order of the glowing stones and repeat it.
• Ice: you slide until something stops you.
• Crumbling path: step on every tile exactly once; it falls behind you.
• Mirrors: turn the mirrors so the light beam reaches the crystal.
• Numbers: pick the tiles that add up to the target.
Every shrine is guaranteed to be solvable and has Reset and Hint buttons.

45 LEVELS IN 5 CHAPTERS
Fountain Isle, Whispering Woods, then a leap into the future: Crystal City, Orbital Station and Shardfall Future. From level 20 on there are spaceships, crystals, cyber monsters and laser weapons. Every level has a timer, and the puzzles keep getting harder.

COMBAT AND WEAPONS
• 10 weapons: wooden and iron swords, bow, spear, axe, rune hammer, crystal sword, blaster, plasma rifle and ion cannon.
• Skeletons, zombies, ghosts and orcs chase you, and archers shoot at you. A red line on the ground warns you, so you can dodge.
• Power-ups: shield, invisibility, speed and fury (double damage).
• At night the monsters are faster. You are safe in the village and inside the shrines.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Co-op for 2–4 players: create a room with a 5-letter code or send the link. Shrines, chests and the portal are shared, so you solve the puzzles together.

HEROES AND SHARDFALL COIN
• 8 heroes with a 3D preview: 6 free and 2 from the shop.
• Shardfall Coin (SFC) is earned only by playing: coins, chests, solved shrines and defeated monsters.
• Mira the merchant sells potions, extra hearts, hints and a coin magnet.
• SFC cannot be bought with real money. The game has no in-app purchases and no ads.

AND MORE
• Online leaderboard.
• Day and night, villages, graveyards, ruins, forests, lakes and bridges.
• No account needed: pick a hero and play.
• Touch controls with a joystick, or a gamepad.
• Languages: English, Romanian and French.
• Low-poly art made with Kenney's models.

Need help? Settings › Support in the game, https://shardfall.joace.ro/en/suport/ or contact@joace.ro.

name: Sheaf Unwind
description:
Every QuillNeedle on the light table points somewhere. Tap one and it slides out that way, unless another needle sits in its path. Then it stays pinned, and you have to work out what leaves first.

That is the whole craft of Sheaf Unwind: read a torn Sheaf, trace which needle blocks which, and pull them in the right order until the page is clear. Later Sheafs bring BinderKnots, tangles that look free and are not, and a tide that tightens when you rush.

Conservator Mara Vale works beside you at the Glass Spine Ledger Desk. She notes your clears and combos, nudges you toward an exit order when you are pinned, loosens a BinderKnot after a run of misses, and softens the tide when the Sheaf gets too sharp. Everything she says is written into the game, so she is there offline too.

Lay a Sheaf in your own outline
The Silhouette Draft Lantern takes a portrait, from your photo library, from the camera, or from the sample, and turns it into a black-and-white outline on the device. Needles are then laid out inside that outline, so you unpick a Sheaf shaped like someone you know.

Hum the combo sound
Open the Motif Hum Cylinder, record a short four-beat hum, and the app reads its pitch contour on the device. Your HumMotif then plays through your combos.

Keep a Restoration Plate
Combine an outline with a cleared Sheaf to compose a Restoration Plate. Plates, drafts and hums stay in your Conservator Folio, where each can be replayed or deleted. Export any plate to Photos if you want to keep it outside the game.

Mara online, if you want it
At the Ledger Desk you can grant AI consent for the current session. Mara can then ask an AI service for one of three structured hint types using a fixed instruction, and have a voice service read her pre-written lines. No board content, photos or hums are sent. Revoke at any time; nothing changes about the puzzle.

No account, no ads, no purchases, no tracking.

name: Sheet Music + Recorder: Leggii
description:
Leggii is a sheet music app for performers, teachers and students. Turn pages like paper, write like with a pencil, and record your lessons and rehearsals. AI sorts out what was said, with times and pages.

■ All your scores in one place
• Import PDF scores or scan paper music with the camera (tilted photos are straightened)
• Browse all, recently opened or by composer; favourites and folders
• Setlists for concerts and lessons
• Title and composer recognised automatically

■ Mark up scores like with a pencil
• Pen, highlighter, eraser, lasso to select and move; Apple Pencil support
• Stamps for dynamics, accidentals, articulation, fingering, repeats and D.C.

■ Record lessons and rehearsals
• One tap records while the score is open, and keeps going with the screen off
• Page turns are saved, so the score follows when you listen back
• Playback continues on other screens and in the background

■ AI lesson analysis
• Lesson notes: corrections, key points and homework, with times and pages
• Transcript: word for word, with translation
• Save the result as a PDF in My notes and write on it
• Runs only when you ask, and shows the AI time it will use before it starts

■ Leggii cloud (Leggii Plus)
• Scores, ink, folders, setlists, My notes and recordings the same on your iPhone and iPad
• 10 GB, or the 50 GB plan
• Keep files you rarely open in the cloud only to free space on the device

■ IMSLP editions, by language
• Search a work and choose by publisher, text language, arranger and preview

■ Practice tools
• A metronome and a piano keyboard right on the score
• Two pages side by side on iPad in landscape
• Night, sepia and dim reading looks
• Page turns by Bluetooth pedal or tap

■ Ask Leggii
• Ask "Where is my Tosca score?" or "Analyse today's recording" and get the answer with a button to do it

■ Plans
• First 7 days: every Pro feature and 30 AI minutes free
• Leggii Pro (one-time purchase, yours for life): all Pro features, no welegato banner, 30 AI minutes a month plus a 60-minute welcome bonus
• Leggii Plus (auto-renewing, monthly or yearly): all Pro features, 5 hours of AI a month and the Leggii cloud
• AI time top-ups of 5 or 15 hours (valid 12 months)
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account subscription settings.

■ welegato ID (optional)
One ID shared with welegato. Signed in, your Pro, Plus and AI time follow you to every device. Without signing in, all of Leggii's basic features still work.

Without the cloud, your scores, notes and recordings stay on your device.
Looking for a teacher or musicians to play with? Visit welegato.com.

Terms of use: https://vicinolabs.com/leggii/terms/
Privacy policy: https://vicinolabs.com/leggii/privacy/
Apple standard licence agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: ShirtZone
description:
ShirtZone is an Egyptian studio that prints oversized hoodies and tees with your design.

Pick a ready design, or create your own:
• Stitch, your design assistant: describe your idea or share a reference picture, and Stitch draws the design and refines it with you.
• Manual Studio: move and resize the print, choose where it sits on the garment, and add your own text.
• Try it on: see the garment on a photo of yourself before you order. Your photo stays private and is deleted after 30 days.

Every piece is printed to order. Choose your size and colour, pay online or with cash on delivery where available, and follow your order in the app until it arrives.

Also in the app:
• Favorites to keep what you like
• Order and shipment tracking
• In-app support
• Arabic and English, light and dark mode

Delivery within Egypt.

name: ShubhVela: Panchang & Muhurat
description:
ShubhVela is a complete Hindu panchang, calendar, muhurat and kundali app — free, with no ads, made in India by Fixholics.

TODAY AT A GLANCE
• Tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana and vaar with exact end times — including kshaya and vriddhi tithis
• Sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset, Vikram and Shaka samvat, ritu and ayana
• Live choghadiya and hora, a Rahu Kaal countdown, Abhijit and Brahma muhurta
• A whole-day timeline of good and bad periods: Rahu Kaal, Yamaganda, Gulika, Dur Muhurtam, Varjyam, Amrit Kalam, Bhadra, Panchak

FESTIVALS AND FASTS
• 100+ festivals and every monthly vrat: Ekadashi with parana, Pradosh, Sankashti with moonrise, Purnima, Amavasya, Shivaratri
• Regional sets for North India, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Bengal, Odisha, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra and more
• Each festival page shows puja time and explains in plain words why it falls on that date
• Eclipses with local visibility and sutak

MUHURAT FINDER
• Wedding, griha pravesh, vehicle, property, gold, naming, mundan and more — ranked dates with the reasons for every choice

KUNDALI AND MATCHING
• North and South Indian charts, D1 to D60, planets with dignity, Vimshottari dasha, Mangal and Kaal Sarp dosha, Sade Sati timeline
• 36-gun kundali matching with clear notes

MORE
• Personal dates by tithi (birthdays, shraddha) with reminders
• Home-screen and lock-screen widgets · Share cards for WhatsApp
• Aartis, chalisa and mantras with large text · Today's sankalp
• 12 languages: हिन्दी, English, मराठी, ગુજરાતી, தமிழ், తెలుగు, ಕನ್ನಡ, മലയാളം, বাংলা, ଓଡ଼ିଆ, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ, नेपाली
• Works offline. No account. Your data stays on your phone.

name: Shushwell: Shusher for Baby
description:
Shushwell is a shusher for babies that listens. It plays a soft, rhythmic "shhh", and when your baby cries it shushes louder, the way you would, then eases back down about a minute after they settle.

ONE TAP, AND IT KEEPS GOING
- Starts the moment you tap. No ads, and nothing pops up to sell you something before the shush
- Keeps playing with the screen locked, and comes back by itself after a call or an alarm
- Plays on the iPhone, a Bluetooth speaker by the crib or AirPlay: pick the speaker right on the main screen
- Controls on the lock screen

A TIMER THAT LASTS WHAT IT SAYS
15 or 30 minutes, 1, 2, 4 or 8 hours, or all night until you stop it. It does not stop before the timer ends: after a call or an alarm it starts again by itself, and at the end it fades out over 30 seconds instead of cutting off and waking your baby.

A SHUSH YOU CAN TUNE
The shush is white noise shaped like a parent's voice, made on your iPhone, so it is not a recording and loops without a gap. Make it deeper or brighter until it sounds like you, and choose shushes in breaths or one steady whoosh, like in the womb.

LISTENS FOR CRYING
Turn on listening and Shushwell checks each second for a baby crying, with Apple's sound recognition, on your iPhone. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere. While your baby cries, the shush goes up to the volume you choose; when the crying stops, it comes back down slowly. In our tests, a TV, voices, a fan and music did not set it off. It works best with the iPhone a step away from the speaker.

PRICE
Your first 3 nights are free with everything. After that, the shush stays free with timers up to 30 minutes. Shushwell Pro adds listening for crying and timers of 1 hour to all night, with a yearly or a monthly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple account; the subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and you can cancel anytime in your Apple account settings.

Keep the speaker at least 7 feet (2 m) from your baby and the volume moderate. Shushwell is not a baby monitor: it does not alert you when your baby cries.

Privacy policy: https://shushwell.baltajmn.dev/privacy/
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Sideline Soccer Stats
description:
Sideline Soccer Stats helps parents and scorekeepers follow the story of a soccer match, one tap at a time.

Track possession and completed passes with large controls. Add goals, shots, shots on target, corners, crosses, fouls, offsides, penalties and tackles. Choose the half length, switch the on-screen team sides and match the team colours to the jerseys on the field.

Save teams and rosters for quick setup between games. Add scorers and match notes, review halftime and full-time statistical briefs, and create a JPEG report to share with your team.

Use the field map to record ball or shot locations and explore the match heat map. Optional controller controls and spoken confirmations help you record events while watching the action.

For shared tracking, invite two assistant trackers with their own responsibilities, or share a live viewing link. Participants can access a published report and send private correction suggestions to the host. Live features require an internet connection.

Core match tracking works offline. Reports and briefs describe the events you record; their usefulness depends on complete and consistent tracking.

One upfront purchase. No subscription.

name: SidePane: Second Monitor
description:
SidePane gives your Mac an extra screen on your iPhone. Drag any window onto it, then tap, scroll and draw on it, over the USB cable or Wi-Fi. It's a real extended display, not a mirror: your Mac sees a new monitor you can arrange like any other.

BUILT FOR IPHONE DUO
• Use the big inner screen or the cover screen. The Mac display follows the screen you're using and resizes when you fold or turn the phone.
• Each screen remembers its own text size, and the picture keeps clear of the rounded corners.
• Works on every iPhone running iOS 18 or later.

USB OR WI-FI
• Plug in for the lowest delay and up to 120 frames a second.
• Or use the same Wi-Fi, at up to 60 frames a second.
• Unplug and SidePane carries on over Wi-Fi; plug back in and it moves to the cable.
• USB keeps working with Chrome or Brave open.

TOUCH AND APPLE PENCIL
• Tap to click, double-tap to double-click, drag with two fingers to scroll, touch and hold to right-click.
• Apple Pencil: hover to point and touch to click, draw in Ink, or write by hand in Write and have it typed on your Mac.
• Your palm is ignored while the Pencil is in use.

MADE TO STAY OUT OF THE WAY
• One small button in a corner opens the controls: Text Size, Screen Fit, Rotation Lock, Wi-Fi, Pencil and Disconnect.
• Pair once by plugging in, or with a QR code. Only your iPhones can connect.
• Turn off Use Wi-Fi on public networks to use the cable only.

FREE TO TRY
• Sessions last 15 minutes, as many as you like.
• Unlock once for no time limit: one payment, no subscription, Family Sharing included.

WHAT YOU NEED
• The free SidePane app for Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later), from getsidepane.com.
• An iPhone with iOS 18 or later, and a USB cable or the same Wi-Fi.

No account, no ads, no data collected.

name: Sign Shoot: Shot List
description:
Sign Shoot is the shot list for photographers who work with clients: weddings, portraits, families, product, fashion, stock, events and real estate.

PLAN THE SHOOT IN MINUTES
• Start from one of 8 built-in templates or from scratch.
• Group shots into blocks and flag the must-haves.
• Keep date, location, duration, client and notes for you or your second shooter.
• Reminder the day before to check your gear and charge batteries.

YOUR CLIENT CHOOSES ON THEIR PHONE
• Send a link by WhatsApp, SMS or email, or show a QR code.
• No accounts or downloads: they pick styles, mark the shots they love and the ones they don't need, add their own, list the important people and upload up to 10 reference photos.
• Answers are end-to-end encrypted and deleted when you close the form or after 30 days.
• You get notified when they answer and apply their choices to the list with one tap.

ON THE DAY
• Full-screen shoot mode: block by block, tick each shot with one tap.
• See at a glance which must-haves are still missing.
• Gear checklist and reusable kits.

MODELS AND RELEASES
• Flag shots that need a model or property release.
• Request the signature with Sign Release and the shoot updates itself when it's signed.

PRIVACY
Your shoots are stored only on your iPhone. Protect them with Face ID or Touch ID, and make a backup you can restore on iPhone or Android.

SIGN SHOOT PRO
Unlimited shoots and links, your own templates and shoot PDFs without branding. Monthly or yearly subscription (with a 7-day free trial) or a one-time purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your Apple Account settings.

Part of the Sign family: Sign Contract (quotes and contracts), Sign Release (model releases) and Sign Gear (gear inventory).

Privacy policy: https://sign-shoot.web.app/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Silvoko: Language Learning
description:
Grow a cozy farm while you practice English or Mexican Spanish. Harvest crops, care for animals, and deliver orders to the village. Along the way, discover words and phrases you can hear aloud and use with the villagers.

- Take short lessons and listen to words and phrases in U.S. English or Mexican Spanish.
- Discover vocabulary around the farm and revisit it in your Word Garden.
- Earn Study Stars through practice and use them to unlock more land.

Start as a guest or sign in with Google to continue the same farm on the web and iPhone.

name: SINGLE 관제
description:
싱글 관제는 Mate Mobility 의 싱글 카트 서비스를 도입한 골프장의 운영 담당자와 Mate Mobility 직원이 사용하는 업무용 앱입니다. 일반 이용자용 앱이 아니며, 발급받은 관리자 계정이 있어야 로그인할 수 있습니다.

주요 기능
- 관제: 코스별 진행 현황(라인뷰)과 카트 위치를 확인합니다.
- 예약: 당일·기간별 라운드 예약을 조회하고 관리합니다.
- 핀 위치: 홀별 핀 위치를 설정합니다.
- 알림: Mate Mobility 가 보내는 공지와 운영 알림을 받고, 알림을 누르면 관련 화면으로 바로 이동합니다.
- 보안: 앱을 다시 열 때 Face ID 또는 Touch ID 로 잠금을 해제합니다.

계정 안내
- 계정은 골프장 또는 Mate Mobility 가 발급합니다. 앱에서 가입할 수 없습니다.
- 문의: contact@matemobility.co.kr

name: SkiReports
description:
SkiReports shows you where the snow is. Open the map and every ski resort lights up, color-coded by how much snow it has had or is about to get, so you can find the best skiing at a glance.

THREE WAYS TO SEE THE SNOW
• Forecast: expected snowfall over the next 24 hours, 3 days or 7 days
• Recent: what has fallen in the past week
• Season: total snowfall since the season began

Switch layers with one tap and watch the map change. Tap any pin for a quick summary, or open the resort page for the full picture.

SEARCH AND EXPLORE
Search resorts by name, region or country and fly straight to them on the map.

RESORT DETAILS
• Day-by-day forecast at base and peak elevation
• Snowfall history
• Resort stats such as elevation, vertical drop, runs and lifts
• Links to the resort's own website

FAVORITES
Star the resorts you care about and compare them side by side: forecast (24 hours, 3 days, 7 days), recent and season snowfall, all in one list. Your favorites sync to your account and are there on the web too at skireports.com.

MADE FOR SKIERS AND RIDERS
• Choose inches or centimeters
• Sign in with Apple, Google, or a one-time email code. No password to remember.
• Browse everything without an account

Whether you're chasing a powder day, planning a trip or deciding where to go this weekend, SkiReports helps you pick the mountain.

Questions or feedback? Visit skireports.com/support.

name: Slow Corner
description: Slow Corner — offline local community for Thai drama talk. Discover titles, post recs, write notes, save lists; poster studio and copy tools on device. No playback, no streaming sources, no personal-data upload.

name: SM Chofer Viajes
description:
SM Chofer es la app para los choferes que transportan carga para empresas de logística que usan SM Logística.

Cómo funciona:
• La empresa te manda por WhatsApp un código de viaje de 6 letras.
• Lo ingresas en la app, revisas el viaje (orden, origen, destino y patente) y lo confirmas.
• La app comparte la ubicación del camión mientras dura el viaje, aunque tengas la pantalla bloqueada o estés usando Waze.
• Marcas cada etapa: en camino a carga, carga lista, en ruta y en destino.
• Si hay un problema en la ruta (tráfico, accidente, falla mecánica o algo con la carga), lo reportas con una foto.
• Al entregar, registras quién recibió, su RUT, su firma y una foto de la entrega.
• Al entregar, el rastreo se apaga solo.

Pensada para el camino:
• Funciona sin señal: guarda todo y lo envía cuando vuelve la conexión.
• Sin cuentas ni contraseñas: solo el código del viaje.
• Se rastrea el viaje y la carga, no a la persona: no se te pide nombre, RUT ni teléfono.

Antes de iniciar cada viaje, la app te muestra el aviso de privacidad: qué se registra, para qué, quién lo ve y cuánto tiempo se guarda.

name: Smart Printer Scanner
description:
Print from your iPhone or iPad to almost any printer, in a few taps.

Smart Printer Scanner App finds the printers around you and prints on AirPrint printers and on many printers without AirPrint.

NEW
• Wi-Fi File Transfer: send files from your computer to your iPhone, then print them
• Document camera: finds the page, takes it by itself and straightens it
• School name labels, pantry labels and Christmas gift tags

PRINT ANYTHING
• Photos: one per page, or at real photo sizes (4 × 6 in, 5 × 7 in, wallet…) packed on a sheet; mirror printing for iron-on T-shirt transfers
• Photo collages: up to 10 photos on one page, in 186 layouts, with colored borders
• Documents: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, images and saved e-mails — also as a booklet to fold
• Web pages: the whole page, as it looks on screen, or only the article without ads and menus
• Labels: real label sheets (Letter and A4) with print alignment, QR codes and barcodes
• Calendars: monthly, weekly, year-at-a-glance and photo calendars in several designs
• Coloring pages: more than 450 pages for kids and adults — animals, mandalas, flowers, vehicles and more
• Kids worksheets: letter, number and name tracing in your language, dot to dot, math, times tables and counting — with answer pages
• Cards and invitations: 66 birthday, wedding, engagement, anniversary and housewarming cards — add stickers and your text in 14 fonts, print 1, 2 or 4 per page
• Planners: daily, weekly and monthly planners, meal and budget planners, habit and fitness trackers, reading log, to-do and shopping lists
• Paper: lined, graph, dot grid, Cornell notes, music and handwriting paper
• Posters: print a photo big, across 4, 9 or 16 pages
• Text, contacts and clipboard: type a quick page, print contact cards or whatever you copied
• Certificates: achievement, appreciation, completion and more, in four styles
• Business cards: four styles, front and back, 10 per sheet with cut marks

SCAN DOCUMENTS
• Scan paper documents with automatic edge detection and perspective correction
• Scan several pages and save them as a PDF
• Extract the text of a scan or a PDF to copy, translate, share or print it
• Scan with your printer's own scanner over Wi-Fi; scans become searchable PDFs

PDF TOOLS AND SHORTCUTS
• PDF tools: make a PDF from photos, merge, split, rotate, reorder or delete pages, crop margins and make a PDF smaller
• Home Screen widget and Siri shortcuts: scan or print in one tap
• Photo editor (13 looks, brightness, contrast, saturation), watermarks, envelopes, several files in one print, share as PDF and favorite prints

WORKS WITH YOUR PRINTER
• Wi-Fi printers found automatically on your network
• Add a printer by its IP address
• AirPrint printers through the iOS print dialog
• Printers without AirPrint: IPP, RAW (port 9100) and LPD, in PDF, PostScript, PCL or PWG raster
• Bluetooth thermal printers (ESC/POS and ZPL)
• Printer status: ink and toner levels, paper jams and other problems, firmware
• Two-sided printing by hand on printers that print one side
• Print options: copies, page range, 2 or 4 pages per sheet, fit or fill the page, margins, paper size (A4, Letter, Legal, A5), orientation, two-sided, black & white and ink saver

PREMIUM
Printing requires Premium. Smart Printer Premium unlocks unlimited printing, with a weekly (3-day free trial for new subscribers), monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase, or at the end of the free trial. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/terms-smart-printer
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/privacy-policy-smart-printers

Brand names are trademarks of their respective owners. This app is not affiliated with them.

name: Smash Rally: Badminton Online
description:
Smash Rally is a 3D badminton game built for your phone. Take on real players in fast online 1v1 matches, climb the ranked ladder and build the badminton star you want to be.

ONLINE 1V1 BADMINTON
• Real-time matches against players around the world
• Ranked seasons with tiers and a global leaderboard
• Invite friends to a private room with your friend code
• Practice against AI opponents across 6 stages

SWIPE, SMASH, DIVE
• Hold to bring up the shot wheel, swipe to pick your shot, release to swing
• Clear, drop, drive, net shot and jump smash, each with perfect timing
• Dive to save the shuttlecock and watch the best rallies in slow-motion replay
• Portrait screen made for phones: left thumb moves, right thumb hits

COLLECT YOUR STARS
• 6 badminton stars with their own play styles: power, speed, net touch and more
• Outfits from everyday kits to Epic and Legendary looks
• 36 rackets with real-style frames and stats that change how you play
• Shoes, wristbands, headbands and knee guards to fine-tune your player

OPEN, UPGRADE, WIN
• Earn coins, gems and cards from matches and card packs
• Upgrade players and gear to unlock higher stages and stronger opponents
• Daily shop deals and a Monthly Pass for regular players

BEAUTIFUL COURTS
• World Tour arena, club hall, city park, night rooftop, beach and school gym
• Cheering crowds, court-cracking smash effects and cinematic replays

Play in English, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, 日本語, 한국어, ไทย and 繁體中文.

Grab your racket, step on court and smash your way to the top in Smash Rally!

Smash Rally is free to play and contains ads and optional in-app purchases. An internet connection is needed for online matches.
Support: support@badminton3d.com

name: Smashik : réservation padel
description:
Smashik, c'est la façon la plus simple de réserver un terrain de sport près de chez vous.

POUR LES JOUEURS
• Trouvez un club et un terrain disponible en quelques secondes : padel, tennis, foot 5, basket, badminton, squash.
• Voyez les créneaux et les prix en direct, avec les bons plans de dernière minute.
• Payez en ligne en toute sécurité ou réglez directement au club.
• Invitez vos amis et partagez le prix de la partie : chacun paie sa part.
• Rejoignez des parties ouvertes et ne jouez plus jamais seul.
• Créneau complet ? Activez une alerte : vous êtes prévenu dès qu'il se libère.
• Suivez votre classement ELO, vos séries et vos créneaux offerts grâce à la fidélité.

POUR LES GÉRANTS DE CLUB
• Votre tableau de bord : réservations du jour, chiffre d'affaires, taux d'occupation, net du mois.
• L'agenda de tous vos terrains, jour par jour.
• Saisissez une réservation prise au comptoir ou par téléphone, ou bloquez un créneau.
• Pointez les paiements joueur par joueur, en paiement unique ou partagé, y compris avec les bons entreprise : plus aucune partie oubliée.
• Fiches joueurs, liste d'attente, rapport du mois et factures.

Smashik est un service de Smashik by Shopifik LTD.

name: Snake Legion: Draw to Conquer
description:
Draw one line and your legion is on the move! Snake Legion is a territory strategy game where you swipe paths to send out your troops and take the map one base at a time.
Drag from your base to a target and your soldiers march along the path you drew. Push an enemy base’s number below zero and it’s yours.

■ Your path is your supply line
• Draw a path once and that base keeps sending troops down it. Tap the base or swipe across the path to stop.
• Route it through +10 and ×2 gates and Supply Crates to make your legion snowball.
• Your bases along the way join the march, and enemy columns you run into spark a firefight.

■ Special buildings worth fighting for
• Augment Cache: take it first for an Augment card, and keep earning more while you hold it.
• Supply Depots, Radio Towers, Armories, Airfields and POW Camps pop up in new places every battle.

■ Augments and Ultimates that change every battle
• Defeat enemies and capture bases to earn a Promotion, then pick a Silver, Gold, Prismatic or Evolution Augment to shape your run.
• When your Ultimate gauge is full, call in a Carpet Bombing anywhere you like! Freeze Bomb and Emergency Reinforcements, too.

■ A legion that keeps getting stronger
• 47 research projects across six branches in the Research Lab boost your Firepower, Production, Troops, Defense, Economy and Air Support.
• Collect 20 guns, from the Assault Rifle to the Laser Cannon, and upgrade them up to +15. Plus 16 Support Units, including Tanks, Attack Helis and Ace Fighters.
• Stuck? Reenlist! You start over from 1-1, but your Reenlist bonus keeps stacking, and Rapid Advance blasts you past the much weaker stretches in one go.

■ A war that never ends
• Endless stages, a Fortress Assault every 20 stages, and enemies that keep getting tougher.
• Enemy commanders with their own styles (Assault, Fortress, Raider) and a freshly generated battlefield every time.
• Online Rankings for Best Stage and Reenlists, plus titles that climb the more you reenlist.
• Sign in with Google or Apple to pick up where you left off on another device.
• Auto battle, sweeps, idle rewards, the Operation Pass, Daily Missions and Check-in rewards.
• Play anywhere, even offline.

Snake Legion is free to play, with ads and optional in-app purchases (Remove Ads, permanent perks, Medals and more). Crate and upgrade odds are listed in the game under “Drop Rates”.

name: Snip & Unfold: Paper Puzzle
seller_name: LISAN BILISIM VE YAYINCILIK TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Remember cutting paper snowflakes? Fold a sheet, make a few snips, open it up and a whole pattern appears. Snip & Unfold turns that small surprise into a puzzle.

Every level shows you a finished pattern. Your paper is already folded. Work out where to cut the folded stack so that it unfolds into the same pattern.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Drag the scissors from one edge to another, or punch a notch with one tap.
- Press Unfold and watch the paper open fold by fold.
- Your cut is compared with the target: one, two or three stars.
- Missed it? The difference is shown on the paper, so the next try is better.

WHAT IS INSIDE
- 40 hand-picked levels, each one solvable exactly.
- Five ways to fold: in half, in quarters, in eighths, a six-fold snowflake and an accordion strip that opens into a paper chain.
- Scissors plus four punch shapes: arc, triangle, slit and diamond.
- Random mode: a fresh puzzle every time, as many as you like.
- Share a picture of your paper cut-out with friends.

CALM BY DESIGN
- No timers and no lives. Undo any cut, retry as often as you want.
- Stuck? Watch a short video for a hint, or skip the level.
- One-handed portrait play, works offline.
- English, Türkçe, Español, Português, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Japanese and Korean.

Snip & Unfold is free to play with ads. A one-time purchase removes the ads between levels.

name: Snoozy Stack: Sleepy Tower
description:
Gently stack sleepy voxel critters on the back of a dreaming whale.
Every friend has a different shape — a sheep, a cat, a hamster, a penguin, a frog — so where and how you drop them is everything.

• ONE-FINGER CONTROLS — drag to aim, release to drop, tap quickly to rotate.
• REAL WOBBLY PHYSICS — built with the Jolt physics engine. Our critters have weighted bellies, so they wobble like roly-poly toys… until they don't!
• SNUGGLE! — matching friends that touch hug each other and hold the tower together. Make a family of three to win back a heart.
• FROM SEA TO SPACE — climb through cotton clouds, sunset skies, starry nights, auroras and ringed planets all the way to the Moon.
• COLLECT & DECORATE — 14 sleepy critters and dreamy bases like the Whale, Old Turtle and Rubber Duck. Daily gifts and sticky honey boosters.

Completely free to play. No in-app purchases.
Privacy Policy: https://aihaejwo.site/privacy-policy_snoozystack.html
Support: aiplease.dev@gmail.com

name: SnowPoint Weather Intelligence
description:
Snowpoint is the field app for snow removal companies. It keeps your crews, managers and equipment connected through every storm, and stays in sync with your Snowpoint desktop software.

KNOW WHAT'S COMING
• Dashboard with current conditions and storm risk levels for your area
• Bulletins from management so every crew member gets the heads-up
• Full weather page with hourly and 10-day forecasts and live radar
• Weather warnings and snowfall totals from Environment Canada

TALK GROUPS: YOUR CREW, ONE CHAT
• Message anyone in your company, one on one or in groups
• Share photos and voice notes from the field
• Read receipts, reactions and pinned messages
• Urgent alerts from managers that break through when it matters
• Company contact cards so you always know who to call

FLEET AND EQUIPMENT
• See every machine in your fleet and its status
• Complete pre-trip inspections with a signature, right from your phone
• Report equipment issues with photos
• Track work orders and log fuel with receipt photos

PROOF OF SERVICE
• Start your shift and Snowpoint records a timestamped route of the properties you serviced
• Tracking stops when you end your shift
• Gives your company a clear record if a service is ever questioned

FAST AND SECURE
• Optional Face ID unlock, once a day or every time you open the app
• What each person sees is controlled by the roles your company sets up

Snowpoint requires a company account. Your company administrator will set up your login.

Snowpoint is developed by CMN Ventures Inc. in Riverview, New Brunswick.

name: Sock It!
description:
Your sock is stuck in the washing machine, and the drum is speeding up.

Tap to jump, tap again in mid-air for a double jump. Clear zips and buttons, stay low when a pair of jeans flaps by, and be in the air when the black hole of the sock-eater rolls by. Every 14 seconds the machine switches programme: Wool, Colours, Hot, Spin, and then it really gets going.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Tap to jump, tap again for a double jump
• The drum keeps accelerating, and it surprises you: it floods with water, blasts steam or suddenly spins the other way
• Grab power-ups: softener saves you once, bleach chases off the sock-eaters, a peg pulls in coins
• Jump just in time for a CLOSE! bonus
• Complete missions to earn extra coins
• Stuck? Watch a short video to carry on where you left off

UNLOCK SOCKS
Stripy, polka, argyle, festive, rainbow, plus the golden sock with a crown and a glowing neon sock.

A SOCK FOR EVERY COUNTRY
Show your colours with flag socks from all 193 countries, sorted by continent. Your own country is always at the top.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Plays offline
• Free with ads. Remove them for good with one purchase
• No account needed

Questions? studiosvivax@gmail.com

name: Solvex ERP
description:
Solvex ERP هو تطبيقُ الهاتف لنظام إدارة الشركات (ERP) من FP للشركات التجاريّة: المبيعات والمشتريات والمخزن والعملاء والحسابات — متّصلٌ مباشرةً بنظام شركتك.

• فاتورة بيع وعرض سعر ومسودّة من الهاتف، مع سعر العميل وآخر سعر بيع ومخزون كلّ مادّة.
• بحثٌ سريع عن المواد يعرض أسعارها كلّها (جملة، وكيل، زبون…) بحسب صلاحيّاتك.
• سندات القبض والدفع، وكشف حساب العميل والمورّد.
• التقارير: المبيعات والأرباح والديون والمخزون المنخفض والميزانيّة وغيرها.
• القوائم السابقة: عرض المستندات وتعديلها ومشاركتها PDF.
• المساعد الذكيّ — إن فعّلته شركتك: اسأله عن المبيعات والأرصدة، أو أرسل له صورة قائمة.
• كلّ صفحات النظام داخل التطبيق.
• يعمل عبر الإنترنت، وعلى شبكة المحلّ مباشرةً إن كان نظام شركتك داخل المحلّ.

كيف تبدأ:
1. اطلب من مدير النظام في شركتك «رمز الشركة» وحسابك.
2. اكتب رمز الشركة في التطبيق، ثمّ ادخل باسم المستخدم وكلمة المرور.

التطبيقُ لموظّفي الشركات المشتركة في نظام ERP من FP ‏(erpmanag.com). ما تراه وتفعله فيه يتبع صلاحيّاتك في شركتك.

name: Sonandi
description:
Sonandi is the tuner for musicians who play more than one string instrument. Pick your instrument, play a string and let the needle guide you to perfect pitch.

INSTRUMENTS AND TUNINGS
• Guitar: standard, Drop D, Drop C, Drop B, half and whole step down, Open D, Open D minor, Open G, Open E, Open A, Open C, Open F, Open B, DADGAD, Nashville and 7-string
• Bass: 4, 5 and 6 strings, Drop D
• Ukulele: standard, Low G, D tuning, baritone
• Mandolin, mandola and octave mandolin
• Banjo: 5-string (Open G, Double C, Open D, Sawmill), tenor and Irish tenor
• Violin, viola, cello and double bass

FAST AND PRECISE
• Automatically detects the string you are playing
• Manual mode: tap a string to select it and hear its reference tone
• Cent-level precision, with colors that tell you whether to tighten or loosen
• Microphone level meter, so you always know if the signal is strong enough
• Adjustable reference pitch from 430 to 450 Hz
• Note names in C D E, Do Re Mi or German notation

MADE FOR YOU
• Remembers your last instrument and tuning
• Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Available in English, Italian, Spanish, French, German and Portuguese

PRIVACY
Microphone audio is analyzed only on your device: Sonandi never records, stores or sends audio or personal data. No ads, no tracking.

name: Soru Kulesi: Bilgi Yarışması
description:
Soru Kulesi, 15 basamaklı büyük bilgi yarışmasıdır. Her doğru cevapla bir basamak yukarı çık, 5. ve 10. basamaktaki güvence noktalarıyla ödülünü koru ve 1.000.000 altına ulaş!

ÜÇ OYUN MODU
• Klasik Milyoner: 15 soru, güvence basamakları, riske girmeden ayrılma seçeneği
• Zamana Karşı: 60 saniyede mümkün olduğunca çok soruyu çöz
• Elenene Kadar: ilk yanlışa kadar devam et

DÖRT JOKER (her oyunda birer kez)
%50, Seyirciye Sor, Uzman Görüşü, Soruyu Değiştir.

4.000'DEN FAZLA SORU
Genel Kültür, Tarih, Coğrafya, Bilim, Spor, Sinema, Edebiyat ve Teknoloji kategorilerinde; zorluk seviyesi kuleyle birlikte artar. Her sorunun açıklaması vardır.

İLERLEME VE ÖDÜLLER
XP kazan, seviye atla, 22 başarım rozetini aç, günlük ödülünle altın biriktir, istatistiklerinde güçlü ve zayıf kategorilerini gör.

GÜZEL VE RAHAT
Açık ve koyu tema, canlı illüstrasyonlar, seyirciler, ses efektleri ve müzik (Ayarlar'dan kapatılabilir).

İlerlemen cihazında saklanır; hesap açmana gerek yoktur. Oyun reklam içerir; tek seferlik "Reklamsız Oyna" satın alımıyla reklamları kaldırabilirsin.

name: Souffleuse: Learn Your Lines
description:
Souffleuse helps you learn your lines for the stage. Photograph your script and Souffleuse finds the roles, scenes and stage directions, right on your phone. It reads the other roles aloud, each with a voice of its own, and stops where your line comes. You say it out loud, check it, and the lines you miss come back sooner.

FREE, AND IT STAYS FREE
• One production at a time, the whole script, no time limit
• Add your script as photos, scans, a PDF, Word or OpenDocument file, or pasted text
• Text recognition on your phone; correct anything with a tap, with the photo of the page next to it
• A voice for each role, with its own pitch and speed
• Run lines with all the words, half of them, only the first letters, or nothing at all
• Cue lines: practise the last words before each of your lines, like flash cards
• Entrances: see when you come on in each scene, and after which words
• The director mode, sharing the script with your cast, and the backup file
• Try listening three times
No ads, no account, and no trial that quietly turns into a subscription.

SOUFFLEUSE PLUS
• Any number of productions at the same time
• Listen to your scenes like a radio play, also with the screen off, with a pause where your line comes
• See how well you know each scene
• Practise only your weak lines
Choose a subscription per month or per year, or pay once and keep it for good. You see the price in your own currency before you buy. A subscription renews automatically until you cancel it, which you can do at any time in the settings of your Apple Account. If you stop, you keep your productions and your progress.

FOR DIRECTORS
The director mode is free. Souffleuse knows from the script who is in which scene. Add the names of your cast, plan a rehearsal with the scenes you want to work on, and see straight away who needs to come. Share the call as a message for the group chat or as a calendar file. And if your group may share the script, send your cast one link: everyone gets the script in Souffleuse, ready to practise, and it disappears on the date you choose. In Souffleuse your cast can practise the script, but cannot copy, print or pass it on. Anyone who still needs to install Souffleuse from the App Store taps the link once more afterwards.

YOUR SCRIPT STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
There is no account and no tracking. Reading the pages, the voices and your progress all stay on your phone. A backup is a file you keep yourself, for example in Files or on iCloud Drive. Souffleuse is left out of the automatic iCloud backup, so your script only leaves your phone when you choose to. Souffleuse only goes online when a director shares a script with the group: it is locked on the phone first, so not even we can read it.

MADE FOR AMATEUR THEATRE
For the play with your local group, the school musical, a monologue or a poem for a contest. Paper scripts, scripts by email, scripts with notes in the margin. Photos of a script are read in English, German, Dutch, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Swedish, Danish and Norwegian, and the other roles are read aloud in any language your iPhone has a voice for that works without internet.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Souffleuse speaks 30 languages.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://souffleuse.h4it.nl/privacy/

name: Sourdough Starter Tracker Bubu
description:
Bubu is a little jar that keeps in step with your real sourdough starter.

Each time you feed your starter, tap "I fed my starter" and pick the ratio. Bubu works out when it should peak and shows it on her face: happy after a feed, bubbly while it rises, at her best at the peak, hungry when it's time for the next one. Around the peak she asks how your jar looks. Tell her it's at its peak (or not yet) and she learns how fast your starter really is, in your kitchen, with your flour.

Want fresh bread on Saturday at 10? Tell Bubu when you want it, pick overnight in the fridge or same day, and she plans every step backwards from there. She warns you if a step would land in the middle of the night, sends a reminder at each step, and shows a countdown on your Lock Screen so you don't have to keep opening the app with floury hands.

What else is in there:
• A Home Screen widget with Bubu's mood and when your starter will peak
• Photos of your jar right after feeding and later on, side by side, so you can see how much it rose
• A 7-day guide if you're making a starter from scratch. It moves on when you tick a day off, so a busy day never puts you behind
• A baker's percentage calculator with true hydration
• 30 recipes, from an easy first loaf and focaccia to bagels, cinnamon rolls and discard crackers
• Space for your own recipes, which you can plan like any other
• A journal of every feed, peak, loaf and note, with your best loaf and a chart of her peaks
• Fridge mode, with one reminder a week

No account, no ads, and everything stays on your iPhone.

Bubu is free to use for your starter: feeding, peaks, reminders, photos, the new-starter guide, the calculator, 8 recipes, your own recipes and your first planned bake. Bubu Plus adds every recipe, as many planned bakes as you like, your full journal history and your baking stats. You can pay yearly (with a 14-day free trial), monthly, or once for good.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://bubu.umhdigital.com/privacy

name: Sowonkong - Family Wish List
description:
"I want this!"
By the time a gift day comes, it is hard to remember what that was.
Sowonkong is a wish list where parents save what their child wished for, then pick together on birthdays and Christmas.

■ One photo or one line
· Snap what you saw at the store or on the street, or add it from your album or as a short note.
· Make a separate pouch for each child.

■ Count every "again"
· Each time your child asks for the same thing, tap "Wants it again".
· See at a glance what they have wanted the longest and the most.

■ Open the pouch on gift day
· Add birthdays and get a reminder ahead of time.
· Pick together by browsing, or by choosing between two at a time.

■ Kid Mode
· A parent turns on a large, simple screen and the child picks.
· Kid Mode has no ads and no outside links. Press and hold the lock to leave.

■ Granted wishes become memories
· Gifts you gave stay on a Memories timeline with their dates.

■ Your records stay on your phone
· No sign-up, no login.
· Wishes and photos are stored on your phone and are not sent to us.
· You can make a backup file and keep it yourself.

■ Good to know
· The app is free and shows ads on some parent screens.
· To improve the app we collect anonymous usage statistics and crash reports. Wish names, photos, and children's names are not collected.
· "Where to buy?" opens a shopping search in your browser only when a parent taps it.

Privacy policy: https://appcellent.dev/apps/sowonkong/privacy/en/
Contact: appcellent.dev@gmail.com

name: Space4X99
description:
Every level. A new universe.

Pilot your ship through 50 levels across five space sectors. Dodge meteors, break through drone patrols and challenge a sector commander in every tenth level.

Move your ship left and right with your finger. Firing is automatic, so you can focus on your route, crystals and incoming danger. Use shields, magnets and overdrive, build a streak and complete optional mission objectives.

Your campaign includes:
• 50 progressively unlocked levels and five bosses
• Five distinct sectors with planets, nebulae and changing backgrounds
• Meteor storms, drone patrols, elite opponents and varied objectives
• Completed levels to replay for better personal scores
• Optional music, sound effects and reduced effect motion
• Slovak and English interfaces

Play without internet, ads or in-app purchases. No account is required. Completed levels, personal bests and settings are saved on your device.

name: Span: Full-Width Safari
description:
On the iPhone Duo's front screen, Safari keeps its buttons in a column on the right and lays web pages out beside it. Almost a fifth of the screen goes unused. Span gives pages the whole width.

FULL WIDTH, NOTHING HIDDEN
• Pages lay out across the entire front screen: pictures, cards, grids and colored bars reach the edge.
• Text wraps before Safari's column, so nothing you read sits under the clock or the buttons.
• Links and buttons stay where you can tap them.
• Headers, cookie banners, sign-in sheets and pop-ups fit, with their close buttons in reach.
• Pages don't slide sideways.

NOTHING TO SET UP PER SITE
• One switch in Safari's settings. No per-site lists, modes or menus.
• Works in Private Browsing.
• Works with sites that rebuild their layout as you browse, right-to-left pages and web apps.
• Leaves desktop-width pages, the unfolded screen and other iPhones exactly as they are.

PRIVATE
Span changes how pages are laid out on your device and nothing else. No account, no analytics, no tracking, no network requests. The code is open source.

SETUP
Open Span, tap Open Settings, turn on Allow Extension and set All Websites to Allow.

Made for iPhone Duo. On other iPhones Safari already gives pages the full width, so Span has nothing to change.

name: Spanish Flashcards: Espanly
description:
Espanly puts Spanish from Spain where you look most: your Lock Screen.

A few new words a day, each on a painted card from a real corner of Spain. Hear it said aloud, tap Slower when you need it, and read it the way it sounds. Words come back just before you would forget them, so they stick.

WHO IT IS FOR
People already learning Spanish, in a class, with a tutor or in another app, who want the everyday words to finally stay. Espanly is a vocabulary app: it builds your words next to your course, it does not replace it.

WHAT YOU GET
- 864 everyday words from Spain, with Latin American words as a small note
- A real recorded voice, not a robot, and it works offline
- Each word written the way it sounds: el PLA·to
- Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets, a new word every time you look
- Two minutes a day: new words, plus the ones coming back right on time
- Topics you pick: travel, daily life, culture, work and love
- Meanings in 13 languages

WHY YOU KEEP COMING BACK
- Finish the day and a painted postcard from Spain arrives, with the words you just learned
- Your week's painting gets a little more colour every day you finish
- A streak you can see, and now and then a golden surprise

ESPANLY PLUS
Espanly Plus is a subscription: Yearly with a 7-day free trial, or Monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://espanly.byaca.dev/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://espanly.byaca.dev/privacy/

name: Speckwick Tavern Duel
description:
Drop pairs of jelly dots onto the board, matching four of the same color to make them explode. Skillfully arrange their positions so that one explosion triggers multiple subsequent explosions, creating a chain reaction and sending pebbles to your opponent's board. But always keep an eye on your own board, because a well-timed counter-attack can stop an incoming attack.
Test your skills against nine opponents, each with their own strategy. Some prefer continuous attacks, while others patiently wait to unleash a large chain. Winning unlocks five heroes with special abilities, from increased attack power and reduced damage to faster counter-attacks. Each hero has their own battle board, offering different challenges and gameplay.
In addition to head-to-head matches, you also have 60 puzzle levels requiring precise calculations to create chains with the fewest moves. A new challenge awaits each day, while the endless mode constantly increases the pace and tests your resourcefulness.
Collect stars and honeycombs to unlock new dotting styles, conquer achievement goals, and break your own records.

name: Spidery Connect
description:
Spidery Connect is a customer messaging inbox for businesses that sell on WhatsApp and Instagram.

ONE INBOX
• WhatsApp Business and Instagram DMs together in one place
• Assign chats to your team, add notes and tags
• Saved replies and approved WhatsApp templates

AUTOMATIC REPLIES, DAY AND NIGHT
• Welcome messages, keyword answers and after-hours replies
• Instagram comment-to-DM: someone comments a word, they get your details by DM
• No-code chatbots with buttons and questions
• The bot steps back as soon as your team replies

NEVER MISS A LEAD
• Every enquiry lands in a lead sheet with status and source
• Follow-up reminders and call logs
• See which ads bring you chats and leads

ON YOUR PHONE
• Instant notifications for new messages
• Face ID lock to keep customer chats private
• Unread count on the app icon

Spidery Connect uses the official WhatsApp Business Platform and Instagram API. An account on connect.spideryweb.com is required.

name: Spinback Door
description:
Spinback Door is the ticket scanner for staff at Spinback Club events.

Scan the QR code on a guest's ticket and the app says right away whether to let them in:
- Green: the ticket is good. The guest's name and ticket type are shown.
- Red: stop. The app says why, such as a ticket that was already used or one for a different night.

Made for a busy door:
- Fast scanning with a flashlight for dark entrances.
- Find a guest by name when a phone has died or a code will not scan.
- A live count of how many guests are inside.
- Keeps working with no signal. Check-ins are saved on the phone and sent when the signal is back.
- Undo a check-in made by mistake.

This app is for Spinback Club door staff. It needs a door PIN from the club. Tickets are sold at spinbackclub.com.

name: Spirit Quest Adventures
description:
A hidden world is waiting within and beyond your doorstep.

Spirit Quest turns ordinary walks into a whimsical adventure. Explore a live map, follow nearby discoveries, and search for friendly Spirits through your iPhone camera in augmented reality.

name: Spoke Depot
description:
Spoke Depot je lokální servis kol a nástroj pro správu pohonů určený pro cyklisty. Centralizuje konfiguraci více kol, porovnávání upgradů, sledování životnosti komponentů, připomenutí údržby a komplexní záznamy o výdajích a historii. Je přizpůsoben pro cyklisty, kteří vlastní jedno nebo více silničních, dojížděcích nebo turistických kol a chtějí si vést systematické záznamy; pro nadšence, kteří často vyměňují kazety, převodníky nebo řetězy a potřebují porovnávat převodové poměry a teoretické rychlosti; a pro kutily, kteří si provádějí údržbu sami a chtějí dostávat připomenutí na základě najetých kilometrů nebo času.

Rozhraní aplikace je v češtině; jednotky jsou pevně stanoveny na km, mm a Kč (české koruny).

Spravujte svou sbírku kol – vytvářejte, přepínejte mezi nimi, archivujte je nebo je obnovujte. Zaznamenávejte podrobnosti, jako je značka, model, sériové číslo a fotografie. Aktualizujte kumulativní počet najetých kilometrů pomocí specializovaného procesu oprav, který uchovává historii, vyrovnává používání komponentů a pozastavuje pravidla údržby do doby, než budou zkontrolována.

Pohon a upgrady
Zadejte a ověřte aktuální počet zubů převodníků/kazet a obvod kola. Porovnejte potenciální konfigurace analýzou převodových poměrů, rozsahu převodů, teoretických rychlostí při specifických kadencích a požadovaných kadencí pro cílové rychlosti. Uložte si plány upgradu a kontrolní seznamy kompatibility manuálů a poté po instalaci komponent synchronizujte aktuální nastavení pohonu – vytvořte historický snímek.

Životnost komponent
Vytvořte záznamy pro jednotlivé díly (např. řetězy) a kategorizujte je jako „používané“, „náhradní“ nebo „vyřazené“. Finalizujte počet najetých kilometrů po demontáži, převeďte komponenty z „náhradní“ do „používané“ (i napříč různými koly) a zohledněte komponenty s neznámým předchozím použitím.

Údržba
Nastavte si připomenutí na základě času (dny), vzdálenosti (km) nebo podle toho, které prahové hodnoty je dosaženo dříve. Spravujte úkoly označením jako dokončené, pozastavené, obnovené nebo odložené o tři dny. Filtrujte zobrazení podle kola (všechny nebo aktuální) a podle stavu (čekající, všechny nebo dokončené).

Výdaje a historie
Zaznamenávejte úkoly údržby a různé náklady (s možností přiložit fotografie nebo účtenky). Zobrazujte souhrny podle roku nebo pro celou historii, včetně měsíčních statistik. Historické záznamy lze filtrovat, upravovat nebo mazat; k dispozici jsou také vestavěné nástroje pro identifikaci a řešení duplicitních záznamů.

name: Spoonless: Energy Pacing
description:
Spoonless shows how much energy you have left right now, so you can pace your day before you run out. It reads sleep, heart rate, and activity from Apple Health and shows your energy as 10 spoons or as a battery.

Why "Spoonless"? Because it doesn't take any of your spoons. Most energy and pacing apps ask you to log how you feel and what you did, every day, and that costs energy you may not have. Spoonless works out of the box: allow Apple Health once, and it updates on its own all day. The only thing you ever need to tap is optional: "Doesn't seem right? Adjust," when a reading feels off, and Spoonless learns from it so it gets closer over time. Checking in is fun, too, with XP and levels just for opening the app.

Made for ADHD, autism, Long COVID, ME/CFS, POTS, fibromyalgia, EDS, and other chronic illnesses, and for anyone running low or heading toward burnout. New to spoons? Spoon theory counts energy in spoons: you start each day with a limited number, and everything you do uses some.

Requires an Apple Watch or another tracking device that syncs your sleep and heart rate with the Apple Health app.

Free:
- See your capacity at a glance: good capacity, medium energy, pushable but hard, or no capacity for activity.
- See when your tracker last synced, with a best estimate while it catches up.
- Teach Spoonless with Adjust, and it learns you over time.
- Gentle pacing tips that fit how many spoons you have right now.
- Earn Spoonage XP just by checking in, and level up.
- Pick your colors, with color-blind mode and dark mode.

Spoonless Plus:
- See the next 7 days in plain words, with your calendar's events and the spoons you're likely to have for each.
- See your pace, and when your capacity is likely to run out today or what you'll have left at bedtime.
- Tips written for your conditions, such as ADHD, autism, Long COVID, ME/CFS, POTS, EDS, fibromyalgia, or lupus.
- Gentle heads-ups with time to rest before you're likely to run out.
- The Spoonage Store and your collection: spend your XP on gifts, backgrounds that restyle the whole app, boosters, and limited editions for the season.

Spoonless Plus is $2.99 a month in the US (prices vary by country), charged to your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Private by design: no account, no server, no tracking, no ads. Spoonless never sells your health data or anything else about you. Your Health data stays on your iPhone.

Spoonless gives an estimate to help with pacing. It isn't medical advice.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1WNENjFrnycCzQ5FLjBcsqTW0A_HFhJ3IDJ_GU6B-7-0/edit?usp=sharing

name: Spoonmath: Recipe Macros
description:
Saved a recipe from a reel and wondered what's in it? Spoonmath turns a recipe caption or recipe link into estimated calories and macros per serving, with the source of every number.

HOW IT WORKS
• Copy the caption from a TikTok or Instagram recipe, or paste a recipe website link
• Spoonmath reads the ingredients and amounts
• Each ingredient is matched to USDA FoodData Central, and the macros are calculated from that data, not guessed
• See calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber per serving

SEE WHERE EVERY NUMBER COMES FROM
Every ingredient shows the USDA food it was matched to. Weak matches are flagged so you know what to double-check.

MADE FOR PEOPLE WHO TRACK MACROS
• Change the servings and the numbers update
• Set a daily protein target
• Keep every recipe in your library, with a link back to the original post

YOUR WAY
• Hide calories at any time and see protein and macros only
• No account needed to start. Sign in with Apple later to keep recipes across devices
• Delete your account and data from Settings

SPOONMATH PRO
Full macros on every recipe and per-ingredient sources. $29.99/year with a 3-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at the end of the trial. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID settings.

Nutrition numbers are estimates calculated from USDA FoodData Central and the amounts in a recipe. They are not medical or dietary advice.

Terms of Use: https://spoonmath.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://spoonmath.com/privacy

name: Sproutees
description:
The seeds walk in a line and never look where they are going. Cliffs, ponds, walls: they just keep walking.
Give one seed a skill. It opens the way, and all the others follow.

ONE SEED SAVES THE CROWD
• Dig down, bore through walls, build vine stairs
• A tendril seed leaves a vine on the wall for everyone to climb
• A fluff seed leaves a cushion where it lands, so the rest drop safely
• Paint moss to make a path, snip vines with scissors, raise a sprout with the watering can

13 SKILLS, 100+ MAPS
• Four worlds: garden, pond, greenhouse and moonlit hill
• Big maps that scroll in every direction, with a minimap to plan your route
• Some skills have to be found along the way
• Gates, crumbling leaves, and a golden seed that must get home
• A new map every day, and a garden that grows with your stars

THREE STARS
• Every map hides three stars
• A seed picks one up by walking through it
• Stars hanging in the air take a jump or a climb to reach

EASY TO PLAY
• Tap a skill and time slows down, so you can choose calmly
• Fast-forward at 2x or 3x
• Plays offline
• Hand-made felt and clay look

Available in English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French and German.

name: States Civic Desk
description:
States Civic Desk is a free, bilingual civic utility for everyone in India. Pick your state and city once and get the public information you actually need — clearly, quickly, in English or Hindi.

SOS AND HELPLINES
• One tap to call 112, ambulance, fire, women's and child helplines, cyber-fraud 1930 and more
• National, state and city helplines in one place, each with its official source
• Works offline, so the numbers are there when you need them

GOVERNMENT JOBS
• Recruitment notices with posts, eligibility, age limit, fee and salary
• Last-date countdown and a direct link to the official application site
• Filter to see only jobs that are still open

LOCAL ALERTS AND NOTICES
• Traffic diversions, power and water shutdowns, weather warnings and official notices
• Severity colours show at a glance what needs action
• Optional notifications for urgent alerts in your city

SERVICES AND GUIDES
• Step-by-step guides for Aadhaar, PAN, voter ID, passport, ration card, driving licence, RTI and more
• Documents checklists, official links, time and cost where the source states them

REPORT A CIVIC PROBLEM
• Report a pothole, garbage, broken streetlight, water leak or other problem with photos and location
• Get a reference number and follow its status
• Reports are checked by our desk before anything is shown publicly, and your identity is never shown

MADE FOR INDIA
• All 28 states and 8 union territories
• Full Hindi and English, light and dark mode, large text support
• No ads, no tracking

States Civic Desk is an independent information service run by Fixholics. It is not a government app and is not affiliated with any government body; every item links to its official source.

name: Station-Pass
description:
Station Pass keeps one hand-sewn book on this iPhone. Name the book, set how many signatures it has, and how many stations run along each signature.

Odd signatures run from the head to the tail. Even signatures run from the tail to the head. The first station and the last station take a kettle stitch. The stations between them take a long stitch. The board shows the current station, the direction, and the stitch.

Each station comes with one line on what to do there: leave a tail at the very first hole, finish the second signature with a square knot, hook behind the link between the two signatures below at a kettle, run along the spine to the next station, and tie off at the end.

The station map draws every signature as one row. Tap any station to move the needle there. Pressed through by mistake? Undo appears for a few seconds and takes back one pass.

Find a book by name. Change the name or the counts. Leave a note about the thread. Delete a book you no longer need. The records stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Statly | Estadística
description:
Statly es una calculadora de probabilidad y estadística pensada para estudiar, enseñar y explorar datos desde tu iPhone o iPad.

DISTRIBUCIONES
• Explora 31 distribuciones continuas, discretas y no paramétricas: normal, t de Student, ji cuadrada, F, exponencial, gamma, beta, Weibull, Pareto, lognormal, binomial, Poisson, hipergeométrica, rachas, Wilcoxon, Mann–Whitney, Kolmogorov–Smirnov, Lilliefors y más.
• Calcula P(X ≤ x), P(X ≥ x), P(X = x) e intervalos, con áreas o barras sombreadas en la gráfica.
• Obtén cuantiles y valores críticos; en discretas, compara los dos umbrales enteros alrededor de la probabilidad solicitada.
• Consulta fórmulas, media, varianza y soporte, y copia la ficha matemática en LaTeX.
• Genera muestras aleatorias de hasta 100 valores con semilla opcional; cópialas, expórtalas a CSV o envíalas a Datos.

ANÁLISIS DE DATOS
• Introduce una tabla, pega valores o importa un CSV.
• Consulta estadística descriptiva, frecuencias, histogramas, diagramas de caja y distribución acumulada empírica.
• Ajusta regresiones lineales simples y múltiples, con coeficientes, R² ajustado, ANOVA del modelo, intervalos y residuos.
• Explora pruebas de normalidad como Shapiro–Wilk, Lilliefors, Anderson–Darling y Cramér–von Mises.
• Compara muestras con pruebas no paramétricas y ANOVA de un factor. Las pantallas explican los supuestos, los datos excluidos y los casos no definidos.

EN TU DISPOSITIVO
Los cálculos principales funcionan sin conexión. Statly no tiene anuncios, no requiere cuenta y no envía tus tablas a un servidor. Tú decides cuándo copiar, exportar o compartir resultados.

Diseñada de forma nativa para iPhone y iPad, con modo claro y oscuro y ajustes de precisión.

Un proyecto de DataMath Academy.

name: StatPi
description:
Numbers in the formula and no idea why? StatPi writes out every step between the formula and the answer, and explains why each step is there.

Designed with a statistician who teaches statistics. Dr. Paul Weiss taught on the faculty of Emory University's Rollins School of Public Health for more than twenty years. StatPi is his way of teaching, on your phone at midnight when the step you are missing is the one in front of you.

Free, always, with no account:
- M1 Data entry: type your numbers or bring in a CSV, one variable or two.
- M2 Describe: mean, spread, shape, the histogram and the boxplot, each sum written out.
- M3 Probability: binomial, Poisson, normal, t, chi-square and F, step by step. Drag the curve or type the value.
- Coach me through it: on any worked answer, StatPi hides the working and asks you each step in turn. A miss gets a hint, never the number.
- Join a class: scan the code on the screen and send your value. No account, and your phone sends no personal data unless you choose to type a name.

The same answers R gives. Every build is checked against reference results from R and SciPy before it ships.

Works offline. Everything you type on a sheet stays on your phone.
