StatPi Full adds M4 Bayes' rule, M5 intervals and t tests, M6 ANOVA and counts with Tukey's follow-up comparisons, linear regression, and live class sessions: one code on the screen, every student phone sends a value, and the room sees the class results. Survey, epidemiology and clinical designs are added as each is built.

StatPi Full is for anyone, student or teacher. Buy it once on the StatPi website, then sign in on the app with the same email and the six-digit code StatPi emails you.

The Case Wall holds worked examples from the StatPi team, labelled as examples. When a teacher shares a class, a person reads it before it appears.

name: Steel Valley Records
description:
Steel Valley Records is an independent record shop from Port Talbot, Wales, for AOR, melodic rock, prog and metal on CD and vinyl. Sold by a fan, to a fan.

DIG THROUGH THE CRATE 
Flick through the shelves one big cover at a time. Swipe right to save a record, left to move on, and hear a 30-second clip of each as you go, like flicking through a crate with headphones on.

IS THAT IN STOCK? 
Hear a song you like in the pub or on the radio? Tap Listen. We'll name it and show you that band's records on our shelf, in stock first.

ROB'S PICKS EVERY MONTH 
The New Releases guide, Record of the Month and the records Rob can't stop playing, written by someone who actually listens.

PICKED FOR YOU 
The more you wishlist, follow and buy, the better your picks get. Your own shelf of records you'll love, on the home screen.

BE FIRST TO KNOW 
Follow your favourite bands and labels and get an alert the moment something new lands, a sold-out CD is back, or your order is on its way.

NEVER MISS A RELEASE 
A big release calendar with covers, pre-orders at £1 off, and countdowns to release day.

MADE FOR iPHONE DUO Unfold on a release and it opens like a CD case: the cover on one side, the tracks, clips and Add to basket on the other.

ALSO

30-second clips of every track, from Apple Music
Steel Shards loyalty points on every order
Home-screen widget with what's new and your next pre-order
Sign in with Apple
Pay with Apple Pay, card or Klarna

name: Steppity Step
description:
Your steps, beautifully on your home screen.

Steppity Step is the step counter widget that matches your aesthetic. Glance at your phone and see today's steps, how far you have to go, and a little sneaker walking you to your goal.

WIDGETS THAT LOOK AS GOOD AS YOUR HOME SCREEN
• Today widget in small and medium, with a sneaker that walks toward your goal as you do
• Lock Screen widgets, so you see your steps without unlocking
• Tap to refresh right on the widget
• Looks great on tinted and clear Home Screens, and in StandBy

WORKS WITH WHAT YOU ALREADY HAVE
Steppity reads your steps from Apple Health, so it works with your iPhone, Apple Watch and other trackers that sync steps to Health. No new gadgets, no setup.

NUDGES, NOT GUILT
• Pick a daily goal that suits you
• Up to three reminders a day, and none once you've hit your goal
• Keep going past 100%. Okay, overachiever.

SHARE YOUR DAY
Make a story-sized card of today's steps and post it anywhere.

STEPPITY PRO: ONE PAYMENT, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Every theme, including Chrome, Lime, Cherry and Berry, on every widget
• Your full step history on a calendar, with best days and streaks
• Week and Streak widgets
Pay once and keep it for good.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your steps never leave your phone.

Step counts come from Apple Health and are estimates. Steppity Step is for everyday motivation, not medical advice.

name: Stéréo - Série 80
description:
Your mix sounds wide in your headphones. But will it hold up on a phone, on the radio or on a Bluetooth speaker?

Stéréo is the stereo meter of Sillon Audio's Série 80. Insert the small Stéréo Émetteur plugin last on Logic Pro's stereo output, and your mix appears on a walnut faceplate with old-school meters.

WHAT YOU SEE
• The vectorscope: the shape of your stereo image, point by point
• The Simple view: your speakers, your head, and the cloud of sound between them
• A needle phase meter, from −1 to +1, that moves like a real needle
• The width of your mix, from narrow to very wide
• Left and right levels
• MONO OK and OUT OF PHASE lights

A VERDICT IN PLAIN ENGLISH
A paper strip tells you in one sentence whether your mix is solid in mono, fragile or out of phase, and what to check.

ON YOUR MAC AND IPAD
• On the Mac: the Stéréo app shows the meters in its own window, next to Logic Pro
• On the iPad: the meters appear right in the plugin window, in Logic Pro for iPad
• A Logic project keeps its Stéréo Émetteur from one device to the other

MADE FOR THE STUDIO
• Your audio passes through untouched: the plugin only measures
• Very light
• A built-in guide that explains what each meter is for
• In English and French
• No account, no data collected

Stéréo is part of Sillon Audio's Série 80, designed in Quebec by a home studio musician.

Requires Logic Pro, GarageBand or another app that hosts Audio Unit v3 plugins.

name: Stillframe
description:
Stillframe lets you step through a video one frame at a time and save the exact frame you want as a photo, at the video's full resolution.

A screenshot of a paused video is lower quality and rarely lands on the right moment. Stillframe reads the real frames from the video file, so what you save is the frame itself.

FIND THE FRAME
• Ruler with one tick per frame for precise stepping
• Thumbnail scrubber for jumping anywhere in the video
• Step buttons (hold to keep stepping) and one-second jumps
• Slow-motion playback at 0.5×, 0.25× and 0.1×
• Pinch to zoom up to 30× to check focus and detail

SAVE IT PROPERLY
• Full original resolution, including 4K
• Lossless PNG or smaller JPEG
• Optional smaller sizes such as 1080p or 720p
• Save to Photos or send it through the share sheet

KEEP TRACK
• Bookmark frames as you go
• Jump between bookmarks from a row of thumbnails
• Export all bookmarked frames in one go

PRIVATE
• Everything happens on your phone
• No account, no ads, no tracking

Works with videos from your photo library and the Files app, including high frame rate clips.

Note: frames from HDR video are saved as standard (SDR) images.

name: Stirloom
description:
Stirloom is an on-device sleep-hygiene companion that listens to mattress micro-motion through the iPhone accelerometer — no wearable, no account, and no cloud upload of raw sensor streams.

Tonight — Set a wake target and a smart window (20–60 minutes). Start a session, place the phone face-down near your torso, and keep Stirloom open (preferably plugged in).

Monitoring — Live motion sparks and a cycle strip estimate quieter and deeper arcs from local samples as a wellness heuristic. Inside your wake window, Stirloom waits for a quieter pocket and uses haptics to nudge you; if none appears, it still wakes you at the window’s end.

Cycles — Every finished night saves a local summary with stage minutes, approximate cycle count, and whether a smart wake fired. Swipe to delete. Clear the archive anytime in Nest.

Field — Offline notes on cycle stacking, mattress placement, lightest-wake rationale, myths, and a simple wind-down lane. Star articles you want to revisit.

Nest — Toggle haptics, keep-awake, and monitor UI dim; reopen the field guide; read the bundled privacy policy without leaving the app.

Stirloom does not require an account and does not need a network connection after install. Airplane Mode still delivers monitoring, history, and field notes.

Stirloom is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis or treatment.

name: STRAIT RUN: Smuggler
description:
Kill the lights, ease the throttle, and get across the strait before anyone sees you.

STRAIT RUN is a stealth game on the water. You pilot a small, fast boat at night, carrying cargo between islands and harbours while patrol boats search the sea.

● Stay unseen
Searchlights sweep the water and the patrols listen for your engine. Creep along slow and quiet, tuck in behind a big ship, or mix with the fishing boats — or push the throttle all the way and race for safety.

● Read the sea
Shallows, anchorages, lighthouses and busy shipping lanes. Fog, blowing dust and the first light of dawn change how far the patrols can see, and how you play each run.

● Part 1, "Where It Began": ten jobs
Sheep that bleat if you turn too hard. A clinic with a deadline. A deck stacked with fuel drums. A meeting in thick fog that you can only find by its horn. Every job has its own client and its own catch.

● Part 2, "Earning Your Stripes": ten new jobs
Head out beyond the strait. On the open sea, hide in the troughs of a heavy swell, and keep an eye on your fuel.
A camera drone that spots boats by their engine heat. Flares that light up the night. A patrol boat too fast to outrun in a straight line. Hovercraft that follow you into the shallows. Watchers hidden among the tour boats.
The risks are higher, and the pay is much better.

● Part 3, "No Way Out": ten new jobs
Even the waters that used to be safe are watched now.
A surveillance balloon over the sea. A map that jumps when the GPS signal is scrambled. Nets and ropes that get caught in your propeller. Patrol boats whose water cannons can stall your engine, jet skis on your tail, and a drone helicopter with a camera. A handover in the middle of a thunder squall.
The toughest runs yet.

● Choose your boat at the shipyard
Buy another boat with the money you earn, and take it out instead.
The "Triple-Engine RIB", fast and good in the waves. The "Reinforced Cargo Boat", tough and able to carry more. The "Disguised Fishing Boat", quiet and easy to lose among the fishing boats. Each one has its own speed, noise, toughness and cargo space.
Four more join them: the "Radar Speedboat", which spots the patrols first; the "Smokescreen Speedboat", which hides behind its smoke; the "Shallow-Water Jet Boat", which slips through the shallows; and the "Silent Electric Boat", almost silent and with no engine heat.

● A work of fiction
All the countries, place names, people and organisations in this game are invented, and its stories are not based on real events.

● Part 1: stages 1–2 are free, and stages 3–10 unlock with a one-time purchase.
● Part 2: all ten stages unlock with a separate one-time purchase.
● Part 3: all ten stages unlock with its own one-time purchase.
● After you buy a part, you can play its stages in any order.
● Shipyard boats can be bought with the money you earn in the game, or as in-app purchases.
● No ads. No account needed.

Languages: Japanese, English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Korean, Traditional Chinese.

name: Stray: Street Snap Camera
description:
For anyone who wants to snap the moment a walk stops them in their tracks.

Stray is a street snap camera for people who shoot the way a stray cat roams: no plan, eyes open. Launch, look, shoot. That's it.

■ Why I made it
I love street photography, small cameras, and a vintage mood. But the cameras I liked were never cheap. I looked for an app, but as far as I searched, I couldn't find one focused on quick access, the kind you pull out mid-walk and just snap. So I made it myself: a camera you can use without any pressure, and one that never loses its character.

It isn't only for street photographers. If you simply love a vintage look, I hope you'll feel at home here too.

No sign-in. No complicated setup. 

■ True 28mm and 40mm
Focal lengths follow the 35mm-equivalent standard. On phones with a telephoto, you see its real focal length (77, 100, 120 and so on).

■ Film looks you see before you shoot
WARM, COOL, VNTG and MONO, live in the viewfinder. Turn them off with OFF.

■ Hands-on controls
Turn the exposure wheel. On iPhones with a Camera Control button, pick the lens and film and press to shoot.

■ Start the way you like
Choose in Settings whether to remember your last lens and film.

■ Choose your format
Save as HEIC (smaller files) or JPEG (opens anywhere).

■ Share right away
Send your photos to messages and other apps without leaving Stray.

■ Where you shot it (optional)
Turn it on in Settings to save the place you took each photo in the Photos app. Your location stays on your device and is never sent anywhere.

■ Honest photo info
Camera, ISO, aperture and focal length stay in the Photos app.

Available in English and Korean.

* 40mm is a crop of the main camera, so resolution may be lower on 12MP phones.
* Camera Control needs an iPhone that has the button.

name: StrayBirds: Bird Journal
description:
StrayBirds turns the birds you meet into stickers you can keep.

Take a photo or pick one from your library. StrayBirds suggests what the bird is, cuts it out into a white-bordered sticker, and saves it to your Sticker Book with the date and place you saw it. Then arrange your stickers into journal pages and put them on your Home Screen.

IDENTIFY BIRDS ON YOUR DEVICE
• Recognizes nearly 11,000 bird species, entirely on-device. No account, no upload, works without a connection.
• Shows the top three candidates with common name, scientific name and confidence, and tells you when it isn't sure.
• If the photo has a location, candidates are re-ranked by which species are actually recorded nearby in that month. You can always switch back to the original ranking.
• None of them right? Search the full species list, or draw a box around the bird and try again.

DIE-CUT STICKERS
• The bird is lifted out of the photo automatically, with a thick white border and a soft shadow.
• Touch Up lets you erase a stray branch or bring back a missed wing tip with a brush.

YOUR STICKER BOOK
• Each sticker keeps the date and place from the photo. Edit the place by name, by search, or with your current location.
• Add field notes: count, sex, age, plumage, heard-only, possible escapee, or mark a record as unconfirmed.
• Stickers from the same day and place are grouped into an outing, like "Today · Wetland Park · 6 species".
• Export your records as CSV, including eBird Record Format for easy import.

FIELD GUIDE
• Every species you've collected, numbered in the order you first met them.
• A small ceremony plays each time you add a new species.
• Species pages show order and family, IUCN status, your sightings, and a profile covering habitat, diet, behavior and breeding.

BIRDING JOURNAL & WIDGETS
• Turn an outing into a journal page in one tap, then rearrange, resize and rotate stickers, add text, and pick paper, cork, grid or kraft backgrounds.
• Shuffle lays your stickers out like a scrapbook page, with washi tape, buttons and bows.
• Add small, medium or large Home Screen widgets that show your journal. Multi-page journals rotate through their pages.
• For threatened and sensitive species, journal captions show only the city, not the exact spot, to help protect the birds.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos, stickers and records stay on your iPhone. StrayBirds has no account, no ads and no tracking.

Species profiles are adapted from Wikipedia under CC BY-SA 4.0. Taxonomy from Wikidata. Distribution data from GBIF.

name: StrongRider: Snowboard & Ski
description:
Runs on iPhone, on Apple Watch, or both.

StrongRider is a dryland strength program for snowboarders and skiers. Twelve weeks, four sessions a week, built around what riding asks of your body: legs that hold an edge all day, a core that keeps you stacked over your board or skis, and landings you can absorb.

It's a whole-body plan: each week has a legs-and-landing day, a pull-and-core day, a push day and a kettlebell day. A pull-up bar, one kettlebell and a bench cover all of it, and every exercise has a no-gear swap.

On iPhone
The full-screen player guides every exercise: the move shown as a looping figure, your target, the cues, and a rest timer that also sits on your Lock Screen. Log reps with a tap, swap any exercise mid-session, and finish with what you beat.

On Apple Watch
Leave your phone in the locker. The watch app runs the whole session on its own: every exercise, rep target and cue, rest with a haptic nudge 10 seconds before the next set, reps on the Digital Crown, and the workout saved to Apple Health so it counts toward your Activity rings.

The program
• Off-Season Build: 12 weeks in three blocks. Foundation, then Build, then Power & Peak.
• Deload weeks (4, 8 and 12) drop to about 60% of the volume so you absorb the work.
• Jumps build in steps: landing drills first, box jumps from week 5, full plyometrics only after 8 weeks of strength work.
• Rider-specific choices: tempo goblet squats, step-ups for landing strength, single-leg RDLs for balance, lateral step-overs for edge-to-edge, lateral bounds you stick on landing, windshield wipers for rotation.
• In-Season Maintain: 2 short sessions a week to keep your strength while you ride, with a "rode today" option that lightens the session.
• Cycle 2: run the build again one rung up each exercise ladder, with your history carried over.

Made to fit you
• A quick placement test sets your starting level for pull-ups, push-ups, single-leg squats and more.
• Every exercise has easier and harder variations. Swap mid-session and the app remembers.
• Tell it your gear (pull-up bar, kettlebell, box, bench, band, jump rope, or nothing) and it substitutes what you don't have.
• 30, 45 or full-length sessions.
• Progress follows sessions, not the calendar. Miss a week for a powder trip and you pick up where you left off.

See yourself get stronger
• Every set logged, with honest "last time" targets and a prompt when it's time to move up a variation.
• Personal records and a chart for every movement.
• Home Screen widget and watch complication: always know what's next.

On iPhone Duo
Fold it halfway and stand it on the floor. The move, its name and your target stay upright where you can read them from across the room; the controls lie flat. Open it fully and today's plan sits beside every move in the session.

Private by design
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your training log stays on your devices. Workouts go to Apple Health only with your permission.

Pricing
Your first 4 sessions are free, with every feature on. After that, one purchase unlocks the Off-Season Build, In-Season Maintain, Cycle 2 and every future update to them. No subscription. Family Sharing supported.

Strength training carries risk. Check with a healthcare professional before starting a new exercise program, and stop if something hurts.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://strongrider.medtekki.no/privacy.html

name: Studia - Notes & EDT
description:
Studia affiche sur ton iPhone les données scolaires de ton compte EcoleDirecte ou Pronote : notes, devoirs, emploi du temps, vie scolaire, messagerie et cantine. Rien de réinventé, juste plus clair et plus rapide.

CE QUE TU RETROUVES DANS STUDIA
  • Notes et moyennes par matière, moyenne générale, avec la moyenne de classe à côté des tiennes.
  • Devoirs à faire, cochables, avec les pièces jointes.
  • Emploi du temps de la semaine, avec les cours annulés ou modifiés mis en évidence. Tourne ton iPhone pour voir la semaine entière.
  • Vie scolaire : absences et retards.
  • Messagerie : tes messages reçus et leurs pièces jointes.
  • Cantine : solde et menus de la semaine.
  • Compte parent : suis plusieurs enfants depuis la même app.
  • Notifications pour les nouvelles notes, les nouveaux messages et les absences, désactivées par défaut.
  • Hors connexion : tes dernières données restent consultables sans réseau.
  • Thème clair, sombre ou automatique.
  
VIE PRIVÉE D'ABORD
Studia n'a aucun serveur : l'application se connecte directement au service de ton établissement. Tes identifiants sont chiffrés dans le trousseau de l'iPhone. Les données gardées pour le mode hors connexion restent dans l'espace privé de l'application, protégé par le chiffrement de ton iPhone. Aucune publicité, aucun traqueur, aucun outil d'analyse.
  
IMPORTANT
Studia est une application indépendante, développée par un particulier. Elle n'est ni affiliée ni approuvée par EcoleDirecte (Aplim), Pronote ou Index Éducation. Les moyennes sont recalculées par l'application à titre indicatif : seul le bulletin officiel fait foi.

name: Suitbound: Card Defense
description:
Every card has a place. Every formation makes a difference.
Suitbound brings playing-card combinations to a world of atmospheric tower defense. Deploy your hand, connect neighboring towers, and hold the gate against creatures with distinct abilities. A clever formation can turn a fragile defense into a powerful chain of attacks.
BUILD WITH PURPOSE
Each suit brings a different role to the battlefield. Pierce armor with Spades, slow advancing creatures with Hearts, strike groups with Clubs, and fire rapid volleys with Diamonds. Choose where each card belongs, then upgrade, merge, or reposition your towers as your strategy develops.
CONNECT YOUR CARDS
Form Straights to attack faster and Flushes to deal more damage. Combine both effects in a single formation, then use Formation Pulse when the pressure rises. Learn how placement changes your combinations in the dedicated Formation Lab.
FEEL THE SURGE
Chain defeats, protect the gate, and trigger Overdrive for a burst of faster attacks. Face armored creatures, restoring Wisps, disruptive Threadwidows, and the Crown Eater. Different threats reward different defenses.
FIND YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE
Journey through a twelve-wave Expedition, tackle the changing rules of the Daily Trial, or discover how far your formation can go in Endless mode. Experiment with starter decks, relics, card marks, and Contracts that reshape your decisions.
BUILD A LASTING LEGACY
Earn experience, advance your collector level, complete goals, and unlock cosmetics. Follow your highest chains and lifetime Overdrives in Combat Records, compare recent defenses, and work toward your next achievement.
From the Glass Garden to the Crown Sanctum, every run is another chance to build a stronger defense.
Coins and Energy are virtual game resources with no cash value. They cannot be redeemed for money or real-world prizes.

name: Suitcase Ledger
description:
Pack with a clear head. Suitcase Ledger keeps trip essentials in one simple checklist, with separate items for each traveller.

FREE TO USE
• Save two trips
• Start with weekend, beach, business, camping, winter or family templates
• Create personal lists for up to 12 travellers
• Add and edit items, categories and quantities
• Search your list and filter by person or unpacked items
• Track packing progress and undo the last check
• Share a text checklist

OPTIONAL LIFETIME PLUS
One non-consumable in-app purchase adds unlimited trips, fresh copies of previous trips, and PDF export. No subscription. Your saved trips stay readable and editable without Plus.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, advertising, tracking or cloud database. Your trips stay on your iPhone. Packing works offline; purchases and restores need an internet connection.

Templates are starting points: edit them for your destination, activities and personal needs. Export important lists before uninstalling.

Privacy: https://jk-207.github.io/ledger-app-support/#privacy
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Suivi KMS
SunReserve: Off-Grid Power
description:
SunReserve: Off-Grid Power is your offline-first interactive solar panel calculator, battery backup planner, and power station load estimator. Designed for homeowners facing blackouts, campers, RV owners, and off-grid enthusiasts, SunReserve turns complex electrical math into a clear, stress-free routine.

Interactively drag and adjust solar panel tilt angles on a 2D visual canvas, simulate seasonal sun angles, calculate daily watt-hour generation, and map out exact runtime loads for refrigerators, routers, and essential home appliances without needing an active internet connection.


Key Features and Power Utility Tools

Interactive SpriteKit Solar & Load Canvas
- Touch-to-Tilt Solar Panel Canvas: Adjust mounting angles for balconies, roofs, or portable stands to maximize sunlight capture.
- Real-Time Battery Discharge Curve: Simulate continuous power draw from household appliances and track remaining station hours.

Power Station & Appliance Load Engine
- Multi-Device Load Scaler: Add refrigerators, Wi-Fi routers, lights, and laptops to compute exact peak wattage and capacity drains.
- Solar Generation Estimator: Factor in peak sun hours, panel wattage ratings, and seasonal efficiency losses offline.

Power Vault & Backup Log
- Saved Energy Scenarios: Store custom blackout readiness profiles and equipment loadouts offline.
- 100% Offline Field Access: Plan power setups directly during grid failures, remote camping sites, or basements with zero cellular signal.

Designed for:
- Homeowners calculating battery station runtime during emergency grid blackouts.
- RV and van-life travelers optimizing solar panel placement on roofs.
- DIY off-grid builders estimating daily watt-hour balances.

name: Super Light Stage
description:
Przygotuj swiatlo przed nagraniem, wystepem lub transmisja i zobacz, jak zmienia sie obraz jeszcze zanim wlaczysz kamere. Super Light Stage pozwala testowac ustawienia lamp, porownywac warianty i dobierac scenografie do rodzaju wystepu, aby szybciej osiagnac wyglad, jaki chcesz pokazac widzom.

Najpierw wybierasz format wystepu, potem scene i fotografie odniesienia, a nastepnie ustawiasz lampy tak, by dopasowac swiatlo do kadru. Wszystko odbywa sie wizualnie, prosto i bez zgadywania.

Najwazniejsze funkcje
- Wybór formatu i sceny - dopasuj startowy układ do rozmowy, muzyki, prezentacji przedmiotu lub ujecia dwojki osób.
- Fotografie odniesienia - korzystaj z gotowych przykladow oswietlenia albo dodaj wlasne zdjecie z mediow.
- Wirtualne lampy - przesuwaj, obracaj i ustawiaj parametry kazdego zrodla swiatla osobno.
- Pelna kontrola swiatla - reguluj jasnosc, kolor, szerokosc wiazki i miekosc oswietlenia.
- Dwa widoki pracy - przechodz miedzy scena a widokiem z kamery, by od razu porownac rezultat.
- Gotowe schematy - korzystaj z presetow, takich jak miekie swiatlo do rozmowy czy swiatlo boczne.
- Zapis i porownanie - zapisuj projekt razem z fotografia, wroc do niego pozniej i porownuj rozne wersje.
- Eksport obrazu - zapisuj schemat lub finalny pionowy kadr do dalszego uzycia.

Dla kogo jest ta aplikacja
- Dla osob prowadzacych transmisje, podcasty i rozmowy przed kamera.
- Dla tworcow wideo, ktorzy chca szybciej planowac oswietlenie przed nagraniem.
- Dla muzykow, prelegentow i prowadzacych wydarzenia.
- Dla osob uczacych sie, jak ustawiac swiatlo na planie lub w domowym studio.

Dlaczego warto
Super Light Stage pomaga myslec o swietle zanim pojawi sie realny plan zdjeciowy. Zamiast prob i bledow dostajesz czytelna, interaktywna przestrzen do testowania ustawien, porownywania wariantow i zapisywania najlepszych rozwiazan. Aplikacja dziala bez konta, a podstawowy scenariusz, przyklady i zapisane projekty sa dostepne takze offline.

Jesli chcesz szybciej przygotowac swiatlo do nagrania, sprawdzic inny klimat sceny albo porownac kilka wariantow oswietlenia, pobierz Super Light Stage i zacznij od razu.

name: Surfside TV
description:
Experience Surfside Community Fellowship right from your living room.

Surfside TV makes it easy to worship with us, catch up on messages, and stay connected with what's happening at Surfside.

**Features include:**
- **Watch Live:** Join our worship services when we're broadcasting.
- **Latest Service:** Catch up on the most recent worship service.
- **Message Archive:** Explore past sermons and browse messages by series.
- **Upcoming Events:** See what's happening in our church community.
- **Visit Us:** Find service times and information about joining us in person.

Whether you're joining us from home, catching up on a message you missed, or exploring Surfside for the first time, we're glad you're here.

Surfside Community Fellowship — The Perfect Church for Imperfect People.

Learn more at surfsidefellowship.org.

name: Sweet Belt: Bakery Sort Puzzle
seller_name: EKSAND BILGISAYAR SANAYI TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
It's a busy day at the bakery! The shelves are full of treats, the belt is spinning and the customers are getting hungry. Send the right dessert at the right moment, serve every order and keep the belt from overflowing.

HOW TO PLAY
• Press and hold a shelf: its treats slide onto the belt one by one.
• The belt pauses while you hold, and treats squeeze in between. You decide when to let go.
• Four customers sit at the counter. Each one wants 3–8 of a single treat and takes only that.
• If the belt fills up with 25 plates, the bakery jams. Plan ahead!
• Once the shelves are empty, "Rush service" kicks in and the belt runs 3x faster.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Easy to learn, satisfying to master: one finger to play, a little strategy in every move.
• No rush, no pressure: think at your own pace and use the belt wisely.
• Soft pastel colors, adorable customers and cheerful sounds.
• Ads never interrupt gameplay; only an occasional short ad between levels (removable with "No Ads").

FEATURES
• Endless levels: every level is checked to be solvable, and each one has 1–3 stars to earn.
• Dessert of the Day: the same level for everyone, every day. Grow your streak and compare times with friends.
• Recipe Book: every treat you serve unlocks new recipe cards. Collect bronze, silver, gold, emerald and diamond badges; every tier rewards a booster, coins or an oven ticket.
• Oven: use an oven ticket and the oven bakes you a booster or coins. One free ticket every day; the odds are shown on the oven screen.
• Daily gift: 100 coins a day for a short video.
• 10 treats: cupcake, donut, cookie, cake slice, chocolate, ice cream, lollipop, bonbon, brownie and jam.
• 3 free hints, combo-multiplied scores and boosters bought with coins.
• Score card: share a great run with a single tap, in the app you choose.
• Play offline: on the subway, on a plane, anywhere.
• English and Turkish, with sound, music and vibration you can switch off.
• No account, no login. The only in-app purchase is the optional "No Ads".

AN HONEST NOTE ABOUT ADS
The game is free and fully playable for free. When the belt fills up or your free hints run out, you can choose to watch a short video to send the belt's desserts back to the shelves or get +2 hints. You can also watch a video for a free booster (3 a day) or the daily gift (once a day). You only watch these if you choose to. Apart from that, after level 4 a short ad may appear between levels, at most once every 3 minutes; ads never interrupt gameplay. Points you earn turn into coins, which buy Sort Shelves, Speed Up Belt and Clear Belt boosters. If you like, a one-time "No Ads" purchase removes the ads between levels for good; rewarded videos stay optional. There are no other real-money purchases.

PRIVACY
Your progress is stored only on your device. Anonymous gameplay stats are collected only if you agree, and you can turn them off in Settings.

Tie your apron, the belt is already rolling. How many customers will you make happy today?

name: Synco · 切分光影节拍器
description:
光，让时间有了形状；
影，让空间有了回响。
琴声未起，呼吸已轻轻落在拍上。

暮光，以流动的光幕铺开节奏；灵动，以轻盈的轨迹勾勒拍点。随机变化的拖尾，让每一次练习都有自然的光影。

• 30–240 的速度范围，惯性滚轮调速，播放中平滑改变速度。
• 支持 1、2、3、4、5、6 六种拍数；每拍可选择 1、2、3、4 个音。

name: T.I.P. Gig: Tech Rider
description:
Create stage plans and technical riders for your next gig.

T.I.P. Gig brings your stage layout, equipment requirements, input and output lists, monitoring details and production notes into one project. Prepare the setup, preview your rider and export a PDF to share with the people working on the show.

Made for musicians, bands, sound engineers and live production crews.

PLAN YOUR STAGE
Arrange instruments, amplifiers, microphones, monitors and other equipment on a measured stage plan. Adjust positions, dimensions, rotation and labels to make your setup clear.

START WITH QUICK PROJECT
Choose your equipment with the guided Quick Project workflow, then refine the layout and technical details.

ORGANISE YOUR TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
Keep input channels, output lists, personal monitoring routing, backline requirements and notes alongside your stage plan.

PREVIEW AND EXPORT
Review your technical rider inside the app, then export it as a PDF with your stage plan and technical information ready to share.

REUSE YOUR SETUPS
Save projects for future shows and manage your own presets and custom input/output objects.

WORK WHERE YOU NEED TO
Create and edit projects on iPhone, iPad and Mac. The core planning and PDF export workflow works locally without an account or an internet connection. Move project files between devices using your preferred file-sharing method.

OPTIONAL RIDER STYLES UPGRADE
The base app includes stage planning, technical rider editing and PDF export. The optional one-time Rider Styles Upgrade adds further control over the rider's appearance, including the option to remove T.I.P. Gig branding.

T.I.P. Gig is a one-time purchase. The Rider Styles Upgrade is sold separately as a one-time in-app purchase.

name: TabiVie: FMGE & NEET PG Prep
description:
TabiVie is a focused prep app for FMGE and NEET PG. Practise MCQs subject by subject and topic by topic, take exam-style timed mocks, and see exactly which topics need more work.

QUESTION BANK
• All 19 FMGE / NEET PG subjects, organised subject → topic → question
• Practice Mode: untimed — the answer and a high-yield explanation appear as soon as you tap
• Search any question by its code or by text
• Save questions to revise later

MOCK TESTS
• Grand Mock: the full syllabus at real exam length
• Custom Mock: choose one topic, a whole subject or several subjects — questions are picked for you
• Exam-style timing: one minute per question, auto-advance when the minute is up, and go back to any question before you submit
• Review every answer with its explanation after the test

ANALYTICS
• Subject-wise accuracy and mastery at a glance
• Tap a subject for topic-by-topic accuracy and your recent results
• AI Study Coach points out weak areas and suggests what to practise next

NOTES & PDFs
• Download faculty notes and read them offline
• Import your own PDFs from Files — books, class notes, past papers
• Highlight, underline and draw on any PDF; your marks are saved on your device

MORE
• Previous-year paper practice and recall-question contributions
• Daily Quick Quiz, study planner, leaderboard and discussions
• Sign in with your email and a one-time code — no password to remember

TabiVie is an independent exam-preparation app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS), the National Medical Commission (NMC) or any government body. Content is for exam preparation only and is not medical advice.

name: TableDirect Caisse
description:
TableDirect Caisse transforme votre iPhone ou iPad en caisse enregistreuse complète pour votre restaurant, bar ou brasserie.

Prenez les commandes à table, envoyez-les directement en cuisine et au bar sur vos imprimantes réseau, encaissez en espèces, carte ou titres-restaurant, et éditez additions et factures en un geste.

FONCTIONNALITÉS
• Plan de salle et gestion des tables
• Prise de commande rapide : menu, catégories, modificateurs (cuisson, suppléments…)
• Envoi automatique des bons en cuisine et au bar (imprimantes du réseau local)
• Addition, note et facture client sur imprimante ticket
• Encaissement multi-moyens : espèces, carte, titres-restaurant, paiement partagé
• Ouverture du tiroir-caisse
• Tickets conformes (NF525) et clôtures Z
• Livre de recettes et export comptable
• Statistiques de ventes en temps réel

TableDirect Caisse se connecte à votre compte TableDirect ; un abonnement actif est requis.

name: Tabletop: Mac Remote Desktop
description:
Tabletop Remote puts your Mac's screen on your iPhone or iPad and lets you drive it: click, type, scroll and drag. It uses the Screen Sharing that is already built into macOS, so there is nothing to install on the Mac.

Your Mac can also sit inside a computer from 1977, with the keyboard to match.

Control your real Mac
Open Remote Desk, pick your Mac from the ones found on your network, and sign in with your Mac account or Screen Sharing password. You are looking at your real desktop. Tap the picture to click, or use the trackpad below it: two fingers to scroll with momentum, a two-finger tap to right-click, touch and hold to drag. Swipe up with three fingers for Mission Control and sideways to change Spaces.

Nothing to install on the Mac
Turn on Screen Sharing in System Settings and you are done. No helper app, no menu bar item, no extra permissions on the Mac.

Your Mac inside a machine from the shelf
Screen Styles show your live desktop in the body of any of the ten shelf computers, with that machine's screen glass, case and a full working keyboard. There is a green phosphor tube from 1977, an amber terminal, a color CRT, an early laptop LCD, and a laptop with a touch strip that sends Esc, Tab, Spotlight and Mission Control. Switch back to the plain view whenever you like.

Made for iPhone Duo
Fold the Duo halfway and it becomes a tiny laptop: your Mac on the top display, trackpad and keys on the bottom, split exactly at the hinge. Open it flat for a larger picture. Folded shut, the cover display gets a compact layout with the picture, a trackpad and the system keyboard.

At home on iPad
With a mouse or trackpad attached, the iPad pointer works on the Mac's picture directly: point, click, right-click, drag and scroll. A hardware keyboard types straight into the Mac, shortcuts included.

Private by design
No account, no cloud and no relay server. The picture and your typing travel only between your device and your Mac, over your own network. Sign-in details are kept in the Keychain on your device. Face ID can lock the list of Macs, and clipboard sharing stays off until you turn it on.

Ask Siri
Say "Connect to my Mac in Tabletop Remote", add the action to a shortcut, or put the Remote Desk button in Control Center.

Ten machines, 1977 to 2001
The shelf holds ten original miniature computers, each with its own desktop. Draw in Petal Sketch, deal Wickspire Solitaire, clear a minefield, break bricks in Seawall Smash, collect flowers in Thistledown Garden or watch a spectrum move to music. Seven apps and games in all.

Fifty secrets
Every machine hides five: trivia, a screensaver, a hidden game, an easter egg. Each has a three-step hint that opens one step at a time.

Light and dark
The app follows your device's appearance. The machines keep their own color either way.

No ads, no subscriptions, no accounts.

name: TagThatMp3
description:
TagThatMp3 is the fast, private way to fix the tags in your MP3, M4A and M4B files, right on your iPhone or iPad.

Edit tags in place. Nothing is re-encoded, so your audio stays bit-for-bit identical. TagThatMp3 rewrites ID3 (v1, v2.2, v2.3 and v2.4) and MP4 tags directly inside your files, and checks the result after every save.

EDIT EVERYTHING
• Title, artist, album, album artist, genre, year, track and disc numbers, composer, comments, grouping and more
• Quick-clean tools: Title Case, UPPERCASE and Clean Spacing
• Auto-capitalize on save and a default genre for untagged files

COVER ART
• Add, replace or remove artwork from Photos, the camera, Files or an artwork search
• Crop to square, resize (500 to 2048 px) and compress as JPEG or PNG
• Front cover, back cover and booklet images

LYRICS
• Plain lyrics for every file
• Synced (LRC) lyrics with tap-to-stamp timing against the built-in player (Pro)

WORKS WITH YOUR FILES
• Open files in place from iCloud Drive, Files, USB drives and network shares
• Add from the Share sheet, by drag and drop, or by importing whole folders
• Your music files never leave your device

BATCH AND AUTOMATION (Pro)
• Edit a whole album at once and change only the fields you choose
• Rename files from tags, and fill tags from file names, with patterns like %track% - %artist% - %title% and a live preview
• Look up tags and artwork from MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive

DESIGNED FOR iOS
Liquid Glass design on the latest iOS, Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, haptics and VoiceOver support. Works on iPhone and iPad.

FREE AND PRO
Edit up to 5 files for free. Unlock unlimited files and the Pro tools with a subscription or a one-time purchase:
• TagThatMp3 Pro Weekly: $2.99 per week
• TagThatMp3 Pro Annual: $19.99 per year
• TagThatMp3 Pro Lifetime: $49.99, one time
The weekly and annual plans include a 3-day free trial for new subscribers.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel at any time in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Takashinga Patriots
description:
Your Patriots, Your Game.

Follow Takashinga Cricket Club with fixtures, results, detailed scorecards and stories from the home of the Patriots.

• Browse upcoming fixtures and published results.
• Explore batting and bowling scorecards, match details and ball-by-ball coverage where published.
• Meet the squads and view player profiles and published competition statistics.
• Check league standings and search club news.
• Enjoy photographs and videos from the club.
• Find ground information, enquire about playing and access club services inside the app.

Previously loaded club information can remain available when your connection is interrupted. Connect to the internet for current scores, new stories, videos and online services.

No app account is required to browse public cricket content. Coverage and statistics depend on information published by the club.

name: TaksiGoo

name: Talado: Thailand Classifieds
description:
Talado is the classifieds app for everyone living in Thailand — Pattaya, Phuket, Bangkok, Koh Samui, Koh Phangan, Hua Hin, Chiang Mai and more.

• Thousands of real listings with real photos: condos and houses for rent, motorbikes and cars, electronics, furniture, clothes, jobs and services.
• No junk: every listing passes an automatic check, spam, scams and prohibited items are filtered out.
• Message the seller in one tap — chats are protected from scammers.
• Where to eat: street food, markets and cafés recommended by real people, with prices and opening hours.
• Events: parties, concerts, Muay Thai, markets and festivals — where to go today and this weekend.
• Choose your city and see only what is near you.
• Three languages: English, Russian and Thai.

Posting is free.

name: Talktray: Voice Notes & To-Do
description:
Talktray turns your voice notes into a to-do list. Tap the mic, say what’s on your mind, and AI speech-to-text transcribes it and sorts it into tasks, reminders, events, shopping lists and notes — in seconds. A voice memo app, AI note taker and reminder app in one.

One sentence like “Call Alex tomorrow at 9, dentist Friday at 2, remind me 30 minutes before, and add oat milk to the list” becomes four neat items with the right dates and times.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tap and talk — natural speech, no special commands
• Accurate speech-to-text powered by Whisper
• AI splits one thought into separate tasks, reminders, events, shopping items and notes
• Review and edit everything before it’s saved

STAY ON TOP OF YOUR DAY
• Reminders with notifications right on time
• Get a heads-up before something is due: 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes, 1 hour or 1 day before — or just say “10 minutes before”
• Set your default alert once in Settings
• Overdue items are clearly marked, so nothing slips through
• Today view with what’s coming up next
• Add confirmed events and reminders to your calendar
• Tasks and notes lists you can check off and edit

MADE FOR REAL LIFE
• Works in 10 languages: English, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean and Indonesian
• Mix Turkish and English in the same thought
• Widgets and shortcuts open straight into recording
• Light and dark mode
• Sign in with Apple, Google or email and pick your own username

PERFECT FOR
• Brain dumps and quick ideas on the go
• Voice reminders and daily to-do lists
• Dictation when typing is too slow — while walking or cooking
• Shopping and grocery lists you just say out loud
• Anyone who forgets what they meant to write down

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads. No tracking across other apps. We never sell your data.
• The microphone is only used while you record
• Export your data, delete recordings or delete your account anytime in Settings

FREE AND PRO
Talktray is free with 25 recordings a month. Talktray Pro (monthly or yearly) gives you a much larger fair-use allowance of 300 recordings a month.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://enesseyit22-create.github.io/Talktray/privacy.html

name: Tallysplit
description:
Before paper money, a debt was a stick with notches, split in two so both sides could keep honest.

Tallysplit is a market arithmetic puzzle. Cut notches for the amount owed, split the stick lengthwise, and hand one half to each villager. Later, settle disputes by matching halves and catching anyone who added a notch.

- Notches of different widths for ones, tens and hundreds
- A satisfying full-length split every time
- Puzzles that reward the fewest notches
- Forgery cases where the halves do not match
- Market days, fairs and a tax collector
- A daily dispute for every player

Cut honest. Split clean.

name: Tango Life Online
description:
Tango Life Online giúp giáo viên tango chuẩn bị, luyện trước và tổ chức một buổi học thật mạch lạc ngay trên iPhone. Tạo giáo án theo mục tiêu và trình độ, sắp xếp bài tập, ghép chuỗi động tác, thêm ghi chú và video minh họa để vào lớp luôn sẵn sàng.

Tính năng nổi bật
- Tạo bài học theo mục tiêu, trình độ và thời lượng để quản lý lớp học rõ ràng hơn
- Thư viện bài tập tango nền tảng với minh họa lớn, mô tả ngắn và các bước trọng tâm dễ theo dõi
- Ghép động tác thành chuỗi, đặt thứ tự, số lần lặp và luyện lại từng phần khi cần
- Thêm nhịp điệu và chỉnh tốc độ để luyện theo tiết tấu phù hợp với từng bài
- Quay video mẫu bằng camera hoặc chọn video có sẵn từ thiết bị để gắn vào bài tập
- Chuẩn bị trước giờ học với toàn bộ chương trình, ghi chú, thời lượng và tài liệu đính kèm
- Chế độ dạy học hiển thị bài hiện tại thật lớn, có hẹn giờ và cho phép chuyển nhanh giữa các khối
- Tạo kế hoạch trực quan cho học viên với hình minh họa, mô tả ngắn và xem trước trước khi chia sẻ

Phù hợp cho
- Giáo viên tango cần soạn bài nhanh, đẹp và dễ kiểm soát trong lớp
- Người dạy muốn lưu lại giáo án, luyện lại động tác và chuẩn bị nội dung gửi cho học viên
- Buổi tập cá nhân, lớp nhóm nhỏ hoặc lớp online cần chương trình rõ ràng

Vì sao nên chọn Tango Life Online
Ứng dụng được thiết kế để hỗ trợ toàn bộ quy trình từ soạn bài, luyện chuỗi động tác đến điều hành lớp học. Giao diện chú trọng hình ảnh lớn, thao tác kéo thả trực quan và các ghi chú ngắn gọn, giúp bạn tập trung vào cách dạy thay vì mất thời gian sắp xếp thủ công. Dữ liệu bài học, chuỗi động tác và video cá nhân được lưu trên thiết bị, nhiều chức năng vẫn dùng được khi không có internet.

Hãy bắt đầu tạo giáo án tango của riêng bạn ngay hôm nay, luyện trước tự tin hơn và mang đến cho học viên một kế hoạch học tập thật rõ ràng.

name: Tanks 90: Retro Tank Battle
description:
Remember blasting tanks on an 8-bit console after school? Tanks 90 brings that feeling back — inside a pocket retro console on your iPhone.

Defend your base, destroy enemy tanks and fight through 50 levels that get tougher as you go.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 50 levels, from a one-on-one duel to waves of 20 enemies
• D-pad and A/B buttons — controls that feel like a classic console
• Break bricks, hide behind steel, avoid water, sneak through bushes, slide on ice
• Regular, fast and heavy enemy tanks, each with its own tactics
• Power-ups: star, helmet, clock, shovel, bomb and extra life
• Collect three stars and your tank changes look and shoots through steel
• Original chiptune music and sound effects, each with its own toggle
• Stage results, high scores and saved progress
• Pick your console's shell color

FAIR PLAY
No in-game currency. The first 10 levels are free. Each short video unlocks 3 more levels. Or buy the full game once — forever, no ads.

Blow the dust off the cartridge and roll out!

name: Tanzul

Tanzul es la app de citas para conocer gente real y quedar de verdad, sin ghosting.

TANZUL PLUS Y VIP
Suscripciones opcionales con más visibilidad, likes ilimitados, ver a quién le gustas, boosts y rewind. Los precios se muestran en la app antes de comprar. La suscripción se renueva automáticamente salvo que la canceles al menos 24 horas antes del final del periodo actual. Puedes gestionarla o cancelarla en los ajustes de tu cuenta del App Store.

Política de privacidad: https://api.tanzul.com/privacidad

name: Target Stones
description:
Think. Calculate. Connect.

Target Stones is a calm, elegant number puzzle. Every round gives you a target and a handful of numbered stones. Combine any two stones with +, −, × or ÷ and they glide together into a new stone. Reach the target exactly, or get as close as you can. No pressure, just good thinking, with an optional clock for those who enjoy a little challenge.

LIVING STONES
Every calculation physically transforms the board. Two stones merge into one, and the new stone remembers how it was made. Long press any merged stone to see its full history.

SIX WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: endless puzzles with difficulty that adapts gently to how you play.
• Nine Stones: the same rules on a three-by-three board. More stones, more routes, more to plan.
• Daily Challenge: one shared puzzle each day. Everyone gets the same stones.
• Relax: large stones, high contrast, unlimited hints and no negative feedback. Designed with older adults in mind.
• Memory: after each calculation, recall which two stones you combined.
• Online Duel: face another player through Game Center on the same stones. Choose a 1, 2, 3 or 5 minute clock; closest to the target wins. Practice against the computer when you are offline.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Every solo mode is untimed by default. If you enjoy a little pressure, turn on an optional round clock of 1, 2, 3 or 5 minutes in Settings. When time runs out, your closest stone still earns partial credit.

FIVE LEVELS, ONE RULE
From Beginner (targets 10–50, one step) to Expert (targets up to 999, multistep). Every puzzle is verified to have at least one exact solution before it reaches you, and results always stay positive whole numbers.

THOUGHTFUL HINTS
Four gentle hint levels, always based on a real solution from your current stones: a stone to start with, two stones to combine, the operation to use, or the next complete calculation. Hints never cost points.

SCORING THAT REWARDS THINKING
Exact matches earn the most, with bonuses for efficient solutions, solving without hints and discovering routes the solver did not expect. Speed is never scored.

MADE TO BE ACCESSIBLE
Dynamic Type, VoiceOver labels for every stone and step, large touch targets, Reduce Motion support, adjustable animation speed, high-contrast colors, optional sound and haptics, and feedback that never relies on color alone.

YOUR PROGRESS, YOUR DEVICE
Statistics, streaks and daily results are stored only on your device. No account, no ads and no data collection. Solo modes work fully offline.

Target Stones is an enjoyable number puzzle that encourages mental arithmetic, working memory and planning. It is not a medical product and makes no health claims.

name: Tarry: Pray Before You Scroll
description:
Tarry gives your day a quiet moment.

Every morning there is one verse, chosen from 365 hand-picked passages, in the World English Bible or the King James Version. Read it slowly, take a breath, and hold the button to say Amen. That is the whole practice. It takes about a minute.

PRAY BEFORE YOU SCROLL
Pick the apps that pull at you. In about a minute, set up a small automation in Apple's Shortcuts app (Tarry guides you step by step), and Tarry will open first with a verse and a moment of quiet. Then your app opens, for 15 minutes, 30 minutes or an hour, as you choose. iOS requires you to create this automation yourself, and Tarry checks that it is connected.

A STREAK THAT FORGIVES
Tarry counts the days you pray. Miss a day and one grace day a week keeps your streak safe. No guilt, no scolding.

VERSE WIDGETS
Today's verse on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, in parchment, night and more.

HONEST BY DESIGN
No ads. No account. Nothing leaves your phone. Both Bibles are in the public domain. The daily pause is free, always.

TARRY PLUS (optional)
Pause as many apps as you like, widgets in every size and style, and all 365 verses by what you are feeling, with saved verses and history.
Yearly: $34.99, with a 7-day free trial. Weekly: $3.99.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (after the free trial for the yearly plan). Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://gettarry.weenjahq.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://gettarry.weenjahq.com/privacy

name: TaskForLife: Widget To-Do
description:
TaskForLife lets you finish tasks and keep daily routines right from your Home Screen widgets — no need to open the app.

TASKS
• Tap a task in the widget to finish it
• Overdue tasks turn red; tasks a week or more away turn blue
• Tasks with due dates are added to your iPhone Calendar automatically (you can turn this off)
• A 9 PM reminder if anything is left for today

ROUTINES
• Track the last 7 days on a ○/× grid. Tap today's square for ○
• Miss a day and it turns into × — no hiding
• Choose which weekdays each routine is for (other days show as a rest day)
• Today's remaining routines appear on top of your task widget, so you see them every day
• Lock Screen widget shows how many are left today
• Look back on every day's ○ and × in a monthly calendar

UNDO ANYTIME
• Tasks you finish today are listed under "Done Today" in the app — tap to undo
• Finished and deleted tasks stay in History for 30 days — tap to restore

PRIVATE
• No account, no ads
• Your data stays on your iPhone

One purchase unlocks everything forever. No in-app purchases or subscriptions.

name: Tavera
description:
Run your trade business from your pocket. Tavera turns job site photos into polished, professional reports, and handles the paperwork that comes before and after: quotes, invoices, expenses, customer records, customer appointments, PDF Tools and business analytics, all in one app.

Snap photos on site, add notes, and build a finished report in minutes. Share it as a clean PDF with your client before you leave the driveway.

KEY FEATURES

Job Reports and Photos
Capture job photos, organize them into sections, and lay them out as a professional PDF report your clients can trust.

Quotes and Invoices
Create quotes, get signatures, convert accepted quotes into invoices, and track what has been paid and what is overdue.

Expenses and Job Profit
Log materials, labor, and receipts against each job so you always know what you actually earned.

Customers and Appointments
Keep every customer's history in one place and manage your schedule with a built-in calendar and reminders.

Business Reports and Insights
See revenue, quote conversion, and customer trends at a glance, and export your records to Excel.

PDF Tools
Scan documents to PDF, merge multiple PDF files into one, compress PDFs to reduce their size, convert phone images to PDF and password protect PDF files.

YOUR BUSINESS. YOUR DATA. YOUR PRIVACY.

We believe your business information should stay yours. That's why Tavera takes a privacy-first approach, keeping your customer records, job photos, invoices, expenses, and business documents stored locally on your iPhone.

No ads, no activity tracking, and no uploading your business data to our servers. Just powerful business tools designed to give you complete control over your information, without compromising your privacy.

Tavera is free to explore, with monthly usage limits on the core features. Upgrade to Pro Monthly or buy Lifetime Pro once for unlimited jobs, customers, quotes, invoices, expenses,  business reports and documents.

Download Tavera today and start sending professional paperwork that wins more work.

Subscriptions auto-renew monthly unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Tawil Manager
description:
Tawil Manager is the mobile companion to the Tawil Technologies property management platform — everything a property manager needs between showings, inspections, and the office.

TODAY
• One screen for what needs you now: emergencies, new maintenance requests, failed payments, and unread messages

MESSAGES
• Every tenant conversation in one inbox, with the lease and balance right there in the thread
• Quick replies, photo attachments, and internal notes your tenants never see

TENANTS, PROPERTIES & LEASES
• Look up any tenant, unit, or lease and edit the details on the spot
• Create and renew leases, attach the lease from your camera or files, send it for e-signature, and countersign right in the app
• Add or remove people on a lease and invite tenants to their portal

MAINTENANCE
• Triage requests by status and priority, assign a vendor, and schedule the visit — the tenant is told automatically
• Snap photos from the unit, attach them to the work order, and share the job with a contractor in one tap

MONEY
• Rent collected vs. billed this month, open receivables, bank balances, and recent payments — live from your books
• Got a check or cash? Record it and it's posted and applied to what's owed, with a receipt emailed to the tenant

REPORTS
• Profit & loss with a monthly trend, rent roll, collections and AR aging, and owner statements, filterable by property

NOTIFICATIONS
• Push alerts for new requests, tenant messages, and payment problems — choose exactly which ones you get

A Tawil Technologies property manager or administrator account is required to sign in. Residents use the Resident Portal app.

name: Tearly: Tear Off Calendar
description:
The tear-off calendar that used to hang by the kitchen door, now in your pocket.

Every morning there is a fresh page: the big date, the weekday and the month, the phase of the moon, the day and week of the year, and a short line from an old almanac. Pull the page down and it tears along the perforation, with the rasp of paper and a small tick under your thumb, then flutters away. The torn stub stays at the top of the pad.

Turn a page over to write one line on the back: a note, a mood, something you're grateful for. Every page you tear off is kept, so you can flip back through your year one day at a time.

• Tear it your way: drag from either corner, stop halfway, or flick it off
• One line on the back of every page, kept with the torn pages you can browse by month
• Send any page, front or back, as a paper-textured picture
• Three original papers: Classic red and black, Minimal and Vintage
• The moon's phase on every page, plus the day and week of the year
• Sayings from public-domain works by Franklin, Thoreau, Emerson, Shakespeare and others, with their sources
• Missed a few days? The pad waits for you; tear them all off at once
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with today's page
• Optional morning reminder
• The tearing sound and the haptics each have their own switch in Settings

What you write on the back stays in the app, on this phone. No account, no ads, and no connection needed.

name: TECON
description:
TECON là ứng dụng quản lý thi công dành cho nhà thầu cơ điện (M&E). Chỉ huy trưởng, kỹ sư hiện trường, QA/QC, cung ứng và ban giám đốc làm việc trên cùng một hệ thống với bản web, số liệu luôn khớp giữa văn phòng và công trường.

VIỆC HÔM NAY • Một màn gom việc được giao, phiếu lỗi cần sửa, nhật ký cần ghi của mọi công trình bạn phụ trách. • Giao việc, nhận việc, báo xong kèm ảnh hiện trường; người giao kiểm và duyệt ngay trên app.

CHẤM CÔNG GPS • Vào ca, ra ca bằng vị trí trong bán kính công trình. • Đi trễ hoặc quên chấm công thì gửi giải trình; chỉ huy trưởng duyệt ngay trên app.

NHẬT KÝ CÔNG TRƯỜNG • Ghi nhật ký hằng ngày: thời tiết, nhân lực theo đội, khối lượng, ảnh. • Đọc bằng giọng nói, ứng dụng soạn sẵn bản nháp để bạn sửa và gửi. • Chỉ huy trưởng xác nhận nhật ký của công trình.

CHẤT LƯỢNG VÀ AN TOÀN • Nghiệm thu nhiều cấp: kỹ sư tự kiểm, QA/QC, chỉ huy trưởng, tổng thầu; nhập số đo theo tiêu chí. • Phiếu lỗi kèm ảnh, giao đội sửa, kiểm lại sau khi sửa. • Kiểm tra an toàn, ghi vi phạm, báo cáo sự cố.

VẬT TƯ VÀ CUNG ỨNG • Kế hoạch vật tư theo dự toán, đề nghị mua, theo dõi đặt hàng. • Nhập kho, xuất kho, kiểm kê tại công trình.

KHỐI LƯỢNG VÀ PHÁT SINH • Lập đợt đo khối lượng, phiếu phát sinh, theo dõi từng bước duyệt.

PHÊ DUYỆT MỘT CHẠM • Tab «Chờ duyệt» gom mọi việc đang chờ bạn từ mọi phân hệ, việc chờ lâu nhất ở trên cùng. • Thông báo đẩy khi có việc mới, việc được duyệt hay sự cố khẩn.

TÀI KHOẢN • Ai cũng có thể tự đăng ký tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng, miễn phí. • Khi được thêm vào dự án, bạn có quyền theo vai trò của mình trong dự án đó; mỗi người chỉ thấy dự án mình tham gia. • Tự xoá tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng.

name: Tell Don’t Show: Team Mystery
description:
Nobody at this table can solve the case alone.

Everyone takes a turn with the phone and reads a private witness statement behind fogged glass. You rub the fog away with a finger, take it in, then turn the phone face down and hand it on. When the last person has read, the phone goes in the middle of the table, the clock starts, and the only way to share what you know is to say it out loud. No showing. Just your memory and your own words.

Somewhere between what the night porter saw, what the cloakroom attendant remembers and what the lab found, there is one name. Your friend holds the clue that makes yours make sense. You hold the one that clears their favourite suspect. Half the fun is realising, three minutes in, that you all heard something different.

Swipe suspects off the board as you talk them through. Forgot a detail? Take a second look, but it comes off everyone's clock. And when the whole group finally agrees, you get one warrant: all hands on the glass, fingers held down together, while the suspects go dark one by one.

There are no points, no ranks and no one left out. You close the case as a crew or it goes cold as a crew, and either way you get to see exactly how the pieces fit together.

Each case is built fresh, so a location never plays the same way twice. Work a stolen brooch at a Vienna hotel ball, a vanished violin on a night train to Trieste, a missing tile at a Lisbon gallery, a lost film reel in a Roman studio and a stolen ledger in a stormy Bergen harbour. Rookie, Inspector and Chief levels decide how tangled the evidence gets, and every case your crew takes on stays pinned to your agency's wall.

Made for three to eight people who would rather crack something together than compete. Game nights, family evenings, dinner tables, long trips. It is all thefts and sabotage, nothing grim, so it suits any group.

Open your agency and take your first case.

name: Tempora Metronome
description:
Tempora is a metronome built for musicians who need more than a simple click. Every rhythm you can imagine, with timing accurate to the single audio sample, even at 400 BPM.

ANY RHYTHM
• Tempo from 20 to 400 BPM: drag the number, use the buttons or tap in time
• Any time signature, from 1 to 32 beats, with any note value
• Groupings for compound and odd meters (7/8 = 2+2+3, 3+2+2…)
• Click only on group starts, and BPM that count groups (6/8 at dotted quarter = 60)
• Tap a beat to make it accented, normal, soft or silent
• Subdivisions from eighths to septuplets, with adjustable swing
• Polyrhythms such as 3 against 4 or 5 against 4

YOUR SOUND
• 9 synthesized sounds: click, wood block, clave, cowbell, rim, hi-hat, beep, kick and tick
• Separate sound, pitch and volume for accents, beats, subdivisions and polyrhythm
• Voice count in your device's language, with or without clicks

TRAIN BETTER
• Speed trainer: raise or lower the tempo every few bars up to a target
• Gap trainer: play some bars, then silence, to test your inner time
• Random mute, count-in bars and automatic stop after bars or minutes

FOR REHEARSALS AND GIGS
• Save presets and line them up in setlists that advance by themselves
• Keeps playing with the screen locked, with lock screen controls
• Pulsing beats or pendulum, screen flash and vibration on each beat
• Visual delay adjustment for Bluetooth headphones
• Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac, in 6 languages

PRIVACY
Tempora doesn't use the microphone, collects no data and never connects to the internet. No ads, no tracking.

name: Tennis GOTour
description:
Tennis GOTour - додаток для тих, хто грає в теніс заради змагань. Знаходь турніри, записуйся, стеж за сіткою й дивись, як ростуть твій рівень і місце в рейтингу.

Рівень гри
У профілі є рівень від 1.0 до 7.0. Спочатку ти обираєш його сам, а після турнірних матчів він рахується за результатами ігор. Рівень видно в профілі й поруч з іменем кожного гравця.

Турніри
Шукай турніри за назвою, містом і рівнем. У картці турніру видно дати, формат і учасників. Поки реєстрація відкрита, записатися можна одним дотиком, а передумав - знятися. Статус заявки видно одразу: подано, підтверджено, список очікування.

Сітка й результати
Коли організатор проводить жеребкування, у додатку з'являється сітка. Твій шлях у ній підсвічений, а рахунок матчу з'являється, щойно його вносить організатор.

Рейтинг
Очки дають завершені турніри. Таблицю можна відфільтрувати за категорією й містом, а своє місце видно в профілі та в окремій смужці внизу.

Тренери
У каталозі тренерів є профілі з досвідом і контактами, їх можна відфільтрувати за містом. Натисни "Написати тренеру", залиш повідомлення й контакт, і тренер відповість сам.

Сповіщення
Нагадування про турнір і матч, зміни в сітці, результати та рішення за твоїми заявками. Групи сповіщень вмикаються й вимикаються в профілі.

Що всередині:
• профіль із рівнем від 1.0 до 7.0
• список турнірів із пошуком і фільтрами
• запис і зняття заявки одним дотиком
• сітки й результати матчів
• рейтинг за очки з турнірів
• каталог тренерів
• сповіщення, які ти налаштовуєш сам

Вхід без пароля: код на пошту, Sign in with Apple або Google. Акаунт можна видалити в профілі.

Організатори ведуть турніри у вебкабінеті на app.tennisgotour.com, а в додатку їх бачать усі гравці.

name: Ter-Idzard.nl
description:
Ter-Idzard.nl brengt Ter Idzard, Oldeholtwolde en Nijeholtwolde samen op je iPhone. Lees het dorpsnieuws, ontdek wat er te doen is en vind de mensen achter verenigingen, bedrijven en commissies.

NIEUWS
Lees de nieuwste berichten met foto’s en tekst- en fotocredits. Zoek in het nieuws of schakel nieuwsmeldingen in om op de hoogte te blijven. Eerder geladen tekst blijft beschikbaar als je even geen internet hebt.

AGENDA
Bekijk activiteiten in de dorpen. Stel bij een activiteit met een bekende begintijd een herinnering in, of zet de activiteit via de iOS-agenda-editor in je eigen agenda.

DORPSGIDS
Vind contactgegevens van verenigingen, bedrijven en de commissies en werkgroepen van Plaatselijk Belang. Bel, mail of bezoek hun website vanuit de app.

NIEUWS INSTUREN
Heb je zelf dorpsnieuws? Maak een bericht, kies foto’s en stuur je bijdrage met je eigen mail-app naar de redactie.

De content komt rechtstreeks van ter-idzard.nl. Je kunt de app zonder account gebruiken. Nieuwsmeldingen en herinneringen schakel je zelf in. De app ondersteunt dark mode; nieuws en nieuwsdetails behouden hun witte leesachtergrond.

name: Tern Letters
description:
Read your letters and send documents from your phone or tablet, one calm step at a time.

Tern is built for people who may share a device. Quick exit is on every screen if you need to leave fast.

What you can do
- Read your letters in a built-in PDF viewer. A text version is there for screen readers.
- Send a document: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB. You choose a document type first.
- Send a statement for a hearing. Type it or attach a file. You get a receipt. The app does not promise any result.
- Update your contact details: email, phone, mailing address and a note.
- Choose English or Spanish. The app follows the light or dark setting of your device. You can switch small vibrations on or off.
- Close your account from the Account tab. A web page for deletion requests is also available.

Made for shared devices
- A Quick exit button is on every screen. It signs you out, clears the screen and opens a plain page.
- The app locks after 60 seconds away. Unlock with Face ID, fingerprint or the device passcode.
- It signs you out after 10 minutes without use.
- Letters open on screen. There is no save button.
- A help page lists 911, the National Domestic Violence Hotline and 988. These are links that open your dialer or messages app. Tern does not call or text for you.
- No ads. No tracking by other companies.

Signing in takes your client number, a password and a code from an authenticator app.

Tern Letters is not affiliated with any public body.

Support: https://ternletters.com/support
Privacy: https://ternletters.com/privacy

name: Terra — Earth Atlas
description:
See how Earth changed over 21,000 years.

Terra is an interactive 3D atlas, from the great ice sheets to coastlines we recognize today. Rotate the planet, move closer to mountain ranges and travel between centuries with a simple timeline.

TRAVEL THROUGH TIME
Explore 211 time slices in 100-year steps. Compare the Ice Age and the Holocene, watch ice sheets retreat and see sea levels reshape the land.

CHANGE THE SEASON
Four seasons reveal changing snow, vegetation and sea ice. Season names follow the Northern Hemisphere; the seasonal cycle is reversed in the south.

LOOK CLOSER
Tap a point on Earth for an estimate of its seasonal air temperature. Switch between landscapes, temperature, and ice and snow. Pause the globe to explore at your own pace.

REDISCOVER FAMILIAR PLACES
Visit Beringia, glacial Europe, the Sahara and mountain regions with the built-in guide.

The atlas works offline after installation. No ads, subscriptions or account required. Available in English and Russian.

Terra combines scientific climate reconstructions with illustrative model estimates. Temperatures are seasonal estimates, not weather forecasts. The 100-year step is a way to explore time, not a claim of equal accuracy across every period. The timeline ends at the 1950 reference date; the latest climate slice represents 1900–1990. Sources and an explanation of the method are available in the atlas.

name: TerribleGetin
description:
TerribleGetin is a vibrant Tamil alphabet memory-match puzzle game that challenges your recall, reflexes, and pattern-recognition skills. Watch glowing Tamil letters appear, memorize their positions, then match them from bottom to top before the timer runs out. With bold neon visuals, dynamic scoring mechanics, and progressive difficulty, every level becomes a fresh mental workout.

 Key Features
 Gameplay
	•	Observe & Remember — Glowing Tamil letters flash at the top for 4 seconds
	•	Tap-to-Match — Tap a bottom letter (it glows yellow), then tap its matching top target
	•	Instant Visual Feedback — Green arrowhead lines confirm correct matches; orange lines mark mistakes
	•	Progressive Difficulty — Higher levels introduce rare, complex Tamil characters 
	•	Flip Trick — Tap top circles during observation to hide/show letters and test your memory
	•	30-Second Timer — Every level is a race against the clock
 Unique Scoring Mechanics
	•	Combo Multiplier — Chain correct matches for ×2, ×3, ×4, ×5 multipliers
	•	Speed Bonus — Answer within the first 20 seconds for +20 bonus points
	•	Rarity Bonus — Harder Tamil letters award difficulty × 10 points
	•	Perfect Round Bonus — Match all 5 with zero mistakes for +100 × level
	•	Progressive Formula — (50 × Level × Combo) + Speed + Rarity bonuses
 Authentic Tamil Content
	•	35 Tamil Characters — Full Uyir (vowels), Mei (consonants), and Grantha letters
	•	35 Unique Tamil Words — Each letter paired with a real Tamil word and English meaning
	•	Learning Through Play — Every correct match reveals vocabulary in the activity log
	•	Difficulty Tiers — Letters introduce gradually from Level 1 to Level 5+
Analytics & Logs
	•	Date-Based Analytics — Track accuracy, average time, best score, best level, max combo, and perfect rounds across sessions
	•	Detailed Session History — Every play session timestamped and stored
	•	Action Logs — Full audit trail of every tap, match, timeout, and level transition
	•	Persistent Storage — All data saved locally via UserDefaults

How to Play
	1	Watch — 4 seconds to memorize 5 glowing Tamil letters at the top
	2	Tap Bottom — Select one of the 5 bottom letters (it turns yellow)
	3	Tap Top — Choose the top target you believe matches
	4	Score Points — Correct matches award base + combo + speed + rarity points
	5	Level Up — Complete all 5 matches before the 30-second timer runs out
	6	Don't Lose Lives — Wrong match or timeout = -1 life; reach 0 and it's game over

name: Terviq Malkuo
description:
Terviq Malkuo brings three hand-picked games together inside a warm, lantern-lit palace hall decorated with golden bells and garlands. One is a reflex arcade round, two are friendly card matches against the CPU, and you move between them from the same dashboard.

Bauble Orbit is the signature mechanic. A glass bauble circles a holly wreath, and a single tap hops it between the outside and inside of the ring, slipping past cards planted along the path. You score a point for every card you pass, and collecting all four suit tokens adds a five-point bonus. Touch a card and the round ends, so you learn to read the wreath a few steps ahead. Easy, Medium and Hard pace the orbit so you can ease in and work toward tighter timing.

Nerts puts you side by side with the CPU in a race to empty a thirteen-card pile. You build shared foundations up by suit from Ace to King and keep your four work piles descending in alternating colors. Scoring rewards every card you move to a foundation and subtracts for anything stuck in your pile at the end.

Garbage is the shorter sit-down round. Ten face-down cards stand for Ace through 10, and you turn them all up before the CPU does. Jacks and Queens end your turn, Kings are wild and can fill any spot, and the finisher's opponent gets one last turn to tie.

Settings let you pick a card back, dial the soft focus behind each screen, and toggle snowfall and haptics so the hall feels the way you want it during a short break.

name: Textproof: Text Message to PDF
seller_name: Wenzhou Meiyi Culture Products Co., Ltd.
description:
Turn a text conversation on your iPhone into a clean, printable PDF record. Every message keeps its date, its exact time to the second and who sent it, so you can hand it straight to your lawyer, a court or HR.

Textproof reads the original messages from the Messages app. It doesn't stitch screenshots or guess text from images, so nothing is retyped, cropped or rounded off.

WHAT'S IN THE PDF
• Every message numbered, with the date, the exact time to the second and the sender
• The time zone written on every page
• A summary page: who is in the conversation, the date range, message counts and when it was exported
• Page numbers on every page
• A SHA-256 fingerprint of the whole record, printed on every page
• Reactions (like a thumbs-up) listed as their own entries, just as iPhone saved them
• Places where a message may be missing are marked, not hidden
• US Letter size, easy to print or email

CHECK IT BEFORE YOU EXPORT
• Scroll through the whole conversation first
• Compare the first and last messages with the Messages app
• Search, or jump to any date
• Preview the first 2 pages of the PDF for free

KEEP PRIVATE DETAILS PRIVATE
• Hide a message that has nothing to do with your case
• Cover phone numbers and email addresses with one tap
• Cover any part of a message by hand
Message text and times can never be edited. Anything you hide or cover is noted in the PDF, so the record stays honest.

STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
• No account, no sign-up
• Messages are read and the PDF is made right on this iPhone
• Nothing is uploaded. We don't collect any data.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Add the free Textproof Reader shortcut (one time, takes about a minute)
2. Pick the dates and the conversation
3. Review the messages, then export the PDF and share it

WHO IT'S FOR
People who need a clear record of their texts: custody and co-parenting, divorce, landlord or tenant disputes, workplace issues for HR, or anyone whose lawyer asked to "send me the texts."

GOOD TO KNOW
• Photos and attachments aren't included in the PDF. Where one was sent, the PDF says so.
• Textproof can only export messages that are still on your iPhone.
• Textproof makes a record of your messages. It is not legal advice, and whether a court accepts it is up to the court.

PRICING
Reading, reviewing and previewing are free. To export the full PDF, choose:
• Weekly: $7.99 a week, renews automatically, cancel any time
• 7 Days: $12.99 one time, ends on its own and never renews
• Yearly: $49.99 a year, renews automatically

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings at any time after purchase.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://toolpackpro.com/textproof/privacy/

name: Textstufe
description:
Textstufe estimates how difficult a German text is to read. Paste a passage and get an approximate CEFR level, a ZIX-compatible understandability score, and the figures behind it — all on your iPhone or iPad.

ZIX-COMPATIBLE SCORING
The six features and trained coefficients of the Zurich ZIX model, ported to Swift: sentence length, long-word ratio, A1–B1 vocabulary coverage and word frequency.

HONEST LIMITS
Short input gets no level. At least 50 words in three sentences are required, so “Hallo” never becomes C2. Results close to a level boundary show the neighbouring level as well.

OFFLINE AND PRIVATE
No account, no analytics, no ads, no upload. Text is analysed in memory and never leaves your device.

TWELVE INTERFACE LANGUAGES
English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese and Turkish. The analysed text is always German.

FREE WITH OPTIONAL TIPS
