- Build your ground from a field: a wooden stand, a tea hut, floodlights, and bigger crowds every season
- Climb the league table, chase the Village Cup, and survive the derby

A VILLAGE FULL OF STORIES
- Five villages, each with its own jokes and landmarks
- More than 400 village stories, each with choices that matter
- A whole village of characters: a vicar with a lot to say, Nan Doreen, whose cake is cut to the score before it happens, Councillor Treadgold and her measuring wheel, Graham and his clipboard, and the village Gazette, which prints the wrong half of every story
- Every lad has a story: painted faces, shirt numbers, nicknames, quirks and careers that rise and fade
- Rival clubs with their own grounds, bosses and grudges
- "Before the match": many weeks bring one small, optional decision, and you see what it did straight away

EASY TO START, HARD TO PUT DOWN
Short, gentle tips from the club show a new chairman around the first few weeks, and a How to play page is always one tap away in Settings. Quick, cosy sessions you can pause at any time, with a brass band theme tune, village ambience and matchday sound, each of which you can switch off.

If you like football management games, sports sims, British comedy or cosy games with a heart, this one is for you.

Up the village!

name: Upkeep: MTG Life Counter
description:
Upkeep is a fast, no-fuss life tracker for Magic: The Gathering at the table.

BUILT FOR THE WAY YOU ACTUALLY PLAY
• Split screen with every seat rotated to face its player
• Portrait layout, or Wide layout with the phone flat between two sides
• Tap to change life by 1, hold to change it by 5 and then 10
• A running "-7" style badge so everyone sees what just happened
• Big, readable life totals that work across the table

COMMANDER
• 2 to 6 players, starting at 40 life
• Commander damage tracked per opponent, color-coded by player, lethal at 21
• Partner commanders tracked separately
• Commander tax counter for each commander
• Commander damage always lowers life, as the rules say

STANDARD
• 1v1 at 20 life with best-of-3 match tracking
• Automatic winner banner and match score

EVERYTHING ELSE
• Undo and a full history log for table misclicks
• Random first player, dice (d4 to d100), and coin flip
• Screen stays awake during a game
• Clear visual cue when a player is out
• Past games saved on your device

No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Upkeep works offline.

Upkeep is an unofficial fan tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Wizards of the Coast. Magic: The Gathering is a trademark of Wizards of the Coast LLC.

name: Uplink IPTV: Player & Live TV
description:
Uplink IPTV turns the TV service you already have into live TV that feels like cable: numbered channels that stay put, a real guide, your team's game tuned in as it starts, and live TV you can pause and rewind, on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. Your service brings the channels. Uplink makes it TV.

UPLINK INCLUDES NO CHANNELS OR CONTENT
Uplink is a media player. It doesn't include, sell or recommend any channels, playlists or subscriptions. To watch, add a service you're authorized to use: an M3U playlist, an Xtream-compatible login or a Stalker-compatible portal from your provider, your own TV server at home, or your own Jellyfin or Emby server. Everything you watch comes from your service. Screenshots show an invented demo service.

TRY EVERYTHING, THEN UNLOCK ONCE
Live TV, the guide, the keypad, movies and series, favorites, playlists, reminders, Picture in Picture, AirPlay and Google Cast come with every download. Uplink Premium adds Multiview, Sports, Signal Lock, the Lock Screen game tracker, live pause and rewind, catch-up, more profiles, iCloud sync and widgets. Try every feature for 14 days: it isn't a subscription, so nothing renews. Then keep it with one in-app purchase for iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, shared with your family. No ads, no account.

LIVE TV LIKE CABLE
• A numbered lineup by genre, with numbers that stay put when your service reshuffles
• A channel keypad (type 204 and you're there) and swipe zapping
• A guide grid with time jumps and filters, plus What's On, from your service's listings

BUILT FOR GAME DAY
• Follow your teams: Uplink finds their games in your own guide, on every channel that carries them
• Game-day alerts, and Signal Lock switches to the game the moment it starts
• A Lock Screen tracker shows when and where your game is on
• Multiview: up to four channels at once, and you pick the one you hear. Where your service reports it, Uplink checks your plan's stream limit first
• Optional live scores with a score-service key of your own, and Hide Scores to stay spoiler-free

PAUSE, REWIND, CATCH UP
• Pause and rewind live TV, even channels your service doesn't archive, with a temporary buffer on your device. Nothing is recorded
• Start Over and catch-up where your service keeps an archive

MOVIES AND SERIES, PICKED FOR YOU
• Continue Watching, Recently Watched and Watch Later
• Star what you love or mark it Not for Me, and Uplink suggests films and shows from your service's catalog, on your device
• Cast & Crew: tap a director, producer or studio to see what else of theirs your service has

STREAMS THAT HOLD UP
• Dropped streams reconnect by themselves and can switch to a working copy
• When a stream stalls, Uplink says what it can see: your service, your Wi-Fi or the TV, with a timeline of every wait
• Made for one-connection plans: Uplink lets go of one stream before opening the next

ON YOUR TV
• AirPlay and Google Cast. Uplink's own TV player keeps the channel going after you leave Uplink, and starts it again if it drops
• With Premium, live TV can play on the TV from your iPhone's buffer, so your service sees one connection
• Apple TV: the guide, Sports, Multiview and movies, made for the Siri Remote, with a number pad, Top Shelf and frame-rate and HDR matching. Set it up by scanning a code with your iPhone

EVERYONE AT HOME
• Up to six profiles, a parental PIN, Kids profiles, and adult categories hidden
• iCloud sync; widgets for what's on now, Continue Watching and your next game; Control Center and Siri shortcuts
• Help & Tips built in, and Send Feedback goes straight to the developer

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No Uplink account, no ads, no tracking. Your login stays in your Keychain and goes only to your service.

You're responsible for the content you access with Uplink and for having the rights to it. Credits come from Wikidata (CC0). Google Cast is a trademark of Google LLC.

Terms of Use: https://apps.audditude.com/uplinkiptv/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://apps.audditude.com/uplinkiptv/privacy/

name: Vaarbewijs Prep — KVB I & II
description:
Pass your Dutch Klein Vaarbewijs I or II first time. Vaarbewijs Prep trains you for the theory exam with questions we wrote ourselves from the BPR, RPR, Westerschelde shipping regulations and the Shipping Traffic Act, following the exam programme exactly. Every question has an explanation and the article the rule comes from.

FREE
• Study, practice and flashcards on a sample of every topic, with answers and explanations
• A sample of the chartwork exercises (KVB II), with checking and worked solutions
• One full mock exam per licence
• Your mistakes and saved questions

VAARBEWIJS PREP PRO – ONE-TIME PURCHASE
• Every KVB I and KVB II question in every mode
• A clear explanation for every question, with the rule it comes from
• Unlimited mock exams in the CBR format
• Chartwork practice on practice charts, with checking and worked solutions
• The Skipper, your AI tutor, explains every answer
• Your readiness per topic, measured against the pass mark
• Smart mistakes list and spaced repetition
• Your personal study plan up to your exam date
• One-time purchase. No subscription, no account.
THE EXAMS
• Klein Vaarbewijs I: 40 questions in 60 minutes, 80 points, pass from 56 points
• Klein Vaarbewijs II: 23 multiple-choice and 4 open chartwork questions in 90 minutes, 50 points, pass from 35 points
• KVB II also requires KVB I: the KVB II track includes both

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
• Navigation rules, lights, day marks, sound signals and VHF
• Buoyage, waterway signs, bridge clearance and fairway depth
• Engine, fire, gas, life-saving equipment and environment
• Open waters, tides, currents, weather and navigation
• Chartwork: cross bearings, compass course, current triangle, rule of twelfths

The exam is in Dutch, so questions are in Dutch, with an English translation and explanations in English for expats.

The boating season starts in spring: start now and skipper your own boat this spring.

name: Vaultage: Hide Photos
description:
Vaultage keeps the photos, videos, and files you would rather keep to yourself in an encrypted vault on your iPhone or iPad. There is no account, no server, and no cloud sync. Nothing leaves your device unless you export it.

ENCRYPTED ON YOUR DEVICE
Every item is encrypted on your device with AES-256-GCM before anything is written to storage. Filenames, the item list, and the search index are encrypted too.

YOUR OWN LOCK
The vault has its own password, six-digit PIN, or pattern on a 3×3, 4×4, or 5×5 grid, separate from your phone passcode.

PHOTOS, VIDEOS, AND FILES
Import from your photo library or the Files app, or take a photo or video straight into the vault. Originals are stored byte-for-byte, with nothing recompressed.

ALBUMS AND SEPARATE VAULTS
Sort items into albums, or keep some behind their own password in a separate vault. The lock screen never lists them.

PRIVATE SEARCH
Text in photos and supported files can be searched after you unlock. The search index stays encrypted inside the vault and is never shared with Spotlight or iCloud.

STAY DISCREET
Optionally show a working Calculator or Clock while the vault is locked, and switch to an abstract app icon.

BACKUPS ON YOUR TERMS
Your vault is left out of iPhone and iCloud backups. Create an encrypted backup file with its own password and save it wherever you choose. To move to a new iPhone, restore that backup.

NO TRACKING
No sign-up, no analytics, no ads, no trackers.

Important: nobody can reset a forgotten password, PIN, or pattern, including us. Keep the optional recovery key, or make an encrypted backup.

name: Vealth.me Activity Tracking
description:
Vealth.me makes staying active more engaging, social, and rewarding.

Join wellness programmes, track your daily activities, and compete with friends and colleagues through friendly challenges and leaderboards.

With Vealth.me, you can:

• Track your daily activity and progress
• Join wellness programmes and challenges
• Compete with friends and colleagues
• Climb leaderboards and see your ranking
• Stay motivated toward your wellness goals
• Follow your progress over time

Vealth.me brings activity tracking and friendly competition together in one simple platform, helping you stay engaged and build healthier habits alongside your community.

Join a programme, get active, and see how far you can go with Vealth.me.

name: Vekil24: Lawyer Cabinet
description:
Vekil24 is the official mobile cabinet for partner lawyers of the Vekil24.az platform. It works only with an approved lawyer account on the platform; it is not intended for clients.

NEW CASE OFFERS
• See every request routed to you in one list: area of law, city, language and a short summary.
• Each offer shows a countdown to its response deadline.
• Accept an offer in one tap, or decline it with a reason.
• Each offer card shows an AI summary, key facts and what still needs clarifying.
• Use the "Accepting requests" switch and your working hours to control when new requests reach you.

CASES
• Accepted cases are grouped into "In progress" and "Closed".
• Case card: client contact details, one-tap call and WhatsApp.
• AI summary and the points that still need clarifying.
• Open and share the documents attached to a case.
• Notes, tags, the outcome of your client contact, and the case history.
• Close a case and record its outcome.

AI ASSISTANT
• If the AI assistant is enabled for your account, "Continue with AI" opens the case, with its context, in the legalas legal assistant.

SECURITY
• Sign in with an SMS code or a password.
• Face ID / fingerprint lock: after 5 minutes in the background the app asks you to confirm again.
• Screen content is hidden when the app goes to the background.
• Signing out removes the session and downloaded files from the device.

Newly approved lawyers see a "Sample case" to get to know the cabinet.

The app interface is in Azerbaijani.

Not a Vekil24 partner yet? Apply at vekil24.az/az/become-a-lawyer
Support: info@vekil24.az

name: Velara: Sleep Sounds
description:
Velara turns your phone into a calm window on a rainy night.

Choose a scene: rain over the city, a tropical forest with a waterfall, a moonlit beach or a campfire cabin. Then listen as raindrops land on the glass and slowly slide down your screen. Every scene is drawn live and moves gently, so it feels like a real place, not a still picture.

MIX YOUR OWN SOUND
• 14 high-quality recordings: rain on a roof, rain on a tent, drizzle, tropical rain, thunder, campfire, ocean waves, stream, waterfall, fan, cave drips, enchanted forest, spaceship and wind chimes
• Play up to 5 sounds at once and set each volume
• Seamless loops with no gaps or clicks
• Lightning flashes across the scene with the thunder

FALL ASLEEP GENTLY
• Sleep timer: 15 min, 30 min or 1 hour
• The sound fades out slowly at the end, so sudden silence won't wake you
• Keeps playing with the screen locked or while you use other apps
• Play and pause from the Lock Screen and Control Center

YOUR OWN NIGHT
• Use one of your own photos as the background; Velara dims it for the night and adds the rain
• Hide the controls to see only the scene
• The screen dims itself after 90 seconds

LIGHT ON YOUR PHONE
Velara is built to stay cool while charging overnight: animation slows down when you aren't touching the screen, and with the screen locked only the audio runs.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Velara works offline and your photo never leaves your device.

Questions or ideas? Write to velara@nanolabtech.net

name: Velliq.
description:
Velliq turns everyday photos into digital stamps and personal postcards—small keepsakes to collect, revisit, and share.

Made for travelers, pet lovers, and journal keepers, Velliq brings scattered memories into personal collections, from favorite places to everyday moments worth remembering.

Compose photos inside live stamp frames with paper textures, perforated edges, and vintage postmarks. Explore seven frame shapes, and choose a paper-backed finish or a transparent background for your journal or scrapbook.

Organize stamps into themed albums, add meaningful names, and find favorites with search and date sorting.

Create postcards with photos, personal messages, and collected stamps. Adjust each stamp’s position, size, and angle, then save both sides together or separately. Keep your creations on your device, export them to Photos, or share them with someone special.

name: Velvet Filament
description: After a magnetic storm, the lights across five islands have gone dark. Restore 15 lights by choosing a fitting, combining metals and setting heating and cooling cycles. Set the shutter, shield the right sectors from spray and align a crystal to test each design against heat, salt and signal targets. Compare saved samples, follow the clues behind a fractured lens, or make your own designs in the free workshop. The game works offline and is in English.

name: Vendie - Modern Photo Booth
description:
Vendie is a photo booth app for events, made by Vendrato. Run it on an iPad on its own, or use an iPad as the wireless touchscreen for a Mac running the Vendie Mac app. Guests pick a layout, get a countdown, review their shots, then take home a print, scan a QR code for their photos, or receive them by email.

Built for the people running the booth. Each event has its own layouts, colours and logo, and the booth-wide settings can be changed for each event.

Two ways to run it
• Booth on its own: the whole booth runs on one iPad, using the front camera or a USB camera or capture card when one is plugged in.
• Guest screen for a Mac: the Mac handles the camera, printer and storage. The iPad is the touchscreen, finds the Mac over Bonjour, and pairs with the 6-digit code the Mac shows.

Events
• Each event has its own name, colours, logo and layouts.
• Turn GIF, boomerang, filters, sharing, email and phone numbers on or off per event.
• Make an event live when you are ready. Photos are saved per event.

Layouts and prints
• Seven print layouts: Photo Strip, Four Strip, Side by Side, Big + Two, Grid of Four, Full Page and Portrait, including strips and 4×6 prints.
• Your own designs: make a frame in Canva or any design tool, export it as a PNG, and import it as a layout.
• Photo filters that guests choose on the review screen.
• Animated GIF from four quick shots, and boomerang from a 1.5-second burst.
• Virtual backdrops: guests are cut out from their background on the device. If a cut-out fails, the photo is kept as shot.
• AirPrint printing from the iPad, offered only when a printer is available.
• Print limits per guest and per event. Guests choose their copies, up to those limits.

Sharing and email
• A QR code on the result screen. Guests download their photos over the venue's Wi-Fi, so they need to be on that network.
• The share sheet and AirDrop on the iPad.
• Email through your own Resend, Postmark or SendGrid account. The API key stays in the device's Keychain. Offline emails wait in a queue and go out when the connection returns.
• Optional phone-number collection with a required consent tick and a separate marketing opt-in. Vendie does not send texts. You export the list and use your own tools.

Operator tools
• Event report with sessions, prints, emails, gallery views and busiest hours, exported as CSV.
• Hide any session from the guest gallery.
• Export or delete an event's contacts.

Works offline, keeps data on your devices
• Taking photos, applying filters and backdrops, printing and serving the QR gallery do not need the internet.
• No accounts, no sign-in, and no per-event fees or credits.
• Photos, events and contacts stay on the device that runs the booth. The only thing the app sends out is email, through the provider you set up.

Free, with Vendie Pro when you want it
• Every feature is free to use. In the free version, prints, photos and GIFs carry a small "Made with Vendie" mark in one corner.
• Vendie Pro removes the mark. It also removes it from a Mac booth while this iPad is connected as its guest screen.
• Vendie Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or at the end of the trial. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://vendie.vendrato.com/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: https://vendie.vendrato.com/support

name: Vibra Padel Manager 2027
description:
Vibra Padel Manager 2027 is a single-player padel management game. Pick a club or found your own, build your pairs and take it, season after season, towards the top division of its country and the international competitions.

YOUR CLUB
- Leagues in 36 countries, with 76 divisions and more than 1,000 clubs in real cities.
- “Create my club”: name, colours, crest, three kits, sponsors, facilities, squad and captain, in 9 steps.
- Transfers, contracts, staff, scouting, sponsors, facilities and training.
- Keep an eye on your squad’s energy and deal with injuries.

A WHOLE SEASON
- League with promotion and relegation, a national cup and the World Club League.
- Pairs tour with rankings, from Bronze all the way to the Finals.
- A World Cup for national teams every two seasons, with continental championships in between.
- Offers from other clubs when the season ends. In Legend mode, getting sacked ends your career.
- Honours, end-of-season awards and a Hall of Fame.

THE MATCHES
- Watch them live in 2D, 3D or Key mode: the whole match in 2D, with the key points in 3D.
- Five cameras, several speeds and point replays.
- Change tactics whenever you like and talk to your players during the breaks.
- In a hurry? Simulate the match and go straight to the result.
- Quick match, to play one without a career.

LOCKER ROOM AND REWARDS
- Dress your players in the Locker room with kits and rackets from the shop: they wear them in their matches.
- 14 achievements with rewards, a daily reward and Vibra Coins for winning titles.

FREE, WITH OPTIONAL PURCHASES
- Careers are free and unlimited.
- Your first 3 matches are free, whether you watch them live or simulate them. After that, watching a match live takes an optional 30-second video, or all of them forever with “Unlimited matches”.
- Simulating a match is always free.
- Optional purchases: Vibra Coins, energy drinks and medkits.

Players, clubs, brands and competitions are fictional; cities and countries are real. VIBRA PADEL is the developer’s own brand.

In English, Spanish and Catalan.
Support: info@vibrapadel.eu

name: Vice Atlas
description:
Explore a community reconstruction of Leonida, browse approximate landmarks, and plan your next session. Save private map pins and notes, create your own checklists, and track your progress through the included landmarks. The map and directory work offline, and you can export your personal progress as a backup file.

Vice Atlas is an independent companion app. It is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. The map and landmark coordinates are community estimates.

name: Vision browser: Private Web
description:
Clean up a link before you share it. Paste an address into Vision browser, see which tags will be removed, then copy or open the result. The tool runs on your iPhone and works offline.

• Clean links. Remove known campaign tags such as utm_source and gclid while preserving other parameters and the page section. Links with a recognized signature or access token are kept intact.
• Browse privately. Enter a web address or search term in one field. Use multiple tabs, go back in each one and share links.
• Favorites on iPhone. Save the pages you choose and open them again later.
• Start fresh. Choose End session to close all tabs, clear the current browsing history and website data, and return to the start screen.

Vision browser has no accounts, in-app ads or app analytics. Websites and the search provider handle requests under their own policies.

name: Vitreous Sentinel
description:
One glass batch holds a plan, a preparation record and a reason to look back.
Vitreous Sentinel connects those details in an account-free, on-device journal.

RECIPE FOUNDATIONS
Create a glass batch around its intended recipe.
Keep ingredient targets beside the batch they belong to.
Separate planned quantities from materials actually weighed.

THE WEIGHING RECORD
Capture actual weighing information during preparation.
Connect entered amounts to the relevant glass batch.
Revisit the values instead of relying on an unrecorded estimate.

MIXING ACTIVITY
Document mixing work in Batch Logs.
Return to the saved logs when reviewing batch preparation.
Keep the record of work distinct from the intended recipe.

INSIGHTS WITH RECEIPTS
Explore insights built from saved entries.
Open the individual records behind a summary.
Understand where the displayed information came from.

AFTER-SHIFT FOLLOW-UPS
Create Batch Reminders for future tasks.
Allow optional notifications when you choose.
Alerts use the reminder title and batch reference, subject to iOS permission.
Keep future tasks separate from completed activity.

Glass Batches, Batch Logs and Batch Reminders are stored locally in Core Data.
No sign-in or equipment connection is required.
Removing the app may delete its local records.
Vitreous Sentinel does not control mixers or furnaces.
It does not certify recipes, material quality or industrial safety.

name: VlogCam: AI Dual Camera
description:
VlogCam is the camera app made for vloggers. Record moto vlogs, road trips, travel and sports with AI tracking, two cameras at once, live filters and a time & location stamp on every clip.

AI TRACK CAM
Press and hold a person, pet or vehicle on the screen. VlogCam's on-device AI locks on, then zooms and follows it so it stays in frame – great for football, basketball, cycling and kids at play.

SPLIT CAM – FRONT & BACK IN ONE VIDEO
The back camera on top and the front camera below, in a single video. Show the road and your reaction together.

DUAL CAM – TWO CAMERAS, TWO VIDEOS
Record the back and front cameras at the same time and get two separate videos. Or pick just one camera.

LIVE FILTERS
10 cinematic looks – Cine, Teal & Orange, Vivid, Golden Hour, Moody, Film, Clean, Noir, Retro VHS and Night Pop – with a strength slider. See the look live before you record.

TIME & LOCATION ON YOUR VIDEO
Add the date, time and place to your videos. Handy for road trips, deliveries, site visits and travel logs.

SCREEN DIM
Dim the screen while recording to save battery on long rides. Tap once to see the picture again.

MADE FOR RECORDING
• Choose the resolution and frame rate for each camera
• Pause and resume in one video
• Ultra-wide 0.5x and zoom, torch, photo button
• Battery, temperature and free space at a glance
• My Videos: sorted by mode, newest first; share or save to Photos
• 16 languages

Split Cam and Dual Cam with both cameras need an iPhone that can use two cameras at once (iPhone XS, XR and newer).

VLOGCAM PREMIUM
No ads, no watermark, unlimited AI Track Cam and every pro filter. Try Track Cam free for 120 seconds by watching a short ad.

VlogCam Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: VOIDHOP: Planet Leap
description:
Leap from planet to planet. Outrun the void.

Your dot circles a planet. Tap, and it flies off in a straight line. Land on the next planet and you are safe, for a moment. Below you the void is rising, and it does not stop.

One tap is all there is to learn. Timing is everything there is to master.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Tap when the aim line points at the next planet
• Land dead centre for a PERFECT and build a streak
• Skip a planet for bonus points, if you dare
• Bank off the walls when a straight shot will not do
• Keep moving: wait too long and the void takes you

DAILY CHALLENGE
Try a new course every day and see if you can beat your best run.

ENDLESS MODE
Keep leaping for as long as you can. Both modes keep a high-score board on your device.

PLAY OFFLINE
No account, no ads and no in-app purchases. Open it and play.

Runs last seconds. "One more" lasts longer.

name: Voorraad SolvCRM+
description:
Met SolvCRM+ Voorraadbeheer heb je altijd grip op je voorraad. Scan artikelen, registreer voorraadmutaties en voer tellingen uit, zelfs wanneer je tijdelijk geen internetverbinding hebt.

Alles voor je voorraadbeheer in één app

- Actueel voorraadoverzicht: Bekijk je voorraad, recente mutaties en tellingen overzichtelijk bij elkaar.
- Artikelen scannen: Vind artikelen snel terug door QR-codes of barcodes te scannen.
- Voorraad in- en uitboeken: Registreer eenvoudig ontvangen of verbruikte artikelen, direct op locatie.
- Offline voorraad bewerken: Voer tellingen en mutaties uit zonder internetverbinding. Je gegevens worden lokaal opgeslagen en later gesynchroniseerd.
- QR-labels maken en printen: Genereer labels voor je artikelen, kies het gewenste formaat en druk ze eenvoudig af.
- Overzicht van mutaties: Houd inzicht in de voorraadwijzigingen die zijn geregistreerd.

Minder administratie, meer overzicht
Of je nu in het magazijn staat of onderweg bent: met Voorraadbeheer SolvCRM+ heb je de belangrijkste voorraadfuncties direct bij de hand. Zo registreer je voorraadbewegingen op het moment dat ze plaatsvinden en blijft je voorraadadministratie overzichtelijk.

Onderdeel van SolvCRM+
Voorraadbeheer is onderdeel van SolvCRM+, het softwareplatform van Solvware voor het stroomlijnen van bedrijfsprocessen. De app is bedoeld voor medewerkers van organisaties die gebruikmaken van de Voorraadbeheer-module.

name: Vsudu — Tours & Hotels
description:
Vsudu brings your whole trip into one app: package tours with flights, hotels around the world, river and sea cruises, flight and rail tickets, transfers, insurance and excursions.

TOURS
Search package tours from leading tour operators: pick a departure city, country and dates, compare prices, check flights and choose your option. Prices are honest: you always see whether the flight is included.

HOTELS
Hotels in Russia and worldwide with photos, descriptions and reviews. A price map, filters by stars, meals and amenities, and the nearest dates with the best price.

CRUISES
River and sea cruises with itineraries, cabins and prepayment.

TICKETS AND TRANSFERS
Flights, rail tickets and airport-to-hotel transfers, all in one place.

PAYMENT AND DOCUMENTS
Secure card payment. Vouchers and booking documents live in “Trips”. Traveller details are saved so you don’t type them twice.

ASSISTANT
A smart assistant suggests destinations, picks a hotel or tour and answers questions about your trip. It is enabled only with your consent.

YOUR DATA
Delete your account right in the app. Booking documents are kept only as long as the law requires.

Vsudu — choose, book and travel.

name: Waddy Rider
description:
Waddy Rider is the app for delivery riders working with Waddy in Maadi, Cairo. Go online, take orders and track what you earn, all from your phone.

GO ONLINE, GET ORDERS
• Go online or offline with one tap.
• New orders are assigned to you automatically, so there is no need to hunt for them.
• See your active orders and handle more than one at a time.

EVERY DELIVERY, STEP BY STEP
• Each order shows clear steps: pick up, deliver, done.
• See the store, the order number and how far away it is.
• Know exactly when an order is ready to pick up.

YOUR EARNINGS
• See what you will get at the end of the month: your fixed pay plus what you earn from every order.
• Check your earnings for today, this week or this month.
• Fill the bonus circles: every circle is 10 orders. Fill them all and unlock your monthly bonus.

YOUR ORDERS
• Every delivery, day by day, with what you earned from each one.
• Filter to see your cash orders.

CASH ON DELIVERY
• Always know how much cash you are holding.
• Deposit it from the app when it is time.

YOUR PROGRESS
• Today's deliveries, this week and all time.
• Your rating and your days with Waddy.

Waddy Rider is for riders who have joined Waddy. Want to ride with us? Get in touch at waddyapp.com and we will tell you how to join.

Available in English and Arabic.

name: WanYouBle
description:
WanYouBle is a Bluetooth accessory and audio diagnostics tool. Check device connections, test microphone input, and review firmware file information.

BLUETOOTH CONNECTIONS AND DIAGNOSTICS
Scan for nearby connectable BLE accessories, filter by name or UUID, and review signal strength, connection status, GATT services and characteristics, and diagnostic logs.

MICROPHONE TESTS AND LOCAL AUDIO PREVIEW
View the live level from your iPhone microphone. When capture is enabled, hold the PTT button to capture audio and release it to stop. Preview recent audio locally. Up to 10 seconds of preview audio is kept in app memory only; it is not saved as an audio file or uploaded.

HEADPHONES AND AUDIO OUTPUT
Check the current audio output, choose headphones with the system output picker, switch to the iPhone speaker, and adjust system volume.

FIRMWARE FILE VALIDATION
Select a .bin file supplied by the accessory manufacturer to review its size, PID, VID, packet count, and SHA-256 digest. This is a local file check only; the app does not install firmware on an accessory.

THREE APP LANGUAGES
Use Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, or English. Follow the system language or choose a language in the app; your preference is saved.

REQUIREMENTS
Requires an iPhone running iOS 15.0 or later. Basic microphone level tests and phone audio capture work without an accessory. BLE connections and physical button features require a physical iPhone and a compatible accessory; available functions depend on the accessory protocol and firmware. Pair Bluetooth headphones in iPhone Settings before selecting them in the app.

name: Warp Wardens: Space Shooter
description:
Take the controls of a Warden fighter and defend the frontier from pirate raiders, heavy gunships and giant dreadnoughts.

Warp Wardens is a fast 3D space shooter made for short sessions. One stick to fly, one button to fire: lock-on aim assist leads your shots, so you can focus on dodging, dashing and timing your homing missiles.

GAME MODES
• Campaign: 14 missions across two star systems: sweeps, convoy escorts, defence, salvage, hunts, strikes and multi-phase boss fights
• Survival: endless waves that keep getting tougher. How long can you hold out?
• Boss Hunt: take on the Gatebreaker, Captain Vey and the Bastion at three tiers
• Warp Run: random sectors back to back, with a new perk after each one

FEATURES
• 9 ships, each with its own stats and role
• Blasters, scatter guns, plasma cannons, homing missiles and swarm rockets
• Ship upgrades, daily rewards and global leaderboards
• Critical hits, combos up to x5 and enemy ships that break apart into tumbling wreckage

name: Wars Word Game
description:
Wars Word Game puts scrambled letters in circles. Tap them to build the word, then on to the next one. Start at 4 letters and climb to 8; every letter is a point!

ONLINE BATTLE
• Same letters, same order as your rival, 90 seconds. Most points wins.
• See your rival's score live.
• If no opponent turns up, a computer opponent clearly labeled "Bot" steps in, so you never wait.
• Inappropriate nicknames are filtered, and after a match you can report or block your opponent.

MORE MODES
• Classic: every word, a little less time. Beat your best!
• Versus Bot: keep battling even offline.

FEATURES
• Any valid word from the letters counts
• English, Turkish, Spanish and German
• No account, no ads, no in-app purchases
• Free

Made by Ekapex.

name: Warung Life Simulator
description:
Selamat datang di Warung Life Simulator!

Pak Misran baru saja membuka warung kecil di pinggir kampung. Modalnya pas-pasan, tapi mimpinya besar: membiayai kuliah Agus, anaknya, sampai lulus. Bantu Pak Misran menjaga warung dari pagi sampai malam, melayani pembeli satu per satu, dan mengubah warung sederhana menjadi warung paling ramai di kampung.

JAGA WARUNGMU SENDIRI
• Layani pembeli: ambil barang dari rak, masukkan ke kresek, dan hitung kembaliannya.
• Atur stok dan harga jual: mi, beras, telur, gas LPG, galon, paket data, token listrik, sampai es krim.
• Belanja stok lewat aplikasi belanja online di HP, pilih kurir reguler, cepat, atau instan.
• Catat utang pelanggan di buku hutang, dan jangan sampai warung bangkrut!

KEMBANGKAN WARUNG
• Beli upgrade: etalase kaca, kipas angin, WiFi gratis, pembayaran QRIS, CCTV, sampai TV warung.
• Naikkan Level Warung dari warung kecil sampai menjadi Legenda Warung Madura.
• Jalankan promosi supaya pembeli makin ramai.

HIDUP DI KAMPUNG
• Jalan-jalan keliling kampung dan kenali warga dengan cerita mereka masing-masing.
• Ambil kerja sampingan dengan mini-game seru untuk menambah modal.
• Mancing ikan dan petik buah di sawah; ada ikan legendaris yang menunggu ditangkap!
• Jaga energi Pak Misran: ngopi, makan, dan istirahat di rumah.
• Hujan, siang-malam, kucing kampung, dan suasana khas Indonesia.

CERITA YANG MENYENTUH
• Ikuti perjalanan Agus dari pendaftaran kuliah, magang dan kos, sampai juara lomba mahasiswa.
• Setiap level membuka cerita, barang, dan warga baru.

BERSAING DENGAN WARUNG LAIN
• Papan peringkat online: bandingkan jumlah pembeli warungmu dengan warung pemain lain.
• Bagikan capaian warungmu ke teman.

Fitur lain:
• Bisa dimainkan tanpa internet (papan peringkat butuh internet).
• Tersedia dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Inggris.
• Gratis dimainkan, dengan iklan opsional berhadiah. Ada pembelian "Main Tanpa Iklan" sekali beli untuk menghapus semua iklan.

Dibuat dengan cinta oleh NeoPaw Studio. Ikuti Instagram @neopawstudio untuk kabar update terbaru!

name: Wavelane
description:
Make whole songs on your iPhone and iPad: record, make beats, write melodies, mix and export.

RECORD
• Record vocals and instruments from the built-in microphone, headphones or an audio interface
• Hear yourself while recording, with latency compensated so takes land in time
• Metronome, loop and snap to the beat

MAKE BEATS
• Drum machine with 10 synthesized drums: tap steps on the grid, hold for accents and ghost notes
• Swing, tune and decay, level and pan for each drum, 1, 2 or 4 bar patterns

PLAY SYNTHS
• 10 synth sounds: pad, strings, lead, pluck, bass, 808, keys, bell, arp and saw
• Piano roll: tap to add notes, drag to move them, drag the end to make them longer
• Change the tempo and every beat and synth part follows

EDIT AND MIX
• Multitrack timeline: split, copy, fades and clip gain, with undo for everything
• Volume, pan, mute and solo on every track
• A master limiter keeps your mix loud and free of clipping

IMPORT AND EXPORT
• Bring in WAV, AIFF, MP3, AAC, Apple Lossless, FLAC and Ogg Vorbis audio
• Export your song as a 16-bit, 24-bit or 32-bit float WAV and share it anywhere

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: Waza Compare: Martial Arts
description:
Compare technique videos side by side, overlaid, and in slow motion.
Made for karate, boxing, judo, kickboxing, MMA and other martial arts, when you want to see exactly how your form differs from a model's.

SIDE BY SIDE AND OVERLAID
- Import videos from Photos or record one right away
- Play 2–4 videos at once, laid out to look as big as possible for portrait or landscape clips
- Overlay two videos and pin them at the body's center (solar plexus) to spot the difference
- Compare different reps within the same video

SLOW MOTION, FRAME BY FRAME, SYNC
- 0.1× to 1× slow motion and frame-by-frame stepping
- Sync every video to the same moment, such as the stance or the moment of impact
- While syncing, play or step only the selected video

SKELETON LINES AND 3D
- On-device AI draws skeleton lines over the video
- Turn the skeleton into 3D and rotate it to see it from the front, side, back or top
- When several people are in the video, tap the one you want

SHARE
- Turn what you see into a video to send in messages or save to Photos
- Share the whole thing or just the part you choose

FREE AND PLUS
Skeleton lines, 3D, comparing up to 4 videos, syncing and sharing are free.
Plus (one-time purchase) lets you keep 5 or more videos (free: up to 4), save layouts as sets, remove the "Waza Compare" mark from shared videos, and remove the ad on the video list.
If you install by December 13, 2026, everything is free for you.

YOUR DATA
Videos and skeleton analysis stay on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded. No account needed.

Skeleton lines and 3D are estimates. Film the whole body for the best results.

name: Weekfold: Weekly Reset
description:
Weekfold is a weekly reset ritual. Once a week you close the week that ended and start the next one lighter.

DURING THE WEEK
• Keep up to three small intents, every day or just once.
• Tick them as you go. Daily intents show how many days you kept them.
• Leave a note for Sunday whenever something comes up; it waits for you at the reset.

THE RESET
At the time you choose (Sunday 20:00 by default), a guided reset of about fifteen minutes walks you through four steps:
• Last week. Write three things that went well and one lesson, with the days you kept each intent in view.
• Collect. Carry or drop what's unfinished, together with your notes.
• Prepare. A short checklist to set up Monday morning.
• Intent. Up to three intents for the new week.
Rain plays softly in the background if you like. Then you fold the week and it moves to your archive.

ALWAYS AT HAND
• Home-screen widgets on Android and iOS show your week and today's intents; tick them right there.
• One reminder a week for the reset, plus an optional morning reminder for daily intents.
• Light and dark themes, layouts for tablets, and seven languages.

Your weeks stay on your device. There is no account, no server and no ads.

WEEKFOLD PLUS
The core ritual is always free. Plus adds:
• Every prep template: Home, Digital, Finance and Student
• Unlimited archive (the free archive shows the last 4 weeks)
• More reset sounds: waves, wind and a deep hum
• PDF week summary to keep or share your weeks as one file

Plus is available weekly, monthly, yearly, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel them any time in your store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://weekfold-ritual.web.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://weekfold-ritual.web.app/privacy

name: Wellhand
description:
The well is deep, and things fall in.

Wellhand is a gentle game about a village well. Lower the bucket hand over hand, feel the echo tell you how deep you are, and dip at just the right moment to bring up water or something precious someone has lost.

Then haul it up without spilling a drop.

- Two-thumb hand-over-hand rope control
- Echo rings you can see and feel
- Water, keys, bangles and coins to recover
- Seven wells, murky water and fraying rope
- A shelf of everything you have found
- A daily board for the deepest dive

Hand over hand. Steady.

name: welovedPDF
description:
welovedPDF turns paper into clean PDFs and gives you the tools to work with them, all on your iPhone.

SCAN
• Automatic edge detection and perspective correction with the system document camera
• Multi-page scans, with retake, reorder and rotate before you save
• Enhancement presets: Color, Grayscale, Black & White, or the original image
• An interrupted scan is kept and can be resumed

EDIT WITHOUT LOSING QUALITY
• Rotate freely, straighten, crop with four corners, reorder, duplicate and delete pages
• Your original captures are kept, so you can change any edit later
• Imported PDFs are edited losslessly: page order, rotation and crop are changed without re-rendering

FIND ANYTHING
• On-device text recognition makes every scan searchable
• Search the library by name or by the text inside your documents
• Copy recognized text, or export it as TXT or CSV

PDF TOOLS
• Merge PDFs and split them by page ranges
• Compress with four levels and a size estimate for each, or pick a target size
• Add page numbers
• Protect a PDF with a password, or remove one
• Export as PDF, searchable PDF, JPEG, PNG or text

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no analytics
• The app never connects to the internet; files leave your device only when you share them
• Optional Face ID or passcode lock

Also imports PDF, JPEG, PNG, HEIC, TIFF, TXT, RTF and CSV files, and keeps Word, Excel and PowerPoint files for preview and sharing.

name: what if.
description:
# Explore Every Possibility with WhatIf

Big decisions can feel complicated when there are several possible paths. WhatIf helps you organize your thoughts, explore alternatives, and compare potential outcomes in one simple workspace.

Whether you're considering a career change, planning a purchase, comparing opportunities, or making an everyday decision, WhatIf gives you a structured way to think through your options.

## BUILD YOUR DECISION SCENARIOS
Create personalized scenarios by giving your decision a title and describing the question you're trying to answer.

## EXPLORE MULTIPLE OUTCOMES
Add different possibilities and compare the paths available to you. Give each outcome a name and description.

## WEIGH WHAT MATTERS
Create your own evaluation criteria and assign importance weights to each one. Focus on the factors that matter most to your decision.

## COMPARE WITH WEIGHTED SCORES
Rate each outcome against your criteria and let WhatIf calculate weighted scores to help you compare alternatives.

## REVIEW BEST AND LOWEST SCORES
See which option scores highest and lowest based on your selected criteria. Review your comparisons in a clear, organized format.

## SAVE YOUR SCENARIOS
Keep your decision scenarios in one place. Revisit your saved options whenever you need to reconsider your choices.

## A CLEARER WAY TO THINK
WhatIf is designed to make complex choices easier to organize and evaluate.

**Your decisions. Your priorities. Your possibilities.**

Download WhatIf and start exploring your options.

*Note: WhatIf provides organizational and comparison tools. Its scores are based on your own ratings and do not predict actual outcomes or guarantee a particular result.*

name: Where's Wink? Christmas Mouse
description:
Meet Wink, a tiny mouse in a red scarf and flying goggles who sneaks into your home every night of December.

At bedtime, a grown-up hides Wink. In the morning, the kids find a note from Wink, the lights go out, and the hunt begins. They drag a flashlight around the room ("Warmer... so close!") until they spot the red scarf.

HIDE AT NIGHT
• Snap a photo of a real spot in your home and tuck Wink in, behind the fruit bowl or up on a shelf
• Or pick a room in Wink's cottage: the Fireplace, the Tree Room, the Kitchen or the Attic
• Takes about a minute, and you can do it from bed
• Busy night? Autopilot hides Wink in the cottage by morning

FIND IN THE MORNING
• A flashlight hunt in a dark room, with giggles when you get close
• A letter from Wink, written to your kids by name
• A small kindness mission each day, like a hug before lunch or a card for a neighbor

24 BELLS TO CHRISTMAS EVE
Every finished mission hangs a golden bell on Wink's scarf. On Christmas Eve, the kids ring them all to call Santa's sleigh, and Wink flies home. Every hide, letter and photo is saved in the attic scrapbook to look back on next year.

ANYONE YOU LOVE CAN TAKE A TURN
Invite the people in your kids' world: a co-parent, a grandparent far away, an aunt, a godparent, a family friend. A parent approves everyone who joins. When someone hides Wink in a photo of their own home, the kids go looking in their house. Family can send letters and voice notes to Wink's kitchen mailbox, and kids can send back a photo of the mission they finished.

It works just as well with one grown-up and one kid. Inviting others is optional.

MADE FOR REAL DECEMBERS
• Nothing to buy, break or lose. Wink lives in the app
• Take turns, with a gentle reminder on your night
• Works on iPhone and iPad, including the kids' own iPad
• Grown-up tools are locked behind a PIN

PRICE
The first 7 mornings are free. The Season Pass is a one-time purchase that unlocks every morning through Christmas Eve for your whole family circle. No subscription, no ads.

PRIVACY
Kids never make accounts. Your photos and notes are only visible to the people a parent approves, and nothing is ever sold.

Privacy: https://wheres-wink.vercel.app/privacy.html
Terms: https://wheres-wink.vercel.app/terms.html

name: WhereDidIKeep
description:
“Where did I keep it?” Never ask that again.

We all do it. You put your stuff somewhere safe, and six months later it’s gone. Spare keys, warranty cards, chargers, the extra remote: they all vanish right when you need them.

WhereDidIKeep is your personal memory for your stuff. Save where you put something in seconds, and find it whenever you need it.

How it works
It requires internet at the very first launch and then you can save/ask offline. You can use dictation in keyboard to dictate and not type. 

Add a quick note, like “I kept my white tshirt in wardrobe top shelf”.
Search when you need it and find it in seconds.

name: Wickpole
seller_name: SIX STAR MACHINERY INDUSTRY CO., LTD.
description:
When the sun goes down, the street waits for you.

Wickpole is a dusk run up a steep old street. Reach each lamp with your long pole, open the glass, light the wick, and keep moving. The wind will try to undo your work, and the sky is the only clock.

- Extend, hook and light, all in one smooth motion
- The sky itself counts down to full dark
- Lamps on tall posts, low posts and balconies
- Wind, fog and steep hills
- Six districts chosen on a pocket watch
- A shared count of lamps lit each night

Light the way home.

name: Wilayat News
description:
The news that speaks your language.

Wilayat News is one calm front page for the stories that matter. No clutter, no shouting headlines, no endless scroll of noise. Just the news, with the source right there.

READ IT YOUR WAY
Choose English, Hinglish, Gujarati, Hindi or Urdu. Pick your language once and the whole app follows: the stories, the topics, even the buttons. Change it any time in Settings.

SEE WHERE IT CAME FROM
Every story names the outlet it is based on and links straight to the original report. Read the quick version here, then check the source in one tap. You never have to just trust us.

YOUR FEED, YOUR TOPICS
Follow the topics you love, like Politics, Business, Sports, Tech or Environment, and they rise to the top of "For You". Prefer what everyone is reading? Open "Trending". Want the freshest? Tap "Latest".

BREAKING, NOT BOTHERING
Alerts only for the biggest stories. No spam, no midnight pings: quiet hours are built in, and one tap turns alerts off.

YOU HAVE A SAY
Upvote the stories that deserve attention, save the ones for later, follow your favourite publishers. The most-loved news rises to the top.

SHARE IT LIKE A FRONT PAGE
One tap makes a beautiful share card plus a clean WhatsApp message with the headline, summary, place, date, the full story and the original source link.

SPOT A MISTAKE? TELL US
Send a news tip or report a wrong fact straight to our editors. Real people read every message.

HOW OUR STORIES ARE MADE (HONESTLY)
Most stories are written by our newsroom automation: it reads public reporting from named outlets, and an AI model rewrites it in our own words and translates it. Every story links to the original. AI can make mistakes, so if you see one, tap "Report this story".

YOUR PRIVACY
No ads. No tracking. Delete your account any time in Settings.

Download Wilayat News and get the news, in your language, with the receipts.

Privacy Policy: https://wilayat.news/privacy
Terms of Use: https://wilayat.news/terms

name: Winnowick
description:
Winnowick je nonogram: čísla vedľa každého riadku a stĺpca sú dĺžky
ťahy atramentu v poradí, s aspoň jedným čistým štvorcom medzi dvoma ťahmi.
Natierajte dosku, kým nie sú všetky čísla pravdivé a postava sa neobjaví z tmy.

Rozdiel je v platni. Nie je to obdĺžnik. Rohy sa skracujú, jedna strana je
zárezy, a štvorce, ktoré padajú vonku, nie sú štvorce vôbec — nie sú
Ak sú nakreslené, nemôžu byť napísané atramentom a prerušujú beh presne ako čistý štvorec.
Čiara, ktorá obíde chýbajúci roh, stále počíta len to, čo sa zmestí na platňu.

**Riadok vám povie, kedy je správny**

Čísla vedľa riadku sa zmenia na mosadzné v momente, keď sa ich behy zhodujú. Nič nie je
porovnané s odpoveďou, takže mosadzná čiara je pravdivá, nie len blízka. The
Stavová linka vedie priebežný počt, čo je úprimné meradlo pokroku: môžeš
byť takmer hotový a stále nemať nič správne.

**Náznak, ktorý prichádza z čísel**

Požiadaj o pomoc a hra vyrieši tvoju skutočnú situáciu, potom ti ukáže
štvorca, ktorý čísla už rozhodujú — s riadkom alebo stĺpcom, ktorý ho rozhoduje. The
štvorec je orámovaný mosadzou a necháva sa krúžiť, kým sa opäť nedotknete platne, takže
Nikdy si nemusela pamätať, kde dopadla posledná nápoveda. Nie je to recitál uloženého
Odpovedz. Ak je nakreslený štvorec, ku ktorému sa figúrka nedostane, nápoveda to povie,
Pretože nesprávna značka má väčšiu hodnotu ako chýbajúca.

**Tridsať tanierov, každá s jednou odpoveďou**

Tri knihy po desať: päť krát päť, osem krát osem a jedenásť po jedenástich. Každý tanier
prešiel cez herný solver pred vydaním, ktorý počítal aranžmány
atramentu, ktorý povoľujú vytlačené čísla. Jedna odpoveď, nikdy dve. Každá platňa môže byť tiež
Dokončené len uvažovaním, bez akéhokoľvek odhadu v žiadnom bode, čo riešiteľ kontroluje
samostatne a screenshoty z App Store to jasne uvádzajú.

**Ticho**

Žiadne časovače. Žiadne skóre. Žiadna reklama, žiadny nákup v aplikácii, žiadny účet, žiadna analytika, a
Žiadny sieťový kód — hra funguje v režime letu a po serveroch
Svet stíchol. Zvuk a haptiku je možné vypnúť.

Späť, vyčistiť a reštartovať sú zadarmo a vždy dostupné, takže tanier môže byť pokazený a
vymazané bez toho, aby to stálo len čas.

name: Wiplist
description:
Wiplist for iPhone brings your time and expenses with you. Sign in with your existing Wiplist account and keep everything connected to the workspace your team already uses.

TIME
Start a timer in one tap and keep an eye on it from the Lock Screen or Dynamic Island. Stop it to log the time against a project and task, or add and adjust entries manually.

EXPENSES
Take a photo of a receipt or choose one from your library. Wiplist reads the date, supplier, amounts and tax for you to check. Then code the expense and submit it for authorisation.

CONTACTS
Find and view contacts from your Wiplist workspace.

DASHBOARD
See your week at a glance, including hours, billable time and expenses.

Wiplist is for teams that run their projects in Wiplist. Accounts are created by your workspace administrator.

name: Witlings: Brain Games
description:
A five-minute workout for your brain, with a cast of jelly critters to keep you company.

Every day Witlings picks three short games. Each one works a different skill, each takes about a minute, and everyone in the world gets the same three, so you can compare with friends.

SEVEN GAMES

• Afterimage: a few sleeping critters wake up, then doze off. The board turns. Which ones were awake?
• Switch: sort critters by color or by shape, while the rule keeps changing without warning.
• Fireflies: keep your eye on the ones that glowed as the whole swarm drifts.
• Fold: a sheet of paper is folded and punched. What does it look like opened out?
• Running Total: a hungry critter swallows numbers one by one. Keep the total in your head.
• Odd Beat: a rhythm loops and one sound quietly changes. Press when you hear it.
• Tip of the Tongue: a definition, and a word that slowly spells itself out. How soon can you name it?

MADE TO FEEL GOOD

• Critters that blink, watch your finger, cheer when you're right and sulk when you're not
• Sparks, bounces and confetti on every tap
• Soft bell sounds, all tuned to one scale so nothing ever clashes
• A calm night-sky look with no ads, ever

SEE YOURSELF IMPROVE

• A daily streak
• A form chart that shows how each day compares with your personal bests
• A trend line for every game
• A result card to share with friends

FREE TO PLAY EVERY DAY

Today's three games are free, every day. Witlings Unlimited is an optional subscription that adds:

• Every game, any day, as often as you like
• Your full history and trends

Witlings Unlimited is available monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Witlings is a game. It is not a medical product and makes no claim to treat, prevent or diagnose any condition.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://zerodrift.github.io/witlings-privacy/

name: Wolf Country
description:
Take Wolf Country wherever you go with our official app!

Based in Fort Wayne, Indiana, Wolf Country brings you All-Time Country Favorites, featuring the best country music from the 1970s through the 2000s.

From legendary country artists to the unforgettable hits you grew up with, Wolf Country delivers the songs you know and love around the clock.

App Features:

- Listen Live: Stream Wolf Country anytime, anywhere.
- Now Playing: See the current song and artist, along with album artwork when available.
- Recently Played: Browse songs recently heard on Wolf Country.
- Talkback: Record and send a voice message up to 30 seconds long directly to Wolf Country.
- Stay Connected: Easily access our website, Facebook page, and studio email.
- Simple Navigation: Enjoy an easy-to-use listening experience designed for your iPhone.

Whether you're at home, at work, on the road, or just relaxing, Wolf Country brings you the country music that never gets old.

From the classics of the '70s and '80s to the country favorites of the '90s and 2000s, there's always something familiar playing on Wolf Country.

Download the official Wolf Country app and start listening today.

Wolf Country — All-Time Country Favorites.

A Fultz Media Group station.

Visit us at wolfcountryradio.com.

name: Wonderkin
description:
Wonderkin là chú rồng nhỏ sống trong căn phòng của bạn bằng thực tế tăng cường (AR). Nói chuyện với rồng, đưa đồ cho rồng xem, chìa tay ra — rồng nghe, trả lời và ghi nhớ.

TRÒ CHUYỆN
- Gọi "rồng ơi" hoặc gọi tên rồng. Rồng trả lời bằng giọng riêng, tiếng Việt hoặc tiếng Anh.
- Bộ não AI nhỏ chạy hoàn toàn trên iPhone/iPad — không cần mạng, không tài khoản, không máy chủ.
- Vì AI đủ nhỏ để chạy trên máy nên trí thông minh có giới hạn: rồng hiểu tốt câu nói hằng ngày, đôi khi sẽ nói chưa hiểu.

NHÌN VÀ CHẠM
- Đưa đồ vật và hỏi "cái gì đây" — rồng nhận ra đồ quen thuộc và đọc được chữ trên đồ.
- Dạy rồng tên đồ trong nhà, rồng nhớ.
- Mở bàn tay là rồng nhảy lên; cầm đùi gà bằng hai ngón để cho rồng ăn.

MIỄN PHÍ
- Một rồng con, trò chuyện bằng giọng nói, chơi bằng tay, nhận đồ vật.

WONDERKIN PRO (mua một lần, không thuê bao)
- Nuôi thêm 1 bạn thuộc loài bất kỳ: rồng, rùa, cáo, mèo, hươu — mỗi bạn một giọng.
- Thêm nhà, món ăn, đồ chơi.
- Tiến hoá, kèm hướng dẫn cách cho thú tiến hoá.
- Luôn có nút "Khôi phục giao dịch".

RIÊNG TƯ
Camera, micro, nhận dạng giọng nói, giọng đọc và bộ não AI chỉ xử lý trên máy. Wonderkin không thu thập dữ liệu, không quảng cáo, không thống kê. Thanh toán do Apple xử lý.

Cần camera và micro để chơi AR và trò chuyện. Cần máy hỗ trợ ARKit, iOS 16.4 trở lên.

name: Woolly Gate Parade
description:
One sheep goes straight ahead. The next sheep blocks the gate. And Pip? Pip is exactly where your best idea begins.

Welcome to Woolly Gate Parade, a cozy spatial puzzle about bringing a small flock home. Sheep walk in one straight line until something stops them. Move Pip the sheepdog, use the landscape, and let one sheep become the perfect stopping point for another.

Every sheep fills two horizontal tiles and never rotates. Each pen has exactly enough room for the whole flock and two to four doors. A sheep in the wrong spot can block the entrance. Choose the order and parking positions to fill every space.

100 LITTLE PASTURES
Explore five chapters of original puzzles. Discover 100 different pen shapes, increasingly busy flocks, apple trees, and two to four gates. Every level has a verified solution.

PIP IS YOUR LIVING BUMPER
Reposition your helpful sheepdog on an empty tile to create the stop you need. Moving Pip uses one move, so his position is part of the puzzle.

A FEW KIND TOOLS
Drop a hay bale to make a soft, stationary bumper. A lantern reveals the next step on a proven route when your flock is on that trail. Rewind freely to rethink a move, or retry with a fresh supply of tools. Earn daisies through first clears and daily baskets to refill empty packs without purchases.

BEAT THE HUNGRY WOLVES
Four gray wolves wait at the corners. Pack the pen before time runs out and stay within the move allowance. Time at zero or a move beyond the limit brings a playful wolf raid! Pause freezes the clock. Rewind during play restores moves, while time keeps ticking. Retry restores the flock and your full tool pack.

A FARM WITH PERSONALITY
Enjoy a softly painted meadow, squishy buttons, cheerful sheep, animated tool effects, and a little celebration whenever everyone gets home. Adjust sound, haptics, and gentle motion in Settings.

YOUR OWN MEADOW LEAGUE
Compare your best pasture scores on a personal leaderboard stored on this iPhone. No invented opponents, accounts, or online competition.

A QUIET LITTLE ESCAPE
Play the entire campaign offline. No advertising, tracking, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Progress and preferences stay on your device.

A little flock. A clever plan. One gate at a time.

name: Woolly Home: Puzzle & Decor
description:
Welcome to Woolly Home, a cosy puzzle game where fluffy lambs help you knit, merge and decorate!

PUZZLE
Every level is a colourful pixel picture made of wool. Tap a crate and its lambs run out to carry back every stitch of their colour they can reach. Plan your moves, keep the slots free and watch the picture unravel stitch by stitch.

MERGE
The wool you collect goes to your workshop. Drag two matching items together to make something better: yarn becomes a rug, a seed grows into a monstera, a candle turns into a chandelier.

DECORATE
Use your finished items to make each room beautiful. Unlock 5 themed homes with 20 rooms: Countryside Cottage, Seaside Villa, Mountain Chalet, Zen Garden House and City Loft. Each home brings its own puzzle pictures, meadow and workshop items.

FEATURES
- Hundreds of relaxing puzzles that slowly get more challenging
- Hard and very hard levels with bigger rewards
- Mystery crates, locked crates and knotted stitches keep it fresh
- Scissors, Shuffle and extra Slot boosters
- No timers: play at your own pace
- 12 languages

Curl up, tap a crate and let the lambs do the knitting!

name: Word Hunter: Daily Hunt
description:
Word Hunter is a daily word puzzle. Every day at midnight UTC a new 5x5 letter board appears with a six-letter word hidden along a path of touching tiles. You have six guesses to find it.

HOW TO PLAY
- Drag across touching tiles to spell any word of 3 or more letters. Diagonals count.
- Every tile you used lights up with a clue: orange is part of the hidden word, yellow is in the word but on a different tile, grey is not in it.
- Follow the orange tiles and spell the hidden word to win.

ALSO INSIDE
- Classic mode: guess the five-letter word in six tries.
- Streaks, leaderboards and achievements.
- Power-ups for when you are stuck.
- A daily reminder when the new board is ready.
- Play as a guest, or sign up to keep your progress on your phone and on word-hunter.com.

HUNTER PASS (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
The Daily Hunt is free and always will be. Hunter Pass unlocks the past hunts archive, the Classic archive, detailed stats and board themes. Choose monthly or annual. Payment is charged to your Apple Account and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://word-hunter.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://word-hunter.com/privacy

name: WordCrate: Word Sort Puzzle
description:
One word, one crate, one satisfying move at a time.

Welcome to WordCrate: Word Sort Puzzle, a cozy word game where a little sorting becomes a clever challenge. Match words to themed crates, arrange your cards, and make room for the next move. It starts simple, but every new level gives you something fresh to figure out.

A LITTLE MORE THAN WORD SORTING

SORT WORDS INTO CRATES
Match words with categories such as animals, food, and everyday objects. Plan your moves carefully when the board starts to fill up.

FIND HIDDEN WORDS
Trace words across a grid of letters in a relaxing word search challenge.

KEEP A WORD COLLECTION
Look back at words you've encountered, browse by theme, and mark the ones you want to revisit.

PRACTICE A LITTLE EACH DAY
Refresh familiar words with short review challenges and listening exercises.

TAKE A BREAK AT THE WORD POND
Watch fish swim, tap floating word bubbles, and enjoy a quieter moment between puzzles.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Take on a quick word challenge or settle in for a longer sorting session. The core game can be played offline.

Whether you enjoy tidy sorting puzzles, hidden-word searches, or gentle vocabulary practice, WordCrate offers a satisfying little place to unwind.

Find a word. Give it a home. Make room for one more.

name: WorkOut Alarm: Wake Up & Move
description:
Can't stop hitting snooze? WorkOut Alarm won't let you.

When the alarm rings, the only way to turn it off is to get out of bed and move. Lean your iPhone against a wall, step back, and do your reps. The camera counts every one with a live skeleton on screen, and the alarm goes quiet the moment you finish.

HOW IT WORKS
• Set a time, pick push-ups, squats, jumping jacks or sit-ups, and choose how many.
• When it rings, tap the exercise button on the alarm.
• Do your reps in front of the camera. Half reps don't count.
• Done. Good morning.

BUILT TO WAKE YOU UP
• Rings in silent mode, during Focus, and when the app is closed.
• Sound starts quietly and builds up, or wake up to your own songs.
• Close the app mid-alarm and it rings again.
• Optional single snooze: 5 more minutes, but 5 more reps.

KEEP THE STREAK
• See your current and best streak, and a home-screen widget.
• Track total reps, wake-ups, and how long it takes you to get going.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Pose detection runs entirely on your iPhone.
• No video is saved or sent anywhere.
• No account and no ads.

Practise any time from the home screen. No alarm needed.

SUBSCRIPTION
WorkOut Alarm Pro unlocks the app, billed yearly or monthly. The yearly plan starts with a 1-week free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.adarshyadav.com/apps/workout-alarm/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.adarshyadav.com/apps/workout-alarm/privacy

name: Wortnote
description:
Your paper brewing log hates water. Your formulas live in forum posts and dusty PDFs. WortNote puts your recipes, the math and every batch into one offline device.
BUILD A RECIPE
Grain and hop tables with editable potentials and alpha acids. WortNote estimates OG from grain potential and efficiency, scores every hop addition with the Tinseth IBU model (each row shows its own IBU, the pot sums them live), and gives a rough SRM color family so you know what you are aiming at before the first scoop.
RUN A BREW DAY
Strike-water temperature computed from your grain temperature and water/grain ratio — a big number card, recomputed on every input. A water plan covers strike, sparge, pre-boil and post-boil volumes from your evaporation rate. A checklist tracks every step, and the fixed boil timer bar shows the countdown with the hop that should go in right now — no notifications, no network, just open the app.
LOG THE FERMENTATION
Record OG and FG readings; apparent attenuation and ABV update instantly. When you package, the priming calculator converts your target carbonation in volumes to sugar grams per liter and total grams for your batch size.
KEEP THE LEDGER
Batches are grouped by status from Brewed to Consumed, with ratings, four-way tasting notes, full-text export of any batch, and stats for total volume and average rating.
CALCULATORS THAT FILL BACK
Standalone tools for dilution and boil-off (points × volume conservation), attenuation round-trips, priming sugar, strike water and unit reference —including L/kg ↔ qt/lb.
WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
No cloud. No account. No sync. No subscription. No ads. No tracking. No analytics. No third-party SDKs. No recipe database. No instructional brewing content. Your data never leaves your device — the app makes zero network connections, and airplane mode changes nothing.
PRIVACY
Everything is one local JSON file plus three rolling backups on your device. Deleting a batch deletes it for good. Uninstalling deletes everything. Privacy label: Data Not Collected. 
DISCLAIMER
For use only where homebrewing is legal. WortNote is a calculation and record-keeping tool. It does not sell alcohol, does not provide drinking-safety guidance, and does not make health claims. Calculations are estimates from public formulas — verify every number with your own instruments. You are responsible for compliance with your local laws.

name: WristTalk: Two-Way Translator
description:
Talk to anyone, in any language, without reaching for your phone.

WristTalk translates both sides of a live conversation, so each person reads the other in their own language on their wrist.

NO PULLING OUT YOUR PHONE
The point of a watch is that it stays on your wrist. WristTalk listens, translates and displays without you touching anything.

TWO-WAY, NOT ONE-WAY
Both sides of the conversation are translated. Pick two languages and WristTalk handles the routing, so each of you reads the other in your own language.

SEVEN LANGUAGES TO START
Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German and Spanish. Every pair is validated separately — the app refuses a combination it has not been tested with, rather than translating it badly.

BUILT FOR REAL CONVERSATIONS
• Automatic sentence-end detection, so you do not press a button between sentences
• Reconnects by itself when the network drops, and tells you plainly if some speech was lost
• Works on a standalone watch, with no iPhone required
• The two-panel display keeps both languages visible at once

PAY ONCE
¥28 for the whole app, on the App Store. No subscription, no renewal, no minute limits, nothing to cancel. Every feature, including the ones added later.

PRIVACY YOU CAN REASON ABOUT
Audio is streamed to our servers only to be translated. It is processed in memory and discarded — it is never written to disk, and there is no conversation history. We do not use your conversations for advertising, and we do not track you across apps or websites.

Support: https://changshoujiaolian.cn/wristtalk/support.html
Terms of Use: https://changshoujiaolian.cn/wristtalk/terms.html

name: Wrong Evolution
description:
Welcome to the Institute for Wrong Evolution. You are the unpaid intern.

Hatch eggs. Drag two creatures together. Watch them become something worse.

A pigeon becomes a Pigeon With Tie. Then a Pigeon CEO. Then a Board of Directors. A few merges later you are looking at a Pigeon State Crisis, and nobody elected it.

MERGE
• Two of a kind make the next stage. Every stage is a bigger mistake than the last.
• Creatures live in your lab. They wander, argue and drop chaos. Swipe it up.

MUTATE
• Parcels bring catalysts: espresso, tax letters, fake moustaches, golden wigs, Wi-Fi routers.
• Drag one onto a creature and it mutates. DNA tape crosses two species.
• 3,552 possible forms. All of them wrong.

COLLECT
• Every new form goes into the evidence file. Outlines show what is still missing.
• Rare, Epic and Legendary eggs are truly rare.

EXPAND
• Unlock the Kitchen, the Aquarium and the Greenhouse, each with its own species.
• Upgrades you can see: tanks, a robot arm, a wall of lucky horseshoes.
• Fill the escalation bar for triple chaos and raining eggs.

START OVER, BUT WORSE
• Let the ethics board shut your lab down and come back with permanent perks.
• Your creatures keep working while you are away.

No ads. No purchases. No account. Works offline.

name: Wyo Wellness Lab
description: Download the Wyo Wellness Lab app and access your personalized member portal anytime, anywhere. Easily browse and book classes, manage your membership, update your account information, and stay connected with everything happening at Wyo Wellness Lab. Receive important updates, announcements, and event notifications directly through the app. Whether you're scheduling your next visit, exploring available services, or checking upcoming events, the Wyo Wellness Lab app provides a convenient and seamless experience designed to keep you engaged with your wellness journey and connected to your community, all from the palm of your hand.

name: xCamKit: Scanner & Proof
description:
xCamKit keeps one job file for the papers and the site photos of a piece of work, then lets you export them together. There is no account. The files stay on this device.

A JOB FILE
• Open a sample job to see a fictional invoice and a fictional letter already filed
• The job lists what is still missing: no papers, no site photos, a paper with no text, a site photo without a GPS fix, or a checklist step that still needs a photo
• Amounts read from the papers are totaled for each currency
• If a new page looks like one already saved, you can keep it or leave it

PAPERS
• File a paper from the camera, or from Photos, into the open job
• Profiles for a plain page, an ID card, a book, an invoice, a whiteboard, and a photo
• Read the text on the device. Latin, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Devanagari. Thai is not recognized
• The reading view shows the text and the amounts on that page

SITE PHOTOS
• Stamp a site photo with the time, the place, and a photo code
• The place comes from GPS while xCamKit is open. Network time is used when a network time source is available
• A local hash can be checked later. It shows whether the file changed after the shot. It does not prove who took the photo
• A checklist step can take the photo while you shoot
• Length and area measured on a photo are estimates, not AR

EXPORT
• A CSV and a PDF report can be shared without Pro
• Free PDFs can show the word xCamKit. You can turn that mark off. Your own wording needs Pro
• Pro adds a Proof Package, one zip with the report PDF, the photos, a CSV, and a SHA-256 list
• Pro also adds a KMZ map, proof video, clock-in and clock-out timesheets, and a password export that opens only in xCamKit

ADS
On the free app, ads appear in four places: a banner on Papers, a banner on the text hub, a native ad at the end of Kit, and a native ad on the QR page. An app-open ad can appear only after you leave the app and come back, not in the first three minutes, and not more often than every four hours. It does not cover the camera, the crop screen, review, the paywall, or the vault. Pro removes these ads.

Kit, in the menu, also has a QR reader, a QR maker, a level, a color picker, and a tool that removes location data from a photo before you share it.

The interface is available in 14 languages.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
xCamKit Pro (3 months) is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your store account when the purchase is confirmed. It renews every 3 months at the price shown by the store, unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in your store account settings. xCamKit Pro Lifetime is a one-time purchase. The price is the price the store displays at purchase. This text does not state a price.

Privacy Policy: https://cocmap.com/privacy-policy

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Xem Tu Vi: Ziwei & Tarot
description:
Xem Tu Vi Moi Ngay brings traditional Eastern cultural references and personal reflection tools together in one thoughtful app.

EXPLORE YOUR ZIWEI CHART
Create profiles using a birth date, time and birthplace. Explore twelve palaces, stars, chart configurations and period layers. Compare profiles, save notes and bookmarks, and export a chart image or PDF report.

A LIBRARY FOR LEARNING
Browse sample charts, a star dictionary, introductory lessons and classical texts. Consult original Chinese passages where available. Translation coverage varies by content.

DAILY TOOLS
Explore the lunar calendar, solar terms and lunar birthdays. Choose optional reminders scheduled on your device. Discover the feng shui compass, I Ching, Tarot, traditional fortune sticks, numerology and a dream reference library.

MADE FOR PERSONAL USE
• Vietnamese, English and Simplified Chinese interface.
• Light and dark appearance.
• No sign-in required.
• Profiles, notes and bookmarks stored on your device.
• Export, back up and manage your own data.

For cultural learning, entertainment and reflection. Interpretations do not guarantee future events and do not replace medical, legal or financial advice. Do not rely on them for important life decisions.

Support: huytrandevios@gmail.com
Privacy policy: https://sites.google.com/view/xem-tu-vi-moi-ngay-privacy

name: Yearprint: Year in Photos
description:
Your camera roll, set in type. Yearprint counts a year of photos and lays it out as printed-looking cards for your story or feed.

One tap, and your library becomes a set of cards:

• The year: every photo and video, and how many days you were shooting
• Month by month: your biggest month, with a bar for each month
• Busiest day: the day you took the most, and how it compares with a usual day
• Longest streak: days in a row with at least one photo, with a dot for every day of the year
• When you shoot: your weekday and hour
• What you made: photos, Live Photos, videos, screenshots and favorites
• Places: how many different areas you photographed (optional, a number only)
• Highlights: a grid of your own photos, favorites first

STORY OR SQUARE
Every card comes in 9:16 for stories and 1:1 for posts, in three ink colors. Share one card or the whole set with the share sheet, or save them to Photos.

WHAT IT READS, AND WHERE IT STOPS
Yearprint reads the date, type and favorite mark of each photo, and does all the counting on the phone. Locations are read only if you turn on Count places, and then you get a number, never a map. There is no account, no server, no analytics and no ads, and the app makes no network requests at all. A card leaves the phone only when you share it.

LIMITED ACCESS IS FINE
Share all your photos or just some. Yearprint counts what you choose, says so, and has a button to add more.

Pick any year since your oldest photo. Paid up front: no subscription, nothing to unlock later.

name: Yemen Kitchen
description:
Yemen Kitchen is an offline Yemeni recipe app with no account. Browse 42 recipes from Sanaa and the highlands, Aden and the south, Hadramawt and the coast, by category (breakfast, bread, mains, rice, soups, starters, sweets, drinks, spices), with Arabic and English search across names and ingredients.

- Scale servings with automatic quantities
- Step-by-step cooking mode with timers, screen kept awake
- Shopping list that merges matching ingredients and can be shared
- Favorites stored on your device only
- Arabic and English, large text and dark mode
- Timer alerts

No sign-in, no ads, no tracking. Photos are illustrative.

name: Yerg Remodeling
description:
Plan your next project with Yerg Remodeling.

Take or upload room photos, describe the changes you want, and send Bryan Yerg the details for a free quote.

PICTURE YOUR IDEAS
Create one free AI room concept per calendar month, with up to three revisions. Email verification keeps your monthly allowance with you across devices. AI previews are illustrative; products, dimensions, feasibility and final pricing need contractor review.

SAVE YOUR FINISHES
